character_v1.name: Lucy

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Light.

abilities.name: Celestial Guidance
abilities.description: Lucy passively generates 'Celestial Energy' over time. The rate is increased for each Celestial Spirit she has summoned, encouraging aggressive summoning. When a Celestial Spirit is summoned, all allies within a moderate radius gain a 'Celestial Resonance' aura, providing a small buff to either attack damage, defense, or speed (randomly determined for each ally). Lucy benefits from all auras at once. These auras last as long as the spirit is summoned. If a spirit is dismissed or defeated, the aura dissipates. Lucy also gains a small boost to her magic attack for each summoned spirit. Stacking auras of the same type do not increase the effect, it only applies the duration of the newest aura. Aura buff amount is affected by Lucy's 'Luck' stat.
abilities.flavorQuote: The stars align to guide our path!

abilities.name: Spirit Summon: Zone Guardians
abilities.description: Lucy summons two Silver Key Celestial Spirits, Plue and Horologium, to designated locations within a short range. Plue acts as a mobile ward, granting vision and slowing enemies that approach. Horologium functions as a stationary shield, absorbing a moderate amount of damage before disappearing. While either spirit is active, Lucy can expend 'Celestial Energy' to empower them: for Plue, it increases his slow potency and grants him the ability to reveal stealthed units for a short duration; for Horologium, it regenerates its shield strength or redirects a percentage of incoming damage to Lucy, increasing her defense temporarily but also potentially exposing her to danger. These spirits provide 'Celestial Resonance' auras to nearby allies.
abilities.flavorQuote: Come forth and protect us!

abilities.name: Star Dress: Leo Empowerment
abilities.description: Lucy channels the power of Leo, the Lion, donning her Star Dress: Leo Form. In this state, her basic attacks become empowered with 'Regulus', dealing bonus true damage and gaining increased attack speed. Additionally, the 'Celestial Resonance' auras of any summoned spirits are amplified, increasing the magnitude of their buffs by a percentage. While in Leo Form, Lucy can expend 'Celestial Energy' to unleash a 'Regulus Impact', a short-range burst of light that damages and blinds enemies. This Star Dress emphasizes offensive capabilities and enhances spirit support, but reduces her overall defense. When using this ability, Lucy loses the magic attack bonus granted by the passive ability 'Celestial Guidance'.
abilities.flavorQuote: The power of the Lion shines through me!

abilities.name: Constellation Barrier
abilities.description: Lucy weaves a protective barrier using the power of her Celestial Spirits. Upon activation, the nearest allied hero gains a shield that absorbs a significant amount of damage. The strength of the shield is increased for each active Celestial Spirit currently summoned by Lucy. While the shield persists, the target gains increased tenacity, reducing the duration of crowd control effects. Furthermore, Lucy can expend 'Celestial Energy' to grant the shield additional effects based on her active Star Dress: in Leo Form, the shield reflects a portion of incoming damage back to attackers; in Virgo Form, the shield pulses, healing nearby allies for a percentage of the damage absorbed; without a Star Dress, the shield grants the target temporary stealth for a brief duration. The duration of the shield is reduced if broken early.
abilities.flavorQuote: The stars are our shield!

abilities.name: Celestial Grand Cross
abilities.description: Lucy channels her ultimate power, summoning a temporary 'Celestial Grand Cross'. For a duration, all active Celestial Spirits have their abilities greatly enhanced and their effects are amplified. During this time, Lucy's 'Celestial Resonance' aura effects are tripled, and she gains a massive surge of 'Celestial Energy' regeneration. If Lucy is in a Star Dress form, the effects of the 'Grand Cross' are further amplified. In Leo Form, spirit attack damage is converted to true damage; in Virgo Form, spirit shields become invulnerable. If no Star Dress is active, all spirits gain bonus HP and Attack damage. Upon the end of the ultimate, Lucy suffers a temporary reduction to her magic attack and speed as she recovers from the energy expenditure. This ability can change the course of any teamfight.
abilities.flavorQuote: The heavens unleash their might!

character_v1.playstyle: Strategic Zone Control and Buff Enhancement
character_v1.teamSynergy: Lucy excels at supporting teams that benefit from sustained buffs and area control. Her ability to enhance spirit abilities through her ultimate makes her a valuable asset in team fights, particularly when coordinated with spirit-based damage dealers or tanky frontliners.
character_v1.tierSummary: Lucy, despite great magical prowess, has some scaling issues. Her reliance on Celestial Resonance is strong, thus she goes down to A-Tier. KPS is adjusted to reflect that her support role is key. New campaign added to explore synergy and buff her Resonance.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Lucy's kit revolves around strategically summoning spirits and amplifying their effects through Star Dresses and Celestial Energy expenditure. Her passive encourages aggressive summoning, while her active abilities offer a mix of zone control, support, and offensive options.

chapters.title: Whispers of the Stars
chapters.mission: Clear a stage with maximum Starfall stacks.
chapters.summary: Lucy seeks guidance from Wendy on understanding celestial energies.
chapters.resonanceBuff: Celestial Guidance duration increased by 1 second.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Lucy needs to master her Celestial Resonance and guide those lost in darkness.

character_v1.name: Wendy

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Wind.

abilities.name: Vernier Gust
abilities.description: Wendy releases a swift gust of wind, granting herself and a targeted ally within range a burst of speed. Both Wendy and the ally gain X% increased Movement Speed for 4 seconds. If Wendy has at least 3 Sky Charges, consuming 3 Sky Charges enhances this ability, increasing the movement speed bonus to X% and also granting the affected targets immunity to slows for the duration. This ability generates 1 Sky Charge upon use.
abilities.flavorQuote: Swift winds, carry us!

abilities.name: Arms of the Sky Dragon
abilities.description: Wendy empowers a targeted ally with the strength of the Sky Dragon, increasing their Attack Damage and Magic Attack by X% for 5 seconds. If Wendy has at least 5 Sky Charges, she can consume 5 Sky Charges to amplify this enchantment, granting the ally a shield equal to X% of their maximum health that lasts for 3 seconds in addition to the attack boost. The shield also reflects X% of damage taken back to the attacker. This ability generates 2 Sky Charges upon use.
abilities.flavorQuote: May the strength of the dragon guide your strike!

abilities.name: Sky Dragon's Roar
abilities.description: Wendy unleashes a concentrated blast of wind energy in a cone-shaped area in front of her, dealing magic damage to all enemies hit. The damage is equal to X + (X% of Wendy's Magic Attack). Enemies hit are also knocked back a short distance. If Wendy has at least 2 Sky Charges, she can consume 2 Sky Charges to apply a debuff to enemies hit, reducing their attack damage by X% for 3 seconds. This ability also generates 1 Sky Charge.
abilities.flavorQuote: Hear the roar of the heavens!

abilities.name: Gentle Healing Winds
abilities.description: Wendy summons a refreshing breeze, healing herself and all allies within a moderate radius for X + (X% of Wendy's Magic Attack) health over 3 seconds. If Wendy has at least 4 Sky Charges, she can consume 4 Sky Charges to enhance the healing, also cleansing all affected allies of one negative status effect (e.g., stun, slow, poison). This ability prioritizes cleansing hard CC effects. Generates 1 Sky Charge.
abilities.flavorQuote: Let the healing winds soothe your wounds.

abilities.name: Dragon Force Unleashed
abilities.description: Wendy channels her inner dragon, transforming into Dragon Force for 15 seconds. During Dragon Force, Wendy gains increased Magic Attack (X%), Attack Damage (X%), and Healing Power (X%). Additionally, her basic attacks apply a small heal over time effect to allies, healing for X health every second. Activating Dragon Force consumes all Sky Charges. For every Sky Charge consumed, the duration of Dragon Force is extended by 0.5 seconds, up to a maximum of 5 additional seconds. After Dragon Force ends, Wendy suffers from 'Draconic Exhaustion,' reducing her Speed and Magic Attack by X% for 5 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: I am the Sky Dragon!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Wendy excels in teams that benefit from attack damage and magic attack buffs, and who can capitalize on the burst healing and damage potential of her Dragon Force form. She pairs well with damage-heavy melee characters and mages.
character_v1.tierSummary: Wendy's kit is potent but reliant on stacking Sky Charges. B+ Tier reflects moderate impact. Campaign to boost her heal synergy with Lucy is added.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Wendy's kit revolves around generating and spending Sky Charges to enhance her supportive abilities and Dragon Force transformation. Mastering Sky Charge management is key to maximizing her effectiveness.

chapters.title: Sky Dragon's Courage
chapters.mission: Use Dragon Force 3 times.
chapters.summary: Wendy gains insight into her own potential by helping Lucy find her Courage.
chapters.resonanceBuff: Increased heal amount from Arms of the Sky Dragon.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Wendy must learn the true meaning of Dragon Force and its impact on her friends.

character_v1.name: Gray

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Wind.

abilities.name: Ice-Make: Floor
abilities.description: Gray freezes the ground in a target area, creating a slippery ice patch that lasts for 5 seconds. Enemies moving through the area are slowed by 25%. Upon cast, Gray gains 1 Ice Stack. If Gray has 3 Ice Stacks, the slow is increased to 50%, and the ice patch persists for 8 seconds. The affected area is circular with a radius of 200 units, chilling all who dare to cross its frosty expanse. The ability has a cooldown of 8 seconds, encouraging strategic placement for maximum control. Beware, allies are also affected by the slippery terrain, requiring careful coordination.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time to even the playing field... literally.

abilities.name: Ice-Make: Shield
abilities.description: Gray creates a shield of ice in front of him, blocking incoming damage. The shield absorbs up to 300 damage and lasts for 3 seconds. Upon cast, Gray gains 1 Ice Stack. If Gray has 3 Ice Stacks, the shield's duration is extended to 5 seconds, and it reflects 20% of the damage back to the attacker. Using this ability also cleanses Gray of any debuffs. The ability has a cooldown of 12 seconds. The shield projects forward in a cone, providing protection against frontal assaults. It's a versatile defense tool for both protecting Gray and his allies. Smart timing is key to maximizing its damage mitigation potential, turning defense into a counter-offensive opportunity.
abilities.flavorQuote: Try and break through this!

abilities.name: Ice Blade: Seven Slice Dance
abilities.description: Gray creates ice blades on his forearms and rapidly slashes at a targeted enemy seven times. Each slash deals 50 damage. Upon cast, Gray gains 1 Ice Stack. If Gray has 3 Ice Stacks, the final slash deals 150 bonus true damage and applies a stacking Frostbite debuff, reducing the target's speed by 5% for each stack, up to a maximum of 25%. The ability has a cooldown of 10 seconds. This flurry of attacks can quickly melt away an opponent's health bar, especially when amplified. The Frostbite debuff adds an additional layer of control, making it easier to chase down or kite enemies. Mastering the timing of this ability can turn the tide of a close encounter, leaving opponents frozen in fear.
abilities.flavorQuote: Seven slices... and you're done.

abilities.name: Cold Body (Signature Passive)
abilities.description: Gray's training in the cold grants him increased tenacity. He gains 10% Crowd Control Reduction. Additionally, every time Gray loses 20% of his maximum HP, he unconsciously removes an article of clothing, gaining 5% bonus movement speed for 5 seconds (stacks up to 3 times). This effect has a 15 second cooldown. When Gray reaches max stacks, he also gains 5 armor. The stripping is purely visual and comedic, adding to Gray's unique charm. This passive ensures that Gray remains resilient in the face of adversity, gaining an edge as the fight intensifies. Balancing risk and reward, this ability encapsulates Gray's character and adds a layer of depth to his survivability. This ability doesn't provide Ice Stacks.
abilities.flavorQuote: It's getting a little warm in here...

abilities.name: Ice Devil's Rage
abilities.description: Gray unleashes a massive beam of freezing air from his mouth, dealing 400 magic damage to enemies in a line. The beam also creates a persistent ice wall along its path, lasting for 4 seconds, that blocks movement. Enemies caught in the initial blast are slowed by 40% for 2 seconds. This ability consumes all Ice Stacks. For each stack consumed, the width of the beam and the length of the ice wall are increased by 25%. The ability has a cooldown of 90 seconds. The Ice Devil's Rage is a devastating ultimate that can completely reshape the battlefield, creating choke points and isolating key targets. This power epitomizes Gray's control over ice, making him a formidable force in any engagement. Strategic use of this ability can secure victory in the most intense clashes.
abilities.flavorQuote: Feel the chill of despair!

character_v1.playstyle: Control the battlefield with persistent ice obstacles, slowing and disrupting enemies. Builds stacks to empower abilities for burst damage or enhanced control.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Gray excels in teams that benefit from zone control and sustained damage. He synergizes well with ranged carries who can capitalize on slowed enemies, and tanks who can hold the line while he builds Ice Stacks.
character_v1.tierSummary: Gray's kit has great control but lacks damage. C+ Tier is a better fit. Add friendship with Ryu for mastery.
appearanceTags: Fairy Tail mark on right pectoral
character_v1.internalSynergy: Gray's abilities work in tandem to control the battlefield. Ice-Make: Floor slows enemies, allowing for easier targeting with Ice Blade: Seven Slice Dance. Ice-Make: Shield provides protection while building Ice Stacks, and Cold Body helps mitigate crowd control. Ice Devil's Rage can be empowered by Ice Stacks for maximum impact.

chapters.title: Embrace the Chill
chapters.mission: Apply max Ice Stacks 5 times in a single battle.
chapters.summary: Gray seeks Ryu's wisdom on mastering the conflicting Ice and Wind power.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Gray confronts his inner demons and the duality of Ice Devil powers.

character_v1.name: Dai Li

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Earth.

abilities.name: Earth Grip
abilities.description: Dai Li launches a rock glove projectile in a straight line. The first enemy hit is inflicted with Earth Bind for 2 seconds, reducing their movement speed by 30% and preventing them from crossing any terrain obstacles. If Earth Grip hits an ally, they gain a shield that absorbs 50 damage for 3 seconds. This ability has a cooldown of 8 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: The Earth Queen's will is absolute!

abilities.name: Stone Restraint
abilities.description: Dai Li summons three small earth pillars in a targeted area. These pillars persist for 5 seconds, acting as terrain obstacles that enemies cannot cross. Enemies within the area when the pillars are summoned are inflicted with Earth Bind for 1 second. This ability is primarily for area denial and tactical repositioning during engagements. Stone Restraint has a cooldown of 12 seconds. These pillars can be destroyed with 1 hit.
abilities.flavorQuote: Resistance is futile.

abilities.name: Unwavering Loyalty
abilities.description: Whenever Dai Li applies Earth Bind to an enemy, he gains 10% increased movement speed for 3 seconds. If an ally is within 5 units of Dai Li when he casts Earth Grip, the shield granted to them is increased by 50%, absorbing 75 damage instead of 50. This passive enhances both Dai Li's mobility and his shielding capability.
abilities.flavorQuote: Our loyalty is our strength.

abilities.name: Forced Relocation
abilities.description: Dai Li selects a targeted enemy and forcefully relocates them a short distance in a chosen direction. This relocation also applies Earth Bind for 1.5 seconds. The relocation distance is roughly equivalent to 3 character lengths. The primary use is for displacing enemies from advantageous positions or disrupting their formations, which greatly improves team fight presence. Has a cooldown of 15 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: You will be moved.

abilities.name: Total Control
abilities.description: Dai Li channels for 2 seconds, selecting a large circular area. After the channel completes, all enemies within the area are afflicted with Earth Bind for 4 seconds and are unable to use movement-based abilities (dashes, teleports, etc.). Allies within the area gain a damage reduction buff of 20% for the same duration. The effect persists even if units leave the targeted radius. This ability has a long cooldown of 90 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: There is order here.

character_v1.teamSynergy: Dai Li works best with aggressive, melee-focused teams that can capitalize on his crowd control and displacement abilities. He provides valuable protection and disruption, allowing his allies to engage more safely and effectively.
character_v1.tierSummary: Dai Li's kit is underpowered with low scaling, but has some utility. Move to D+. Campaign to explore loyalty is added.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Dai Li's kit revolves around the 'Earth Bind' mechanic, which is consistently applied throughout his abilities. This ensures that his skills synergize well, allowing him to effectively control enemy movement and create openings for his team.

chapters.title: Forged in Stone
chapters.mission: Use Total Control 3 times in a stage.
chapters.summary: Dai Li and Gray seek clarity in their purpose when doing others' bidding.
chapters.resonanceBuff: Increased Shield Strength of Earth Grip.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Dai Li reflects on unwavering loyalty when ordered to do wrong.

character_v1.name: Ryu

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Wind.

abilities.name: Shoryuken Ascendancy
abilities.description: Ryu performs a leaping uppercut, dealing X physical damage to enemies in a small area and knocking them airborne. The height of the knock-up is increased for enemies closer to Ryu, creating a localized displacement. This ability grants 1 stack of Hado Surge. Successfully hitting an enemy with Shoryuken Ascendancy grants Ryu a temporary 20% increase in movement speed for 3 seconds, allowing him to chase down airborne targets or reposition after the initial strike. If no enemy is hit, Ryu will land vulnerable for 1 second. The uppercut's trajectory and damage are slightly increased when performed after a successful parry.
abilities.flavorQuote: The dragon rises to meet its challenge.

abilities.name: Tatsumaki Whirlwind Kick
abilities.description: Ryu unleashes a spinning kick that propels him forward a short distance, dealing multiple instances of X physical damage to enemies in his path over 1.5 seconds. The kick also pushes enemies slightly away from Ryu, creating space and disrupting formations. Ryu is immune to crowd control effects during the execution of Tatsumaki Whirlwind Kick. Upon completion of the kick, Ryu gains 1 stack of Hado Surge. The distance traveled and number of hits are increased if Ryu is below 50% health, reflecting his desperate need to create space.
abilities.flavorQuote: The wind becomes a blade.

abilities.name: Mind's Eye Parry
abilities.description: Ryu enters a defensive stance for 0.75 seconds. If Ryu is struck by a melee attack during this stance, he parries the attack, mitigating all damage and crowd control effects. Successfully parrying an attack grants Ryu 2 stacks of Hado Surge and reduces the cooldown of Shoryuken Ascendancy by 1 second. If Ryu isn't attacked during the stance, he suffers a brief 0.5-second self-stun, emphasizing the risk associated with anticipating an incoming attack. This ability encourages careful timing and prediction to maximize its benefits.
abilities.flavorQuote: Anticipate the blow, become the defense.

abilities.name: Hadoken Barrage
abilities.description: Ryu unleashes a powerful Hadoken, dealing X magic damage to enemies in a line. For each stack of Hado Surge, the Hadoken's size and knockback distance are significantly increased. At 3 stacks, the Hadoken becomes a massive energy wave that knocks enemies back a considerable distance and applies a slow, reducing their movement speed by 30% for 2 seconds. This ability consumes all stacks of Hado Surge. Hadoken Barrage's damage scales slightly with Ryu's missing health, encouraging strategic risk-taking to maximize its impact.
abilities.flavorQuote: Embrace the surge, unleash the wave.

abilities.name: Wandering Warrior
abilities.description: After using an ability, Ryu gains a 10% movement speed bonus for 2 seconds. This effect stacks up to 2 times, encouraging quick ability rotations and maintaining mobility during combat. Additionally, Ryu's basic attacks deal 10% bonus damage to enemies that are knocked airborne by his abilities. This passive promotes a hit-and-run playstyle and rewards successful displacement of enemies. Subsequent basic attacks will cause enemies to slowly descend to the ground.
abilities.flavorQuote: The path is the fight; the journey, the strength.

character_v1.teamSynergy: Ryu works well with team compositions that can capitalize on his displacement abilities. Allies that deal increased damage to crowd-controlled enemies or benefit from increased mobility will synergize well with Ryu.
character_v1.tierSummary: Ryu's high attack is offset by low HP/Def, which is why he is at B-Tier. Adding a campaign with gray to help focus him
character_v1.internalSynergy: Ryu's kit revolves around generating Hado Surge stacks and using them to power up his ultimate ability. His passive and active abilities synergize to provide mobility and displacement, creating opportunities for burst damage.

chapters.title: Wind's Guidance
chapters.mission: Trigger Mind's Eye Parry 3 times in a boss fight.
chapters.summary: Ryu seeks guidance from Gray to control his Wind energy.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Ryu goes on another Journey to master his Hado Surge and help others.

character_v1.name: Rock Volnutt

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Fire.

abilities.name: Mega Buster Barrage
abilities.description: Rock Volnutt rapidly fires a series of energy projectiles from his Mega Buster. Upon activation, Rock unleashes 5 shots in quick succession, each dealing 10 + (0.2 * Atk) damage. The shots automatically target the nearest enemy within a 400-unit range. Each shot applies a small amount of knockback. If multiple enemies are within range, the shots are distributed evenly among them, prioritizing the target with the lowest percentage of max HP. This ability has a 6-second cooldown, starting after the last shot is fired, allowing for brief periods of sustained fire if the player times it correctly. This ability benefits from attack speed buffs, reducing the delay between shots. Consumes 5 energy per shot.
abilities.flavorQuote: Locking on... firing!

abilities.name: Digout Deployment
abilities.description: Rock designates a target area within a 300-unit radius as a 'Digout' site. Upon activation, Rock spends 20 Refractor Shards to establish the site, which lasts for 20 seconds. Every 5 seconds, the Digout site has a 50% chance to unearth one of the following: a Weapon Fragment (25%), an Equipment Fragment (25%), or a Landmine (50%). Weapon Fragments can be combined to create temporary weapons, and Equipment Fragments improve Rock's armor. The landmine arms itself after 1 second and explodes upon enemy contact, dealing 50 + (0.3 * Magic Atk) damage in a small area. Only one Digout site can be active at a time. Deactivating or allowing the site to expire destroys any unclaimed fragments and disarms unexploded landmines. The digout sites grants vision in a small radius and reveals stealthed units inside. Subsequent castings refresh the duration of the site, if active. Cooldown 8 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Let's see what treasures are buried here!

abilities.name: Adaptive Armor Plating
abilities.description: Rock Volnutt consumes accumulated Equipment Fragments to enhance his defensive capabilities. Upon activation, Rock consumes all available Equipment Fragments, granting him a shield and bonus defensive stats. Each Equipment Fragment consumed provides a shield worth 5% of Rock's maximum HP, and a 2 point increase to both Defense and Magic Defense. The shield lasts for 5 seconds, and the stat bonuses persist for 8 seconds, after which they decay linearly over 4 seconds. If Rock's shield is broken before the duration ends, the stat bonuses are immediately reduced by half for the remaining duration. This ability has a 10-second cooldown, and can be activated even without Equipment Fragments, though it will provide no benefit. If used when at least 10 equipment fragments are used, the effect also cleanses debuffs. Maximum fragments able to be held: 20.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time to reinforce my defenses!

abilities.name: Weapon Synthesis
abilities.description: Rock Volnutt can combine Weapon Fragments obtained from 'Digout Deployment' to create temporary Special Weapons. When Rock gathers 5 Weapon Fragments, he automatically synthesizes a random Special Weapon, replacing his Mega Buster with it for 8 seconds. The Special Weapon is chosen from a pool of 3 options: 'Shining Laser' (fires a piercing beam dealing 30 + (0.4 * Magic Atk) damage), 'Crusher' (a short-range blast that deals 60 + (0.3 * Atk) damage in a cone and stuns for 0.5 seconds), or 'Blade Arm' (grants increased attack speed by 20% and melee range, attacks deal 20 + (0.3 * Atk) damage in a wide arc). After the duration ends, Rock reverts to his Mega Buster. Any excess fragments beyond 5 are retained. The effect occurs automatically and is not directly player-controlled, providing a dynamic and unpredictable combat experience. If a Digout Site expires, it destroys all Weapon Fragments in the Digout site.
abilities.flavorQuote: Alright, Roll, what did we find this time?

abilities.name: Purifier Protocol
abilities.description: Rock Volnutt taps into his past as MegaMan Trigger, unleashing a devastating burst of energy. Upon activation, Rock channels for 1 second, becoming immune to crowd control effects during the channeling period. After channeling, Rock emits a massive shockwave that deals 100 + (0.5 * Atk) + (0.5 * Magic Atk) True Damage to all enemies within a 500-unit radius. This ability has a 20% chance to critically damage Rock himself for 20% of his Max HP as he struggles to handle the power of Elysium. Additionally, for the next 5 seconds, Rock gains 30% increased movement speed and attack speed, but also takes 15% increased damage from all sources, representing the instability of his transformation. The increased damage stacks additively with other damage modifiers. The explosion applies knockback in a medium radius. Cooldown: 90 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: System... Purge!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Rock Volnutt synergizes well with teammates who can provide crowd control or area denial, protecting his Digout sites. Allies that can boost his attack speed or damage output further enhance the effectiveness of his Special Weapons and Purifier Protocol. Characters who can provide shields or healing can mitigate the self-damage from his ultimate. Rock's area denial with mines protects allies from flankers and allows for control of objectives.
character_v1.tierSummary: Rock's reliance on scaling and specific conditions is not as valuable as it seems. A+ Tier is more appropriate. New friendship.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Rock's kit revolves around setting up Digout sites to generate resources. Weapon Synthesis provides him with temporary offensive capabilities, while Adaptive Armor Plating allows him to use excess resources to bolster his defenses. Purifier Protocol serves as a high-risk, high-reward burst damage option, capitalizing on gathered resources to turn the tide of battle. The reliance on resource gathering creates a distinct playstyle centered on exploration and strategic deployment of Digout sites.

chapters.title: Buster Barrage
chapters.mission: Achieve max Armor Plating stacks in a single battle.
chapters.summary: Rock teams up with Flik to improve his blaster
chapters.resonanceBuff: Mega Buster Barrage damage increased by 15%.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Rock discovers purpose behind saving the planet after loss.

character_v1.name: Flik

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Physical.

abilities.name: Grain Harvester Barrage
abilities.description: Flik deploys his modified grain harvester, rapidly launching grains in a cone-shaped area, dealing damage to enemies hit. Each grain deals a small amount of physical damage (X), but the sheer volume of grains creates a barrage that can interrupt enemy actions. For every enemy hit by at least 5 grains, Flik gains 1 Innovation Point, reflecting his efficient harvesting technique. If Flik has at least 10 Innovation Points, he can choose to Overload the Harvester, consuming all 10 Innovation Points to increase the damage of each grain by 50% for the duration of the barrage and applying a brief Slow effect (15% movement speed reduction for 1 second) to all impacted enemies. The Overload lasts for 3 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time to get harvesting!

abilities.name: Inspiring Speech
abilities.description: Flik delivers an impassioned speech, bolstering the morale of his allies. All allies within a moderate radius receive a temporary buff, increasing their attack damage and speed by 20% for 5 seconds. Additionally, the ally with the lowest health receives a small burst of healing (X HP). If Flik has at least 5 Innovation Points, he can enhance the speech by consuming 5 Innovation Points. This enhancement grants the affected allies immunity to crowd control effects (such as stuns and silences) for 2 seconds during the speech's duration, ensuring they can act without interruption. The heal amount is doubled if he enhances it. The cooldown of this skill is 12 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: For the colony and for oppressed ants everywhere!

abilities.name: Makeshift Bird Scare
abilities.description: Flik unveils his ingenious, albeit somewhat crude, bird contraption. He launches it forward in a straight line, dealing a burst of magic damage (X) to the first enemy hit. More importantly, the contraption emits a loud, startling screech upon impact, fearing the primary target and nearby enemies for 3 seconds. While feared, enemies will run away from Flik at a reduced speed (25% of their normal speed). The contraption then explodes, leaving behind a cloud of feathers that linger for 5 seconds, reducing the evasion of enemies within the area by 30%. This area denial tactic creates space for Flik and his allies to maneuver. Cooldown: 15 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: They're afraid of birds, remember?

abilities.name: Resourceful Inventor
abilities.description: Flik's inventive mind allows him to generate 1 Innovation Point every 5 seconds passively. Furthermore, whenever an ally uses an Ultimate ability, Flik gains 3 Innovation Points, symbolizing his ability to learn and improve from the efforts of his comrades. The maximum number of Innovation Points Flik can hold is 15. This passive ensures a steady stream of resources for Flik to enhance his abilities and contribute to the team. Flik also gains 5% increased speed for every 5 points he has saved.
abilities.flavorQuote: I've got an idea!

abilities.name: Colony's Strength
abilities.description: Flik rallies the entire colony to his aid, unleashing a coordinated swarm attack. For the next 8 seconds, allied heroes gain 30% increased damage and 20% damage reduction, representing the collective power of the ants united against a common foe. During this period, Flik summons a wave of worker ants that surge forward, dealing continuous damage to enemies in a wide path. This wave deals a scaling magical damage (X + 10% of Flik's Magic Attack per second) and applies a stacking debuff, reducing enemy movement speed by 5% per second (up to a maximum of 30%) for as long as they remain within the wave. After the wave ends, there will be a dirt patch that persists for 5 seconds, slowing any enemies within by 20%.
abilities.flavorQuote: Ants are not meant to serve grasshoppers!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Flik excels in teams that benefit from sustained buffs and crowd control. His attack and speed buffs enhance the damage output of damage dealers, while his fears and slows disrupt enemy formations and protect allies. He works particularly well with heroes that have impactful ultimate abilities, as they generate Innovation Points for Flik and synergize with his ultimate to create overwhelming force.
character_v1.tierSummary: Flik's burst heal is useful, but his kit suffers from low stats. Bump down to C, and add campaign with Rock.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Flik's kit revolves around generating and spending Innovation Points to enhance his abilities. His passive provides a steady income, while his basic attack and ally ultimates grant bursts of Innovation Points. His active abilities can be enhanced with these points to provide stronger buffs, additional effects, and greater area control. This creates a gameplay loop where strategic use of abilities and resource management are key to maximizing Flik's impact.

chapters.title: Grain of Hope
chapters.mission: Use Colony's Strength to save the team 3 times in a single encounter.
chapters.summary: Flik shows Rock the value of innovation and helping other's.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Flik inspires others to fight for a better future.

character_v1.name: Hopper

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Physical.

abilities.name: Insect Squish
abilities.description: Hopper leaps towards the closest enemy, crushing them under his weight, dealing 150 physical damage and stunning them for 2 seconds. Nearby enemies within a 200-unit radius also take 75 physical damage and are knocked back a short distance. If Hopper has the 'Bully Buff' active, the primary target is stunned for an additional 1 second, and the damage to nearby enemies is increased by 25%. This ability has a cooldown of 8 seconds. It represents Hopper's ability to physically dominate his opponents, using brute force and intimidation to control the battlefield.
abilities.flavorQuote: It's a bug-eat-bug world out there, Princess.

abilities.name: Grasshopper Kick
abilities.description: Hopper delivers a powerful kick to the nearest enemy, dealing 100 physical damage and knocking them back significantly. The target also suffers a 40% movement speed reduction for 3 seconds. If the target is already stunned, the kick deals an additional 50 true damage. This ability has a cooldown of 10 seconds. It shows Hopper's aggression in combat, allowing him to control the positioning of enemies and punish those who are already vulnerable, representing his tendency to kick those who are already down.
abilities.flavorQuote: Get out of my way!

abilities.name: Thumper Threat
abilities.description: Hopper calls upon Thumper to intimidate the enemy team. Thumper charges into the fray, dealing 80 magical damage to all enemies within a 300-unit radius and applying a 'Fear' effect for 1.5 seconds. 'Feared' enemies are forced to move away from Thumper at a reduced speed. The cooldown for this ability is 15 seconds. This showcases Hopper's reliance on his gang to enforce his rule and demonstrates the fear he instills in others, disrupting enemy formations and buying time for his team.
abilities.flavorQuote: Thumper, show them what happens when they disobey.

abilities.name: Ruthless Dominance
abilities.description: Hopper's presence inspires fear. Whenever an enemy hero is stunned or feared within a 400-unit radius of Hopper, he gains 15% bonus attack damage for 4 seconds. This effect can stack up to 3 times. Additionally, the 'Bully Buff' grants Hopper 20 armor and 20 magic resist when active. This passive emphasizes Hopper's ability to capitalize on crowd control effects and his increased resilience when facing outnumbered opponents, reinforcing his role as a dominant force on the battlefield.
abilities.flavorQuote: They're gonna pay for this.

abilities.name: No One Stands Up!
abilities.description: Hopper unleashes his pent-up rage, becoming unstoppable for 5 seconds. During this time, his attack damage is increased by 50, and his basic attacks apply a stacking debuff called 'Suppressed'. Each stack of 'Suppressed' reduces the target's damage output by 5% for 3 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. After the unstoppable effect ends, Hopper deals 100 true damage to each enemy with at least one stack of 'Suppressed'. This ability has a cooldown of 75 seconds. This ultimate showcases Hopper's ultimate dominance and control, suppressing the enemy's ability to fight back and punishing them for defying him, epitomizing his fear of rebellion and his ruthless suppression tactics.
abilities.flavorQuote: Does anybody else want to stay?!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Hopper synergizes well with teams that can provide additional crowd control, allowing him to consistently trigger his passive and capitalize on vulnerable enemies. He benefits from allies who can isolate targets, maximizing his 'Bully Buff' and increasing his overall effectiveness.
character_v1.tierSummary: Hopper is bulky and high damage, but can be countered with his lack of resistances. S-Tier due to this weakness. Camp with Dai Li.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Hopper's kit revolves around controlling the battlefield with stuns and fears, enhancing his own damage output through his passive. His ultimate allows him to heavily debuff and then punish enemies, creating a cycle of dominance and control.

chapters.title: Superior Muscle
chapters.mission: Stun 3 enemies with Insect Squish.
chapters.summary: Hopper and Dai Li test their limits, but Hopper struggles to get the win.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Hopper needs to learn to be more self reliant on his attacks.

character_v1.name: Hemlich

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Light.

abilities.name: Voracious Appetite
abilities.description: Heimlich's hunger is insatiable. Whenever an enemy projectile or environmental hazard (such as a lingering area-of-effect spell) comes within a radius of 250 units, Heimlich automatically consumes it. Consuming a projectile grants Heimlich a temporary health shield equal to 15% of his maximum health, stacking up to 3 times. Each consumed projectile also increases his 'Fullness' meter by 20%. Consuming environmental hazards grants a larger shield of 25% of max health and increases Fullness by 35%. This shield decays by 5% of maximum health every 2 seconds. Once Fullness reaches 100%, Heimlich can activate his Ultimate ability, 'Butterfly Transformation'. This passive also grants a permanent 10% reduction to all incoming damage.
abilities.flavorQuote: Just a nibble... or twenty!

abilities.name: Digestive Burst
abilities.description: Heimlich unleashes a short-range burst of digestive fluids in a cone in front of him, dealing 75 (+30% Magic Attack) magic damage to enemies within 200 units. Enemies hit are also slowed by 20% for 2 seconds. If Heimlich has a temporary health shield from 'Voracious Appetite', the burst consumes the lowest health shield stack to add a corrosive effect, reducing enemy healing received by 30% for 4 seconds. This ability has a cooldown of 8 seconds. This ability does not generate or consume any Fullness directly, but provides a means to apply a debuff while managing shield stacks gained from his passive.
abilities.flavorQuote: A little something I ate!

abilities.name: Caterpillar Crawl
abilities.description: Heimlich propels himself forward a short distance (400 units), becoming unstoppable for the duration of the dash. Upon reaching the destination, Heimlich slams into the ground, dealing 50 (+20% Attack) physical damage to enemies within 150 units and knocking them up for 0.75 seconds. This ability has a cooldown of 12 seconds. If Heimlich consumes a projectile within 1 second before using Caterpillar Crawl, the dash distance is increased by 50% and the impact radius is increased to 250 units. This provides a way to initiate engages, reposition, or escape while capitalizing on Voracious Appetite stacks.
abilities.flavorQuote: Gotta go fast... for a caterpillar!

abilities.name: Sweet Tooth Taunt
abilities.description: Heimlich produces a tempting candy corn, taunting all enemy units within a 300-unit radius for 1.5 seconds. While taunted, enemies are forced to attack Heimlich. This ability consumes 10% of his current Fullness. If Heimlich's Fullness is below 10%, this ability cannot be used. Successfully taunting at least 3 enemies grants Heimlich a temporary buff, increasing his defense by 20% for 5 seconds. This ability has a cooldown of 15 seconds. The ability provides a means to draw aggro and control the battlefield, while also integrating the Fullness mechanic, demanding strategic usage.
abilities.flavorQuote: Come and get it! I dare ya!

abilities.name: Butterfly Transformation
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~6% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Upon reaching 100% Fullness, Heimlich can activate this ability. After a 1.5-second channel, Heimlich transforms into his 'beautiful butterfly' form for 12 seconds. In butterfly form, Heimlich gains 50% increased movement speed, flight (allowing him to traverse impassable terrain), and deals 40 (+15% Magic Attack) magic damage per second to all enemies within a 200-unit radius. However, during the transformation and for 3 seconds after the transformation ends, Heimlich loses all temporary health shields and his defense is reduced by 30%. This ability has a 90 second cooldown, starting after the transformation ends. Transforming consumes all Fullness. During transformation, all basic abilities are disabled.
abilities.flavorQuote: I'm a beautiful butterfly!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Heimlich synergizes well with teams that can provide him with projectile cover (e.g., shield walls) or create environmental hazards for him to consume. His taunt and butterfly form make him effective at disrupting enemy formations and dealing sustained damage.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Heimlich's kit revolves around building Fullness with Voracious Appetite and then using that Fullness strategically with Sweet Tooth Taunt or Butterfly Transformation. Digestive Burst provides a support tool, and Caterpillar Crawl enhances mobility.

chapters.title: The Butterfly's Banquet
chapters.mission: Collect all the rare ingredients within the time limit, avoiding the traps and defeating the guardians.
chapters.summary: Hemlich and Lisa Lisa team up to gather rare ingredients for a celebratory feast, using Hemlich's mobility and Lisa Lisa's Ripple techniques to overcome environmental hazards and monstrous guardians.
chapters.resonanceBuff: Butterfly Transformation's heal is increased by 15%.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Hemlich explores different biomes, partnering with a diverse array of heroes to enhance his adaptability and survival skills.
bondPerks: Increased Taunt duration from Sweet Tooth Taunt by 1 turn.

character_v1.name: Kimiko

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Fire.

abilities.name: Tailwind Gust
abilities.description: Kimiko releases a small gust of wind from her tails, increasing the movement speed of allies within the Fox Clan Blessing radius by 10% for 5 seconds. This ability has a 8 second cooldown. Upon activation, the Fox Clan Blessing now grants allies within the radius an additional 5% evasion chance for the duration, refreshing upon subsequent casts of Tailwind Gust. This effect does not stack with itself.
abilities.flavorQuote: Feel the wind at your back!

abilities.name: Mystic Flames
abilities.description: Kimiko ignites her tails with mystic flames, granting allies within the Fox Clan Blessing radius 10% increased magic attack for 5 seconds. This ability has an 8 second cooldown. Activating Mystic Flames changes the Fox Clan Blessing to grant 5% magic lifesteal for the duration. If Tailwind Gust is active, the evasion chance from Tailwind Gust is reduced to 2% while Mystic Flames is active. This effect does not stack with itself.
abilities.flavorQuote: Burn with arcane power!

abilities.name: Guardian Stance
abilities.description: Kimiko assumes a protective stance, granting allies within the Fox Clan Blessing radius 10% increased defense for 5 seconds. This ability has an 8 second cooldown. Activating Guardian Stance changes the Fox Clan Blessing to grant a shield equal to 2% of Kimiko's max HP to allies, which lasts for 3 seconds or until depleted. If Tailwind Gust is active, the evasion chance from Tailwind Gust is reduced to 2% while Guardian Stance is active. If Mystic Flames is active, the magic lifesteal granted by Fox Clan Blessing is reduced to 2%. This effect does not stack with itself.
abilities.flavorQuote: Stand strong, shielded by the clan!

abilities.name: Fox Clan Blessing
abilities.description: Kimiko passively emits an aura of blessing to allies within 300 units. The effect of this blessing changes depending on the last active ability used. Only one blessing effect can be active at a time. If no active ability has been used in the last 8 seconds, the Fox Clan Blessing provides 2% increased luck. Activating an ability refreshes the duration of the associated Fox Clan Blessing effect. This blessing is the core of Kimiko's support capabilities.
abilities.flavorQuote: May the Fox Clan watch over you.

abilities.name: Foxfire Blessing
upgrades: The shield effect granted by Foxfire Blessing now absorbs 400 damage.
Foxfire Blessing now increases allies' movement speed by 15% for its duration.
The Magic Lifesteal granted by Foxfire Blessing is increased to 25%.
abilities.description: Kimiko channels the ancient fox spirits, invoking a radiant wave of protective foxfire. Upon activation, all allied champions within a 500-unit radius are instantly cleansed of all harmful status effects, banishing debuffs like slows, stuns, and damage-over-time effects. Furthermore, each cleansed ally is enveloped in the full suite of Fox Clan Blessings, regardless of their recent ability usage: they receive an ethereal Evasion buff, granting a 35% chance to completely avoid incoming attacks for 8 seconds; a revitalizing Magic Lifesteal aura that restores health equal to 20% of the magic damage dealt by their spells for 8 seconds; and a shimmering shield, absorbing up to 300 points of damage for the same duration. This powerful blessing comes at a cost, however, requiring a 120-second cooldown before it can be invoked again. To compensate for this lengthy recharge, all of Kimiko's active ability cooldowns are reduced by 50% during this 120 second period after casting, allowing her to more frequently use her basic abilities to control the battlefield and support her team.

character_v1.teamSynergy: Kimiko excels in teams that benefit from consistent, minor buffs. Her flexibility allows her to support a variety of team compositions.
character_v1.tierSummary: Kimiko's Fox Clan Blessings provide buffs, but her individual power is low. Her cleanse is valuable, but limited. Reposition to C- to reflect limited impact.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Kimiko's abilities are designed to be rotated to provide a mix of buffs, adapting to the needs of the team. The ultimate allows for a temporary burst of all benefits.
character_v1.bestFriendshipBuff: Increased speed buff duration from Tailwind Gust

chapters.title: The Forest's Guardian
chapters.mission: Extinguish the wildfire before it consumes the entire forest, protecting the ancient tree at its heart.
chapters.summary: Kimiko and Joseph must protect a sacred forest from a rampaging wildfire, utilizing Kimiko's wind and fire magic alongside Joseph's cunning tactics to contain the blaze.
chapters.resonanceBuff: Mystic Flames now also applies a Burn effect to enemies, dealing damage over time.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Kimiko seeks to spread the blessings of the Fox Clan, forming alliances to protect the balance of nature and aid those in need.
bondPerks: Increased Shield amount from Spiritual Burst by 10%.

character_v1.name: Joseph Joestar

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Melee basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Fire.

abilities.name: Your Next Line Is...
abilities.description: Joseph possesses a unique ability to anticipate his opponent's moves. Before an enemy uses an ability, a prediction window appears, displaying a possible action the enemy might take. If Joseph activates any ability during this window, and the enemy performs the predicted action, Joseph gains one 'Trick Stack' (max 3). Each 'Trick Stack' increases Joseph's damage by 10% and ability haste by 5%, stacking multiplicatively. Failing to predict the enemy's action incurs a 2 second lockout on the prediction window. Successfully predicting an Ultimate ability grants two Trick Stacks. The prediction window duration scales with Joseph's luck stat, providing a longer reaction time.
abilities.flavorQuote: I know exactly what you're going to say!

abilities.name: Ripple Overdrive
abilities.description: Joseph channels Ripple energy into his fists, enhancing his next basic attack within 5 seconds. The enhanced attack deals an additional 50 (+0.3x magic atk) magic damage and applies a slow, reducing the target's movement speed by 30% for 1.5 seconds. If Joseph has any 'Trick Stack', consuming one stack empowers the Ripple Overdrive further, causing the next basic attack to also apply a short stun for 0.75 seconds and deal an additional 20 true damage per stack consumed. The stun duration does not scale with tenacity. The Ripple Overdrive also conducts the element of the last item used, adding an elemental damage type to the enhanced basic attack.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time to channel my inner Ripple!

abilities.name: Clacker Volley
abilities.description: Joseph throws his Ripple-infused Clackers in a targeted direction. The Clackers act as a boomerang, dealing 70 (+0.45x magic atk) magic damage to enemies in their path on the way out and back. The Clackers have a wider range than a basic attack. If Joseph has at least two 'Trick Stack', he can consume them to modify the Clacker Volley into 'Clacker Boomerang'. This version throws the Clackers behind the target, dealing 100 (+0.6x magic atk) magic damage on the return trip, while also reducing the target's magic defense by 20% for 3 seconds. The magic defense reduction does not stack.
abilities.flavorQuote: Take this! Clacker Volley!

abilities.name: Tactical Item: Sudden Stratagem
abilities.description: Joseph pulls out a random item from his inventory (Tommy Gun, Sledgehammer, Tequila Bottle, Wool Hat). Each item has a unique effect and cooldown, and their availability rotates on a short internal cooldown. 'Tommy Gun' fires a barrage of projectiles (25 physical damage each). 'Sledgehammer' performs a slow but powerful melee attack (150 physical damage, knockup). 'Tequila Bottle' throws a projectile that deals moderate damage (80 magic damage) and applies a brief drunken effect (causes erratic movement). 'Wool Hat' sets a trap that snares enemies (immobilize for 1 sec). Using an item successfully grants Joseph a 'Trick Stack'. Internal cooldown of item skills is reduced by 10% per 'Trick Stack'.
abilities.flavorQuote: I've got a plan… sort of!

abilities.name: Hermit Purple: Ripple Connection
abilities.description: Joseph unleashes Hermit Purple, creating a large area of Ripple-infused vines around him for 8 seconds. Enemies within the area take 40 (+0.2x magic atk) magic damage per second and have their healing reduced by 40%. For each successful prediction Joseph made before activating this ability, the area also inflicts a stacking slow by 10% (Max 30%). Allies within the area gain 20% increased movement speed and have any Cleanse effects amplified by 30%. During the ultimate, Joseph can move freely within the area. If enemies attempt to leave the zone, Hermit Purple will constrict and deal true damage based on 10% of their Max HP. This ability does not stack with other forms of Max HP damage.
abilities.flavorQuote: Hermit Purple! Let’s see what we can do!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Joseph benefits from allies who can provide crowd control or information, helping him to land predictions. He provides strong area control and utility, making him a valuable asset in team fights and objective control.
character_v1.tierSummary: Lisa Lisa's potent AoE true damage and control are among the best. Correct placement at SS+.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Joseph's kit revolves around building and utilizing 'Trick Stack'. Accurate predictions empower his Ripple Overdrive and Clacker Volley, while successful item usage grants him more stacks. Hermit Purple provides area control and utility, further rewarding prediction and tactical play.
character_v1.bestFriendshipBuff: Increased damage and duration of Ripple Overdrive

chapters.title: Scarf Supremacy
chapters.mission: Hold the line for 8 turns against waves of enemies, utilizing Ripple Barriers and area-of-effect attacks.
chapters.summary: Lisa Lisa and Joseph work together to defend an area from an onslaught of enemies using precise Ripple control.
chapters.resonanceBuff: Increases the range of Satiporoja's Embrace by 25%.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Lisa Lisa teams up to demonstrate Ripple Mastery, focusing on synergy, leadership, and powerful zone denial tactics.
bondPerks: Reduces cooldown of Ripple Barrier by 1 turn.

character_v1.name: Lisa Lisa

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Fire.

abilities.name: Snake Scarf Strike
abilities.description: Lisa Lisa channels Ripple through her Satiporoja beetle-thread scarf, launching a swift, linear strike. Upon activation, Lisa Lisa unleashes a precise scarf attack in the targeted direction, dealing X magic damage to the first enemy hit. If 'Ripple Current' is active, the strike's range increases by 50%, and the target is also inflicted with 'Ripple Bind' for 2 seconds, slowing their movement speed by 30%. Consumes all Ripple Current upon use, regardless of whether the empowered effect is triggered. This ability has a moderate cooldown, encouraging strategic use of Ripple Current.
abilities.flavorQuote: A flawless strike requires no hesitation.

abilities.name: Ripple Barrier
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Lisa Lisa generates a defensive Ripple Barrier, mitigating incoming damage. Upon activation, Lisa Lisa creates a circular barrier around herself or a targeted ally, absorbing up to X damage for 3 seconds. If 'Ripple Current' is active, the barrier also reflects 20% of the absorbed damage back to the attacker as magic damage. Generating Ripple Current provides a stacking buff to the barrier's strength, capping at a 50% increase. This ability has a long cooldown but offers substantial protection, particularly when combined with strategic Ripple Current management. The barrier dissipates prematurely if the damage threshold is reached before the duration ends.
abilities.flavorQuote: Defense is the first step towards victory.

abilities.name: Satiporoja's Embrace
abilities.description: Lisa Lisa manipulates her scarf to create a localized zone of Ripple energy. Upon activation, Lisa Lisa designates a target area, creating a zone that persists for 5 seconds. Enemies within the zone take X magic damage per second. If 'Ripple Current' is active, the zone expands by 30% and inflicts 'Ripple Resonance', increasing damage taken by enemies within the zone by 15% for the duration they remain inside. The zone's placement requires careful consideration, maximizing its impact on enemy positioning and movement. This ability is key to Lisa Lisa's area denial strategy, forcing enemies to reposition or suffer continuous damage.
abilities.flavorQuote: The threads of fate bind you.

abilities.name: Ripple Breathing
abilities.description: Lisa Lisa passively generates 'Ripple Current' over time, enhancing her combat prowess. Every 5 seconds, Lisa Lisa gains 1 stack of 'Ripple Current', up to a maximum of 5 stacks. Using an ability consumes all stacks of Ripple Current. Additionally, Lisa Lisa gains 10% increased magic atk for each nearby ally (within a radius of 500 units), representing her ability to synchronize with her team. This passive rewards both consistent ability usage and strategic positioning, allowing Lisa Lisa to adapt to different combat scenarios and maximize her effectiveness. The magic atk bonus persists as long as the ally remains within range.
abilities.flavorQuote: Focus your breath, and unleash its power.

abilities.name: Super Aja - Ripple Overdrive
abilities.description: Lisa Lisa channels the Red Stone of Aja, unleashing a devastating surge of Ripple energy. Upon activation, Lisa Lisa channels for 1 second, then fires a concentrated beam of Ripple energy in a straight line, dealing massive X true damage to all enemies in its path. Enemies hit are also stunned for 1.5 seconds. If Lisa Lisa has maximum 'Ripple Current' stacks upon activation, the beam splits into three, covering a wider area and dealing an additional Y magic damage to all targets hit. This ultimate requires precise aiming and strategic Ripple Current management, offering a high-impact option for team fights and objective control. The channeling period leaves Lisa Lisa vulnerable, necessitating careful timing and positioning.
abilities.flavorQuote: Behold the pinnacle of Ripple!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Lisa Lisa excels in teams that can capitalize on her area denial and control capabilities. She synergizes well with characters who benefit from increased damage output via 'Ripple Resonance', or those who can lock down enemies within the zone created by 'Satiporoja's Embrace'. Characters that can provide peel or protection during her ultimate's channeling phase are also highly valuable.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Lisa Lisa's kit revolves around managing 'Ripple Current' to empower her abilities. 'Ripple Breathing' provides the resource, while 'Snake Scarf Strike', 'Ripple Barrier', and 'Satiporoja's Embrace' consume it for enhanced effects, encouraging calculated ability usage and strategic planning. Mastering the timing and interplay of these abilities is key to maximizing her zone control and damage output.

chapters.title: The Ultimate Gamble
chapters.mission: Defeat a team of enemies using Ripple-enhanced attacks and tactical maneuvers.
chapters.summary: Joseph and Lisa Lisa collaborate to outsmart a powerful enemy with superior Ripple techniques.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Joseph teams up with various characters to showcase his cunning and adaptability in diverse combat scenarios.
bondPerks: Reduced cooldown on Tactical Item: Sudden Stratagem by 1 turn.

character_v1.name: Kakyoin

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Ice.

abilities.name: Emerald Splash
abilities.description: Kakyoin unleashes a barrage of Emerald projectiles in a cone-shaped area in front of him. Each projectile deals moderate magic damage. This ability has a moderate cooldown. If Emerald Splash passes through an active Emerald Barrier created by 'Hierophant's Barrier', the projectiles gain increased speed and pierce through enemies, dealing 50% damage to subsequent targets. The range of Emerald Splash is extended by 20% when used from within an Emerald Lattice zone created by 'Emerald Lattices'. This ability is Kakyoin's primary source of damage and is crucial for wave clearing and harassing enemies at a distance.
abilities.flavorQuote: No one can just deflect the Emerald Splash!

abilities.name: Hierophant's Barrier
abilities.description: Kakyoin creates a large, rectangular Emerald Barrier at a target location within a moderate range. The Barrier persists for a moderate duration and blocks enemy movement. Enemies attempting to pass through the barrier take minor magic damage over time. The barrier's size is affected by Kakyoin's magic attack stat, with higher magic attack increasing both its width and height. Activating this ability near an Emerald Lattice causes the barrier to be fortified, increasing its health and duration by 30%. This ability is essential for controlling choke points, protecting allies, and setting up combos with other abilities.
abilities.flavorQuote: I've set up a barrier… you can't escape now!

abilities.name: Emerald Lattices
abilities.description: Kakyoin can place up to three invisible Emerald Lattices within a moderate range. Enemies who trigger these lattices are briefly stunned for 0.75 seconds and revealed for 3 seconds. The reveal effect allows Kakyoin and his allies to see stealthed units within the lattice's radius. If an enemy triggers multiple lattices simultaneously, the stun duration is not increased, but they take a small burst of magic damage for each additional lattice triggered. Kakyoin passively regenerates a charge of Emerald Lattice every 30 seconds, up to a maximum of 3 charges. This ability is crucial for area denial and setting up ambushes.
abilities.flavorQuote: Did you really think you could sneak past me?

abilities.name: Possession
abilities.description: Kakyoin sends Hierophant Green to possess a nearby, non-player controlled enemy unit (minions, summons, monsters). While possessing the unit, Kakyoin controls its movements and basic attacks. The possessed unit gains a 20% increase to its attack damage and speed. Possession lasts for a short duration, or until the possessed unit is defeated. If the possessed unit triggers an Emerald Lattice, the possession duration is extended by 50%. Using this ability grants vision of the possessed unit's location, even through stealth or fog of war. This is a powerful ability for scouting, disrupting enemy formations, and dealing unexpected damage.
abilities.flavorQuote: I'll take control of you, and you'll be my puppet!

abilities.name: 20 Meter Emerald Barrier
abilities.description: Kakyoin creates a massive, labyrinthine Emerald Barrier that covers a large area. The barrier consists of interconnected Emerald strands that deal high magic damage and apply a stacking slow to enemies that touch them. The slow effect increases with each strand touched, up to a maximum of 50%. Enemies trapped within the labyrinth are easily targeted by Kakyoin's 'Emerald Splash'. After a short duration, the labyrinth collapses, dealing a final burst of magic damage to all enemies inside. If cast near existing 'Emerald Lattices', the lattices detonate, dealing additional damage to enemies within the 20 Meter Emerald Barrier. This is Kakyoin's ultimate area control ability, capable of completely locking down a zone and dealing significant damage.
abilities.flavorQuote: This is my ultimate technique! The 20 Meter Emerald Barrier!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Kakyoin works well with teams that can capitalize on his zoning and area denial capabilities. Allies who can deal burst damage to slowed or stunned enemies within his barriers benefit greatly. He provides valuable vision control and can protect vulnerable allies with his barriers.
character_v1.tierSummary: Kakyoin's zoning and control are useful, but his damage is underwhelming. He lacks consistent burst or sustain. Distribution needs a shift down; B- reflects his strategic niche rather than raw power.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Kakyoin's abilities synergize heavily with the strategic placement of Emerald Lattices. Hierophant's Barrier can be fortified by nearby Lattices, and Emerald Splash benefits from the reveal and extended range provided by them. Possession also benefits from Lattices, extending its duration. His ultimate, 20 Meter Emerald Barrier, gets a damage boost by detonating pre-existing Lattices.

chapters.title: The 20 Meter Emerald Challenge
chapters.mission: Survive for 5 rounds against increasingly difficult enemy waves within the Emerald Barrier.
chapters.summary: Kakyoin and Koichi must combine their powers to defend a location from waves of enemies using Hierophant Green's Emerald Barrier and Echoes Act 3's Freeze.
chapters.resonanceBuff: Emerald Barrier now also applies a Slow effect, reducing enemy speed by 20%.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Kakyoin seeks to understand the limits of his Hierophant Green, forging alliances to test its strategic capabilities.
bondPerks: Reduced cooldown on Emerald Lattices by 1 turn.

character_v1.name: Koichi

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Wind.

abilities.name: Repeating Words (ACT1)
abilities.description: Koichi writes a word onto a target location within a 50-meter range. For the next 5 seconds, any enemy within a 5-meter radius of that location will have that word repeated in their mind, causing a 20% reduction to their magic defense. This effect stacks up to 3 times. If Koichi evolves to ACT2, Repeating Words changes to ACT2.
abilities.flavorQuote: "I'm going to make one!"

abilities.name: Sound Effects (ACT2)
abilities.description: Evolves Repeating Words (ACT1) and replaces the effect. Koichi writes a sound effect onto a target location within a 30-meter range. If an enemy touches this location, the associated effect is triggered, dealing 50 magic damage and inflicting a status based on the sound. 'Whoosh' creates a small gust of wind, slowing the target by 30% for 2 seconds. 'Zap' deals additional 25 electric damage over 3 seconds. 'Poof' creates a smoke cloud, reducing vision range by 40% for 2 seconds. Has a 10 second cooldown. If Koichi evolves to ACT3, Sound Effects changes to ACT3.
abilities.flavorQuote: "A new Echoes! Echoes ACT2!"

abilities.name: 3 Freeze (ACT3)
abilities.description: Evolves Sound Effects (ACT2) and replaces the effect. Koichi sends Echoes ACT3 to punch a target within 10 meters. On hit, the target is afflicted with '3 Freeze', increasing their weight by 50% for 3 seconds, reducing their movement speed by 50% and reducing jump height to near zero. After 3 seconds, the weight returns to normal, but they take 80 magic damage as a result of the sudden change. Has an 8 second cooldown.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Now I'm starting to get pissed off!"

abilities.name: Act Evolution
abilities.description: Koichi begins the match with access to only Repeating Words (ACT1). After 60 seconds, Echoes evolves to ACT2, upgrading Repeating Words to Sound Effects. After another 90 seconds (total 150 seconds), Echoes evolves to ACT3, upgrading Sound Effects to 3 Freeze. Upon reaching each evolution, Koichi gains a permanent 10% boost to his magic defense. This passive is the core of Koichi's progression, rewarding patience and strategic play.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Wow! It's really Echoes ACT3! Does that mean I got stronger again?"

abilities.name: Reliable Soul
abilities.description: Koichi inspires his allies, granting a 20% damage reduction to all allies within a 15-meter radius for 8 seconds. Additionally, allies within the area gain a 15% increase to their movement speed. If Koichi is in ACT3 form, affected allies also gain a shield absorbing 100 damage for the duration. This ability has a long cooldown of 120 seconds, emphasizing its use as a strategic teamfight tool.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Didn't I tell you? Don't underestimate me."

character_v1.teamSynergy: Koichi synergizes well with damage-focused characters who benefit from the zoning and crowd control his abilities provide. He is also effective in teams that can capitalize on the damage reduction and speed boost provided by his ultimate.
character_v1.tierSummary: Koichi is primarily a debuffer with limited direct damage, reliant on evolution. His utility needs support. Shift up to C+ to represent increased viability with proper setup.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Koichi's ACT Evolutions allow him to transition from a debuff-focused character to a crowd control specialist. His ultimate benefits greatly from reaching ACT3, offering increased survivability to his team.

chapters.title: The Weight of Words
chapters.mission: Solve the puzzles within 8 turns, using each of Echoes' Acts to their full potential.
chapters.summary: Koichi and Josuke must use Echoes' sound manipulation and Crazy Diamond's restoration to solve a series of environmental puzzles and rescue trapped civilians.
chapters.resonanceBuff: Sound Effects (ACT2) now also applies a Knockback effect.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Koichi faces trials that force him to adapt and evolve his Echoes Stand, exploring the balance between power and control.
bondPerks: Increased Speed when using Reliable Soul by 8%.

character_v1.name: Josuke

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Wind.

abilities.name: Dora! Restoration Punch
abilities.description: Josuke rapidly punches the target enemy with Crazy Diamond, dealing damage and inflicting a 'Restoration Imprint'. The imprint lasts for 5 seconds. If Josuke uses another ability on a target with 'Restoration Imprint', the imprint is consumed. If the target is an ally, they are healed for X% of their max HP. If the target is an enemy, they are stunned for 1.5 seconds. The damage of this ability scales with Josuke's Attack stat. If no other ability is used to consume the 'Restoration Imprint' within 5 seconds, the imprint disappears, dealing a small burst of true damage to the target equal to 3% of Josuke's Max HP. The range of this ability is relatively short, encouraging Josuke to be in melee range to support and control the battlefield.
abilities.flavorQuote: I'll fix you up real good!

abilities.name: Environmental Reshape
abilities.description: Josuke targets a nearby terrain feature (e.g., a wall, a pillar) and channels Crazy Diamond's power to manipulate it. If targeting a terrain feature near an ally, the terrain provides a shield to the ally for X amount that scales with Josuke's defense. If targeting a terrain feature near an enemy, the terrain feature is briefly propelled towards the enemy, dealing damage and knocking them back. The range of this ability is moderate. Josuke can target anywhere from medium range near a terrain, and terrain features can include anything as large as a building to as small as a pebble on the ground. Terrain features must be visible, and if there is no terrain feature nearby, the ability fizzles and goes on a reduced cooldown.
abilities.flavorQuote: Looks like we need a little… alteration!

abilities.name: Furious Retaliation
abilities.description: Whenever Josuke is struck by a critical hit, he gains a stack of 'Furious Retaliation'. At 3 stacks, Josuke's next ability is instantly cast and gains 25% increased effectiveness. Effectiveness is further defined as damage, healing, shield amount, and duration of stuns and knockbacks. In addition, whenever Josuke heals an ally with the 'Restoration Imprint' effect, both Josuke and the healed ally gain a speed boost for 3 seconds. This passive is a reflection of Josuke's reactive nature and anger when provoked. It encourages a more aggressive playstyle when Josuke is under pressure, allowing him to turn the tide of battle with a well-timed and empowered ability. The speed boost ensures that both Josuke and the healed ally can engage in combat.
abilities.flavorQuote: What'd you say about my hair?!

abilities.name: Reconstructive Barrage
abilities.description: Josuke unleashes a flurry of punches with Crazy Diamond, targeting a cone-shaped area in front of him. Enemies caught in the barrage take damage over time and have their armor and magic resistance reduced by X% for 4 seconds. Allies caught in the barrage gain increased movement speed and attack speed for the same duration. This ability serves as a potent area-of-effect support and debuff tool, reflecting Josuke's ability to both harm and heal with his Stand. The scaling reduction of armor and magic resistance debuffs on enemies will allow allies to do more damage. While allies gain an offensive speed boost to unleash chaos.
abilities.flavorQuote: DORARARARARARA!

abilities.name: Ultimate Restoration
abilities.description: Josuke focuses Crazy Diamond's power to rewind time for a single target ally to 3 seconds prior, restoring their health, mana, and removing all debuffs. In addition, the target ally gains invincibility for 1 second. Josuke then inflicts himself with a 'Restoration Imprint' to be consumed when the time rewind is complete. This ability has a long cooldown. Upon completion, Josuke will consume his own 'Restoration Imprint' and be healed for X% of his max health, gain increased attack damage, and a shield. The long cooldown emphasizes the weight of the decision to use this ultimate, requiring strategic foresight and coordination. 'Ultimate Restoration' showcases Josuke's dedication to protecting his friends. The healing effect for Josuke upon completion ensures that he continues to support his allies.
abilities.flavorQuote: I'll turn things back to the way they were!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Josuke pairs well with burst damage dealers and characters who benefit from speed boosts and terrain manipulation. He excels in coordinated teams that can capitalize on the openings he creates.
character_v1.tierSummary: Josuke has strong healing and some debuff utility, but his damage output is inconsistent. Environmental Reshape is situational. Move to B reflects his support/disruptor capabilities.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Josuke's abilities synergize by applying 'Restoration Imprint' and providing various supportive effects. 'Furious Retaliation' encourages aggression and smart ability usage. His ultimate provides a powerful single-target reset, enhancing team survivability.
character_v1.bestFriendshipBuff: Increased heal amount from Restoration Punch

chapters.title: The Diamond Heist
chapters.mission: Infiltrate the museum and recover the artifact within 10 turns, minimizing collateral damage.
chapters.summary: Josuke and Kakyoin must infiltrate a heavily guarded museum to recover a stolen artifact, using Crazy Diamond's reconstruction and Hierophant Green's Emerald Barrier to overcome obstacles.
chapters.resonanceBuff: Reconstructive Barrage now also grants a 10% damage reduction to allies in the area.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Josuke seeks to master his Crazy Diamond Stand, partnering with others to test the limits of his restorative and reconstructive abilities.
bondPerks: Increased healing from Ultimate Restoration by 12%.

character_v1.name: Crono

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Melee basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Wind.

abilities.name: Cyclone Strike
abilities.description: Crono performs a rapid, spinning sword attack, dealing 80 + (1.0 * Atk) physical damage to enemies in a small radius around him. Each enemy hit grants 0.3 stack of Chrono Shift, up to the maximum of 3. If Crono has at least 1 stack of Chrono Shift, this ability's radius is increased by 25% and the damage is increased by 20%. This ability has a cooldown of 6 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Whirlwind of steel!

abilities.name: Lightning Slash
