There is a 20% chance for 'Cursed Magic' to trigger: instead of stunning, the limb attaches to the first enemy hit, slowing them by 50% for 3 seconds and dealing X damage per second. Eda can have a maximum of two Detached Limbs active at one time. If she reaches her limit, the first Limb detonates automatically. Eda regenerates a limb every 15 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Eh, I wasn't using that anyway!

abilities.name: Embrace the Curse
upgrades: [object Object]
[object Object]
[object Object]
abilities.description: Eda succumbs to the Owl Beast's influence, transforming for 15 seconds. While transformed, Eda gains 30% increased attack damage and 20% increased movement speed, becoming immune to all crowd control effects. During this period, Exploding Apple Blood is replaced with a powerful Wing Barrage, unleashing a cone-shaped blast of feathers that deals 150 + (50% Magic Power) damage to enemies within its range. Owlbert's Diversion morphs into a piercing Owl Beast Shriek, a wave of sonic energy that deals 100 + (40% Magic Power) damage and fears enemies for 1.5 seconds. Detachable Decoy evolves into a ferocious Claw Swipe, a melee attack that deals 200 + (60% Magic Power) damage in a small area around Eda. However, Eda's connection to the curse is volatile; there's a 10% chance for 'Cursed Surge' to trigger upon activation. If triggered, the transformation extends by 5 seconds, but during this extended period, Eda uncontrollably attacks allies as well as enemies with the full force of her transformed abilities. The Owl Beast also gains power over time, accumulating a stacking buff that grants 2% additional damage per second while active. After the transformation concludes, the strain leaves Eda stunned for 2 seconds as she returns to her human form.

abilities.name: Wild Magic Affinity
abilities.description: Eda gains 10% increased magic damage. Additionally, every time Eda triggers 'Cursed Magic', she gains a stack of 'Unstable Power', increasing her magic attack by X per stack. Stacks are capped at 5, and decay one stack at a time every 5 seconds. When Eda reaches 5 stacks, her next ability will not trigger 'Cursed Magic', but will be greatly enhanced, increasing its damage/duration/size by 50%. This effect cleanses all stacks of Unstable Power. This passive promotes skillful play, rewarding players who strategically manage their 'Cursed Magic' procs and build stacks of 'Unstable Power' for devastating combos. This encourages diverse and adaptable playstyles centered around managing the chaos of Eda's wild magic.
abilities.flavorQuote: A little chaos never hurt anyone... much.

character_v1.teamSynergy: Eda excels in teams that can capitalize on area-of-effect damage and crowd control, setting up opportunities for her to deal massive damage with enhanced abilities. She also benefits from teams that can provide her with protection while she builds stacks of 'Unstable Power'.
character_v1.tierSummary: Eda Clawthorne has a mix of damage and control, but her curse transformation is risky and unreliable. KPS adjusted to 63. She has a campaign, so nothing is changed. Best friendship buff supports damage area.
appearanceTags: Long gray hair, golden and silver eyes, one golden fang
character_v1.internalSynergy: Eda's kit is designed around the 'Cursed Magic' mechanic, creating unpredictable effects that can be both beneficial and detrimental. Managing this chaos is key to maximizing her potential.

chapters.title: Unleashed Potential
chapters.mission: Clear enemy waves using Wild Magic spells while controlling their erratic side effects.
chapters.summary: Eda teaches Luz wild magic, resulting in unbridled chaos and increased magical aptitude.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Eda mentors Luz, teaching her the chaotic art of Wild Magic but the consequences are drastic.
bondPerks: Chance to trigger additional Wild Magic effects on spell cast.

character_v1.name: King

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~13% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Physical.

abilities.name: Dominion's Aura
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~42%).
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: King's presence inspires his allies and intimidates his foes. Allied champions within 700 units of King gain 5% increased Ability Haste and 3% increased movement speed. Enemy champions within the same range have their attack damage reduced by 4% and receive 1 stack of 'Subjugation' every 5 seconds, up to a maximum of 3 stacks. King generates 1 Titan Echo every time an enemy champion gains a stack of Subjugation. This effect encourages King to stay close to his team while subtly weakening the opposing team's damage output, creating opportunities for coordinated engagements. Remember: Even small advantages can be decisive on the battlefield.
abilities.flavorQuote: Bow before your King! Or at least, try to keep up.

abilities.name: Sonic Edict
abilities.description: King unleashes a targeted sonic shout in a cone-shaped area (600 units range, 60-degree angle). Enemies caught in the blast take 70 (+30% of Magic Attack) magic damage and are slowed by 20% for 1.5 seconds. If King has at least 3 Titan Echoes, he can expend them to enhance the shout: the cone's width increases to 90 degrees, the slow effect is amplified to 40%, and the duration is extended to 2.5 seconds. This amplified effect allows King to peel more effectively for his carries or set up extended crowd control chains for his team.
abilities.flavorQuote: Hear my decree! And try not to get deafened.

abilities.name: Titan's Echo Location
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~41%).
abilities.description: King emits a pulse, briefly revealing the location of all enemies within a 900-unit radius for 3 seconds. Revealed enemies also take 40 (+20% of Magic Attack) magic damage. If King possesses at least 5 Titan Echoes, he can spend them to apply 'Marked' to all revealed enemies for 4 seconds. 'Marked' enemies take 10% increased damage from all sources. This ability provides valuable scouting information and enables coordinated burst damage on priority targets. Knowing the enemy's position is half the battle, use this to control objectives.
abilities.flavorQuote: I know where you're hiding, you can't escape my royal senses!

abilities.name: Glyphic Mandate
abilities.description: King carves a glyph onto the ground, creating a zone that lasts for 5 seconds. Allies who enter the zone gain a shield absorbing 80 (+25% of Magic Attack) damage for 3 seconds. Enemies who enter the zone take 60 (+20% of Magic Attack) magic damage per second and are silenced for 0.75 seconds. If King has at least 4 Titan Echoes, he can spend them to enlarge the glyph zone by 50% and increase the shield and damage values by 30%. This ability is crucial for controlling chokepoints, protecting allies during engages, and zoning out enemy carries. A well-placed glyph can completely change the course of a fight.
abilities.flavorQuote: By the power vested in me, you shall be shielded... or silenced!

abilities.name: Titan's Roar
abilities.description: King channels for 1.5 seconds, then unleashes a devastating roar in a massive area (1200 unit radius). Enemies in the area take 150 (+50% of Magic Attack) magic damage and are knocked back 400 units. For every enemy champion hit, King generates 2 Titan Echoes. If King has at least 7 Titan Echoes upon casting, he can expend them to apply 'Terrified' to all enemies hit for 2 seconds. 'Terrified' enemies flee uncontrollably away from King at 300 movement speed. This ultimate ability can initiate fights, peel for allies, or disrupt enemy formations on a grand scale. A perfectly timed roar can turn a losing battle into a victory.
abilities.flavorQuote: Hear my call! Tremble before the power of a Titan!

character_v1.teamSynergy: King excels in teams that benefit from sustained buffs, strategic vision, and zone control. He synergizes well with aggressive melee champions who can capitalize on his slows and knockbacks, as well as ranged carries who appreciate the protection of his shields and silences. His global vision from Titan's Echo Location also helps coordinate ganks and objective control.
character_v1.tierSummary: King has high HP but low damage and utility outside of his passive. He is reassigned to D-. KPS is 52. Best friendship buff is set to strengthen his single upside. He has a campaign, so nothing is changed.
character_v1.internalSynergy: King's kit revolves around accumulating and strategically spending Titan Echoes to amplify his abilities. Dominion's Aura generates a steady stream of Echoes, while Titan's Roar provides a large burst. Sonic Edict, Echo Location, and Glyphic Mandate all benefit from Echo expenditure, allowing King to adapt to different situations and optimize his impact.

chapters.title: Hooty's Domain
chapters.mission: Navigate Hooty's labyrinthine house while completing strange tasks.
chapters.summary: King attempts to take control of the Owl House, but Hooty's bizarre challenges test King's patience and abilities.
chapters.resonanceBuff: +10% Area of Effect Size & +5% Magic Damage Reduction

friendshipCampaign.overview: King tries to assert his dominance over Hooty, leading to a series of absurd challenges.
bondPerks: Reduced damage taken from AoE attacks.

character_v1.name: Mario

abilities.name: Fireball
upgrades: Lv10: Increases Burn duration by 1 second.
Lv50: Applies a small knockback effect on hit.
Lv100: Fireball chains to a nearby enemy dealing 25% less damage.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Mario hurls a blazing sphere of fire, incinerating his foes with a ranged attack. This fiery projectile targets a single enemy, dealing initial physical damage equal to 50% of Mario's ATK plus a base fire damage. The Fireball then applies a 'Burn' status effect for 3 seconds, inflicting additional fire damage equal to 10% of Mario's ATK per second. The 'Burn' effect stacks up to 3 times, increasing the damage per second accordingly. Subsequent Fireballs refresh the duration of the 'Burn' effect. This ability has a short cast time, leaving Mario briefly vulnerable. The range of the Fireball is medium, allowing Mario to strike from a safe distance. Enemies afflicted with a second stack of 'Burn' are also stunned for 0.5 seconds, interrupting their actions. With three stacks, 'Burn' becomes 'Inferno', increasing fire damage to 20% of Mario's ATK per second and stunning them for 1 full second.

abilities.name: Super Slide
abilities.description: Mario performs a powerful slide tackle in a designated direction. This slide covers a substantial distance, dealing X damage to enemies in its path and knocking them up slightly. If the slide connects with an enemy, Mario gains the 'Momentum Plunge' buff for 3 seconds, increasing his movement speed by 20% and his next basic attack damage by 30%. This ability has a short cooldown, allowing for frequent use and aggressive plays. Successfully hitting an enemy with Super Slide also reduces the cooldown of 'Ground Pound' by 1 second, encouraging combo play. The slide tackle animation is quick and responsive, allowing for skillful maneuvering and evasion.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Here I come!"

abilities.name: Ground Pound
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~18%).
abilities.description: Mario leaps into the air and slams down onto the ground with a mighty Ground Pound. Upon impact, enemies within a small radius take X magic damage and are briefly stunned for 0.75 seconds. This ability can be used to interrupt enemy abilities or set up combos. If Mario has the 'Momentum Plunge' buff, the Ground Pound's radius is increased by 25% and applies a brief slow (20% for 1.5 seconds) in addition to the stun. The cooldown of Ground Pound is moderately long, but can be reduced by successfully hitting enemies with 'Super Slide', promoting aggressive slide tackle play.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Wahoo!"

abilities.name: Red Comet
upgrades: (Patch) Role realignment: this ability now emphasizes assassin-style interactions.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~7% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~8% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Mario channels his inner Super Star, becoming a blur of red-hot speed for 5 seconds. During this time, Mario's movement speed is amplified, allowing him to swiftly traverse the battlefield. As he dashes, he leaves behind a burning trail of star fragments for 3 seconds. Enemies caught in this fiery wake suffer 20 true damage per second for 2 seconds, marking them as vulnerable. At the end of Red Comet, Mario's next basic attack within 4 seconds gains 'Star Power', dealing an additional burst of true damage equivalent to 125% of the total damage dealt by the star fragments to all marked enemies hit by the attack. Using Super Slide during Red Comet further enhances his speed, increasing the movement speed boost of 'Momentum Plunge' to 50% and boosting basic attack damage by 75%. This ability turns Mario into a high-risk, high-reward assassin, focusing on swift strikes and exploiting enemy weaknesses.

abilities.name: Plumber's Grit
abilities.description: Mario's innate resilience as a seasoned plumber grants him increased tenacity. He gains a flat 15% reduction to the duration of stuns, slows, and other crowd control effects. Furthermore, each successful Super Slide hit grants a stacking 5% tenacity bonus for 5 seconds, up to a maximum of 25%. This encourages aggressive play and makes Mario more resistant to crowd control when chaining slide tackles. This passive synergizes directly with Mario's core kit, allowing him to maintain momentum and disrupt enemies more effectively even when targeted with disabling effects.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Let's-a go! Nothing can stop me!"

abilities.name: Superstar Rally
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~12% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Mario summons a gigantic Super Star, becoming invulnerable and unstoppable for 7 seconds. During this time, his movement speed is drastically increased, and his Super Slide ability's range and damage are doubled. Each successful slide tackle during Superstar Rally instantly defeats non-boss enemies and deals massive damage to boss-type enemies. After the Super Star effect ends, Mario releases a final Ground Pound that deals X true damage in a massive area around him. This ultimate ability is designed to be a game-changing burst of power, allowing Mario to single-handedly turn the tide of a fight.
abilities.flavorQuote: "I'm-a invincible!"

character_v1.teamSynergy: Mario excels at disrupting enemy formations, setting up kills for teammates with his knockups and stuns. His area denial with Coin Rush can protect allies, while Superstar Rally can wipe out key targets.
character_v1.tierSummary: Mario has burst potential and mobility, but relies too heavily on predictable plunge attacks. He is reassigned to B-. KPS adjusted to 68. He has a campaign, so nothing is changed. Best friendship buff buffs the damage for his best ability.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Mario's kit revolves around chaining Super Slides to trigger Momentum Plunge, enhancing Ground Pound and Coin Rush. Plumber's Grit ensures he maintains momentum, while Superstar Rally provides a powerful burst for team fights.

chapters.title: Goomba Onslaught
chapters.mission: Defeat waves of Goombas using teamwork and power-ups.
chapters.summary: Mario and Luigi must work together to defeat a massive Goomba invasion threatening the Mushroom Kingdom.
chapters.resonanceBuff: +15% Damage on first hit & +10% Movement Speed

friendshipCampaign.overview: Mario and Luigi team up to stop a rogue Goomba invasion, rediscovering their teamwork.
bondPerks: Bonus movement speed while moving towards ally.

character_v1.name: Princess Peach

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Light.

abilities.name: Royal Blessing
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Peach bestows a royal blessing upon a chosen ally, mending their wounds and bolstering their defenses. The targeted ally is healed for X HP and gains a shield that absorbs damage equal to 20% of their maximum health for 3 seconds. If Peach has accumulated any stacks of 'Royal Grace', consuming one stack will increase the healing amount by 25% and the shield strength by an additional 10% of the ally's maximum health. This ability has a cooldown of 8 seconds, reduced by 1 second for each subsequent application of Royal Blessing within 5 seconds, down to a minimum of 4 seconds. Peach delicately waves her hand, and a soft pink aura envelops the ally, providing immediate relief and temporary resilience.
abilities.flavorQuote: May this blessing keep you safe from harm!

abilities.name: Parasol Defense
abilities.description: Peach elegantly deploys her parasol, creating a protective zone that mitigates incoming damage for herself and nearby allies. For 4 seconds, all allies within a 3-unit radius of Peach receive a 30% damage reduction from all sources. Additionally, if an enemy attempts to pass through the parasol's zone, they are briefly slowed by 40% for 1.5 seconds. While Parasol Defense is active, Peach's movement speed is reduced by 20%. This ability has a 12-second cooldown. The parasol shimmers with a soft, ethereal light, deflecting projectiles and providing a comforting sense of security to those sheltered beneath it.
abilities.flavorQuote: Under my parasol, you're safe from the storm!

abilities.name: Royal Interruption
upgrades: Increases the stun duration of Royal Interruption by 0.25 seconds.
Decreases the cooldown of Royal Interruption by 1 second.
Increases the damage dealt by Royal Interruption by 20%.
Royal Flourish stacks now last 6 seconds instead of 4.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~17% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: With a mischievous glint in her eye, Princess Peach momentarily adopts a poised, defensive stance for 1.5 seconds, poised to transform an opponent's aggression into their own undoing. If an enemy hero attempts to strike Peach with a basic attack during this brief window, she gracefully sidesteps the blow and retaliates with a dazzling display of royal power. A shimmering fan of iridescent energy unfurls in a 90-degree cone directly in front of her, inflicting 75 (+45% of Magic Power) magic damage to any foe caught within its radiant embrace. Not only does this sudden burst of energy deal significant harm, but it also leaves her opponents temporarily bewildered, stunning them for a precious 0.75 seconds, enough time for Peach to reposition or for her allies to capitalize on their vulnerability. However, should no enemy attack trigger the counter within the allotted 1.5 seconds, Peach instead gains one stack of 'Royal Flourish,' increasing her magic damage by 10% for 4 seconds to a maximum of 3 stacks, rewarding careful timing and strategic anticipation. This ability has a cooldown of 12 seconds, requiring careful consideration of when to deploy its deceptive power.

abilities.name: Royal Grace (Signature Passive)
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~15% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Whenever Peach directly assists an ally (healing, shielding, or buffing), she gains one stack of 'Royal Grace', up to a maximum of 5 stacks. Each stack of Royal Grace increases Peach's magic defense by 5 and her healing and shield potency by 3%. Upon reaching 5 stacks, Peach's next use of 'Royal Treatment' gains a bonus effect, granting allies a 15% speed boost for 4 seconds. Royal Grace stacks decay one stack every 10 seconds if no further assists are provided, encouraging continuous support to maintain maximum effectiveness. The more Peach helps, the stronger she becomes, embodying her unwavering dedication to her friends and kingdom.
abilities.flavorQuote: My grace flows strongest when I help others.

abilities.name: Royal Treatment
abilities.description: Peach unleashes a wave of pure, benevolent energy, providing extensive aid to her entire team. All allies within a large radius are instantly healed for X HP and receive a temporary buff that increases their attack damage by 20% and their defense by 15% for 6 seconds. For each stack of 'Royal Grace' Peach possesses at the time of casting, the healing amount is increased by 10%, and the duration of the attack and defense buff is extended by 1 second, up to a maximum of 10 seconds. This ability has a 120-second cooldown. A radiant aura emanates from Peach, washing over her allies and filling them with renewed vigor and determination, showcasing the boundless power of her compassion.
abilities.flavorQuote: I bestow upon you the strength to persevere!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Peach excels in teams that benefit from sustained healing, damage mitigation, and offensive buffs. Her Royal Treatment can significantly enhance a team's damage output and survivability during crucial moments, making her a valuable asset in both offensive and defensive compositions.
character_v1.tierSummary: Peach's kit is heavily focused on support, providing heals, shields, and buffs. A-Tier seems too low considering her defensive capabilities and utility. Elevating to A+ to acknowledge the support meta and her role as a defensive wall.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Peach's abilities synergize by rewarding proactive support. Royal Blessing and Parasol Defense provide immediate protection, while Peach Blossom Counter offers a surprising offensive option. Royal Grace strengthens her supportive capabilities, culminating in a powerful team-wide buff with Royal Treatment.

chapters.title: Kindness Festival
chapters.mission: Complete festival mini-games and spread happiness to the citizens.
chapters.summary: Peach and Daisy work together to organize a grand festival, spreading joy and goodwill throughout the Mushroom Kingdom.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Peach and Daisy host a kingdom-wide celebration, ensuring everyone feels welcome and appreciated.

character_v1.name: Bowser

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Fire.

abilities.name: Shell Spin
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~13% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~13% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Bowser retracts into his shell and spins forward, dealing X physical damage to enemies in his path. If Bowser has at least 50 Rage, the spin duration is increased by 50%, and enemies hit are knocked back a further distance. At maximum Rage (100), Shell Spin also applies a stacking debuff, reducing enemy armor by 10% for 5 seconds, up to a maximum of 30%. This effect triggers on the first hit and is refreshed with each subsequent hit during the extended spin. The spin stops prematurely if Bowser collides with a wall or terrain obstacle.
abilities.flavorQuote: Let's see how you handle this!

abilities.name: Flame Breath
abilities.description: Bowser unleashes a cone of fire in front of him, dealing X magic damage over 3 seconds to enemies within the area. Enemies caught in the flame also suffer from a burn effect, taking an additional X% of their max HP as magic damage over 5 seconds. If Bowser's Rage is above 50, the range of Flame Breath is increased by 30% and the burn damage is increased by 50%. At maximum Rage, Flame Breath also applies a stacking 'Scorched' debuff, increasing the magic damage enemies take from all sources by 5% for 5 seconds, stacking up to 20%.
abilities.flavorQuote: Feel the heat!

abilities.name: Koopa Fortitude
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Bowser gains bonus armor and magic resistance. Additionally, Bowser gains Rage whenever he takes damage, with the amount of Rage gained scaling with the damage received (1 Rage per 1% of max HP lost). When Bowser reaches 100 Rage, he gains a temporary shield equal to 15% of his maximum HP for 5 seconds. This shield also explodes upon expiration or being broken, dealing X magic damage to nearby enemies and consuming all Rage. This ability encourages an aggressive tanking playstyle, rewarding Bowser for staying in the fray and absorbing damage.
abilities.flavorQuote: You'll have to try harder than that!

abilities.name: Ground Pound
abilities.description: Bowser leaps into the air and slams down on a target location, dealing X physical damage to enemies in a small radius. Enemies hit are also stunned for 1.5 seconds. If Bowser has at least 50 Rage, the impact area is increased by 50%, and a fissure erupts from the center of the impact, traveling in a line and dealing X additional physical damage to enemies in its path. Consuming all Rage at max Rage (100) also grants Bowser temporary immunity to crowd control effects for 3 seconds after landing, allowing him to follow up aggressively.
abilities.flavorQuote: Prepare for a world of hurt!

abilities.name: Giga Bowser Transformation
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~14% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Bowser transforms into Giga Bowser for 15 seconds, gaining increased size, X bonus HP, X bonus attack damage, and X bonus armor and magic resistance. During this transformation, all of Bowser's basic abilities are significantly enhanced. Shell Spin deals double damage and applies a stronger knockback. Flame Breath becomes a continuous stream, dealing damage over a wider area. Ground Pound's impact area is doubled, and it creates additional fissures. Koopa Fortitude's shield amount is increased by 50%. After the transformation ends, Bowser suffers from Exhaustion, reducing his speed and damage output by 20% for 5 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Witness my true power!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Bowser synergizes well with teams that can provide him with sustain or amplify his damage output. He also benefits from teammates who can capitalize on the armor reduction and magic damage vulnerability he applies.
character_v1.tierSummary: Bowser's kit has some potential with his Giga Bowser Transformation, but his overall performance is hampered by his lower speed and reliance on rage. A bump to C+ is appropriate due to slight improvements in his kit's synergy.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Bowser's kit revolves around building and utilizing Rage. Koopa Fortitude generates Rage, while his other abilities benefit from having high Rage. Giga Bowser amplifies these effects for a short period.

chapters.title: Castle Siege
chapters.mission: Defend the castle from waves of enemies using traps and brute force.
chapters.summary: Bowser and Kamek must defend Bowser's castle against a sudden invasion, utilizing their combined strength and magic.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Bowser reluctantly teams up with Kamek to defend his castle from a surprise attack.

character_v1.name: Rosalina

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Melee basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Physical.

abilities.name: Cosmic Companions
upgrades: The protective shield granted by 'Starry Aegis' now absorbs additional damage based on a percentage of the target's maximum health.
The 'Stardust Surge' aura now also grants a stacking bonus to attack speed to affected allies, improving their combat effectiveness.
Enemies affected by 'Gravitational Pull' now suffer reduced damage output, weakening their offensive capabilities while slowed.
abilities.description: Rosalina calls upon the aid of her celestial children, summoning a Luma to orbit her, up to a maximum of three. These Lumas, drawn from the very fabric of the cosmos, each emanate a unique aura that affects nearby allies and enemies. Upon summoning, each Luma is imbued with one of the following celestial blessings: 'Starry Aegis', enveloping allies within its aura in a protective shield that absorbs damage, the strength of which scales with Rosalina's magical prowess, deflecting incoming harm for a duration of 3 seconds; 'Stardust Surge', accelerating the movement speed of allies caught in its shimmering embrace by 20%, allowing them to traverse the battlefield with greater haste for 4 seconds; or 'Gravitational Pull', a disorienting field that slows the advance of enemies within its influence by 30%, hindering their progress for 2 seconds. These Lumas persist in their duty for 10 seconds, tirelessly providing their celestial aid, or until they are dismissed by Rosalina or fall to enemy attacks. Each Luma possesses a resilience of 50 health points, making them vulnerable to targeted attacks. Rosalina may choose to recall her companions at any time by reactivating this ability, dismissing all currently summoned Lumas.

abilities.name: Shooting Star Barrage
abilities.description: Rosalina calls down a barrage of shooting stars in a target area. After a 1-second delay, 5 waves of stars fall over 3 seconds, each dealing magic damage to enemies in the area of effect. Each wave deals 40 (+ 20% of Rosalina's Magic Attack) magic damage. If Rosalina has any Lumas active, each Luma increases the damage of the stars by 10%. The area of effect is a circle with a 5-unit radius. Enemies hit by multiple waves take 10% reduced damage from subsequent hits, with a minimum damage reduction of 50%.
abilities.flavorQuote: Feel the celestial wrath!

abilities.name: Cosmic Shift
abilities.description: Rosalina manipulates the cosmic fabric to teleport herself a short distance. Upon activation, Rosalina dashes towards a target location within a 7-unit radius. If a Luma is within 3 units of the destination, Rosalina can choose to teleport the Luma with her, leaving a temporary gravitational distortion at her original location for 2 seconds, slowing enemies by 40%. If Rosalina teleports without a Luma, the ability's cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds. This dash cannot go over impassable terrain.
abilities.flavorQuote: A blink across the universe...

abilities.name: Celestial Harmony
abilities.description: Rosalina passively collects 'Star Bits' whenever an allied champion or Luma damages an enemy champion. Each instance of damage grants her 1 Star Bit, up to a maximum of 100. Upon reaching 100 Star Bits, Rosalina can consume them to empower her next Luma Swarm. The empowered Luma Swarm grants each summoned Luma an additional effect based on its type: (1) Star Shield Luma grants allies within its aura a 10% damage reduction. (2) Cosmic Speed Luma grants allies within its aura immunity to slows. (3) Gravity Well Luma increases the slow effect to 50%. The empowered effects last for the duration of the Lumas' existence.
abilities.flavorQuote: The stars guide my hand, and yours.

abilities.name: Grand Star Nova
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Rosalina unleashes the power of a Grand Star, creating a massive nova centered on herself. The nova expands outward, dealing heavy magic damage to enemies within a 10-unit radius and knocking them back. The damage dealt is 200 (+ 60% of Rosalina's Magic Attack). For each active Luma, the nova's radius increases by 2 units and the damage increases by 50 (+15% of Rosalina's Magic Attack). After the initial blast, the area becomes a 'Cosmic Zone' for 5 seconds, granting allies within the zone a 30% increase in attack speed and magic attack. This ability has a long cooldown.
abilities.flavorQuote: Behold, the heart of a star!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Rosalina synergizes well with teams that can capitalize on her buffs and utility, such as hyper-carry compositions or teams that benefit from increased mobility and attack speed. Her ability to control the battlefield with slows and knockbacks makes her a valuable asset in both offensive and defensive strategies.
character_v1.tierSummary: Rosalina's kit is disjointed. The scaling is poor for her stats, and the summon mechanics are unreliable. Her low defensive stats and inconsistent damage make her an underperformer. Dropping her to F- to reflect the underperforming kit.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Rosalina's kit revolves around summoning and managing Lumas to enhance her and her team's capabilities. Her passive encourages aggressive play to collect Star Bits, which then empower her Lumas, providing significant buffs. Her ultimate is a powerful team fight tool that benefits from having Lumas active.

chapters.title: Starlight's Plea
chapters.mission: Navigate a treacherous asteroid field using Mario's jumping skills and Rosalina's cosmic awareness.
chapters.summary: Rosalina encounters Mario near a telescope, seeking his help to navigate a new galaxy. Mario agrees, fascinated by the potential adventure.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Rosalina discovers a hidden galaxy of forgotten stars and seeks help from Mario to restore their light.

character_v1.name: Ness

abilities.name: PK Rockin'
upgrades: Lv10: +0.1 ATK scaling
Lv50: +5% critical strike chance; critical strikes reduce target's defense by 10% for 3s
Lv100: +15 base damage and interrupt duration increased to 0.75s
abilities.description: Ness focuses his PSI energy, unleashing a single, potent strike of earth-infused force upon a designated enemy. This attack manifests as a concentrated wave of psychic energy, impacting with a base damage value of 50, augmented by a scaling factor of 0.75 times his total ATK. The range extends to 600 units, ensuring Ness can engage from a safe distance. The channeled psychic energy briefly disrupts the target's focus, applying a 0.5 second interrupt (unless the target has interrupt protection) after the damaging strike. As the Rockin' energy surges forth, it slightly drains Ness, reducing his movement speed by 15% for 1.25 seconds immediately after casting, representing the expenditure of mental energy.

abilities.name: PSI Shield
abilities.description: Ness projects a psychic barrier around himself or an ally, granting a shield that absorbs damage. The shield's strength is equal to 10% of Ness's maximum HP, plus an additional amount based on his current PSI stacks. For every 10 PSI stacks Ness has, the shield's strength increases by 5%. This shield lasts for 3 seconds, and any damage absorbed is converted into additional PSI stacks at a 20% efficiency rate. If cast on an ally, Ness gains 5 PSI stacks. This ability has a cooldown of 8 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Taking the hit, so they don't have to.

abilities.name: PK Flash
abilities.description: Ness unleashes a blinding flash of psychic energy in a cone-shaped area in front of him. Enemies caught in the flash have a 40% chance to be afflicted with one of several status effects: Confusion, Paralysis, or Sleep. The chance of inflicting a status effect increases by 2% for every PSI stack Ness has, up to a maximum of 70%. This ability costs 20 PSI stacks to activate; if Ness doesn't have enough stacks, it cannot be used. The range of the cone is 10 units. This ability has a cooldown of 12 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Prepare for a dazzling display... of status ailments!

abilities.name: PSI Resonance (Signature Passive)
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~10% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Ness channels incoming damage into psychic energy. Whenever Ness takes damage, 30% of the damage received is converted into PSI stacks. These stacks can be consumed to enhance the effects of his other PSI abilities. Ness can store a maximum of 100 PSI stacks at any given time. If Ness is at maximum PSI stacks, any further damage taken will instead grant him a temporary buff of 10% increased magic attack for 5 seconds, which does not stack.
abilities.flavorQuote: Every blow fuels my power.

abilities.name: PK Rockin'
abilities.description: Ness unleashes a powerful burst of psychic energy in a targeted area. This ability deals magic damage to all enemies within a 5-unit radius of the target location. The base damage is 80 magic attack, increased by X for every PSI stack Ness consumes upon activation. X = 1.5 * PSI stacks consumed. Activating this ability consumes all current PSI stacks. If there are fewer than 20 stacks available, this ability deals greatly reduced damage (50% of base magic attack).
abilities.flavorQuote: Let's rock this world... with psychic energy!

abilities.name: SMAAASH!! (Ultimate)
abilities.description: Ness channels all his psychic energy into a single, devastating strike. For the next 5 seconds, all of Ness's attacks have a 30% chance to deal critical damage, inflicting 200% damage. Additionally, for every 10 PSI stacks Ness has, this critical damage chance increases by 3%, up to a maximum of 60%. During this time, Ness also gains a 20% increase in speed. After the duration ends, Ness is exhausted, reducing his speed by 10% for 3 seconds. This ability has a long cooldown of 60 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: I'm feeling... a SMAAASH!! coming on!

character_v1.playstyle: Absorbing damage to empower psychic abilities, controlling the battlefield with PSI.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Ness excels on teams that can provide him with protection and opportunities to absorb damage. He synergizes well with tank characters who can draw enemy fire and healers who can keep him in the fight. Additionally, characters that benefit from crowd control or burst damage can capitalize on Ness's PK Flash and PK Rockin'.
character_v1.tierSummary: Ness has a versatile kit with PSI abilities, but he lacks the raw power to be a top-tier damage dealer. The interrupt capability of PK Rockin' is useful. Bump to B- due to his utility and moderate damage output.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Ness' kit revolves around absorbing damage to charge his PSI abilities. PSI Shield and PSI Resonance work together to convert incoming damage into useful PSI stacks. PK Flash provides crowd control, while PK Rockin' serves as a powerful damage dealer when fully charged. SMAAASH!! offers a burst of enhanced damage potential.

chapters.title: Echoes of Giygas
chapters.mission: Coordinate PSI attacks with Paula to disrupt Giygas's influence and purify the affected area.
chapters.summary: Ness senses a disturbance and meets Paula. They discover a localized echo of Giygas's power, requiring their combined PSI to defeat it.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Ness encounters Paula, forming a strong psychic link as they battle a manifestation of the evil Giygas.

character_v1.name: Thor

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Electric.

abilities.name: God of Thunder
abilities.description: Thor generates 5 Odinforce with each basic attack and 10 Odinforce with each ability cast, up to a maximum of 100. When Thor reaches 100 Odinforce, his next lightning-based ability gains Empowered status, increasing its damage by 30% and applying a 2-second stun. Additionally, Thor gains 10% increased movement speed for 3 seconds upon reaching maximum Odinforce, allowing him to close the distance to deliver devastating blows. This passive rewards aggressive play and strategic skill usage, turning Thor into a fearsome presence on the battlefield as he builds up his divine power.
abilities.flavorQuote: The storm is always brewing within me.

abilities.name: Hammer Throw
upgrades: [object Object]
[object Object]
[object Object]
[object Object]
[object Object]
abilities.description: Thor, son of Odin and God of Thunder, channels the raw power of the storm as he hurls his enchanted hammer, Mjolnir, with incredible force towards a designated area. As Mjolnir soars through the air, it cleaves through enemies in its path, inflicting 70 magic damage, augmented by 60% of Thor's magic attack, upon each unfortunate soul caught in its trajectory. The targeted enemies are then branded with 'Stormtouched,' a mark of celestial fury that lasts for 5 seconds. This divine brand amplifies their vulnerability, causing them to suffer 15% increased damage from subsequent lightning-based abilities unleashed by Thor. Should Mjolnir collide with an unyielding wall or traverse its maximum designated range, the mystical hammer defies earthly physics and swiftly returns to Thor's awaiting grasp. During its return journey, Mjolnir continues its onslaught, dealing 40 magic damage, enhanced by 30% of Thor's magic attack, to any enemy foolish enough to remain in its path, ensuring that no foe escapes the God of Thunder's wrath unscathed. This ability is crucial for area control and strategic positioning, allowing Thor to dominate the battlefield and punish reckless opponents.

abilities.name: Mjolnir's Grounding
upgrades: Upon consuming Odinforce, enemies within the shockwave are stunned for 0.5 seconds.
Increases the radius of the shockwave by 50 units.
The shield now also reflects 25% of incoming damage back to the attacker as magic damage.
(Empowered) If at Max Odinforce, the shield also grants Thor 25% tenacity for its duration.
abilities.description: Thor slams Mjolnir into the earth with thunderous force, creating a localized shockwave that reverberates outwards. All enemies within a 300-unit radius of Thor instantly suffer 90 (+70% of Thor's Magic Attack) magic damage. But the true might of Mjolnir is revealed through the Odinforce. If Thor possesses at least 50 Odinforce upon activation, he expends it, not just to unleash the lightning, but to fortify himself. Upon consuming the Odinforce, Thor immediately gains a protective shield that absorbs up to 100 incoming damage for a duration of 4 seconds. The magnitude of this shield is directly proportional to the Odinforce consumed; for every single point of Odinforce spent, the shield's hit points are bolstered by an additional 2 points of protection. The shield decays at a rate of 25 points per second. Thus, a Thor skilled in managing his Odinforce can transform this attack into a potent combination of area damage and robust self-preservation, allowing him to both disrupt enemy formations and steadfastly hold the front line against overwhelming odds.

abilities.name: Lightning Barrage
abilities.description: Thor calls down a series of lightning strikes on a targeted area over 3 seconds, dealing 25 (+20% magic atk) magic damage per strike, hitting up to 5 times. If Thor has at least 75 Odinforce, he consumes it to empower the barrage, increasing the number of strikes to 8 and adding a 30% slow to enemies hit for 2 seconds. The empowered barrage prioritizes enemies marked with 'Lightning Rod', ensuring maximum damage output. This ability serves as Thor's primary sustained damage dealer, punishing grouped-up enemies and providing valuable crowd control.
abilities.flavorQuote: Let the heavens crack!

abilities.name: Odin's Judgement
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~15% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~40%).
abilities.description: Thor channels the Odinforce, becoming invulnerable for 1.5 seconds as he gathers energy. Afterward, he unleashes a massive lightning strike that deals 200 (+100% magic atk) true damage in a large area. If Thor has maximum Odinforce upon casting, the lightning strike also creates a lingering electric field for 5 seconds that deals 30 (+10% magic atk) magic damage per second to enemies within it. This ability represents Thor's ultimate expression of power, capable of obliterating foes and controlling entire sections of the battlefield.
abilities.flavorQuote: By Odin's beard, you shall be judged!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Thor synergizes well with teams that can provide crowd control or damage amplification. Allies who can root or stun enemies allow Thor to land his 'Lightning Barrage' more effectively. Characters who provide damage buffs further increase the impact of his burst damage and ultimate.
character_v1.tierSummary: Thor's kit suffers from inconsistent scaling and limited survivability. The reliance on 'Odinforce' is not impactful enough to compensate for his low stats. Moved down to F because his current state is very weak compared to other heroes, with minimal impact in fights.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Thor's kit revolves around building and expending Odinforce. 'Mjolnir's Flight' marks enemies, setting them up for the increased damage from 'Lightning Barrage.' 'Thunderous Strike' provides survivability with the shield, allowing him to stay in the fight and continue generating Odinforce. 'Odin's Judgement' is a devastating finisher, amplified by having maximum Odinforce.

chapters.title: Asgardian Shield
chapters.mission: Defend strategic points on Earth, utilizing Thor's thunder and Captain America's strategic defense.
chapters.summary: During a Chitauri attack, Thor aligns with Captain America to coordinate defense and tactical assault.
chapters.resonanceBuff: +15% Odinforce buff duration, +10% damage to shielded enemies.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Thor must team up with Captain America to defend Earth from a massive Chitauri invasion.

character_v1.name: Hulk

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Fire.

abilities.name: Gamma-Charged Fists
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Hulk unleashes a devastating punch, dealing 10 + (10% of Hulk's Max HP) physical damage to the primary target and generates 15 Rage. If Hulk has reached 50 Rage, this attack also applies 'Weakened', reducing the target's attack damage by 10% for 3 seconds. If the target is already 'Weakened', the duration is refreshed. This ability also provides Hulk with a shield equal to 5% of his Max HP for 2 seconds, scaling with his defense stat. This shield does not stack and can absorb any type of damage. Utilizing this ability while under the effect of 'Devil Hulk' increases the attack's damage to 15 + (15% of Hulk's Max HP) and the shield to 7% of Max HP.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Hulk smash!"

abilities.name: Seismic Stomp
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~11% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Hulk slams the ground, creating a shockwave that deals 8 + (5% of Hulk’s Max HP) magic damage to all enemies within a moderate radius, knocking them airborne for 1 second and generating 20 Rage. Enemies that are already airborne take an additional 3 True Damage. If Hulk is under the effects of 'World Breaker' persona, this ability deals an additional 5 + (3% of Hulk's Max HP) physical damage and extends the airborne duration by 0.5 seconds. The range of this ability is increased by 10% when Hulk is under the 'World Breaker' persona. This effect can apply every 10 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: "You make Hulk angry!"

abilities.name: Unstoppable Rampage
abilities.description: Hulk charges forward a short distance, becoming immune to crowd control effects for 2 seconds. He deals 12 + (8% of Hulk's Max HP) physical damage to enemies in his path. If Hulk collides with an enemy hero, he stuns them for 1.5 seconds and generates 25 Rage. If Hulk has less than 30% HP when activating this ability, he heals for 10% of his Max HP over 3 seconds after the charge completes, this healing can only occur once every 15 seconds. The stun duration increases to 2 seconds and the healing to 15% of his Max HP while Hulk is under the effects of the 'Savage Hulk' persona.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Hulk is the strongest there is!"

abilities.name: Gamma Surge: Hulk Transformation
abilities.description: Upon reaching 100 Rage, Hulk unleashes a Gamma Surge, transforming into one of three personas at random: 'Savage Hulk', 'World Breaker', or 'Devil Hulk'. Each transformation lasts for 15 seconds. 'Savage Hulk' grants a 20% increase to attack damage. 'World Breaker' provides a 15% damage reduction and a 10% increase to movement speed. 'Devil Hulk' grants 10% Lifesteal and applies a burn effect dealing 2% of the target's Max HP as true damage per second for 5 seconds to enemies hit by Hulk's basic attacks. The choice of transformation is random. After the transformation ends, Hulk loses all accumulated Rage. Each effect can only occur once every 30 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Hulk… changing!"

abilities.name: Anger Amplification
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~9% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Hulk's damage output and damage reduction increase based on the percentage of missing HP. For every 1% of missing HP, Hulk gains 0.3% increased damage output and 0.2% increased damage reduction, up to a maximum of 30% increased damage and 20% damage reduction at 100% missing HP. This passive stacks multiplicatively with the effects of 'Gamma Surge' transformations. Additionally, whenever Hulk takes damage equal to 10% of his Max HP or more in a single instance, he generates 10 Rage. This ability enhances Hulk's tanking and damage dealing capabilities making him more resilient as he sustains more damage.
abilities.flavorQuote: "The madder Hulk gets, the stronger Hulk gets!"

character_v1.teamSynergy: Hulk excels in teams that can capitalize on his crowd control and high damage output. He benefits from allies who can provide healing or shields, allowing him to stay in the fight longer and maximize his Rage generation.
character_v1.tierSummary: Hulk's kit is heavily reliant on Rage and HP scaling. His effectiveness is directly tied to his ability to maintain Rage, which can be easily disrupted. Drop to D- due to the clunky rage mechanic and poor damage outside of transformations.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Hulk's abilities synergize by building Rage, triggering powerful transformations that enhance his combat prowess. The Signature Passive ensures he becomes more formidable as he takes damage, rewarding aggressive play.

chapters.title: Rage Discipline
chapters.mission: Complete a series of combat trials designed to focus Hulk's rage into controlled bursts of power.
chapters.summary: Wolverine seeks out Hulk to teach him control. They clash initially, but discover a mutual respect through intense training.
chapters.resonanceBuff: +10% Rage generation rate, +10% increased max HP scaling

friendshipCampaign.overview: Hulk is mentored by Wolverine to control his rage and focus his power, forming an unlikely bond.

character_v1.name: Aryll

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Wind.

abilities.name: Seagull's Grace (Passive)
abilities.description: Aryll's inherent connection to the skies grants her team passive benefits based on her accumulated Seagull Sightings. For every stack of Seagull Sighting, allies within a medium radius gain 1% increased movement speed and 0.5% increased evasion. When Aryll reaches 10 Seagull Sightings, this bonus doubles for the next 5 seconds. Additionally, once Aryll reaches 20 stacks of Seagull Sighting, she can activate her ultimate ability without cooldown and her basic ability cooldowns refresh, consuming all stacks. This passive encourages proactive scouting and rewards sustained map awareness.
abilities.flavorQuote: The winds whisper secrets, and the gulls guide our way.

abilities.name: Grandma's Telescope
abilities.description: Aryll lovingly gazes through her grandmother's cherished telescope, peering into the distance with practiced ease. As she focuses, a large circular area is revealed, granting vision within for 5 seconds. Enemies caught in the lens's gaze are not merely seen, but subtly judged by Aryll's discerning eye, becoming Marked for the duration. This 'Marked' status weakens their defenses, reducing their evasion by 10%, and providing Aryll with a tangible advantage. For each enemy revealed and marked, Aryll gains 3 stacks of Seagull Sightings, a testament to her keen observation. Furthermore, the magic inherent within the telescope allows Aryll to pierce through trickery, revealing stealthed units within the area; and even after they attempt to flee, the telescope's magic lingers for an additional 2 seconds, keeping them visible. As Aryll observes, the warmth of her intent extends to nearby allies within a short radius, bestowing upon them a shield capable of absorbing up to 50 damage. The strength of this shield resonates with Aryll's magical prowess, scaling with her magic attack, making her insights a source of both knowledge and protection. This ability has a medium cooldown.

abilities.name: Ocean Breeze
upgrades: Increases the duration of the wind area vision.
abilities.description: Aryll, channeling the familiar winds of her island home, summons a powerful gust that sweeps forward in a straight line, embodying the refreshing nature of Outset's shores. This ocean breeze doesn't just tickle; it forcefully pushes back all enemies caught in its path, disrupting their formations and buying precious time for her allies. Those unfortunate enough to be shoved are also slowed by 20%, their movements sluggish for 3 seconds, making them easy targets or hindering their escape. Yet, Aryll's magic isn't purely disruptive. Allies who bask in the Ocean Breeze experience a surge of energy, increasing their attack speed by 10% for the same 3-second duration, allowing them to unleash a flurry of attacks. If this wave of wind collides with a wall or other solid barrier, it doesn't simply dissipate. Instead, it pools into a concentrated vortex of swirling air, creating a visible, circular area of wind that persists for 2 seconds. This small cyclone grants vision within its confines, revealing hidden enemies or providing a safe point of observation. Further enhancing its utility, allies who pass through this breezy haven receive a 5% speed boost, a small but significant advantage that can help them outmaneuver opponents or chase down fleeing foes. For each enemy or ally touched by the Ocean Breeze, Aryll gains 2 Seagull Sightings, empowering her other abilities and solidifying her role as a versatile support.

abilities.name: Grandma's Wisdom
abilities.description: Aryll channels her Grandma's wisdom, granting an ally increased tenacity (reducing the duration of crowd control effects by 30%) and a small heal over time for 4 seconds. The heal restores 5% of the target's maximum HP per second. Additionally, the targeted ally gains 'Clarity', removing one stackable debuff. For each positive effect cleansed or applied, Aryll gains 1 stack of Seagull Sighting, up to a maximum of 3 stacks. Has a medium cooldown. This ability ensures key allies can withstand enemy pressure and maintain their momentum, enabling aggressive plays.
abilities.flavorQuote: Grandma always knows best, her wisdom shields us all.

abilities.name: Great Sea Beacon (Ultimate)
abilities.description: Aryll calls upon the spirit of the Great Sea, creating a large visible beacon at a target location for 8 seconds. The beacon reveals the surrounding area, and any allies within the beacon gain 15% increased damage against marked targets revealed by Aryll's Telescope Spotting ability. The beacon also provides a 10% reduction to incoming damage for all allies inside. This ability has a long cooldown, but is immediately available when reaching 20 stacks of Seagull Sighting from her passive ability. Utilizing the beacon requires Aryll to consume all Seagull Sightings. It is crucial for coordinated team fights and securing objectives, turning the tide with vision and damage amplification.
abilities.flavorQuote: May the Great Sea's light guide our victory!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Aryll excels in teams that can capitalize on vision and burst damage. Her revealed targets are prime for assassins and burst mages, while her team buffs benefit all damage types. She synergizes particularly well with characters who can follow up on her crowd control or benefit from increased speed and damage amplification. Her vulnerability to focus fire requires a team that can protect her while she provides strategic support.
character_v1.tierSummary: Aryll's kit is centered around utility and vision control, but her low damage output and reliance on 'Seagull Sighting' make her difficult to play effectively. Moved to D since her buffs are not strong enough to compensate for her low damage.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Aryll's kit revolves around maximizing her Seagull Sightings to enable her ultimate ability more frequently. The Telescope Spotting and Outset Breeze are both effective at generating Seagull Sightings, while Grandma's Wisdom provides sustain and control support, and the ultimate synergizes well with her other abilities by amplifying damage against revealed targets. Her passive supports the team, especially in long fights, and enables her ultimate for burst engages.

chapters.title: Telescope Rescue
chapters.mission: Use Aryll's spotting and Link's sword skills to rescue the telescope from a band of Bokoblins.
chapters.summary: Aryll seeks Link's help to retrieve her telescope. They travel together, with Aryll spotting danger with her bird watching hobby.
chapters.resonanceBuff: +20% Seagull spotting range, +5% team critical hit chance.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Aryll teams up with Link to recover her stolen telescope, discovering more about the world beyond Outset Island.

character_v1.name: Twilight Sparkle

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Fire.

abilities.name: Harmony Link (Passive)
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~15% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Twilight Sparkle can form a Harmony Link with up to three allied champions within a 700-unit range. Each active link grants her 15% increased Ability Power and reduces her ability cooldowns by 5%, stacking multiplicatively. However, each active link also reduces her Armor and Magic Resistance by 8. These buffs and debuffs dynamically adjust as allies enter or leave the range, creating a risk-reward system for team positioning and synergy. If an ally with a Harmony Link falls below 25% health, Twilight Sparkle gains 20% movement speed towards them and any subsequent healing or shielding on that ally is increased by 10%.
abilities.flavorQuote: Friendship is the most powerful magic of all.

abilities.name: Arcane Barrier
abilities.description: Twilight Sparkle conjures an Arcane Barrier around a targeted ally, granting them a shield that absorbs up to 120 (+60% of Twilight Sparkle's Ability Power) damage for 3 seconds. If Twilight Sparkle has active Harmony Links, the shield's strength is increased by 20% for each linked ally. Additionally, if the shield breaks before its duration ends, the shielded ally gains 10% increased movement speed for 1.5 seconds. This ability has a base cooldown of 12 seconds, reduced by Harmony Link.
abilities.flavorQuote: A little protection goes a long way!

abilities.name: Friendship Beam
abilities.description: Twilight Sparkle fires a concentrated beam of magical energy in a targeted direction, dealing 80 (+50% of Twilight Sparkle's Ability Power) magic damage to the first enemy hit and applying a 'Friendship Mark' for 4 seconds. Enemies with a Friendship Mark take 10% increased damage from Twilight Sparkle's allies. If Twilight Sparkle has at least two Harmony Links active, the beam splits upon impact, firing two smaller beams that deal 40 (+25% of Twilight Sparkle's Ability Power) magic damage to nearby enemies (within 300 units) and also apply the Friendship Mark. Cooldown: 10 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Let's be friends… or else!

abilities.name: Magical Cleanse
abilities.description: Twilight Sparkle unleashes a wave of purifying magic, cleansing a targeted ally of all crowd control effects and granting them immunity to new crowd control effects for 1 second. If Twilight Sparkle has all three Harmony Links active, this ability also heals the target for 80 (+30% of Twilight Sparkle's Ability Power) health. This ability has a base cooldown of 18 seconds, which is reduced by the Harmony Link passive. The cleanse effect has a 300-unit radius, potentially affecting multiple allies in close proximity.
abilities.flavorQuote: Bad magic? Not on my watch!

abilities.name: Elements of Harmony (Ultimate)
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~11% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Twilight Sparkle channels the power of the Elements of Harmony, creating a delayed burst of magical energy in a large targeted area (600-unit radius). After a 2-second delay, the area erupts, dealing 200 (+70% of Twilight Sparkle's Ability Power) magic damage to all enemies within. Additionally, allies within the area gain a 30% increase to their attack and movement speed for 4 seconds. The damage and buff durations are increased by 10% for each active Harmony Link. This ultimate has a long cooldown of 120 seconds, encouraging strategic use during critical team fights.
abilities.flavorQuote: The Elements will always protect us!

character_v1.teamSynergy: She synergizes well with teams that can clump together to benefit from Harmony Link and Elements of Harmony's area buff. Champions that benefit from increased damage or speed also work well with her.
character_v1.tierSummary: Twilight Sparkle's kit has a mix of support and magic damage, but her reliance on Light and the clunky nature of Harmony Link makes her inconsistent. Slightly decreased to C- to reflect lower performance.
appearanceTags: Alicorn with gradient mane (dark blue/magenta streaks)
Cutie Mark: Pink star with white sparkles
character_v1.internalSynergy: Twilight Sparkle's kit revolves around team coordination, with Harmony Link affecting all her abilities. Arcane Barrier and Magical Cleanse offer direct support, while Friendship Beam provides a damage amp for allies. Elements of Harmony can turn the tide of a fight but requires setup.

chapters.title: Equality's Shadow
chapters.mission: Help the villagers embrace their differences and use their unique talents to overcome the magical equality barrier.
chapters.summary: Twilight and Starlight confront a lingering pocket of the village Starlight reformed. The town's past is resurfacing.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Twilight Sparkle aids Starlight Glimmer in reforming a village built on forced equality, emphasizing the importance of individuality.

character_v1.name: Naruto (Season 1)

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~7% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Fire.

abilities.name: Shadow Clone Barrage
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Naruto creates three shadow clones that each perform a separate action. One clone dashes forward, dealing 60 + (0.6 * Attack) physical damage to the first enemy hit. Another clone throws three shurikens, dealing 30 + (0.3 * Attack) physical damage each to enemies in a small cone. The third clone performs a sweeping kick, knocking up enemies in a small radius for 0.75 seconds. If Naruto's HP is below 30%, 'Unpredictable Stamina' kicks in, and there's a 30% chance the clones will attack each other instead, dealing half damage to Naruto and his clones. Additionally, after the clones disperse, Naruto gains 10 Rasengan Charge.
abilities.flavorQuote: Believe it! Triple threat, coming right up!

abilities.name: Foxfire Frenzy
abilities.description: Naruto channels his inner fox spirit, increasing his attack speed by 30% and movement speed by 20% for 4 seconds. During this time, his auto-attacks inflict a stacking debuff called 'Foxfire' on enemies, increasing the damage they take from his Rasengan by 5% per stack, up to a maximum of 25%. If Naruto's health drops below 30% during Foxfire Frenzy, 'Unpredictable Stamina' causes the buff to end prematurely with a 50% chance, stunning Naruto for 1 second. If the effect ends naturally, Naruto gains 20 Rasengan Charge.
abilities.flavorQuote: I'm just gettin' warmed up!

abilities.name: Hidden Potential
abilities.description: Naruto's determination allows him to tap into hidden reserves. Whenever Naruto takes damage equal to 10% of his maximum health, he gains a stack of 'Guts', up to a maximum of 5 stacks. Each stack of 'Guts' increases his attack damage by 4% and his tenacity by 2%. Upon reaching 5 stacks, Naruto consumes all stacks to enter a 'Focused' state for 5 seconds, granting immunity to crowd control effects and increasing his Rasengan Charge gain from other abilities by 20%.
abilities.flavorQuote: I'm not gonna back down, EVER!

abilities.name: Rasengan Charge
abilities.description: Naruto passively builds up Rasengan energy through his actions. Dealing damage with basic attacks grants 2 Rasengan Charge per hit. Successfully landing ability hits grants a bonus to Rasengan Charge. Rasengan Charge decays over time. Upon reaching 100 Rasengan Charge, Naruto's next ability, 'Rasengan', becomes available for use. The decay rate of Rasengan Charge is accelerated when Naruto is out of combat for more than 5 seconds, emphasizing the importance of maintaining aggression.
abilities.flavorQuote: Gotta focus... gotta build it up!

abilities.name: Rasengan
abilities.description: Naruto unleashes his signature Rasengan, channeling all accumulated energy into a devastating attack. Naruto dashes forward a short distance, dealing 200 + (1.2 * Attack) magic damage to the first enemy hit. The damage is increased by the number of 'Foxfire' stacks on the target. If 'Rasengan' is used when Naruto has less than 30% HP, 'Unpredictable Stamina' has a 70% chance of causing Naruto to fumble the Rasengan, dealing only 50% damage and knocking himself back a short distance, stunning himself for 1.5 seconds. Using Rasengan consumes all Rasengan Charge.
abilities.flavorQuote: RASENGAN!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Naruto benefits from teammates who can apply crowd control to help him land his Rasengan and stack Foxfire. He also excels in teams that can provide sustain, allowing him to maintain aggression and stack Guts without being easily bursted down.
character_v1.tierSummary: Naruto (Season 1) is moved up to C- due to his Rasengan's potential for burst damage and his supportive abilities. However, his reliance on scaling and status conditions limits his overall impact. Low base stats limit his performance.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Naruto's kit revolves around building Rasengan Charge through aggressive play. Foxfire Frenzy amplifies the damage of Rasengan, while Shadow Clone Barrage helps to initiate fights and build additional Rasengan Charge. Hidden Potential rewards taking damage, making him a surprisingly resilient skirmisher.

chapters.title: Bridge of Courage
chapters.mission: Coordinate attacks to protect Tazuna from Zabuza's attacks. Focus on their teamwork and mutual support.
chapters.summary: Naruto and Sasuke work together under Kakashi to protect Tazuna from Zabuza. Their early teamwork begins to form.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Naruto must learn to cooperate with Sasuke to stop Zabuza and Haku. This is the first step to their bond.

character_v1.name: Kitty Softpaws

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Melee basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Physical.

abilities.name: Softpaw Stealth
abilities.description: Kitty's declawed nature grants her unparalleled stealth. When not attacking or taking damage for 3 seconds, Kitty enters a 'Softpaw Stealth' state, gaining 20% increased movement speed and becoming partially invisible. While in this state, her next basic attack or ability gains increased critical hit chance by 30% and generates 5 Gambit Points. Successfully hitting an enemy with a critical strike while in 'Softpaw Stealth' grants her an additional Gambit Point and applies a 'Marked' debuff to the target for 4 seconds. Marked enemies take 8% increased damage from all sources. The 'Softpaw Stealth' state is immediately broken upon attacking or being hit. This passive ensures Kitty can strategically position herself for burst damage opportunities.
abilities.flavorQuote: Sometimes, the greatest weapon is the one they don't see coming.

abilities.name: Acrobatic Escape
abilities.description: Kitty performs a quick, acrobatic dash in a target direction. If 'Acrobatic Escape' passes through an enemy, she gains 3 Gambit Points. If Kitty has at least 5 Gambit Points, she can choose to expend them upon activation to enhance the dash with one of the following effects: 'Enfeebling Vault,' applying a 20% slow to enemies within a small radius at the destination for 2 seconds; or 'Evasive Roll,' granting Kitty a shield that absorbs X damage (scales with level) for 2 seconds. This ability provides Kitty with essential mobility and allows her to either set up plays or protect herself.
abilities.flavorQuote: Did you see that? No? That's the point.

abilities.name: Gatito Blade
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Kitty extends her Gatito Blade, performing a swift, precise strike at a target enemy. This attack deals high single-target damage, scaling with Kitty's attack and luck stats. If Kitty has at least 8 Gambit Points, she can empower 'Gatito Blade,' consuming the points to deal additional True Damage equal to 10% of the target's missing health, making it a formidable execute. Furthermore, empowered 'Gatito Blade' critically strikes guarantee a bleed effect that inflicts X damage over 3 seconds. Landing an empowered strike also refunds 3 Gambit Points. This ability is Kitty's primary source of burst damage and is enhanced by strategic use of Gambit Points.
abilities.flavorQuote: This little thing? It's more dangerous than you think.

abilities.name: Charming Distraction
abilities.description: Kitty uses her charm and wit to distract enemies. Upon activation, Kitty throws a glittering object in a target direction. Enemies within a moderate radius of the landing point are taunted for 1.5 seconds and have their magic defense reduced by 15% for 4 seconds. If Kitty is in 'Softpaw Stealth' when activating 'Charming Distraction,' the taunt duration is increased to 2.5 seconds, and affected enemies also suffer a 20% reduction in attack damage for the same duration. This ability provides crowd control and amplifies damage, making Kitty a valuable asset in team fights and synergizing with allies' burst damage.
abilities.flavorQuote: Oh, look! Shiny!

abilities.name: Nine Graces
abilities.description: Kitty embodies her agility and cunning, entering a state of 'Nine Graces' for 8 seconds. While active, Kitty gains 30% increased evasion and 20% increased attack speed. Additionally, each successful evasion grants her 2 Gambit Points (up to a maximum of 10). During 'Nine Graces', Kitty's 'Acrobatic Escape' cooldown is reduced by 50%, allowing for rapid repositioning. At the end of the ultimate, Kitty unleashes a final flourish, dealing AoE damage around her and stunning enemies for 1 second. The AoE damage dealt scales with the amount of Gambit Points she accumulated during the ultimate's duration, making skillful play paramount. This ability transforms Kitty into an elusive, damage-dealing force.
abilities.flavorQuote: I may be down a few claws, but I've got more than enough tricks.

character_v1.playstyle: Acrobatic Burst Damage Dealer with Debuffs
character_v1.teamSynergy: Kitty excels in teams that can capitalize on her debuffs and burst damage potential. Allies who can follow up on her 'Marked' targets or take advantage of taunted enemies will synergize well. Her mobility and crowd control make her valuable in both offensive and defensive compositions, providing utility and disruption to control the flow of battle.
character_v1.tierSummary: Kitty Softpaws drops to A- despite burst potential. Relies heavily on Gambit Points for damage which is unreliable. Decent speed and execute potential keeps her viable but not top tier. Kit doesn't offer enough utility.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Kitty's kit revolves around generating and expending Gambit Points for enhanced mobility, damage, and debuffs. 'Softpaw Stealth' and 'Acrobatic Escape' generate Gambit Points, while 'Gatito Blade' utilizes them for burst damage. 'Charming Distraction' sets up enemies for burst, and 'Nine Graces' amplifies her evasion and attack speed, while her playstyle rewards precise positioning and timing.

chapters.title: Gem Heist
chapters.mission: Infiltrate the vault and steal the gem using stealth and acrobatic maneuvers. Coordinate to evade guards.
chapters.summary: Kitty and Puss reluctantly join forces for a heist. Their rivalry is intense.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Kitty works with Puss in Boots to steal a legendary gem, rediscovering their shared past and complex relationship.

character_v1.name: Light Yagami

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Light.

abilities.name: Surveillance State
abilities.description: Light passively gathers intel on enemies. Every 20 seconds, Light gains a 'Profile' on the enemy champion who has dealt the most damage to him in the last 20 seconds. A 'Profile' grants Light vision of that enemy champion for 3 seconds and reveals their current mana/energy. If no damage has been taken, the profile is instead generated on the closest enemy champion. Additionally, when an enemy champion remains visible within 1200 units of Light for 6 seconds, they receive 1 stack of 'Judgement'. This ability has a global range and will always prioritize enemy champions, not minions or other units.
abilities.flavorQuote: Knowledge is power, and I intend to wield it.

abilities.name: Criminal Profile
abilities.description: Light analyzes a target enemy champion within 700 units, meticulously noting their most recent actions. Upon activation, the target receives one stack of 'Judgement'. For the next 4 seconds, all damage that target deals is reduced by 10%. If Light lands his 'Basic Attack' on this target, the remaining damage reduction is converted to a 30% slow that decays over 1 second, effectively disrupting their combat rhythm. If, however, the target has been previously identified by Light's passive 'Surveillance State', the application of 'Judgement' is accelerated, adding two stacks instead of one, furthering his control over their fate. This allows light to control a target and set them up for his other abilities. Criminal Profile has a cooldown of 8 seconds and consumes 50 mana.

abilities.name: Death Note - Final Judgement
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Potency re-evaluated: Reduced base damage by 15, increased silence duration by 0.25 seconds.
(Tactical Patch) Shifted Paradigm: Applying the first stack of Judgement now grants Light a shield equal to 5% of his maximum health for 3 seconds.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~42%).
abilities.description: Light Yagami focuses his intent, fixing his gaze upon a chosen enemy champion within 800 units, instantly inscribing their name within the Death Note and branding them with one stack of 'Judgement'. Each stack of 'Judgement' applied by Light will increasingly affect the target's defenses, making them increasingly vulnerable to his lethal sentence. If the selected target already bears three stacks of 'Judgement', Light can choose to enact 'Final Judgement', inflicting 200 true damage enhanced by 60% of Light’s Magic Attack, dealing a devastating blow to their life force and silencing them for 1.5 seconds, preventing them from using abilities or casting spells. This conclusive act of Final Judgement will consume all stacks of 'Judgement' upon the target, demanding that Light once again focus on his opponents before passing final sentence. 'Final Judgement' demands meticulous planning and timing, for it carries a cooldown of 10 seconds and expends 60 mana.

abilities.name: L Lawliet's Gambit
abilities.description: Light lays a trap, mimicking L's meticulous planning, placing an invisible marker at a target location within 600 units, which arms after 1.5 seconds. If an enemy champion wanders within 250 units of this marker, the trap triggers, ensnaring them with binding chains for 1 second, grounding them, and applying one stack of 'Judgement'. The trap persists for 15 seconds or until triggered, allowing Light to strategically control enemy movements and dictate the flow of engagement. This ability holds two charges, enabling Light to deploy multiple traps, but each charge regenerates independently over a duration of 16 seconds. However, Light must manage his resources carefully as each use costs 60 mana. L Lawliet's Gambit provides both area denial and crowd control, enhancing Light's tactical prowess. It is invisible and persists in the environment.
abilities.flavorQuote: Let's see if you can solve this puzzle.

character_v1.teamSynergy: Light excels in teams that can capitalize on his vision control and delayed executions. Champions that benefit from revealed enemies or can quickly follow up on executed targets synergize well with him. He can also provide peel for carries with his silence and zoning capabilities.
