abilities.name: Twisted Hairs' Wisdom
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~12% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Ulysses gains a stack of 'Reflection' each time an enemy applies a debuff to him or an ally within a medium radius. At 5 stacks, Ulysses consumes them to gain 'Clarity,' cleansing all debuffs from himself and nearby allies, and granting them immunity to crowd control effects for 2 seconds. Additionally, the 'Ideological Warfare' ability gains a 25% reduced cooldown for the next application after achieving Clarity. This passive emphasizes Ulysses's resilience and adaptability in chaotic situations, allowing him to turn enemy aggression into strategic advantage. It also supports his role as a protector of his team.
abilities.flavorQuote: We learn from every scar, every betrayal. History is the greatest teacher.

abilities.name: Dividing the Wastes
upgrades: Increase the duration of ideology effects on the ground from 5 seconds to 7 seconds.
Increase the shield strength granted by the Legion ideology by 20%.
Allies within an NCR aligned area heal for an additional 5 health per second.
Reduce the cooldown by 2 seconds.
abilities.description: Ulysses brands the battlefield with echoes of the Old World, choosing between NCR, Legion, or Independent ideologies with each cast. Upon activation, Ulysses designates either a ground area or a single enemy champion. If an area is chosen, the ground becomes imbued with his chosen ideology for a duration of 5 seconds. An NCR-aligned zone pulses with righteous fury, healing allied champions within for 15 (+10% of Ulysses's magic attack) health per second. A Legion-aligned zone reinforces his allies, granting those inside a shield that absorbs 25 (+15% of Ulysses's magic attack) damage. An Independent zone stimulates action, granting allies 10% increased movement speed. If, instead, Ulysses casts this ability upon an enemy, the effects are altered. An NCR brand causes them to deal 15% less attack damage. A Legion brand reduces their healing received by 30%. An Independent brand slows them by 20%. Ulysses can only maintain one instance of each ideology at any given time and must wait 8 seconds before casting this ability again.

abilities.name: Parting Shot
upgrades: Further reduces cooldown by 1 second.
Damage increased by 10%.
Increases slow duration by 1 second.
abilities.description: Ulysses unleashes a blast of compressed air and debris, a final parting message delivered to a targeted zone. This localized tempest deals 60 (+20% of Ulysses's magic attack) magic damage over 3 seconds to all adversaries caught within its wrath. The true power of this ability, however, lies in its manipulation of Ideological Warfare. Those enemies who find themselves aligned with Ulysses's ideology, as defined by his Ideological Warfare ability, suffer an amplified fury, enduring 50% increased damage from Parting Shot. Conversely, those who stand in opposition, whose beliefs clash with Ulysses's own, are slowed by 30%, hindering their retreat. The turbulent air lingers for 4 seconds, a constant reminder of Ulysses's presence. Should any foe dare to flee the tempest's embrace before its conclusion, they are branded with 'Windswept', a mark lasting 3 seconds. This brand ensures that the next instance of damage they suffer is amplified, taking an additional 20 (+10% of Ulysses's magic attack) magic damage. Parting Shot offers a potent combination of area control and strategic advantage, punishing disunity and rewarding ideological coherence. Cooldown of 12 seconds.

abilities.name: Old Glory
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~9% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Ulysses plants his Old World flag in a target location, creating a zone of influence for 6 seconds. Allies within this zone gain 20 (+10% of Ulysses's Def) shield that regenerates every second. If the flag is planted within a zone affected by 'Ideological Warfare', the effects of that Ideology are amplified by 30% for allies and enemies respectively. If the flag is planted on an enemy affected by 'Ideological Warfare,' the shield is applied to the affected enemy instead, absorbing damage. However, the regeneration is converted to a damage-over-time effect, dealing 10 (+5% magic atk) magic damage per second. Cooldown of 15 seconds. This ability provides a powerful defensive tool while also amplifying the strategic effects of Ideological Warfare.
abilities.flavorQuote: A flag is more than cloth and thread. It's a promise, a symbol, a reason to fight.

abilities.name: Lonesome Road
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~47%).
abilities.description: Ulysses channels for 2 seconds, then unleashes a devastating barrage of missiles targeting a large area. Each missile deals 80 (+30% magic atk) magic damage upon impact and applies a stacking debuff called 'Cracked Earth.' Each stack of 'Cracked Earth' reduces the target's armor and magic resistance by 5%, stacking up to 5 times. If the target area overlaps with any 'Ideological Warfare' zone, the channel time is reduced by 0.5 seconds, and the missile damage is increased by 20% for each active Ideology. After the missiles land, the area remains irradiated, dealing 15 (+5% magic atk) magic damage per second for 4 seconds. This ultimate represents Ulysses's destructive potential and ability to reshape the battlefield, enhanced by his strategic setup.
abilities.flavorQuote: Every road leads to a choice. This one leads to destruction... or perhaps, a new beginning.

character_v1.playstyle: Strategic Zone Control, Ideological Synergies, Conditional Gameplay
character_v1.teamSynergy: Ulysses excels in teams that can capitalize on his zone control and ideological buffs. Allies who benefit from Lifesteal or increased movement speed pair well with Legion and Independent Ideologies, respectively, while tanks who can withstand damage while Ulysses sets up his zones are also valuable. Characters that can benefit from armor and magic resistance reduction will thrive in teams with Ulysses.
character_v1.tierSummary: Ulysses has a decent kit for debuffing and some supportive capabilities. His low damage and lack of focus make him inconsistent. KPS boost and move to D+.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Ulysses' kit revolves around the strategic application of Ideologies, with his passive granting cooldown reduction to Ideological Warfare. Divide Storm synergizes with Ideological Warfare by dealing increased damage to enemies of aligned ideology, and Old Glory amplifies the effects of Ideologies, creating a cohesive playstyle that rewards careful planning and tactical execution. Lonesome Road benefits directly from active Ideologies, rewarding preemptive placement.
character_v1.bestFriendshipBuff: Increased area of effect of debuffs.

chapters.title: Ideological Clash
chapters.mission: Debate is simulated, players select dialogue options that give arguments. At the end of each round, health is decreased based on the opponent's better arguments.
chapters.summary: Ulysses and Osmund debate their ideologies. They end up needing to come together to find the source of the divide and conquer.
chapters.resonanceBuff: Grants Ulysses a 25% chance to resist debuffs applied by enemies and increases damage from Ideological Warfare by 8%.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Ulysses confronts the consequences of his actions, seeking redemption and a path to peace.

character_v1.name: Marshmallow

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~7% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Wind.

abilities.name: Icy Rampage
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~15% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Marshmallow charges forward a short distance, dealing 80 + (0.5 * ATK) physical damage to all enemies in his path and applying 1 stack of Chill. If Marshmallow collides with a wall or terrain during this charge, the impact creates a small area of icy shards that persist for 3 seconds, slowing enemies within by 20%. Enemies hit by the charge or standing in the icy shards also have their attack speed reduced by 10% for 2 seconds. This ability has a cooldown of 8 seconds. This ability is best utilized to quickly engage or disengage from fights, or to create obstacles that can disrupt enemy movement.
abilities.flavorQuote: Get out of my way!

abilities.name: Snowy Breath
abilities.description: Marshmallow unleashes a cone of freezing breath in front of him, dealing 50 + (0.4 * Magic ATK) magic damage over 2 seconds to enemies within the area. Each tick of damage applies a stack of Chill. Enemies hit by Snowy Breath are also blinded for 1 second, reducing their accuracy. If an enemy is already at max Chill stacks, Snowy Breath immediately converts it to Freeze, stunning them for 1.5 seconds instead of applying additional Chill. This ability has a 10-second cooldown. It’s most effective in close-quarters combat to maximize the chance of freezing enemies.
abilities.flavorQuote: Feel the chill of the North Mountain!

abilities.name: Frozen Fortitude
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~38%).
abilities.description: Marshmallow gains bonus armor and magic resistance equal to 10% of his current Chill stacks across all enemies. Each stack of Chill also grants Marshmallow 2% increased tenacity. Additionally, whenever an enemy is Frozen by Marshmallow's abilities, he gains a shield equal to 5% of his maximum health for 4 seconds. This shield can stack up to 3 times. Frozen Fortitude enhances Marshmallow's tankiness, making him harder to kill the more he can apply Chill and Freeze effects. This passive encourages aggressive play and strategic use of his abilities.
abilities.flavorQuote: The cold only makes me stronger!

abilities.name: Glacial Smash
abilities.description: Marshmallow slams the ground, creating a shockwave that deals 120 + (0.6 * ATK) physical damage to nearby enemies. Enemies hit are knocked up for 0.75 seconds and have 2 stacks of Chill applied. If an enemy is already at max Chill stacks, Glacial Smash deals an additional 50 true damage and applies a 30% slow for 2 seconds. This ability has a 12-second cooldown. Glacial Smash is a powerful area-of-effect ability that can disrupt enemy formations and set up for further attacks, especially against enemies already affected by Chill. Positioning is key to maximizing the impact of the knock-up and slow effects.
abilities.flavorQuote: Feel the ice quake!

abilities.name: Absolute Zero
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~17% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Marshmallow channels for 2 seconds, becoming immobile but gaining 50 bonus armor and magic resistance. After the channel, he unleashes an immense blast of freezing energy, dealing 200 + (0.8 * Magic ATK) magic damage to all enemies in a large area. All enemies hit are instantly frozen for 2 seconds. Afterwards, the ground in the affected area becomes frozen for 5 seconds, slowing enemies by 40%. This ability has a 90-second cooldown. Absolute Zero is a game-changing ultimate ability that can lock down entire teams, providing a window for allies to capitalize. Strategic positioning and timing are crucial to ensure maximum impact and avoid being interrupted during the channel.
abilities.flavorQuote: Embrace the eternal winter!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Marshmallow synergizes well with damage dealers who can capitalize on crowd control, especially those who benefit from grouped or slowed enemies. He provides both initiation and follow-up, making him a valuable asset to any team composition focused on sustained engagements.
character_v1.tierSummary: Marshmallow's kit has decent utility with chill, freeze, and shield. However, the scaling is inconsistent, and the stats are not skewed enough for D+. The move to C- recognizes the potential, but it needs better stat optimization to be viable.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Marshmallow's kit revolves around applying Chill and capitalizing on the Frozen status. Icy Rampage and Snowy Breath provide consistent Chill application, while Glacial Smash and Absolute Zero offer powerful follow-ups for already chilled enemies. Frozen Fortitude enhances Marshmallow's tankiness, making him a resilient disruptor.

chapters.title: Frozen Frontier
chapters.mission: Tisha must keep up with Marshmallow while cleaning up the frozen frontier. Both will need to defeat the local wildlife along the way.
chapters.summary: Marshmallow's playful nature clashes with Tisha's cleanliness. The two eventually learn that they have more in common than they thought.
chapters.resonanceBuff: Reduces the cooldown of Icy Rampage by 3 seconds and increases the AoE radius by 5%.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Marshmallow discovers the beauty and danger of the frozen wilderness, seeking a place to call home.

character_v1.name: Osmund Saddler

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~11% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Wind.

abilities.name: Plaga Seed
abilities.description: Saddler launches a Plaga Seed at the target location. Upon impact, the seed explodes, dealing 80 (+60% magic atk) magic damage to enemies within a 200 radius and applying 'Plaga Resonance' to the area for 5 seconds. Enemies hit are also slowed by 20% for 2 seconds. If cast on terrain already affected by 'Plaga Resonance', the area expands by 100 radius and the slow effect is increased to 40%. This allows Saddler to strategically expand his area of influence and control enemy movement. The Plaga Seed travels at a moderate speed, allowing for both offensive and defensive use. Casting range is 600 units.
abilities.flavorQuote: Let us give you our power.

abilities.name: Resonance Burst
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~8% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Saddler channels for 1 second, then detonates all 'Plaga Resonance' areas within a 700 unit radius. Each detonated area deals 100 (+70% magic atk) magic damage to enemies caught in the blast, consuming the 'Plaga Resonance'. For each enemy hit by the blast, Saddler gains a stack of 'Plaga Amplification', increasing his magic attack by 5% per stack, up to a maximum of 5 stacks, lasting 6 seconds. This encourages strategic placement of Plaga Seeds to maximize Resonance Burst damage and gain significant magic attack boosts. The detonation has a distinct visual cue, giving enemies a brief window to evade.
abilities.flavorQuote: Feeble humans, unable to resist this intoxicating power.

abilities.name: Master Plaga
abilities.description: Saddler is infused with the Master Plaga, granting him several benefits. Firstly, he gains 10% increased magic resistance. Secondly, enemies affected by 'Plaga Resonance' take 10% increased magic damage from all sources. Finally, whenever an enemy affected by 'Plaga Resonance' dies, a new, smaller 'Plaga Resonance' area (100 radius) is created at their location for 3 seconds. This encourages aggressive play and rewards Saddler for successfully eliminating enemies within his controlled zones, further expanding his area of influence. The increased magic resistance helps Saddler survive engagements while setting up his combos.
abilities.flavorQuote: I can feel them, growing ever so strongly inside you.

abilities.name: Mind Control
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Saddler attempts to mentally dominate a target enemy within 500 range. If the target is affected by 'Plaga Resonance', the ability instantly charms them for 1.5 seconds, forcing them to attack their allies. If the target is not affected by 'Plaga Resonance', Saddler must channel for 2 seconds, after which the target is charmed for 1 second. During the channel, Saddler is vulnerable and slowed by 30%. This ability provides strong crowd control and disruption, but requires strategic setup with Plaga Resonance to be used effectively in chaotic situations. Charmed enemies deal 20% reduced damage.
abilities.flavorQuote: Perhaps you can resist, but you cannot disobey.

abilities.name: Final Mutation
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~18% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Saddler transforms into his monstrous mutated form for 15 seconds. During this time, his magic attack is increased by 50%, his movement speed is increased by 20%, and he gains 200 bonus health. Additionally, Resonance Burst now has no cast time and its range is increased to 900 units. Each successful Resonance Burst cast during this form also heals Saddler for 10% of the damage dealt. Upon transformation, Saddler emits a pulse that applies 'Plaga Resonance' to all enemies within a 400 radius. This ultimate dramatically enhances Saddler's damage output, mobility, and survivability, making him a terrifying force in team fights. The transformation has a distinct visual and audio cue.
abilities.flavorQuote: It is time to shed the one. My flesh shall give birth to a God everlasting!

character_v1.playstyle: Strategic deployment of Las Plagas to control space and amplify damage, culminating in a devastating transformation.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Saddler synergizes well with teams that can either group enemies together for easier Resonance Burst detonations or provide additional crowd control to set up Mind Control. Allies that can benefit from the increased magic damage taken by enemies in Plaga Resonance zones also synergize well.
character_v1.tierSummary: Saddler has potential with Plaga synergy, but his base stats are too low and his abilities are inconsistent. Moving him from E- to F+ to reflect the minimal impact he has even with team synergy.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Saddler's kit revolves around establishing and detonating Plaga Resonance zones. Plaga Seed sets up these zones, which Resonance Burst then detonates for damage and buffs. Mind Control benefits greatly from pre-existing Plaga Resonance, and Master Plaga further enhances the damage output within these zones. The ultimate, Final Mutation, amplifies all of these effects, making Saddler a powerhouse during its duration.

chapters.title: Plaga Conspiracy
chapters.mission: Cammy must lead the town under the influence of the Plaga, taking out any rebels along the way while protecting civilians from any other harm.
chapters.summary: Osmund tries to take control of Cammy, however is unable to due to her Delta upgrade. Instead, he decides to manipulate Cammy to his advantage, working together to take over a town.
chapters.resonanceBuff: Increases the duration of Plaga Seed's effects by 2 seconds and boosts the damage of Resonance Burst by 15%.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Osmund Saddler seeks to expand his influence, using the Plaga to control and conquer.

character_v1.name: Marth

abilities.name: Fire Emblem
upgrades: Lv10: Increases the base damage scaling to 60% Attack + 30% True Damage.
Lv50: Flame Emblem duration increased to 5 seconds, and critical hit chance increased by 10%.
Lv100: Flame Emblem now also applies a 5% movement speed reduction per stack.
abilities.description: Marth swiftly draws Falchion, delivering a precise, faith-infused strike. He focuses all his skill and experience into one fluid motion, channeling divine power to maximize the blow's impact. The attack deals physical damage equal to 50% of Marth's Attack, plus an additional 25% Attack as bonus true damage, piercing through conventional armor. The radiant energy of Falchion briefly ignites the target, inflicting 'Flame Emblem' for 3 seconds, reducing the target's healing received by 10% per stack. Stacks up to 3 times. This attack has a base critical hit chance of 5%, which can be further enhanced by other abilities or items. The attack range is melee, and it can only target a single enemy at a time.

abilities.name: Royal Lineage
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: late-level scaling improved for increased sustain.
(Patch) Synergistic Adjustment: now scales with % missing HP.
abilities.description: Marth's noble bloodline bolsters his allies. Nearby allies within a 500-unit radius of Marth benefit from his unwavering presence, passively healing for 2% of their maximum health every second. This healing is visually represented as a gentle, blue aura washing over affected allies, signifying the restorative power of Marth's leadership. Further enhancing this effect, whenever Marth uses 'Binding Shield', the healing rate from Royal Lineage doubles to 4% of maximum health per second for the next 4 seconds, providing a surge of vitality to his comrades when they need it most, allowing them to withstand greater pressures and assaults in heated combat.

abilities.name: Falchion's Edge
abilities.description: Marth dashes forward a short distance, delivering a swift strike with Falchion. This attack deals 80 base damage and applies 'Weakened' to the target for 4 seconds, reducing their attack damage by 10%. Additionally, if the target is affected by a 'Royal Decree', the duration of 'Weakened' is extended by 2 seconds. This move allows Marth to both engage and disrupt enemy damage output, making him invaluable against high-threat targets. The dash component also provides a small mobility option, enhancing his positioning capabilities within a fight.
abilities.flavorQuote: Evil shall not prevail while I stand!

abilities.name: Aura of Command
upgrades: (Patch) Role realignment: this ability now emphasizes utility-style interactions.
abilities.description: Marth inspires his allies with an 'Aura of Command', bolstering their defenses and weakening their foes. Upon activation, for the next 5 seconds, allies within a radius of 8 units emanate a protective field, reducing incoming damage by 5%. This aura, subtly visible through a shimmering effect around the affected allies, also causes enemies struck by allies benefiting from the 'Aura of Command' to suffer a reduction in damage output. This debuff diminishes the enemy's damage dealt by 10% for 3 seconds. The 'Aura of Command' encourages team-focused strategies, amplifying the benefits of coordinated actions and positioning. This tactical maneuver has a cooldown of 15 seconds, requiring judicious usage to maximize its impact on the battlefield, turning the tide in critical engagements.

abilities.name: Shield of Seals
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Marth raises the Shield of Seals, granting himself a shield that absorbs up to 200 damage for 4 seconds. If the shield breaks before the duration ends, Marth gains a temporary 15% increase to his speed for 3 seconds, allowing him to reposition and escape danger. This provides both protection and an escape option, enhancing Marth's survivability and mobility. This is crucial for any hero.
abilities.flavorQuote: The Shield will guard us from all harm!

abilities.name: Altean Valor
abilities.description: Marth inspires his entire team with Altean Valor, instantly granting all allies a 'Royal Decree' and increasing their attack damage by 15% and speed by 10% for 8 seconds. This powerful ultimate ability provides a significant boost to the entire team, enabling decisive pushes and turning the tide of battle. After the duration ends, all allies are healed for 10% of their max HP. Proper coordination with teammates is key to maximizing the impact of Altean Valor, making it a game-changing ability in team fights.
abilities.flavorQuote: Altea's spirit shall never falter!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Marth synergizes well with damage-focused team compositions, providing valuable buffs and debuffs that amplify their damage output and survivability.
character_v1.tierSummary: Marth's high attack and multiple buffs make him a strong damage dealer. The move from C- to A- elevates him to a proper DPS tier while retaining some counterplay. His ability to debuff enemies further enhances his utility.
appearanceTags: Wears a blue and red cape.
Has short blue hair and a regal circlet.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Marth's kit revolves around enabling allies and debuffing enemies, with Royal Decree being a central mechanic that is utilized across multiple abilities, incentivizing timing and coordination.

chapters.title: A Royal Decree
chapters.mission: Assist Marshmallow to train to become a better fighter. Marshmallow will require to beat a boss to achieve that goal.
chapters.summary: Marth's formal manner clashes with Marshmallow's goofy attitude. Marth must find a way to connect with Marshmallow to inspire them to fight.
chapters.resonanceBuff: Increases the potency of Marth's buffs by 10% and reduces the cooldown of Royal Decree by 2 seconds.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Marth struggles with the burdens of leadership, seeking to inspire hope in a war-torn world.
bondPerks: Stronger shields from Shield of Seals.

character_v1.name: Daroach

abilities.name: Fiery Fingertips
upgrades: Lv10: Increases the fire damage bonus to 15% of Attack Power.
Lv50: Critical hits with Fiery Fingertips now apply 'Scorched' to all enemies within a small radius of the primary target.
Lv100: Base damage increased and 'Scorched' now also reduces magic resistance by 5%.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Daroach flicks his wickedly sharp, magically-infused fingernails, launching a precise burst of searing flame toward a single enemy. This targeted strike deals physical damage equivalent to Daroach's Attack Power plus an additional 10% of his Attack Power as bonus fire damage. If the target is afflicted with a status effect, this attack gains an additional 5% critical hit chance. Furthermore, if this attack critically strikes, the target is afflicted with 'Scorched' for 3 seconds, reducing their armor by 10%. This 'Scorched' effect does not stack. This ability prioritizes targets with the lowest remaining health percentage, seeking to finish off weakened foes swiftly and decisively. He is a master thief, after all, and doesn't believe in wasting time or energy!

abilities.name: Squeak Squad Ambush
abilities.description: Daroach possesses 'Stash Capacity', a unique resource that governs his ability to deploy bombs and summon Squeak Squad members. He starts with 3 Stash Capacity. Capacity regenerates 1 every 8 seconds up to a maximum of 3. Whenever an enemy steps within a radius of 300 units of Daroach, there is a 25% chance one of his Squeak Squad members is summoned to assist for 5 seconds. The Squeak summoned depends on Daroach's current Stash Capacity: if it's full, Storo is summoned (melee bruiser); at 2, Spinni (agile damage dealer); at 1, Doc (ranged support). Successfully ambushing an enemy grants Daroach a 15% increase in movement speed for 3 seconds, enhancing his mobility and positioning.
abilities.flavorQuote: Heh heh, you never see us coming!

abilities.name: Bomb Barrage
abilities.description: Daroach hurls a cluster of three bombs in a targeted direction. Each bomb explodes upon impact, dealing 60 (+30% magic atk) magic damage in a 150-unit radius. These bombs can be strategically placed to control enemy movement or to set up combos with other abilities. If Daroach has full 'Stash Capacity' (3), this ability consumes 1 capacity, enhancing the bombs to leave a lingering fire patch for 2 seconds, dealing 20 (+10% magic atk) magic damage per second to enemies within. The ability has a cooldown of 8 seconds and a range of 600 units, allowing for long-range harassment and zone denial.
abilities.flavorQuote: Bombs away! Hope you brought a fire extinguisher!

abilities.name: Icy Embrace
abilities.description: Daroach conjures a chilling blast in a cone-shaped area in front of him, dealing 80 (+40% magic atk) magic damage and slowing enemies hit by 30% for 2 seconds. This ability serves as both a defensive tool and a setup for more complex plays. If an enemy is already standing on a bomb left by 'Bomb Barrage', the icy blast causes the bomb to freeze, creating a larger ice patch that slows enemies by 50% for 3 seconds. Icy Embrace has a cooldown of 10 seconds and a range of 400 units. The cone angle is 60 degrees, requiring precise aiming for maximum impact.
abilities.flavorQuote: Feeling a bit chilly, are we?

abilities.name: Squeak Squad Support
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~13%).
abilities.description: Daroach expends 2 'Stash Capacity' to summon a targeted Squeak Squad member to his side, based on the player's choice. Spinni appears as an agile assassin, dealing high single-target damage and evading attacks; Storo acts as a frontline bruiser, providing crowd control and soaking up damage; Doc provides ranged support, healing allies and applying debuffs to enemies. The summoned Squeak lasts for 8 seconds. If Daroach has less than 2 'Stash Capacity', he cannot cast this ability. The cooldown for 'Squeak Squad Support' is 15 seconds, promoting strategic use of resources and tactical decision-making on the battlefield.
abilities.flavorQuote: Alright, team, let's get 'em!

abilities.name: Triple Star Cataclysm
abilities.description: Daroach channels the power of the Triple Star, unleashing a devastating magical barrage across the battlefield. For 5 seconds, three stars orbit Daroach, automatically targeting the nearest enemy within 600 units, dealing 100 (+50% magic atk) magic damage per star on impact. Each star bounces up to three times, hitting multiple enemies if they are closely grouped. This ability is perfect for turning the tide of team fights and securing objectives. 'Triple Star Cataclysm' has a long cooldown of 90 seconds, emphasizing its strategic use as a game-changing ultimate ability. During the barrage, Daroach gains 20% increased movement speed, allowing for better positioning and kiting.
abilities.flavorQuote: Behold! The power of the Triple Star!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Daroach excels in teams that can capitalize on his zone control and crowd control abilities. He synergizes well with burst damage dealers who can quickly eliminate enemies trapped by his bombs and ice patches. He also benefits from tanks who can peel for him and protect him from being dove on, allowing him to safely deploy his abilities from a distance.
character_v1.tierSummary: Daroach possesses a versatile kit with summons, AoE damage, and speed boosts. The promotion from A- to S- acknowledges his high potential and the synergy within his kit, making him a formidable mage.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Daroach's kit revolves around strategically placing bombs with 'Bomb Barrage' and using 'Icy Embrace' to control enemies in those zones. 'Squeak Squad Support' offers versatility in team fights, adapting to different scenarios. The passive 'Squeak Squad Ambush' provides consistent utility and synergizes with his overall zone control playstyle.

chapters.title: Operation: Grand Heist
chapters.mission: Successfully complete the heist by disabling all security nodes within the time limit.
chapters.summary: Daroach needs Inaho's strategic mind and electric abilities to disable security systems during a major heist.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Daroach seeks to expand his Squeak Squad's operations, requiring assistance in securing resources and evading the law.

character_v1.name: Waddle Dee

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~9% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Wind.

abilities.name: Friendly Aura
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Waddle Dee exudes an aura of friendliness, embodying the 'Buddy Buffs' mechanic. All allied characters within a 4-unit radius gain a 5% increase to their Attack and Defense. This aura persists as long as Waddle Dee is alive and within range. The effects of this aura stack additively with other similar buffs. Furthermore, if an ally remains within the aura for 5 consecutive seconds, they gain a small burst heal of 2% of their maximum HP, encouraging coordinated positioning and rewarding sustained support.
abilities.flavorQuote: Company makes the heart grow stronger.

abilities.name: Item Toss
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~22%).
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~27%).
abilities.description: Waddle Dee randomly tosses an item to a targeted location within a 7-unit range. The item can be one of three possibilities, each with an equal chance of occurring: A Maxim Tomato, restoring 15% HP to the first ally who touches it; a Spicy Curry, granting 10% bonus attack damage for 4 seconds to the first ally; or a Bomb Block, dealing 8% max hp true damage to enemies in a small area. This ability has a cooldown of 8 seconds, forcing Waddle Dee to carefully choose when and where to provide assistance. The effect radius for both healing and damage items is 1.5 units.
abilities.flavorQuote: Here, have this! ...Careful, it might explode.

abilities.name: Parasol Shield
abilities.description: Waddle Dee equips a parasol, granting himself and all allies within a 3-unit radius a shield absorbing up to 8% of Waddle Dee's maximum HP for 3 seconds. While the parasol is active, Waddle Dee's movement speed is reduced by 20%, making him more vulnerable but providing a focused defensive buff to his team. Additionally, if an enemy attacks an ally shielded by the Parasol Shield, Waddle Dee has a 30% chance to counter with a small burst of wind, knocking the attacker back a short distance (1 unit). This ability has a 12-second cooldown.
abilities.flavorQuote: Stay behind me, I've got you covered!

abilities.name: Waddle Train
abilities.description: Waddle Dee summons a small group of Waddle Dees, forming a 'Waddle Train' that moves in a straight line from Waddle Dee's location to a targeted point within a 9-unit range. The Waddle Train deals 5% max hp damage to enemies it passes through, knocking them aside. Allies touched by the train gain 7% movement speed for 4 seconds. The Waddle Train persists for 4 seconds or until it reaches its target location, whichever comes first. This ability has a 15-second cooldown, requiring careful planning to maximize its impact. The width of the train is approximately 1 unit.
abilities.flavorQuote: All aboard! Next stop, victory!

abilities.name: Dee-fensive Maneuvers
abilities.description: Waddle Dee calls upon the combined might of his brethren, greatly enhancing his support capabilities for 8 seconds. During this time, the range of Friendly Aura is doubled to 8 units, and the Attack and Defense bonus it provides is increased to 12%. Additionally, Item Toss's cooldown is reduced to 2 seconds, allowing for rapid item deployment. Finally, the Parasol Shield now provides immunity to crowd control effects for allies within its radius. After the duration ends, Waddle Dee is stunned for 1 second, representing the exertion of coordinating such a large-scale maneuver. This ability has a 60-second cooldown.
abilities.flavorQuote: With the power of friendship, anything is possible!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Waddle Dee excels in teams that can capitalize on his sustained buffs. Melee-focused teams benefit greatly from the increased Attack and Defense, while ranged characters appreciate the defensive support and healing. His item-based utility complements a variety of team compositions, providing adaptable support for different situations.
character_v1.tierSummary: Waddle Dee provides consistent buffs and utility, his A+ tier is well-deserved with team support and decent survivability.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Waddle Dee's abilities synergize by providing constant passive buffs through Friendly Aura, while actively supporting with Item Toss and Parasol Shield. Waddle Train provides mobility and damage, enhancing his utility. Dee-fensive Maneuvers amplifies all his support capabilities, creating a powerful burst of team-wide enhancement.

chapters.title: The Healing Hand
chapters.mission: Heal injured allies using starlight-infused techniques, maintaining their health above a certain threshold.
chapters.summary: Waddle Dee partners with Alk to master elemental healing techniques using Alk's starlight.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Waddle Dee embarks on a journey to improve their support capabilities, learning new healing techniques and protective strategies.

character_v1.name: Mia

abilities.name: Glimmering Bolt
upgrades: Lv10: Increases damage scaling to 95% of Mia's ATK.
Lv50: Adds a 20% chance to critically strike, dealing 150% damage.
Lv100: Upon impact, nearby enemies within a small radius (150 units) have their accuracy reduced by 10% for 1.5 seconds.
abilities.description: Mia channels radiant light into a concentrated bolt, unleashing it upon a single enemy with blinding speed. This attack deals physical damage, infused with the essence of Light, calculated as a base 50 damage plus an additional amount based on 80% of Mia's Attack stat. The Glimmering Bolt seeks its target with unwavering precision, guaranteeing it will strike true unless the enemy is invulnerable or has evaded the projectile through other means. As the bolt connects, it explodes in a small burst of light, potentially disorienting nearby enemies for a brief moment, reducing their accuracy by 10% for 1.5 seconds, although this effect is only triggered upon reaching level 100. The pure, concentrated light is especially effective against shadowy creatures, inflicting 5% additional damage to enemies tagged as 'Dark' or 'Shadow'. The time it takes Mia to fully charge and release the Glimmering Bolt is relatively short, clocking in at 0.75 seconds, making it a reliable source of consistent damage in prolonged engagements. However, it is best used selectively as its damage falls off if used excessively, peaking in efficiency around 4-5 consecutive casts and then progressively decaying.

abilities.name: Gilded Snare
upgrades: Upgrade 1: Increases the base damage of Gilded Snare by 15%.
Upgrade 2: Increases the Attack Speed bonus per stack by 1%, capping at 5%.
Upgrade 3: Increases the chance to inflict the 'Hindered' status by 5%.
Upgrade 4: Extends the duration of the Attack Speed buff by 0.5 seconds.
abilities.description: Mia, ever the resourceful treasure hunter, cracks her radiant, gold-infused whip in a wide arc before her, unleashing a wave of glittering energy. This 'Gilded Snare' deals Physical Damage equal to 110% of Mia's Attack stat, striking all enemies within a shimmering, cone-shaped area. The width of this cone is enhanced by Mia's 'Fortune's Favor' stacks, a measure of her luck and skill. Each stack increases the cone's width by 8%, allowing her to ensnare more enemies, up to a maximum of 40% at 5 stacks. Additionally, each enemy struck by the 'Gilded Snare' empowers Mia, granting her a 4% increase to her Attack Speed for 3 seconds. This invigorating effect can stack up to 5 times, culminating in a maximum bonus of 20% Attack Speed. The golden energies also carry a chance to inflict the 'Hindered' status. Each target struck has a 25% chance to become 'Hindered,' reducing their Movement Speed by 35% for 1.75 seconds, leaving them momentarily vulnerable to Mia's cunning maneuvers. This ability allows Mia to control the flow of battle, slowing pursuing enemies or creating opportunities for her allies to capitalize on weakened foes.

abilities.name: Gemini Barrage
upgrades: Increases the base damage of each dagger by 5%.
Increases the 'Fracture' chance by 3%.
Reduces the cooldown of Gemini Barrage by 0.5 seconds.
Increases the critical damage bonus from 'Treasure Trove' by 10%.
abilities.description: Mia channels her dual essence, unleashing a swift and deadly barrage of twin-bladed projectiles. Over 1.5 seconds, she launches five pairs of mirror-edged daggers towards her target, each pair perfectly synchronized to strike with devastating precision. Each dagger inflicts physical damage equal to 75% of Mia's Attack, totaling 150% per volley. Consuming a stack of 'Treasure Trove' causes the final pair to resonate with arcane energy, inflicting a critical hit dealing 175% of normal critical damage. Each pair has an 12% chance to inflict 'Fracture', causing the target's armor to shatter, reducing their armor by 8% for 4 seconds. This debuff stacks up to 3 times, potentially reducing the target's armor by 24%. Gemini Barrage prioritizes the enemy with the lowest remaining Health. If multiple enemies are tied, it targets the closest.

abilities.name: Golden Compass Intuition
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: Gleaming Insight's peak potency significantly improved at later levels.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: Maximum stack count increased, but per-stack bonus slightly reduced, delaying full power spike.
abilities.description: Mia's innate connection to hidden riches manifests as 'Gleaming Insight' whenever she skillfully lands 8 consecutive hits in combat. Each stack of Gleaming Insight sharpens her senses, increasing her Critical Hit Chance by a subtle but significant 1.75%, stacking up to a maximum of 12 times. Reaching the pinnacle of 12 'Gleaming Insight' stacks allows Mia to unleash a 'Gilded Revelation,' a wave of pure arcane energy that empowers her allies. Upon activation, Gilded Revelation immediately grants all allied champions within a generous radius a substantial 12% increase to both their Attack Power and Magic Power for a duration of 7.5 seconds, enhancing their offensive capabilities. Furthermore, Mia's natural affinity for life-giving energies permanently grants her a 4% Lifesteal bonus, allowing her to sustain herself in prolonged engagements by restoring a portion of damage dealt as health. This bonus is active at all times, offering constant resilience and survivability, thus enhancing Mia's prowess on the battlefield.

abilities.name: Prismatic Flicker
upgrades: This ability now prioritizes tactical utility and disruption effects.
Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches.
Reduced peak potency and slightly longer ramp-up.
This ability now emphasizes bruiser-style interactions.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~11%).
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~18% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Mia becomes a blur of iridescent light, instantly dashing forward a short distance, leaving behind a fractured echo of her form. As Mia rematerializes at her destination, the residual light condenses and explodes, releasing a cascade of prismatic shards. These shards inflict Physical Damage equal to 70% of Mia's Attack to all enemies within a 250-unit radius, each shard momentarily disorienting her foes, reducing their Movement Speed by 20% for 1.5 seconds. Should Mia possess at least 3 'Treasure Trove' stacks, she may elect to spend 3 stacks during the Prismatic Flicker, further enhancing the protective facets of her light. Upon reappearing, Mia constructs a shimmering prism around herself, absorbing damage equal to 12% of her maximum HP for 4 seconds. Any excess damage beyond the shield's capacity is then inflicted upon Mia, meaning any surplus effects will still apply. This ability serves as both an instantaneous repositioning tool and a sudden burst of disruptive force, providing a potent combination of strategic maneuverability, moderate area denial, and self-fortification that dramatically augments her capacity to engage or evade with precision. This repositioning effect has a maximum range of 400 units.

abilities.name: Ultimate Treasure Seeker
abilities.description: Mia unleashes her ultimate treasure hunting prowess. For 15 seconds, Mia's combo count requirement for generating 'Treasure Trove' stacks is reduced to 5. Additionally, her attack speed is increased by 30%, and each 'Treasure Trove' stack consumed during this duration grants all allies 10% increased critical damage for the remainder of the ultimate's duration, stacking multiplicatively. At the end of the duration, Mia unleashes a final burst of energy, dealing 200% of her Attack as Physical Damage to all enemies in a large radius. This ability ensures Mia can maximize her team's damage output and control the battlefield.
abilities.flavorQuote: The greatest treasure is our victory!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Mia synergizes well with team compositions that can benefit from increased attack speed, critical damage, and consistent damage output. Characters that can apply crowd control effects or boost attack speed can further enhance Mia's combo potential.
character_v1.tierSummary: Mia's kit is a mix of damage and utility, but her low stats hold her back. The move from D to E adjusts for her middling performance. She doesn't excel in any particular role and requires significant investment.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Mia's kit revolves around building combo counts and utilizing 'Treasure Trove' stacks. Her abilities encourage aggressive play and reward maintaining high combo counts, while also providing buffs and utility for her team.

chapters.title: Case of the Missing Artifacts
chapters.mission: Gather evidence and identify the thief behind the artifact thefts.
chapters.summary: Mia and Judy investigate the disappearance of several historical artifacts, following clues that lead them to a shadowy organization.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Mia teams up with Judy Hopps to solve a series of puzzling heists, uncovering a conspiracy that threatens both their worlds. Judy's detective skills and Mia's treasure hunting instincts combine to overcome obstacles and expose the true mastermind.

abilities.name: Basic Attack

Lv100: small passive interaction
abilities.description: Basic melee/ranged attack that scales with ATK.

abilities.name: Sandy Swipe
abilities.description: Mia playfully swipes with her sand-covered hands, dealing 30% of her attack damage to a single target. Each successful hit grants Mia a stack of 'Sunscreen'. Sunscreen stacks provide 1% increased healing potency, stacking up to 20 times. This effect lasts for 5 seconds, refreshing with each new stack. This encourages aggressive and persistent participation in combat to maximize her healing capabilities.

abilities.name: Tidal Tune-Up
abilities.description: Mia summons a wave of rejuvenating energy, instantly healing the ally with the lowest HP for 10% of Mia's maximum HP. In addition to the direct heal, the target also receives a 'Seashore Shell' buff for 8 seconds. This buff increases their defense by 15% and their evasion by 10%. Using this ability also consumes all stacks of 'Sunscreen', increasing the base heal by 2% of Mia's max HP per stack consumed. Proper usage of 'Sandy Swipe' beforehand is essential to fully realize the value of this targeted heal and defensive buff.

abilities.name: Sunbeam Shield
abilities.description: Mia focuses a beam of sunlight into a protective barrier, granting all allies a shield that absorbs damage equal to 15% of Mia's max HP for 5 seconds. This ability is more than just a defensive maneuver; it also applies a 'Radiant Refreshment' buff. Allies with the shield active are cleansed of one debuff and gain 5% increased attack speed for the duration. Mastering the timing of this ability is key to maximizing its debuff removal and attack speed buff.

abilities.name: Beachcomber's Blessing
abilities.description: Mia's presence on the battlefield inspires her allies. Whenever an ally uses their ultimate ability, Mia grants them a 'Coastal Courage' buff for 10 seconds. 'Coastal Courage' increases their critical hit chance by 20% and their critical hit damage by 15%. This effect emphasizes teamwork and strategic coordination, rewarding players who synchronize their ultimate abilities for a burst of offensive power.

character_v1.playstyle: Scaling Support, Buff Focused, Active Play
character_v1.teamSynergy: Summer Mia pairs well with damage dealers who can capitalize on the critical hit chance from 'Beachcomber's Blessing' and the damage buff from 'Summer Solstice Surge'. She also supports tanks effectively with her defensive buffs and shields, keeping them alive longer.
character_v1.tierSummary: Summer Mia's focus on healing and shielding makes her a decent support, but she lacks offensive power. Moving her to D- reflects that she is on the lower end of 'functional'.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Summer Mia excels at creating a feedback loop where consistent basic attacks generate 'Sunscreen' stacks, boosting her heals from 'Tidal Tune-Up'. Her passive encourages allies to use ultimates often, creating opportunities to synchronize with the CC immunity and damage from her Ultimate.

chapters.mission: Overcome trials and defeat the guardians of the sea to gain entrance to the underwater palace.
chapters.summary: Mia and Hercules must complete a series of challenges set by the sea gods to prove their worth and gain access to the hidden treasure.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Summer Mia, always seeking adventure, finds an unlikely ally in Hercules. Together, they navigate a treacherous archipelago, facing mythical creatures and ancient trials to uncover a hidden treasure.
bondPerks: Bonus Damage vs. Crowd Controlled Enemies

For each stack of Star Fragments Alk has, the attack buff is increased by an additional 5%, up to a maximum of 30% increased attack. This buff prioritizes allies with the lowest current HP percentage, encouraging strategic play and rewarding effective targeting. This ability also grants Alk one stack of Star Fragments (Max 3).
abilities.flavorQuote: May the stars guide my blade!

abilities.name: Starlight's Blessing
upgrades: [object Object]
[object Object]
[object Object]
abilities.description: Alk’s radiant aura invigorates his allies, bolstering their offensive capabilities. At the start of each battle, Alk bestows a Starlight's Blessing upon all team members, immediately increasing their Attack stat by 10%. Furthermore, Alk recognizes the power of synergy, and this initial bonus amplifies depending on the diversity of elemental affinities within the team. For each unique elemental alignment present within the team's composition at battle start - whether it's fire, water, earth, wind, light, or dark – the Starlight's Blessing attack bonus increases by an additional 5%, capping at a potent 30%. Complementing Alk’s ability to bolster his team, he also possesses a unique connection to the very essence of the stars themselves. At the commencement of each battle, Alk has a 10% chance to instantly generate one stack of Star Fragments. This immediate access provides him with an early advantage, allowing him to more quickly charge and unleash his other celestial-themed abilities.

abilities.name: Starforged Resolve
upgrades: (Patch) Role realignment: this ability now emphasizes bruiser-style interactions.
abilities.description: Alk, embodying resilience, reinforces his allies whenever he casts Meteor Strike. Upon activation, allies within a 20-meter radius receive a surge of energy, bolstering their Skill Gauges. The initial boost is a flat 5%, further amplified by the remnants of stardust Alk gathers during combat. For each Star Fragment Alk possesses, the boost increases by an additional 3%, stacking multiplicatively, to a ceiling of 20%. Moreover, allies who are actively engaged within melee range, defined as being within 5 meters of an enemy hero, receive an enhanced fortitude effect. They instantly gain 2 stacks of Defiance, which each provide 10% damage reduction and last for 5 seconds. These defiant stacks dissipate one at a time, triggered upon receiving damage. These protective stacks are critical in enabling aggressive, sustained engagements, allowing allies to weather substantial damage while capitalizing on offensive opportunities.

abilities.name: Starfall Symphony
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~11% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Alk channels the power of the stars, unleashing a devastating series of fiery strikes against all enemies. Deals Fire damage equal to 200% of his attack stat to all enemies. Afterwards, he grants the entire party a substantial attack buff, increasing their attack by 30% for 10 seconds. For each Star Fragment Alk possesses, the duration of this attack buff is extended by 2 seconds, up to a maximum of 16 seconds. In addition, this ultimate skill resets the cooldown of Alk's active skill, Meteor Strike, allowing him to immediately follow up with another powerful attack and further enhance his team's damage output and maintain momentum in combat.
abilities.flavorQuote: Behold the might of the heavens!

abilities.name: Astro Navigator
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~7% and slightly longer ramp-up.

abilities.description: Alk’s innate understanding of the cosmos enhances his and his allies’ capabilities. Whenever an ally uses their skill, Alk gains 1 stack of Star Fragments (max 3). This ability encourages skill-based team compositions and rewards active play. Additionally, Alk’s base attack is increased by 5% for each stack of Star Fragments he possesses, up to a maximum of 15%. The Star Fragments decay one stack at a time every 10 seconds if no skills are used, encouraging constant team skill usage. This passive also grants allies a small tenacity buff, reducing the duration of debuffs by 5%.
abilities.flavorQuote: The stars whisper their secrets!

character_v1.playstyle: Buffing teams with attack and skill gauge boosts, enhancing damage over time through skill usage.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Alk excels in teams that benefit from attack buffs and skill gauge boosts, such as skill-dependent damage dealers and characters who rely on frequent skill activations.
character_v1.tierSummary: Alk has underwhelming stats and an inconsistent kit relying on 'Star Fragments'. Stays in F tier but moves to F- as he needs significant reworks to be viable.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Alk synergizes well with characters who can frequently use their skills, allowing him to maintain high stacks of Star Fragments and maximize the potency of his buffs.

character_v1.name: Teo

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~6% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Electric.

abilities.name: Electric Lash
upgrades: Grants bonus damage to 'Shocked' enemies.
Reduces cooldown on successful application of 'Shock'.
Increases the duration of 'Shock' debuff.
abilities.description: Teo cracks his electrified whip with blinding speed, unleashing a torrent of five distinct strikes upon his chosen foe. Each lash crackles with energy, inflicting damage equal to 20% of Teo's Attack Damage. Every successful hit generates a stack of Beastial Momentum, fueling Teo's primal instincts. Should Teo possess a reservoir of ten or more stacks of Beastial Momentum, the final strike of Electric Lash surges with unparalleled power, imbuing the target with a potent Shock debuff. This electrical assault inflicts true damage equivalent to 5% of the target's maximum health, dispersed evenly over a harrowing three-second duration. Teo's agility allows him to weave Electric Lash seamlessly into his combat rhythm, thanks to its moderate cooldown. Landing all five strikes significantly accelerates the charging of Teo's ultimate ability, bringing him closer to unleashing his full potential. Further capitalizing on his mastery of electricity, if the target is already suffering under the effects of any electric debuff, successfully completing Electric Lash refunds 25% of the ability's cooldown, ensuring Teo remains a relentless force on the battlefield.

abilities.name: Primal Instinct
abilities.description: Teo's innate connection to his beastial nature grants him increased agility and attack power. Teo gains 3% increased Attack Damage and 3% increased Evasion for every stack of Beastial Momentum he has, up to a maximum of 30 stacks. Upon reaching 30 stacks of Beastial Momentum, Teo's next Active ability gains an additional effect, depending on the ability used. Stacks decay by 3 every 4 seconds if no attacks or dodges are made. Additionally, Teo's basic attacks have a 10% chance to apply a stack of 'Static Charge', dealing 2% of Teo's attack as magic damage per second for 3 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: The wild heart beats strong within!

abilities.name: Liberation's Leap
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~18% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Teo performs a swift leap towards a targeted location, dealing damage to enemies in a small area upon landing. Enemies hit take 70% of Teo's Attack Damage as physical damage and are briefly stunned for 0.75 seconds. This ability also grants Teo a temporary shield equal to 10% of his maximum HP for 3 seconds. The distance of the leap scales slightly with Teo's movement speed. 'Liberation's Leap' consumes 5 stacks of Beastial Momentum; for each stack consumed, the damage of the leap is increased by 5%. This ability serves as both an engagement and disengagement tool, offering Teo increased mobility and survivability in the fray.
abilities.flavorQuote: Freedom is but a jump away!

abilities.name: Ancestral Echo
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~7% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Teo channels the spirits of his ancestors, unleashing a powerful roar that resonates through the battlefield. This ability deals 90% of Teo's magic attack as magic damage in a large cone in front of him. Enemies hit are also inflicted with 'Fear', causing them to flee away from Teo for 1.5 seconds. If Teo has at least 20 stacks of Beastial Momentum, the roar also applies a 'Silence' effect, preventing enemies from using abilities for 1 second after the fear ends. This ability has a long cooldown but can turn the tide of a battle with its crowd control potential. Consumes all stacks of Beastial Momentum, converting them into a shield (1% of Max HP per stack).
abilities.flavorQuote: Hear the voices of the past!

abilities.name: King's Ultimatum
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~35%).
abilities.description: Teo taps into the full potential of his Lionfolk heritage, transforming into a ferocious beast for 12 seconds. In this form, his Attack Damage and Speed are increased by 30%, and he gains 20% lifesteal on all attacks. Furthermore, each attack during this transformation automatically generates a stack of Beastial Momentum, bypassing the normal conditions. The duration of the transformation is extended by 0.5 seconds for every kill or assist Teo secures during the transformation. Upon the transformation ending, Teo lets out an electric discharge, dealing damage to enemies caught nearby (120% of Attack) and granting himself Overload, supercharging his next basic ability.
abilities.flavorQuote: Behold, the true power of the Lion King!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Teo works well with teams that can provide crowd control or damage amplification, allowing him to more easily build and maintain his Beastial Momentum. He also benefits from allies that can capitalize on the 'Shock' debuff applied by his 'Lionheart's Surge' ability at higher stack counts.
character_v1.tierSummary: Teo is a highly conditional character. His kit encourages using 'Beastial Momentum' but there's no real payoff as his damage doesn't justify using him over other characters. His statline is decent and can land at C tier
character_v1.internalSynergy: Teo's abilities are designed to synergize with each other, building and consuming Beastial Momentum to enhance his damage and utility. 'Lionheart's Surge' builds stacks quickly, 'Primal Instinct' rewards maintaining those stacks, 'Liberation's Leap' provides mobility and consumes stacks for burst, 'Ancestral Echo' offers powerful crowd control at the cost of all stacks, and 'King's Ultimatum' unleashes his full potential.

abilities.flavorQuote: Our spirits resonate, amplifying our power!

abilities.name: Nine-Tailed Surge

abilities.flavorQuote: Feel the surge of the nine tails' power!

abilities.name: Fever Tempest

During this time, all allies gain maximum stacks of Fever Surge. abilities.flavorQuote: Witness the storm unleashed!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Inaho excels in Thunder-focused team compositions, providing attack speed buffs, shields, and consistent Fever Surge stacks. She can also support other damage dealers by providing utility and enhancing Fever durations, making her a versatile enabler.
character_v1.tierSummary: Inaho provides support. Her buffing abilities are great, as well as shielding and healing, but she lacks any real defense. Her stat distribution is also really skewed so she lands in B-.

abilities.description: Blaze ignites her claws, unleashing a swift, fiery strike upon a single target. The initial impact deals physical damage, scaling with her Attack stat, representing her honed martial prowess combined with raw pyrotechnic power. Moreover, the sheer heat of the blow ignites the target, inflicting 'Scorched' for 3 seconds. 'Scorched' deals a percentage of Blaze's attack damage as magical damage each second. The flame's intensity makes armor less effective, reducing the target's armor by a flat amount. The armor reduction lasts the duration of the 'Scorched' effect, diminishing as the flames subside. With the right upgrades, 'Burning Swipe' becomes less about raw damage and more about sustained pressure and enabling follow-up attacks, transforming Blaze into a durable, fire-wielding combatant.

abilities.name: Ember Step

Enemies stepping on the embers take 20 (+30% magic atk) fire damage per second and are slowed by 15%. If Blaze passes through an ally during the dash, she grants them 10% increased movement speed and 15 (+15% magic atk) fire damage on their next auto attack. Generates 5 Sol Empowerment per enemy damaged by the embers. Ember Step has a cooldown of 8 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: A flicker of fire, a step ahead.

abilities.name: Burning Slash
upgrades: Buff: Damage scaling from magic attack increased.

abilities.description: Blaze channels her inner flame, unleashing a scorching slash in a wide arc before her. This fiery assault sears up to five enemies within range, inflicting 80 fire damage, enhanced by 60% of her magic attack power. The intensity of the flames leaves her opponents 'Scorched' for 4 seconds, making them vulnerable and increasing the damage they receive from all sources by 5%. Moreover, if Blaze's Ember Step deposits fiery embers on a 'Scorched' foe, these embers detonate in a burst of flames, dealing an additional 40 fire damage plus 30% of her magic attack to all foes caught in the small area around the originally 'Scorched' target. The sheer force of this blazing technique also grants Blaze 10 Sol Empowerment for each enemy struck by the initial slash, fueling her other abilities. Burning Slash has a cooldown of 10 seconds.

abilities.name: Sol Guardian (Signature Passive)
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~50%).
abilities.description: Blaze passively generates 1 Sol Empowerment every 3 seconds. Additionally, when Blaze reaches 100 Sol Empowerment, her next basic attack becomes empowered, dealing an additional 40 (+30% magic atk) fire damage and inflicting 'Sol Brand' for 5 seconds. Enemies with 'Sol Brand' take 10 (+5% magic atk) true damage per second. This effect consumes all Sol Empowerment, resetting it to 0.
abilities.flavorQuote: The emeralds grant me strength.

abilities.name: Burning Boost
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~15% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Blaze ignites herself in flames, becoming invulnerable for 1.5 seconds and gaining 20% increased movement speed. During this time, she deals 50 (+40% magic atk) fire damage per second to nearby enemies. Upon activation, Burning Boost instantly generates 15 Sol Empowerment and applies a stacking buff to allies within range that grants 5% magic atk up to 3 stacks. Burning Boost has a cooldown of 15 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Feel the heat of my soul!

abilities.name: Burning Blaze
abilities.description: Blaze transforms into Burning Blaze for 15 seconds, consuming 200 Sol Empowerment (if available; otherwise, this ability cannot activate). While transformed, her magic atk is increased by 40%, her speed is increased by 25%, and her basic attacks deal 30 (+20% magic atk) additional fire damage. Additionally, while transformed, Ember Step applies a stronger slow of 30% and the embers explode for double damage. All Sol Empowerment generation is increased by 50% during the transformation. When the transformation ends, Blaze emits a final burst of fire dealing 100 (+80% magic atk) damage to nearby enemies.
abilities.flavorQuote: This is the power of the Sol Emeralds!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Blaze synergizes well with teams that can capitalize on her zone control and damage amplification. She provides a consistent source of fire damage and can empower allies with increased movement speed and magic attack. Her Burning Blaze transformation offers a powerful burst of damage and enhanced abilities, making her a valuable asset in team fights.
character_v1.tierSummary: Blaze is a decent bruiser. Offers damage with some utility. Blaze is more of a stat-check character who gets most of her power from her ultimate. She lands at B tier.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Blaze's kit revolves around generating Sol Empowerment through fire damage and utilizing it to empower her abilities and transform into Burning Blaze. Ember Step provides mobility and zone control, while Flame Purgation amplifies damage and interacts with Ember Step's embers. Burning Boost offers invulnerability and buffs allies, further enhancing her tactical capabilities.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Blaze, always pushing her limits, finds a fiery ally in Hades. Together, they descend into the Underworld, confronting infernal challenges and mastering the art of manipulating flames.

abilities.description: Rise scans the targeted enemy, revealing all weaknesses, resistances, and immunities for 8 seconds. Upon successful scan, Rise gains 5 Performance Points (PP). If the enemy has already been scanned, she gains only 1 PP. This skill has a cooldown of 10 seconds. Rise will prioritize scanning new enemies. If no new enemy is available, this ability will not trigger automatically, but can be manually activated to scan a previously scanned enemy to add duration to the weakness/resistance vision, giving 1 PP on recast to previously scanned enemy. This is essential for building up the 'Idol Performance' gauge.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Alright, let's see what you're hiding!"

abilities.name: Idol Performance: Encore!

abilities.description: Rise consumes all accumulated Performance Points (PP) to enhance a targeted ally, with the duration and magnitude of the buffs scaling with the amount of PP spent. For every 10 PP spent, the ally receives a stacking buff of 2% to ATK, Magic ATK, DEF, and Magic DEF for 5 seconds. Additionally, if the targeted ally's primary attribute aligns with a weakness revealed by 'Weakness Scan' on an enemy present on the field (e.g., an ally with high Fire damage output targeting an enemy weak to Fire), the buff effectiveness is amplified by 50% (to 3% per 10 PP) for the duration. This amplification effect only triggers if there is an unscanned enemy on the field; this encourages continued use of 'Weakness Scan'.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Time for a special performance, just for you!"

Enemies entering the zone are 'charmed', reducing their damage output by 15% against allies outside the zone. If an enemy already under the effect of 'Mind-Bending Melody' enters the zone, the 'charmed' debuff is amplified, applying a 30% damage reduction instead. This ability has a 15-second cooldown.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Let's turn this battlefield into my stage!"

abilities.name: Mind-Bending Melody

abilities.name: True Story

character_v1.tierSummary: Rise provides great utility and team-wide buffs. But lacks damage and has limited defensive options. She fits comfortably at C+.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Rise's kit revolves around scanning enemies to generate Performance Points, then expending those points to buff allies based on enemy weaknesses. Mind-Bending Melody works in tandem with Risette Field to control enemies and extend debuff durations. True Story benefits from a well-controlled battlefield and synergizes with Mind-Bending Melody.

character_v1.name: Vanellope

abilities.name: Pixel Burst
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling; increased glitch dash speed boost (25% -> 30%).
Lv50: Candy projectiles gain a 15% chance to critically heal, doubling the potency of the healing burst.
Lv100: base damage increases; healing duration increased by 1 second (3 -> 4 seconds).
abilities.description: Vanellope glitches forward, leaving a trail of fragmented code in her wake. Upon reaching her target, she unleashes a rapid-fire burst of digitized candy projectiles, each infused with a vibrant surge of healing energy. These projectiles strike the nearest ally within melee range, inflicting 60% of her ATK as physical damage to nearby enemies, then healing the ally for 120% of the damage dealt over 3 seconds, ticking every 0.5 seconds. The initial glitch dash applies a brief burst of speed enhancement to Vanellope, increasing her movement speed by 25% for 1.5 seconds, allowing her to quickly reposition and deliver her sugar-fueled support. If no ally is in range, the candy projectiles will seek out Vanellope instead.

abilities.name: Sugar Rush Surge
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~14% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Vanellope taps into her inherent glitches, executing a rapid dash forward, leaving a sugary sweet, yet treacherous trail in her wake. As she glitches through the digital plane, she deals 50 + (0.6 * Magic Attack) magic damage to every enemy she passes, a cascade of pixelated candies exploding outwards with each surge. Vanellope doesn't merely pass through; she contaminates the area with a 'Sugar Rush' trail that lingers for 3 seconds. This delectable-looking residue is anything but pleasant for her adversaries. Any enemy foolish enough to step onto this sweet trap finds their movement speed slowed by 20%, their progress hampered by the sticky sweetness. To add insult to injury, they also suffer 25 + (0.2 * Magic Attack) magic damage per second as long as they remain within the sugary morass. Now, should Vanellope's 'Pixel Surge' ability be active at the time of using 'Sugar Rush Surge', the slowing effect of the 'Sugar Rush' trail is magnified to a staggering 40%, making escape a near impossibility. The 'Sugar Rush' trail doesn't just vanish after its 3-second duration; it culminates in a final act of sugary sabotage. At the end of its duration, it detonates in a sugary explosion, dealing a further 75 + (0.4 * Magic Attack) magic damage to all enemies unlucky enough to be caught within the blast radius, a space roughly equivalent to Vanellope's own diminutive size. Vanellope's natural affinity for speed influences the cooldown of this ability. The faster she is, the more frequently she can access the 'Sugar Rush Surge'. The base cooldown is 10 seconds, which is reduced by 0.1 seconds for every 1 point of speed Vanellope possesses. Each use of this ability also feeds her 'Pixel Surge', filling approximately 20% of the Pixel Surge bar.

abilities.name: Glitch Burst
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~10% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~36%).
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~10% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Vanellope unleashes a chaotic burst of glitch energy around her, dealing X magic damage to nearby enemies and applying a 'Pixelated' debuff for 4 seconds. While 'Pixelated', enemies have their evasion reduced by 15% and their attacks have a 20% chance to 'glitch', dealing 50% reduced damage. If 'Pixel Surge' is active, the damage is increased by 30%, and the 'Pixelated' debuff also silences enemies for 1 second at the start of its duration. This ability serves as a powerful tool for disrupting enemy compositions, forcing them to reposition or suffer reduced effectiveness. The area of effect is moderately sized, making it effective in clustered engagements. This ability also generates a significant amount of Pixel Surge on hit.
abilities.flavorQuote: Ooh, a glitch!

abilities.name: Glitch Barrier
upgrades: (Patch) Role realignment: this ability now emphasizes utility-style interactions.
abilities.description: Vanellope momentarily destabilizes her form, creating a flickering barrier around herself. For 3 seconds, she gains a shield that absorbs damage equal to X, enhanced by her magic defense. This shield is not merely defensive; it's an active distortion of reality. Whenever an enemy attacks Vanellope while the Glitch Barrier is up, there is a 30% chance their attack will be deflected by a 'Pixel Bounce.' This Pixel Bounce manifests as a burst of corrupted code that deals X magic damage back to the attacker. Furthermore, if Vanellope is actively surging with Pixel Surge, the shield's duration extends to a full 5 seconds, providing extended protection. Additionally, the Pixel Bounce projectile slows the attacker's momentum, inflicting a 10% reduction to their attack speed for 2 seconds, hindering their ability to unleash rapid follow-up attacks. The Glitch Barrier also generates a small amount of Pixel Surge upon activation, reflecting Vanellope's inherent connection to the digital fabric of the game, regardless of whether the shield fully absorbs damage or not, allowing her to prepare for further glitches.

abilities.name: Sugar Rush
upgrades: (Patch) Role realignment: this ability now emphasizes damage-style interactions.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~22%).
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~17%).
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Vanellope's innate glitch grants her a perpetual 5% boost to her movement speed and critical hit chance, reflecting her erratic nature. Whenever Vanellope damages an enemy, she generates 'Code Rush,' an unstable energy buildup representing her chaotic coding. The amount of Code Rush generated scales with 10% of her Attack stat plus a flat 5 units per hit. Upon reaching 100 Code Rush, Vanellope can activate 'Sugar Surge' for 8 glorious seconds, significantly enhancing her abilities. During Sugar Surge, her 'Glitch Dash' distance increases by 25%, and 'Pixel Bomb' deals 20% more damage to all targets within its blast radius, guaranteeing a candy-coated explosion. After Sugar Surge dissipates, Vanellope channels her remaining energy, granting a 15% damage bonus to the next ability used within 3 seconds, rewarding skillful timing and tactical play. This damage bonus stacks multiplicatively with other damage modifiers, allowing for devastating combos. The effectiveness of both Sugar Surge and the post-surge damage bonus are influenced by Vanellope's critical hit chance. For every 10 points of critical hit chance, the duration of Sugar Surge increases by 0.2 seconds, up to a maximum of 10 seconds, and the damage bonus is increased by 1%, up to a maximum of 25%.

abilities.name: Finish Line Frenzy
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~16% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~14% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Vanellope becomes unstoppable, rapidly glitching between enemies for 6 seconds, dealing X damage to each enemy hit and applying a stack of 'Sugar Rush Overload'. Each stack of 'Sugar Rush Overload' reduces enemy healing received by 10% and increases damage taken from Vanellope by 5%, stacking up to 5 times. While active, Vanellope is untargetable and her speed is greatly increased. After the frenzy ends, Vanellope teleports back to her starting location. This ultimate ability allows Vanellope to wreak havoc on the battlefield, disrupting enemy formations and maximizing damage output. The amount of glitches and damage scales with her speed and magic atk. If Pixel Surge is active, enemies hit are also stunned for 0.5 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Prepare for the glitch!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Vanellope synergizes well with teams that can capitalize on her disruptive capabilities. Characters that can amplify damage to debuffed targets or control enemy positioning benefit greatly from her abilities.
character_v1.tierSummary: Vanellope's stats are extremely low. Her kit is overloaded with conditions and drawbacks. Vanellope is the weakest of the bunch.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Vanellope's kit revolves around generating and utilizing Pixel Surge. Her active abilities contribute to filling the surge meter, while her passive and ultimate enhance her capabilities when the surge is active, creating a gameplay loop that rewards aggressive play and strategic ability usage.

chapters.title: Code Breakers
chapters.mission: Navigate virtual landscapes, overcome security protocols, and rewrite the code to unlock hidden potential.
chapters.summary: Vanellope and Tron venture into the digital world, exploring uncharted territories and mastering new code manipulation techniques.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Vanellope, always seeking to push the boundaries of her glitching abilities, teams up with Tron. Together, they explore the digital frontier, mastering code and bending reality to their will.

character_v1.name: Fix it Felix

abilities.name: Basic Attack
