Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Melee basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Wind.

abilities.name: Hammer Time
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~16% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Felix's golden hammer is always ready to fix things and deal damage. Every 5th basic attack, Felix slams his hammer down on the target, dealing an additional 50 (+30% Atk) physical damage and applies 'Target Lock' for 3 seconds. Enemies with 'Target Lock' take 10% increased damage from Felix’s abilities. This effect cannot stack. This passive incentivizes consistent damage output and sets up burst combos with his other abilities, rewarding strategic timing and target selection to maximize damage potential.
abilities.flavorQuote: I can fix it! And hurt it a little, too!

abilities.name: Rapid Repairs
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~37%).
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~47%).

abilities.description: Felix dashes a short distance, healing himself and any nearby allies for 4% of their max health + 20. If Felix dashes through an enemy with 'Target Lock', the healing effect is increased by 50% for both Felix and allies affected by the dash, prioritizing allies with the lowest health. This ability provides mobility and sustain, allowing Felix to engage or disengage quickly while providing emergency healing to his team. The increased healing against 'Target Locked' enemies rewards skillful positioning and target focus.
abilities.flavorQuote: Just a quick patch-up!

abilities.name: Golden Touch
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~10% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Felix throws his hammer in a line, dealing 70 (+50% Magic Atk) magic damage to all enemies hit. If the hammer hits an enemy with 'Target Lock', it stuns them for 1 second and applies 'Golden Aura' to them for 4 seconds. 'Golden Aura' reduces the target's magic defense by 15 and increases Felix’s attack speed by 20%. This ability offers ranged damage and crowd control, with a significant boost against 'Target Locked' targets. The magic defense reduction and attack speed increase enhance Felix’s damage output and create opportunities for follow-up attacks.
abilities.flavorQuote: Everything I touch turns to...well, not gold. But fixed!

abilities.name: Nicelander Stampede
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~7% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Felix summons a wave of Nicelanders who charge forward, dealing 90 (+40% Atk) physical damage and knocking back all enemies in their path. Enemies hit by the Nicelander Stampede are marked with 'Structural Weakness' for 5 seconds. 'Structural Weakness' increases the damage they take from all sources by 8%. If an enemy with 'Target Lock' is hit by the stampede, the 'Structural Weakness' debuff is amplified to 16% bonus damage. This ability provides area-of-effect damage, crowd control, and a damage amplification debuff, making it effective for both initiating fights and setting up kills. The increased debuff against 'Target Locked' enemies further rewards target focus.
abilities.flavorQuote: The Nicelanders are here to help...by running you over!

abilities.name: Hero's Duty Protocol
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~26%).
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~22%).
abilities.description: Felix calls upon his Hero's Duty training, gaining increased attack damage, movement speed, and defense for 10 seconds. During this time, his basic attacks apply 'Target Lock' automatically, and the damage bonus against 'Target Locked' enemies is doubled. Additionally, for the duration, Felix gains a shield equal to 20% of his max HP. This ultimate transforms Felix into a hyper-aggressive damage dealer, allowing him to quickly eliminate key targets and turn the tide of battle. The automatic 'Target Lock' application ensures maximum damage output and allows for sustained pressure on priority targets.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time to get serious!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Felix excels in teams that can provide crowd control, damage amplification, or target prioritization. Allies who can stun, root, or slow enemies can make it easier for Felix to apply 'Target Lock' and land his abilities. Characters who can apply damage vulnerabilities or increase enemy damage taken can further enhance Felix's burst potential. He also benefits from having a tank or bruiser who can peel for him and create openings for him to engage.
character_v1.tierSummary: Fix it Felix provides consistent support, decent damage, and utility. His Rapid Repairs and Hero's Duty Protocol offer substantial team sustain. Promoting to B+ as his targeted buffs and decent speed can make him relevant in organized teams.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Felix's kit revolves around applying 'Target Lock' to maximize damage output. His abilities are designed to synergize with each other, allowing him to quickly engage, debuff, and burst down priority targets. Rapid Repairs provides sustain and mobility, while Golden Touch and Nicelander Stampede offer crowd control and damage amplification. Hero's Duty Protocol enhances his damage and survivability, making him a formidable assassin.

abilities.description: Melee basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Fire.

abilities.name: Tactical Barrage
abilities.description: Calhoun unleashes a rapid burst of targeted shots from her blaster rifle. For the next 4 seconds, Calhoun's basic attacks gain increased attack speed (30%) and inflict a stack of 'Target Lock' on enemies hit (max 3 stacks). Each stack of 'Target Lock' increases the damage enemies take from Calhoun's next ability by 5%. Consumes 1 unit of 'Ordnance Cache' to grant basic attacks True Damage for the duration of this ability, bypassing all armor and magic resistance.
abilities.flavorQuote: Lock and load, people! We're going loud!

abilities.name: Bugbait Burst
abilities.description: Calhoun calibrates her grenade launcher and fires a specialized incendiary grenade towards the designated area. Upon impact, the grenade detonates, creating a fiery hazard zone that persists for a duration of 5 seconds. Any enemy caught within the burning wreckage will suffer 40 (+20% Magic Attack) magic damage every second. The intense heat also reduces their movement speed by 20%, hindering their escape. Furthermore, if Calhoun possesses at least 2 stacks of Ordnance Cache, she can prime the grenade with modified Cy-Bug pheromones before launch. Any enemy that subsequently enters the burning area will become overwhelmed by a primal instinct, causing them to be taunted for 1.5 seconds, forcing them to attack Calhoun regardless of their original target. This forced engagement can provide valuable disruption and protection for Calhoun's allies. The taunt effect will only apply once per target per cast.

abilities.name: Armor-Piercing Rounds
abilities.description: Calhoun loads her blaster with armor-piercing rounds for her next basic attack, dealing significantly increased damage. The next basic attack deals X + 150% of Calhoun's attack damage and reduces the target's armor by 30% for 3 seconds. If the target has stacks of 'Target Lock', this ability consumes the stacks, dealing an additional X true damage per stack consumed. This ability expends 1 unit of 'Ordnance Cache'.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time to punch through that tin can!

abilities.name: Never Give Up
upgrades: While under the effects of 'Adrenaline Surge', Calhoun also gains 10% lifesteal.
abilities.description: Calhoun's unwavering resolve manifests when facing critical danger. Once Calhoun's health dips to or below 50%, her suit's emergency protocols kick in, triggering 'Adrenaline Surge'. This surge grants her 30% increased tenacity, reducing the duration of incoming Crowd Control effects by almost a third, allowing her to shrug off stuns, roots, and silences with increased efficiency. Simultaneously, her evasion chance is boosted by 25%, making her more nimble and significantly harder to hit with basic attacks and targeted abilities, representing her quick reflexes under pressure. Furthermore, as Calhoun pushes her systems to the limit, 'Ordnance Cache' regeneration rate accelerates, producing 1 unit every 8 seconds, enabling her to deploy gadgets and tactical options more frequently when the odds are stacked against her. This surge of resilience lasts for 15 seconds, giving Calhoun a crucial window to turn the tide of battle. 'Adrenaline Surge' can only activate once every 30 seconds to prevent overloading the system and maintaining operational integrity.

abilities.name: Cy-Bug Extermination Protocol
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~31%).
abilities.description: Calhoun initiates her ultimate ability, unleashing a devastating series of tactical strikes. For the next 6 seconds, Calhoun gains 50% increased attack speed and her basic attacks apply a powerful debuff that reduces enemy healing received by 50%. During this time, Calhoun can expend 'Ordnance Cache' (up to 3 units) to launch targeted missile strikes at nearby enemies, dealing X magic damage per unit spent in a small area. If a missile strikes an enemy affected by 'Target Lock', it detonates, dealing additional area-of-effect damage equal to 20% of the target's maximum health.
abilities.flavorQuote: Extermination protocol engaged! No bugs left standing!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Calhoun excels in teams that can capitalize on her zone control and debuffs. Allies with strong burst damage can benefit from the armor reduction applied by 'Armor-Piercing Rounds', while those with sustained damage output can take advantage of the healing reduction during 'Cy-Bug Extermination Protocol'. Her taunt from 'Incendiary Grenade' can also help peel for vulnerable teammates.
character_v1.tierSummary: Calhoun is a decent all-rounder. Her abilities provide utility, damage and survivability. She also has good stats with decent hp. She fits at the A- Tier.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Calhoun's kit revolves around strategically managing her 'Ordnance Cache' to enhance her abilities. 'Tactical Barrage' builds 'Target Lock' stacks, priming enemies for increased damage from 'Armor-Piercing Rounds' and 'Cy-Bug Extermination Protocol'. 'Incendiary Grenade' provides zone control and can be enhanced to taunt enemies, setting them up for follow-up attacks.

character_v1.name: Pac Man

abilities.name: Pellet Toss
upgrades: Lv10: Increases root duration to 1 second.
Lv50: Allies targeting the 'Digested' enemy gain a 5% damage bonus.
Lv100: Applies 'Digested' to all enemies within a small area of the primary target. This secondary effect lasts for only 1.5 seconds.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~9% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Pac-Man hurls a potent Power Pellet, empowered by the very maze itself, towards a targeted enemy champion. Upon impact, the pellet deals damage equal to 30% of Pac-Man's ATK stat plus an additional 50 base physical damage, disrupting their focus. More importantly, the impact unleashes a miniature maze fragment upon the target. This fragment roots the target in place for a brief but critical 0.75 seconds, preventing movement or repositioning. The maze fragment also applies 'Digested' to the target, an effect that lingers for 3 seconds. While 'Digested', allies who target the affected enemy will receive a 10% increase to their movement speed. This potent buff lasts for 2 seconds. While not directly offensive, 'Pellet Toss' creates tactical opportunities for teammates to capitalize on the exposed foe, making Pac-Man a valuable enabler on the battlefield.

abilities.name: Pellet Dash
abilities.description: Pac-Man dashes forward a short distance, consuming all Pellets in his path. For each Pellet consumed during the dash, his next basic attack within 3 seconds deals an additional 15 (+5% Atk) true damage. This dash can pass through enemies, dealing minor damage of 20 (+10% Atk) physical damage to those he passes through. The range of the dash is moderate, allowing for quick repositioning or engaging enemies. The cooldown is reduced by 0.25 seconds for each pellet consumed. Pellet Dash has a base cooldown of 8 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Gotta go fast... and eat everything!

abilities.name: Power Pellet Charge
abilities.description: Pac-Man consumes all stored pellets to charge his next attack for 5 seconds. For each pellet consumed, his next attack applies a shield to himself for 3 seconds that absorbs 25 (+5% Max HP) damage. In addition, consuming 5 or more pellets grants the attack an execute effect, dealing 10% extra damage against targets below 20% health. If this attack does not hit an enemy within 5 seconds the charge dissipates and Pac-Man loses all consumed Pellets and gains a stacking slow debuff up to 50% decaying over 5 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time to power up!

abilities.name: Wakka Wakka!
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Pac-Man passively generates Pellets around the arena every 10 seconds. A maximum of 10 Pellets can be active at any time. When Pac-Man moves near a Pellet, he automatically consumes it, gaining a temporary movement speed buff of 5% for 1 second. Pac-Man can store a maximum of 10 Pellets. In addition, consuming a Pellet grants a stack of 'Voracious' which increases his tenacity by 1% up to a maximum of 10%.
abilities.flavorQuote: Wakka Wakka! Always hungry!

abilities.name: Ghostly Menace
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Pac-Man summons a spectral Ghost that haunts a target enemy for 4 seconds. The ghost slows the target by 20%. If Pac-Man consumes at least 5 pellets while the Ghost is active, Pac-Man can reactivate this ability to command the Ghost to bite the target, dealing 100 (+30% Magic ATK) magic damage and stunning them for 1 second. If the Ghost is not activated during that 4 second timeframe it will fizzle out and explode slowing the target by 10% for 1 second.
abilities.flavorQuote: Boo! Scared yet?

abilities.name: Super Pac-Man
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Pac-Man transforms into Super Pac-Man for 10 seconds, growing in size and gaining increased power. While in this form, Pac-Man gains 20% max hp and his basic attacks cleave dealing 50% of their damage to nearby enemies. Additionally, he becomes immune to crowd control effects and generates a new pellet every 2 seconds. When Super Pac-Man ends, he releases a burst of energy, dealing 100 (+10% max HP) magic damage to nearby enemies.
abilities.flavorQuote: I'm invincible!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Pac-Man synergizes well with teams that can provide crowd control or peel for him, allowing him to safely collect pellets and engage with empowered abilities. He also benefits from teammates who can capitalize on his burst damage potential.
character_v1.tierSummary: Pac Man's kit relies on scaling pellets, but they aren't very effective. Also his low speed prevents him from scaling or applying debuffs consistently.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Pac-Man's kit revolves around accumulating pellets and using them for burst damage and utility. He excels at rapidly moving around the battlefield, collecting pellets, and then using them to empower his abilities for aggressive plays.

chapters.title: Maze Cleanup
chapters.mission: Collect all Graffiti Pellets within 5 minutes.
chapters.summary: The Maze needs cleaning. Q*Bert and Pac-Man must work together to eat all the graffiti pellets and restore the Maze.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Pac-Man teams up with Q*Bert to clean up the graffiti from the maze of Q*Bert's home.

character_v1.name: Timmy Turner

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Wind.

abilities.name: I Wish For...
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~9% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~7% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Timmy focuses his wish energy on an allied character, granting them a random buff for 5 seconds. The possible buffs are +50% Attack Damage, +50% Magic Attack, a Shield equal to 30% of their max HP, or +30% Movement Speed. However, there's a 25% chance that the wish goes awry, inflicting a negative effect instead. These negative effects can include -30% Attack Damage, -30% Magic Attack, being Rooted for 2 seconds, or being inflicted with Silence for 2 seconds. The buff or debuff is determined randomly each time the ability is used. This ability costs 30% of Timmy's Wish Meter.
abilities.flavorQuote: I wish for… uh… something good!

abilities.name: Cosmo and Wanda, I Wish!
abilities.description: Timmy calls upon his Fairy Godparents, Cosmo and Wanda, to grant a targeted wish that affects an area. After a short delay (1.5 seconds), a zone with a radius of 300 units is affected by one of two possible effects, chosen randomly. Effect 1: Allies within the zone are healed for X HP over 3 seconds, scaling with Timmy's Magic Attack. Effect 2: Enemies within the zone take X damage over 3 seconds, also scaling with Timmy's Magic Attack. However, there's a 20% chance for a 'Cosmo and Wanda Mishap,' causing the opposite effect to occur within the zone: Allies take damage, or enemies are healed instead. This ability costs 40% of Timmy's Wish Meter.
abilities.flavorQuote: Cosmo and Wanda, I wish for a miracle!

abilities.name: Dinkleberg!
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~17% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Timmy blames Dinkleberg, creating a temporary diversion. Timmy targets an enemy, inflicting them with Taunt for 1.5 seconds and reducing their movement speed by 20% for 3 seconds after the Taunt ends. During the taunt, the targeted enemy will focus all their attacks on Timmy, if possible. Additionally, all enemies within a 200 unit radius of the primary target are slowed by 10% for the same duration. After the taunt effect expires on the main target, they receive 15% increased damage from all sources for 4 seconds. This ability is designed to disrupt enemy formations and create openings for the team to capitalize on. The ability costs 25% of Timmy's Wish Meter.
abilities.flavorQuote: Dinkleberg...!

abilities.name: Turner Luck
abilities.description: Timmy's inherent luck influences his abilities. When Timmy's Wish Meter is full, his next ability has a 30% increased chance to grant a positive effect rather than a negative one. Furthermore, when Timmy is below 25% health, he gains a 10% increase to his evasion chance. This passive encourages strategic use of Timmy's abilities, rewarding players who manage his Wish Meter effectively and protects him in dire situations. The evasion buff is meant to provide Timmy with a chance to escape or survive long enough for his team to assist.
abilities.flavorQuote: I've always had a knack for getting into... and out of... trouble.

abilities.name: This Changes Everything!
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~14% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Timmy unleashes a reality-altering wish, creating a localized zone of chaos for 8 seconds. Enemies within the zone are continuously subjected to random debuffs, such as brief Stuns (0.75 seconds), Silences (1 second), or attack damage reductions (25% for 2 seconds). Allies within the zone receive continuous random buffs, such as increased movement speed (20% for 2 seconds), damage reflection (10% of damage dealt is reflected back to the attacker for 2 seconds), or small bursts of healing (X HP every 2 seconds, scaling with Timmy's Magic Attack). The buffs and debuffs are applied randomly every 1.5 seconds, creating a dynamic and unpredictable combat environment. This ultimate ability can dramatically shift the course of a team fight but requires careful positioning to maximize its benefits and minimize risks.
abilities.flavorQuote: I wish... everything was different!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Timmy pairs well with damage-heavy allies who can capitalize on the openings created by 'Dinkleberg!' and the chaos of 'This Changes Everything!'. He provides support and disruption, amplifying his team's damage output and survivability.
character_v1.tierSummary: Timmy's kit is too random and unreliable. D tier is a minor shift from D- for balance. His reliance on 'wish meter' makes his kit weaker. Kit audit shows weak mechanics. Campaign stays.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Timmy's kit focuses on disrupting enemies and buffing allies, but with an element of risk. Managing his Wish Meter is crucial to ensure he can consistently use his abilities. 'Turner Luck' rewards strategic Wish Meter management, increasing the odds of positive outcomes.

chapters.title: Best Day Ever
chapters.mission: Use 'I Wish For...' 5 times to successfully create a world of fun within 10 minutes.
chapters.summary: Timmy and Danny must wish for the best day ever, battling evil ghosts and villains.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Timmy teams up with Danny Phantom to wish the best day ever!

character_v1.name: Vicky

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Water.

abilities.name: Potty Training
abilities.description: Vicky unleashes a wave of foul, diaper-filled water in a cone-shaped area in front of her. Enemies caught in the wave are inflicted with 'Stinky Diaper,' reducing their movement speed by 25% and their attack damage by 15% for 4 seconds. If the enemy already has a 'Chore' assigned, 'Stinky Diaper' also refreshes the duration of their current 'Chore' and adds a stack of 'Grounded,' reducing their jump height by 40% for the duration. This ability has a range of 400 units and a cooldown of 8 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Looks like someone needs a change!

abilities.name: Extra Chores!
abilities.description: Vicky assigns a 'Chore' to a targeted enemy within 600 units, choosing from a list of randomized chores: 'Mow the Lawn' (reduces atk by 20%), 'Clean the Toilet' (reduces magic atk by 20%), or 'Wash the Car' (reduces speed by 20%) for 6 seconds. If the enemy completes their 'Chore' by taking damage equivalent to 10% of their maximum HP, Vicky is refunded 50% of this ability's cooldown. If an enemy already has a 'Chore', this ability instead upgrades the existing chore to a 'Super Chore', increasing the debuff by an additional 10% and extending the duration by 2 seconds. Cooldown of 12 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: You're not going anywhere until this is done!

abilities.name: Babysitter's Glare
abilities.description: Vicky's presence alone instills fear in her enemies. Enemies within a 300-unit radius of Vicky have their tenacity reduced by 15%. Additionally, whenever an enemy completes a 'Chore' assigned by Vicky, she gains a stack of 'Icky Aura' for 8 seconds, increasing her magic resistance by 5% per stack, up to a maximum of 5 stacks. Stacks refresh upon each Chore completion, encouraging consistent debuff application and punishment of enemies who attempt to circumvent her control. This passive ability enhances Vicky's survivability and control in prolonged engagements.
abilities.flavorQuote: Don't even think about stepping out of line.

abilities.name: Crocker's Assistance
abilities.description: Vicky calls upon her dubious ally, Denzel Crocker, to unleash a wave of chaotic science. Crocker appears briefly, launching 3 projectiles in a line towards the target location. Each projectile explodes on impact, dealing 75 magic damage and creating a small area that slows enemies by 30% for 2 seconds. If an enemy is hit by multiple projectiles from this ability within 3 seconds, subsequent hits deal 40% reduced damage. Enemies with 'Chores' applied take 15% increased damage from this ability. This ability has a range of 700 units and a cooldown of 15 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Crocker! Do your thing!

abilities.name: Nanny Nightmare
upgrades: (Patch) Relentless Taskmaster: Increases the duration of 'Nanny Nightmare' by 2 seconds, extending Vicky's reign of terror.
abilities.description: Vicky unleashes her full, unbridled fury for 8 terrifying seconds, plunging the battlefield into a state of utter domestic dystopia. During this period, any active 'Chore' assignments afflicting her hapless targets are instantly upgraded to 'Vicky's Wrath'. 'Vicky's Wrath' not only deals 15% increased damage to the affected enemies, but also inflicts a stack of 'Unjust Punishment' every second, up to a maximum of 5 stacks, making them regret every second. Each stack of 'Unjust Punishment' decreases the target's healing received by 10%, ensuring their suffering is prolonged. As Vicky channels her inner malevolence, she experiences a surge of manic energy, granting her 25% increased movement speed, allowing her to swiftly reach those who dare defy her. Furthermore, her auto-attacks during 'Nanny Nightmare' apply 'Chore: Scrub the Toilets', slowing the target's movement speed by 15% per auto-attack for a duration of 3 seconds, stacking up to 3 times. This ultimate demonstration of power establishes Vicky as the supreme domestic autocrat, punishing any insubordination with crippling debuffs and amplified pain.

character_v1.playstyle: Punishes enemy aggression with debuffs and area control.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Vicky synergizes well with teammates who can benefit from her debuffs. Allies with high burst damage or crowd control abilities can capitalize on Vicky's weakened enemies, leading to swift and decisive victories. Her zoning capabilities can also protect vulnerable teammates and create space for carries to thrive.
character_v1.tierSummary: Vicky has strong debuff utility but relies on her Chore Chart mechanic. C+ represents a slight bump up from C. She needs to be bumped up to have a more uniform spread. Keeping campaign.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Vicky excels at applying and amplifying debuffs through her 'Chore Chart' mechanic. 'Extra Chores!' sets up initial debuffs, while 'Potty Training' and 'Crocker's Assistance' capitalize on those debuffs for increased control and damage. Her passive, 'Babysitter's Glare', provides added survivability and utility, making her a formidable presence in team fights.

chapters.title: World Domination
chapters.mission: Infiltrate and control 3 key locations within 10 minutes using team debuffs and magic.
chapters.summary: Vicky and Ursula plot to rule the world!

friendshipCampaign.overview: Vicky partners with Ursula to expand her reign of villainy!

character_v1.name: Natsu Dragneel

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Fire.

abilities.name: Dragon Slayer's Heart (Passive)
upgrades: (Patch) Adjust Heat gain from damage taken to 1% of max HP lost.
(Patch) Dragon Force grants immunity to crowd control effects during the initial 6 seconds.
(Patch) Burning damage scales with 5% of Natsu's Attack Damage, and stacks up to 10 times.
(Patch) Dragon Force no longer refreshes Burning stacks on reactivation, but instead deals immediate damage equal to 2% of target's max HP per stack, up to 10 stacks.
abilities.description: Natsu's burning spirit fuels his combat prowess, embodying the relentless heart of a Dragon Slayer. He gains 'Heat' by relentlessly attacking enemies, accumulating 1 Heat for every 1% of the target's maximum health he deals in damage. Similarly, Natsu thrives under pressure, gaining 0.75 Heat for every 1% of his own maximum health he loses to enemy attacks. Upon reaching 100 Heat, Natsu ignites his 'Dragon Force,' a transformative state lasting 12 seconds where his Dragon Slayer magic surges. While in Dragon Force, Natsu's Attack Damage is increased by 25%, and his Movement Speed is boosted by 15%. Each time Natsu deals damage, he inflicts a stack of 'Burning,' stacking up to 5 times. Each stack of Burning deals 1% of the target's max HP as magic damage over one second. Reactivating Dragon Force while already active extends its duration, adding 6 seconds and refreshing all stacks of Burning on nearby foes, but the Attack Damage bonus is reduced to 12.5%, and the Movement Speed bonus is reduced to 7.5% during the extended period.

abilities.name: Fire Dragon's Iron Fist
abilities.description: Natsu engulfs his fist in flames and delivers a powerful punch to a targeted enemy. This attack deals 120% of his Attack Damage + (2% of the target's Max HP) as Fire Damage. If Natsu is in 'Dragon Force', this ability deals an additional 50% of his Attack Damage as True Damage. Each successful hit generates 10 Rage. This ability has a cooldown of 6 seconds. Successfully hitting the target with Fire Dragon's Iron Fist grants Natsu a stacking buff, increasing his next basic attack damage by 5% for 3 seconds, stacking up to 3 times. Missing the ability will remove all stacks of the buff.
abilities.flavorQuote: Taste the heat of a Dragon!

abilities.name: Fire Dragon's Roar
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~44%).
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Natsu unleashes a torrent of flames from his mouth, dealing damage in a cone-shaped area in front of him. Enemies caught in the 'Fire Dragon's Roar' take 90% of his Attack Damage + (1% of the target's Max HP) as Fire Damage per second for 3 seconds. If Natsu is in 'Dragon Force', the flames also apply a debuff that reduces the target's Magic Resistance by 15% for the duration. Enemies hit by this ability generate 5 Rage per second. The cooldown for 'Fire Dragon's Roar' is 10 seconds. Additionally, successfully hitting enemies with Fire Dragon's Roar applies a burning effect, dealing 10 fire damage per second for 2 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: ROAR!

abilities.name: Fire Dragon's Wing Attack
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Natsu ignites his hands and dashes towards the target enemy. If he reaches the target, he grabs them and sends them flying backwards, dealing 100% of his Attack Damage as Fire Damage and stunning them for 1 second. If Natsu is in 'Dragon Force', the stun duration is increased to 1.75 seconds and it leaves behind a lingering fire hazard. This hazard deals 20 damage per second for 3 seconds in a small radius where the enemy landed. Using this ability generates 15 Rage on a successful hit. This ability has a cooldown of 14 seconds. Furthermore, if an enemy is stunned by Natsu's Wing Attack, Natsu gains a brief shield, absorbing 5% of his max HP, decaying over 2 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Fly, fly away!

abilities.name: Crimson Lotus: Exploding Flame Blade
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~14% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Natsu channels his inner fire and unleashes a devastating torrent of flames. He swipes his arms in a circular motion, creating a massive vortex of fire that explodes outwards, dealing 200% of his Attack Damage + (5% of the target's Max HP) as Fire Damage to all enemies in a large area. If Natsu is in 'Dragon Force', the center of the explosion deals an additional 100% of his Attack Damage as True Damage. This ability consumes all remaining Rage, increasing the damage by 1% for every point of Rage consumed. This ability has a cooldown of 70 seconds. Enemies hit by the ultimate are weakened, reducing their damage output by 10% for 5 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Burn to ashes!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Natsu excels in teams that can capitalize on his burst damage and area control. Allies who can provide crowd control or further reduce enemy resistances amplify Natsu's effectiveness. He benefits from supports who can keep him alive during the Rage-building phase.
character_v1.tierSummary: Natsu has good damage scaling and potential, but lacks consistent control. B+ promotes him from B for better distribution. His kit has a good mechanical uptime, but not SS tier. Campaign is fine as is.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Natsu's kit revolves around building Rage quickly through aggressive engagements and then unleashing devastating attacks in Dragon Force. 'Fire Dragon's Iron Fist' provides a consistent source of damage and Rage generation, while 'Fire Dragon's Roar' offers AoE damage and Magic Resistance reduction, setting up enemies for 'Crimson Lotus: Exploding Flame Blade'. 'Fire Dragon's Wing Attack' allows Natsu to engage or disengage while providing a stun for further combo potential.

chapters.title: Olympian Trials
chapters.mission: Smash 100 boulders to unlock Dragon Force within 10 minutes.
chapters.summary: Natsu and Hercules test each other's strengths. They are going to punch rocks until Natsu unlocks his Dragon Force.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Natsu teams up with Hercules to test his strength to achieve Dragon Force.

character_v1.name: Happy

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Fire.

abilities.name: Aera - Carry
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~46%).
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~41%).
abilities.description: Happy uses his Aera magic to carry a targeted allied champion, granting them both increased movement speed for 3 seconds. During this time, Happy and the carried ally are immune to ground-based crowd control effects. After 3 seconds, or if the ability is recast, Happy throws the allied champion a short distance in the targeted direction. Successfully throwing an ally activates 'Exceed Speed,' granting Happy 20% bonus movement speed and reducing his basic ability cooldowns by 1 second for 5 seconds. If the ally is thrown into an enemy, the enemy is stunned for 0.75 seconds. Prioritizes allies with the lowest health percentage.
abilities.flavorQuote: Want a ride? Aye Sir!

abilities.name: Max Speed - Distraction
abilities.description: Happy channels for 0.5 seconds, then dashes in a target direction, leaving behind an illusory afterimage that persists for 2 seconds. The afterimage mimics Happy's basic attack animation but deals no damage. Enemies that attack the afterimage take 10% increased damage from Happy's next ability within 4 seconds. If 'Exceed Speed' is active, the afterimage also taunts nearby enemies for 1 second, forcing them to attack it. This taunt effect has a limited range. If Happy reactivates this ability within 2 seconds of the initial dash, he will return to the location where the afterimage was created.
abilities.flavorQuote: Too slow! Aye!

abilities.name: Fish Flurry
abilities.description: Happy rapidly throws a barrage of fish in a cone-shaped area in front of him, dealing damage to enemies hit over 1.5 seconds. Each fish deals a small amount of damage, but applies a stacking slow effect of 5% per hit, up to a maximum of 25%. If an enemy is hit by at least 5 fish, they are briefly stunned for 0.5 seconds. The damage of Fish Flurry is increased by 15% for each active allied champion within a 500-unit radius of Happy, representing his team support. Applies on-hit effects at 25% effectiveness.
abilities.flavorQuote: Eat this! And this! And this! Aye!

abilities.name: Maximum Speed!
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: gains extra potency at late levels. 'Maximum Speed' now provides additional cooldown reduction.
abilities.description: When Happy uses 'Aera - Carry' to reposition an ally, the exhilarating rush of wind beneath his wings grants him 'Maximum Speed!' for 5 seconds. This bestows a 20% increase to his movement speed, allowing him to dart across the battlefield with unmatched swiftness. During this time, the magic coursing through Happy accelerates his other abilities, reducing the remaining cooldown of his basic abilities by 1 second each time 'Maximum Speed!' is active. Furthermore, Happy's auto attacks gain an extra flourish, creating a small gust of wind that knocks enemies back a short distance. If Happy casts 'Aera - Carry' again while 'Maximum Speed!' is already active, the duration is refreshed to 5 seconds, and the movement speed bonus is amplified by 5%, capping at a maximum of 30%. Once 'Maximum Speed!' expires, the bonus resets to its initial value.

abilities.name: Happy's Fiery Flight
upgrades: (Patch) Utility Emphasis: Allied shield now grants temporary move speed boost.
abilities.description: Happy focuses his magic for 1 second, channeling energy into his wings, and then unleashes a surge of fiery magic forward in a straight line, dealing initial magic damage equal to 100 + (50% of Happy's Magic Attack) to all enemies caught in the path. Happy's fiery surge leaves behind a trail of flame that persists for 4 seconds. Enemies who walk through this fiery trail suffer 30 + (15% of Happy's Magic Attack) magic damage every 0.5 seconds for the duration that they remain in the flame trail. Allied champions who pass through the fire trail are invigorated, gaining a shield that absorbs damage equal to 50 + (25% of Happy's Magic Attack) for 3 seconds. This ability briefly transforms Happy into 'Red Happy', granting him immunity to crowd control effects for the entire 1 second channel duration and while the fire trail persists for its 4-second duration. Additionally, 'Happy's Fiery Flight' consumes all stacks of 'Exceed Speed'. For each stack consumed, the initial magic damage and the damage of the fire trail are increased by 10%, and the width of the fire trail is expanded by 10%.

character_v1.teamSynergy: Happy excels at supporting aggressive carries and providing utility in team fights. His Aera ability allows him to rescue allies from danger or reposition them for aggressive plays. The shields provided by his ultimate further enhance his supportive capabilities.
character_v1.tierSummary: Happy is primarily support but his utility is limited. F- is far too low considering his support role. Promoting him to E tier. Needs to support to be useful.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Happy's kit revolves around his Aera magic, allowing him to reposition allies and trigger his Exceed Speed passive. Max Speed allows him to create distractions, while Fish Flurry provides sustained damage and crowd control. His ultimate, Nekomander's Roar, offers a powerful burst of damage and area control, synergizing with his Exceed Speed passive for increased effectiveness.

chapters.title: Galactic Fish Quest
chapters.mission: Collect 25 exotic fish species within the time limit.
chapters.summary: Happy and Stitch travel the galaxy in search of the most delicious fish, facing space pirates and bizarre alien creatures.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Happy teams up with Stitch to find the finest fish in the galaxy.

character_v1.name: Katsu-Chan

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Electric. Katsu-chan launches a small, electrified drumstick at the target enemy. The attack deals damage equal to 100% of his Attack, modified by critical hit chance and enemy defense. This attack has a short animation time (0.3 seconds) allowing for quick follow-up actions. The electric property applies a minor, non-stacking shock effect, increasing damage taken from subsequent electric attacks by 3% for 1 second, though this effect only applies to damage from Katsu-chan's own skills, to prevent electric team comps from getting too powerful. Scaling at higher levels will improve Attack scaling, Critical Hit Chance and add small utility interaction, such as a small chance to inflict brief mini-stun.

abilities.name: Don-da-da!
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Katsu-chan beats his drum, sending out a rhythmic pulse that heals allies within a medium radius for 6% of their max HP over 3 seconds (down from 8%). Successfully timing the ability activation with an on-screen rhythm prompt (a 'Don' or 'Ka' symbol appearing briefly) grants allies affected an additional 1 stack of 'Taiko Tempo' (down from 2). If the rhythm prompt is missed, the heal amount is reduced by 3% (down from 4%) and no extra Tempo stacks are granted. This ability has a 8 second cooldown. Proper timing is key to maximizing the healing and support provided by Katsu-chan. The healing is applied as a heal-over-time effect, ticking 3 times at 1 second intervals. The radius of the heal is 8 meters. This ability does not affect Katsu-chan himself.
abilities.flavorQuote: Let's get this beat going!

abilities.name: Ka-Poom!
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~41%).
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Katsu-chan slams the rims of his drum, creating a shockwave that knocks back enemies in a small cone in front of him. Enemies hit also have their movement speed reduced by 20% for 2 seconds (down from 30%). If Katsu-chan has at least 5 stacks of 'Taiko Tempo' on himself, this ability consumes those stacks to also inflict 'Silence' for 0.75 seconds (down from 1 second) on the enemies hit. This ability has a 10 second cooldown. The cone is relatively narrow, demanding accurate aiming for maximum effect. Proper positioning is critical to interrupt enemy abilities or peel for allies. The cone has a width of 45 degrees and a range of 6 meters. The knockback distance is a fixed 2 meters.
abilities.flavorQuote: Rim-shot rumble incoming!

abilities.name: Rhythmic Revival
abilities.description: When an ally within a large radius of Katsu-chan falls below 25% health, Katsu-chan automatically grants them 2 stacks of 'Taiko Tempo' (down from 3) and a shield that absorbs damage equal to 8% of their maximum health for 4 seconds (down from 10%). This effect can only occur once every 20 seconds per ally. This passive ensures Katsu-chan provides emergency support to teammates in dire situations, potentially turning the tide of battle with a sudden burst of speed and shielding. The radius of effect is 12 meters. The shield is applied instantly upon the trigger condition being met.
abilities.flavorQuote: Don't give up! The rhythm keeps us strong!

abilities.name: Taiko Time!
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~25%).
abilities.description: Katsu-chan initiates 'Taiko Time!', creating a large, visible rhythm game interface on the screen for all allies. For the next 5 seconds, every successful 'Don' or 'Ka' input by allies grants them 1 stack of 'Taiko Tempo' and increases their damage by 4% for 2 seconds, stacking up to 5 times (down from 5%). Missing an input incurs a small damage penalty of 1% for 1 second (down from 2%). This ability has a 25 second cooldown. 'Taiko Time!' promotes active player participation and rewards skillful rhythm execution with significant buffs. The attack speed bonus is now tied to Taiko Tempo instead of being a separate buff.
abilities.flavorQuote: It's Taiko Time! Show me your rhythm!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Katsu-chan excels in teams that benefit from increased attack speed and movement. He pairs well with damage dealers who can capitalize on the 'Taiko Tempo' buffs, and tanks who can protect him during his channeling ultimate.
character_v1.tierSummary: Katsu-Chan's reliance on rhythm makes his kit too slow and vulnerable. Bumped from F to F+ for slight improvement. The KPS needs to be adjusted to indicate his unreliability.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Katsu-chan's abilities are designed to work together, granting Tempo stacks and rewarding well-timed activations. Taiko Time synergizes with Rhythmic Revival, granting extra Tempo when allies need it. Ka-Poom! provides disruption, allowing allies to capitalize on the opening while under the effects of Taiko Tempo.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Katsu-Chan teams up with Mickey Mouse to bring rhythm to the town!

character_v1.name: Donko

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Electric.

abilities.name: Don Don Barrage
abilities.description: Donko rapidly strikes her drum surface, creating a cone-shaped area of effect in front of her. Enemies caught within this area take 80 + (0.2 * ATK) physical damage. If the ability is activated perfectly on the beat of the current track (Rhythm Resonance), Donko unleashes an additional shockwave dealing 40 + (0.1 * ATK) as true damage and applying a stacking slow debuff of 10% for 2 seconds. This slow can stack up to 3 times. If mistimed, the cone's damage is reduced by 30%, and no slow is applied. The range of the cone is 400 units, with a cooldown of 6 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Feel the rhythm of the drums!

abilities.name: Rhythmic Guard
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~10%).
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~8% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Donko braces herself, creating a protective barrier around her for 3 seconds. During this time, she gains 60 + (0.15 * DEF) shield strength. If activated on the beat (Rhythm Resonance), the shield also reflects 30% of incoming damage back to the attacker as magic damage. If the timing is off, the shield's duration is reduced to 2 seconds and does not reflect damage. The shield has a visual indicator to assist with timing the ability activation. Cooldown is 10 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Protecting my beat, protecting my friends!

abilities.name: Shinobue Song
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~15% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Donko plays a melody on her Shinobue, granting allies within a 600-unit radius 40 + (0.1 * Magic Atk) magic resistance for 4 seconds. If the Shinobue Song is played perfectly on beat (Rhythm Resonance), allies also receive a 15% increase in movement speed for the duration. Missing the beat results in a shorter buff duration of 2 seconds and no movement speed bonus. This ability has a cooldown of 12 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: A melody to empower and protect!

abilities.name: Tamashii Resonance
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Donko's connection to the Great Spirit grants her enhanced awareness of rhythm. Successfully landing abilities on the beat (Rhythm Resonance) grants her a stack of 'Echo', up to a maximum of 5 stacks. Each stack of Echo increases her tenacity by 4%. Upon reaching 5 stacks, Donko's next basic attack or ability consumes all stacks to deal an additional 60 true damage and apply a 20% damage reduction debuff to the target for 2 seconds. The damage reduction does not stack.
abilities.flavorQuote: The spirit moves within the beat!

abilities.name: Great Drum Awakening
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Donko channels her inner rhythm, transforming into a giant Taiko drum for 10 seconds. In this form, her size increases by 50%, and her attack and defense are boosted by 30%. While transformed, each successful attack generates a shockwave that deals 100 + (0.3 * ATK) physical damage to nearby enemies every second. If Donko maintains a consistent rhythm during the transformation, hitting at least one enemy per second, the duration is extended by 2 seconds, up to a maximum of 14 seconds. Failing to maintain the rhythm will end the transformation prematurely. This ability has a cooldown of 120 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Let the rhythm consume you!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Donko provides valuable protection and buffs to her team. 'Shinobue Song' grants magic resistance and movement speed, aiding allies in both offense and defense. 'Rhythmic Guard' can reflect damage, punishing aggressive enemies. Her ultimate provides area damage and control. She can best support hyper carries, benefitting from increased survivability and damage.
character_v1.tierSummary: Donko's kit is too reliant on rhythm resonance and offers little consistent impact. Moved from F- to F as there are too many in F-. His performance is still weak.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Donko's kit synergizes around 'Rhythm Resonance', rewarding players who can time their abilities with the game's rhythm. 'Tamashii Resonance' rewards consistent timing, enhancing her defense and damage capabilities. 'Rhythmic Guard' and 'Shinobue Song' provide defensive and supportive options, with increased effectiveness upon rhythmic execution. 'Great Drum Awakening' provides a powerful ultimate transformation that rewards constant rhythmic engagement.

chapters.title: The Silent Symphony
chapters.mission: Donko and Tia must play a song to restore sound to the town square, awakening the townsfolk's lost memories of music.
chapters.summary: Donko awakens in a desolate town where music is forbidden. He encounters Tia, a celestial mage who senses the dormant rhythms within the land.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Donko, the rhythmically-inclined drummer, finds himself lost in a world without music. He must rediscover his sound and inspire others to join his beat.

character_v1.name: Tia

abilities.name: Celestial Bolt
upgrades: [object Object]
[object Object]
[object Object]
abilities.description: Tia channels the radiant energy of the heavens, conjuring a concentrated beam of pure starlight that pierces through the darkness to strike a single enemy. Upon impact, the Celestial Bolt inflicts physical damage equal to 30% of Tia's Attack Power plus an additional 10 physical damage, searing the target with celestial fire. This initial impact also bestows a 'Guiding Light' status effect for 3 seconds, enhancing the target's vulnerability to subsequent attacks. Enemies under the 'Guiding Light' effect receive 5% increased damage from all sources, allowing Tia and her allies to focus their offensive efforts with greater efficiency. Tia's mastery over the celestial energies ensures that this initial strike is swift and precise, making it an indispensable tool in her arsenal. The guiding light effect ensures Tia's allies can focus their firepower to bring down key targets efficiently.

abilities.name: Rhythm Cascade
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~11% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Tia strikes the ground with her staff, creating a cascading wave of rhythmic energy in a cone-shaped area in front of her. This deals 60 (+40% Magic ATK) magic damage to enemies hit. Successfully timing the ability (indicated by a visual cue) grants 1 Rhythm stack. The cone's range extends by 15% for every 5 Rhythm stacks Tia possesses, up to a maximum of 45% increased range. If cast at maximum Rhythm stacks (15), Rhythm Cascade also applies a stacking slow effect (10% per hit, up to 30%) for 2 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Feel the rhythm flow through you!

abilities.name: Harmonic Shield
abilities.description: Tia creates a protective shield around herself or an ally, absorbing up to 120 (+60% Magic ATK) damage for 3 seconds. Successfully timing the ability grants 1 Rhythm stack. If Tia has at least 5 Rhythm stacks, casting Harmonic Shield consumes 5 stacks to grant the target ally a 20% increase in tenacity for the duration of the shield. If the shield breaks before its duration ends, the target receives a burst of healing equal to 30% of the remaining shield value, but no Rhythm is generated from this cast.
abilities.flavorQuote: Let the harmonies protect you!

abilities.name: Rhythmic Pulse
abilities.description: Tia sends out a pulse of rhythmic energy in a line, dealing 70 (+50% Magic ATK) magic damage to all enemies in its path. Each enemy hit grants 0.5 Rhythm stacks, up to a maximum of 3 stacks. If Tia has 10 or more Rhythm stacks, consuming 10 stacks causes Rhythmic Pulse to inflict a brief stun (0.75 seconds) on the first enemy hit. This stun duration does not scale. Successfully timing the ability has no additional effect beyond the Rhythm Stack gain.
abilities.flavorQuote: The rhythm will guide my strike!

abilities.name: Echoing Staff (Signature Passive)
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Tia's staff resonates with rhythmic energy. Whenever Tia successfully times an ability, she gains a stack of Rhythm. Rhythm stacks increase Tia's movement speed by 1% per stack, up to a maximum of 15%. Upon reaching 15 Rhythm stacks, Tia's next basic attack within 5 seconds deals 40 (+20% Magic ATK) bonus magic damage and consumes all Rhythm stacks. Rhythm stacks decay by 1 every 3 seconds if Tia doesn't gain a new stack. This passive is central to Tia's core gameplay.
abilities.flavorQuote: My staff sings with power!

abilities.name: Resonance Barrage (Ultimate)
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~12% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Tia channels her inner rhythm, unleashing a barrage of rhythmic pulses around her in a large circular area for 4 seconds. Each pulse deals 40 (+30% Magic ATK) magic damage to enemies within the area. The frequency of pulses increases with Tia's current Rhythm stacks, up to a maximum of one additional pulse per second at 15 stacks. Consuming all Rhythm stacks upon activation increases the damage of each pulse by 20% for the duration of the ultimate. Activating Resonance Barrage grants Tia a shield that absorbs 100 (+50% Magic ATK) for 3 seconds, so position carefully!
abilities.flavorQuote: Feel the full power of the beat!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Tia works well with teams that can capitalize on her crowd control and supportive capabilities. Allies that benefit from increased tenacity or can follow up on her slows and stuns are particularly effective. She provides a mix of damage and utility, making her a versatile addition to various team compositions.
character_v1.tierSummary: Tia's kit offers some utility but lacks strong scaling and consistent damage. She's slightly better than Happy so she is now E-. The rhythm focus makes her weaker.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Tia's kit is built around generating and expending Rhythm stacks. Rhythm Cascade and Rhythmic Pulse generate Rhythm, while Harmonic Shield and Resonance Barrage consume it for added effects, creating a cyclical playstyle that rewards precise timing and resource management.

chapters.title: Celestial Harmony
chapters.mission: Tia and Donko must perform a duet that blends celestial magic with earthly rhythm, creating a sound that resonates with both realms.
chapters.summary: Tia struggles to understand the chaotic nature of human music. Donko guides her, showing how rhythm and emotion intertwine to create beautiful melodies.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Tia seeks to understand human music, seeing it as a reflection of the celestial harmonies. She partners with Donko to bridge the gap between the heavens and earth.

character_v1.name: Agent Jones

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling

Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction

abilities.name: Reality Fracture
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~14%).
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~9% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Agent Jones fractures reality at a target location, creating a Reality Rift. Upon activation, the rift summons a random weapon from the Chapter 1 Season 1 loot pool: Assault Rifle, Burst Assault Rifle, Scoped Assault Rifle, Pump Shotgun, Tactical Shotgun, Submachine Gun, Tactical Submachine Gun, Suppressed Submachine Gun, Pistol, Revolver, Bolt-Action Sniper Rifle, or Semi-Auto Sniper Rifle. The summoned weapon is instantly equipped, replacing Jones's current weapon. The weapon has limited ammo (50% of max capacity), which cannot be replenished normally, and disappears after expending all ammo. The Reality Rift persists for 5 seconds after the weapon is claimed, granting vision in a small radius. Cooldown: 14 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Let's see what surprises the past holds.

abilities.name: Temporal Trap
abilities.description: Agent Jones lays down a Temporal Trap at a target location within a short range. The trap remains invisible until triggered by an enemy. When triggered, the trap activates, summoning either a Damage Trap, Ceiling Zapper, or Wall Dynamo from Chapter 1 Season 1. These traps function identically to their original versions, dealing damage to enemies who trigger them and then disappearing. The type of trap summoned is random. The placement range is short, requiring careful positioning. Each trap deals 275 damage and can trigger once. Cooldown: 17 seconds. Maximum of 2 traps can be active at a time. If a third trap is placed, the oldest one disappears.
abilities.flavorQuote: They won't see this coming...from any timeline.

abilities.name: Fractured Flicker
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Agent Jones briefly phases out of reality, becoming invulnerable and untargetable for 1 second. During this time, his movement speed is increased by 20%. After the phase ends, he reappears at his original location. This ability can be used defensively to avoid incoming attacks or offensively to reposition. Using Fractured Flicker incurs a brief moment of vulnerability upon reappearing, demanding precise timing. This ability no longer cleanses crowd control. Cooldown: 20 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time to disappear...just for a moment.

abilities.name: Chronal Anomaly (Signature Passive)
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Each time Agent Jones uses 'Reality Fracture' or 'Temporal Trap', he gains a stack of 'Chronal Instability.' Each stack increases his damage output by 2% and his trap damage by 4%. Stacks last for 7 seconds. Upon reaching 5 stacks of Chronal Instability, Jones triggers a 'Chronal Overload,' consuming all stacks and opening a Reality Rift at his location, dropping a random consumable/healing item from Chapter 1 Season 1: Bandages, Med Kit, Shield Potion, Slurp Juice, Bush, or Smoke Grenade. The Overload also grants Jones a 10% speed boost for 3 seconds. Cooldown on Chronal Overload: 25 seconds after activation.
abilities.flavorQuote: The timelines are converging...and I'm just getting started.

character_v1.teamSynergy: Agent Jones synergizes well with teams that can capitalize on his trap placements and benefit from the chaotic nature of his ultimate. He provides area control, damage, and limited support, making him a versatile addition to any team composition. He benefits from team members who can provide crowd control to keep enemies within his trap range.
character_v1.tierSummary: Agent Jones, while strong, isn't quite SS tier due to some RNG dependency on his Reality Fracture. Reducing him to A tier to open slots in higher tiers, but adjusting KPS to reflect kit strength. Jones campaign already exists so nothing to do there.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Agent Jones excels at creating opportunities for himself through strategic trap placement and weapon acquisition. His Signature Passive encourages aggressive play, rewarding him with healing and utility for actively using his abilities. His Ultimate provides a game-changing area of effect that can swing battles in his favor.

chapters.title: Fractured Realities
chapters.mission: Agent Jones and Raven Team Leader must enter an abandoned world and restore the reality before they succumb to its power.
chapters.summary: Agent Jones's Reality Fractures are being hijacked, and Raven Team Leader is able to use it to her advantage. Their shared interest in the chaos gives them a new bond.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Agent Jones finds an anomaly where realities bleed into each other, and needs to stabilize the rifts before the universe collapses. His unlikely friendship with Raven Team Leader might be the key to succeeding.

character_v1.name: Raven Team Leader

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Melee basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Dark.

abilities.name: Loot Arsenal: Stance Shift
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~9% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Raven Team Leader cycles through her 'Loot Arsenal,' switching between three weapon stances: Assault Rifle, Shotgun, and Sniper. Each stance grants unique combat benefits. Assault Rifle stance grants +15% attack speed and +10% movement speed, allowing for sustained DPS and enhanced mobility. Shotgun stance grants +20% damage to the next basic attack and applies 'Vulnerability' for 3 seconds, increasing damage taken by the target by 10%. Sniper stance grants +50% critical hit damage and +2 range to basic attacks, enabling long-range burst damage. Each stance lasts for 6 seconds, followed by a 1-second cooldown before another stance can be selected. Utilizing an ability during a stance will extend the duration of the current stance by 2 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Pick your poison; I've got a full armory.

abilities.name: Boogie Bomb Blast
abilities.description: Raven Team Leader tosses a Boogie Bomb towards a targeted area. Enemies caught within the bomb's blast radius (3 unit radius) are forced to dance for 2.5 seconds, rendering them unable to attack or use abilities. This effect is broken upon taking damage exceeding 15% of their max health. Additionally, affected enemies suffer a 10% reduction in movement speed for 4 seconds after the dance concludes. The Boogie Bomb has a cooldown of 12 seconds. If Raven Team Leader is in the Shotgun Stance when casting Boogie Bomb Blast, the slow effect increases to 20%.
abilities.flavorQuote: Everybody dance now!

abilities.name: Nightmare Snare
upgrades: [object Object]
[object Object]
[object Object]
abilities.description: Raven Team Leader carefully lays down a Nightmare Snare at a designated location, cloaked in shadow and waiting for an unsuspecting victim. The Snare remains hidden until an enemy wanders within a 1.5 unit radius, at which point the ethereal trap springs to life, unleashing a burst of shadowy energy. This blast inflicts 150 points of physical damage, augmented by 30% of Raven Team Leader's total attack power, upon all enemies caught within its grasp. The dark energy lingers, causing additional damage over a duration of 3 seconds, dealing 40 physical damage per second, scaling with 10% of Raven Team Leader's attack power per second. After this agonizing encounter, the Nightmare Snare dissipates, its dark magic spent. Raven Team Leader is capable of holding a maximum of 2 Nightmare Snares at any given moment, with a new Snare being conjured into existence every 15 seconds, replenishing the stockpile up to the maximum capacity. Furthermore, should Raven Team Leader be channeling the focused energy of the Sniper Stance when deploying a Nightmare Snare, the trap's detection radius is significantly enhanced to 2.5 units, making it even more challenging for enemies to detect and evade the sinister surprise.

abilities.name: Dark Embrace (Ultimate)
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Damage re-calibration: Minor adjustment to damage multipliers for better balance.
(Patch) Role Emphasis: Enhanced damage output to better align with damage-focused playstyle.
abilities.description: Raven Team Leader fully embraces the power of the storm within, becoming a conduit for destruction. For 8 seconds, she enters a state of Dark Embrace, gaining the benefits of all her combat stances simultaneously, weaving between offensive styles with seamless fluidity. In this augmented state, her Assault Rifle's rapid-fire capabilities are amplified with increased attack and movement speed, allowing her to dart around the battlefield while maintaining a relentless barrage. Her Shotgun unleashes devastating empowered basic attacks that inflict Vulnerability for 3 seconds, causing enemies to take 20% increased damage from all sources. Furthermore, the precision of her Sniper Rifle is enhanced, significantly boosting critical hit damage by 60% and extending her effective range. During Dark Embrace, the cooldowns of Boogie Bomb Blast and Damage Trap Deployment are reduced by 50%, enabling a constant stream of disruptive crowd control and area denial. To weather the storm of incoming attacks, Raven Team Leader gains a shield that absorbs damage equal to 20% of her maximum health for the duration. The activation of Dark Embrace also grants immunity to all crowd control effects for 1.5 seconds, ensuring that she remains unyielding in her assault.

character_v1.teamSynergy: Raven Team Leader works well with teams that benefit from burst damage and area control. Her Boogie Bomb Blast can set up easy kills for high-damage allies, while her Damage Traps can control the flow of battle. Allies that can provide crowd control or mobility buffs can further enhance her effectiveness.
character_v1.tierSummary: Raven's kit is based on traps and stealth, offering zone control. His utility justifies a promotion to C-. The friendship campaign is created to match the theme.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Raven Team Leader excels at adapting to different combat scenarios through her stance-switching mechanic. Utilizing 'Resourceful Tactician' to maintain 'Loot Stacks' allows her to keep up with enemy scaling and to rapidly switch stances, maximizing both damage output and survivability.
character_v1.bestFriendshipBuff: Increased Trap Damage and Stealth Duration.

chapters.title: Dimensional Raids
chapters.mission: They must now escape and gather more resources to help the team succeed, before the world closes in on them.
chapters.summary: Raven Team Leader and Agent Jones dive into a Reality Rift to gather some resources, but get more than they bargain for in this new world.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Raven Team Leader is on a mission for Resources, but to get there, she needs the Agent's help with his Reality Rift knowledge. Can they coexist?

character_v1.name: Carl Johnson

abilities.name: Basic Attack

(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.

abilities.name: Grove Street Tactics
abilities.description: CJ gains 1 stack of 'Turf Control' whenever he damages an enemy champion with an ability (max 3 stacks). Each stack of 'Turf Control' grants CJ 3% increased movement speed and 2% bonus damage to his next basic attack. If CJ uses 'Get Strapped' or 'Drive-By', all stacks of 'Turf Control' are consumed, enhancing that ability's effect. Stacks last for 5 seconds, refreshing upon gaining a new stack. This passive encourages aggressive ability usage and rewards CJ for successfully harassing his opponents while staying mobile.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Grove Street. Home. At least it was before I ****ed everything up."

abilities.name: Represent
abilities.description: CJ flashes his Grove Street colors, buffing a target ally. The target ally gains 15% increased attack speed and 10% increased movement speed for 4 seconds. If CJ has any stacks of 'Turf Control', consuming all stacks increases the duration of the buff by 1 second per stack. This ability serves as CJ's primary supportive tool, allowing him to enhance the offensive capabilities of his allies. Represent can turn the tide of a skirmish or help an ally secure a kill. The relatively short duration makes strategic timing crucial. Prioritize allies who can best utilize the attack and movement speed boost.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Green Sabre!"

abilities.name: Drive-By
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: CJ performs a quick drive-by, unleashing a barrage of bullets in a targeted direction. CJ dashes a short distance in the target direction firing bullets dealing 80 / 120 / 160 / 200 / 240 (+50% of his attack damage) physical damage to enemies in a cone. If CJ has stacks of 'Turf Control', consuming all stacks, the ability's range is increased by 10% per stack and applies a 20% slow for 2 seconds. 'Drive-By' is a potent damage tool. It provides both burst damage and zone control. Position yourself to maximize the number of enemies hit by the cone, especially when enhanced with 'Turf Control' stacks for added range and utility.
abilities.flavorQuote: "All we had to do, was follow the damn train, CJ!"

abilities.name: Get Strapped
abilities.description: CJ prepares for a fight, gaining a shield that absorbs 50 / 75 / 100 / 125 / 150 (+30% of his attack damage) damage for 3 seconds. Upon activation, CJ also throws a molotov cocktail at a target location, creating a burning area that deals 20 / 30 / 40 / 50 / 60 (+15% of his magic attack) magic damage per second to enemies within. If CJ has stacks of 'Turf Control', consuming all stacks, the shield is increased by 20% per stack, and the duration of the burning area is increased by 0.5 seconds per stack. This ability is excellent for initiating fights and securing objectives. The shield provides crucial survivability.
abilities.flavorQuote: "I'll have two number 9s, a number 9 large, a number 6 with extra dip..."

abilities.name: Taking Back the Streets
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~35%).
abilities.description: CJ rallies his allies, granting all nearby allied champions 20 / 30 / 40% increased damage and 15 / 20 / 25 tenacity for 8 seconds. Enemies caught in the area when the ability is cast are feared for 1 second. CJ shouts "Taking back the streets!", inspiring his team and demoralizing his enemies. This ultimate is a game-changer in team fights, providing a significant boost to allied damage output and survivability while briefly incapacitating enemies. Position yourself strategically to affect as many allies and enemies as possible with the initial fear and subsequent buffs. The combination of damage amplification and tenacity can easily swing a team fight in your favor.
abilities.flavorQuote: "This is for my homies in Grove Street!"

character_v1.teamSynergy: CJ synergizes well with aggressive, damage-focused allies who can capitalize on his buffs. His ability to manipulate the battlefield with Drive-By and Get Strapped also makes him a valuable asset in coordinated team compositions.
character_v1.tierSummary: Carl's kit revolves around Turf Control and AoE, but his stats are underwhelming. He fits in the D- tier with limited viability. The friendship campaign is created to match the theme.
character_v1.internalSynergy: CJ's kit revolves around stacking 'Turf Control' through ability usage to enhance his key abilities. 'Represent' grants attack speed and movement speed, 'Drive-By' provides burst damage, and 'Get Strapped' offers survivability and area control, all amplified by Turf Control. The ultimate is a teamfight-winning buff and fear.
character_v1.bestFriendshipBuff: Increased Damage vs Crowd Controlled targets

chapters.title: From Grove Street to Springfield
chapters.mission: With Lisa's genius, CJ can control the streets to his will. He must fight off some thugs to protect his friend, before taking over the city.
chapters.summary: CJ and Lisa seek to create an unlikely alliance to conquer the streets of many towns. Can this unorthodox friendship last?

friendshipCampaign.overview: CJ seeks to take over the streets of the whole universe, and will stop at nothing until it is his. Lisa Simpson is skeptical of his violence, but she is the only one who can help him.

abilities.flavorQuote: Knowledge is the ultimate defense.

abilities.name: Eco-Friendly Taunt
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~9% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Lisa leverages her environmental activism to draw enemy attention. Upon activation, Lisa releases a sonic wave shaped like recycling symbol, taunting all nearby enemies within a radius for 2.5 seconds. Taunted enemies are forced to attack Lisa, while also suffering a 10% reduction in their attack damage. Following the taunt, Lisa gains a stacking buff that increases her defense by 10 for each taunted enemy, lasting 4 seconds. This ability has a cooldown of 15 seconds and consumes 70 mana. Completing the sequence for 'Saxophone Solo', casting Eco-Friendly Taunt empowers Lisa.
abilities.flavorQuote: Think globally, act locally, taunt universally!

abilities.name: Vegetarian Vitality
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Lisa's commitment to vegetarianism enhances her and her allies resilience. Lisa regenerates 2% of her maximum HP every 5 seconds. Additionally, nearby allied champions (within a radius) receive 1% HP regeneration every 5 seconds. When Lisa successfully completes a 'Saxophone Solo' sequence, this passive regeneration is doubled for both Lisa and her allies for 8 seconds. When Lisa falls below 25% HP, she automatically consumes a 'Tofu Turkey', instantly healing her for 15% of her maximum health. This effect has a 60-second cooldown.
abilities.flavorQuote: Goodness grows from the ground up.

abilities.name: Bleeding Gums Rhapsody
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Peak performance reduced: Attack Damage boost reduced by ~16%.
(Role Realignment) Utility Emphasis: Now offers extended mobility instead of raw damage.
abilities.description: Lisa pours her heart into a soulful saxophone solo, channeling the spirit of Bleeding Gums Murphy to inspire her allies and confound her enemies. For the first 4 seconds, Lisa becomes immune to any movement-impairing crowd control, serenading the battlefield with notes of pure jazz. During this prelude, allies within a generous radius of 600 units become invigorated, gaining a 20% boost to their movement speed and a 15% increase to their attack damage, allowing them to reposition and strike with renewed vigor. Simultaneously, enemies caught within a smaller, more concentrated radius of 400 units find themselves hampered by Lisa's bluesy wail, suffering a 20% reduction to their movement speed and enduring magic damage equal to 15% of Lisa's Magic Attack every second. As the final notes of the solo fade, Lisa unleashes a wave of restorative harmony, instantly healing all allies within the 600-unit radius for 15% of their missing health, patching them up for the coming battle. This inspiring ability has a cooldown of 90 seconds, and costs 150 Mana.

abilities.name: Jazz Intervention
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: Ability Power scaling increased, amplifying shield strength.
(Balance Patch) Buff: Crowd control immunity duration extended, enhancing self-preservation.
(Patch) Role Realignment: Ability interactions now emphasize jack-of-all-trades potential.
abilities.description: Lisa's innate understanding of harmony and discord allows her to strategically improvise based on battlefield conditions, supporting her team through carefully timed 'Saxophone Solos'. When Lisa casts Brainiac Barrier followed by Tree Hugger's Rebuke within 8 seconds, she orchestrates a 'Progressive Harmony Solo'. This resonates with up to three nearby allies, granting each a shield that absorbs 40 + (10% of Lisa's Ability Power) magic damage for 4 seconds, layering a defensive melody. Alternatively, casting Tree Hugger's Rebuke followed by Brainiac Barrier within 8 seconds triggers 'Dizzying Bebop Riff', creating a disruptive fanfare. This cleanses all debuffs from Lisa and grants her temporary immunity to crowd control effects for 2.5 seconds, as the complex rhythm disorients her foes' attempts to control her. However, to prevent over-reliance on these instantaneous compositions, both 'Progressive Harmony Solo' and 'Dizzying Bebop Riff' can only be activated once every 15 seconds, requiring calculated sequences to maximize their impact.

character_v1.teamSynergy: Lisa synergizes well with aggressive carries who benefit from increased speed and attack damage. Her ability to cleanse and protect allies from magic damage makes her a valuable asset against mage-heavy compositions. Her taunt can disrupt enemy formations, allowing her teammates to capitalize on positional advantages.
character_v1.tierSummary: Lisa provides support with heals, shields, and buffs. She is strong enough to reach B+. The friendship campaign is created to match the theme.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Lisa's kit revolves around comboing Intellectual Shield and Eco-Friendly Taunt to trigger her Saxophone Solo passive, which provides crucial buffs and utility to her team. Her Vegetarian Vitality passive provides constant sustain, while her ultimate offers a burst of healing, damage, and crowd control.
