upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Elsa unleashes her full power, creating a blizzard that covers a large area for 8 seconds. Enemies within the blizzard are slowed by 30% and take 40 (+20% Magic ATK) magic damage per second, gaining a stack of Frostbite every second. Allies inside the blizzard gain a shield absorbing up to 100 (+10% Max HP) damage that refreshes every 2 seconds. This ultimate ability allows Elsa to drastically alter the battlefield, providing sustained crowd control and protection to her team while hindering enemy advances, making it a game-changing ability in prolonged engagements.
abilities.flavorQuote: I can’t go back; the past is in the past!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Elsa excels in teams that can capitalize on her crowd control and zone denial. Her abilities are particularly effective with burst damage dealers who can take advantage of the vulnerability debuff from Glacial Prison and sustained damage dealers who can thrive in the Eternal Winter blizzard.
character_v1.tierSummary: Elsa's crowd control and magic damage have solid uptime and AoE. B tier reflects balanced damage output and team synergy with solid defensive stats.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Elsa's abilities synergize to create persistent zones of control and provide burst crowd control. Frozen Ground and Winter's Aura apply Frostbite, setting up Ice Lance and Glacial Prison for additional effects. Eternal Winter provides sustained area control and protection, maximizing her impact in team fights.

chapters.title: Elemental Harmony
chapters.mission: Navigate the temple, solve elemental puzzles, and purify the energy source, enhancing Elsa's connection to her powers.
chapters.summary: Elsa seeks Aang's help to control her ice powers. They must find a source of pure elemental energy in a hidden temple.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Elsa seeks guidance from Aang to master her elemental powers, leading to collaborative ice sculptures and spiritual balance.

character_v1.name: Anna

abilities.name: Spirited Strike
upgrades: Lv10: Increases damage scaling to 65% of ATK.
Lv50: Grants a 15% chance to critically strike, dealing 150% damage.
Lv100: Increases base damage to 75 and grants a minor speed boost on hit.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Anna's inherent optimism manifests as a spirited strike against a single target within her attack range, dealing physical damage. This attack, fueled by her determination, inflicts 50 (+60% of Anna's Attack) physical damage to the targeted enemy. As Anna's spirit burns brighter, the power of this attack grows, benefiting from Anna's own strength and resolve. This initial impact can resonate, creating the potential for follow-up strategies and benefiting from Anna's other abilities that capitalize on basic attacks. Her strong heart allows her to push through any obstacle. This attack is considered ranged and single target, making it effective at picking off weakened foes or focusing fire on more resilient enemies.

abilities.name: Frozen Heart Resilience
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Anna's unwavering spirit grants her increased resilience. Whenever Anna takes damage exceeding 10% of her Max HP from a single source, she gains a stack of 'Resolve'. Each stack of Resolve increases her Defense by 5% and her Attack by 3%, stacking up to 5 times. These stacks last for 8 seconds. Additionally, when 'True Love's Resolve' activates, the duration of Resolve stacks is refreshed. This passive encourages Anna to engage in sustained combat, rewarding her for enduring heavy blows and converting that endurance into offensive power.
abilities.flavorQuote: I'm not giving up! I'm here until we fix this!

abilities.name: Arendelle's Stand
abilities.description: Anna steels herself, charging forward a short distance and slamming her shield into the ground. Enemies within a cone-shaped area in front of her are knocked back and dealt X physical damage, with X scaling off of her current Defense stat (15% of current defense). If 'True Love's Resolve' is active when this ability is used, the knockback distance is doubled. This ability is crucial for disrupting enemy formations and creating space for her allies. The damage is not the primary focus; it's all about battlefield control.
abilities.flavorQuote: Arendelle will not fall while I stand!

abilities.name: Unwavering Devotion
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Slightly reduced peak shield potency to balance against True Damage reflection.
(Patch) Emphasized support role; shield scales more effectively with ally HP, slightly reduced damage redirection to self.
abilities.description: Anna leaps forth with boundless optimism to safeguard an allied hero, enveloping them in a shimmering barrier of pure, selfless affection. This potent shield absorbs a significant amount of incoming damage, specifically calculated as 20% of Anna's maximum health plus an additional 5% of the targeted ally's maximum health, ensuring resilience against substantial threats. However, Anna's dedication doesn't come without sacrifice; 30% of the total damage prevented by the shield is then redirected back onto Anna, manifesting as delayed damage dealt over a duration of 3 seconds, testing her resolve. Should Anna's 'True Love's Resolve' ability be active at the moment of casting 'Unwavering Devotion', the shield resonates with enhanced protective energies; it gains the unique property of reflecting 10% of the absorbed damage directly back to the attacker as True Damage, an unmitigated counterstrike that further discourages assaults on her cherished ally. The shield will be applied before any incoming damage is calculated, protecting the ally from immediate harm, and the reflected True Damage bypasses armor and resistances, guaranteeing a response that cannot be easily ignored.

abilities.name: Unwavering Determination
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~38%).
abilities.description: Anna channels her inner strength, granting herself increased tenacity and damage reduction for 5 seconds. During this time, Anna gains 50% tenacity, reducing the duration of incoming crowd control effects, and also reduces all incoming damage by 25%. If 'True Love's Resolve' is triggered during this period, the damage reduction is increased to 40% for the remaining duration. This ability significantly enhances Anna's survivability, making her a formidable force in team fights and prolonged engagements.
abilities.flavorQuote: I know what I have to do. And I'm going to do it.

abilities.name: For Arendelle!
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Anna unleashes her ultimate protective ability, inspiring nearby allies with her courage. For 8 seconds, all allies within a large radius around Anna gain 15% increased attack speed and 20% lifesteal. In addition, Anna activates 'True Love's Resolve' at maximum strength, gaining a powerful shield equal to 30% of her Max HP and reflecting 40% of incoming damage back to attackers as magic damage. This ability turns Anna into a bastion of support, enhancing her team's offensive capabilities while ensuring her own survival.
abilities.flavorQuote: We stand together! For Arendelle!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Anna synergizes well with high-damage carries who benefit from increased attack speed and lifesteal. Her ability to disrupt enemy formations and protect allies makes her a valuable asset in team fights. She also pairs well with healers who can sustain her health while she absorbs damage.
character_v1.tierSummary: Anna is promoted to C+ for her tankiness, shield abilities, and damage scaling. Synergies with Def buffing are high.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Anna's kit revolves around absorbing damage and converting it into both offensive and defensive buffs. 'Frozen Heart Resilience' rewards her for taking hits, while 'True Love's Resolve' mitigates damage and reflects it back. 'Arendelle's Stand' disrupts enemy formations, and 'Sisterly Protection' helps keep allies alive. 'Unwavering Determination' provides crucial survivability, and 'For Arendelle!' amplifies her team's offensive power.

chapters.title: Frozen Bonds
chapters.mission: Complete a training course where Anna must protect Elsa from waves of ice constructs using her shields and resilience.
chapters.summary: Anna confides in Elsa about her struggles with power control. Elsa guides her through meditation and training exercises.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Anna seeks guidance from Elsa to better understand and control her powers after a near-disaster. She learns to channel her sisterly bond for strength.

character_v1.name: Olaf

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Wind.

abilities.name: Reassemble!
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~7% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Whenever Olaf's HP drops below 30%, he disassembles, becoming invulnerable for 3 seconds. During this time, his individual snowballs roll around, dealing 20 (+5% of Olaf's Max HP) true damage to enemies they collide with. After 3 seconds, Olaf reassembles at his initial location, healing for 10% of his Max HP and gaining 10 stacks of Snowdrift. This ability has a 45-second cooldown. If an enemy steps on one of Olaf's snowballs during the disassembly phase, they are slowed by 30% for 2 seconds. The invulnerability effect prevents any damage or crowd control from affecting Olaf, ensuring he has a chance to escape or reposition.
abilities.flavorQuote: I'm okay! I'm reassembling!

abilities.name: Snowball Barrage
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~18%).
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~15% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Olaf throws three snowballs in a cone in front of him. Each snowball deals 60 (+30% of Olaf's magic atk) magic damage and applies a stack of 'Frostbite' to enemies hit. Enemies with 3 stacks of Frostbite are stunned for 1 second. Consumes 5 stacks of Snowdrift to increase the size of the cone by 50% and make the snowballs pierce through enemies, affecting all targets in their path. The stun duration does not stack. This ability has a 8 second cooldown. The cone's initial angle is 45 degrees, which widens to 67.5 degrees when Snowdrift is consumed. If no enemies are hit, Olaf gains 2 stacks of Snowdrift.
abilities.flavorQuote: Have a snowball!

abilities.name: Warm Hug
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~8% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Olaf rushes to an allied champion, granting them a shield that absorbs 100 (+40% of Olaf's Def) damage for 4 seconds. Olaf also gains 5 stacks of Snowdrift. If the shield breaks before its duration ends, Olaf gains an additional 3 stacks of Snowdrift. This ability has a 12-second cooldown. The shield scales with Olaf's defense, encouraging tankier builds. If the targeted ally is at full health, Olaf instead cleanses a single debuff from them before applying the shield. The rush has a medium range, allowing Olaf to quickly assist allies in need.
abilities.flavorQuote: I love warm hugs!

abilities.name: Summer Craze
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Olaf becomes obsessed with summer, creating a small, localized heatwave around himself for 6 seconds. During this time, enemies within a 300-unit radius take 30 (+15% of Olaf's magic atk) magic damage per second and have their healing reduced by 40%. Olaf loses 3% of his max HP per second while this ability is active. Consumes 15 stacks of Snowdrift to increase the damage by 50% and the radius by 50% for the duration. The healing reduction makes enemies much more susceptible to damage, encouraging your team to attack during this window.
abilities.flavorQuote: I'm gonna tell him!

abilities.name: Eternal Optimist
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~36%).
abilities.description: Olaf channels his unwavering optimism, granting himself and nearby allies within a 500-unit radius immunity to crowd control effects for 5 seconds and a 20% increase to their movement speed. Additionally, Olaf gains 2 stacks of Snowdrift per second during this time. After the duration ends, Olaf releases a wave of frost, slowing enemies within the same radius by 50% for 2 seconds. This ability has a 90-second cooldown. This ability allows for decisive engages or disengages, providing a significant advantage in team fights and allowing your team to position aggressively.
abilities.flavorQuote: Hang on, guys! Everything's gonna be alright!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Olaf works well with aggressive teams that can capitalize on his crowd control immunity and engage potential. He provides shields and disruption, enabling allies to dive into fights and secure objectives.
character_v1.tierSummary: Olaf is adjusted to E. He has survivability, but his damage and control are unreliable. KPS lowered significantly to reflect inconsistent performance. He gets a minor bump for tank synergy.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Olaf's kit revolves around accumulating and spending Snowdrift stacks. The passive and Warm Hug provide ways to generate stacks, while Snowball Barrage and Summer Craze consume them for enhanced effects. Eternal Optimist offers utility and helps generate more stacks.

chapters.title: The Heart of Snow
chapters.mission: Navigate a hazardous ice cave, using Olaf's Snowdrifts to create safe paths and protect Kristoff from environmental hazards.
chapters.summary: Olaf and Kristoff journey to find the legendary 'Heart of Snow', learning about the importance of sadness in appreciating happiness.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Olaf, feeling lonely, seeks to understand sadness with Kristoff's help. He learns to appreciate the balance of emotions and uses Snowdrifts strategically.

character_v1.name: Hans

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~41%).
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Light.

abilities.name: Charming Presence
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~14%).
abilities.description: Hans passively generates 'Charm' over time. The rate of Charm generation increases slightly for each enemy hero within a medium radius. Additionally, when an enemy hero is afflicted by any crowd control effect applied by Hans (such as Stun, Taunt, or Silence), he gains a burst of Charm. This passive encourages Hans to stay in the thick of the fight, strategically positioning himself to maximize the generation of Charm. The generated Charm is crucial for enhancing his other abilities and controlling the battlefield effectively.
abilities.flavorQuote: A smile and a kind word can open any door.

abilities.name: Love is an Open Door
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~18%).
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~17%).
abilities.description: Hans throws a charmed handkerchief in a line, dealing a small amount of magic damage to the first enemy hit and applying 'Enchantment'. Enchanted enemies have their damage output slightly reduced and are subtly drawn towards Hans over the next few seconds. Additionally, this ability generates a small amount of 'Charm' for Hans. If Hans has accumulated a substantial amount of 'Charm', he can expend it upon casting this ability to amplify its effects, increasing the damage and duration of the Enchantment, making enemies even more susceptible to his manipulation and drawing them more forcefully to his side. This ability creates opportunities for strategic positioning and enemy misdirection.
abilities.flavorQuote: I promise I'll never shut you out.

abilities.name: Arendelle's Savior
abilities.description: Hans dashes a short distance, leaving behind an illusory image of himself at his original location. If an enemy attacks the illusion, it shatters, dealing a small amount of magic damage to that enemy and briefly taunting them to attack the nearest allied hero instead of Hans for a few seconds. This ability also grants Hans a small burst of speed for a short duration after the dash. 'Charm' can be expended to enhance the illusion, making it appear more realistic and last longer, further deceiving enemies and increasing the duration of the taunt if the illusion is attacked. The dash grants Hans increased mobility and escape potential.
abilities.flavorQuote: I'm only trying to protect this kingdom!

abilities.name: Betrayal's Kiss
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~18% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Hans targets an enemy, channeling briefly before inflicting a 'Frozen Heart' debuff that deals damage over time based on Hans' magic attack. If Hans has a significant amount of 'Charm' stored, he can expend it to intensify the Frozen Heart effect, causing the targeted enemy to also deal reduced damage to their allies with their basic attacks, effectively turning them into a temporary source of harm for their own team. This amplified effect lasts for a duration, creating strategic opportunities to disrupt enemy formations and damage output. This ability allows Hans to single out key targets and sow chaos within the enemy ranks by weaponizing their attacks against themselves.
abilities.flavorQuote: Oh Anna, if only there was someone who loved you...

abilities.name: King of Arendelle
abilities.description: Hans empowers himself, dramatically increasing his speed, magic attack, and 'Charm' generation rate for a moderate duration. During this time, his basic attacks also apply a stacking debuff called 'Desperation' to enemies. Each stack of Desperation increases the damage that the affected enemy takes from all sources. Upon expiry of King of Arendelle, or if Hans chooses to end the effect early, all stacks of Desperation detonate, dealing a burst of true damage to the affected enemies based on the number of stacks. This ability empowers Hans to become a potent threat, increasing his damage output and control, leading to a devastating finishing blow.
abilities.flavorQuote: I've been searching my whole life to find my own place!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Hans synergizes well with damage dealers who can capitalize on his crowd control and debuffs. Allies that benefit from enemies being taunted or taking increased damage will thrive alongside him. He also provides utility for tanky frontlines that can benefit from enemies being subtly manipulated or temporarily turned against each other.
character_v1.tierSummary: Hans is assigned to C- due to his Charm application and scaling magic attack. The taunt ability makes him a hybrid support tank. KPS reflects that role.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Hans's abilities synergize by allowing him to generate and expend 'Charm' effectively. Charming Presence allows constant Charm generation. This Charm is used in Love is an Open Door and Arendelle's Savior to amplify their effects. Betrayal's Kiss serves as a powerful tool when Charm is maximized, and King of Arendelle further boosts Charm generation, creating a cycle of control and damage amplification.

chapters.title: False Promises
chapters.mission: Participate in a series of 'charity events' organized by Hans, exposing his corrupt practices and turning the townsfolk against him.
chapters.summary: Hans tries to convince Kristoff that Arendelle needs new leadership, subtly undermining Anna and Elsa. Kristoff sees through his lies.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Hans attempts to manipulate Kristoff by feigning camaraderie. He ultimately underestimates Kristoff's loyalty and faces the consequences.

character_v1.name: Teddie

abilities.name: Teddie Smack
upgrades: Lv10: Increases Attack scaling to 30%
Lv50: Teddie's Warmth also grants 5% increased defense against fire-based attacks.
Lv100: Base damage increased by 20; Teddie's Warmth now heals the lowest-health ally for 5% of their maximum health over the effect's duration.
abilities.description: Teddie winds up for a mighty, albeit goofy, smack with his giant bear paw, launching a fiery burst towards a single enemy. This attack deals physical damage with a distinct fiery afterburn, initially dealing a base damage of 30 plus an additional amount scaling with 20% of Teddie's Attack stat. Upon impact, the target is inflicted with 'Teddie's Warmth', a unique status effect that causes them to receive 5% increased healing from all sources for 4 seconds. However, due to balance adjustments, the peak potency of the initial damage has been reduced by approximately 12%, and the rate at which the damage scales with Attack increases slightly over time. This adjustment also emphasizes Teddie's role as a support, shifting the focus of this ability from pure damage to creating opportunities for allies to keep the affected target alive. The Warmth also interacts with allies who apply further fire-based status effects, extending the healing received from it by one extra second, to a total of 5 seconds.

abilities.name: Kuma Comfort
abilities.description: Teddie wraps himself in a comforting aura, granting a shield to himself and the ally with the lowest health for 4 seconds. The shield absorbs up to X damage, scaling with Teddie's magic attack. Additionally, Kuma Comfort cleanses one random negative status effect from each shielded target. If Teddie has an 'Item Box' item available, consuming a 'Honey' item will increase the shield amount by 50%, while consuming a 'Cure Water' item will extend the shield duration by 2 seconds. Successfully shielding an ally also grants them a 15% increase to their movement speed for the duration of the shield. This ability has a 12-second cooldown.
abilities.flavorQuote: Don't worry, I'll make it all better with a big bear hug!

abilities.name: Teddie Toss
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~15%).
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~17% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Teddie flings a random item from his 'Item Box' at the targeted enemy. The effect of the thrown item varies: 'Confetti Bomb' deals moderate magic damage in a small area and applies a 30% slow for 2 seconds; 'Love Letter' charms the enemy for 1.5 seconds, forcing them to attack their allies; 'Mystery Food X' deals low damage and has a 50% chance to inflict poison, burn, or freeze for 3 seconds. If Teddie has no item in his 'Item Box', he throws a small claw swipe that deals minimal physical damage. The type of item thrown cannot be chosen. This ability has a 8-second cooldown, reduced by 1 second for each 100 points of luck.
abilities.flavorQuote: Catch this! It's... uh... surprise!

abilities.name: Beary Good Reflexes
abilities.description: Every 10 seconds, Teddie generates a random item into his 'Item Box'. This item can be a 'Honey' (provides bonus healing), 'Cure Water' (provides status ailment cleanse), 'Confetti Bomb' (deals AoE damage and slows), 'Love Letter' (charms enemies), or 'Mystery Food X' (deals damage and inflicts random status ailments). Teddie can store up to a maximum of 2 items in his 'Item Box' at any given time. If the 'Item Box' is full, the oldest item is discarded. Additionally, whenever Teddie dodges an attack, the cooldown of his 'Teddie Toss' ability is reduced by 1 second.
abilities.flavorQuote: I'm quick as a bear! ...Wait, is that a thing?

abilities.name: Midnight Snack
abilities.description: Teddie consumes an item from his 'Item Box' to heal himself and nearby allies. If Teddie consumes a 'Honey' item, he heals himself for X HP and allies within a 400 unit radius for half that amount, scaling with his magic attack. If Teddie consumes a 'Cure Water' item, he removes all negative status effects from himself and grants allies within the same radius immunity to all status effects for 3 seconds. If the Item Box is empty, Teddie eats a consolation lollipop, healing himself for a very small amount. This ability has a 15-second cooldown, reduced by 0.5 second for each 100 points of luck. Consuming a 'Confetti Bomb', 'Love Letter' or 'Mystery Food X' has no healing effect.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time for a beary delicious snack! Nom nom nom!

abilities.name: Kamui-Moshiri's Grand Finale
abilities.description: Teddie summons his ultimate Persona, Kamui-Moshiri, who unleashes a powerful barrage of ice and wind attacks across a wide area. For 8 seconds, enemies within a large radius take X magic damage per second. During this time, Teddie gains increased movement speed and evasion, allowing him to reposition and avoid damage. After the initial barrage, Kamui-Moshiri unleashes a final, devastating blizzard that deals massive magic damage to all enemies caught within the area. This final blast also has a 30% chance to freeze enemies for 2 seconds. This ability has a long 120-second cooldown, reduced by 1 second for each 100 points of luck. Also, this ultimate consumes ALL items in the 'Item Box', increasing the overall magic damage done by 10% per item consumed.
abilities.flavorQuote: It's showtime! Prepare for Kamui-Moshiri's Grand Finale!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Teddie provides valuable support to his team through healing, shielding, and crowd control. His ability to cleanse status effects and buff allies with movement speed makes him a versatile addition to any team composition. His ultimate, 'Kamui-Moshiri's Grand Finale', offers significant AoE damage and crowd control potential, making him a powerful asset in team fights.
character_v1.tierSummary: Teddie relegated to F- due to unreliable Luck scaling and middling stats. Despite some support utility, his lack of impact is severe. KPS reflects his position.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Teddie's kit revolves around managing his Item Box and utilizing items strategically. 'Beary Good Reflexes' keeps his Item Box stocked, while 'Teddie Toss' and 'Midnight Snack' allow him to use those items for offense and support, respectively. 'Kuma Comfort' benefits from specific items for enhanced shielding and cleansing.

chapters.title: Stage Fright Scramble
chapters.mission: Complete a series of mini-games designed to improve Rise's confidence, utilizing Teddie's randomized abilities to overcome challenges.
chapters.summary: Teddie helps Rise prepare for a performance by creating a series of wacky minigames and confidence-boosting exercises.
chapters.resonanceBuff: +30% Luck Scaling on Healing, +15% Cleanse Effectiveness.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Teddie tries to help Rise overcome stage fright. He creates a chaotic, fun environment to help her relax and embrace her true self.

character_v1.name: Freya

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Wind.

abilities.name: Dragon's Lineage (Signature Passive)
abilities.description: Freya passively generates 1 Dragon Spirit every 2 seconds, up to a maximum of 5. Additionally, successfully landing a basic attack grants 1 Dragon Spirit. When Freya takes damage exceeding 10% of her maximum health, she gains 2 Dragon Spirit. Consuming Dragon Spirit enhances Freya's abilities, granting bonus effects or increased potency. Finally, after using an ability that consumes Dragon Spirit, Freya's next basic attack within 5 seconds deals an additional 20% of her attack as true damage, reflecting the focused energy of her Dragon Knight training. This effect cannot occur more than once every 3 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: The blood of dragons flows through me, fueling my spirit and steeling my resolve.

abilities.name: Aerial Assault
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~25%).
abilities.description: Freya leaps into the air, becoming untargetable for 1.5 seconds. Upon landing, she strikes the target area, dealing 70% of her attack as physical damage to all enemies within a 3-meter radius. Consuming 2 Dragon Spirit enhances this ability: The damage is increased to 110% of her attack, and Freya also applies a 20% slow to enemies hit for 2 seconds. If Freya has 5 Dragon Spirit, consuming all 5 grants an additional effect: she stuns enemies hit for 0.75 seconds upon landing, ensuring a brief window for follow-up attacks. The cooldown of Aerial Assault is 12 seconds, reduced by 1 second for each enemy hero hit (up to a maximum reduction of 4 seconds).
abilities.flavorQuote: From the heavens, justice descends!

abilities.name: Reversal
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~14% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Freya prepares to counter incoming attacks for 1 second. If Freya is hit by a physical attack during this time, she immediately retaliates, dealing 90% of her attack as physical damage back to the attacker and reducing their attack damage by 15% for 3 seconds. If Freya consumes 2 Dragon Spirit before activating Reversal, the counterattack damage is increased to 130% of her attack, and the attack damage reduction applied to the attacker increases to 30%. If no attack is countered within the 1-second window, Freya recovers 1 Dragon Spirit and the cooldown is reduced by 4 seconds. Cooldown: 15 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: You will find my resolve unyielding!

abilities.name: Dragon Breath
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~26%).
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~7% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Freya channels her inner dragon, unleashing a cone-shaped blast of wind in front of her, dealing 60% of her magic attack as magic damage to all enemies in the area. Enemies hit are also knocked back a short distance. If Freya consumes 3 Dragon Spirit before using Dragon Breath, the range and width of the cone are increased by 30%, and enemies are afflicted with 'Wind Vulnerability' for 4 seconds, increasing damage taken from all sources by 10%. Cooldown: 10 seconds. This ability benefits more from Magic attack stats than physical attack.
abilities.flavorQuote: Feel the wrath of the storm!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Freya excels in teams that can capitalize on her crowd control from Jump and Dragon Breath. Allies that benefit from increased damage output synergize well with her Wind Vulnerability debuff, and her Reversal ability can protect her from burst damage, allowing her to frontline effectively.
character_v1.tierSummary: Freya moved to A for high HP and passive True Damage. Her Dragon Spirit mechanics provide scaling and sustain. Reversal utility gives her defense. Very well-rounded, high mechanical uptime.

tips: Consistently land basic attacks to generate Dragon Spirit and proc the true damage effect. Don't waste the true damage proc on tanks.
Prioritize Aerial Assault when you have 5 Dragon Spirit for the stun. It's your best way to set up kills, but also your most Spirit-hungry move.
Use Reversal preemptively to punish predictable melee attacks. The threat of a counter can deter aggressive enemies and disrupt their combos.
strategyData.overview: Freya is a bruiser who revolves around Dragon Spirit, a resource that empowers her abilities. She excels in short bursts of damage and control, using her mobility and counter to disrupt enemies. However, she struggles with sustained damage output and can be vulnerable when her Dragon Spirit is depleted. Your goal is to weave basic attacks between abilities to maintain Dragon Spirit and maximize your empowered skill usage.
strategyData.counterplay: Bait out Reversal, then punish her during its cooldown. Crowd control effects like silences and stuns can interrupt her ability usage and resource generation. Kite her to avoid her burst damage and control, especially when she has full Dragon Spirit.

teamLineups.note: Combines Freya's slow and stun with Hopper's stun and knockback to create a strong disruption and control comp.
teamLineups.label: Dragon Spirit CC Chain

teamLineups.note: Freya's primary element is Wind so this comp is built around Wind, with each character having a Wind attack as their primary basic atk.
teamLineups.label: Wind Damage Amplifier

teamLineups.note: This comp is built around characters that can deal true damage, which Freya can scale off of with her passive abilities.
teamLineups.label: Dragon Spirit True Damage

character_v1.internalSynergy: Freya's kit is designed around managing Dragon Spirit to enhance her core abilities. Jump provides mobility and damage, Reversal offers defensive counterplay, and Dragon Breath adds ranged disruption. Continuous Jump allows for sustained damage output and self-healing.

chapters.title: Dragon's Ascension
chapters.mission: Complete a series of rigorous training exercises alongside Valkyrie, focusing on mastering Dragon Spirit management and executing powerful combos.
chapters.summary: Freya seeks Valkyrie's guidance to hone her Dragon Spirit. They spar and meditate in a secluded mountain retreat.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Freya trains with Valkyrie to master her Dragon Spirit and unlock her full potential. She learns to channel her lineage for unparalleled power.

character_v1.name: Duke of Weselton

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Ice.

abilities.name: Arrogant Posturing
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Whenever an enemy enters a Trade Route controlled by the Duke of Weselton, they suffer a stackable 3% reduction to their attack damage, stacking up to 15%. In addition, if the Duke remains within any Trade Route for at least 5 seconds, he gains a shield equal to 5% of his maximum HP, which refreshes every second while inside the zone. This shield is reduced by 50% if the Duke is attacked. This passive reflects the Duke's self-importance and his reliance on controlled spaces for protection and influence, hindering those who dare to trespass on his territories.
abilities.flavorQuote: My presence alone is enough to dishearten the rabble!

abilities.name: Scheming Sanction
upgrades: (Bugfix) Addressed an issue where the Sanction's boundary would occasionally flicker erratically.
(Patch) Rebalanced for tactical depth: now, the speed boost allies receive degrades linearly over the final 2 seconds of the effect, emphasizing strategic timing.
abilities.description: The Duke, ever the opportunist, designates a lucrative, though perhaps questionably legal, business venture in a targeted area with a radius of 300 units. This 'Scheming Sanction' lasts for 8 seconds. Allies, swayed by the promise of profit, gain a 10% increase to their movement speed within the area. Conversely, enemies find themselves disadvantaged; their incoming healing reduced by 20%, representing the Duke's interference in their recovery and supplies. Should the Duke already be standing amidst the riches of an existing Scheming Sanction when this ability is cast, he leverages his existing infrastructure. The duration of the current Sanction is extended by 3 seconds, but this extension is capped at a maximum duration of 15 seconds. This ensures that even the Duke's most ambitious schemes are not without limit, preventing endless exploitation and maintaining a semblance of balance, however fragile. The area shimmers with the illusion of wealth, a subtle visual cue of the Duke's pervasive influence and the opportunities and drawbacks it presents.

abilities.name: Icy Restraint
abilities.description: The Duke conjures a patch of slippery ice within a target Trade Route, rooting enemies who step onto it. This patch has a radius of 150 units and lasts for 5 seconds. Enemies who enter the icy patch are rooted for 1.25 seconds and suffer 40 (+20% Magic Attack) magic damage. If no Trade Route exists, he places a small patch of ice centered on himself with a 100 unit radius lasting only 2 seconds. This icy terrain embodies the Duke's treacherous nature, ensnaring his foes in a trap of his own making. The root effect has a 0.5 second delay upon entry. Multiple ice patches can be active, but overlapping patches do not stack root durations.
abilities.flavorQuote: You'll find progress here... *difficult*.

abilities.name: Accusatory Outburst
abilities.description: The Duke launches a shrill accusation in a cone-shaped area in front of him, dealing 70 (+50% Magic Attack) magic damage. Enemies hit by this ability are silenced for 1.5 seconds. If the targeted enemies are within a Trade Route, the silence duration is increased to 2.5 seconds, and they also take an additional 30 (+15% Magic Attack) magic damage. This ability demonstrates the Duke's tendency to quickly condemn others based on his own fears and prejudices, amplified within his controlled territories. The cone has a range of 400 units and a width of 60 degrees.
abilities.flavorQuote: Sorcery! I say, sorcery! Seize them!

character_v1.teamSynergy: The Duke excels in teams that can capitalize on area control and sustained engagements. He pairs well with durable front-line characters who can occupy the Trade Routes, benefiting from the movement speed buff and armor/magic resist reduction. He also supports damage dealers who can take advantage of the attack and magic attack boosts, amplified lifesteal and movement debuffs within the zones.
character_v1.tierSummary: Duke of Weselton elevated to D+ due to the utility of his Trade Route mechanic and AoE debuffs. His stats are skewed but viable enough for moderate disruption. Solid scaling.
appearanceTags: Large round glasses and gray toupee
character_v1.internalSynergy: The Duke's abilities are designed to synergize around his Trade Routes, providing buffs to allies and debuffs to enemies within these zones. 'Arrogant Posturing' rewards him for staying in these areas, while 'Exploitative Edict' extends their duration. 'Defensive Formation' provides protection within these zones, and 'Accusatory Outburst' gains increased crowd control. 'Economic Domination' serves as an ultimate area control ability, enhancing all Trade Routes to maximize the benefits for allies and penalties for enemies.

chapters.title: Crustacean Calamity
chapters.mission: Engage in a series of business negotiations with Mr. Krabs, attempting to secure favorable trade deals while preventing Krabs from sabotaging Arendelle's economy.
chapters.summary: The Duke attempts to form a trade alliance with Mr. Krabs, hoping to exploit his business expertise for Arendelle's economic gain. Krabs sees through his schemes.

friendshipCampaign.overview: The Duke tries to exploit Mr. Krabs' business acumen. He finds himself outmaneuvered and his trade routes crumble under Krabs' shrewdness.

character_v1.name: Gatomon

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Electric.

abilities.name: Lightning Paw
abilities.description: Gatomon dashes a short distance, slashing at the first enemy hit with her energized claws, dealing 70 + (0.6 * Attack Damage) physical damage. If this ability hits an enemy, Gatomon gains one stack of Holy Ring Resonance. Additionally, if Gatomon has 5 or more Holy Ring Resonance stacks, the enemy hit is also slowed by 20% for 1.5 seconds. The dash range is slightly increased with each Holy Ring Resonance stack (up to 5 stacks). The cooldown of Lightning Paw is reduced by 0.5 seconds per stack of Holy Ring Resonance, down to a minimum of 2 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Feel the might of my claws!

abilities.name: Cat's Eye Hypnotism
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Gatomon focuses her gaze on a target enemy within range, attempting to hypnotize them for 1.25 seconds. If successful, the target is Charmed, forcing them to walk towards Gatomon. The chance of successfully Charming the target is 60% + (5% per Holy Ring Resonance stack), capping at 90%. If the charm is successful, Gatomon also gains a shield absorbing 50 + (0.3 * Attack Damage) damage for 3 seconds. Enemies with tenacity can reduce the duration of the Charm effect. This ability has a base cooldown of 14 seconds, reduced by 1 second for each stack of Holy Ring Resonance.
abilities.flavorQuote: Look into my eyes... you're getting sleepy...

abilities.name: Celestial Barrier
upgrades: (Patch) Role realignment: this ability now emphasizes tank-style interactions.
abilities.description: Gatomon's Holy Ring radiates a soothing, protective aura that empowers nearby allies. All allied champions within a radius of 400 units surrounding Gatomon benefit from a bolstering barrier, gaining 5 bonus armor and 5 bonus magic resistance. Furthermore, for each stack of Holy Ring Resonance that Gatomon possesses, this protective aura intensifies, granting an additional 1 armor and 1 magic resistance to all affected allies. Upon reaching a maximum of 10 Holy Ring Resonance stacks, Gatomon's aura takes on an even more potent quality. Whenever an allied champion within the aura's range suffers crowd control, they receive an immediate burst of protection. This burst provides a temporary shield, absorbing 30 damage plus 20% of Gatomon's maximum health, lasting for 2.5 seconds. This shield effect can only trigger once every 12 seconds per allied champion. The visible manifestation of this aura appears as a radiant, faint golden shimmer enveloping all beneficiaries, a clear sign of Gatomon's unwavering support.

abilities.name: Cat Kick
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~25%).
abilities.description: Gatomon performs a spinning kick, dealing 90 + (0.7 * Attack Damage) physical damage to enemies in a small cone in front of her. Each enemy hit grants Gatomon one stack of Holy Ring Resonance. If Gatomon has 7 or more stacks of Holy Ring Resonance, this ability also applies a knockback effect, pushing enemies a short distance away from Gatomon. The knockback distance increases with the number of Holy Ring Resonance stacks, up to a maximum distance at 10 stacks. The width of the cone also increases slightly with each stack, providing greater area coverage.
abilities.flavorQuote: Take this!

abilities.name: Angewomon's Descent
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Gatomon consumes all 10 stacks of Holy Ring Resonance, Digivolving into Angewomon for 15 seconds. While in Angewomon form, Gatomon gains 50 bonus attack damage, 30 bonus armor and magic resistance, and her basic attacks deal 30 true damage on hit. Additionally, all of her ability cooldowns are reduced by 50%. After the transformation ends, Gatomon returns to her original form and is unable to gain Holy Ring Resonance stacks for 5 seconds. Using this ability grants all allies within a large radius a burst heal of 15% of their maximum health.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time to show you true power!

character_v1.playstyle: Gatomon focuses on accumulating Holy Ring Resonance stacks to empower her abilities, offering both damage and utility, culminating in a temporary transformation into Angewomon for significant burst potential.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Gatomon synergizes well with teams that benefit from sustained damage and utility. Her Holy Ring Aura enhances survivability, while Cat's Eye Hypnotism provides valuable crowd control. Angewomon's Descent offers a powerful burst phase and area heal, making her a strong addition to any team composition.
character_v1.tierSummary: Gatomon's kit has a good mix of support and damage, but it doesn't excel in any one area. The multiple stacking buffs and the transformation ultimate justify moving her up to B tier.
appearanceTags: Long striped tail with Holy Ring
character_v1.internalSynergy: Gatomon's kit revolves around building stacks of Holy Ring Resonance. Lightning Paw and Cat Kick provide reliable stacking, while Cat's Eye Hypnotism benefits from high stacks to ensure a successful charm. The Holy Ring Aura provides passive benefits based on stacks, and Angewomon's Descent consumes all stacks for a powerful transformation.

chapters.title: Celestial Evolution
chapters.mission: Complete a series of trials alongside Angewomon, focusing on channeling Holy Light for powerful strikes and shielding allies from dark forces.
chapters.summary: Gatomon trains with Angewomon in a heavenly realm, learning to harness her Holy Light for devastating attacks and unwavering protection.
chapters.resonanceBuff: +60% Holy Ring Aura Healing, +40% Angewomon's Descent Damage.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Gatomon undergoes intense training with Angewomon to unlock her full potential as a Holy Digimon. She gains immense power and purpose.

character_v1.name: Black Rock Shooter

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Fire.

abilities.name: Rock Cannon Barrage
abilities.description: Black Rock Shooter unleashes a rapid barrage of energy blasts from her Rock Cannon in a cone-shaped area in front of her, dealing damage multiple times over a short duration to enemies caught within. Each blast deals a base damage of X, with a scaling factor of X% of her Attack Damage. If Black Rock Shooter is in her 'Other Self' form, the damage per blast is increased by 30%, and the cone area widens by 20%, allowing for greater coverage but increasing mana cost by 15%. Enemies hit multiple times within the barrage receive a stacking debuff, reducing their movement speed by 5% per hit, up to a maximum of 25%. The final blast in the barrage deals an additional X true damage, ignoring armor and magic resistance, ensuring a finishing blow to weakened targets.
abilities.flavorQuote: Lock and load. Let's paint the battlefield blue.

abilities.name: Black Blade Slash
abilities.description: Black Rock Shooter dashes a short distance, slashing with her Black Blade at the end of the dash. Enemies hit by the slash take X base damage plus X% of her attack damage as physical damage and are marked with 'Severed'. 'Severed' enemies take 10% increased damage from Black Rock Shooter's basic attacks and abilities for 4 seconds. If Black Rock Shooter is in her 'Other Self' form, the dash distance increases by 25%, and the slash inflicts 'Deep Wound', reducing healing received by the target by 40% for the duration of the 'Severed' effect. If the target is already 'Severed', using this ability while in 'Other Self' form will consume the 'Severed' effect and deal an additional burst of true damage equal to X% of the target's missing health, executing low-health enemies.
abilities.flavorQuote: Steel meets flesh. There will be no healing.

abilities.name: Burning Soul (Passive)
abilities.description: Black Rock Shooter gains increased movement speed by X% when near enemy champions who are below 40% health. This bonus is doubled while Black Rock Shooter is in her 'Other Self' form. Additionally, dealing damage to an enemy champion grants Black Rock Shooter a stack of 'Resolve', up to a maximum of 5 stacks. Each stack of Resolve increases Black Rock Shooter's attack damage by 2% and magic attack by 2%, stacking multiplicatively. When Black Rock Shooter transforms into her 'Other Self', all stacks of Resolve are consumed, granting her a temporary shield that absorbs X damage. However, the shield decays rapidly, losing X% of its value every second. After transforming back from 'Other Self', Black Rock Shooter loses all stacks of 'Resolve' and gains a debuff called 'Exhaustion', reducing her movement speed by X% for X seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: My soul burns brighter with every strike.

abilities.name: Other Self Awakening (Ultimate)
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Black Rock Shooter taps into her 'Other Self', transforming for a duration of 12 seconds. While in this form, her Attack Damage and Magic Attack are increased by X%, and her movement speed is increased by X%. However, she takes X damage per second as true damage that cannot be mitigated. Activating this ability grants Black Rock Shooter immunity to crowd control effects for the first 1.5 seconds of the transformation. Upon reverting to her normal form, Black Rock Shooter is 'Weakened', reducing her attack damage and magic attack by 30% and her movement speed by 20% for 5 seconds. If Black Rock Shooter kills an enemy champion while in 'Other Self' form, the duration of the 'Weakened' debuff is reduced by 2 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Embrace the pain! Unleash the other self!

abilities.name: Soul Resonance
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~13% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: When Black Rock Shooter is within X units of an allied champion, she forms a 'Soul Link' with them. This link grants both Black Rock Shooter and the allied champion X% bonus tenacity, up to a maximum of 20%. If the allied champion is below 40% health, Black Rock Shooter gains an additional X% movement speed towards them. While in her 'Other Self' form, the 'Soul Link' effect is amplified, increasing the bonus tenacity to X% (max 40%) and granting Black Rock Shooter a shield that absorbs X damage when she is near the linked ally. If the linked ally dies while Black Rock Shooter is in 'Other Self' form, Black Rock Shooter instantly reverts to her normal form and becomes 'Enraged', gaining X% attack damage and magic attack for X seconds, but also taking increased damage (X%) from all sources.
abilities.flavorQuote: We fight together. Our souls resonate as one.

character_v1.teamSynergy: Black Rock Shooter benefits from allies who can provide crowd control or healing to mitigate the self-damage from 'Other Self' form. She excels at diving into the enemy backline to eliminate high-priority targets, making her a valuable asset in team fights. Synergizes well with champions who can buff damage or provide shields. Soul Resonance encourages coordinated play, rewarding Black Rock Shooter for staying close to allies.
character_v1.tierSummary: Black Rock Shooter's kit is a mixed bag of true damage and debuffs, but it lacks cohesive synergy and survivability. While her stats are skewed towards speed, her overall impact is limited, justifying a promotion to D+.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Black Rock Shooter's kit revolves around maximizing the effectiveness of her 'Other Self' transformation. The passive grants her a shield upon transforming and increased movement speed, encouraging her to aggressively seek out kills. Black Blade Slash provides mobility and an execute, which synergizes with her ultimate. Rock Cannon Barrage delivers consistent damage, especially potent in 'Other Self' form.

chapters.title: Resonant Souls
chapters.mission: Protect Madoka from waves of Grief Seeds, utilizing Black Rock Shooter's Burning Soul and Soul Resonance to overcome the darkness.
chapters.summary: Black Rock Shooter and Madoka connect on a spiritual level, understanding each other's struggles and finding strength in their shared experiences.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Black Rock Shooter forms a deep connection with Madoka Kaname, amplifying her Soul Resonance and granting her unmatched power and resolve.

character_v1.name: Ada Wong

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Fire.

abilities.name: Intel Scan
abilities.description: Ada deploys a short-range scanner in a cone-shaped area in front of her, revealing hidden enemies and identifying their weaknesses. The scan lasts for 5 seconds. Enemies revealed by Intel Scan have a stack of 'Exposed' applied for 8 seconds. Each stack of exposed increases damage taken from Ada's abilities by 5%, up to a maximum of 3 stacks. Additionally, each enemy scanned grants Ada 15 'Intel', up to a maximum of 100 'Intel'. Intel decays by 5 per second when above 50, encouraging active use of her abilities. Consumes 30 mana. Cooldown: 12 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Knowledge is power, and I intend to wield it.

abilities.name: Wire Trap
abilities.description: Ada sets a tripwire at a target location that remains invisible until triggered by an enemy. When triggered, the trap immobilizes the enemy for 1.5 seconds and deals 80 (+40% magic atk) magic damage over time for 3 seconds. If Ada has at least 50 'Intel', she can consume 50 Intel to enhance the trap. The enhanced trap increases the immobilization duration to 2.5 seconds and applies 'Vulnerable,' increasing damage taken from all sources by 10% for 5 seconds. Multiple traps can be active at once, up to a maximum of 3. Cooldown: 15 seconds. Consumes 40 mana.
abilities.flavorQuote: A little surprise for the unwary.

abilities.name: Explosive Bolt
abilities.description: Ada fires a crossbow bolt that detonates upon impact with an enemy or at the end of its trajectory, dealing 120 (+60% magic atk) magic damage to enemies in a small area. If the target is 'Exposed', the damage is increased by X% per stack. Additionally, if Ada has at least 30 'Intel', she can consume 30 Intel to add a knockback effect, pushing enemies away from the center of the explosion. The knockback distance scales with the number of 'Exposed' stacks on the target. Cooldown: 8 seconds. Consumes 50 mana.
abilities.flavorQuote: Let's see how you handle a little firepower.

abilities.name: Spycraft Evasion
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~26%).
abilities.description: Ada gains 10% increased evasion. Additionally, whenever Ada successfully evades an attack, she gains 20 'Intel' and increases her movement speed by 15% for 3 seconds. This effect can only occur once every 5 seconds. If Ada reaches maximum 'Intel' (100) through this passive, she also gains a shield that absorbs 50 (+20% max hp) damage for 4 seconds. This shield is consumed immediately upon taking damage and does not stack with other shields.
abilities.flavorQuote: Sometimes, the best offense is simply not being there.

abilities.name: Black Market Arsenal
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~10% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Ada calls in a drone that drops a supply crate at her location. The crate contains one of three items, chosen randomly: (1) A powerful sniper rifle that deals 200 (+80% atk) physical damage and applies 'Marked' for 5 seconds, increasing critical hit chance against the target by 15%. (2) A cluster grenade that deals 150 (+70% magic atk) magic damage in multiple smaller explosions over 2 seconds. (3) A temporary cloak that grants Ada invisibility for 5 seconds, removing all debuffs and granting her 30% increased movement speed. The supply crate takes 3 seconds to arrive. Ada gains 25 Intel when the drone deploys. Cooldown: 90 seconds. Consumes 100 mana.
abilities.flavorQuote: I always come prepared.

character_v1.teamSynergy: Ada synergizes well with teams that can capitalize on her debuffs and control. Allies who deal high burst damage benefit from the 'Exposed' and 'Vulnerable' debuffs, while those who thrive in coordinated engagements appreciate the zone control provided by Wire Trap and Explosive Bolt. Her ability to scout with Intel Scan also benefits stealth-based allies.
character_v1.tierSummary: Ada Wong's kit revolves around stealth and utility, but her low HP and reliance on Intel make her vulnerable. Her damage output is also lacking, pushing her down to E tier.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Ada's kit revolves around gaining and utilizing Intel to enhance her gadgets. Intel Scan provides the initial Intel and applies Exposed, enabling higher damage output with Explosive Bolt. Wire Trap controls enemy movement, creating opportunities for further exploitation. Spycraft Evasion ensures survivability and further Intel generation.

chapters.title: The Assignment
chapters.mission: Collect 10 Intel tokens while avoiding Leon's attacks.
chapters.summary: Ada needs to secure a vial of the T-Virus, but is constantly being harassed by Leon.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Ada Wong needs to acquire more intel to help her organization.

character_v1.name: Punch and Judy

abilities.name: Cudgel Concussion
upgrades: Lv10: Damage scaling increased by a moderate amount.
Lv50: Grants a chance to apply 'Staggered' for 2 seconds.
Lv100: Base damage dramatically increases, and successful hits slightly reduce the cooldown of Punch's other abilities.
abilities.description: Mr. Punch winds up his trusty cudgel, channeling his chaotic energy into a devastating single strike against a target directly in front of him. This is a purely physical attack that deals base damage scaling linearly with Punch's Attack stat, amplified by 50% of Judy's Magic Attack. Upon impact, the sheer force of the blow can inflict 'Staggered' if the target is not already affected by 'Wanted.' A staggered target is slowed by 30% and has their evasion reduced by 20% for 2 seconds. However, if the target is already under the effects of 'Wanted' by Judy, the cudgel strike deals 30% more damage and extends the duration of 'Wanted' by 1 second. Mr. Punch punctuates this display with a hearty 'That's the way to do it!', reveling in the confusion and pain he inflicts.

abilities.name: Puppet Pandemonium
upgrades: (Bugfix) Corrected issues regarding puppet targeting and pathing logic.
(Patch) Emphasized area denial by increasing puppet health and AoE range.
abilities.description: Punch, the master puppeteer, throws out three miniature Punch puppets onto the battlefield. Each puppet has 30% of Punch’s maximum health and deals 20% of his attack as physical damage per attack. The puppets last for 10 seconds and each puppet prioritize different targeting. The first puppet targets the enemy with the lowest health. The second puppet targets the enemy with the highest attack. The third puppet targets a random enemy. The puppets deal damage in a small AoE around them. However, the puppets' individual attack rate is reduced by 30% against targets affected by 'Wanted.' This reduction reflects the puppets' hesitant engagement with Judy's chosen targets, creating a tactical choice between focusing fire and spreading chaos.

abilities.name: Judy's Jury
abilities.description: Judy points an accusing finger at the enemy with the highest Attack, declaring them 'Wanted'. For 7 seconds, the 'Wanted' target suffers a 25% reduction in their Magic Attack, representing Judy's psychological warfare. This 'Wanted' debuff also enhances the effects of Punch's other abilities, allowing for a strategic synergy between the duo. Judy’s keen eye for trouble and her skill at singling out adversaries makes her an invaluable asset in controlling the flow of battle. The initial application of 'Wanted' deals magic damage to the target equal to 30% of Judy's magic attack.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Oh my stars! This situation is just dreadful!"

abilities.name: Slapstick Symphony
abilities.description: Each time Punch lands a successful 'Cudgel Concussion' or Judy applies 'Wanted,' the target accumulates 'Slapstick' stacks, up to a maximum of 5 stacks. Each stack of 'Slapstick' increases the damage Punch and Judy deal to the target by 4%, stacking additively. At 5 stacks, the target becomes 'Overwhelmed,' increasing the damage taken by 10% and applying a 15% slow for 2 seconds. This passive transforms Punch and Judy into masters of sustained damage and control, rewarding aggressive play and coordinated strikes. The building tension of 'Slapstick' culminates in a crescendo of chaotic power, punishing opponents who underestimate the seemingly harmless nature of their theatrical antics.

abilities.name: Curtain Call Catastrophe
upgrades: (Patch) Role realignment: This ability now emphasizes burst damage with a longer cooldown.
abilities.description: Punch and Judy unleash a devastating combination attack. Punch throws a barrage of props dealing AoE damage equivalent to 60% of his attack to enemies in the target area. Judy then follows up, creating a magical shockwave that detonates around any 'Wanted' targets, dealing magic damage equal to 80% of her magic attack and consuming the 'Wanted' status. The detonation deals additional damage to nearby enemies within a small radius of the 'Wanted' target, creating a chain reaction of explosive slapstick. If no target is 'Wanted,' Judy still creates a small magic explosion at the center of the AoE that Punch inflicted, dealing 40% of her Magic Attack. This ability has a cooldown of 15 seconds, giving it more impact when used tactically. This ability exemplifies Punch and Judy's capacity for turning theatricality into tactical advantage, showcasing their unique brand of chaotic coordination.

character_v1.playstyle: Buffing and debuffing support, excels at amplifying team damage.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Punch and Judy synergize well with damage dealers who can capitalize on debuffed enemies and appreciate attack/magic attack buffs.
character_v1.tierSummary: Punch and Judy have a unique kit with summon and debuff potential. While their survivability is low, their burst damage and debuff utility justify moving them to C+ tier.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Their abilities apply and benefit from the 'Wanted' debuff, creating a natural synergy within their kit. The ultimate amplifies the effectiveness of their other skills.

chapters.title: The Heist
chapters.mission: Complete the heist without getting caught.
chapters.summary: Punch and Judy plan a bank heist with Spike as a distraction.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Punch and Judy are wanted criminals who need to raise money to leave town.

character_v1.name: Jet Black

abilities.name: Unwavering Stalwart
upgrades: Lv10: Shield potency increased to 90% of ATK.
Lv50: Shield duration increased to 4 seconds and ATK bonus increased to 15%.
Lv100: If the shield breaks before expiring, the target is healed for 25% of Jet's ATK.
(Balance Patch) Buff: Shield potency scales better at later levels, reaching up to 120% of ATK at max level.
(Patch) Role realignment: Now prioritizes allies with the lowest HP percentage.
abilities.description: Jet Black channels the indomitable strength of the earth, manifesting a protective geode that bursts forth to shield his allies. Upon activation, Jet hurls a fragment of the earth, targeting a single ally within a moderate range. This projectile is a focused surge of geological energy, striking the designated target with the force of a miniature earthquake. Upon impact, the geode explodes, releasing a surge of protective energy that instantly grants a shield to the targeted ally, absorbing damage equal to 80% of Jet's ATK. The shield persists for 3 seconds, steadfastly guarding the ally from incoming harm. Furthermore, the impact of the geode also grants the target a burst of invigorating power, increasing their ATK by 10% for the duration of the shield. This supportive technique not only fortifies his allies but also empowers them to strike with enhanced force, making Jet Black a reliable bastion in the heat of battle.

abilities.name: Black Dog's Bite
abilities.description: Jet lunges forward a short distance, clamping down on the first enemy hit with his cybernetic arm. This deals a small amount of physical damage (Atk * 0.6) and applies a stacking debuff called 'Marked'. Each stack of Marked reduces the target's speed by 5% and defense by 3%, stacking up to 5 times. The debuff lasts for 4 seconds. If the target is already at 5 stacks, the next application instead stuns them for 0.75 seconds. Jet gains a small shield (10% of Max HP) for 2 seconds after successfully applying Marked. This ability has a cooldown of 8 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: I'm the Black Dog, and when I bite, I don't let go.

abilities.name: Salvage Operation
abilities.description: Upon a nearby enemy unit's death (within a 5-unit radius), Jet scavenges usable components. This grants him a 'Salvage Stack'. At 3 Salvage Stacks, Jet's next basic attack is empowered to deal bonus true damage equal to 5% of the target's maximum HP, and heals Jet for 5% of his maximum HP. Excess Salvage Stacks are consumed. This effect has an internal cooldown of 5 seconds between Salvage Stack gains. Additionally, after using his ultimate, Jet gains 3 Salvage Stacks immediately.
abilities.flavorQuote: Waste not, want not. There's always something useful lying around.

abilities.name: Hammerhead Defense
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~17%).
abilities.description: Jet deploys a temporary defensive field around a target ally (or himself) within a 7-unit radius, diverting a percentage of incoming damage to himself. For 3 seconds, 40% of all damage the targeted ally would take is redirected to Jet instead. This damage is reduced by Jet's defense stat. While this effect is active, the targeted ally also gains a shield equal to 15% of Jet's maximum HP. This shield lasts for the duration of the damage redirection. This ability has a cooldown of 14 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Get behind me! I'll cover you.

abilities.name: ISSP Interrogation
abilities.description: Jet uses his former ISSP training to intensely interrogate an enemy target within a 6-unit radius. The target is rooted in place for 1.25 seconds and is inflicted with 'Exposed'. Exposed enemies take 10% increased damage from all sources. Additionally, enemies affected by Exposed have their tenacity reduced by 20% for the duration. After the root ends, Jet gains a Salvage Stack, representing the information extracted during the interrogation. This ability has a cooldown of 12 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Alright, pal, start talking. I haven't got all day.

abilities.name: Bebop's Last Stand
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Jet calls upon the Bebop's emergency systems, granting himself and all nearby allies (within a 5-unit radius) a significant boost to their defenses and tenacity. For 7 seconds, allies gain 30% bonus defense and 20% tenacity. Furthermore, all allies affected by this ultimate are healed for 8% of their maximum HP per second for the duration. After the effect ends, Jet emits a pulse that grants all allies a temporary shield equal to 10% of Jet's max HP for 3 seconds. This ability has a long cooldown of 90 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Bebop, give 'em everything we've got!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Jet excels in teams that benefit from sustained damage and crowd control, providing a strong defensive backbone. He pairs well with damage dealers who can capitalize on the Exposed debuff and benefit from the defensive buffs provided by Hammerhead Defense and Bebop's Last Stand.
character_v1.tierSummary: Jet Black is a strong tank with excellent support abilities, especially with his shield and damage redirection. His low damage output is offset by his utility and survivability, making him a solid A- tier character.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Jet's kit revolves around protecting his allies and disrupting enemies, with Salvage Operation providing sustain and bonus damage. The Marked debuff from Black Dog's Bite synergizes well with ISSP Interrogation's damage amp.

chapters.title: Protect the Crew
chapters.mission: Survive 10 waves of bounty hunters.
chapters.summary: Jet has to protect Spike from the bounty hunters chasing him.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Jet needs to get stronger in order to protect his crew.

character_v1.name: Rue

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Earth.

abilities.name: Forest Whisper
upgrades: (Patch) Shifting Sands: Evasion stacks on enemies afflicted with 'Mockingjay's Song' now additionally grant Armor Pen.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~14%).
abilities.description: Rue, attuned to the subtle songs of the arena, finds herself moving with heightened agility through areas shrouded in Stealth or concealed by Brush, gaining a 15% increase to her base movement speed within these regions. Furthermore, whenever Rue applies a stack of 'Mockingjay's Song' – whether it be the bolstering melody shared with an ally or the haunting tune cast upon an enemy – she resonates with its effects. When an ally is graced with 'Mockingjay's Song', they benefit from a 5% boost to their movement speed for a duration of 3 seconds, allowing them to deftly navigate the battlefield. However, if 'Mockingjay's Song' targets an enemy, Rue gains a stacking advantage. For each stack of 'Mockingjay's Song' inflicted upon an enemy, Rue receives a 10% increase in evasion against their attacks, lasting for 3 seconds. This evasion effect can stack up to a maximum of 3 times, culminating in a significant 30% reduction in incoming damage from that specific foe. Through this attunement, Rue leverages her understanding of the arena's environment to enhance her own survivability and to strategically position herself and her allies.

abilities.name: Sugar Net Snare
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~15% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Rue casts a woven net of sweetened tree sap towards a targeted area, creating a zone that lasts for 5 seconds. Any enemy that steps into this sticky trap becomes ensnared, suffering 60 (+30% of her magic attack) magic damage distributed evenly over 3 seconds, while also accumulating a 'Mockingjay's Call' stack. In contrast, allies lingering within the sweet-smelling zone are soothed, gaining a protective layer of hardened sap that acts as a shield, absorbing up to 30 (+15% of Rue's magic attack) hit points for 3 seconds. Furthermore, this Sugar Net Snare grants Rue a clear line of sight into the targeted area, piercing through dense foliage to reveal hidden enemies lurking within the brush. The area pulsates with magical energy every second, continually reapplying the damage or shielding effect to any targets within its radius, ensuring a constant stream of either supportive defense for allies or disruptive offense against foes. The lingering net effectively shapes the battlefield, creating strategic choke points that can either bolster her team's resilience or impede the enemy's advance, all while dealing consistent damage.

abilities.name: Mockingjay's Refuge
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: Ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Patch) Role realignment: This ability now emphasizes utility-style interactions.
abilities.description: Rue, drawing strength from the forest's resilience, begins to weave a comforting melody, channeling her energy for 2 seconds. As she sings, Rue fades into the shadows, gaining stealth to reposition herself strategically. Simultaneously, her song mends the wounds of nearby allies, restoring 40 health plus an additional amount equal to 20% of her magic attack every half-second, providing a constant flow of vitality to her team. Upon completing the lullaby's channel, the remaining echoes of her song resonate outwards, granting all allies within range a surge of speed, increasing their movement speed by 20% for a duration of 3 seconds, allowing them to swiftly escape danger or rapidly close the distance to an enemy. During the channel, Rue also benefits from the 'Mockingjay's Song' effect, cleansing any roots or slows hindering her movement. Should Rue's melody be interrupted prematurely, the comforting burst of speed will not reach her allies, but the healing continues up until the song stops. This song can be cancelled early to retain the Mockingjay stacks, useful when using other abilities.

abilities.name: District's Harvest
abilities.description: Rue gathers resources from the environment, creating a patch of harvestable plants at a target location. Allies interacting with the patch gain 5% Lifesteal for 5 seconds. Additionally, enemies moving through the patch are slowed by 20% and gain a stack of 'Mockingjay's Song'. The harvest patch lasts for 8 seconds. The slow effect is applied once upon entering the patch. Rue can strategically place this patch to control enemy movement, allowing her allies to sustain themselves in prolonged fights or create opportunities for engaging or disengaging. This ability reflects Rue's resourceful nature and her ability to provide for her team in dire circumstances.
abilities.flavorQuote: "The land provides, if you know where to look."

abilities.name: Whispers of Rebellion
abilities.description: Rue weaves a complex melody, a rallying cry known as 'Whispers of Rebellion', that lasts for 8 seconds, amplifying the influence of 'Mockingjay's Song' upon both allies and adversaries caught within its enchanting notes. Empowering comrades touched by 'Mockingjay's Song', the anthem grants them a surge of ferocity, boosting their attack speed by 25% and fortifying their magical prowess with an increase of 25% magic attack. Conversely, enemies ensnared by the original song find their defiance withered as the 'Whispers of Rebellion' inflict 50 (+12% of Rue's magic attack) magic damage every second, while simultaneously hindering their advance by reducing movement speed by 35%. While singing her subversive anthem, Rue herself becomes an untouchable beacon of resolve, enjoying complete immunity to crowd control effects, allowing her to fearlessly orchestrate the battlefield's symphony of survival and subversion.

character_v1.teamSynergy: Rue pairs well with aggressive allies who can capitalize on the speed boosts and lifesteal she provides. She also works well with teammates that can control the battlefield allowing her to position plants safely.
character_v1.tierSummary: Rue's kit provides a mix of stealth, healing, and area control. While she can be elusive, her damage output is somewhat limited, thus a C tier placement.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Rue synergizes internally through Mockingjay's Song, allowing her to buff allies or debuff enemies depending on what action she takes. Rue also benefits from using Stealth and the Brush.

chapters.title: Echoes of the Arena
chapters.mission: Collect rare herbs in a dangerous forest, facing off against wild beasts and poachers while protecting Katniss.
chapters.summary: Rue relives her experiences, grappling with survivor's guilt. Katniss helps her understand the importance of remembering and honoring the fallen.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Rue, haunted by memories of the arena, seeks solace in nature. A chance encounter with Katniss Everdeen sparks a bond, helping Rue confront her trauma and rediscover her fighting spirit.

character_v1.name: Alice Hardy

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~47%).
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Ice.

abilities.name: Impending Dread
abilities.description: Alice gains 1 stack of Survival Instinct whenever an ally is defeated, up to a maximum of 3 stacks. Additionally, successfully evading an enemy attack grants her 0.5 stacks of Survival Instinct. Each stack of Survival Instinct increases Alice's evasion by 15% and her attack damage by 10%. At 3 stacks, Alice's next active ability is empowered, gaining additional effects based on the ability used. Survival Instinct stacks are lost upon using an empowered ability, or after 15 seconds of being out of combat. This passive represents Alice's growing resolve as the situation becomes more dire.
abilities.flavorQuote: They can't all be dead, right? ...Right?

abilities.name: Makeshift Trap
abilities.description: Alice places a trap at a target location within a short range. The trap remains stealthed until an enemy unit moves within its radius. When triggered, the trap inflicts 50 (+30% Atk) physical damage and slows the enemy's movement speed by 40% for 3 seconds. If Alice has 3 stacks of Survival Instinct, this ability is empowered. The empowered version of Makeshift Trap also roots the enemy in place for 1.5 seconds after the slow ends. The trap lasts for a maximum of 20 seconds before disappearing. Only one trap can be active at a time. This ability allows Alice to control the battlefield and disrupt enemy movements.
abilities.flavorQuote: Just a little something to slow you down.

abilities.name: Desperate Dodge
