upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Alice performs a quick dash in a target direction, becoming briefly invulnerable during the dash animation (0.5 seconds). If Alice successfully dodges an enemy attack during this dash, she gains 1 stack of Survival Instinct. If Alice has 3 stacks of Survival Instinct, this ability is empowered. The empowered version of Desperate Dodge also leaves behind a smoke screen at Alice's starting location that blinds enemies in the area for 2 seconds. This ability is crucial for Alice's survival, allowing her to evade danger and reposition herself effectively.
abilities.flavorQuote: Not this time!

abilities.name: Panic Attack
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~33%).
abilities.description: Alice unleashes a flurry of desperate attacks, dealing 70 (+40% Atk) physical damage to a target enemy. This attack has a 30% chance to inflict the 'Fear' debuff, causing the enemy to flee in a random direction for 1 second. If Alice has 3 stacks of Survival Instinct, this ability is empowered. The empowered version of Panic Attack guarantees the 'Fear' debuff and also applies a stacking debuff that reduces the target's damage output by 10% for 5 seconds (up to 30%). This ability allows Alice to disrupt enemy formations and weaken their offensive capabilities.
abilities.flavorQuote: Get away! Just... stay back!

abilities.name: Final Stand
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~6% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Alice taps into her deepest reserves of resilience, granting herself and nearby allies a shield equal to 15% of Alice’s max HP for 5 seconds. During this time, Alice gains a 30% increase to her movement speed and a 20% increase to her attack damage. Additionally, for each ally that is currently defeated, the shield strength is increased by 5%. Upon activation, Alice also gains 1 stack of Survival Instinct. This ultimate ability represents Alice's ultimate act of defiance and determination to protect herself and her remaining allies, even in the face of overwhelming odds.
abilities.flavorQuote: I won't let you win! Not like this!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Alice synergizes well with tanky characters who can draw enemy fire, allowing her to safely set up traps and evade attacks. She also benefits from having damage-dealing allies who can capitalize on the openings created by her traps and Panic Attack. Characters who can revive fallen allies can indirectly boost her Survival Instinct stacks, further empowering her abilities.
character_v1.tierSummary: Alice Hardy's kit relies heavily on evasion and traps. While she can be difficult to hit, her damage output is low, and she is easily countered by tenacity. A D tier ranking is justified.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Alice's kit revolves around gaining stacks of Survival Instinct, which empowers her abilities. Desperate Dodge helps her evade attacks and gain stacks, while Makeshift Trap and Panic Attack benefit greatly from the empowered state. Final Stand provides a temporary boost to her team's survivability and damage, further enhancing her role as a 'Final Girl Tactician'.

chapters.title: Echoes of Crystal Lake
chapters.mission: Assist Laurie Strode in fortifying a safe house, setting traps and defending against waves of masked assailants and other threats while boosting Atk power.
chapters.summary: Alice helps Laurie to set traps that will slow down the enemy.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Alice, burdened by the horrors of Camp Crystal Lake, finds a kindred spirit in Laurie Strode. Together, they confront their fears and prepare for the inevitable return of evil.

character_v1.name: Nekomata Okayu

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Ice.

abilities.name: Onigiri Overload
abilities.description: Okayu passively generates 1 Onigiri every 5 seconds, up to a maximum of 5 Onigiri. Consuming an Onigiri grants Okayu a stack of 'Mogu Mogu', increasing her defense by 5 and magic defense by 5 for 8 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. Additionally, consuming an Onigiri empowers Okayu's other abilities, providing bonus effects based on the ability used. Onigiri are also consumed when hit by a critical attack, reducing incoming damage by 15% and granting a burst of speed, increasing movement speed by 20% for 3 seconds, but preventing Onigiri generation for 5 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Mogu mogu... time to get stronger!"

abilities.name: Rice Ball Barrage
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Okayu launches three rice balls in a cone-shaped area in front of her, each dealing 80 magic damage to enemies hit. If Okayu has at least 1 Onigiri, she consumes 1 to empower the attack, causing the rice balls to inflict 'Mogu Mogu' on hit enemies, reducing their attack damage by 3% for 5 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. If the target already has 5 stacks of Mogu Mogu, this ability instead deals 10% of the target's maximum health as true damage. This ability has a cooldown of 8 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Have a taste of my homemade Onigiri!"

abilities.name: Comfort Food
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~9% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Okayu creates a comforting aura around herself, healing for 150 HP over 3 seconds. If Okayu consumes 1 Onigiri, the healing is increased to 250 HP over 3 seconds, and she gains a shield equal to 10% of her maximum health for 5 seconds. If used on an ally, she shares 50% of the healing and shield with them. This ability has a cooldown of 12 seconds. The healing effect is reduced by 30% if the target is affected by more than 3 'Mogu Mogu' stacks.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Here, have some of my special onigiri. It'll make you feel better!"

abilities.name: Purrfect Taunt
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~40%).
abilities.description: Okayu lets out an irresistible purr, taunting all nearby enemies for 2 seconds, forcing them to attack her. If Okayu has at least 2 Onigiri, she consumes 2 to further enhance the taunt, granting herself 30% damage reduction during the taunt duration and inflicting 'Mogu Mogu' on all taunted enemies. Additionally, enemies with 5 stacks of 'Mogu Mogu' are also stunned for 1 second after the taunt ends. This ability has a cooldown of 15 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Come on, try and get past this! Mogu mogu!"

abilities.name: Gluttonous Devour
abilities.description: Okayu targets an enemy champion. If the target has 5 stacks of 'Mogu Mogu', Okayu consumes them, dealing 40% of their maximum health as true damage and healing herself for 20% of her maximum health. If the target does not have 5 stacks, Okayu instead deals 150 magic damage and applies 2 stacks of 'Mogu Mogu'. After using this ability, Okayu is briefly stunned for 1 second due to the massive consumption. This ability has a cooldown of 90 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Alright, time for the main course! Mogu mogu... GONE!"

character_v1.teamSynergy: Okayu synergizes well with teams that can apply additional debuffs or provide crowd control, making it easier for her to stack 'Mogu Mogu' and land her ultimate. Allies that can benefit from a tank drawing enemy fire also synergize well with her.
character_v1.tierSummary: Okayu has a unique kit focused on onigiri consumption for buffs, heals and true damage. Her tankiness and ability to sustain herself make her a solid B+ tier character, despite the lack of direct offensive power.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Okayu's kit revolves around stacking 'Mogu Mogu' on enemies to enable her ultimate ability and enhance other effects. Her passive provides a steady supply of Onigiri to fuel her abilities, and her taunt offers a way to control the battlefield while setting up for her ultimate.

chapters.title: The Infinite Buffet
chapters.mission: Compete in a series of eating contests, using Okayu's Onigiri Overload to outpace the competition and defend Gura from mischievous food spirits. Gain additional True DMG.
chapters.summary: Okayu and Gura explore a legendary buffet, facing food-themed challenges and battling rival eaters.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Okayu's insatiable appetite leads her to a culinary quest, teaming up with Gura. Together, they embark on a food-filled adventure.

character_v1.name: Inugami Korone

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~11%).
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Physical.

abilities.name: Yubi Cutter
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Korone performs a quick melee attack, slashing with imaginary finger blades, dealing 90 (+X% Atk) physical damage to the target. This attack has a 25% chance to inflict 'Bleed' for 3 seconds, dealing 15 (+X% Atk) physical damage per second. Activating this ability generates 5 Finger Debt. If Korone is in 'Payment' phase, this ability instead consumes 10% of her current HP to deal an additional 40 (+X% Atk) true damage, and the bleed chance is increased to 75%. This consumes 15% of the current hp. This effect can only occur once per Payment Phase.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Yubi! They're sharper than you think!"

abilities.name: Doog's Frenzy
abilities.description: Korone enters a frenzied state for 5 seconds, increasing her attack speed by 40% and movement speed by 25%. During this frenzy, she gains 10 Finger Debt per second. If used during 'Payment' phase, the attack speed bonus is increased to 70%, and Korone gains a shield equal to 15% of her maximum HP that lasts for the duration of the frenzy. If the shield is depleted Korone loses 15% of the movement speed buff. At the end of the frenzy, she deals 50 (+X% magic Atk) magic damage to all nearby enemies within a 5-meter radius. The radius is increased to 7 meters during payment phase.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Orayo! Time to get serious!"

abilities.name: Eekum Bokum
abilities.description: Korone lets out a primal scream, stunning all enemies within a 4-meter cone for 1.25 seconds. Enemies that are already bleeding receive an additional effect, becoming 'Terrified' for 1.75 seconds, reducing their attack damage by 25%. Using this ability generates 15 Finger Debt. If Korone is in 'Payment' phase, the stun duration is increased to 2 seconds, and 'Terrified' reduces damage by 40%. This ability has a cooldown of 12 seconds. Terrified will trigger before the cone. Enemies stunned by this effect cannot be stunned again for 5 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: "EEekum Bokum! Did I scare ya?"

abilities.name: God Dog's Favor
abilities.description: Korone gains 3% Lifesteal. For every 20 Finger Debt accumulated, her Lifesteal increases by 1%, up to a maximum of 8% at 100 Finger Debt. Upon reaching 100 Finger Debt, Korone enters 'Payment' phase for 8 seconds. During 'Payment' phase, Korone's damage is increased by 30%, but she takes 15% increased damage. After 'Payment' phase ends, Korone loses all Finger Debt. The 'Payment' phase will automatically trigger, resetting the Finger Debt upon trigger. Additionally, the 'Payment' phase will remove all bleed effects from Korone.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Wanna see what a real God Dog can do?"

abilities.name: Infinite Bakery Works
abilities.description: Korone unleashes a flurry of melee attacks over 6 seconds, dealing 120 (+X% Atk) physical damage to a single target every 0.5 seconds. Each attack applies a stack of 'Baked Goodness' to the target, up to a maximum of 12 stacks. For each stack of Baked Goodness the target has, Korone heals for 2% of the damage dealt. If Korone is in 'Payment' phase, this ability applies 2 stacks of Baked Goodness per hit and has an additional 20% Critical Hit Chance. Consumes all Finger Debt, and upon completion of this ultimate, the target takes 10% extra damage from Korone's teammates for 4 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Welcome to my bakery! Today's special is... YOU!"

character_v1.playstyle: Aggressive Melee DPS with resource management
character_v1.teamSynergy: Korone benefits from teammates who can provide her with shields, heals, or damage mitigation during her Payment phase. She can also synergize well with characters who can capitalize on the vulnerability debuff she applies with her ultimate, making her a valuable addition to aggressive, burst-oriented team compositions.
character_v1.tierSummary: Korone has a solid kit with bleed, stun, and AoE, but her stats are spread too thin. B tier reflects her all-around utility. Her friendship campaign already exists.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Korone's kit revolves around rapidly accumulating Finger Debt to trigger Payment phase, which significantly boosts her damage output but also makes her more vulnerable. Her abilities are designed to synergize with this risk-reward playstyle, allowing for bursts of high damage and sustain.
character_v1.bestFriendshipBuff: Increased Lifesteal and Attack Speed for Melee Allies

chapters.title: Nightmare on Holo Street
chapters.mission: Infiltrate a series of dreamscapes, using Korone's Yubi Cutter and Freddy's dream manipulation to trap victims and gain bonus Finger Debt stacks to increase damage.
chapters.summary: Korone and Freddy invade dreams, causing mischief and mayhem. Freddy teaches Korone new ways to terrorize.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Korone's playful antics take a dark turn when she meets Freddy Krueger. Their twisted friendship leads to chaotic dream invasions.

This attack deals moderate magic damage; however, the true strength lies in the tactical advantage it provides. Upon impact, the target is marked with 'Opportunistic Strike,' enhancing their vulnerability for 5 seconds. Any damage inflicted upon a target suffering from 'Opportunistic Strike' is increased by 15%, giving Yosuke's allies an opening to strike decisively. Furthermore, the swirling winds have a chance to disorient the enemy, potentially inflicting 'Staggered' for 3 seconds, reducing their movement speed by 20%. If the target is already under the effects of 'Opportunistic Strike' when Tailwind Slice connects, the odds of inflicting 'Staggered' rise by an additional 10%, ensuring Yosuke can set up his team for a coordinated assault. abilities.name: Sukukaja Shuffle

abilities.description: Yosuke performs a swift series of acrobatic maneuvers, greatly increasing the evasion and speed of a targeted ally for 4 seconds. The affected ally gains a 30% increase to their evasion and a 20% increase to their speed. Furthermore, if the targeted ally successfully evades an attack while under the effect of 'Sukukaja Shuffle', Yosuke gains 1 stack of 'Adrenaline Rush'. Each stack of 'Adrenaline Rush' increases Yosuke's Persona's attack speed by 5%, stacking up to a maximum of 3 times. This skill is crucial for enabling allies to dodge crucial attacks and reposition effectively in the heat of battle. The duration of 'Adrenaline Rush' is refreshed each time an ally evades an attack.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time to pick up the pace, partner!

abilities.name: Junes' Jingle
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.

abilities.description: Yosuke cues up the iconic Junes theme song through his Persona, creating a wave of commercial bliss that invigorates his allies. Upon activation, a familiar tune radiates outwards from Yosuke, visualized by a glowing Junes logo, enveloping all allies within a radius of 400 units. Each affected ally is immediately healed for 120 HP plus 30% of Yosuke's Magic Attack stat. The catchy jingle continues its restorative effects, applying a Regen buff for 3 seconds. This buff heals allies for 20 HP plus 5% of Yosuke's Magic Attack every second, totaling an additional 60 HP plus 15% of Yosuke's Magic Attack over the duration. If an ally is already benefiting from Yosuke's 'Junes Advantage' buff when 'Junes' Jingle' is cast, the initial heal is amplified by 20%, providing 144 HP plus 36% of Yosuke's Magic Attack at the start, ensuring maximum support for those diving into the fray.

abilities.name: Windy Edge
upgrades: Reduces cooldown by 1 second.
Increases damage by 20 (+10% Magic Attack).
'Dazed' chance increased to 80%.
Increases teleport distance by 20%.
Applies 'Junes Advantage' to target for 1 second.
abilities.description: Yosuke, with a sly grin, channels his Persona, creating a localized gust of wind that distorts his position. He vanishes in a swirl of leaves and reappears a short distance forward, executing a lightning-fast strike with his kunai. Upon arrival, Yosuke slices through his target with practiced ease, dealing 80 (+40% Magic Attack) magic damage to the first enemy hit. The sheer speed and force of the attack has a 60% chance to inflict 'Dazed' for 1.5 seconds, interrupting their current action and reducing their movement speed by 30%. Should Yosuke teleport through an enemy currently suffering from 'Junes Advantage', the 'Dazed' duration extends by an additional 0.75 seconds, allowing for prolonged vulnerability and setup for a devastating follow-up assault. This maneuver is crucial for quickly closing the distance, escaping danger, and capitalizing on enemy missteps, showcasing Yosuke's nimble and opportunistic fighting style.

abilities.name: Susano-o's Gale
abilities.description: Yosuke summons the full might of his evolved Persona, Takehaya Susano-o, unleashing a devastating vortex of wind that sweeps across the battlefield. All enemies caught within the vortex take heavy magic damage over 5 seconds and are pulled towards the center. At the end of the duration, enemies are launched into the air, becoming vulnerable to follow-up attacks. For each enemy affected by 'Junes Advantage' caught in Susano-o's Gale, Yosuke's Persona's speed is permanently increased by 1% for the remainder of the match, up to a maximum of 10%. This skill is the ultimate expression of Yosuke's supportive capabilities, providing both significant damage and lasting enhancements to his abilities.
abilities.flavorQuote: Feel the wrath of Susano-o's Gale!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Yosuke synergizes well with damage-focused characters who can capitalize on the increased damage from 'Junes Advantage'. Characters with strong follow-up attacks also benefit from the crowd control and repositioning offered by 'Mirage Slash' and 'Susano-o's Gale'. Yosuke's healing ensures that allies can stay in the fight longer.
character_v1.tierSummary: Yosuke's reliance on wind damage and awkward utility skills makes him weak. Moves down from E to D- to fit the distribution.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Yosuke's kit revolves around applying 'Junes Advantage' and capitalizing on it with his other abilities. 'Garudyne Gust' is the primary applicator, while 'Healing Breeze' and 'Mirage Slash' gain benefits from it. 'Sukukaja Shuffle' enhances ally evasion, potentially granting Yosuke stacks of 'Adrenaline Rush'. 'Susano-o's Gale' deals massive damage and provides lasting stat boosts based on the number of enemies with 'Junes Advantage'.
character_v1.bestFriendshipBuff: Increased Magic Attack for Wind Allies.

abilities.description: After School Special is a passive ability that reflects Chie's unwavering dedication to her training and her love for martial arts movies. This potent passive provides a unique interplay between movement, attack, and defense. Whenever Chie dodges an incoming attack, she gains one stack of "Focus." Each stack of Focus grants a modest increase to attack damage and critical hit chance, but perhaps more importantly, also empowers her next active ability. Focus stacks decay over time, incentivizing aggressive play and rewarding precise timing. Furthermore, upon reaching three stacks of Focus, Chie gains a temporary shield, reinforcing her bruiser role by enabling her to absorb significant damage while preparing to unleash a devastating counter-attack. The shield strength scales with Chie's HP. This ability allows Chie to transform her defensive capabilities into offensive advantages, perfectly encapsulating her fighting style.

These 'Embers' remain active for 5 seconds, refreshing their duration each time Yukiko takes damage. Once the 'Embers' fade, Yukiko loses 1 stack every 0.5 seconds until all stacks are gone. This passive solidifies Yukiko's position as a bruiser, rewarding aggressive play and the ability to endure sustained damage, translating resilience into potent offensive capabilities.

The chair is a non-descript metal folding chair, reflecting Kanji's delinquent tendencies and resourcefulness. The animation involves a brief wind-up before the powerful downward strike, giving opponents a small window to react, but the potential payoff makes it a worthwhile risk, particularly when comboed with other abilities that inflict Shocked. The high single-target damage is excellent for bursting down priority targets.

abilities.description: Kanji, channeling the raw power of his Persona, Take-Mikazuchi, delivers a devastatingly swift electric strike. He disappears in a flash of lightning and reappears directly behind the targeted enemy, delivering a concentrated blow of electrifying force. Upon impact, the target suffers significant magic damage, calculated as 200 base damage plus 60% of Kanji's magic attack stat. The lightning strike leaves the target Shocked, reducing their movement speed by 30% and their attack speed by 20% for a duration of 3 seconds. This attack guarantees a critical hit if the target is already afflicted with the Shocked status effect. The speed of this maneuver allows Kanji to close the distance to a target swiftly, placing him in a strategic position behind them, providing an opportunity to follow up with additional attacks or reposition for tactical advantage. Furthermore, for a short window of 2 seconds after executing Take-Mikazuchi's Judgement, Kanji gains a 25% bonus to his evasion chance, reflecting his momentary burst of speed and precision during the attack.

abilities.description: Kanji's imposing stature and battle-hardened resolve manifest as a protective aura. Kanji starts each encounter with a passive shield that absorbs 15% of incoming damage, scaling up to a maximum of 30% based on Kanji's maximum HP. This shield represents Kanji's ability to weather punishment and stand as a bulwark against the enemy's attacks, inspiring those around him. Moreover, whenever Kanji is struck by an attack that applies the Shocked status, the raw electric power resonates with his imposing aura, causing his shield to regenerate instantly for 5% of his max HP, reinforcing his defenses. This regeneration effect can only occur once every 5 seconds. Should the shield be fully depleted, it automatically recharges after 10 seconds, representing Kanji's unwavering will to endure. The recharge rate is affected by status effects; if Kanji is affected by the 'Slowed' status, the recharge time increases by 50%. This passive ability encourages players to position Kanji aggressively, soaking up damage for his team and punishing those who dare attempt to shock him.

abilities.name: Electric Rampage
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: Exhaustion duration reduced by 0.5 seconds.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: Initial Attack Damage bonus reduced to 55%.
(Bugfix) Fixed an issue where Shocked damage was not scaling correctly with Attack Damage.
(Patch) Added a visual effect to clearly indicate the duration of Electric Rampage.
abilities.description: Kanji's fury erupts, unleashing his true potential on the battlefield for 8 seconds. During this rampage, Kanji's Attack Damage surges by 60%, his Armor and Magic Resist each increase by 40, and his Movement Speed is amplified by 25%. Furthermore, his basic attacks and abilities crackle with electrical energy, inflicting the Shocked status effect for 2 seconds, dealing 30 (+15% Attack Damage) bonus magic damage over its duration to each enemy hit. Opponents already afflicted with Shocked are struck with an additional surge of true damage, taking 50 (+25% Attack Damage) true damage instantly. Moreover, Kanji becomes Unstoppable during Electric Rampage, rendering him immune to all forms of crowd control. Once the rampage subsides, Kanji experiences a 4-second Exhaustion, reducing his Attack Damage by 30% and his Movement Speed by 15%, leaving him vulnerable but poised for a strategic follow-up. The raw power of this ultimate demands careful planning and precise execution to maximize its devastating impact and mitigate the subsequent exhaustion.

character_v1.internalSynergy: Kanji's abilities synergize by using Shocked to increase damage output. His passive enhances survivability, and his ultimate provides a burst of power and control.

abilities.description: Adachi flicks his wrist, sending a gust of wind at a single target with unnerving glee. This ranged attack deals physical damage enhanced by his twisted persona and scales directly with Adachi's Attack stat, inflicting an initial damage of 50% of his total ATK. This 'Filthy Breeze' isn't just about immediate damage; the wind carries a hidden layer of insidious intent. If the target is already suffering from a status effect (such as 'Fear,' 'Stun,' or 'Poison,' and of at least one turn remaining duration), the damage is amplified by an additional 25% ATK scaling, reflecting Adachi's enjoyment of exploiting weaknesses. Additionally, the 'Filthy Breeze' has a 15% chance to inflict a minor status effect upon the target, lasting for 1 turn. This 'Off Balance' effect decreases the target's evasion by 10% and attack by 5%, further setting them up for additional attacks.

abilities.description: Adachi casts a malevolent grin towards a single enemy, exploiting their mental weaknesses. This act of psychological manipulation deals X magic damage and inflicts a random debilitating status effect for 3 seconds. The specific debuff is weighted based on the target's most prominent attribute, reflecting Adachi's talent for finding the right pressure point. If the targeted enemy's highest stat is their Attack, they are more likely to be struck by 'Fear,' reducing their Attack by 20%. If their Magic Attack is higher, they will more likely be afflicted with 'Confusion,' resulting in a 50% chance that their next attack will target an ally. Lastly, if their Health Pool is higher, they have increased odds of being subjected to 'Despair', causing damage equal to 3% of their maximum health every second for 3 seconds. Generating 5 stacks of Television Static upon completion, Adachi's 'Twisted Grin' becomes significantly more dangerous if the target is already suffering under a debuff, dealing an additional instance of true damage equal to 10% of their current health

abilities.description: Adachi taps into the chaotic frequency of the Midnight Channel, broadcasting a surge of distorted energy at a targeted foe. Damage scales primarily with Attack, but receives additional potency from Luck. This ability represents Adachi's twisted manipulation and should be incorporated into a broader strategy revolving around exploiting debuffs.

abilities.description: Adachi projects a torrent of mental anguish directly into the minds of his enemies, channeling his inner turmoil into raw psychic force. This attack manifests as a cone of distorted energy erupting from Adachi, dealing X magic damage to all opponents caught within its range. Furthermore, the psychic backlash can overload cognitive functions, potentially inducing Silence for 1.5 seconds, preventing affected targets from casting any abilities. Base chance to inflict Silence starts at 40%, but this chance dramatically increases to 60% against enemies already suffering from two or more debuffs, exploiting their weakened mental state. Casting Mind Crush requires 15 Television Static. Should Adachi possess insufficient Static, he will still channel the ability, but its damage is reduced by 25%, showcasing the strain on his psyche. Enemies with high Magic Defense will experience a mitigated impact from the psychic assault, lessening the damage received. The debilitating effects of Silence are also vulnerable to Tenacity; targets with higher Tenacity will see a reduced duration of the silence effect.

abilities.description: Adachi unveils his twisted reality, summoning a miniature Midnight Channel broadcast focused on a designated location. This sinister domain emanates an aura of delusion, dealing X magic damage every second to enemies trapped within its confines for a total of 5 seconds. The constant exposure to the truth warps their minds, causing a 15% reduction in both physical and magical defenses. Furthermore, as the broadcast fades, the lingering psychic residue probes the deepest secrets of those affected, forcing a 'Forced Persona' effect. This reveals any hidden passive abilities, buffs, or deceptive facades for a crucial 3 seconds, exposing their true nature. Adding insult to injury, the psychic shockwave from the broadcast has a 25% chance to inflict a random status ailment, such as poison, stun, or silence, further crippling his foes. To amplify the broadcast’s potency, Adachi consumes all stacks of Television Static he has accumulated. For each stack devoured, the damage per second escalates by 1%, ensuring the broadcast is tailored to obliterate any resistance. Remember that enemies with high Magic Defense will inevitably suffer reduced damage from the Midnight Channel's insidious influence, a constant reminder of their refusal to accept the truth.

character_v1.teamSynergy: Adachi works well with allies who can inflict additional debuffs, amplifying his Jester's Grin passive and providing more opportunities to exploit enemy weaknesses.
character_v1.tierSummary: Adachi is too weak and has a terrible kit focused on stat debuffs and status effects with a low base stat. Moves from F to F+.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Adachi's kit revolves around applying debuffs to generate Television Static, which then empowers his other abilities, creating a self-sufficient engine of disruption and damage.
character_v1.bestFriendshipBuff: Increased Debuff Duration for Television Static Allies.

abilities.description: Crocodile nonchalantly flicks a precise blast of sand at his foe. This basic ranged attack deals physical damage influenced by his ATK stat, striking a single target. However, rather than delivering raw destructive force, the sand saps at the target's defenses. Upon impact, the affected enemy suffers 'Parched,' reducing their defense by 3% for 4 seconds. If the enemy is already suffering from 'Parched,' instead increases the duration by 2 seconds, up to a maximum duration of 8 seconds. The sandy gust possesses a slight wind elemental affinity, enhancing its utility in conjunction with other wind-based abilities. This ability's focus shifted towards support emphasizes debuffs and utility, rather than raw damage output.

abilities.name: Sandstorm Blades
upgrades: (Patch) Role realignment: Hitting an enemy champion with Sandstorm Blades now grants Crocodile a shield equal to 5% of his maximum health for 4 seconds. This effect can only occur once every 8 seconds.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~27%).
abilities.description: Crocodile exhales a swirling blast of sharpened sand, launching three sand blades in a targeted direction. Each blade deals X magic attack damage to the first enemy it strikes. If these blades are cast within the bounds of Crocodile's Desert Domain, the range of the blades increases by 30% and each blade inflicts 'Sandblasted' upon impact, reducing the target's movement speed by 10% per stack, up to a maximum of 30% speed reduction. This ability drains 20% of Crocodile's Sand resource, which regenerates naturally over time. Additionally, if a target struck by Sandstorm Blades is already suffering from the 'Dehydration' status effect, the impact of the blades causes them to hemorrhage, applying a Bleed effect that deals an additional Y% of the target's maximum health as true damage over 3 seconds, further punishing their lack of moisture. This bleed effect stacks additively with any other Bleed effects, but the duration does not refresh.

abilities.name: Sables
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~10% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Crocodile, with a flick of his golden hook, conjures a swirling vortex of razor-sharp sand at the targeted location within a substantial range. This localized Sables assault deals X magic atk damage every second to all enemies trapped within its sandy embrace. The relentless barrage also inflicts the 'Impaired Vision' debuff, reducing their accuracy by a staggering 10% with each tick of damage, stacking up to a maximum of 50%. The Sables persist for 5 seconds, relentlessly eroding the enemies' fighting ability. Activating this deadly spectacle consumes 40% of Crocodile's sand resource. If Crocodile is standing within his self-created Desert Domain when casting Sables, the area of effect expands significantly by 20%, amplifying the chaos. The damage inflicted by the Sables also spikes by 20%, while Crocodile himself becomes cloaked in stealth, disappearing from enemy sight within the eye of his own storm. This mastery over sand requires a cooldown period of 12 seconds before it can be unleashed again.

abilities.name: Sables
upgrades: (Patch) Role realignment: this ability now emphasizes damage-style interactions.
abilities.description: Crocodile, the master strategist and manipulator of the sands, passively emanates a field of Sables around him. Every 5 seconds, this deadly domain expands, subtly extending his influence over the battlefield. When Crocodile unleashes an ability that manipulates his sands, the domain's expansion is briefly accelerated as the sands rush to obey his command. Enemies caught within Sables have their movement speed reduced by 10%, making them easier targets for Crocodile's devastating attacks. Furthermore, they suffer X true damage per second, a relentless erosion that scales directly with Crocodile's own cunning, represented by his level. To further enhance his control over the sands, Crocodile gains 2% magic atk per second spent inside the area and 1% defense per second spent inside, stacking up to 10% and 5% respectively. The maximum size of the Sables domain is capped, growing substantially at levels 6, 11, and 16, representing Crocodile's increasing mastery over his Devil Fruit powers and his expanding ambitions.

abilities.name: Dehydration
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~9% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~17%).
abilities.description: Crocodile focuses his power to rapidly dehydrate a single target enemy. The target takes X magic atk damage and is inflicted with the 'Dehydrated' debuff for 4 seconds. While dehydrated, the target's healing received is reduced by 50%, and they take 10% increased damage from all sources. If the target is within Crocodile's Desert Domain, the duration of Dehydrated is increased by 2 seconds, and the target also suffers a stacking slow of 15% every second, up to 45% slow. This ability has an 8-second cooldown and costs 15% of his sand resource.
abilities.flavorQuote: I'll suck you dry.

abilities.name: Desert Girasole
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~46%).
abilities.description: Crocodile channels his Devil Fruit powers to summon a massive Desert Girasole at a target location. After a 2-second delay, the Girasole erupts, creating a massive sinkhole that deals X magic atk damage and pulls enemies towards the center. The area then becomes heavily infused with Desert Domain, increasing its size by 50% in that location for 10 seconds. Enemies caught in the initial sinkhole are also stunned for 1.5 seconds. Crocodile gains a shield equal to 20% of his maximum HP for the duration of the Girasole's effect. This ability has a 120-second cooldown.
abilities.flavorQuote: Witness the birth of a new desert.

character_v1.playstyle: Crocodile excels at manipulating the battlefield, creating hazards, and empowering himself within his Desert Domain. Players should focus on strategic placement and resource management to control key areas and disrupt enemy movements.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Crocodile works well with team compositions that can capitalize on his zone control and debuffs. Allies with strong burst damage can take advantage of Dehydration's damage amplification, while those with crowd control can help keep enemies inside his Sandstorm and Desert Girasole. He also benefits from teammates who can provide vision, as it allows him to safely expand his Desert Domain.
character_v1.tierSummary: Crocodile's kit is strong with scaling true damage, AoE, and debuffs centered around Desert Domain. But his reliance on Desert Domain hurts him. Moves from B+ to A-.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Crocodile's kit revolves around establishing and expanding his Desert Domain, which empowers his other abilities. Sables and Dehydration benefit from being cast within the Domain, while Sandstorm helps to control enemy movement and provides stealth. His Ultimate, Desert Girasole, drastically increases the size of his Domain, setting up devastating combos.
character_v1.bestFriendshipBuff: Increased Damage against Debuffed Enemies for Desert Domain Allies

abilities.description: Zidane dashes to a target enemy, dealing X physical damage and attempting to steal a buff. If successful, the stolen buff is applied to Zidane for 5 seconds. The chance to steal a buff is 40%, increased by 5% per stack of 'Adrenaline Rush'. If the target has no buffs, Zidane gains 2 stacks of Adrenaline Rush, up to a maximum of 5 stacks. 'Adrenaline Rush' increases Zidane's speed by 3% per stack. The dash has a short range, requiring careful positioning to reach the intended target, and can be interrupted by crowd control effects. Cooldown: 8 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Gotta be quick, or they'll catch on!

abilities.name: Swift Steal
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~33%).
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~43%).
abilities.description: Zidane, with the agility of a seasoned thief, executes a rapid series of strikes in a wide cone directly in front of him. Each enemy caught within this area of effect suffers X physical damage, reflecting the force of his expertly placed blows. But Zidane's skills go beyond mere damage; with each successful strike against an enemy, he attempts to pilfer their strength. Each enemy hit is subjected to a 25% chance for Zidane to steal one beneficial buff currently affecting them. If Zidane successfully steals a buff, that buff is immediately transferred and randomly distributed to either Zidane himself or one of his allies within a 5-unit radius, with the stolen buff retaining its original duration, up to 4 seconds, enhancing the team's overall effectiveness. However, if Zidane's attempt to steal buffs yields no results, he channels his frustration into self-preservation. Zidane generates a shield around himself that absorbs X damage, offering a bulwark against incoming attacks. This protective shield lasts for 3 seconds, allowing Zidane to reposition or continue his assault with reduced risk. The ability recharges after a cooldown period of 10 seconds.

abilities.name: Unwavering Spirit
upgrades: Grants permanent stacks of 'Enduring Theft' for each stolen buff, lasting until consumed.
abilities.description: Zidane's relentless spirit allows him to endure even the most debilitating conditions, channeling the energy of stolen buffs into formidable defenses. Whenever Zidane successfully steals a buff from an enemy, he immediately gains a stacking damage reduction buff called 'Enduring Theft', reducing incoming damage by 1% per stack. Additionally, for each unique buff Zidane currently possesses, he gains 5 bonus armor and 5 bonus magic resist. This effect stacks multiplicatively, synergizing with skills like 'Swift Steal' and 'Free Energy'. Zidane can stack 'Enduring Theft' up to a maximum of 5 times, granting a total of 5% damage reduction at maximum stacks. 'Enduring Theft' lasts for 5 seconds, after which the stacks gradually dissipate one at a time, disappearing completely after 5 seconds have elapsed since the last stack was gained. Successfully stealing another buff will refresh the remaining stacks, resetting the 5 second duration. This passive makes Zidane increasingly resilient as he accumulates and maintains stolen buffs, transforming him into a tenacious and difficult target to bring down, thriving in the thick of battle.

abilities.name: Thief's Escape
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~33%).
abilities.description: Zidane performs a quick backflip, becoming briefly untargetable and creating a smoke cloud at his previous location. Enemies within the smoke cloud are slowed by 30% for 3 seconds. After the backflip, Zidane's next basic attack within 4 seconds deals an additional X true damage. This ability offers both defensive utility and offensive potential, allowing Zidane to reposition safely while also setting up a powerful follow-up attack. The untargetable window is brief but crucial for dodging incoming high-impact abilities. Cooldown: 14 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: See ya! Wouldn't wanna be ya!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Zidane excels in teams that can capitalize on the buffs he steals and redistributes. Allies who benefit greatly from temporary stat boosts or those who can follow up on his disrupted enemies will synergize well with his playstyle.
character_v1.tierSummary: Zidane has high speed and attack but low HP and defense. A tier fits his role. Friendship campaign already exists.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Zidane's kit revolves around 'Pilfered Power,' with 'Swift Steal' and 'Free Energy' enabling his passive, 'Lucky Find.' 'Thief's Escape' offers survivability, while his ultimate, 'Dyne of Thievery,' amplifies his stealing and damage potential.
character_v1.bestFriendshipBuff: Increased Speed and Evasion for Thief Allies

abilities.name: Mist Veil
abilities.description: Kuja shrouds himself in a veil of Mist, becoming briefly untargetable and gaining a burst of movement speed. Upon activation, Kuja dashes a short distance in the targeted direction, leaving a trail of Mist that lingers for 3 seconds. Enemies who walk through the Mist take a small amount of magic damage every 0.5 seconds and have their movement speed slowed by 20%. If Kuja activates 'Trance Shift' within 2 seconds of using Mist Veil, the Trance Shift cast time is reduced by 50%. The movement speed bonus lasts for 1.5 seconds and decays rapidly. Using this ability grants 5% Trance Charge. The Mist Veil trail applies a stacking debuff, up to 3 stacks, each increasing magic vulnerability by 5%.
abilities.flavorQuote: Such fleeting beauty, concealing true intent.

abilities.description: Kuja unleashes a devastating Flare Star at a target location. After a short cast time (0.75 seconds), a massive Flare Star descends, dealing significant magic damage to enemies in a large radius. The damage is higher closer to the center of the impact. Enemies caught at the epicenter take an additional burst of true damage equal to 10% of their missing health. Successfully hitting an enemy with Flare Star grants 10% Trance Charge. If Kuja is in Trance, the cast time is reduced to 0.3 seconds and the radius of the explosion is increased by 20%. Enemies hit by Flare Star are marked with 'Stardust', increasing damage they take from subsequent spells by 15% for 4 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Behold, the brilliance of oblivion!

abilities.name: Trance Shift
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~15% and slightly longer ramp-up.

abilities.description: Kuja taps into the latent power within, transforming into his Trance state. Upon activation, Kuja consumes a full Trance bar and transforms for 15 seconds. While in Trance, Kuja's magic attack is increased by 30%, his speed is increased by 15%, but his magic defense is reduced by 20%. Additionally, while in Trance, Kuja's abilities are enhanced, gaining additional effects and reduced cooldowns. When Trance ends, Kuja suffers from 'Reversion Sickness' for 5 seconds, reducing his movement speed by 30% and preventing him from accumulating Trance Charge. Successfully damaging an enemy champion while in Trance extends the duration by 1 second, up to a maximum of 5 additional seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Feel the power... the ecstasy!

abilities.name: Terran Resonance
abilities.description: Kuja's connection to Terra grants him increased magic penetration. Kuja gains 10% Magic Penetration. Additionally, every third successful ability cast on an enemy champion applies 'Terran Resonance', dealing bonus magic damage over 3 seconds. The damage is equal to 5% of the target's maximum health. When Kuja enters Trance, 'Terran Resonance' is instantly applied to the nearest enemy champion within a 500 unit radius. If no enemy champions are nearby, the next successful ability cast will apply Terran Resonance, regardless of the ability count. If an enemy affected by Terran Resonance is damaged by Flare Star, the remaining damage is dealt instantly.
abilities.flavorQuote: The very planet echoes with my might.

abilities.description: Kuja channels the destructive power of Ultima, unleashing a torrent of magical energy. Upon activation, Kuja becomes stationary and channels for 2 seconds, during which he is immune to crowd control. After the channel, Kuja fires five bolts of Ultima in rapid succession at targeted locations within a large range. Each bolt deals high magic damage to enemies in a small radius. If Kuja is in Trance, he fires seven bolts instead of five, and each bolt applies a stack of magic vulnerability, increasing damage taken from subsequent spells by 10% per stack for 3 seconds. The channel time is reduced by 0.5 seconds while in Trance. The final bolt always targets the enemy champion with the lowest health within range.
abilities.flavorQuote: Tremble before the ultimate magic!

character_v1.playstyle: Hyper-mobile burst mage; Trance-state management; High-risk/high-reward gameplay.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Kuja excels in teams that provide crowd control and protection, allowing him to safely channel Ultima Fury and capitalize on his burst potential. He benefits from allies that can apply slows or stuns, enabling him to land Flare Star more reliably. His magic penetration also benefits other magic damage dealers on the team.
character_v1.tierSummary: Kuja moves up to B. His kit has high burst potential and utility due to Mist Veil. His stats are fairly well-rounded, and his fire/ice elemental typing provide good coverage. The move to B recognizes his sustained damage potential and overall utility.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Kuja's kit revolves around building Trance Charge and utilizing Trance Shift to amplify his damage output. Mist Veil provides mobility and sets up engagements, while Flare Star delivers burst damage. Terran Resonance enhances his sustained damage and synergizes with Flare Star. Ultima Fury serves as a powerful finisher, especially when empowered by Trance.

abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Physical.

abilities.name: Super Sniffer
abilities.description: Dudley's enhanced sense of smell grants him unparalleled awareness. Every 8 seconds, Dudley passively scans the area for the nearest enemy champion. The scanned enemy is revealed for 3 seconds. If the revealed enemy is CC'd (stunned, rooted, etc.) while revealed, Dudley gains 1 stack of Mutt Mayhem and the revealed enemy's defenses are reduced by 10% for the duration of the reveal. Subsequent scans on the same target within 15 seconds have reduced duration (1.5 seconds) and do not grant Mutt Mayhem, preventing rapid stacking from the same target. This passive also grants Dudley a permanent +10% bonus to his movement speed while moving towards revealed enemies.
abilities.flavorQuote: I smell trouble... and maybe a hot dog stand!

abilities.name: Greyhound Dash
abilities.description: Dudley utilizes his greyhound lineage to perform a rapid dash in the target direction, covering a short distance. Upon reaching the destination or colliding with an enemy champion, Dudley unleashes a small burst of energy, dealing 60 (+30% of Attack) physical damage to nearby enemies and applying a slow effect, reducing their movement speed by 20% for 1.5 seconds. If Dudley has Mutt Mayhem stacks, this ability consumes one stack to increase the slow duration by an additional 0.5 seconds per Mutt Mayhem stack consumed, up to a maximum of 3.5 seconds total slow duration. This ability has a cooldown of 10 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Gotta go fast! Zoom zoom!

abilities.name: T.U.F.F. Justice Strike
upgrades: (Bugfix) Corrected targeting behavior to ensure consistent impact on the first enemy hit.
(Tuning) Improved knockback distance and adjusted stun duration based on target size and weight.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~12% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Dudley, ever the eager agent, launches forward with a powerful, justice-fueled punch! He targets a direction, striking the first enemy encountered with righteous force, inflicting 80 physical damage plus 50% of his total Attack stat. The impact sends the hapless villain reeling backwards a substantial distance. Should this forced retreat result in a collision with a solid object such as a wall, turret, or even another supervillain, the impact stuns them for a full 1 second, leaving them vulnerable to further T.U.F.F. justice. Furthermore, the sheer thrill of serving justice empowers Dudley, granting him 2 stacks of Mutt Mayhem. Always ready to protect the innocent, Dudley also generates a temporary shield capable of absorbing up to 50 points of damage, bolstered by an additional 20% of his Attack stat. This shield lasts for 3 crucial seconds, providing a buffer while Dudley continues to uphold the law. Due to the intense effort required, this ability has a cooldown of 14 seconds before it can be used again, giving Dudley a brief moment to catch his breath before diving back into action.

abilities.name: Billy Goat Bounce
abilities.description: Dudley's unexpected billy goat DNA manifests as a high-powered jump. Dudley leaps to a targeted location, dealing 70 (+40% of Magic Attack) magic damage upon landing to nearby enemies and stunning them for 0.75 seconds. The range of the jump increases based on the number of Mutt Mayhem stacks Dudley has, with each stack increasing the jump range by 10%. Upon landing, Dudley gains 1 stack of Mutt Mayhem, regardless of whether enemies were hit. This ability has a cooldown of 16 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Boing! Did somebody order a bouncy house?

abilities.name: Mutt Mayhem Overdrive
abilities.description: Dudley fully embraces his mixed-breed nature, unleashing a flurry of chaotic energy. For 8 seconds, Dudley gains increased attack damage (40), magic attack (30), and movement speed (20%). During this period, his basic attacks apply a random debuff to enemies, chosen from: a 15% slow for 1 second, a 0.5 second stun, or a 10% attack damage reduction for 2 seconds. Additionally, during Mutt Mayhem Overdrive, Dudley generates 1 stack of Mutt Mayhem every 2 seconds. Upon expiration of the ultimate, Dudley is exhausted, reducing his movement speed by 10% for 3 seconds. This ability has a cooldown of 100 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: It's TUFF justice time! Prepare for maximum mayhem!

character_v1.playstyle: Aggressive, mobile, disrupt-focused, excels at harassing backlines and creating openings.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Dudley excels with teams that can capitalize on his disruption. Champions with follow-up CC or burst damage synergize well, allowing them to take advantage of Dudley's stuns, slows, and knockbacks.
character_v1.tierSummary: Dudley falls to F-. His kit has too much reliance on status application without sufficient damage or survivability to back it up. His stat profile is also skewed towards HP without sufficient defensive stats to make him an effective tank. His reliance on gadget points is also a downside.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Dudley's kit revolves around building and consuming Mutt Mayhem stacks. His passive and Billy Goat Bounce generate stacks, while Greyhound Dash benefits from consuming them. Malamute Muscle offers utility, and his ultimate provides a burst of stats and chaos, maximizing his effectiveness in team fights.
