abilities.description: The Chief deploys a holographic decoy of himself at a target location within a short range. Enemies entering the decoy's radius have their movement speed reduced by 30% for 3 seconds. If The Chief has at least 3 'Memory Fragments', he can consume them to enhance the decoy. Upon consumption, the decoy's radius increases by 50% and any enemy caught within its area takes 50 magic damage per second. The enhanced effect lasts 5 seconds. The holographic decoy disappears after either its duration expires or it is destroyed by enemy attacks. The Chief gains 1 'Memory Fragment' upon activation, regardless of whether fragments were consumed.
abilities.flavorQuote: They'll never see this coming!

abilities.name: Bionic Boost
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~36%).
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~15% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: The Chief slams his bionic foot down, creating a shockwave that grants him a burst of speed and temporary invulnerability. For 3 seconds, The Chief's movement speed is increased by 50% and he becomes immune to all forms of crowd control. Additionally, his next basic attack within 5 seconds deals 100 bonus true damage. This ability consumes all 'Memory Fragments' upon activation, increasing the duration of the speed boost and invulnerability by 0.5 seconds for each fragment consumed, up to a maximum of 2 seconds. After the ability ends, the Chief is stunned for 0.2 seconds for each stack consumed, representing the strain of using the Bionic Foot.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time to kick things into high gear!

abilities.name: Tax Write-Offs
upgrades: (Patch) Role realignment: this ability now emphasizes damage-style interactions.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~34%).
abilities.description: The Chief, ever the shrewd negotiator, generates 'Write-Offs' over time, representing dubious but advantageous accounting practices. The Chief gains 1 'Write-Off' every 8 seconds, accumulating up to a maximum of 6. These 'Write-Offs' expire one at a time after 12 seconds if unused, representing the audit window closing. The Chief's abilities consume or are enhanced by these 'Write-Offs', transforming questionable accounting into tangible power. For each 'Write-Off' stack The Chief possesses, his Basic Attack damage increases by 3%, as he funnels illicit gains directly into the impact of his punches. Additionally, the Chief gains 4% bonus damage on all of his damaging abilities, representing him skirting the tax code to take more value from his actions.

abilities.name: T.U.F.F. Justice Beam
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: The Chief activates the T.U.F.F. headquarters' giant monitor, targeting a large area with a powerful beam of pure, concentrated justice! After a 2-second charge-up, the beam strikes, dealing 300 magic damage to all enemies within the target area. Enemies caught in the center of the beam are stunned for 1.5 seconds. If The Chief has less than 3 'Memory Fragments' when activating this ability, the charge-up time is increased by 1 second. If The Chief has 5 'Memory Fragments', he consumes them upon activation, increasing the damage by 50% and the stun duration by 0.5 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time to bring down the hammer... or rather, the monitor!

character_v1.teamSynergy: The Chief synergizes well with teams that can capitalize on the attack and speed buffs provided by 'Order Up!'. Durable front-line fighters benefit from the increased damage output and healing from the Memory Fragments. Area-of-effect damage dealers can effectively clear enemies slowed by 'Strategic Misplacement'. His ultimate provides a powerful zoning and damage tool for coordinated team fights.
character_v1.tierSummary: The Chief moves up to D. His kit has some utility with Order Up, but Strategic Misplacement has limited impact. His stat profile is skewed towards speed, but his low defense makes him vulnerable. The D placement reflects his limited impact, but potential for niche strategies.
character_v1.internalSynergy: The Chief's kit revolves around generating and utilizing 'Memory Fragments'. His passive generates them passively and his active abilities can consume them for enhanced effects. 'Order Up!' provides a team-wide buff and applies fragments, while 'Strategic Misplacement' uses them for area control. 'Bionic Boost' is a personal mobility and damage tool that can be amplified by fragments. The ultimate benefits from having a full stack of fragments for maximum impact.

chapters.title: The Paperwork Plague
chapters.mission: Complete a series of challenges that require efficient resource management, strategic planning, and overcoming bureaucratic obstacles with a focus on buff application.
chapters.summary: The Chief teams up with Peg to tackle a mountain of paperwork threatening to shut down T.U.F.F. Their combined skills are crucial.

friendshipCampaign.overview: The Chief navigates bureaucratic nightmares alongside a dedicated ally to improve T.U.F.F.'s operational efficiency.

character_v1.name: Professor Membrane

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~36%).
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Water.

abilities.name: Hover Boots Deployment
abilities.description: Professor Membrane activates his hover boots, creating a localized field that alters terrain. Upon activation, designate a circular area. Allies within this area gain 20% increased movement speed and jump height for 4 seconds. Enemies within the area have their movement speed reduced by 15% and jump height reduced by 30% for the same duration. The terrain also becomes slightly uneven, causing melee attacks from enemies to have a 20% chance to miss within the area. This ability has a short cooldown, allowing for frequent terrain manipulation. Careful placement can disrupt enemy advances or enable allies to reach strategic positions more quickly.
abilities.flavorQuote: Mobility is merely a question of applied science!

abilities.name: Membrane Monitor
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~11% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Professor Membrane deploys a holographic monitor at a target location. The monitor acts as a mobile ward, providing vision in a small radius for 8 seconds. The monitor can also be activated remotely to emit a brief, but potent, EMP burst. This EMP deals 60 (+ 30% magic atk) magic damage to nearby enemies and silences them for 1.5 seconds. Allies near the monitor when the EMP is activated gain a shield that absorbs 50 (+20% magic atk) damage for 3 seconds. The monitor is fragile and can be destroyed by enemy attacks, but its tactical value in scouting and providing temporary protection makes it a valuable asset. The EMP functionality has a separate cooldown, encouraging strategic timing.
abilities.flavorQuote: Supervising from a distance is the key to effective management!

abilities.name: Shark Repellent System
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~41%).
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~13% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~13%).
abilities.description: Professor Membrane activates a device that emits a specialized frequency, deterring aggressive aquatic creatures. Upon activation, create a line towards the target direction, creating a field that lasts 5 seconds. Enemies that walk through this field are slowed by 40% and take 40 (+25% magic atk) magic damage per second while inside the field. Additionally, allies that traverse the field gain a 25% tenacity boost for 3 seconds. This ability is particularly effective in areas with water or against enemies with water-based attacks, and can be used both offensively and defensively to control the flow of battle and provide enhanced resilience to allies.
abilities.flavorQuote: A little preemptive defense goes a long way!

abilities.name: Eureka Protocol
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Professor Membrane, in his scientific genius, subconsciously analyzes the battlefield. Membrane gains a 'Eureka Moment' stack whenever an ally is critically wounded (below 25% health) within a 10 unit radius of him, or when an enemy uses an ultimate ability within a 15 unit radius. At three stacks, this ability is activated and he can unleash a powerful, targeted invention. The invention's effect is determined by the surrounding environment and nearby combatants. If an ally is within 5 units of the target, the invention heals them for 200 (+50% magic atk). If an enemy is within 5 units, the invention deals 150 (+40% magic atk) true damage. If neither are present, the invention creates a static field that silences enemies for 2 seconds in a 3 unit radius. Once the invention is deployed, 'Eureka Moment' stacks are reset. This ability encourages strategic positioning and rewards players for adapting to dynamic combat situations.
abilities.flavorQuote: I knew all those equations would come in handy!

abilities.name: Probing the Membrane of Reality
abilities.description: Professor Membrane focuses his scientific intellect to momentarily bend the laws of reality. Upon activation, Membrane becomes invulnerable for 1.5 seconds. Following this brief invulnerability, he designates a large area within a moderate range. After a short 1 second delay, all allies within the designated area gain 40% increased attack speed and 30% increased magic attack for 6 seconds. Enemies within the same area are subjected to a 'Scientific Anomaly', causing them to be randomly teleported a short distance (3-5 units) every 1.5 seconds for the same duration. The teleportation is unpredictable and can disrupt enemy formations or move them out of position. This ability can dramatically shift the momentum of a fight, providing a significant advantage to allies while sowing chaos among the enemy ranks. Activating this ability automatically grants Professor Membrane one 'Eureka Moment' stack.
abilities.flavorQuote: Reality is just a suggestion!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Professor Membrane synergizes well with teams that can capitalize on zone control and burst damage. Allies that can quickly follow up on the chaos created by 'Probing the Membrane of Reality' or benefit from the speed boost of 'Hover Boots Deployment' will maximize his potential. Tanky characters who can draw enemy ultimates will accelerate his Eureka stacks.
character_v1.tierSummary: Professor Membrane stays at C-. His kit has some niche utility with Eureka Protocol, but his overall damage output is low. His stat profile is fairly balanced, but lacks any particular strengths.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Professor Membrane thrives on chaos and uses it to his advantage. 'Hover Boots Deployment' and 'Shark Repellent System' control zones, setting up ambushes or creating escape routes. 'Membrane Monitor' provides vision and a defensive shield, while 'Eureka Protocol' and 'Probing the Membrane of Reality' are reactive abilities that can turn the tide of battle when used strategically.

chapters.title: The Irken Interference
chapters.mission: Defend a research lab from waves of Irken robots while gathering data to understand the anomaly.
chapters.summary: Professor Membrane enlists Dib's help to decipher strange energy readings, uncovering an Irken plot.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Professor Membrane teams up with Dib Membrane to investigate a mysterious scientific anomaly.

character_v1.name: Kirby

abilities.name: Burning Tackle
upgrades: Lv10: Damage scaling from ATK increased to 85%.
Lv50: Applies an additional stack of 'Scorched' (max 4 stacks).
Lv100: 'Scorched' reduces outgoing damage by 15% and increases Physical Vulnerability to 3% per stack.
abilities.description: Kirby, wreathed in scorching flames, launches himself forward in a short, but incredibly destructive burst, colliding with the nearest enemy! This explosive tackle deals significant Physical Damage equal to 75% of his Attack stat plus a base damage of 25 that scales linearly with level. Furthermore, the intense heat lingers, applying 'Scorched' to the target for 3 seconds. 'Scorched' reduces the target's outgoing damage by 10% whilst also applying a stacking physical vulnerability. For each stack of 'Scorched', the target takes an additional 2% damage from Physical attacks. Each Burning Tackle can stack Scorched up to 3 times, synergizing well with allies who deal Physical damage. As Kirby grows stronger, so does the blaze; at later levels, the base damage escalates faster, making Burning Tackle a reliable source of both initial burst and sustained debuffing power. This ability is designed to enhance Kirby's role as a formidable initiator and supportive tank.

abilities.name: Inhale
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~43%).
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~33%).
abilities.description: Kirby opens his mouth wide, inhaling a targeted enemy dealing a small amount of magic damage (15 + 10% magic atk) and briefly stunning them for 0.75 seconds. If the target is a minion it's instantly swallowed. Upon swallowing any unit, Kirby activates 'Copy Carousel', gaining a random Copy Ability buff for 4 seconds. This ability has a cooldown of 8 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Gulp! What'll I get this time?

abilities.name: Star Spit
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Kirby spits out a star projectile in a line, dealing moderate magic damage (40 + 30% magic atk) to enemies hit. The range of the spit is medium. If an enemy is already stunned, they take 20% increased damage from this ability. This ability has a cooldown of 6 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Ptooey! Take this!

abilities.name: Copy Carousel
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Whenever Kirby inhales a unit, he gains a random Copy Ability: Sword (increases attack by 15%), Fire (adds 10% magic atk and applies burn), Stone (grants a shield equal to 10% of Kirby's max hp), or Cutter (increases speed by 10%). These buffs last for 4 seconds, with different Copy Abilities being able to stack. There is a 1 second lockout after gaining a copy ability before another can be gained.
abilities.flavorQuote: So many powers!

abilities.name: Float
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Kirby inflates himself with air, hovering in place for up to 3 seconds. While floating, he gains increased movement speed by 20% and is immune to ground-based crowd control effects. However, while floating, Kirby cannot attack and is vulnerable to air-based attacks. Pressing the ability button again or taking damage cancels the float. The cooldown is 12 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Up, up, and away!

abilities.name: Ultimate Inhale
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Sustained Consumption: Reduced vortex pull strength by 18% and slightly increased the time it takes to reach maximum pull potency.
abilities.description: Kirby opens his mouth wide, creating a swirling vortex of pure, pink energy for 5 glorious seconds. Enemies caught in this powerful inhale are irresistibly pulled towards the famished puffball, experiencing a continuous stream of magic damage equal to 50 plus 20% of Kirby's magic attack stat every single second they remain trapped within the vortex. Should any enemy unit fully succumb to the vortex and be swallowed whole by Kirby during this ravenous display, Kirby gains a substantial protective shield. This shield valiantly absorbs damage equal to 25% of Kirby's maximum health, providing a vital buffer against incoming attacks for a duration of 8 seconds, allowing Kirby to fearlessly charge into the fray. However, such an immense act of consumption requires a significant cooldown of 90 seconds before Kirby can unleash his Ultimate Inhale once more.

character_v1.teamSynergy: Kirby excels at disrupting enemy formations and providing brief windows of opportunity for his team. His crowd control and shield generation abilities make him a valuable asset in protecting allies and initiating fights.
character_v1.tierSummary: Kirby moves up to C+. He has high HP. While his kit is straightforward, the multiple copy ability provide good versatility. He moves up slightly due to his survivability and ability to adapt to different situations.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Kirby's kit revolves around using Inhale to trigger Copy Carousel and gain temporary buffs, enhancing his combat effectiveness. Star Spit provides ranged damage, while Float offers mobility and crowd control immunity. Hypernova Inhale acts as a powerful teamfight tool.

chapters.title: The Gourmet's Gauntlet
chapters.mission: Travel through various food-themed levels, collecting ingredients and defeating enemies while maintaining a high cooking score.
chapters.summary: Kirby and Chef Kawasaki team up to create the ultimate dish, gathering ingredients and battling food monsters.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Kirby embarks on a culinary quest with a new friend, encountering delicious delights and formidable foes.

character_v1.name: Bulma

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Ice.

abilities.name: Dragon Radar Scan
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Bulma activates her Dragon Radar, scanning the battlefield for vulnerabilities. Upon activation, this ability grants all allies within a moderate radius 15% increased critical hit chance and 10% increased damage against enemies who are currently afflicted by a debuff. The effect lasts for 8 seconds. This ability costs 20 Gadget Points to activate. Additionally, if an ally scores a critical hit while under the effect of Dragon Radar Scan, Bulma gains 5 Gadget Points, up to a maximum of 15 points per activation, encouraging aggressive play from her team.
abilities.flavorQuote: Alright, let's see what you're REALLY made of!

abilities.name: Hoi-Poi Capsule Support
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~7% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Bulma deploys a Hoi-Poi Capsule, instantly summoning a supportive device that provides various buffs to nearby allies. The device can either grant a shield absorbing up to 150 (+20% of Bulma's Magic Def) damage to all allies within a small radius for 5 seconds, OR it can boost the attack speed of allies within the same radius by 20% for 5 seconds, depending on the current needs of the team. This ability consumes 30 Gadget Points and the device persists for 10 seconds before deactivating. Activating the ability again while a device is active will destroy the old device and summon a new one.
abilities.flavorQuote: Just the right tool for the job!

abilities.name: Gravity Chamber Mod
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~14% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~9% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Bulma overloads an enemy with a personalized gravity device, significantly hindering their movement and combat capabilities. When activated, this ability targets the enemy with the highest attack, reducing their speed by 30% and their attack damage by 20% for 6 seconds. However, there is a 20% chance of the device malfunctioning, reversing the effects and instead buffing the target's speed and damage. Gravity Chamber Mod costs 25 Gadget Points. If the device malfunctions, Bulma gains 10 Gadget Points, as compensation for the mishap.
abilities.flavorQuote: A little extra pressure never hurt anyone... mostly.

abilities.name: Scientific Acumen
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~35%).
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~47%).
abilities.description: Bulma's innate scientific genius allows her to rapidly create and deploy gadgets. This passive ability grants Bulma 8 Gadget Points every 3 seconds. In addition, whenever an ally uses their Ultimate ability, Bulma gains an additional 15 Gadget Points, encouraging team coordination. Furthermore, her Gadget Point maximum is increased by 25, allowing for greater resource management and strategic deployment. The ability to adapt and invent on the fly is what sets Bulma apart from other supports.
abilities.flavorQuote: Give me a wrench and a problem, and I'll give you a solution!

abilities.name: Temporal Field Disruptor
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~39%).
abilities.description: Bulma activates her most advanced invention: the Temporal Field Disruptor. Upon activation, Bulma targets an area, creating a temporal distortion that dramatically alters the flow of combat within a large radius for 10 seconds. Allies within the field gain 25% increased speed and their cooldowns are reduced by 1 second per ability used (max 5 seconds total reduction per ability). Enemies within the field have their speed reduced by 20% and their healing received is reduced by 30%. This Ultimate costs 50 Gadget Points to activate. Bulma also receives 10 Gadget Points for each ally affected by the field.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time to rewrite reality, just a little!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Bulma excels in teams that benefit from increased damage output and utility. Her buffs synergize well with damage-focused characters, while her debuffs provide valuable control against high-threat enemies. She is particularly effective in teams that can capitalize on critical hits, as Dragon Radar Scan rewards aggressive play.
character_v1.tierSummary: Bulma moves to E+. She has utility with Dragon Radar and Hoi-Poi Capsules, but her impact is limited and stats are mediocre. This placement reflects her supportive role but limited combat presence.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Bulma's Gadget Arsenal mechanic encourages active ability use and strategic gadget deployment. Scientific Acumen ensures a steady flow of Gadget Points, while Dragon Radar Scan and Hoi-Poi Capsule Support provide immediate buffs and utility. Gravity Chamber Mod offers debuffing capabilities, and Temporal Field Disruptor provides a powerful area-of-effect control and buffing ability.

chapters.title: The Chronological Conundrum
chapters.mission: Collect rare components, solve complex puzzles, and fight time-displaced enemies.
chapters.summary: Bulma teams up with Future Trunks to repair a damaged time machine and prevent a paradox.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Bulma partners with a tech-savvy hero to enhance her inventions and unravel a temporal mystery.

character_v1.name: Meta Knight

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~20%).
abilities.description: Melee basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Fire.

abilities.name: Knight's Resolve (Passive)
abilities.description: Meta Knight's unwavering resolve grants him increased resilience in battle. When Meta Knight's HP falls below 30%, he gains a shield absorbing damage equal to 15% of his maximum HP for 5 seconds. Additionally, successfully dodging an attack with i-frames grants him one stack of Knight's Honor, up to a maximum of 5 stacks. These stacks persist until consumed by other abilities. Each stack of Knight's Honor increases Meta Knight's movement speed by 3% and his attack damage by 2%. Knight's Resolve can only trigger once every 30 seconds, preventing it from being repeatedly exploited in quick succession. This ensures that Meta Knight’s low health state is strategically managed.
abilities.flavorQuote: A knight's true strength lies not in his armor, but in his spirit.

abilities.name: Mach Tornado
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~21%).
abilities.description: Meta Knight unleashes a rapid whirlwind of slashes, dealing damage to nearby enemies. Upon activation, Meta Knight becomes invulnerable for 0.75 seconds as he spins, dealing 50 + (10 per Knight's Honor stack) magic damage per second for 3 seconds to enemies within a 3-unit radius. Each tick of damage has a 10% chance to inflict a stack of 'Wind Shear,' reducing enemy armor by 5 for 4 seconds, stacking up to 3 times. Using Mach Tornado consumes all stacks of Knight's Honor. The range of this ability is limited, requiring close proximity to enemies. This ability is best used to engage groups of enemies or to provide a brief period of invulnerability while dealing sustained damage.
abilities.flavorQuote: Witness the fury of a thousand winds!

abilities.name: Dimensional Cape
abilities.description: Meta Knight utilizes his Dimensional Cape to teleport a short distance, gaining a brief window of invulnerability during the teleport. Upon activation, Meta Knight teleports up to 7 units in the targeted direction, becoming invulnerable for 0.5 seconds. If Meta Knight has at least one stack of Knight's Honor, he can choose to expend a stack to extend the teleport distance to 10 units and apply 'Shadow Strike' to the nearest enemy within 5 units of his arrival point. Shadow Strike reduces the target's movement speed by 25% for 2 seconds. Dimensional Cape has a cooldown of 8 seconds. This ability allows Meta Knight to quickly reposition himself in battle, escape danger, or engage enemies from unexpected angles.
abilities.flavorQuote: Now you see me...

abilities.name: Galaxia Slash
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~15% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Meta Knight channels the power of Galaxia into a devastating sword strike. Upon activation, Meta Knight charges for 1 second, during which he gains 25 armor and magic resist. After the charge, he unleashes a powerful slash that deals 150 + (25 per Knight's Honor stack) physical damage to enemies in a 4-unit wide cone in front of him. If the slash critically hits, it consumes all stacks of Knight's Honor and deals an additional 10% of the target's maximum HP as true damage. Galaxia Slash has a cooldown of 10 seconds. This ability is designed for dealing high burst damage to a single target, especially if a critical hit is achieved. It also provides a brief window of increased defenses during the charge-up phase.
abilities.flavorQuote: Feel the wrath of Galaxia!

abilities.name: Halberd Descent (Ultimate)
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Meta Knight summons the Battleship Halberd to bombard a targeted area with devastating cannon fire. Upon activation, Meta Knight designates a large circular area (8-unit radius). After a 2-second delay, the Halberd unleashes a barrage of energy blasts, dealing 400 + (50 per Knight's Honor stack) magic damage to enemies within the area over 4 seconds. Enemies caught in the center of the blast (3-unit radius) are stunned for 1.5 seconds. Meta Knight is granted 3 stacks of Knight's Honor upon a successful cast regardless of whether the attack landed. The area is visibly marked before the bombardment begins. Halberd Descent has a long cooldown of 90 seconds. This ability is ideal for disrupting enemy formations, controlling objectives, or providing massive area-of-effect damage in team fights.
abilities.flavorQuote: The Halberd will bring swift justice!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Meta Knight excels in teams that can capitalize on his mobility and burst damage. Teammates who provide crowd control or create openings for Galaxia Slash and Halberd Descent are highly valuable. He benefits from allies who can peel for him, allowing him to safely generate Knight's Honor and reposition with Dimensional Cape.
character_v1.tierSummary: Meta Knight goes to B+. His high attack and speed make him a dangerous offensive character. Knight's Resolve and Dimensional Cape give him survivability. His placement reflects his strong offensive potential.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Meta Knight's kit revolves around generating and expending Knight's Honor. Knight's Resolve provides initial stacks, while precise dodges maintain them. Mach Tornado benefits from accumulated stacks for damage, while Dimensional Cape uses them for enhanced mobility and debuffs. Galaxia Slash delivers burst damage, scaling with Knight's Honor for true damage on critical hits. Halberd Descent provides a powerful area-of-effect ultimate that also grants Knight's Honor.

chapters.title: The Dark Mirror Menace
chapters.mission: Navigate treacherous dungeons, solve ancient riddles, and battle formidable bosses using their combined swordsmanship.
chapters.summary: Meta Knight and Link team up to defeat a dark reflection that threatens to consume their worlds.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Meta Knight confronts a shadowy nemesis with the help of a valiant swordsman.

character_v1.name: Marx

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~18% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Melee basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Wind.

abilities.name: Jester's Flourish
upgrades: (Bugfix) Addressed an edge case where cards would occasionally vanish without dealing damage.
(Tuning) Increased the base damage from 40 to 50 and the scaling from 30% to 35% Magic Attack.
abilities.description: Marx unleashes a quartet of magical jesting cards in a wide, playful arc, each carrying a touch of whimsical chaos. These cards, propelled by Marx's magical energy, deal 40 (+30% Magic Attack) magic damage to any enemies they strike. More than just a simple attack, each card also bestows a stack of 'Giggles' upon its target, increasing the healing allies receive from Marx's subsequent actions by 8% per stack, up to a maximum of 3 stacks. Thus, a fully stacked target will receive 24% increased healing. These Giggles last for 6 seconds. Targets already burdened with three stacks of Giggles will find the duration of their existing stacks refreshed with each new card hit, ensuring a continued period of heightened healing receptiveness. The cards travel a respectable distance of 600 units, enabling Marx to influence battles from a relatively safe position. The wide spread of the cards makes it more likely that enemies in close proximity to Marx will be struck by multiple cards, accelerating the accumulation of 'Giggles' and maximizing the potential healing amplification on those nearest to the chaotic jester.

abilities.name: Vine Snare
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~31%).
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Marx disappears briefly, becoming untargetable, then reappears at a target location within a medium range. Upon arrival, he summons four thorny vines in a square pattern around the location, each dealing magic damage and rooting enemies caught within their area of effect for 1.5 seconds. If Marx reappears inside of an enemy, they are immediately rooted. This ability has a moderate cooldown, making precise placement key. The vines persist for 3 seconds after being summoned, acting as temporary obstacles that can disrupt enemy movement and set up combos.
abilities.flavorQuote: Trapped in my little garden!

abilities.name: Jester's Gambit
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~13% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~26%).
abilities.description: Marx creates two illusory copies of himself that last for 5 seconds. These illusions mimic Marx's basic movements but deal no damage. If an enemy attacks an illusion, the illusion explodes, dealing a small amount of magic damage in an area and applying a stack of 'Mischief'. This ability also grants Marx a brief burst of speed, allowing him to reposition or escape. The illusions prioritize spreading out, making it harder for enemies to distinguish the real Marx. This ability contributes to charging his 'Galactic Wish' by a flat amount per illusion created and a percentage depending on how much damage they absorb.
abilities.flavorQuote: Which one is real? Hehehe...

abilities.name: Black Hole
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~33%).
abilities.description: Marx transforms into his true form, gaining wings and increased movement speed for 8 seconds. During this time, he can activate this ability again to summon a miniature black hole at a target location. The black hole pulls enemies towards its center, dealing a large burst of magic damage to all enemies caught within its radius after 2 seconds. If an enemy has 3 stacks of 'Mischief,' they are stunned for 1 second before the black hole implodes. Transforming back to his jester form after the time limit or after activation will cause a brief moment of vulnerability.
abilities.flavorQuote: Embrace the void!

abilities.name: Galactic Wish
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~45%).
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~10% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Marx unleashes the accumulated 'Mischief' energy in a devastating attack. He flies into the air and summons a giant energy beam that strikes a wide area, dealing massive magic damage to all enemies within. The damage is increased based on the amount of 'Mischief' accumulated through previous abilities. For every stack of 'Mischief' on enemies hit by the beam, the beam deals an additional X% of true damage. After casting, Marx reverts to his jester form and has all his abilities refreshed. While channeling, Marx is vulnerable to crowd control abilities and damage.
abilities.flavorQuote: I wish for... OBLIVION!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Marx benefits from allies that can provide crowd control or peel to protect him while he channels his ultimate. Allies that can further amplify magic damage or debuff enemy magic resistance will also significantly increase his damage output. He pairs well with tanks that can initiate fights, allowing him to follow up with his burst damage.
character_v1.tierSummary: Marx drops to E-. His kit focuses on Mischief and Utility, but it suffers from low damage. While his attack stat is decent, his abilities don't make effective use of it.
appearanceTags: Jester hat with red and blue sides
Lavender skin with large purple eyes
character_v1.internalSynergy: Marx's kit revolves around building 'Mischief' on enemies to amplify the damage of his 'Black Hole' and 'Galactic Wish'. 'Crescent Slash' is his primary source of 'Mischief', while 'Vine Snare' can be used to set up easy hits. 'Jester's Gambit' provides an escape and additional 'Mischief' application, and 'Black Hole' provides mobility and burst when transformed.

chapters.title: The Cosmic Comedy Caper
chapters.mission: Complete a series of pranks, solve absurdist puzzles, and battle confused adversaries.
chapters.summary: Marx and Discord create interdimensional chaos, causing mayhem across multiple realities.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Marx teams up with a prankster to unleash chaos, mixing magic and mischief.

abilities.name: Artistic Inspiration

abilities.description: Adeleine's artistic talent grants her unique benefits based on her current Palette Swap. While in Red Palette, her summoned creations gain 15% increased attack damage and 10% lifesteal. In Blue Palette, summons gain a shield equal to 10% of Adeleine's max HP and reflect 5% of incoming damage back to attackers. In Yellow Palette, summons gain 20% increased movement speed and their attacks have a 15% chance to inflict stun for 1 second. Additionally, Palette Swaps empower Adeleine's basic attacks, granting them bonus magical damage equal to 5% of her magic attack, scaling with the corresponding palette's attribute (Lifesteal for Red, Damage Reflect for Blue, Stun Chance for Yellow).
abilities.flavorQuote: Every stroke holds the power to inspire.

abilities.name: Canvas Creation: Bronto Burt
abilities.description: Adeleine expends 60 mana to paint a Bronto Burt, summoning it to fight for her. The Bronto Burt lasts for 15 seconds and attacks nearby enemies, dealing physical damage. While in Red Palette, Bronto Burt gains increased attack range and deals fire damage with each attack. In Blue Palette, the Bronto Burt becomes a 'Frost Burt', slowing enemies hit and having increased HP. In Yellow Palette, the Bronto Burt becomes a 'Blitz Burt', gaining increased attack speed and having a chance to deal electric damage which can chain to nearby enemies.  The summoned Bronto Burt inherits 30% of Adeleine's Attack Damage and 15% of her HP, providing a reliable source of sustained damage and disruption.
abilities.flavorQuote: A little flutter can cause quite the stir!

abilities.name: Palette Shift
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~9% and slightly longer ramp-up.

abilities.description: Adeleine focuses her artistic energy to shift her Palette, choosing between Red, Blue, or Yellow. This ability has a 10 second cooldown. Red Palette increases the attack damage of summons, grants them lifesteal and makes Adeleine's basic attacks heal her for 2% of the damage dealt. Blue Palette grants shields to summons, reflects damage, and grants Adeleine damage reduction. Yellow Palette increases summon movement speed, grants them a chance to stun, and grants Adeleine a burst of movement speed upon using this ability. This ability is crucial for adapting to various combat situations and maximizing the effectiveness of her summoned creations.
abilities.flavorQuote: Colors can change the world in an instant.

abilities.name: Canvas Creation: Ice Dragon
abilities.description: Adeleine expends 90 mana to paint an Ice Dragon, summoning it to fight for her. The Ice Dragon lasts for 20 seconds and attacks enemies with freezing breath, dealing magic damage in a cone. While in Red Palette, the Ice Dragon's breath also inflicts burn damage over time. In Blue Palette, the Ice Dragon's breath freezes enemies in place for a short duration and applies a stacking slow effect. In Yellow Palette, the Ice Dragon's breath becomes a burst of icy wind, knocking back enemies and creating a temporary zone that increases ally movement speed. The summoned Ice Dragon inherits 40% of Adeleine's Magic Attack and 20% of her HP, providing powerful ranged control and damage.
abilities.flavorQuote: A touch of frost can freeze the battlefield.

abilities.name: Masterpiece: Crystal Shards
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~14% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Adeleine channels her artistic power to create a stunning Crystal Shard painting, summoning a barrage of crystal shards that rain down on a target area over 5 seconds. Each shard deals magic damage and applies a debuff based on her current Palette. In Red Palette, shards explode on impact, dealing additional area-of-effect fire damage. In Blue Palette, shards create small ice patches that slow enemies. In Yellow Palette, shards electrify the ground, dealing continuous electric damage and stunning enemies that remain in the area for too long. The Crystal Shards deal damage scaling with Adeleine's magic attack, making it a devastating ultimate ability for both damage and crowd control. (120 second cooldown)
abilities.flavorQuote: Behold, the power of art in its purest form!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Adeleine synergizes well with teams that benefit from sustained damage, area control, and disruption. Her summons can provide additional damage and tanking capabilities, while her Crystal Shards ultimate can be used to initiate fights or peel for allies. Her Palette Swaps allow her to adapt to the needs of her team, providing increased damage, crowd control, or utility as needed.
character_v1.tierSummary: Adeleine's kit is overloaded with palette swaps, hindering consistent performance. Summons are weak and scaling is slow. Moved to F+ due to slight outplay potential.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Adeleine's kit revolves around strategically utilizing Palette Swaps to enhance her summoned creations and adapt to different combat scenarios. The synergy between her passive and active abilities allows for versatile playstyles, whether focusing on sustained damage with Red Palette, control with Blue Palette, or mobility and disruption with Yellow Palette.

chapters.title: The Palette of Dreams

chapters.summary: Adeleine and Bob Ross combine their artistic skills to create a world of tranquility and overcome obstacles.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Adeleine collaborates with a fellow artist to bring worlds to life through their combined artistic talents.

abilities.description: Mike gains 1 stack of 'Cartography' every 8 seconds, up to a maximum of 10 stacks. When Mike is at maximum Cartography stacks, his movement speed increases by 15% and his next basic attack deals 50 bonus true damage, consuming all Cartography stacks in the process. This passive encourages strategic positioning and awareness of the surrounding environment, rewarding players who actively explore and adapt to the ever-changing layout of the battlefield, mirroring the Backrooms' unpredictable nature.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Every corner holds a secret...or a threat."

If no Cartography stacks are available, this ability cannot be cast. The revealed area provides vision over walls and through bushes. This ability allows Mike to strategically control areas of the map, hindering enemy movement and making them more vulnerable to attacks, replicating the act of mapping and understanding the environment for survival.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Let's see what's lurking in the dark."

abilities.name: Almond Water Ration
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Mike consumes a ration of Almond Water, instantly healing himself for 15% of his maximum health and providing a shield that absorbs damage equal to 10% of his maximum health for 3 seconds. Mike expends 2 Cartography stacks to increase the healing and shield amount by 50%. If no Cartography stacks are available, only the base healing and shield are applied. This ability offers Mike a crucial sustain option, allowing him to recover from damage and protect himself from incoming attacks, mirroring the resourcefulness required to survive within the Backrooms by utilizing found supplies.
abilities.flavorQuote: "A little hope in a bottle."

abilities.name: Makeshift Trap
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~18%).
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Mike expends 4 Cartography stacks to place a makeshift trap at a target location. After a 1-second arming time, the trap becomes invisible. If an enemy steps on the trap, they are rooted for 1.5 seconds and take 80 magic damage plus 10% of Mike's magic attack. If no Cartography stacks are available, the trap can still be placed but has a 5-second arming time and deals 50% reduced damage. The trap lasts for 30 seconds or until triggered. This ability allows Mike to control enemy movement and create strategic chokepoints, reflecting the use of ingenuity and resourcefulness to create defenses against the Backrooms' entities.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Surprise!"

abilities.name: Sanctuary Beacon

abilities.description: Mike throws a Sanctuary Beacon to a target location, creating a safe zone with a radius of 500 units for 8 seconds. Allies within the safe zone gain 25% damage reduction and are cleansed of all crowd control effects upon entering. Additionally, Mike expends all remaining Cartography stacks to enhance the safe zone. For each Cartography stack consumed, the duration of the safe zone is increased by 0.5 seconds and allies inside gain 5% increased damage. This ability provides a powerful defensive and supportive tool, allowing Mike and his team to create a temporary haven amidst the chaos of battle, reminiscent of finding a moment of respite within the treacherous Backrooms.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Hold the line! We're safe here... for now."

character_v1.teamSynergy: Mike synergizes well with teams that benefit from vision control, debuffs, and sustain. His ability to reveal areas of the map and slow/debuff enemies makes him a valuable asset for aggressive carries and burst damage dealers. The 'Sanctuary Beacon' ultimate provides a crucial defensive tool, protecting allies from damage and crowd control, making him a strong support for vulnerable teammates.
character_v1.tierSummary: Mike's kit relies heavily on utility that scales poorly. Low stats and inconsistent damage. Promoted to F+ due to niche utility.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Mike's kit revolves around strategically gaining and utilizing Cartography stacks to enhance his abilities. 'Scavenger's Intuition' provides the primary method of generating stacks, rewarding map awareness. 'Survey the Territory' and 'Makeshift Trap' allow Mike to control areas of the map and debuff enemies, while 'Almond Water Ration' offers crucial sustain. 'Sanctuary Beacon' serves as a powerful ultimate, providing a temporary haven for his team and further scaling with accumulated Cartography stacks.

chapters.title: Unexpected Guidance

chapters.summary: Mike encounters Professor Membrane, who analyzes Mike's resourcefulness. Membrane mentors Mike to improve his trap efficiency and utilize his environment for defense.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Mike struggles to find his place, until he meets a veteran survivor.

abilities.flavorQuote: Just passing through, don't mind me!

abilities.flavorQuote: Take a breather, you deserve it.

abilities.description: Phoebe rummages through the environment, 'finding' a random item from the Backrooms. This item can be one of several possibilities, such as Almond Water (instantly heals 100 HP), a Flashlight (reveals stealthed enemies in a 10-unit radius for 5 seconds), or a Makeshift Weapon (grants 50 bonus attack damage for 4 seconds). The item is immediately granted to Phoebe's nearest ally. The type of item found is influenced by Phoebe's Luck stat; higher Luck increases the chance of finding rarer and more powerful items. Cooldown: 20 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Oh, I think you dropped this!

abilities.name: Ephemeral Echo
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Reduced peak slow potency by approximately 7% and slightly increased the time required to fully charge the resonance.
(Patch) Role Adjustment: Enhanced synergy with all abilities to promote fluid combo-based gameplay.
abilities.description: Phoebe dances on the edge of reality, accumulating 'Fractured Resonance' over time. She passively gains 1 stack of Fractured Resonance every 2 seconds, mirroring her inherent instability. Engaging actively with her abilities, such as casting 'Reality Shear' or positioning aggressively within a 4-unit radius of enemy champions, accelerates this accumulation, granting bonus stacks. Upon reaching 50 Fractured Resonance stacks, Phoebe's next basic attack unleashes a fleeting echo of fractured space around the target. This momentary distortion slows the affected enemy by 30% for a duration of 1.5 seconds, hindering their escape or counter-attack. After the resonance is expended, the accumulation process restarts anew. Should Phoebe disengage from combat, remaining outside of active engagements for more than 5 seconds, the accumulated Fractured Resonance will gently decay at a rate of 1 stack per second, representing the fading of her connection to the disrupted reality. This rewards proactive play while punishing passive timidity.

abilities.name: Mega Flicker
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Phoebe unleashes a localized 'Mega Flicker,' warping reality in a large area (15-unit radius) around her. Allies within the area become briefly invulnerable for 2 seconds and gain 40% increased damage. Enemies within the area are disoriented, causing their attacks to have a 30% chance to miss and reducing their movement speed by 25% for 4 seconds. After the Mega Flicker ends, a 'residual instability' remains for 3 seconds, healing allies for 20 HP per second and damaging enemies for 15 HP per second. This ultimate has a long cooldown of 90 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Things are about to get…weird.

character_v1.playstyle: Mobile, strategic support focused on manipulating the environment and providing temporary safe zones for allies.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Phoebe excels in teams that benefit from her strategic positioning, environmental control, and item support. Carries can utilize the damage buff from Mega Flicker and the items from Lost and Found to secure kills, while tanks appreciate the protection of Safe Haven. Her ability to disrupt enemy formations with Reality Shift and Flicker Step makes her a valuable asset in both offensive and defensive scenarios.
character_v1.tierSummary: Phoebe has good utility and mobility but lacks damage output and is too squishy. Moves to D because she can heal.
appearanceTags: Carries a bundle of red balloons
Has short, choppy brown hair with heterochromia (one blue eye, one green eye)
character_v1.internalSynergy: Phoebe's abilities synergize around accumulating Reality Glitch stacks to enhance her supportive and disruptive capabilities. Her mobility from Reality Shift allows her to quickly reposition and gather stacks, while Safe Haven provides essential protection and healing. Lost and Found adds an element of surprise and utility, and Mega Flicker serves as a powerful team-fight ultimate.

chapters.title: Hidden Pathways
chapters.mission: Guide a caravan of survivors through a series of increasingly unstable rifts. Protect them from the entities that lurk within, using Phoebe's abilities to create safe zones and manipulate the environment.
chapters.summary: Phoebe discovers a series of interconnected rifts leading to different points in the Backrooms. She experiments with her ability to stabilize these glitches to create shortcuts.
chapters.bondRewardHint: Phoebe's notes on Reality Shifting, detailing her strategies for creating temporary safe zones.

friendshipCampaign.overview: A short friendship arc that lets you see how Phoebe interacts with the rest of the roster.
bondPerks: Low bond: minor stat bump when queued with at least one ally from a different franchise.
Mid bond: gain a small shield whenever you cast your ultimate alongside any support ally.
Max bond: once per fight, survive a lethal hit with 1 HP when standing near an ally.
friendshipCampaign.dailyNode: A short repeatable mission where Phoebe runs joint drills with random allies to farm bond XP and a small amount of upgrade currency.

abilities.name: Sudden Tentacle Barrage

abilities.description: Sudden Tentacle Barrage – a terrifying display of Irken might (or…something like that). Zim, fueled by unbridled confidence and a touch of madness, unleashes a torrent of rapidly extending and retracting tentacles from his PAK. These appendages, previously unseen and likely of questionable origin, lash out with surprising force in a cone directly in front of him. Each tentacle strike deals moderate physical damage, with a small chance to inflict the 'Confused' status, disorienting enemies with the sheer absurdity of the attack. The number of tentacles unleashed, and therefore the total damage potential, scales dynamically with both Zim's ATK stat and a hidden 'Nerves' stat representing his current level of panic and excitement. Note: The 'Confused' status is purely psychological; the enemy simply questions their life choices. Furthermore, the barrage also leaves a slimy, glistening residue on the ground that slightly slows enemies who traverse it. This ability embodies the unpredictable nature of Invader Zim, offering a mix of damage, crowd control (of sorts), and sheer, unadulterated weirdness.
abilities.flavorQuote: Behold! The might of my... tentacles of doom!

abilities.name: GIR, ATTACK!
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~44%).
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~10% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Zim commands GIR to charge towards a target direction. GIR moves quickly in a straight line, stopping upon hitting an enemy hero or terrain. If GIR hits an enemy hero, he explodes in a burst of cupcakes and sprinkles, dealing 80 + (30% Magic ATK) magic damage and stunning the target for 1 second. If GIR doesn't hit anything, he continues moving until his timer expires, then he explodes. The damage and stun duration are increased by 0.5% per stack of Operation Impending Doom, up to a maximum of 50%. After exploding, GIR is incapacitated for 15 seconds before returning to Zim. The range is 500 units, and the cooldown is 18 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: GIR! DO SOMETHING USEFUL!

abilities.name: Defective Cloaking Device
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~11% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Zim, in his infinite (and often misguided) genius, activates his experimental cloaking device. For 3 glorious seconds, Zim phases almost entirely out of view, granting him near invisibility and boosting his movement speed by a desperate 15% as he desperately tries to reposition himself for a strategic advantage. The problem? The device is prone to malfunction. Upon flickering back into existence, the device emits a cloud of horribly caustic fumes, inflicting anyone foolish enough to be nearby with a lingering Irken Poison. This initial burst of noxious fumes deals 50 plus 20% of Zim's Magic Attack as magic damage to all enemies within a moderate radius. The lingering poison continuously deals damage; 10 plus 5% of Zim's Magic Attack as magic damage every second for 5 agonizing seconds. What's worse? The effect can stack up to 3 times, refreshing the duration each time, exacerbating the suffering. If Zim is actively furthering Operation Impending Doom with stacks of the 'Operation Impending Doom' ability, each stack of operation impending doom increases the applied Irken Poison by 1 additional damage per second, amplifying the horror of this defective technology. The cloaking device requires a lengthy recharge after use, inflicting a 15 second cooldown before Zim can once more utilize its questionable benefits.

abilities.name: Invasion Plans
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: Toxin duration reduced by 0.5 seconds.
(Patch) Role Realignment: Now grants allies hit by the toxin a 10% damage increase for 3 seconds.
abilities.description: Zim, the magnificent planner that he is, passively accumulates 'Plans' every 1.5 seconds, reaching a maximum capacity of 100. These Plans, representing his meticulously crafted (yet often flawed) strategies, amplify the effectiveness of Zim's abilities, offering a variety of enhancements. Each ability benefits uniquely from these plans, enhancing its primary function, from weakening enemies to bolstering allies. At maximum Plans, Zim's next auto-attack becomes a 'Master Plan', delivering a debilitating toxin. This toxin causes enemies to suffer 10% reduced outgoing damage for 3 seconds. Once the Master Plan is executed, all Plan stacks are reset, compelling Zim to concoct new schemes and strategies, ensuring he remains a constant strategic threat and support to his team. This passive rewards careful timing and resource management, pushing Zim to make every auto attack count.

abilities.name: Gir Deployment Sequence
upgrades: The area of effect from each Gir impact increases, spreading the chaos further.
abilities.description: Zim cackles madly, pausing for 2 seconds to establish a vital tactical advantage – namely, the summoning of GIR! A targeted area, reaching up to 700 units away, becomes the focal point for Gir's chaotic arrival. Over the subsequent 4 seconds, Gir rains down from the sky in not one, not two, but ten separate instances of utter pandemonium. Each Gir impact deals 50 magic damage, scaling with an additional 25% of Zim's Magic Attack, to all enemies caught within the blast radius of each chaotic landing. To add insult to injury, each individual Gir subjects enemies to a brief 0.25-second stun, disrupting their plans. However, the true brilliance of this maneuver lies in its synergy with Zim’s 'Operation Impending Doom' passive. For every stack of 'Operation Impending Doom' currently active on Zim, the duration of the stun inflicted by each Gir landing increases by 0.5 seconds. This means a fully stacked Doom ability will extend the gir-inflicted stun to a whopping 2.75 seconds!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Zim works well with allies who can lockdown enemies or force them into specific areas. Allies with strong crowd control or engage tools can help ensure enemies trigger his traps, maximizing his damage output. Supports who can provide vision are also valuable, allowing Zim to safely deploy his Voot Cruisers.
character_v1.tierSummary: Zim has some burst potential but is held back by low survivability and reliance on GIR. Moved to E for potential burst.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Zim's kit revolves around strategically placing traps with Voot Cruiser Deployment and punishing enemies who trigger them. GIR's charge can disrupt enemy formations, setting them up for the rubber piggy barrage. The Invisi-Suit allows Zim to reposition and apply poison, adding to his area denial capabilities.

chapters.title: Interspecies Cooperation (For Doom!)
chapters.mission: Repair the Friendship Ray by collecting scattered components from across the map while battling mutated squirrels and malfunctioning robots.
chapters.summary: Zim attempts to build a 'Friendship Ray' to brainwash Dib, but it malfunctions and creates a series of increasingly bizarre anomalies that they must fix together.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Zim, realizing the need for interspecies understanding (to better conquer Earth, of course), begrudgingly partners with Dib. Hilarity and near-disasters ensue as they try to 'bond' over science projects and paranormal investigations.

abilities.name: Hunnycomb Barrier

This Hunny Pot applies a slowing aura to enemies within a 3-unit radius, reducing their movement speed by 15% and their attack speed by 10%. The 'Hunny Pot' also provides vision in the area. Up to 3 Hunny Pots can be active at any given time. If Pooh creates a fourth Hunny Pot, the oldest one disappears. The cooldown on this ability is 12 seconds, reduced by 1 second for each 'Sweet Sustenance' stack Pooh has when the ability is cast. abilities.flavorQuote: "Sometimes, the smallest things take up the most room in your heart."

abilities.name: Sticky Situation

abilities.description: Pooh causes all active 'Hunny Pots' to explode in a burst of sticky hunny. Enemies within a 4-unit radius of each exploded pot are rooted for 0.75 seconds, and allies gain 5% damage reduction for 3 seconds. The radius of the explosion is increased by 0.25 units for each stack of 'Sweet Sustenance' Pooh has. This ability provides a potent crowd control effect and a temporary defensive buff to allies. The dual-purpose nature of this ability allows Pooh to both protect his team and disrupt enemy engagements, making him a formidable force in team fights. This ability has a cooldown of 15 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: "We'll be friends forever, won't we, Pooh?' asked Piglet. 'Even longer,' Pooh answered."

abilities.name: Hunnycomb Buffet
abilities.description: Pooh consumes a 'Hunnycomb', granting himself and the nearest ally within a 6-unit radius a burst of healing. The healing amount is equal to 8% of Pooh's maximum HP, scaling with 2% of Pooh's Defense. In addition to the heal, both Pooh and the ally gain 10% increased movement speed for 4 seconds. If no ally is nearby, the healing effect is increased by 50% on Pooh. This ability provides immediate sustain and mobility to Pooh and his allies. It encourages Pooh to position himself strategically to maximize the healing benefits for his team. The cooldown is 10 seconds, reduced by 0.5 seconds per 'Sweet Sustenance' stack.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Eating honey is a very good thing to do."

character_v1.teamSynergy: Pooh excels in teams that benefit from sustained healing and damage mitigation. His abilities synergize well with damage-heavy carries who need protection and benefit from attack speed or magic attack buffs. His crowd control resistance also makes him a valuable asset against teams with heavy CC.
character_v1.tierSummary: Winnie the Pooh's high HP and sustain, combined with control abilities, make him a strong tank. Moved to B+ tier because of his role as a tank.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Pooh's kit revolves around absorbing damage to fuel his supportive abilities. 'A Bear of Little Brain' generates Hunny Pots, which are then consumed by 'Rumbly in My Tumbly' for healing and shielding. 'Thinking, Thinking, Thinking' accelerates Hunny Pot generation while slowing enemies, facilitating setup. 'Hunny Pot Toss' provides versatile buffs or debuffs, and 'Expotition to the North Pole' offers team-wide support, making Pooh a resilient and valuable tank.

chapters.title: The Case of the Missing Hunny
chapters.mission: Survive waves of enemies in the haunted forest. Protect Courage as he investigates clues.
chapters.summary: Pooh and Courage must navigate a haunted forest filled with spooky creatures, using Courage's bravery and Pooh's simple wisdom to solve puzzles and find clues leading to the missing hunny.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Pooh finds himself lost and confused in a new world, desperately searching for hunny. He stumbles upon Courage the Cowardly Dog, who is equally scared and confused. Together, they must overcome their fears to find Pooh's hunny and return home.

character_v1.name: Gaz

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Ice.

abilities.name: Vampire Piggies Fury
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~14% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Gaz summons a pixelated horde of Vampire Piggies that charge forward in a line, dealing 80 magic damage to all enemies they pass through. For each enemy hit, Gaz gains 1 stack of 'Rage Quit'. If 'Rage Quit' stacks are at maximum (5 stacks), consuming them empowers the Piggies, causing them to inflict 'Fear' for 1.5 seconds upon impact, in addition to the damage. This ability has a range of 600 units and a cooldown of 8 seconds. Any ally hit by the Piggies gains a shield for 5% of their max HP, lasting for 3 seconds. The width of the Vampire Piggies is narrow, rewarding accuracy.
abilities.flavorQuote: My high score... is at stake!

abilities.name: Game Over Screen
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~15%).
abilities.description: Gaz projects a holographic 'Game Over' screen in a target area (250 unit radius), lasting for 5 seconds. Enemies within the area have their movement speed reduced by 30% and attack speed reduced by 20%. If Gaz consumes 3 stacks of 'Rage Quit' upon casting, the 'Game Over' screen also silences enemies for 1 second upon initial entry. This area persists, and deals 30 magic damage per second to those within. Allies that walk through it receive a 15% speed boost for 2 seconds. Cooldown: 12 seconds. The screen's visuals are customizable with various retro game designs.
abilities.flavorQuote: You... are out of lives.

abilities.name: Pizza Shield
abilities.description: Gaz creates a protective barrier of sentient pizza slices around herself or a targeted ally, providing a shield that absorbs up to 200 damage. The shield lasts for 4 seconds. If the shield breaks before the duration ends, the pizza slices launch towards the nearest enemy, dealing 60 true damage and applying a 'Pizza Grease' debuff that reduces healing received by 15% for 3 seconds. Consuming 2 'Rage Quit' stacks enhances the shield, increasing its absorption to 350 damage and extending its duration by 1 second. Cooldown: 10 seconds. If cast on Dib, shield potency increases by 20%.
abilities.flavorQuote: Get behind the pizza!

abilities.name: Rage Quit
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~13% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~16% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Whenever Gaz takes damage exceeding 10% of her maximum HP, or if an enemy damages a nearby pizza (within 300 units), she gains a stack of 'Rage Quit', up to a maximum of 5 stacks. Each stack increases her magic resistance by 5%. Upon reaching maximum stacks, Gaz's next basic attack becomes empowered, dealing 50 bonus magic damage and applying a 1-second stun. Successfully stunning an enemy with the empowered attack consumes all stacks and grants Gaz 20% increased movement speed for 3 seconds. The bonus damage scales by 10% per level.
abilities.flavorQuote: I'm... getting... ANGRY!

abilities.name: God Mode
upgrades: (Patch) Role realignment: this ability now emphasizes support-style interactions.
abilities.description: Gaz, with a dismissive flick of her wrist, activates the ultimate cheat code. For 7 seconds, she ascends to 'God Mode', granting her complete awareness of the battlefield. All enemy hero locations are revealed on the minimap, and Gaz gains the ability to anticipate their next move, seeing a subtle visual 'tell' for each enemy ability being prepared. Furthermore, during God Mode, all of Gaz's ability cooldowns are reduced by 50%, allowing her to unleash a flurry of counter-attacks. Should Gaz successfully 'counter' an enemy ability by casting an appropriate response ability within 0.5 seconds of the enemy’s ability firing, she not only receives a full cooldown refund on her countering ability, but also inflicts 'Digital Static' upon the countered foe. This debilitating status effect reduces the enemy’s damage output by 20% for 4 seconds, representing their momentary system crash. Consuming all stacks of Rage Quit before activation boosts God Mode's duration to a formidable 10 seconds. Cooldown: 90 seconds.

character_v1.teamSynergy: Gaz synergizes well with teams that can capitalize on her zone control and debuffs. Allies that benefit from increased speed or can follow up on her stuns are particularly effective. She excels at peeling for carries and disrupting enemy engagements, making her a valuable asset in team fights. Characters who can set up chokepoints or amplify her crowd control effects will greatly enhance her overall effectiveness.
character_v1.tierSummary: Gaz has a decent mix of damage and control with a strong ultimate, but is unreliable due to Rage Quit mechanic. Down to C- because her kit is difficult.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Gaz's kit revolves around manipulating the battlefield and punishing enemies who invade her space. 'Vampire Piggies Fury' and 'Game Over Screen' allow her to control zones and generate 'Rage Quit' stacks. 'Pizza Shield' provides protection and a means to retaliate, while 'Rage Quit' passive empowers her attacks and increases her survivability. 'Omniscient Gamer' allows her to perfectly counter enemy plays, capitalizing on her strategic knowledge.

chapters.title: The Quest for the High Score
chapters.mission: Compete in a series of mini-games to earn tokens. Use the tokens to unlock the final challenge and defeat the arcade champion.
chapters.summary: Gaz and Marceline travel to a hidden arcade, facing challenges that test their gaming skills and their ability to work together. They must defeat the arcade's champion to claim the legendary game.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Gaz partners with Marceline from Adventure Time, recognizing a kindred spirit in their shared love for independence and disdain for social norms. Together, they embark on a quest to find the ultimate video game.

character_v1.name: Toothless

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction

abilities.description: Melee basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Fire.

abilities.name: Plasma Barrage
abilities.description: Toothless unleashes a rapid volley of five plasma blasts in a cone-shaped area in front of him. Each blast deals 30 (+30% Magic Attack) magic damage. If 'Wingman' is active, the cone angle widens by 20%, and each blast has a 15% chance to inflict 'Scorched' dealing an additional 5 (+5% Magic Attack) fire damage over 3 seconds. Cooldown: 8 seconds. This ability is excellent for quickly applying damage to multiple enemies in a team fight or clearing minion waves, proving Toothless's ability to adapt his offensive strategy.
abilities.flavorQuote: Here comes the boom!

abilities.name: Echolocation Pulse
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Toothless emits a pulse of sonic energy, granting vision in a large radius around him for 5 seconds and revealing stealthed enemies. Enemies within the pulse's radius are also slowed by 25% for 2 seconds. If 'Wingman' is active, the slow is increased to 40% and the vision duration is extended to 7 seconds. Cooldown: 12 seconds. This ability serves as a powerful tool for scouting ahead, revealing enemy ambushes, and providing crucial information for the team, emphasizing Toothless's awareness and support capabilities.
abilities.flavorQuote: Seeing through the shadows!

abilities.name: Plasma Bolt Burst
upgrades: (Bugfix) Corrected an issue where the ability would occasionally fail to trigger damage on multiple enemies.
abilities.description: Toothless, with a surge of draconic energy, launches himself forward a moderate distance, becoming a fleeting shadow, completely untargetable for the duration of the dash. As he streaks across the battlefield, if he collides with an enemy, he unleashes a concentrated burst of plasma energy, inflicting 75 (+55% Magic Attack) magic damage. Furthermore, if 'Wingman' is active, the plasma burst intensifies, increasing the damage by 25%, and immediately after the swift passage, Toothless gains a protective shield formed from condensed dragonfire, absorbing 55 (+25% Magic Attack) damage for a duration of 3 seconds, deflecting incoming attacks. This ability allows Toothless to rapidly close the distance, weave through enemy lines, and strike with surprising force, all while maintaining an element of surprise and bolstering his defenses. Cooldown: 10 seconds. Toothless's plasma bolt burst embodies his cunning and agility, allowing him to navigate the battlefield with speed and precision, turning the tide of battle with a swift, decisive strike.

abilities.name: Wingman
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~16% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: While within 500 units of at least one ally, Toothless gains 10% increased movement speed and his abilities deal 10% more damage. Additionally, if an ally within the radius takes damage exceeding 20% of their maximum health, Toothless gains 25% increased attack speed for 5 seconds. This passive reinforces Toothless's synergy with his team, rewarding coordinated play and strategic positioning, emphasizing the heart of his fighting style.
abilities.flavorQuote: Together, we're unstoppable!

abilities.name: Night Fury Plasma Barrage
upgrades: Increase the damage shield's absorption by 50 (+10% Magic Attack).
Reduce the channel time by 0.25 seconds.
Increase the duration of 'Night Fury's Wrath' by 1 second.
Grant Toothless 20% damage reduction during the channel.
abilities.description: Toothless focuses his draconic energy, gathering power for 1.5 seconds as he prepares to unleash a concentrated barrage of plasma blasts. During this channel, Toothless is immobile but gains a damage shield that absorbs up to 300 (+60% Magic Attack) damage. Once fully charged, Toothless fires a series of five plasma bolts in a narrow cone in front of him, each dealing 75 (+25% Magic Attack) magic damage to the first enemy hit. Each bolt also inflicts 'Night Fury's Wrath', reducing the target's magic resistance by 15% for 4 seconds, stacking up to three times. If 'Wingman' is active, the cone's area widens, covering a greater range, and each plasma bolt applies a brief stun for 0.5 seconds. Cooldown: 90 seconds. This ultimate ability allows Toothless to control the battlefield, weakening magical defenses and potentially stunning enemies in a large area, turning him into a powerful supportive and offensive force.

character_v1.teamSynergy: Toothless synergizes well with tanky allies who can engage and draw aggro, allowing him to safely deal damage from range and utilize his 'Alpha Strike' to finish off low-health targets. Allies with crowd control abilities can set up enemies for 'Plasma Barrage'.
character_v1.tierSummary: Toothless boasts high attack and speed, coupled with a mix of ranged damage and utility. His weakness is lack of sustain. B- tier for damage.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Toothless' kit revolves around positioning and team coordination, 'Echolocation Pulse' provides vision for 'Night Fury Dive' engagement, which can be followed up by a burst of damage from 'Plasma Barrage'. 'Alpha Strike' serves as an execute after enemies are weakened.

chapters.title: Lost in Translation
chapters.mission: Guide Toothless and Stitch through the jungle. Solve puzzles using their unique abilities and defeat hostile creatures.
chapters.summary: Toothless and Stitch must navigate a dense jungle, overcoming communication barriers and environmental hazards. They use Stitch's chaotic energy and Toothless's senses to find a way out.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Toothless, separated from Hiccup, finds an unlikely ally in Stitch. Their combined ingenuity and unique abilities are needed to return Toothless home.

character_v1.name: Puppycorn

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
