Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~17% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Wind.

abilities.name: Corn Cannon
abilities.description: Puppycorn launches a volley of corn kernels in a cone-shaped area in front of him, dealing 80 (+30% Magic ATK) magic damage to enemies hit. For each stack of 'Zoomies' Puppycorn has, the number of kernels increases by 1, up to a maximum of 5 additional kernels. Each kernel applies a stack of 'Buttered Up', reducing the target's speed by 5% for 3 seconds, stacking up to 3 times. If Puppycorn has 5 stacks of 'Zoomies' upon casting this ability, the kernels also have a 25% chance to inflict 'Kernel Blindness', causing the target to miss their next basic attack. Applies on hit effects at 25% effectiveness.
abilities.flavorQuote: Pop pop! Get corned!

abilities.name: Puppy Pounce
abilities.description: Puppycorn excitedly pounces towards a target ally, granting them 20% increased movement speed and a 15% damage buff for 4 seconds. If Puppycorn has any stacks of 'Zoomies', he consumes them all to extend the duration of the buff by 0.5 seconds per stack consumed, up to a maximum of 2.5 seconds. Upon reaching the ally, Puppycorn also emits a small 'Puppy Love' aura for 2 seconds, healing the ally for 5% of their max HP per second. If the target ally is already at full health, the aura grants them a shield equal to 5% of their max HP instead. Has a cooldown of 12 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: I'm coming to help! Whee!

abilities.name: Sparkle Power!
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Stack generation increased.
(Patch) Rainbow Burst radius increased.
abilities.description: Puppycorn overflows with playful energy! Every 6 seconds, Puppycorn accumulates a stack of 'Sparkle Power', up to a maximum of 5 stacks. For each stack of Sparkle Power, Puppycorn's movement speed and tenacity are increased by 3%. When Puppycorn has at least one stack, he gains 4% lifesteal, enhancing his survivability in the thick of battle. Whenever Puppycorn is hit by an enemy ability or attack, there is a 30% chance he will generate an additional stack of Sparkle Power, fueling his chaotic bursts. Once Puppycorn reaches 5 stacks of Sparkle Power, his next basic attack expends all stacks to unleash a 'Rainbow Burst', dealing 150 (+50% of his Magic Attack) magic damage to the primary target and 75 (+25% of his Magic Attack) magic damage to nearby enemies within a 250 unit radius. If Puppycorn is below 30% health when reaching 5 stacks, the Rainbow Burst also stuns all affected enemies for 1 second, offering a clutch opportunity for escape or counter-attack.

abilities.name: Tail Wag Tango
abilities.description: Puppycorn starts wagging his tail furiously, creating a whirlwind of happiness around him for 5 seconds. Allies within the whirlwind gain 10% increased attack speed and have their basic attacks apply a 10% lifesteal for the duration. Enemies within the whirlwind have a 15% chance to be disoriented by Puppycorn's cuteness, causing them to attack the nearest unit (ally or enemy) for 1 second. The attack speed buff is doubled for allies who are also affected by 'Puppy Pounce'. This ability has a 15 second cooldown.
abilities.flavorQuote: Wiggle, wiggle, wiggle!

abilities.name: Rainbow Power Playtime
upgrades: (Balance Patch) More Sparkle: Sparkle Showers now heal for 10% of max hp.
(Patch) Slippery Slide: Slow duration from Silly Slide increased to 2.5 seconds.
abilities.description: Puppycorn, fueled by uncontainable joy, creates a localized 'Rainbow Power Playtime' zone at the target location, persisting for a joyful 8 seconds! Every 1.5 seconds, this zone erupts with a randomly chosen effect, either showering allies within the zone with 'Sparkle Showers' that instantly heal them for 8% of their maximum health, or bombarding enemies with 'Giggle Grenades' that explode on contact, dealing 120 magic damage, plus an additional 50% of Puppycorn's Magic Attack stat. He may also trigger a 'Zoomie Zone' which instantly grants all allies within the radius one stack of the 'Zoomies' buff, increasing their movement speed, or a 'Silly Slide,' creating a slippery mud patch that slows enemy movement speed by 30% for a brief but disorienting 2 seconds. Due to the sheer ecstatic energy involved, 'Rainbow Power Playtime' has a cooldown of 90 seconds.

character_v1.teamSynergy: Puppycorn excels with damage dealers who benefit from attack speed, damage buffs, and lifesteal. He can also provide valuable healing and disruptive effects to support a tank or bruiser.
character_v1.tierSummary: Puppycorn is a mix of utility and damage, lacking focus. Scaling is inconsistent, and the randomness is unreliable. Slightly promoted to D-
character_v1.internalSynergy: Puppycorn's abilities synergize through Zoomies. Puppy Pounce can consume zoomies to extend the buff duration, while Tail Wag Tango benefits from the increased speed. The passive encourages taking damage to trigger chaotic effects.

chapters.title: The Glitter Storm
chapters.mission: Travel through different dimensions, collecting magical artifacts to stabilize the glitter storm.
chapters.summary: Puppycorn and Star accidentally create a glitter storm that threatens to engulf multiple dimensions. They must work together to contain the storm and restore balance.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Puppycorn befriends Star Butterfly, and together they embrace their chaotic, magical natures. They embark on a series of interdimensional adventures, leaving a trail of glitter and confetti in their wake.

abilities.flavorQuote: Just a quick doodle to get you going!

abilities.name: Rewind Time!

The target ally is healed for 15% of their maximum health over 3 seconds and is cleansed of one negative status effect. Wolfychu gains 1 stack of Enthusiasm. If Wolfychu has 3 or more stacks of Enthusiasm, the heal amount is increased to 25% of their maximum health. If Wolfychu has 5 or more stacks of Enthusiasm, the target also gains 20% tenacity for 3 seconds, reducing the duration of incoming crowd control effects.
abilities.flavorQuote: Oops, let's try that again!

abilities.name: Frame Skip!

If Wolfychu has 3 or more stacks of Enthusiasm, the slow effect is increased to 45%. If Wolfychu has 5 or more stacks of Enthusiasm, enemies in the area also have a 15% chance to have their attacks 'misfire', dealing 50% reduced damage instead.
abilities.flavorQuote: Did you see that? It was just a little… skip!

When Wolfychu reaches 5 stacks of Enthusiasm, her next ability cast has its cooldown reduced by 25% and its effects are amplified by 15%. After casting the ability, Wolfychu loses all Enthusiasm stacks and restarts accumulating them.
abilities.flavorQuote: The stream must go on!

abilities.name: Animation Overload! (Ultimate)
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~28%).
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~48%).
abilities.description: Wolfychu unleashes a chaotic burst of animation energy, creating a massive, screen-wide visual spectacle. For 8 seconds, all allies gain 30% increased damage and are immune to crowd control effects. During this time, enemy vision is slightly obscured by comical animations and sound effects, reducing their accuracy by 20%. At the end of the duration, Wolfychu heals all allies for 10% of their maximum health. Wolfychu immediately gains 5 stacks of Enthusiasm upon casting this ability, maximizing her buff potential. This ability has a long cooldown but can drastically turn the tide of battle.
abilities.flavorQuote: Get ready for the grand finale!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Wolfychu synergizes well with damage-focused carries who benefit from increased attack speed and damage. Her shields and cleanses protect vulnerable allies, while her ultimate provides a crucial damage boost and crowd control immunity for coordinated team fights. Her debuffs also help to peel for allies.
character_v1.tierSummary: Wolfychu's kit has a lot of moving parts, including heals, shields, and speed boosts, but they're reliant on Enthusiasm which feels clunky. The KPS reflects a jack-of-all-trades that doesn't excel. B- is a reasonable compromise.
appearanceTags: Navy dress with a red bow
character_v1.internalSynergy: Wolfychu's kit revolves around building Enthusiasm to amplify her abilities, creating a dynamic playstyle where she balances support and offensive disruption. Sketch Boost! and Rewind Time! benefit from Enthusiasm stacks, enhancing her ally-buffing and healing capabilities. Frame Skip! provides area control, while Art Stream ensures a steady flow of Enthusiasm.

chapters.title: Sketching new ideas
chapters.mission: Defeat the evil Lord Hater with positive energy
chapters.summary: The two must save a town who is overcome with negativity, and must share friendship in order to save all.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Wolfychu finds an unlikely friend in Wander from Wander Over Yonder, who both share the power of friendship. They explore the realms of art, animation and imagination and spread positivity.

character_v1.name: Spongebob SquarePants

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling

abilities.name: Spatula Smackdown
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved instances where enemy debuff icons were displaying the wrong Krabby Patty configuration.
(Balance Patch) Fine-tuned Patty Prep: Reduced the likelihood of 'Forgotten Formula Fumble!' debuff by 8%.
abilities.description: Spongebob, ever the diligent fry cook, wields his trusty spatula to deliver a culinary calamity to the opposition. Targeting a single enemy, Spongebob leaps forward, spatula raised, and smacks them with a beautifully crafted Krabby Patty. The initial impact deals X magic damage (scaling with Spongebob's magic attack). Furthermore, the greasy goodness (or lack thereof) of the patty inflicts a random debuff, determined by the Patty Prep Gods! If the enemy gets a 'Pickle Mishap!', their physical attack is reduced by 15% for a duration of 4 seconds, leaving them struggling to lift even the lightest anchor. Should they be afflicted with 'No Secret Sauce!', their movement speed slows by 20% for 4 seconds, as if they're trudging through kelp. Or, worst of all, if it's a 'Forgotten Formula Fumble!', their magic attack power wanes by 15% for 4 seconds, leaving their spells as effective as a jellyfish net made of Swiss cheese. Consecutive Spatula Smackdowns are encouraged! Each subsequent Krabby Patty thrown reduces the ability's cooldown by 1 second, to a maximum reduction of 3 seconds. Debuffs from Spatula Smackdown do not stack; the newest patty simply overwrites the previous mishap.

abilities.name: Imagination Rainbow!
upgrades: (Bugfix) Addressed anomalies in interaction sequences identified during live gameplay sessions (affected roughly 48% of interactions).
(Balance Patch) Adjustment: overall power diminished by about 17%, with a gradual buildup to peak effectiveness.
(Patch) Redesign: this ability now focuses on delivering impactful support interactions.
abilities.description: Spongebob, fueled by the power of imagination, conjures a prismatic rainbow that envelops a chosen ally. This shimmering shield, sustained for 5 seconds, absorbs incoming damage. When an enemy strikes the rainbow, 30% of the inflicted damage bounces back as magical energy, splattering across the attacker. In chaotic melees, if several foes target the shielded comrade, the reflected damage is cleverly divided, ensuring each assailant receives an equal share of the magical backlash. Moreover, the rainbow's playful essence sometimes overwhelms enemies with the 'Krabby Patty Craving' status, compelling them to advance towards Spongebob for 1 second. The likelihood of inducing this craving equals Spongebob's current luck statistic divided by 100. As time passes, the rainbow shield's strength diminishes, and when the shield finally shatters, Spongebob experiences a comforting surge of healing energy, mending some of his wounds, symbolizing the power of friendship and shared experiences.

abilities.name: F is for Friends
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~16% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~15%).
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~9% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Spongebob sings a heartfelt rendition of the 'F.U.N.' song, boosting the morale of his nearby allies. All allies within a radius gain increased attack and magic attack by X% for 6 seconds. The strength of the buff scales with Spongebob's magic attack stat. Additionally, allies gain a small heal over time effect for the duration of the song. During the performance, Spongebob becomes immune to crowd control effects, ensuring the song reaches its heartwarming conclusion. The heal over time effect is equivalent to 5% of Spongebob's max HP per second.
abilities.flavorQuote: F is for friends who do stuff together!

abilities.name: Kelp Shake Savior
abilities.description: Spongebob prepares a batch of Kelp Shakes, providing sustenance to nearby allies. All allies within a 5-meter radius receive an immediate heal equal to 8% of Spongebob's maximum HP, plus an additional 2% per level. Furthermore, allies gain 10% increased defense for 4 seconds, bolstered by the shake's nutritious properties. Each application of Kelp Shake Savior grants the affected ally a stack of 'Sea Strength,' up to a maximum of 3 stacks. Each stack of Sea Strength increases the potency of subsequent heals by 5%, enhancing Spongebob's consistent support role. Kelp Shake Savior has a cooldown of 10 seconds, encouraging tactical use during critical moments.
abilities.flavorQuote: It's the best around, and it's free!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Spongebob excels in teams that benefit from attack and magic attack buffs. He synergizes well with damage dealers who can capitalize on the debuffs applied by 'Krabby Patty Toss'. Tanks appreciate the shield provided by 'Bubble Blower Bonanza,' making Spongebob a versatile support choice for various team compositions.
character_v1.tierSummary: Spongebob's kit is highly unreliable with random stat buffs. F- is fair, due to the lack of reliable impact and poor stats. The overall scaling is terrible.

tips: Prioritize max HP: Your Kelp Shake and 'F is for Friends' scale with your max HP, making it your most important stat. Get tanky, or you'll be useless.
Use 'Imagination Rainbow!' proactively: Shield allies who are about to take damage, especially tanks or divers. The taunt effect can also peel enemies off your carries.
Time 'F is for Friends' carefully: The CC immunity is valuable, but the buff duration is short. Coordinate with your team to maximize its impact, or you'll waste the immunity.
strategyData.overview: Spongebob is a support character who relies on providing buffs, heals, and a bit of CC to his team. He's not going to carry any fights, but he can keep your damage dealers alive and help them do their job. His kit is a bit of a mixed bag, with some RNG elements and scaling issues that make him unreliable at times. He needs allies to protect him while he sings his song, and he won't do much good if he's focused down immediately.
strategyData.counterplay: Spongebob is vulnerable to focus fire. CC him during 'F is for Friends' to interrupt his healing and buffs, then burst him down. The taunt from 'Imagination Rainbow!' can be baited and punished. If he's building HP, consider %HP damage to cut through his bulk.

character_v1.internalSynergy: Spongebob's kit revolves around creating and using Krabby Patties to buff allies and debuff enemies. His 'F is for Friends' ability provides a team-wide buff, while 'Bubble Blower Bonanza' offers defensive support and disruption. The Ultimate ability, 'Golden Spatula Fury,' amplifies his offensive capabilities and allows for rapid Krabby Patty generation, creating a powerful synergy between his abilities.

Enemies in the center of the impact zone (100-unit radius) are also stunned for 0.75 seconds. For every 25 stacks of Starfish Endurance, the damage of Rock Toss increases by 20, up to a maximum of 160 bonus damage at maximum stacks. The rock's travel time is affected by Patrick's movement speed; if Patrick is slowed, the rock travels slower. The ability has a cooldown of 12 seconds. This ability provides both crowd control and damage, scaling with Patrick's passive to reward sustained engagement.

While the dome is active, Patrick is rooted in place but regenerates 3% of his max HP per second. If Patrick has at least 25 stacks of Starfish Endurance, he can cast this ability on an ally, granting them the same shield and regeneration effect, but Patrick himself receives only half of the regeneration (1.5% of max HP per second). Has a cooldown of 18 seconds. This ability offers strong defensive utility, allowing Patrick to protect himself or a teammate while sustaining his health.

If an enemy is affected by multiple outcomes, only the most beneficial outcome to Patrick will be applied. Each stack of Starfish Endurance increases the chance of a knockback by 0.5%, up to a maximum of 25% bonus chance. This ability deals 60 (+20% magic atk) magic damage. Cooldown: 15 seconds. Upon transformation ending, Patrick unleashes all accumulated damage as a burst around him, damaging all nearby enemies for the total damage he inflicted during this time plus 50 (+15% max hp). abilities.flavorQuote: Prepare to feel the might of... uh... me!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Patrick excels on teams that benefit from a damage-soaking frontliner. character_v1.tierSummary: Patrick is a VERY basic tank with scaling that's all over the place. D is appropriate; it needs more utility or reliable damage mitigation to climb higher.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Patrick's abilities are designed to work together to maximize his tanking potential. Starfish Endurance provides the base for his resilience, while Rock Toss and Dumb Luck offer crowd control, Temporary Home offers survivability and Idiot Star forces enemies to focus on him, allowing him to absorb even more damage and unleash a devastating counter-attack.

character_v1.internalSynergy: Sandy's kit synergizes around controlling space with 'Acorn Burst' and using 'Squirrel Agility' to traverse the battlefield while gaining defensive buffs. This allows Squidward to reposition himself quickly, whether to escape danger or to further harass his foes. More than just speed, Squidward's annoyance radiates outwards, toughening his resolve against magical threats. For every stack of Annoyance present on enemy heroes within a 500 unit radius of Squidward, he gains 4 bonus magic resistance. Thus, positioning near 'annoyed' enemies not only amplifies his mobility but also fortifies his defenses, making him a formidable presence in chaotic engagements. As a result, Squidward is encouraged to stay close to his most annoyed targets, gaining additional benefits such as stacking additional magic resistance and ensuring his survival in prolonged skirmishes.

character_v1.internalSynergy: Squidward's kit is designed around the 'Annoyance' mechanic, allowing him to effectively control the battlefield by reducing enemy damage and mobility. His passive further incentivizes applying Annoyance, enhancing his own survivability and speed.

Upon activation or after 3 seconds, Daisy explodes, dealing 80 (+50% Magic ATK) magic damage to nearby enemies and inflicting 'Confused' for 1.5 seconds. 'Confused' causes enemies to move erratically and have a 30% chance to misfire their next ability. Consumes 1 'Precognition Stack' to increase the 'Confused' duration to 2.5 seconds and guarantees the misfire. The range of the placement is moderate, allowing for tactical positioning. The explosion radius is small, requiring precise placement to maximize its effectiveness. This ability has a cooldown of 12 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: I've already calculated the optimal outcome.

abilities.name: Prodigy's Gambit
upgrades: Increases critical hit damage during 'Perfect Calculation' from 175% to 200% of attack damage.
abilities.description: Anais, ever the tactical prodigy, anticipates her foes' every move. Whenever an enemy uses an ability within a medium range of Anais, she gains a 'Calculated Stack'. Each Calculated Stack provides Anais with a 2% increase to her critical hit chance and a 1.5% bonus to her movement speed, synergizing with a proactive, assassin-style playstyle. This effect stacks up to 7 times, reflecting her growing confidence in predicting combat scenarios. Upon reaching the maximum of 7 Calculated Stacks, Anais enters a state of 'Perfect Calculation' for 4 seconds, where her next basic attack is guaranteed to critically hit, dealing 175% of her attack damage. After delivering this perfectly calculated strike, all Calculated Stacks are consumed, forcing her to recalculate and reposition. If Anais fails to capitalize on this moment of enhanced critical strike and movement within 10 seconds, the 'Perfect Calculation' buff will fade and reset to zero, requiring re-stacking. This passive encourages aggressive plays, rewarding timely positioning and swift decision-making, while demanding a high degree of precision and tactical awareness from its user.

abilities.name: Tactical Advantage
upgrades: Adjusted scaling to better suit mid-game progression.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~10%).
abilities.description: Anais, with her unparalleled intellect, assesses an allied target within a medium range, bestowing upon them the 'Tactical Advantage' status for a duration of 5 seconds. This keen evaluation substantially bolsters the ally's offensive capabilities, increasing both their Attack Damage and Magic Attack by 25%, enabling them to strike with greater force. Furthermore, Anais safeguards her chosen ally by conjuring a protective shield, absorbing up to 150 points of incoming damage, enhanced by 40% of Anais's own Magic Attack. To elevate this tactical maneuver further, Anais can expend 2 of her 'Precognition Stacks,' not only strengthening the initial buffs but also granting the ally an additional 15% increase to their Movement Speed. This swiftness allows for more agile positioning and engagement, ensuring that the ally remains both shielded and strategically advantaged for the entire duration. Deploying Tactical Advantage requires careful consideration of both Anais's available 'Precognition Stacks' and the positioning of the intended recipient. A well-timed boost can significantly swing the momentum of a skirmish.

abilities.name: Emotional Manipulation
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Anais unleashes a wave of psychic energy in a cone-shaped area, dealing 60 (+30% Magic ATK) magic damage and inflicting 'Self Doubt' for 3 seconds. 'Self Doubt' reduces the damage output of affected enemies by 20% and their movement speed by 10%. Consumes 1 'Precognition Stack' to increase the damage reduction to 30% and the movement speed reduction to 20%. This ability serves as both an offensive and defensive tool, weakening enemy damage and hindering their mobility. The cone's width is moderate, requiring careful aiming. The duration of 'Self Doubt' is relatively short, necessitating strategic timing. This ability has a cooldown of 15 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: You're not as good as you think you are.

abilities.name: The Power of Reason
upgrades: (Analysis) Resolved a logical inconsistency in threat assessment, preventing misdirected aggression (19% occurrence).
(Refinement) Fine-tuned the power scaling for optimal battlefield impact, resulting in a more consistent advantage (12% uplift).
(Adjustment) Role specialization: Emphasized the zone's disruptive capabilities, maximizing its impact on enemy positioning and control.
abilities.description: Anais, with a knowing sigh, imposes a bubble of pure, unadulterated reason upon the battlefield, an 'Argument Zone' that persists for a base duration of 8 seconds. Allies caught within this sphere of logic find their resilience heightened, enjoying a 30% increase to both Tenacity and Evasion, making them significantly more resistant to crowd control effects and incoming attacks. Simultaneously, Anais leverages her intellect against her foes; enemies within the Argument Zone suffer a 40% reduction to all incoming healing, and durations of any crowd control effects they inflict are reduced by 30%. Upon casting, Anais consumes all current stacks of 'Ahead of the Curve.' For each stack consumed, the duration of the Argument Zone is extended by 1 additional second, up to a maximum extension of 5 seconds, allowing the zone to potentially persist for a total of 13 seconds. This strategic deployment of intellect creates a haven for allies, enhancing their survivability, while simultaneously hindering the opposition's ability to sustain themselves and control the flow of battle.

character_v1.teamSynergy: Anais excels in teams that benefit from strategic buffs and disruptions. She provides valuable support to damage-focused carries and tanks, enhancing their survivability and damage output while disrupting enemy formations.
character_v1.tierSummary: ANais has excellent debuffs and buffs combined with the Logic Zone. The problem is that the effects are all conditional. B+ is a fair assessment.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Anais' abilities synergize by generating and consuming 'Precognition Stacks.' Strategic Foresight generates stacks, while Calculated Diversion, Critical Analysis, and Emotional Manipulation consume them for enhanced effects. Her Ultimate benefits directly from having more stacks, further encouraging stack generation.

chapters.title: Calculated Composition
chapters.mission: Create a strategy based on Squidward's teachings that beats Squidward.
chapters.summary: Squidward challenges Anais to create an artwork that embodies complex strategy.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Anais seeks intellectual sparring with Squidward to further refine her strategic abilities.

Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction

abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Light.

abilities.name: Optimistic Overflow
upgrades: Darwin’s redirected damage is reduced by 2% for every 10 armor he has.
Allies with health above 75% receive an additional 5% movement speed.
The radius of Optimistic Overflow is increased by 20%.
(Patch) Role realignment: this ability now emphasizes controller-style interactions.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~15% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Darwin exudes an unwavering aura of optimism, a tangible expression of his deep-seated belief in the potential of his allies. This radiant aura, subtly visualized as shimmering golden motes dancing around affected teammates within a medium radius, instills a surge of confidence, bolstering their defenses by 12%, hardening their resolve and fortifying their resistance to incoming attacks. Furthermore, should an ally, emboldened by Darwin’s unwavering faith, maintain a Health level exceeding 75%, their invigorated state grants an additional 6% increase to their outgoing damage, transforming their sustained vitality into aggressive combat prowess. However, when the tides of battle turn against a nearby comrade, causing their health to plummet to a precarious 25% or less, Darwin's innate compassion manifests as a selfless sacrifice: he absorbs 12% of the damage directed at the imperiled ally, channeling the harm towards himself in a dramatic act of shared suffering. This redirected damage cannot be mitigated or reduced by any means, underscoring Darwin's boundless dedication to his team's survival and well-being.

abilities.name: Protective Orb
upgrades: Increases shield duration by 1 second.
Reduces cooldown by 2 seconds.
Shield strength increased to 20% of Darwin's Max HP.
If the shielded ally is affected by Darwin's Positive Aura, they are healed for 5% of their Max HP upon shield expiration.
abilities.description: With a burst of optimism, Darwin conjures a shimmering, aquatic orb of pure healing energy. He launches this orb towards a chosen ally, encasing them in a protective bubble that lasts for 4 seconds. This bubble grants the ally a shield capable of absorbing damage equal to 15% of Darwin's maximum health, providing crucial defense against incoming attacks. The orb's emanation grants the shielded ally a surge of resilience, bolstering their tenacity by 20%, making them significantly more resistant to stuns, slows, and other debilitating crowd control effects. Furthermore, if the targeted ally is already basking in the revitalizing embrace of Darwin's Positive Aura, the shield's strength is amplified considerably, increasing its protective capacity to 25% of Darwin's maximum health, enhancing the ally's survivability even further. After bestowing this safeguarding bubble, Darwin must wait 12 seconds before conjuring another. Should the duration expire or the shield be fully depleted by enemy attacks, the orb pops harmlessly, dissipating into a gentle splash of water, leaving behind only the memory of its protective embrace.

abilities.name: Optimistic Tackle
abilities.description: Darwin charges forward a short distance, tackling the first enemy he encounters. This deals 80% of his attack as damage and applies a "Cheered Up" debuff for 3 seconds. Cheered Up reduces the enemy's attack by 15%. If the targeted enemy is within Darwin's Positive Aura, they are also knocked back a short distance. This ability has an 8-second cooldown and a slightly longer range when used outside of the Positive Aura's effect.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Let's turn that frown upside down!"

abilities.name: Fin Slap Frenzy
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Darwin rapidly slaps enemies in a cone in front of him with his fins, dealing multiple instances of low damage over 2 seconds. Each slap deals 25% of his attack damage. Enemies hit are also slowed by 10% for 1 second per hit, stacking up to 50%. If Darwin is below 50% health while using this ability, the slow effect is doubled. This ability has a 10-second cooldown. The animation shows Darwin flailing his fins with increasing speed.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Take that, negativity!"

abilities.name: Best Friends Forever
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Darwin calls upon Gumball, creating a powerful bond that dramatically enhances their combined capabilities for 8 seconds. During this time, Darwin gains 30% increased Max HP and his Positive Aura's Defense bonus is doubled. Gumball, if present, gains 20% increased Attack and Speed. Additionally, Gumball and Darwin share 20% of the damage they receive during this duration. This ultimate has a long cooldown of 60 seconds. The activation is accompanied by a short animation of Gumball and Darwin high-fiving.
abilities.flavorQuote: "We're an unstoppable team!"

character_v1.playstyle: Darwin excels at protecting allies and disrupting enemies with his positive attitude and surprising resilience. He thrives in teams that maintain high health and benefit from defensive buffs.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Darwin synergizes well with damage dealers who benefit from increased defense and speed, such as Gumball or other high-attack carries. His ability to redirect damage makes him a valuable asset to protect squishy damage dealers. Teams that maintain high health pools will maximize the effectiveness of his Positive Vibes aura.
character_v1.tierSummary: Darwin, despite having a support-focused kit, lacks the stats to be a reliable tank or buffer in higher tiers. While the kit has several support options (shields, damage redirection), the base stats are too low for C+. Moving to B- addresses the overpopulation in F and E, and reflects a slight bump in usability from added survivability.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Darwin's kit revolves around protecting allies and disrupting enemies while amplifying his supportive capabilities through Positive Vibes and health thresholds. The Bubbly Shield and Optimistic Tackle provide immediate protection and disruption, while Fin Slap Frenzy offers sustained damage and control. Best Friends Forever dramatically boosts both Darwin and Gumball, creating a formidable duo.

chapters.title: Optimistic Outlook
chapters.mission: Convince Homer to do anything in less than 1 minute.
chapters.summary: Darwin tries to convince Homer to be happy and cheerful.
chapters.resonanceBuff: Fin Slap Frenzy grants a 20% speed boost for 3 seconds.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Darwin, wanting to spread more cheer, tries to teach Homer optimism.

character_v1.name: Charmcaster

abilities.name: Mystic Bolt
upgrades: Lv10: Damage scaling increased to 70% of ATK
Lv50: Grants 2 Arcane Charges per successful attack.
Lv100: Base damage increased and the Mystic Bolt now reduces the target's magic resistance by an additional 5% for 3 seconds.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Charmcaster launches a concentrated blast of raw magic at a single target, dealing significant magic damage. This attack manifests as a violet energy sphere, crackling with dark arcane power. Upon impact, the Mystic Bolt inflicts 50 base damage, enhanced by 60% of Charmcaster's total attack power. This damage is considered magical and is mitigated by the target's magic resistance. Against targets with high magic resistance, the bolt pierces a small amount of resistance (5%) ensuring at least some impact. This ability has a short cast time, during which Charmcaster is slightly vulnerable. Furthermore, each successful Mystic Bolt attack grants Charmcaster a stack of 'Arcane Charge', increasing her next ability's effectiveness by a small margin (3% per stack, up to a maximum of 5 stacks). This is represented visually by a faint aura intensifying around Charmcaster's hands. Should Charmcaster not cast another ability within 6 seconds, the Arcane Charges will dissipate.

abilities.name: Luckstone Ward
upgrades: (Bugfix) Corrected inconsistencies in Totem Echo activation when multiple totems were simultaneously present.
(Patch) Redefined Luckstone Ward as a core ability: Emphasis shifted to versatile interactions within a balanced gameplay strategy.
abilities.description: Charmcaster begins each match cloaked within a Luckstone Ward, a protective enchantment woven from her personal mana and the latent energies of her totems. This ward grants her a shield capable of absorbing up to 200 damage plus an additional amount equal to 50% of her Magic Attack stat. While enveloped by the Luckstone Ward, Charmcaster's movement speed is enhanced, increasing by 10%, allowing for swifter positioning and tactical maneuvers. This protective shell lasts for 10 seconds. Upon its expiration, whether shattered by enemy attacks or simply dissolved by time, the Luckstone Ward unleashes 'Totem Echo', a surge of restorative and disruptive energy. This energy prioritizes connection with any active totems summoned by Charmcaster within the preceding 5 seconds. These totems become conduits, amplifying the Totem Echo's effects, emanating a pulse that heals allies within range for 100 health plus an amount equal to 30% of Charmcaster's Magic Attack. Simultaneously, the pulse inflicts 75 magic damage plus an amount equal to 25% of her Magic Attack to enemies within the area. The health regeneration and damage over time effects each persist for 3 seconds, afflicting multiple targets at once. After triggering Totem Echo, the Luckstone Ward enters a cooldown period of 20 seconds, but this cooldown is reduced by 1 second for every 1000 damage dealt by Charmcaster, encouraging aggressive play and spellweaving.

abilities.name: Stone Ward Totem
upgrades: (Patch) Role realignment: this ability now emphasizes tank-style interactions.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Charmcaster weaves a potent spell, conjuring forth a Stone Ward Totem at a designated location within a medium range, imbuing it with protective magic. This ancient sentinel possesses a health pool of 300, augmented by an additional 40% of Charmcaster's Magic Defense. It stands vigil for 15 seconds, emanating pulses of arcane energy every 2 seconds, inflicting 40 magic damage, scaling with 15% of Charmcaster's Magic Attack, upon all adversaries caught within its vicinity. These foes also find their movements hampered, suffering a 20% reduction in their movement speed for a duration of 1 second. Should Charmcaster unleash another spell within 5 seconds of summoning the Totem, its protective capabilities surge, fortifying its disruptive presence by increasing the slow to 40% and bolstering the damage output by 50%. A maximum of two Stone Ward Totems can simultaneously grace the battlefield under Charmcaster's command. Should a third be summoned, the oldest of the totems will crumble, yielding its place to the newly conjured ward. Though steadfast and unyielding, the Stone Ward Totem remains immobile, dedicating its essence to passive protection and the disruption of enemy advances.

abilities.name: Manna Bolt
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Charmcaster fires a bolt of pure Manna energy in a straight line, dealing 100 (+60% of her Magic Attack) magic damage to the first enemy hit. If the Manna Bolt passes through or is cast near (within a 200-unit radius) an active Rock Monster Totem, it is amplified, splitting into three smaller bolts that deal 60 (+30% of her Magic Attack) magic damage each to enemies in a cone-shaped area. If the primary bolt hits an enemy already affected by the slow from a Rock Monster Totem, the target is stunned for 0.75 seconds. The split bolts prioritize targets not yet affected by the stun.
abilities.flavorQuote: Feel the sting of my magic!

abilities.name: Magical Transference
abilities.description: Charmcaster channels magical energy for 2 seconds, during which she is rooted in place. Upon completion, she teleports to the location of one of her active Rock Monster Totems, destroying it in the process. Upon arrival, Charmcaster gains a shield equal to the destroyed Totem's remaining health, and deals 60 (+30% of her Magic Attack) magic damage to nearby enemies. If no Totem is active, Charmcaster teleports a short distance in the direction she is facing instead, gaining only 50% of her Magic Attack as a shield. This ability has a 12-second cooldown. While channeling, Charmcaster gains 20 (+10% of her Magic Def) tenacity.
abilities.flavorQuote: Now you see me...now you're doomed!

abilities.name: Legerdomain's Fury
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~13%).
abilities.description: Charmcaster channels the power of Legerdomain for 3 seconds, becoming invulnerable and summoning three enhanced Rock Monster Totems in a triangle formation around her within a large radius. These enhanced Totems have 500 (+60% of her Magic Defense) health and pulse every 1.5 seconds, dealing 80 (+30% of her Magic Attack) magic damage and slowing enemies by 50% for 1.5 seconds. After the channeling finishes, Charmcaster unleashes a devastating wave of energy that deals 200 (+80% of her Magic Attack) magic damage to all enemies within the triangle formation. This ultimate has a 90-second cooldown.
abilities.flavorQuote: The might of Legerdomain is mine to command!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Charmcaster synergizes well with teammates who can capitalize on her area control and slows. Tanks can protect her while she channels, and damage dealers can focus down enemies trapped within her Totem formations. Healers can sustain her during engagements, allowing her to maintain her Totem presence on the battlefield.
character_v1.tierSummary: Charmcaster has a versatile kit with heal, shield, damage, and summoning. With decent speed and a mixed damage profile, Charmcaster can be very potent if played well. She goes up to A because B is too crowded, given her flexibility.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Charmcaster's kit revolves around strategic placement and empowerment of her Rock Monster Totems. Her passive and other abilities benefit from Totem placement, encouraging players to plan ahead and control the battlefield. Manna Bolt's enhanced effect requires a Totem nearby, and Magical Transference provides mobility and defense at the cost of a Totem. Her ultimate amplifies this strategy, creating a powerful area-of-effect damage zone.

chapters.title: Ancient Wisdom
chapters.mission: Complete a ritual where Charmcaster channels life energy into a new Luckstone Ward totem, guided by Betilla's instructions, facing elemental challenges.
chapters.summary: Charmcaster consults Betilla for advice on channeling nature's magic into her totems. Betilla shares secrets of imbuing life energy into inanimate objects.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Charmcaster seeks guidance from a seasoned magic user to better control her totems and harness their supportive potential.
bondPerks: Luckstone Ward now grants temporary magic resistance

abilities.name: Proto Strike
upgrades: Lv10: Enhances physical damage scaling and reduces the mana cost.

Lv100: Grants Protoman a small amount of lifesteal for a short duration upon successful hit, and the stun chance of the base ability is doubled.
abilities.description: Proto Strike is a devastating single-target ability embodying Protoman's precision and lethal intent. Upon activation, Protoman executes a blindingly fast dash towards the targeted enemy, culminating in a powerful, shield-shattering strike delivered with pinpoint accuracy. The move consists of two distinct phases: the initial dash, which grants Protoman temporary invincibility frames to bypass enemy defenses, and the subsequent strike, imbued with high physical damage augmented by a small % of the target's maximum HP. The attack also applies a 'Vulnerability' debuff, increasing damage received from all sources for a short duration. This move prioritizes shield damage, making it ideal to break shielding enemies and set up follow-up attacks, which can turn the tide of battle. When executed, Protoman emits a sonic boom. Furthermore, there is a small chance to inflict stun.
abilities.flavorQuote: "I fight for what I believe in. That includes ending you swiftly."

abilities.name: Proto Strike
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~25%).
(Patch) Role realignment: this ability now emphasizes tank-style interactions.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Protoman unleashes a focused burst of energy from his Proto Buster, striking the first enemy in its path for X damage. The Buster's recoil generates Heat within Protoman, increasing it by 10 per shot. Charging the Proto Buster by holding the fire command intensifies the blast, boosting damage output by up to 50% and escalating heat generation by up to 30 based on charge duration. Managing Heat is crucial: reaching 100 causes a Buster Overheat. This not only silences Protoman but also locks all of his abilities until his internal temperature cools back down to 0. Protoman passively dissipates Heat at a rate of 5 per second when not actively firing the Proto Buster, enabling a calculated balance between offense and sustained performance. The charged burst will also briefly stun an enemy hit for .3 seconds, allowing Protoman to act as a tank against stronger enemies and protect his allies. Timing bursts between defensive maneuvers is critical to conserving energy and preventing critical overheating.

abilities.description: Proto Man raises his Proto Shield, becoming invulnerable to frontal attacks for 2 seconds. While the shield is active, Proto Man's movement speed is reduced by 30%. After the duration ends, or if the ability is manually deactivated, Proto Man can perform a Shield Bash in the next 0.5 seconds, dashing forward a short distance and dealing X damage and knocking back enemies in his path. Using Proto Shield reduces Heat by 20, providing a brief respite from the Buster Overheat mechanic. The shield has a cooldown of 8 seconds. Successfully blocking an attack with the shield grants Proto Man a temporary 10% damage boost for 3 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Defense is the best offense.

abilities.name: Proto Strike
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~29%).

(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Proto Man unleashes a powerful, fully charged Proto Buster shot that pierces through enemies, dealing X damage to all targets in a line. Proto Strike consumes 40 Heat and has a longer range than the standard Proto Buster. If used while Proto Man's Heat is above 60, the ability deals 20% bonus damage but also increases his Heat by an additional 20. This ability has a cooldown of 12 seconds. If Proto Man's Buster is overheated, Proto Strike cannot be activated. The piercing effect allows Proto Man to hit multiple targets, making it effective in clustered fights or for clearing waves of enemies.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time to end this!

abilities.name: Proto System (Signature Passive)
upgrades: (System Optimization) - Reduced Vulnerability: Damage taken during Overheat is reduced by 5%.
(Adaptive Cooling) - Improved Heat Dissipation: Dodge Heat reduction increased to 20.
(High-Efficiency Core) - Increased Overclock: Attack Damage bonus increased to 15%.
abilities.description: Proto Man's internal systems, a marvel of engineering, offer increased combat effectiveness but demand careful management. His buster gains a 10% attack damage bonus, enhancing his offensive capabilities from the start. However, reaching 100 Heat triggers a system overload. When Proto Man's Buster overheats, his frame vents excess energy, increasing incoming damage by 15% for 5 seconds. This Heat Vulnerability necessitates skillful heat management to prevent exploitation. A perfectly timed dodge, executed when heat levels are above 80, bleeds off 15 Heat from the system. This provides a skillful means of mitigation to help you prevent the Heat Vulnerability debuff. With careful planning and sharp reflexes, you can optimize your performance and keep Proto Man in the fight.

abilities.name: Shadow Strike: Delta
upgrades: Lv10: Enhances attack potency and reduces cooldown, but extends afterimage duration slightly.
Lv50: Unlocks a secondary effect: upon hit, applies a short-duration 'Exposed' debuff, increasing damage taken from all sources.
Lv100: Improves scaling, and grants a small chance to instantly reset a basic ability cooldown upon a successful Shadow Strike.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~41%).
abilities.description: Protoman executes a lightning-fast, near-invisible attack. Upon activation, Protoman vanishes in a burst of afterimages, becoming briefly untargetable while analyzing the target's vulnerabilities. After a short delay, a single, devastating strike is delivered. This isn't merely a physical blow; the Shadow Strike is augmented with a concentrated pulse of destabilizing energy, calculated to exploit weaknesses in the target's defenses. Damage scaling is complex, drawing heavily from Protoman's ATK and Crit Chance, but also factoring in any elemental vulnerabilities the target possesses. If the target is suffering from a status ailment, Shadow Strike Delta's damage is amplified. Visually, the effect culminates in a shimmering, delta-shaped energy imprint left upon the target at the point of impact, a testament to the precision and controlled power of the strike. The entire sequence is intended to be extremely fast to emphasize Protoman's nature as an assassin.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Calculated precision. Nothing more."

character_v1.teamSynergy: Proto Man benefits from allies who can provide crowd control or shields, allowing him to safely deal damage from a distance. He pairs well with tanks who can draw aggro and supports who can mitigate the effects of his post-Big Bang Strike vulnerability. His piercing Proto Strike is effective for clearing waves of enemies, making him a valuable asset in team fights.
character_v1.tierSummary: Protoman, with high attack and speed, is a decent damage dealer. His reliance on 'Buster Overheat' resource mechanic introduces complexity. While B is a good fit, A- accounts for Protoman having clear weaknesses.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Proto Man's kit revolves around managing his Buster Overheat. Proto Shield helps mitigate Heat build-up, while Proto Strike rewards careful Heat management with bonus damage. His signature passive provides a constant damage boost but punishes overheating with increased vulnerability, forcing players to balance offense and defense. The Big Bang Strike is a powerful finisher but leaves Proto Man vulnerable, requiring careful positioning and timing.

chapters.title: Controlled Burn
chapters.mission: Protoman and Bass spar, with Protoman focusing on maintaining consistent damage output without overheating his buster, guided by Bass's real-time feedback.
chapters.summary: Protoman trains with Bass, learning techniques to manage Buster Overheat and channel its power more efficiently. Bass shares his own methods of weapon control and energy regulation.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Protoman struggles to control Buster Overheat. He seeks guidance from someone familiar with resource management and energy control.
bondPerks: Proto Strike now reduces enemy defense

abilities.description: Bass unleashes a concentrated burst of Chaos energy from his buster, creating a stream that persists for 2 seconds. Simultaneously, each hit on an enemy applies a stack of 'Riot'. Riot stacks last for 5 seconds and can stack up to 5 times per target. Enemies at 5 stacks are considered 'Unstable'. While unstable, allies can consume the stacks on the target to deal an additional 40 (+10% of ally's magic power or attack power, whichever is highest) as bonus magic damage. If no stacks are consumed within 3 seconds after reaching 5 stacks, it detonates on its own, dealing 30 (+7% of Bass' magic power) as magic damage. The cone's width is moderate, allowing for both single-target focus and area denial. This skill has a moderate cooldown of 8 seconds.

abilities.name: Dash & Strike

abilities.description: Bass dashes a short distance in a target direction, dealing damage to the first enemy he collides with. If Bass has any 'Overload' stacks, he consumes them to enhance the damage of Dash & Strike, increasing damage by X% per stack consumed (X=5%). This ability provides mobility and can be used both offensively and defensively. The dash distance is fixed, and the collision detection is generous, ensuring that Bass connects with his target reliably. If no enemy is hit, the dash still occurs, but no damage is dealt, and Overload stacks are not consumed. The cooldown is 6 seconds, providing frequent opportunities for repositioning and burst damage.
abilities.flavorQuote: Too slow to react!

abilities.name: Copy Shot
upgrades: (Bugfix) Fixed instances where Copy Shot's acquisition process resulted in unintended system instability (reported frequency: 41%).
(Bugfix) Corrected anomalies related to inconsistent ability activation following Copy Shot's usage (reported frequency: 47%).
(Balance) Enhanced late-game scaling for copied abilities, increasing their power potential in prolonged engagements.
(Role Adjustment) Copy Shot now leans into tank-oriented strategies, offering increased survivability or utility to enhance Bass's frontline presence.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~32%).
abilities.description: Bass targets an enemy and, with a flash of violet energy, instantly duplicates one of their non-Ultimate abilities for a duration of 8 seconds. During this time, Copy Shot overwrites Bass's Dash & Strike ability, replacing it with the acquired power. The copied ability's base damage is slightly reduced, but it receives significantly increased scaling based on Bass's current Buster Overload stacks. If Bass has accumulated 5 or more Buster Overload stacks, the copied ability gains an additional effect determined by its elemental affinity. For instance, copying a Fire-based ability grants it the ability to inflict a burn, dealing damage over time for 3 seconds equal to 15% of Bass's magic attack per tick, while a Water-based ability applies a slow, reducing the target's movement speed by 30% for 2 seconds. After the 8-second duration concludes, the copied ability vanishes, and Dash & Strike is restored. Effective use of Copy Shot relies on identifying key enemy abilities to exploit; careful planning will allow you to turn the tide. Copy Shot has a cooldown of 15 seconds.

abilities.name: Ruthless Pursuit
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~12% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~11% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~16% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Bass gains a stacking damage buff whenever an enemy dies within a 15-unit radius of him. Each stack increases his attack damage by 2%, stacking up to 10 times. Stacks are lost if Bass does not kill or assist in killing an enemy within 8 seconds. Additionally, consuming Overload stacks with a copied ability grants Ruthless Pursuit stacks equal to the number of Overload stacks consumed. This passive encourages aggressive positioning and rewards Bass for staying in the thick of battle. This provides sustain damage enhancement through consistently engaging in combat and capitalizing on kills.
abilities.flavorQuote: Survival of the fittest, that's the motto I live by!

abilities.name: Treble Boost: Ultimate Override
abilities.description: Bass fuses with Treble, gaining increased attack speed, movement speed, and a shield equal to 25% of his max HP. While Treble Boost is active, Bass's Bass Buster Barrage now fires in a 360-degree radius around him, hitting all enemies within range. Bass also gains access to 'Ultimate Override'. Activating Ultimate Override consumes all Overload stacks to fire a powerful blast in a straight line, dealing damage equal to 200% of Bass's attack damage plus X% (X=10% per Overload stack) of the target's max HP. Treble Boost lasts for 12 seconds, or until the shield is broken. This Ultimate provides a significant power boost and allows for both sustained damage and burst potential. The ultimate has a long cooldown of 90 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Let's show them what true power is!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Bass synergizes well with teams that can provide crowd control or peel, allowing him to safely build Overload stacks and deliver burst damage. He also benefits from teams that can capitalize on the openings he creates with his mobility and damage output.
character_v1.tierSummary: Bass has a mixed kit with damage, utility, and a resource mechanic. The kit is unfocused, and the need to manage 'Buster Overload' hinders consistent performance. Remains in B but closer to the mid range.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Bass' kit revolves around building Overload stacks with Bass Buster Barrage and then consuming them with Dash & Strike or a copied ability for burst damage. Ruthless Pursuit rewards aggressive play, while Treble Boost provides a powerful temporary boost to damage and survivability.

chapters.title: Psycho-Resonance
chapters.mission: Bass must endure M. Bison's psycho-power training, resisting the corrupting influence while mastering control over his Chaos Stream.
chapters.summary: Bass trains with M. Bison, attempting to understand the principles of psycho-power manipulation to control his chaotic energy stream. M. Bison offers guidance, albeit with a sinister undertone.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Bass, seeking to refine his chaotic energy control, partners with M. Bison, whose psycho-power manipulation may offer insight.
bondPerks: Treble Boost now grants temporary invincibility

character_v1.name: M. Bison

abilities.name: Psycho Shot
upgrades: Lv10: Psycho-Flame damage per tick increased to 7%.
Lv50: Adds a 15% chance to inflict 'Crushed' for 2 seconds, reducing target's DEF by 20%
Lv100: Base damage increased to 60% ATK + 25% Max HP, Psycho Flame duration increased to 4 seconds.
(Balance Patch) Buff: Ability scaling improved – base ATK scaling now 75%.
abilities.description: Bison channels his Psycho Power, unleashing a concentrated blast of crimson energy at a single enemy. This ranged attack deals physical damage augmented by Psycho Power, inflicting (50% ATK) + (20% of Bison's maximum HP) as damage. The blast carries a lingering Psycho-Flame, burning the target for 3 seconds. Each tick of the Psycho-Flame deals additional damage equal to 5% of the initial damage dealt by Psycho Shot. In addition, the sheer malevolent force behind the shot reduces the target's outgoing damage by 10% for the duration of the burn, sapping their will to fight.

abilities.name: Psycho Charge (Passive)
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~20%).
abilities.description: M. Bison passively generates Psycho Charge over time, accumulating up to 100 stacks. Certain abilities consume Psycho Charge to create Psycho Mines. When an enemy is near a Psycho Mine, M. Bison gains increased movement speed and magic attack. Upon reaching 100 stacks, M. Bison's next basic attack becomes empowered, dealing bonus magic damage and stunning the target for 0.75 seconds. This passive encourages strategic play and careful management of Psycho Charge for optimal burst damage and crowd control.
abilities.flavorQuote: Power is absolute, and mine is limitless.

abilities.name: Psycho Field
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Reduced peak potency ~11% and slightly longer ramp-up.
Emphasizes tank-style interactions.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: M. Bison channels Psycho Power, expending 30 Psycho Charge to project a localized Psycho Field at a designated location, marking his dominion. Initially cloaked in malevolent energy, the Field remains invisible until an opponent strays within 300 units. Upon detection, the Psycho Field flares to life, its crimson aura betraying its presence and ensnaring trespassers. Enemies caught within the Psycho Field's influence suffer a 40% reduction to their movement speed for a duration of 1.5 seconds, hindering their escape and making them vulnerable to further assaults. Bison can trigger a catastrophic burst, detonating the field remotely through 'Psycho Detonation' or 'Psycho Crusher'. This releases a surge of Psycho Power, inflicting magic damage to all enemies caught within a 250-unit radius, pulverizing their defenses. Multiple Psycho Fields can exist simultaneously, creating a network of control points for Bison to exploit, lasting up to 60 seconds.

abilities.name: Psycho Crusher
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~18%).
abilities.description: M. Bison charges forward a moderate distance, enveloped in Psycho Power, dealing magic damage to enemies he passes through. If 'Psycho Crusher' comes into contact with a Psycho Mine, the mine detonates, amplifying the damage and increasing the radius of the explosion by 50%. If 'Psycho Crusher' does NOT detonate a mine, the ability consumes 10% max HP. Successfully detonating a mine also grants M. Bison a shield equal to 15% of the damage dealt for 3 seconds. The shield mechanic encourages strategic placement of mines, and successful detonations can turn the tide of a fight, providing both damage and survivability.
abilities.flavorQuote: Feel the wrath of my Psycho Crusher!

abilities.name: Psycho Crusher
upgrades: The Psycho Power shield's absorption capacity is significantly increased based on M. Bison's Magic Attack stat.
Reduces the cooldown period between uses, enabling more frequent use of the devastating Psycho Crusher.

(Patch) Re-prioritizes assassin-style interactions for this ability.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~44%).
abilities.description: M. Bison, fueled by raw Psycho Power, becomes a destructive crimson projectile, surging forward to obliterate his enemies. During this frenzied charge, Bison is briefly untouchable, bathed in Psycho energy for 0.75 seconds, rendering him invulnerable to all forms of harm. Upon colliding with his initial target, Bison unleashes a concentrated burst of Psycho energy, inflicting 80 (+60% Magic Attack) magic damage. The force of impact violently destabilizes the surrounding area. Enemies caught within a 250-unit radius of the point of impact are engulfed in a Psycho shockwave, suffering 40 (+30% Magic Attack) magic damage and are violently launched into the air for 0.75 seconds, leaving them vulnerable to follow-up attacks. Should a 'Psycho Mine' be detonated within a 400-unit radius of Bison's target during the moment of impact, its destructive force merges with Bison's attack, intensifying the devastation. All enemies within the impact zone suffer an additional 60 (+40% Magic Attack) magic damage, and the duration of their airborne vulnerability is extended to a staggering 1.25 seconds. This prolonged vulnerability creates a significant window of opportunity for coordinated assaults. After landing his devastating blow, M. Bison channels the residual Psycho Power into a protective barrier, granting himself a shield that absorbs 50 (+20% Magic Attack) damage for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Psycho Driver (Ultimate)
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~16%).
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~20%).

(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~6% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: M. Bison channels his Psycho Power, gaining global vision and the ability to deploy up to three Psycho Mines anywhere on the map, consuming 25 Psycho Charge per mine. After a brief delay, M. Bison unleashes a massive Psycho Detonation, instantly detonating all placed Psycho Mines, dealing significant magic damage to enemies within their detonation radius, and stunning them for 1 second. If at least three mines are detonated simultaneously, the stun duration is increased to 2 seconds, and M. Bison gains a temporary 30% increase to his magic attack for 5 seconds. This ultimate emphasizes Bison's global presence and strategic mine placement.
abilities.flavorQuote: The world shall tremble before Shadaloo!

character_v1.playstyle: Strategic zoning and burst damage from afar
character_v1.teamSynergy: M. Bison synergizes well with teams that can capitalize on his zoning and crowd control, creating opportunities for allies to follow up with high-damage abilities. His ultimate provides global pressure, complementing other map-wide abilities.
character_v1.tierSummary: M. Bison has a good mix of magic attack, utility, and area damage. The 'Psycho Power' mechanic enhances his kit. Moving him to A accurately places him near the top.
appearanceTags: Red military uniform with large silver shoulder plates
Peaked cap with Shadaloo skull insignia
Ghastly white eyes glowing with Psycho Power
character_v1.internalSynergy: Psycho Charge management is key to M. Bison's kit, enabling strategic mine placement and detonations to maximize damage and control. Synergistic combos can be formed between Head Press and Psycho Crusher, utilizing mine detonations for amplified effects.

chapters.title: Dark Dealings
chapters.mission: The Magician must resist M. Bison's temptations and use his illusionary skills to expose Bison's evil plans to his subordinates, undermining his authority.
chapters.summary: M. Bison attempts to sway The Magician to his cause, promising him power and influence. The Magician is conflicted between his moral compass and the allure of forbidden knowledge.

friendshipCampaign.overview: M. Bison, seeking to enhance his global influence, attempts to recruit individuals to increase his overall campaign. He attempts to recruit The Magician.
bondPerks: Psycho Driver now has increased range

character_v1.name: Wolf

abilities.name: Basic Attack

abilities.description: Wolf unleashes a rapid volley of blaster fire, targeting the enemy with the lowest defense. This attack hits 5 times, each dealing 15% of Wolf's attack damage. If all five shots hit the same target, Wolf gains 1 stack of Vendetta. If the target dies during the barrage, the remaining shots are redirected to the next closest enemy, prioritizing those with low health. This ability has a short cooldown to allow for tactical repositioning and setup for other abilities, emphasizing quick, calculated strikes. This helps build stacks of Vendetta fast to prepare an enemy for a critical finisher.
abilities.flavorQuote: Feel the sting of calculated firepower!

abilities.name: Wolf Flash
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~22%).
abilities.description: Wolf executes a swift, unpredictable dash, dealing 60% of his attack damage to the first enemy he passes through and applying a 'Weak Point' debuff. This debuff increases the target's vulnerability to critical hits by 15% for 3 seconds. 'Wolf Flash' can be used defensively to evade attacks or offensively to set up high-damage combos. If used immediately after 'Blaster Barrage,' the cooldown of 'Wolf Flash' is reduced by 1 second, enabling faster engagements and disengagements. Mastering the timing of this ability is crucial for maximizing Wolf's effectiveness in battle. This ability is core for inflicting Weak Point, vital to the playstyle.
abilities.flavorQuote: Too slow! You can't anticipate my movements!

abilities.name: Ruthless Pursuit
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Whenever an enemy's health drops below 30%, Wolf gains 1 stack of Vendetta and his speed increases by 10% for 5 seconds. This passive ability reflects Wolf's predatory instincts, rewarding aggressive play and finishing blows. The speed boost allows him to quickly close the distance on weakened targets, further cementing his role as a lethal assassin. Stacks of Vendetta gained from Ruthless Pursuit can be combined with stacks gained from Blaster Barrage to maximize the power of Vendetta-consuming abilities, reinforcing the importance of strategic execution.
abilities.flavorQuote: Nowhere to run! Your end is here!

abilities.name: Vendetta Strike
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~16%).

abilities.description: Wolf unleashes a devastating strike, consuming all stacks of Vendetta to deal bonus critical damage. Each stack of Vendetta increases the critical hit damage by 25%. If the target is affected by 'Weak Point,' the critical hit chance is increased by an additional 10%. This ability represents Wolf's ultimate finishing move, requiring careful setup and precise timing to maximize its impact. The damage from Vendetta Strike is calculated before any damage mitigation effects, ensuring it remains a potent threat against even the tankiest opponents. Consuming stacks of Vendetta leaves Wolf vulnerable, emphasizing the high-risk, high-reward nature of this ability.
abilities.flavorQuote: This ends now! Feel my Vendetta!

abilities.name: Corneria Gambit
upgrades: (Patch) Role realignment: The 'Hunted' debuff now lasts for 7 seconds.
