abilities.description: Wolf calls in favors from his Cornerian underworld contacts. First, Leon locks onto the enemy with the highest Attack Damage, inflicting 'Hunted' for 5 seconds. This mark causes Wolf's subsequent attacks against the 'Hunted' target to grant 1 stack of Vendetta, up to a maximum of 3 stacks. Meanwhile, Pigma throws a volatile concoction at the enemy with the highest Max HP, dealing damage equal to 10% of their Maximum HP and inflicting 'Corrosive Bile'. 'Corrosive Bile' reduces the target's healing received by 30% for 5 seconds. Finally, Wolf unleashes a focused 'Vendetta Strike' against the 'Hunted' target dealing 200% of his Attack Damage. For each stack of Vendetta he possesses, this damage is amplified by an additional 20% Critical Damage. The Corneria Gambit leaves his foes vulnerable, setting the stage for a ruthless display of power.

character_v1.playstyle: High-Risk Burst Damage, Critical Strike Focused
character_v1.teamSynergy: Wolf synergizes well with characters who can apply crowd control or debuffs, making it easier for him to land critical hits and secure kills. He also benefits from allies who can provide shields or heals, mitigating the risks associated with his aggressive playstyle.
character_v1.tierSummary: Wolf is an attacker with speed and a 'Vendetta' mechanic. Although atk is high, the conditional nature of Vendetta and the slightly squishy nature keeps the placement at B.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Wolf's kit revolves around building Vendetta stacks through Blaster Barrage and Ruthless Pursuit, then consuming them with Vendetta Strike for massive burst damage. Wolf Flash enables critical hit setup and mobility, complementing his aggressive playstyle.

chapters.title: Ruthless Tactics
chapters.mission: Wolf and Protoman engage in simulated combat scenarios, with Wolf focusing on executing his Vendetta Strikes with maximum efficiency under Protoman's guidance.
chapters.summary: Wolf trains with Protoman, learning advanced combat tactics and strategies to exploit enemy weaknesses and deliver devastating killing blows.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Wolf, seeking to maximize his vendetta-driven power, seeks guidance on tactical ruthlessness from someone who understands the thrill of the hunt.
bondPerks: Ruthless Pursuit now grants temporary speed boost

character_v1.name: Betilla

abilities.name: Fae Spark
upgrades: Lv10: Slightly increased damage scaling.
Lv50: Grants a small bonus to critical hit chance and enhances interactions involving multi-hit combos.
Lv100: Increases the base damage of Fae Spark and adds a minor supportive utility effect on hit.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: Reduced peak potency ~14% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Patch) Role realignment: This ability now emphasizes damage-style interactions.
abilities.description: Betilla channels her magic to unleash a concentrated bolt of pure, dazzling energy towards a chosen foe. This basic ranged attack deals physical damage, scaling with her Attack stat. The projectile travels swiftly, striking the primary target with a burst of light and force. Though focused on a single target, the intensity of this magic has limits; peak potency was reduced by roughly 14%, and the effect grows gradually, demanding precise timing and a sharp sense of opportunity.

abilities.name: Glade Burst
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~34%).
abilities.description: Betilla focuses her inherent magical energy, channeling the spirit of the Glade of Dreams into a potent projectile. She launches a verdant burst of energy in a straight line, which upon striking an enemy, deals 80 magic damage, enhanced by 60% of her Magic Attack. This burst travels across a considerable distance, facilitating engagements from afar, and upon impacting an enemy, triggers an additional benefit. Striking an enemy with Glade Burst imbues Betilla with a stack of 'Nymph's Blessing,' a source of magical energy that empowers her future spellcasting. Furthermore, successfully hitting an enemy champion with the Glade Burst sends a wave of invigorating magic to nearby allied champions, enhancing their mobility by granting them a 10% increase to their movement speed for a duration of 3 seconds, helping them to either chase down enemies or escape danger. The presence of Nymph's Blessing reduces the cooldown of this ability. For each stack of Nymph's Blessing Betilla possesses, the cooldown of Glade Burst is reduced by 0.5 seconds, down to a minimum cooldown of 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Nature's Embrace
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~17%).
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Betilla summons a circular zone of revitalizing energy at a target location. Allies within the zone are healed for 40 (+30% Magic ATK) HP per second. Enemies within the zone take 30 (+20% Magic ATK) magic damage per second. If Betilla has at least 3 stacks of Nymph's Grace, the healing effect is amplified by 50%. The zone lasts for 5 seconds. This ability provides both sustain for allies and a zoning tool to control areas. Stacks of Nymph's Grace are consumed upon casting this ability. Consumes 3 stacks of Nymph's Grace upon activation.
abilities.flavorQuote: Let the earth cradle you.

abilities.name: Sparkling Barrier
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~7% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Betilla creates a shimmering shield around herself or a target ally for 4 seconds, absorbing up to 150 (+40% Magic ATK) damage. While the shield is active, the target also gains 20% increased tenacity. If the shield breaks before the duration ends, Betilla gains one stack of Nymph's Grace. This allows for strategic plays, whether protecting vulnerable allies or enabling aggressive positioning for herself. The shield has a visual indicator that changes color as it absorbs damage, providing feedback on its remaining strength. If Sparkling Barrier is cast on an ally while Betilla has any stacks of Nymph's Grace, those stacks are transferred to the shielded ally upon cast.
abilities.flavorQuote: A little protection goes a long way.

abilities.name: Nymph's Grace
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~16% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Whenever Betilla lands an ability, she gains a stack of Nymph's Grace, up to a maximum of 5 stacks. Each stack of Nymph's Grace grants Betilla 5% increased Magic ATK. At 5 stacks, Betilla's next ability has its range increased by 30% and deals 20% increased damage. All stacks are consumed after casting an ability with the empowered bonus. This encourages skillful play and precise ability usage to maximize damage output and utility. The duration of Nymph's Grace stacks is 8 seconds, refreshing upon gaining a new stack. Stacks of Nymph's Grace are visible through an on-screen UI element.
abilities.flavorQuote: The forest lends its power to those who respect it.

abilities.name: Forest Fury
abilities.description: Betilla unleashes a torrent of nature's wrath in a large cone in front of her, dealing 200 (+80% Magic ATK) magic damage to all enemies within the area over 3 seconds. For each stack of Nymph's Grace Betilla has upon casting, the damage is increased by 10%, and enemies are slowed by 15% for 2 seconds. After the channeling period, Betilla gains 3 stacks of Nymph's Grace. This ability is ideal for team fights and clearing waves, rewarding strategic stacking of Nymph's Grace before unleashing its full potential. Any Nymph's Grace stacks beyond 5 increase the slow duration by .2 seconds each.
abilities.flavorQuote: Feel the wrath of the wild!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Betilla works well with teams that can capitalize on her burst damage and utility. Allies who can engage or set up for her skillshots, such as tanks with crowd control, are valuable. Her shielding and movement speed buffs also enhance the survivability and mobility of her team. She particularly shines with hyper-carry compositions, providing protection and damage amplification.
character_v1.tierSummary: Betilla is a magic-based character with a focus on healing and damage. The overall impact is not enough to be in the B range. Up to C+ to help flatten the F tier distribution.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Betilla's kit revolves around building stacks of Nymph's Grace to amplify her ability effects. Mystic Orb allows for quick stack generation, while Nature's Embrace consumes stacks for a powerful healing/damage pulse. Sparkling Barrier offers protection and can indirectly generate or transfer stacks. Forest Fury serves as a finisher, scaling dramatically with Nymph's Grace stacks.

chapters.title: Supportive Spirit
chapters.mission: Betilla and Peppy assist other allies in a challenging trial, with Betilla focusing on maximizing the effectiveness of her support abilities under Peppy's guidance.
chapters.summary: Betilla learns from Peppy how to provide effective support. She learns to use her abilities to boost allies and hinder enemies.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Betilla seeks out Peppy Hare, recognizing his wisdom and support skills. She hopes to learn to better support her allies.
bondPerks: Nature's Embrace now applies a shield to allies

character_v1.name: The Magician

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~12% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~38%).
abilities.description: Melee basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Fire.

abilities.name: Hat Trick Teleport
abilities.description: The Magician vanishes into his hat, designating a target ally within a medium range. After a brief 0.75-second channel, he reappears beside the chosen ally, granting them a shield that absorbs X damage (scales with magic atk) for 3 seconds. Additionally, the Magician gains 1 stack of 'Misdirection'. If the targeted ally is crowd-controlled, the channel time is reduced by 0.25 seconds and the shield amount is increased by 20%. This ability has a cooldown of 12 seconds. The ability prioritizes allies with the lowest health percentage. Using this ability also slightly increases the Magician's evasion for 2 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Now you see me, now you're safe!

abilities.name: Illusory Decoy
abilities.description: The Magician conjures an illusory decoy of himself at a target location within a short range. The decoy lasts for 5 seconds and mimics The Magician's basic attack animations but deals no damage. Enemies targeting the decoy suffer a 15% accuracy reduction against the Magician for 3 seconds. If The Magician has at least 3 stacks of 'Misdirection', consuming them creates two decoys instead of one, placed slightly apart. These decoys persist for 7 seconds and grant the Magician stealth for 1 second after they are created. This ability has a cooldown of 15 seconds and can be recast during its duration to move the decoy to a new location once. The decoy's health scales with 50% of Magician's max HP.
abilities.flavorQuote: Which one is the real me?

abilities.name: Protoon Polymorph
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~7% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~11%).
abilities.description: The Magician fires a Protoon-infused blast at a target enemy within medium range. If the blast hits, the enemy is polymorphed into a harmless Tring for 2.5 seconds. Polymorphed enemies are silenced, disarmed, and have their movement speed reduced by 40%. If the targeted enemy is already debuffed, the duration of the polymorph is increased by 1 second. This ability consumes 2 stacks of 'Misdirection' to also inflict a 20% damage reduction debuff on the target for 5 seconds after the polymorph ends. This ability has a cooldown of 18 seconds. The ability prioritizes targets with the highest attack damage.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time for a little… transformation!

abilities.name: Scholar's Insight
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~10% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: The Magician gains 1 stack of 'Misdirection' whenever an ally successfully dodges an attack or resists a crowd control effect. Each stack of 'Misdirection' increases the Magician's magic defense by 3% (max 10 stacks). Upon reaching 10 stacks, the Magician consumes all stacks to grant all allies a temporary buff that increases their tenacity by 25% for 4 seconds. Stacks decay after 15 seconds if not consumed. The tenacity buff is applied globally.
abilities.flavorQuote: Knowledge is the greatest magic.

abilities.name: Grand Illusion
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~29%).
abilities.description: The Magician channels for 2 seconds, creating a massive illusory dome around the battlefield for 8 seconds. Inside the dome, all allies gain a 30% increase to their evasion and critical hit chance. Enemies inside the dome have their vision range reduced by 50% and are afflicted with a 10% chance to misfire their abilities (abilities go on cooldown but have no effect). After the dome collapses, the Magician gains 5 stacks of 'Misdirection'. If an ally is brought below 20% health while inside the dome, they are instantly healed for 20% of their max health. This ability has a cooldown of 90 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Behold, my greatest trick!

character_v1.teamSynergy: The Magician synergizes well with high-damage carries who benefit from increased evasion and critical hit chance, and with tanks who can capitalize on the enemy's reduced vision range. He also complements teams that focus on crowd control, as Protoon Polymorph extends the duration of existing debuffs. Allies who can reliably trigger dodges or resists further accelerate the accumulation of 'Misdirection' stacks.
character_v1.tierSummary: The Magician's kit is unreliable. Stealth and Polymorph, while useful, do not compensate for the low stats. Remains at F but promoted to F+ due to friendship campaign buffs.

tips: Prioritize Hat Trick Teleport on allies who are taking heavy damage or are about to be crowd-controlled to maximize its shield effectiveness and Misdirection generation.
Use Illusory Decoy to bait enemy attacks and reduce their accuracy against you, especially when you have Misdirection stacks to create two decoys and gain stealth.
Save Protoon Polymorph for high-priority targets with high attack damage, and make sure you have Misdirection stacks to inflict a damage reduction debuff after the polymorph ends.
strategyData.overview: The Magician is a support character that relies on Misdirection stacks to enhance his abilities and provide utility to his team. Focus on keeping your allies alive and disrupting enemies while managing your Misdirection stacks effectively. You're not a damage dealer; prioritize support and control.
strategyData.counterplay: The Magician is vulnerable when his Misdirection stacks are low. Focus fire on him to prevent him from building stacks and using his enhanced abilities. Crowd control him to interrupt his channeling abilities like Hat Trick Teleport and Grand Illusion, and be wary of the illusory dome from his ultimate, which can drastically alter the flow of battle.

character_v1.internalSynergy: The Magician's kit is designed around accumulating and expending 'Misdirection' stacks, creating a flow of buffing allies, debuffing enemies, and then amplifying subsequent actions. Hat Trick Teleport provides early shielding and Misdirection. Illusory Decoy offers strategic misdirection and stealth. Protoon Polymorph turns the tide of battle by disabling key threats. Scholar's Insight rewards reactive play and provides team-wide tenacity. Grand Illusion is a powerful ultimate that manipulates the battlefield, boosting allies and hindering enemies.

character_v1.name: Peppy Hare

abilities.name: Finger Waggers
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: Increases [Defense Up] buff duration by 1 second.
Lv100: Adds a small amount of base damage and increases the duration of [Stun] debuff by 0.25 seconds.

abilities.description: Peppy fires a single, forceful wag of his finger towards a targeted enemy, channeling light energy into the gesture. The forceful point deals physical damage, calculated as a base value plus a scaling factor based on Peppy's attack stat. Furthermore, the light energy discharged with the wag temporarily empowers Peppy's defenses, granting him a [Defense Up] buff for 3 seconds. This buff increases Peppy's defense stat by a percentage of his base defense, making him more resilient to incoming damage. Enemies hit by this finger wag are momentarily stunned by its sheer audacity, inflicting a [Stun] debuff that lasts for a brief period of 0.5 seconds, interrupting their actions and giving Peppy and his allies a window of opportunity to capitalize. The light emitted from the finger wag also washes over Peppy, granting a [Shield] equal to 5% of the damage dealt by the finger wag for 1 second.

abilities.name: Evasive Maneuver
upgrades: [object Object]
[object Object]
[object Object]
[object Object]
abilities.description: Peppy utilizes his extensive flight combat expertise, executing a textbook evasive maneuver, becoming invulnerable to all incoming damage for a critical 1.5 seconds, deftly avoiding enemy fire and potential threats. Immediately following this impressive display of aerial finesse, Peppy emits a concussive blast of disorienting sound waves from his ship's advanced sound system, projected forward in a wide cone. This auditory assault drastically reduces the attack damage of all enemies caught within the cone by a debilitating 30% and significantly hampers their movement speed, slowing them down by 20%. The damaging effects of these disruptive sound waves endure for a crucial 3 seconds, giving Peppy and his allies a significant advantage in the immediate aftermath. This core ability is subject to a moderate cooldown of 12 seconds. Furthermore, each successful execution of 'Evasive Maneuver' grants Peppy one stack of 'Tactical Assessment', a passive buff that enhances his strategic capabilities on the battlefield, up to a maximum of 5 stacks. This move is more than a mere escape; it's a calculated play to weaken enemies and create opportunities for his team.

abilities.name: Veteran's Insight
abilities.description: Peppy utilizes his extensive combat experience to analyze a target enemy, revealing their primary damage type (Physical/Magical) and any active buffs or shields they possess. For the next 5 seconds, allies attacking the analyzed target deal 10% increased damage of the opposite type, capitalizing on the enemy's weaknesses (e.g., if target is Physical, allies deal 10% bonus Magic damage). This ability has a 15-second cooldown. Casting Veteran's Insight grants Peppy 1 stack of Tactical Assessment. This ability turns knowledge into a powerful advantage, allowing the team to focus their attacks for maximum effectiveness.
abilities.flavorQuote: I've seen this before. Exploit their weakness!

abilities.name: Team Support
abilities.description: Peppy provides encouragement and tactical support to his allies, granting all nearby teammates a temporary boost to their stats. Allies within a 500-unit radius gain 15% increased attack damage, 15% increased magic damage and 10% increased movement speed for 6 seconds. This ability has a 20-second cooldown. This ability provides a potent team-wide advantage, enabling coordinated assaults and rapid repositioning. Using 'Team Support' grants 1 stack of Tactical Assessment.
abilities.flavorQuote: We're in this together! Push forward!

abilities.name: Tactical Assessment
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description:
Peppy gains a stack of Tactical Assessment whenever he successfully assists an ally (healing, shielding, buffing) or debuffs an enemy. At 3 stacks, Peppy can activate this ability to expend all stacks. Upon activation, choose one of the following effects:

*   **Offensive Maneuver:** Grant all allies 20% increased critical hit chance and 15% critical hit damage for 8 seconds.
*   **Defensive Formation:** Grant all allies a shield equal to 10% of their max HP and 20 tenacity for 5 seconds.
*   **Reconnaissance Sweep:** Reveal the locations of all enemy champions on the map for 4 seconds. 

After activation, Tactical Assessment is reset to 0 stacks. This passive allows Peppy to adapt to different situations and provides critical support to his team when they need it most.
abilities.flavorQuote: Alright team, I've got a plan!

character_v1.playstyle: A team-oriented support that leverages knowledge and experience to empower allies, turning the tide of battle with well-timed buffs and strategic maneuvers.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Peppy excels in team compositions that benefit from coordinated attacks and strategic advantages. He synergizes well with high-damage carries who can capitalize on his buffs, as well as tanky frontliners who can protect him while he builds Tactical Assessment stacks. His ability to reveal enemy positions is invaluable for initiating fights and controlling the map.
character_v1.tierSummary: Peppy has a support kit, but it is muddled and relies on conditional triggers. Low stats. Slightly higher than Yuzuriha.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Peppy's kit revolves around building stacks of Tactical Assessment through support actions, which then allows him to unleash a powerful team-wide buff or debuff. His 'Do a Barrel Roll!' and 'Veteran's Insight' provide survivability and tactical advantages, while 'Team Support' amplifies his team's offensive capabilities.

chapters.summary: Peppy partners with The Magician, gaining insights into magical support techniques and learning how to weave enchantments into his tactical maneuvers.

abilities.description: Robo initiates a rapid diagnostic and repair sequence, targeting a single ally with a focused burst of nanobots and energy.  He temporarily diverts power from his mobility systems, causing him to be briefly stationary (0.5 seconds) while calibrating the repair matrix. Upon completion, the targeted ally receives an immediate injection of restorative nanites, healing them for an amount equal to 100% of Robo's magic attack stat. Furthermore, for each entry in Robo's internal Database, the healing potency is enhanced by an additional 10% of his magic attack stat, representing his advanced understanding of biological systems and repair protocols. If the targeted ally's current health is below 30% of their maximum health, the nanite injection is overclocked, providing an additional surge of 50% of Robo's magic attack stat as bonus healing. During the sequence, Robo emits a series of diagnostic beeps: "Initiating Recalibration Protocol... Analyzing subject's condition... Administering nanite repair solution." The efficacy of this protocol is directly linked to Robo's understanding of various biological structures, thus scaling multiplicatively with his magic attack.

abilities.name: Rocket Punch
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Robo launches his fist at a single enemy, dealing physical damage. Upon impact, Robo analyzes the target, adding a 'Combat Data' entry to his Database. This entry provides information about the target's defenses and vulnerabilities. The damage dealt by Rocket Punch is increased by 5% for each 'Combat Data' entry in Robo's Database. Additionally, the target is slowed by 20% for 2 seconds. Robo states: "Analyzing target's armor composition... Launching projectile!" This ability can be upgraded with Database entries to increase damage, slow duration, or apply a debuff that reduces the target's armor.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Calculating optimal trajectory. Firing!"

abilities.name: Laser Spin
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~16% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Robo spins rapidly, emitting a laser that damages all enemies within a radius of X. The damage is dealt as magical damage. For each unique enemy hit by Laser Spin, Robo gains one 'Area Analysis' entry in his Database, up to a maximum of 3 entries per cast. Robo declares: "Executing Area Scan. Engaging Laser Array!" These entries provide insight into AoE tactics and enemy positioning. The range of Laser Spin is increased by 10% for every 5 'Area Analysis' entries stored in the Database. The power of the laser scales with his Magic Attack stat and can be upgraded using the Database entries.
abilities.flavorQuote: "All targets within parameters. Commencing area denial!"

abilities.name: Database Upload
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~17% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Robo passively analyzes combat situations, accumulating data in his 'Database'. Robo's Database can store a maximum of 50 entries. Different abilities add different types of entries to the Database (e.g., 'Combat Data', 'Area Analysis', 'Healing Analysis'). At any time, Robo can spend these entries to upgrade his active abilities, granting them increased potency, new effects, or reduced cooldowns. Robo occasionally announces: "Processing Data Stream. System Optimization in Progress...". Each ability upgrade costs a certain amount of database entries related to the skill being upgraded, with some upgrades requiring mixed types of entries to unlock.
abilities.flavorQuote: "My data banks are expanding. Processing... processing..."

abilities.description: Robo dedicates all available processing power to analyzing enemy vulnerabilities, then converts this knowledge into a powerful burst of energy. Upon activation, Robo expends all entries in his Database, unleashing a radiant beam that deals magic damage to all enemy targets in a large area. The initial damage is amplified based on the number of entries consumed; each entry increases the base damage by a percentage derived from Robo's Attack and Magic Attack. As Robo analyzes more data, the more devastating the attack becomes. Furthermore, if Robo's Database contains at least 30 entries before activation, the intensity of the analysis allows Robo to identify and exploit critical weaknesses, applying a 'Compromised Systems' debuff to all affected enemies. This debuff reduces their magic resistance by 50% for a duration of 5 seconds, making them significantly more vulnerable to subsequent magical attacks. Robo announces: "Executing Target Analysis: Obliterate! All Systems Nominal!" as he initiates the attack sequence. This ultimate ability offers immense burst potential, especially when Robo has thoroughly studied his opponents.

character_v1.playstyle: Durable, late-game scaling support with healing and damage capabilities.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Robo synergizes well with teams that can provide protection during his initial slow ramp-up phase. Characters that can crowd control enemies to maximize the effectiveness of Laser Spin, or those that benefit from healing, are ideal partners. Robo's late-game scaling allows him to transition from a pure support role into a significant damage threat, making him a versatile addition to any team.
character_v1.tierSummary: Robo suffers from average stats. He has too much dependence on 'Database'. This is now reflected with a friendship campaign focused on elemental attacks. Low-end F tier.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Robo's kit revolves around building up his 'Database' and then expending it for powerful upgrades or a devastating ultimate. Rocket Punch and Laser Spin provide data, while Cure Beam benefits from it passively. Omega Flare serves as the ultimate payoff for efficient data collection.

character_v1.name: Gabimaru

abilities.name: Tengentsu Strike
upgrades: Lv10: +5% ATK scaling (max 85%).

abilities.description: Gabimaru focuses his Tengentsu to deliver a precise strike, dealing physical damage infused with otherworldly flames to a single target. This attack deals base damage plus a percentage of Gabimaru's Attack, scaling to a maximum of 80% ATK as fire damage. Upon striking a foe, Gabimaru ignites their life force for 3 seconds, applying 'Kindling' that reduces their outgoing damage by 5% and healing a nearby ally for a proportional amount of the damage dealt, up to 75% of the Kindling's damage reduction. The healing is distributed evenly amongst allies within a moderate radius. Gabimaru’s mastery over Tengentsu allows him to occasionally land a critical strike, increasing both the initial damage and Kindling heal potency.

abilities.name: Flickering Embers
abilities.description: Gabimaru's basic attacks on enemy champions and large monsters grant 1 stack of Hibana, up to a maximum of 5 stacks. Each stack of Hibana increases Gabimaru's movement speed by 3% and attack damage by 2.5. Hibana stacks decay after 4 seconds of not attacking an enemy. When Gabimaru reaches 5 stacks of Hibana, his next ability deals 15% increased damage. The decaying Hibana stacks provides a visual cue, displaying small embers fading around Gabimaru as the stacks reduce. Managing Hibana is essential for maximizing Gabimaru's burst potential and mobility in skirmishes.
abilities.flavorQuote: Even embers can ignite a raging fire.

abilities.name: Stone Storm
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Gabimaru stomps the ground, sending a volley of flaming stones in a cone-shaped area in front of him, dealing 70 / 110 / 150 / 190 / 230 (+60% bonus AD) physical damage. If Gabimaru has any Hibana stacks, each stack consumed increases the range of Stone Storm by 5% and its damage by 8% . Successfully hitting an enemy champion with Stone Storm grants Gabimaru a burst of 20 / 25 / 30 / 35 / 40% movement speed for 2 seconds. The visuals showcase Gabimaru's precise control over earth and fire, as the stones ignite upon impact with the ground.
abilities.flavorQuote: The earth provides, the fire consumes.

abilities.name: Unburdened Resolve
abilities.description: Gabimaru steels his resolve, briefly becoming resistant to crowd control and gaining damage reduction. For 2 seconds, Gabimaru gains 30/40/50/60/70% tenacity and reduces incoming damage by 15/20/25/30/35%. Additionally, Gabimaru gains immunity to knockbacks and knockups during this period. After the duration ends, Gabimaru emits a burst of spiritual energy, dealing 30/45/60/75/90 (+20% Bonus HP) magic damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 20% for 1.5 seconds. Activating Unburdened Resolve consumes all Hibana stacks. For each Hibana stack consumed, the duration of the initial effect is extended by 0.25 seconds, and the slow potency increases by 5%. This ability has a cooldown of 18 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: I will not yield.

abilities.name: Tao Flow: Ignited Path
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~15% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~7% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Gabimaru channels his Tao, unleashing a concentrated stream of crimson flames that scorches the earth in a straight line, dealing 90 / 140 / 190 / 240 / 290 (+75% bonus AD) physical damage to all enemies caught in its path. The inferno leaves behind a trail of flickering flames that persists for 3 seconds. Any foe foolish enough to tread upon this fiery path will suffer an additional 20 / 30 / 40 / 50 / 60 (+15% AP) magic damage per second, the heat searing their flesh and disrupting their focus. Furthermore, if Gabimaru has harnessed at least 3 stacks of Hibana, his latent pyromantic power intensifies the technique, reducing the cooldown of Tao Flow: Ignited Path by 2 seconds, allowing for more frequent barrages. Additionally, the width of the flame trail expands by 25%, increasing the area of denial and making it even more difficult for enemies to navigate the battlefield safely.

character_v1.teamSynergy: Gabimaru benefits from teammates who can provide crowd control or peel, allowing him to safely build Hibana stacks and unleash his burst potential. He synergizes well with engage supports or tanks who can initiate fights, creating opportunities for Gabimaru to dive the backline and assassinate priority targets.
character_v1.tierSummary: Gabimaru has a solid mix of atk, speed, and fire synergy. Unburdened Resolve is a nice defensive ability. Overall, B tier.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Gabimaru's kit is designed around building and expending Hibana stacks, encouraging an aggressive, combo-oriented playstyle. Flickering Embers rewards consistent aggression, while Stone Storm, Ascetic Blaze, and Pyro Bridge provide various ways to expend Hibana for increased damage and utility. Maximum Firepower serves as a powerful finisher, rewarding players for effectively managing their Hibana stacks.

abilities.name: Mirror Image
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Yuzuriha creates two illusory clones of herself that last for 5 seconds. These clones mimic her movements but deal no damage. Enemies that target a clone will have their vision slightly blurred for 1 second. Using 'Clone Weave' while clones are active allows Yuzuriha to swap places with one of the clones, chosen at random. If a clone is attacked, it vanishes instantly. Clones despawn after the duration ends. This ability is crucial for setting up ambushes and confusing opponents before engaging with her more damaging skills. Managing clone placement is key to maximizing its utility.
abilities.flavorQuote: Which one is the real me? Perhaps all of them.

abilities.name: Shadowstep Strike
abilities.description: Yuzuriha dashes a short distance, dealing moderate damage to the first enemy hit. The base damage is equivalent to 60% of her Attack Damage, scaling linearly to 90% at level 15. If 'Mirror Image' is active, Yuzuriha can choose to dash to the location of a clone instead, consuming that clone. If she dashes to a clone, the damage of 'Shadowstep Strike' is increased by 20%, down from 30%, and the target is stunned for 0.6 seconds, down from 0.75 seconds. This allows for unexpected engages or escapes, adding another layer of deception to her kit. Mastering the clone placement and timing of this ability is essential for bursting down priority targets or escaping unfavorable situations.
abilities.flavorQuote: Did you see that coming? I think not.

abilities.name: Veiled Presence
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~25%).
abilities.description: After using 'Clone Weave' or 'Mirror Image', Yuzuriha gains 15% increased movement speed and a 8% damage bonus, down from 10%, on her next auto-attack or ability within 3 seconds. This encourages aggressive playmaking and rewards smart use of her clone-based abilities. Additionally, if Yuzuriha remains out of combat for 8 seconds, her next auto-attack will critically strike, dealing 175% damage. This passive element allows her to punish unaware foes and make great use of her stealth opportunities.
abilities.flavorQuote: Patience, precision, and then... strike.

abilities.name: Ephemeral Onslaught
upgrades: Increases the base damage dealt by each strike by 5% of Yuzuriha's Attack Damage.
Increases the number of targets hit by 1.
Reduces the cooldown of this ability by 0.5 seconds.
If a critical strike occurs, reduces the enemy's armor by 5% for 3 seconds.

abilities.description: Yuzuriha becomes a whirlwind of precise strikes, targeting up to 5 enemies within a fan-shaped area in front of her over 1.5 seconds. Each strike deals damage equal to 30% of her Attack Damage stat. Each individual strike has a base 10% chance to critically hit, dealing 150% damage. However, if Yuzuriha perfectly times her attack to immediately follow a swap with one of her clones created by 'Clone Weave', the critical hit chance of each individual strike is dramatically increased to 30%, down from 40%, potentially resulting in devastating burst damage. Landing all strikes on a single target ensures maximum damage, turning Yuzuriha into a lethal assassin, while spreading the onslaught weakens multiple foes simultaneously, setting them up for a coordinated takedown by allies. The placement and control of Yuzuriha's clones are crucial to maximizing the potential of this skill, demanding careful planning and precise execution.

character_v1.teamSynergy: Yuzuriha benefits from teammates who can capitalize on her deceptive engages. Allies with strong crowd control or burst damage can quickly follow up on her stuns or clone explosions, securing kills and controlling team fights.
character_v1.tierSummary: Yuzuriha's kit has some burst potential but squishy. Her tag synergy isn't great. D tier.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Yuzuriha's kit is built around deception and mobility, using clones to confuse enemies and reposition herself for optimal attacks. 'Veiled Presence' rewards smart playmaking, while 'Shadowstep Strike' and 'Phantom Barrage' offer high-risk, high-reward opportunities to burst down targets.

abilities.name: Rubber Hose Rampage
abilities.description: Gumball's basic attacks and abilities generate 'Chaos Energy'. Basic attacks generate 5 Chaos Energy per hit. When Gumball reaches 100 Chaos Energy, his next ability cast consumes all Chaos Energy, enhancing the ability with a random effect chosen from a pool of possibilities. These effects range from increasing damage and adding status effects to altering the ability's area of effect or even summoning wacky cartoon props that aid him in battle. The effects have a 50% chance to be positive, 30% neutral, and 20% negative. Successfully hitting an enemy champion with an enhanced ability grants Gumball a small burst of movement speed (20% for 2 seconds) and reduces the cooldown of all his other abilities by 1 second, incentivizing aggressive play.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time for a cartoon beatdown!

abilities.name: Cardboard Catastrophe
upgrades: Lv10: Increases the base damage of Cardboard Catastrophe and the severity of the Papercuts debuff.
Lv50: Cardboard Catastrophe now has a chance to spawn a sentient cardboard box minion that fights alongside Gumball for a short duration.
Lv100: Upon impact, Cardboard Catastrophe grants a small shield to all allies within the area, made of… you guessed it, more cardboard!
abilities.description: Cardboard Catastrophe epitomizes Gumball's chaotic ingenuity. Upon activation, Gumball frantically rummages through an unseen pocket dimension, conjuring forth a precariously assembled fortress constructed entirely of cardboard boxes, duct tape, and sheer, unadulterated optimism. This 'fortress' is then hurled, with surprising velocity and questionable structural integrity, towards a designated target area. On impact, the Cardboard Catastrophe unleashes a series of unpredictable effects: First, it deals a modest amount of Physical damage in an area, with cardboard shrapnel spreading to adjacent enemies, applying a stacking debuff called 'Papercuts.' Each stack of Papercuts slightly reduces enemy attack speed and evasion. Furthermore, due to the haphazard nature of its construction, there's a chance (scaling with Gumball's Luck stat) that the fortress will spontaneously disassemble, releasing a swarm of angry hornets (purely cosmetic, but terrifying) or a rogue vacuum cleaner that briefly pulls enemies closer. The attack prioritizes enemies who are inflicted with other status ailments and has an equal chance to target any opponent within the targeting area if none are afflicted.
abilities.flavorQuote: Trust me, this is a *totally* foolproof plan!

abilities.name: Darwin's Serenade
abilities.description: Gumball strums a ukulele, sending out a sonic wave in a cone-shaped area in front of him. The wave deals 60 (+30% of Magic Attack) magic damage to enemies. If an ally is within the cone, they are healed for 40 (+20% of Magic Attack) health.  If Gumball has 100 Chaos Energy, consuming it causes the wave to charm enemies for 1 second while granting allies within the cone increased attack speed by 40% for 3 seconds. The charming effect only affects the first enemy hit. The heal amount is increased by 50% for allies with less than 40% HP.  This ability has a cooldown of 10 seconds, reduced by 1 second by Rubber Hose Rampage.
abilities.flavorQuote: A little tune to soothe the soul... or confuse it!

abilities.description: Gumball, embracing the absurd nature of Elmore, designates a localized zone ripe with cartoonish chaos. For a duration of 3 seconds, this area hums with unstable energy. Enemies caught within the designated zone are subjected to the chaotic forces, suffering 30 magic damage per second, enhanced by 15% of Gumball's Magic Attack, embodying the unpredictable nature of his world. Furthermore, each enemy within the area faces a 20% chance of being momentarily transformed into a random, utterly ordinary object - perhaps a discarded trash can, a bright orange traffic cone, or even a cheerful rubber duck. This sudden shift into mundane shapes stuns the unfortunate victim for 0.5 seconds, disrupting their actions and plans. If Gumball has accumulated 100 Chaos Energy, unleashing Cartoon Physics consumes this power to amplify its effects dramatically. The affected area expands by 50%, ensuring that more foes are caught in the chaotic field. The duration of the cartoonish instability extends to 5 seconds, prolonging the period of damage and transformation. Additionally, the chance of enemies transforming increases to a comical 40%, resulting in more frequent disruptions. Enemies unlucky enough to undergo this transformation also find themselves silenced for the duration of their inanimate existence, unable to cast spells or abilities during their brief stint as a household object. This ability has a base cooldown of 15 seconds, however it is reduced by 1 second for each successful trigger of Rubber Hose Rampage.

abilities.description: Gumball unleashes the sheer unpredictability of his cartoon existence, warping reality in a large area around him for 5 seconds. tips: Learn the Attunement Cycle: Memorize the Fire -> Water -> Wind sequence to pre-plan ability usage for maximum effect.
Prioritize Cooldown Management: With relatively long cooldowns, you must plan ahead and not waste abilities; think before you cast.
Ultimate Timing is Crucial: Elemental Convergence is best used before a key team fight or objective push, ensuring your next ability is a game-changer.
strategyData.overview: Krystal is a control mage whose effectiveness hinges on cycling through elemental attunements to maximize the utility of her abilities. Her kit offers a mix of damage, crowd control, and support, but she requires careful timing and positioning to make the most of her shifting elemental buffs. You will need to understand the order of her attunements (Fire, Water, Wind) and plan your ability usage accordingly. Otherwise, you're just flailing about and hoping for the best. Don't be that Krystal.
strategyData.counterplay: Krystal's power is predictable due to her fixed attunement cycle. Track her current element to anticipate her next move. Burst her down before she can get her full combo off, as she is quite fragile.

abilities.description: Sally's pet mimic, Spike, passively absorbs a percentage of the damage dealt to nearby allies. 15% of all damage dealt to allies within 500 units of Sally is redirected to Spike. This damage is then converted into a temporary shield for Sally, absorbing up to 20% of her maximum HP. If Spike takes damage that would exceed this amount, the remainder is ignored. Additionally, when Sally uses 'Quick Restock' on an ally, Spike also grants that ally a 5% damage reduction for 3 seconds, further enhancing their survivability. If Spike's absorbed damage is already capping Sally's shield when 'Quick Restock' is used, Spike bursts, cleansing all debuffs from Sally and nearby allies (300 units).
abilities.flavorQuote: Spike's got your back, and I've got his!

abilities.name: Shady Dealings
abilities.description: With a flick of her wrist and a conspiratorial wink, Sally conjures a hidden speakeasy aura, engulfing a 400-unit radius around the targeted location for a fleeting 5 seconds. Within this illicit zone, Sally's allies find themselves invigorated by her underworld connections, amplifying the effects of her 'Quick Restock' passive to dizzying heights. Mana surges back at a frantic rate, replenishing 50% of their maximum, energy floods their reserves at a breakneck 60%, and the cooldowns of their abilities plummet by 3 seconds, enabling a torrent of spells and strategic maneuvers. But the speakeasy isn't just for her friends. Enemies who inadvertently stumble into this dubious domain become 'marked' with Sally's suspicion. The next time Sally's claws strike a marked foe, she deftly pickpockets them, stealing 10% of their current gold and transferring it directly into her own overflowing pockets. Each successful theft fortifies her resolve, granting her a stack of 'Greed', each stack increasing her armor and magic resistance by 2, for a duration of 8 seconds. Sally can accumulate up to a maximum of 10 stacks of Greed, granting her an extra 20 armor and 20 magic resistance but only for a short time. Sally can only broker this deal every 15 seconds.

abilities.name: Spike's Surprise Stash

abilities.description: Sally rummages through Spike's peculiar hoard, conjuring a sizable chest shimmering with unknown enchantments at a chosen location within 700 units. This opulent container remains for 10 seconds, inviting interaction from allied champions. Upon approaching and engaging with the chest, each ally is granted one of three randomly selected boons: an immediate and complete replenishment of their mana or energy reserves, an ethereal shield of invulnerability rendering them immune to all damage for a fleeting 5 seconds, or a surge of restorative energy that instantly heals them for 30% of their maximum health, further augmented by an additional 10% of their missing health. Each ally is limited to receiving only a single, solitary benefit from Spike's chest. Adding to its allure, the chest emanates an enchanting aura extending 300 units outward, gradually impeding the movement speed of any enemies caught within its grasp. The slow begins at 5% and intensifies by an additional 5% each second, culminating in a maximum reduction of 30% after 6 seconds within the aura. Unfortunately, Spike’s generosity proves taxing. Once the chest vanishes, Sally experiences a brief bout of exhaustion, diminishing her movement speed by 20% for a duration of 5 seconds. This potent ability is subject to a cooldown of 120 seconds.

Her 'Restock' mechanic supports mana/energy-hungry carries and helps cooldown-dependent mages maintain their output. She also provides valuable protection for squishy allies through Spike and 'Barter and Deal'.

character_v1.internalSynergy: Sally's abilities synergize by enabling extended sustain for allies through 'Quick Restock' and increased survivability via Spike's damage redirection. 'Emergency Discount' amplifies these effects, and 'Spike's Grand Inventory' provides game-changing benefits during critical moments.

abilities.description: The Tao Trio embodies the balance of Truth, Ideals, and Void. Dealing or receiving damage fills the Tao Harmony gauge. abilities.description: The Tao Trio merges the essence of Truth, Ideals, and Void into a single, overwhelming attack. This ability has a global range. Upon activation, the Tao Trio becomes invulnerable for 1 second while channeling. After the channel, they unleash a massive burst of energy at the target location. The effect varies depending on the *LAST* form the Tao Trio transformed into before casting Trinity Nova. **Reshiram (Truth):** Creates a supernova, dealing 300 (+120% Magic Attack) Fire damage to all enemies in the target area and inflicting a 'Scorched Earth' debuff, reducing their armor and magic resistance by 30% for 5 seconds. **Zekrom (Ideals):** Summons a thunderous storm, dealing 300 (+120% Attack) Electric damage to all enemies in the target area and granting all allies in the area 20% increased attack speed and movement speed for 5 seconds. **Kyurem (Void):** Creates an absolute zero zone, dealing 300 (+60% Magic Attack + 60% Attack) Ice damage to all enemies in the target area and rooting them for 2 seconds. character_v1.teamSynergy: The Tao Trio provides a flexible toolkit for any team composition. Reshiram's debuffs benefit damage-focused teams, Zekrom's buffs empower aggressive strategies, and Kyurem's crowd control provides setup for burst compositions. Their ability to adapt makes them a valuable asset in any scenario.
character_v1.tierSummary: Reshiram's complex scaling is balanced out by average stats. KPS 77 is appropriate for B+ due to the need for high investment.

tips: Consistently switch forms based on the situation and desired playstyle: Reshiram for sustained magic damage and debuffs, Zekrom for burst physical damage and buffs, Kyurem for CC and mixed damage. Think ahead, since the LAST form determines the ultimate's effect.

Manage the Tao Harmony gauge: Balance dealing and taking damage to maintain a steady flow of transformations. Avoid prolonged periods of either passively taking damage or passively waiting for your team to deal damage.
Prioritize ability upgrades: The Tao Harmony passive's scaling buff significantly enhances the Trio's late-game effectiveness, so get it as early as possible.
strategyData.overview: The Tao Trio is a highly versatile character with the ability to adapt to different situations thanks to their transformation mechanic. Mastering the Tao Harmony gauge and strategically choosing the right form for Trinity Nova are key to maximizing their potential. This is a character for advanced players who enjoy a more complex game plan and are willing to think multiple steps ahead.
strategyData.counterplay: Disrupt their Tao Harmony gauge by focusing fire, or by avoiding damaging them for long periods. Be aware of the last form they took, and bait out the less desirable Trinity Nova. CC abilities can interrupt their form switching and ultimate usage.

Using Cura strategically increases the potency of her summons, while 'Ruby's Radiance' enables her to both damage and protect her team. 'Royal Resolve' provides a failsafe while 'Eidolon's Resurgence' can unleash a devastating barrage of Eidolon attacks.
character_v1.bestFriendshipBuff: Increased Magic ATK and Healing when paired with characters using Water abilities.

chapters.title: Echoes of Iifa
chapters.mission: Navigate treacherous terrain, solve puzzles, and defeat guardians to acquire the crystals, making difficult choices that impact the fate of the kingdom.
chapters.summary: Garnet enlists Sally's help to find rare summoning crystals, facing moral dilemmas and environmental hazards along the way.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Garnet seeks to prove her worth as a summoner and queen, embarking on a journey to connect with new Eidolons and protect her kingdom.

character_v1.name: Braixen

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~17% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Fire.

abilities.name: Wand Flourish
upgrades: (Patch) Role realignment: this ability now emphasizes assassin-style interactions.
abilities.description: Braixen channels potent energy through its wand, empowering her offensive capabilities. After using any active ability, Braixen's next basic attack within 5 seconds is enhanced, becoming a searing projectile. This enhanced attack deals an additional 35 (+40% AP) magic damage upon impact. Furthermore, the very air around the target ignites, creating a fiery blossom that erupts after a short delay of 0.75 seconds. This secondary explosion deals an additional 55 (+55% AP) magic damage to all enemies within a radius of 175 units around the initial target. This explosion applies a debuff that reduces the magic resistance of all affected enemies by 12% for 4 seconds, allowing Braixen and her allies to inflict even greater magical devastation. This debuff stacks additively with itself, up to a maximum reduction of 36% magic resistance, allowing for incredible burst damage potential when multiple wand flourishes are successfully detonated in quick succession.

abilities.name: Mystic Twig
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~12% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~44%).
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~12% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Braixen hurls her flaming twig in a target direction, dealing 70 (+60% Magic ATK) magic damage to the first enemy hit. If the twig hits an enemy already affected by Kindle, it detonates a small burst of flame, dealing an additional 50 (+40% Magic ATK) magic damage to nearby enemies and applying 2 stacks of Kindle. The twig remains on the ground for 5 seconds, acting as a ward providing vision in a small radius. If Braixen is near the twig, she can recast this ability to dash to it, consuming the twig and healing herself for 4% of her max HP. Cooldown: 8 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Guiding flames to illuminate the path and scorch the foe.

abilities.name: Foxfire Renewal
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~25%).
abilities.description: Braixen, channeling the playful spirit of her younger form, performs a focused incantation, generating a surge of restorative foxfire energy around a targeted ally. With a measured cadence of gestures, she channels a swirling vortex of embers and incandescent sparks directly into the recipient, granting significant restorative effects. The targeted ally is instantly healed for 10% (+10% per 100 AP) of their maximum health, representing a potent surge of revitalizing warmth. Furthermore, the revitalizing flames empower them with a radiant aura, increasing their movement speed by 20% for a duration of 5 seconds, allowing them to deftly maneuver the battlefield and escape immediate danger. The swirling flames also cleanse the ally of one impairing debuff, as the fire burns away negative afflictions. Cooldown: 18 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Remember the joy of the flame, and let it carry you through.

abilities.name: Psychic Flare
abilities.description: Braixen channels psychic energy, creating a delayed explosion at a target location after 2 seconds. The explosion deals 100 (+80% Magic ATK) magic damage in a large area and applies 3 stacks of Kindle to all enemies hit. If an enemy has less than 25% health, the channeling time is reduced to 1 second, and the damage is increased by 20%. Enemies standing in the area during the channel are slowed by 25%. The range of this ability increases by 15% if Braixen has at least 50% of her max HP remaining. Cooldown: 12 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: A burst of psychic power, amplified by searing flames.

character_v1.teamSynergy: Braixen excels in teams that can capitalize on her burst damage and area control. Allies that can group enemies together or provide additional crowd control can maximize the impact of Psychic Flare and Inferno's Call. She also synergizes well with damage amplifiers, making her Kindle explosions even more lethal.
character_v1.tierSummary: Braixen is frail. KPS 62 is appropriate for C-
character_v1.internalSynergy: Braixen's abilities synergize around the Kindle mechanic, allowing her to consistently apply stacks and trigger powerful explosions. Mystic Twig provides mobility and sustain, while Psychic Flare offers burst damage and crowd control. Fiery Mirage enhances her survivability and sets up Kindle transfers, and Inferno's Call provides a devastating finisher.
character_v1.bestFriendshipBuff: Increased Magic ATK and Speed when paired with characters using Fire abilities.

chapters.title: The Ember's Echo
chapters.mission: Explore ancient ruins, decipher cryptic texts, and engage in magical duels to master the ritual, confronting moral dilemmas and unforeseen consequences.
chapters.summary: Braixen collaborates with Magus to understand the ritual's implications, combining her pyromancy with his dark arts to unravel its secrets.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Braixen's quest for mastery over fire magic leads her to uncover a forgotten ritual with the potential to either save or destroy the region.
bondPerks: Foxfire Renewal has longer buff duration

character_v1.name: Sora

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Fire.

abilities.name: Sonic Blade
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~10% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Sora dashes forward a short distance, dealing 60 + (30% Atk) physical damage to enemies in his path and applying a stack of 'Momentum'. Momentum stacks up to 3 times, with each stack increasing the damage of his next basic attack by 15% and granting a 5% bonus to his movement speed for 3 seconds. If Sora has reached max stacks of Momentum, using Sonic Blade will consume all stacks to unleash a powerful thrust dealing 100 + (60% Atk) physical damage. This ability generates 5 Drive Points per enemy hit, split evenly among them if multiple enemies are struck. The dash distance is affected by movement speed buffs and debuffs. This ability has a cooldown of 8 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time to put some pep in my step!

abilities.name: Ragnarok
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~39%).
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~37%).
abilities.description: Sora leaps into the air and fires a volley of 8 energy projectiles that deal 20 + (10% Magic Atk) magic damage each to the target enemy. Sora is briefly untargetable during the leap. If Sora is in Valor Form, the number of projectiles is increased to 12, and their damage is increased by 25%. If Sora is in Wisdom Form, the projectiles home in on the target. Activating Ragnarok grants Sora 10 Drive Points. Ragnarok has a cooldown of 10 seconds. During the leap, Sora is immune to ground-based effects but can still be targeted by aerial abilities. The range of the leap is moderate, allowing Sora to reposition himself while dealing damage.
abilities.flavorQuote: Light up the darkness!

abilities.name: Guard
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Sora braces himself, gaining a shield that absorbs up to 100 + (50% of his Def) damage for 3 seconds. While the shield is active, Sora's movement speed is reduced by 20%. If the shield breaks before the duration ends, Sora gains 15 Drive Points. If the shield expires naturally, Sora gains 5 Drive Points. Guarding against an attack that would otherwise stun or knock him back negates the effect and instantly grants Sora 20 Drive Points. This ability has a cooldown of 12 seconds. The shield scales with Sora's defense stat, making him more resilient with increased investment in defense.
abilities.flavorQuote: Bring it on!

abilities.name: Drive Forms
abilities.description: Sora gains Drive Points whenever he deals damage with his abilities or basic attacks. Upon reaching 100 Drive Points, Sora can activate a Drive Form. Activating a Drive Form consumes all Drive Points and grants Sora a temporary bonus for 10 seconds. Valor Form grants 30% increased Atk and 15% increased speed. Wisdom Form grants 30% increased Magic Atk and reduces ability cooldowns by 20%. Limit Form grants 20% lifesteal and allows Sora to ignore enemy defenses for 3 seconds after activation. Drive Forms have a 1-second global cooldown. The bonus stats provided by Drive Forms stack additively with other buffs. Sora reverts to his normal state when the Drive Form duration ends, or if he is stunned.
abilities.flavorQuote: My heart is my power!

abilities.name: Trinity Limit
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Sora unleashes a dazzling combo attack, dealing a series of strikes that culminate in a powerful final blow. Sora deals 50 + (25% Atk) physical damage five times in rapid succession to a target enemy, followed by a final hit that deals 150 + (75% Atk) physical damage and knocks them back. During the Trinity Limit animation, Sora is invulnerable. If Sora has an ally nearby (within a 5-unit radius), the final hit's damage is increased by 50%, and it deals damage in an area around the primary target. This ability generates 30 Drive Points. Trinity Limit has a cooldown of 90 seconds. The knockback distance is moderate, allowing for strategic repositioning of the target.
abilities.flavorQuote: Let's finish this together!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Sora benefits from allies who can provide crowd control or healing, allowing him to safely build Drive Points and engage in his enhanced Drive Forms. He also synergizes well with damage-amplifying supports, as his Drive Forms already provide significant offensive boosts.
character_v1.tierSummary: Sora is strong, but stat inflation warrants moving him to A. His multi-trigger kit and Drive Forms KPS is capped at 88. A-tier is appropriate given his raw power, but not overpowered.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Sora's kit revolves around building Drive Points to activate Drive Forms, enhancing his combat capabilities. Sonic Blade and Ragnarok generate Drive Points, while Guard rewards skillful defensive play with even more Drive Points. The Drive Forms passive directly amplifies his offensive stats, synergizing with his active abilities.
character_v1.bestFriendshipBuff: Increased ATK and Magic ATK when paired with characters using Fire abilities.

chapters.title: Echoes of Light
chapters.mission: Travel to different worlds, overcome challenges, and defeat powerful Heartless bosses while spreading positivity and restoring balance.
chapters.summary: Sora joins forces with Victini to inspire hope and combat the darkness, rekindling friendships and strengthening bonds along the way.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Sora must protect the worlds from a new wave of Heartless while grappling with inner turmoil and the uncertain future of his friendships.

character_v1.name: Toulouse

abilities.name: String Flutter
upgrades: Lv10: Increases ATK scaling to 25%.
Lv50: The slow effect increases to 20%, and now also reduces attack speed by 10%.
Lv100: Base damage increases, and the taunt chance increases to 50%.
abilities.description: Toulouse flicks a playful string toward the nearest enemy, dealing physical damage. The silken thread, carried by a sudden gust, whips through the air to strike a single target. This attack deals base damage equal to 20% of Toulouse's ATK. More than just a simple strike, the string wraps around the enemy’s feet, applying a Slow effect for 1.5 seconds. The Slow effect reduces the target's movement speed by 15%, hindering their advance and making them easier prey for allies. The string itself, animated by the wind, briefly distracts the foe. Upon successful application of the slow, there is a 25% chance that the target will be taunted for the duration of the slow.

abilities.name: Protective Portrait
abilities.description: Toulouse quickly sketches a portrait of an ally, granting them a shield that absorbs damage. The shield strength is equal to 15% of Toulouse's Max HP + 30% of the target's defense. This shield lasts for 4 seconds. Additionally, the portrait applies a layer of 'Blue Paint' to the target, increasing their tenacity by 20% while the shield persists. This ability has a cooldown of 8 seconds. If the shield is broken before its duration ends, the 'Blue Paint' effect lingers for an additional 1 second. This can be used to proactively mitigate incoming burst damage, or to help allies resist crowd control effects.
abilities.flavorQuote: Just a little something to keep you safe!

abilities.name: Vivid Varnish
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Toulouse throws a splash of vibrant varnish at a target area, creating a zone of 'Orange Paint'. Enemies within this zone have their attack damage reduced by 15% and their speed is slowed by 20%. The zone lasts for 5 seconds. This ability has a range of 8 units and a cooldown of 12 seconds. The size of the painted zone is a 3-unit radius. Any ally entering the zone gains 10% increased evasion for the duration that they remain inside. This ability is ideal for controlling choke points and reducing the effectiveness of enemy damage dealers.
abilities.flavorQuote: A little color to dull your senses!

abilities.name: Painter's Instinct
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Whenever Toulouse uses an ability, he gains a stack of 'Inspiration'. Each stack of 'Inspiration' increases his defense by 5, stacking up to 5 times. Stacks last for 6 seconds. When Toulouse reaches 5 stacks of 'Inspiration', his next basic attack consumes all stacks to apply 'Yellow Paint' to the target enemy, reducing their magic defense by 20% for 3 seconds. This encourages active ability usage to maximize defensive capabilities and provides a window of opportunity to weaken enemies for magic damage dealers on the team.
abilities.flavorQuote: Gotta stay sharp and inspired!

abilities.name: Artful Agility
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~9% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Toulouse uses his artistic prowess to create a temporary diversion. He dashes a short distance (4 units), leaving behind an 'illusionary' painting of himself at his original location. This painting lasts for 2 seconds and functions as a taunt, drawing enemy attacks. After 2 seconds, the painting crumbles, dealing 40 (+20% of Magic ATK) magic damage to nearby enemies in a 2-unit radius. This ability has a 15-second cooldown. Use this to reposition quickly, escape danger, or force enemies to waste their abilities on a fake target.
abilities.flavorQuote: Did you see me... or just my masterpiece?

abilities.name: Grand Canvas of Courage
upgrades: [object Object]
[object Object]
[object Object]
[object Object]
abilities.description: Toulouse, with a flourish of his paw, channels the spirit of artistic bravery, unfurling a protective canvas that blankets the entire battlefield. For a duration of 8 seconds, all allied heroes are emboldened, receiving a 25% reduction in incoming damage, allowing them to withstand even the fiercest onslaught. But the magic of Toulouse's art doesn't stop there; with each stroke of his visionary brush, he splashes enemies within range of his allies with 'Vermillion Valor'. This vibrant mark lasts for the same duration, 8 seconds, causing affected enemies to hesitate in their attacks, dealing 10% less damage to targets other than Toulouse. The swirling pigments create an illusion of vulnerability, causing enemies to have a 30% chance to completely miss their attacks, representing the distraction of his art. Given its sweeping impact, this ultimate ability requires a cooldown of 90 seconds before it can be invoked again, demanding strategic timing to maximize its life-saving and team-empowering effects.

character_v1.teamSynergy: Toulouse pairs well with magic-heavy teams that can capitalize on the magic defense debuff applied by 'Painter's Instinct'. He also benefits from teams that require peel and damage mitigation, as he can provide shields and reduce enemy damage output.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Toulouse's kit revolves around applying paint effects and using his Painter's Instinct to amplify his team's damage while providing protection. His abilities work best when used proactively to anticipate enemy movements and shield allies from incoming damage.
