chapters.mission: Travel to different regions, create works of art that inspire hope, and battle the forces of darkness to revive the world's palette.
chapters.summary: Toulouse partners with Garnet to restore the world's color, using his artistic skills and her magical abilities to combat the blight.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Toulouse's artistry is called upon when a mysterious blight threatens to erase color from the world, draining its beauty and vibrancy.

character_v1.name: Berlioz

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Physical.

abilities.name: Painter's Palette
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Berlioz, ever the aspiring artist, passively accumulates "Paint Splatters" at a rate of 5 per second, up to a maximum of 100. Upon reaching 100 Paint Splatters, Berlioz begins storing additional Paint Splatters as "Loaded Canvases", with each Canvas holding another 100 Splatters, up to a maximum of 3 Loaded Canvases. Every 12 seconds, Berlioz automatically creates a quick painting, expending all available Paint Splatters. The effect of this impromptu masterpiece varies based on the amount of Paint Splatters consumed. If only Splatters are consumed, the painting grants a random ally (prioritizing the one with the lowest health) a small buff for 3 seconds, granting either 5% increased attack damage (red paint), 5% increased magic damage (blue paint), or a shield absorbing 30 damage (white paint). If Loaded Canvases are consumed, the painting's buff has increased effectiveness depending on the amount of canvases used: 1 canvas will double the buff, 2 will triple it and 3 will quadruple it. Berlioz will be adorned with a color aura to showcase his artistic ability. The color of this aura corresponds to whichever buff can be provided at that time.
abilities.flavorQuote: A true artist always finds inspiration, even in the heat of battle!

abilities.name: Syncopated Shield
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~13% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Berlioz expends 40 Musical Score to cast a 'Syncopated Shield' on himself or an ally. The shield absorbs 150 damage and lasts for 4 seconds. If the shielded unit takes damage equal to or exceeding 50% of the shield's capacity within the first 2 seconds, the shield 'resonates', cleansing them of one debuff. Otherwise, the shield simply expires after 4 seconds, with no secondary effect. This ability has a cooldown of 8 seconds, starting after the shield expires or is broken. The shield's color changes based on whether it has resonated (blue) or not (red).
abilities.flavorQuote: A little off-beat protection, just in time!

abilities.name: Harmonic Taunt
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Berlioz unleashes a discordant note, taunting a targeted enemy for 1.5 seconds. This costs 30 Musical Score. While taunted, the enemy's Attack Damage is reduced by 20%. If Berlioz's Musical Score is at maximum (100) when this ability is cast, the taunt duration is increased to 2.5 seconds, and the Attack Damage reduction is increased to 40%. This ability has a cooldown of 10 seconds. The range of the taunt is relatively short, requiring Berlioz to be in a moderate range of the enemy. Successfully taunting an enemy also grants Berlioz 10% increased movement speed for 3 seconds, allowing him to reposition.
abilities.flavorQuote: A little discord to ruin your day!

abilities.name: Crescendo of Courage
abilities.description: Berlioz channels for 2 seconds, expending all of his current Musical Score to unleash a 'Crescendo of Courage'. The effect of the Crescendo is determined by the amount of Musical Score consumed: For every 20 Musical Score spent, all nearby allies gain 3% increased Attack and Magic damage and 3% increased Movement Speed for 5 seconds. Allies also receive a heal equal to 5% of their missing health. The radius of the Crescendo is relatively large, affecting all allies within a significant area around Berlioz. The buff durations do not stack but are refreshed upon subsequent casts of 'Crescendo of Courage'. This ability has a 15 second cooldown.
abilities.flavorQuote: Let the music swell and our courage rise!

abilities.name: Aristocat Acrobatic Assault
abilities.description: Berlioz unleashes his inner Aristocat, transforming into a whirlwind of feline fury and high-pitched piano scales! Upon activation, Berlioz leaps into the air, becoming untargetable for a brief moment, channeling his inner alley cat. He then selects a target location within a moderate range. After selecting the location, Berlioz begins a series of rapid acrobatic maneuvers, dashing between up to 5 nearby enemies (prioritizing heroes), dealing physical damage with each pounce, scaling with his Attack Damage and a percentage of the target's maximum health. Each successful pounce also applies a stack of 'Discordant Note', which reduces the target's armor and magic resistance by a small amount. If there are fewer than 5 targets available, Berlioz will repeatedly bounce between the available targets, ensuring the full duration of the ultimate is utilized and maximizing the application of 'Discordant Note'. The final strike will instead critically strike the target, and inflict a short stun. Finally, Berlioz lands with a flourish, releasing a powerful, albeit slightly off-key, piano chord that grants himself and nearby allies a temporary shield and a burst of movement speed. The shield scales with Berlioz's maximum health and the number of enemies hit by the pounces. The movement speed buff lasts for 3 seconds, allowing for aggressive follow-up or a tactical retreat. Enemies affected by 'Discordant Note' suffer an additional 10% reduction to healing received for the duration of the shield buff on Berlioz's allies. The cooldown is 75 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time for some… improvisational composition!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Berlioz excels in teams that can capitalize on his buffs and peel for him during his channeling abilities. High-damage carries benefit immensely from the damage increases provided by 'Crescendo of Courage' and 'Grand Finale', while tanks appreciate the shields and taunts. Teammates that can provide crowd control effects can help ensure that Berlioz can complete his 'Grand Finale' without interruption.
character_v1.tierSummary: Berlioz's toolkit has niche musical-score synergy and utility (shield, cleanse). While versatile, his raw power output doesn't compete with higher tiers. KPS adjusted to reflect this. Stays in B.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Berlioz's kit revolves around managing his Musical Score effectively. 'Scales and Arpeggios' provides a baseline generation, while 'Harmonic Taunt' can be used strategically to maximize its effectiveness at full Score. 'Syncopated Shield' provides crucial protection and debuff mitigation. The 'Crescendo of Courage' rewards consistent Score expenditure, and the 'Grand Finale' offers a powerful, game-changing effect when fully channeled.
character_v1.bestFriendshipBuff: Increased shield strength and cleanse duration

chapters.title: Harmonic Convergence
chapters.mission: Complete a duet performance, perfectly synchronizing abilities with Bard to defeat a sound-based enemy.
chapters.summary: Berlioz collaborates with Bard, experimenting with new musical styles. They face challenges blending their distinct approaches.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Berlioz seeks inspiration for his next masterpiece, finding a kindred spirit in a fellow musician who helps him unlock hidden potential.

character_v1.name: Cait Sith

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Fire.

abilities.name: Lucky Mime
upgrades: Lv10: Increases the likelihood of beneficial outcomes.
Lv50: Adds a new, exceptionally rare, and powerful outcome (either positive or negative).
Lv100: Improves scaling with Luck and adds a visual indicator of the likely outcome.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~30%).
abilities.description: Lucky Mime – a highly peculiar, luck-based support ability reflective of Cait Sith’s whimsical combat style. Upon activation, Cait Sith brandishes his megaphone and begins an elaborate, utterly nonsensical mime routine. This performance, baffling to behold, has a chance to elicit one of several outcomes, both beneficial and detrimental, scaling with his Luck stat. There is a chance for a brief burst of party-wide damage reduction; a more likely chance to apply a 'Confused' status to a single enemy; or, conversely, a small possibility that Cait Sith clumsily damages himself and applies a temporary Debuff on the team. The exact nature of the outcome is determined through a complex RNG calculation, factoring in not only Cait Sith's Luck, but also the overall party's status effects, the current phase of the moon (in-game time), and whether or not any party member has recently consumed a healing potion. It truly is… unpredictable!
abilities.flavorQuote: I've got a good feeling about this... I think!

abilities.name: Lucky Charm
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~14%).
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Cait Sith bestows a charm of fortune upon an ally, granting them increased critical hit chance and evasion for 8 seconds. The potency of these buffs is increased by 2% per Fortune Cait Sith has stored, consuming 10 Fortune upon cast. If Cait Sith has over 50 Fortune, the ally also gains a shield equal to 10% of their maximum HP that lasts for 4 seconds. This shield scales with Cait Sith's magic attack. If Cait Sith has less than 10 Fortune, the ability instead has a 50% chance to inflict 'Misfortune' on the target, decreasing their critical hit chance and evasion for 4 seconds. The Misfortune debuff cannot occur if 'Lucky Charm' is cast on self.
abilities.flavorQuote: A little luck can go a long way, kupo!

abilities.name: Dicey Situation
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~11%).
abilities.description: Cait Sith throws a pair of loaded dice at the enemy with the highest attack. The dice roll determines the debuff inflicted. A roll of 2-6 inflicts 'Weakness' (decreases atk by 10% for 6 seconds). A roll of 7-10 inflicts 'Slow' (decreases speed by 20% for 4 seconds). A roll of 11-12 inflicts 'Silence' (prevents casting abilities for 3 seconds). Consumes 15 Fortune. If Cait Sith has over 75 Fortune, he can reroll the dice once. If Cait Sith has less than 15 Fortune, the ability has a 30% chance to backfire, debuffing a random ally instead. Debuff duration increased by 1 second per 25 magic atk.
abilities.flavorQuote: Let's roll the dice and see what fate has in store!

abilities.name: Royal Decree
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Patch) Role realignment: this ability now emphasizes tank-style interactions.
abilities.description: Cait Sith, ever the showman and royal commander, uses his megaphone to issue a *Royal Decree*, commanding his Moogle companion to execute a flashy maneuver with unpredictable results. This ability costs 20 Fortune to activate and has a cooldown of 12 seconds. Depending on Cait Sith's current Fortune, the *Royal Decree* will trigger one of three outcomes. With less than 10 Fortune, the Moogle will be easily distracted by the music of battle and begin dancing randomly, either healing one random ally for 15% of their max HP plus a bonus amount scaling with Cait Sith's magic attack, or taunting a random enemy for 3 seconds. If Cait Sith has between 10 and 90 Fortune, the *Royal Decree* has a 50% chance to either heal all allies for 15% of their maximum HP (scaling with Cait Sith's magic attack), or taunt all enemies for 3 seconds. The base chance for the heal increases by 2% for every 10 Fortune Cait Sith possesses, shifting the probability towards group healing. If Cait Sith has over 90 Fortune, then both effects occur simultaneously: the Moogle expertly heal's the party while taunting the enemy team at the same time.

abilities.name: Royal Flush
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Cait Sith plays his trump card, unleashing a wave of manipulated probability. All allies gain increased attack, magic attack, defense, and magic defense for 10 seconds. All enemies suffer reduced attack, magic attack, defense, and magic defense for 10 seconds. The potency of these buffs and debuffs is equal to 1% per 5 Fortune Cait Sith possesses at the time of casting. After casting, Cait Sith expends ALL Fortune. If Cait Sith had at least 100 fortune, the buff and debuff duration is extended by 5 seconds and cleanses all allies.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time to go all in! The house always wins, kupo!

abilities.name: Spy Network
abilities.description: Cait Sith passively generates 3 Fortune per second. Whenever an enemy uses an ability, Cait Sith gains an additional 2 Fortune. When Cait Sith critically hits an enemy, he steals 5 Fortune from them, up to a maximum of 50. Cait Sith can store a maximum of 100 Fortune. Additionally, Cait Sith's basic attacks have a 15% chance to inflict 'Expose Weakness' on the target, increasing the damage they take from the next source of magic damage by 25%. Expose Weakness lasts for 4 seconds. When an ally casts an ultimate, Cait Sith gains 10 Fortune.
abilities.flavorQuote: Information is power, and I'm always listening, kupo!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Cait Sith synergizes well with teams that can capitalize on critical hits and magic damage. His expose weakness helps boost magic damage.
character_v1.tierSummary: Cait Sith, promoted from E to E+. The random nature of his abilities is still a significant drawback. But the combination of healing, shielding, and debuffs offers some team support. Stats are okay, but Royal Flush is valuable.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Cait Sith's kit revolves around generating and spending Fortune to manipulate the odds. He excels at buffing allies and debuffing enemies, making him a valuable asset in team compositions that benefit from consistent stat boosts and controlled engagements.
character_v1.bestFriendshipBuff: Improved Fortune-based buff potency and shield effectiveness.

chapters.title: The High Roller's Gambit
chapters.mission: Outsmart the rigged games using a combination of Gambit's calculated risk-taking and Cait Sith's unpredictable 'luck'.
chapters.summary: Cait Sith tries to learn from Gambit. They face a series of rigged games designed to test their ability to read situations and react accordingly.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Cait Sith, looking to improve his 'luck', consults a master gambler for tips and tricks, but learns a more valuable lesson about calculated risk.

character_v1.name: Riku

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Light.

abilities.name: Twilight Strike
abilities.description: Riku dashes forward a short distance, striking with Braveheart. If the Balance Gauge is tilted towards Light, the strike heals allies near the impact for X% of Riku's max HP. If the Balance Gauge is tilted towards Dark, the strike inflicts a debuff on enemies near the impact, reducing their attack damage by X% for 3 seconds. Neutral balance deals moderate damage in a small AoE with no additional effect. The dash can pass through enemy units, positioning Riku strategically. Using Twilight Strike shifts the Balance Gauge slightly towards the neutral position, promoting tactical stance-dancing.
abilities.flavorQuote: Balance is the key.

abilities.name: Dark Firaga
abilities.description: Riku channels dark energy, unleashing a potent blast of Dark Firaga that deals significant magic damage to a target and nearby enemies. This ability consumes a portion of the Balance Gauge. The amount consumed is greater the closer the Balance Gauge is to Light. If the Balance Gauge is heavily tilted towards Light, Dark Firaga deals increased damage but consumes almost the entire gauge, resetting it closer to neutral. If the Balance Gauge is heavily tilted towards Dark, the ability grants Riku a shield for 2 seconds equal to a percentage of the damage dealt. This ability is Riku's primary way of shifting the Balance Gauge towards the Dark side, allowing him to capitalize on Dark-aligned abilities. The shield granted from Dark Firaga scales with Riku's magic defense stat.
abilities.flavorQuote: Embrace the darkness, control it.

abilities.name: Dark Firaga Shield
upgrades: [object Object]
[object Object]
[object Object]
[object Object]
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~10%).
abilities.description: Riku channels the power of darkness to conjure a protective ward around an allied champion, manifesting as shadowy flames that envelop them for 4 seconds. This ward grants a shield that absorbs incoming damage, fortifying the ally's defenses against enemy attacks. The strength of this shield is directly proportional to Riku's defense stat, scaling dynamically to provide substantial protection. Furthermore, this ward grants the ally bonus tenacity, reducing the duration of crowd control effects like stuns, slows, and roots by 20% while active. When Riku's Balance Gauge leans toward the Light, the act of casting Dark Firaga Shield also expels any existing crowd control effects from the targeted ally, freeing them from impairments. Conversely, should the Balance Gauge be tilted towards Darkness, the shield reflects 30% of the damage it absorbs back to the attacker as true damage, bypassing conventional armor and resistance. Using this ability shifts Riku's Balance Gauge toward the Dark side, influencing the effects of his other abilities, empowering Dark-aligned effects, and diminishing the healing potency of Twilight Strike.

abilities.name: Dual Divinity
upgrades: (Bugfix) Addressed a UI bug where the Balance Meter would occasionally display an inaccurate value.
(Balance) Increased Light alignment healing output scaling from 0.15% to 0.2% per 1% Balance Meter, duration increased from 0.02 to 0.05 seconds.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~17% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Riku's very essence embodies the conflict between Light and Darkness. His Dual Divinity passive revolves around a Balance Meter that starts at equilibrium. Using Light-aspected abilities will add to the Light alignment, while casting abilities steeped in Darkness shifts the meter towards Darkness. As the Balance Meter leans, Riku gains increased effectiveness in either healing (Light) or damage mitigation (Dark). Specifically, for every 1% the Balance Meter favors Light, Riku's healing output is amplified by 0.2%, and the duration of any healing effects he applies to allies is increased by 0.05 seconds, up to a maximum of 10 seconds base. Conversely, for every 1% the Balance Meter favors Darkness, Riku gains 0.1 armor and 0.1 magic resistance, capping at 100 armor and 100 magic resistance. When the Balance Meter reaches a threshold of 75% towards either Light or Darkness, Riku can unleash a unique empowered ability. Maintaining a Balance Meter hovering within +/- 25% grants no bonus stats but allows for flexible access to a broader range of ability effects, making him a versatile hybrid character. Should Riku fully embrace either Light or Dark, reaching 100% on the Balance Meter, he gains a burst of 25 additional armor or magic resistance, depending on the alignment, that lasts for 5 seconds.

abilities.name: The Road to Dawn
abilities.description: Riku transcends his limitations, achieving a state of perfect balance between Light and Darkness for 10 seconds. While active, his Balance Gauge is locked in the neutral position, granting access to empowered versions of all basic abilities. Twilight Strike now deals increased damage and heals allies for a larger amount. Dark Firaga's shield is stronger and consumes less of the Balance Gauge after the effect ends. Guardian Light's shield is larger and both cleanses allies AND reflects damage. Additionally, Riku gains increased attack speed and movement speed during The Road to Dawn. Upon activation, the ability grants temporary immunity to crowd control effects for 1 second. This ultimate is Riku's most powerful ability, allowing him to unleash his full potential and dominate the battlefield for a short period of time. Activating this ability while the Balance Gauge is already perfectly neutral extends the duration by 2 seconds, rewarding precise gameplay.
abilities.flavorQuote: This is my road!

character_v1.playstyle: Adaptive melee fighter, shifting between Light and Dark stances to disrupt enemies, protect allies, and unleash powerful mixed damage.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Riku excels in compositions that benefit from sustained damage, disruption, and targeted protection. He provides peel for carries with Guardian Light, and his damage debuff from Twilight Strike can mitigate incoming damage. His balanced damage output makes him a versatile addition to any team.
character_v1.tierSummary: Riku, originally rated 'A', is brought down to A-. His kit is powerful with healing, damage, and shielding, but slightly less potent than top-tier carries. Stats are decent. He fits well in A- due to balanced utility and damage.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Riku's kit revolves around manipulating the Balance Gauge to optimize ability effects. Twilight Strike's positioning advantage, combined with Dark Firaga's damage and Guardian Light's protection, provides tactical flexibility. The passive 'Way to Dawn' ties the kit together, rewarding skillful balance and encouraging dynamic stance-switching.

chapters.title: The Yin-Yang Duel
chapters.mission: Defeat a series of shadow creatures using Drizzt's guidance to blend light and dark abilities.
chapters.summary: Riku trains with Drizzt, learning to control the chaotic energies within himself and harness both Light and Darkness for greater power.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Riku seeks to understand the balance between Light and Darkness, finding guidance from a dual-wielding hero who has mastered both.

character_v1.name: Kraid

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Earth.

abilities.name: Belly Spike Generation (Passive)
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Kraid passively generates Belly Spikes over time, accumulating up to a maximum of 10 spikes. He generates 1 Belly Spike every 4 seconds. When Kraid takes damage from enemy basic attacks or abilities, he gains an additional Belly Spike, up to the maximum of 10. When reaching maximum Belly Spikes, Kraid's next basic attack is empowered, dealing an additional 50 (+10% of Kraid's maximum HP) as true damage and consuming all spikes. This passive now grants Kraid 10% damage reduction against the next source of damage after he reaches maximum spikes, lasting 2 seconds or until damage is received. This passive encourages aggressive play and rewards Kraid for being in the thick of the battle.
abilities.flavorQuote: Rrrraaaaargh! More fuel for the fire!

abilities.name: Claw Swipe
abilities.description: Kraid performs a wide, sweeping claw attack in a cone-shaped area in front of him. Enemies hit take 80 (+60% of Kraid's Attack) physical damage (up from +50%) and are knocked back a short distance. If Kraid has at least 3 Belly Spikes, he consumes them to empower the claw swipe, increasing the range and damage by 50%, and applying a slow that reduces movement speed by 30% for 3 seconds. Empowered Claw Swipe also grants Kraid a temporary shield equal to 8% of his maximum HP for 3 seconds. This ability provides area control and sets up opportunities for Kraid to initiate further attacks or peel for his teammates.
abilities.flavorQuote: Out of my way, insects!

abilities.name: Belly Spike Barrage
abilities.description: Kraid unleashes a volley of Belly Spikes in a target direction, consuming 1-5 Belly Spikes. For each spike consumed, the barrage's damage increases by 55 (+25% of Kraid's Magic Attack) (up from +20%), and the range increases linearly. If 5 spikes are used, the barrage pierces through enemies, dealing 75% damage to subsequent targets. Enemies hit by the barrage are afflicted with 'Spiked', reducing healing received by 25% for 4 seconds. Additionally, if Kraid consumes 3 or more spikes, he heals for 3% of his maximum HP for each enemy hit by the barrage, up to a maximum of 15% of his maximum HP. This ability is the cornerstone of Kraid's zone control, offering flexible damage and utility depending on the number of spikes used.
abilities.flavorQuote: Feel the sting of my fury!

abilities.name: Thick Hide
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Kraid reinforces his scales, gaining a shield that absorbs 250 (+60% of Kraid's Defense) damage (up from 200 (+50%)) for 4 seconds. If Kraid is hit in his vulnerable mouth area (indicated by a brief opening animation) during the shield duration, the shield breaks instantly, and Kraid is stunned for 0.75 seconds. If the shield remains unbroken for its full duration, Kraid gains 3 Belly Spikes. Furthermore, upon the shield expiring without being broken, Kraid's next Claw Swipe or Belly Spike Barrage within 5 seconds gains 20% increased damage and range, empowering his next offensive move. This ability provides crucial survivability while highlighting Kraid's inherent weakness and requiring careful positioning.
abilities.flavorQuote: My hide is impenetrable!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Kraid synergizes well with teams that benefit from zone control and disruption. His ability to knock back enemies with Claw Swipe and slow them with Belly Spike Barrage provides valuable peel for backline carries. The crowd control from his ultimate, Zebesian Tremor, can set up opportunities for burst damage dealers to secure kills. Tanky allies can further enhance his survivability, while damage-oriented teammates can capitalize on the space he creates.
character_v1.tierSummary: Kraid, demoted to F, lacks impactful abilities and has very low base stats. Belly Spike scaling is too slow and unreliable. The kit lacks focus and damage output, making him the weakest character.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Kraid's kit revolves around generating and expending Belly Spikes. The passive and Thick Hide ability allows for the sustainable generation of spikes. Claw Swipe and Belly Spike Barrage gives opportunities to spend them. The combination of his passive true damage on basic attacks and abilities empower Kraid's role as a damage dealing bruiser. Zebesian Tremor combines area control, damage, and disruption.

chapters.title: Monster's Tutorial
chapters.mission: Survive Grendel's brutal training regime with increased defense and healing.
chapters.summary: Kraid attempts to learn the ways of Grendel, but his softer personality clashes with Grendel's raw brutality. Kraid's techniques remain largely unchanged.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Kraid, feeling inadequate, seeks to become a fearsome predator. He attempts to learn from a monstrous enemy whose form is more brutal than his own.

character_v1.name: Sylux

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Fire.

abilities.name: Shock Coil Burst
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~44%).
abilities.description: Sylux fires a rapid burst of energy from his Shock Coil, dealing X magic damage to the target and nearby enemies within a small radius. For each enemy hit, Sylux steals 5% of their current energy (mana, rage, etc.). This stolen energy is converted into a stacking buff that increases Sylux's attack and magic attack by 2% per stack, up to a maximum of 10 stacks. The buff lasts for 5 seconds, and each subsequent Shock Coil Burst refreshes the duration and can add more stacks. If there are no targets in range, Sylux will not fire. This ability costs 50 energy to use.
abilities.flavorQuote: Feel the drain of your power fueling my ascent.

abilities.name: Lockjaw Ram
abilities.description: Sylux transforms into his Lockjaw form and dashes forward a short distance, dealing X physical damage and stunning the first enemy hit for 1.5 seconds. If Sylux hits an enemy with full energy, the stun duration is increased to 2.5 seconds, and Sylux siphons 10% of their max energy. This siphon effect does not grant the buff. This ability has a moderate cooldown of 12 seconds. The range of the dash is roughly twice Sylux's normal movement speed per second. If no target is hit, Sylux simply reverts to humanoid form, making him vulnerable momentarily.
abilities.flavorQuote: Prepare for a brutal collision.

abilities.name: Adaptive Plating
upgrades: Each stack also grants a minor amount of crowd control resistance.
Reactive Plating stacks now also reduce damage taken from the ability that triggered the stack by a small amount.
Increase the duration of Reactive Plating.
The range to trigger Reactive Plating is significantly increased.
abilities.description: Sylux's advanced Chozo armor constantly analyzes and adapts to the battlefield. Whenever an enemy champion casts an ability within a range of 750 units, Sylux's armor gains a stack of 'Reactive Plating', shimmering with a brief pulse of energy. Each stack of Reactive Plating enhances Sylux's defensive capabilities, granting 3 bonus armor and 3 bonus magic resistance for 8 seconds, allowing Sylux to effectively weather incoming assaults. The maximum number of Reactive Plating stacks that can be accumulated is 15, providing a substantial boost to Sylux's defenses when fully stacked. Should the enemy champion be classified as 'Federation', Sylux's armor recognizes the technology and quickly assimilates defensive countermeasures, gaining 2 stacks of Reactive Plating per ability cast. However, to prevent excessive stacking from repeated casts by a single enemy, Reactive Plating stacks can only be gained from the same champion once every 2 seconds, forcing enemies to coordinate multiple ability casts to break Sylux's stalwart armor.

abilities.name: Delano 7 Support
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~11% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Sylux calls in his ship, the Delano 7, to bombard a targeted area with a series of energy blasts over 3 seconds. Each blast deals X magic damage to enemies in the area. Enemies caught in multiple blasts take 10% increased damage from subsequent hits. If an enemy in the targeted area is below 25% energy, the Delano 7 focuses its fire, dealing 50% more damage to that specific target. The targeted area is roughly the size of Sylux's Lockjaw Ram dash distance. This ability has a long cooldown of 20 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Witness the firepower I've amassed.

abilities.name: Nexus Drain
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Sylux overloads his power systems, emitting a catastrophic energy pulse from his suit's central nexus. This pulse violently destabilizes energy fields within a vast radius, dealing X magic damage to all enemy units caught within its reach. The nexus field causes each enemy struck to immediately lose 20% of their current energy reserves, transferring this stolen energy directly into Sylux's protective systems. He converts 50% of the total energy drained into a temporary energy shield, offering substantial protection against incoming attacks. This shield remains active for 8 seconds, providing a crucial window of opportunity for Sylux to engage aggressively. Furthermore, during the shield's duration, each of Sylux's subsequent attacks inflicts a debuff on his targets known as 'Energy Fracture'. This effect reduces the enemy's energy regeneration rate by 5% per stack, up to a maximum of 25%, disrupting their ability to utilize their own abilities effectively. Nexus Drain demands precise timing and strategic placement, costing 100 energy to activate and requiring a lengthy cooldown of 90 seconds to recharge its formidable power. In dire circumstances, should Sylux's energy reserves fall short of the required 100 when initiating Nexus Drain, his suit will automatically siphon the remaining energy from the closest enemy champion, forcibly seizing the necessary power to unleash the devastating pulse.

character_v1.teamSynergy: Sylux benefits from teammates who can apply crowd control to help him land his Lockjaw Ram and Delano 7 Support, and from allies who can capitalize on the energy regeneration debuff applied by his ultimate.
character_v1.tierSummary: Sylux, demoted to C-. Has energy siphon, but mediocre damage output. Adaptive plating is useful. The kit's dependence on specific anti-Federation mechanics lowers overall viability. Decent speed, but the rest of the stats are lackluster.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Sylux's kit revolves around draining enemy energy and converting it into personal buffs and shields. Shock Coil Burst keeps the damage buff up, Lockjaw Ram offers burst damage and stun with an energy-dependent bonus, Federation Tech Scavenger enhances mobility and anti-shield capabilities, and Energy Parasite provides a massive shield based on the energy drained from enemies.
character_v1.bestFriendshipBuff: Increased energy siphon and damage output.

chapters.title: Symbiotic Devour
chapters.mission: Drain the energy of a powerful foe using Venom's techniques to maximize the shield generated by Sylux's ultimate.
chapters.summary: Sylux studies Venom's methods of energy absorption, learning to enhance their own siphoning abilities and create a nearly impenetrable energy shield. Venom teaches them the art of symbiotic bonding to enhance one's own parasitic abilities.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Sylux, seeking to refine their energy-siphoning techniques, finds a kindred spirit in a parasitic being who can drain life force with ease.

character_v1.name: Finn

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~21%).
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Wind.

abilities.name: Scarlet Strike
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~15% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Finn charges forward a short distance, dealing X physical damage to enemies in his path and applying a stack of 'Hero's Mark' to each enemy hit. Hero's Mark increases the damage enemies take from Finn's subsequent attacks by 3% per stack, up to a maximum of 15%. If Finn is in 'Shoko' stance from Echoes of Ooo, the charge distance is doubled and the damage is increased by 20%. This ability's cooldown is reduced by 1 second for each enemy champion hit by the charge. The attack range is telegraphed before activation, allowing enemies a brief window to evade or prepare for impact. This ability emphasizes Finn's early game aggression and utility, providing a consistent means of engaging and debuffing opponents.
abilities.flavorQuote: Let's go slay some monsters!

abilities.name: Grass Sword Lash
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~26%).
abilities.description: Finn unleashes a wide sweeping attack with a spectral Grass Sword, dealing X physical damage in a cone in front of him. Enemies hit are also ensnared by the Grass Sword, rooting them in place for 1.25 seconds. If Finn is in 'Farmworld Finn' stance from Echoes of Ooo, the ensnare duration is increased to 2 seconds, and the cone's range is extended by 30%. Upon activation, Finn gains a brief burst of movement speed, allowing him to reposition slightly before unleashing the lash. This ability provides crucial crowd control, enhancing Finn's team fight presence and peel potential. Mastering the timing and positioning of this ability will allow Finn to control the battlefield.
abilities.flavorQuote: I've got the power of the grass!

abilities.name: Vault Defense
abilities.description: Finn enters a defensive stance, channeling for up to 3 seconds. While channeling, Finn gains a shield that absorbs X damage. If Finn is in 'Catalyst Comet' stance from Echoes of Ooo, the shield's absorption is increased by 50%, and any damage exceeding the shield's capacity is reflected back to the attacker as true damage. Upon ending the channel early or when the shield breaks, Finn releases a burst of energy, slowing nearby enemies by 30% for 2 seconds. This ability is crucial for surviving burst damage and turning the tide in unfavorable engagements, offering both protection and a tactical advantage.
abilities.flavorQuote: Gotta protect my homies!

abilities.name: Echoes of Ooo
abilities.description: Finn passively cycles through stances representing his past lives or forms every 10 seconds, granting different bonuses: 'Shoko' (Increased mobility and damage on Scarlet Strike), 'Farmworld Finn' (Enhanced crowd control on Grass Sword Lash), and 'Catalyst Comet' (Increased shield strength and damage reflection on Vault Defense). Activating an ability corresponding to the current stance consumes the stance, granting an additional effect and triggering a 3-second cooldown before cycling resumes. Consumed Shoko stance grants 10% lifesteal for 4 seconds. Consumed Farmworld Finn stance grants a 25% reduction on the next ability cooldown. Consumed Catalyst Comet stance heals Finn for 10% of his missing health. This passive introduces a dynamic element, encouraging tactical ability usage.
abilities.flavorQuote: I've lived a thousand lives!

abilities.name: Everything Stays
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~7% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Finn calls upon the memories of his past, creating a temporal distortion field around him for 6 seconds. Within this field, allies gain 20% increased attack speed and 15% increased movement speed. Additionally, enemies within the field have their healing and shielding effects reduced by 40%. At the end of the duration, allies are healed for X health based on 10% of the damage they dealt during the field, and enemies take X true damage based on 5% of the damage they dealt. This Ultimate provides both offensive and defensive utility, bolstering his team's capabilities while weakening the enemy. Properly timed and positioned, this can swing entire team fights in Finn's favor, emphasizing the power of remembering and learning from the past.
abilities.flavorQuote: Remember what you've learned!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Finn excels in teams that need a front-line bruiser who can both engage and protect. He synergizes well with damage dealers who can capitalize on his debuffs and crowd control. His ultimate provides team-wide buffs and enemy debuffs, making him a valuable addition to any team composition.
character_v1.tierSummary: Finn has a mixed kit of damage, utility, and healing. The 'Everything Stays' ability is powerful but unreliable. Promoted from B- to C+ due to the heavy nerf on Scarlet Strike and inconsistent utility, but still valuable. Good speed stat.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Finn's abilities synergize by allowing him to engage, control, and protect. Scarlet Strike allows for quick engagement and debuffing. Grass Sword Lash provides essential crowd control and peels for carries. Vault Defense provides a crucial shield. Echoes of Ooo dictates which of those is most potent at a given time, adding depth. His ultimate gives him a late game edge.

chapters.title: The Adventurer's Code
chapters.mission: Survive a wilderness trial by adapting to various situations with Bear Grylls.
chapters.summary: Finn seeks training from Bear Grylls. Grylls helps him amplify all of his current skills and adapt to every situation.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Finn seeks to hone his adaptable skills, and finds an ultimate teacher of survival.

character_v1.name: Jake

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Physical.

abilities.name: Key Hand
abilities.description: Jake stretches his hand into a skeleton key, attempting to unlock an enemy unit, structure or terrain feature. Upon successful channel (1.5 seconds), the target enemy is 'Unstable' for 4 seconds, reducing their Def and Magic Def by 20%. If used on a structure, the structure is temporarily disabled for 5 seconds. If cast on terrain, Jake creates a small gap in the terrain, allowing allies to pass through (lasts 6 seconds). Key Hand grants 1 'Stretch' stack upon completion of the channel. If the channel is interrupted, Jake is stunned for 0.75 seconds and no 'Stretch' stack is gained. Has a cooldown of 8 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Lemme pick that for ya, buddy!

abilities.name: Bacon Pancakes!
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~16% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Jake quickly cooks up a stack of bacon pancakes, offering them to an allied hero. The allied hero consumes the pancakes over 3 seconds, healing for 15% of their max HP. During this time, the ally also gains 10% increased movement speed.  If the ally is at full HP, the pancakes provide an overshield equal to 5% of their maximum HP for 5 seconds. Successfully using Bacon Pancakes grants Jake 1 'Stretch' stack. If no ally is nearby, Jake eats the pancakes himself, gaining half the healing and speed boost. Has a cooldown of 12 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Bacon pancakes, makin' bacon pancakes!

abilities.name: Shapeshift Slam
abilities.description: Jake transforms into a massive, spiky ball and slams into the target location, dealing 100 + (50% Atk) physical damage to enemies in a 3-unit radius and knocking them back a short distance.  The distance of the knockback scales with Jake's 'Stretch' stacks; each stack increases the knockback distance by 5%. Upon impact, Jake expends all 'Stretch' stacks. If Jake has 5 or more 'Stretch' stacks upon using this ability, enemies are also stunned for 1 second. Has a cooldown of 15 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time for a little...rearrangement!

abilities.name: Stretchy Guard
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~12%).
abilities.description: Jake's 'Stretchy Powers' provide him with enhanced durability. For every 'Stretch' stack Jake has, he gains 3 bonus Def and 3 bonus Magic Def. Additionally, whenever an ally within a 5-unit radius takes damage, Jake stretches to intercept a portion of the blow, reducing the ally's damage taken by 10% and redirecting 5% of the damage to himself.  This redirection effect does not apply if Jake is crowd controlled (stunned, silenced, etc.). The maximum damage redirected is capped at 15% of Jake's maximum HP per instance.
abilities.flavorQuote: I got your back, Finn!

abilities.name: Warren Ampersand Form
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Jake taps into his true shapeshifter heritage, transforming into his Warren Ampersand form for 15 seconds. In this form, Jake gains 30% bonus HP, 20% increased Atk, and access to new abilities. While in Warren Ampersand form, Key Hand is replaced with 'Alien Grasp' which becomes a long-range grab that pulls enemies towards Jake. Bacon Pancakes! is replaced with 'Cosmic Feast', instantly healing all allies within range for 25% of their max HP. Shapeshift Slam gains a larger AoE, deals 50% increased damage and inflicts silence for 2 seconds. Upon transformation Jake instantly gains 5 'Stretch' stacks. This ability has a cooldown of 90 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Alright, let's get alien!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Jake excels at supporting damage-heavy allies by providing them with healing, shields, and crowd control.  His ability to disrupt enemies with Key Hand and Shapeshift Slam allows his team to capitalize on openings. He is especially effective with melee carries who benefit from his protective abilities and engage tools.
character_v1.tierSummary: Jake, kept at B, offers good utility and control through shapeshifting. Stretchy Guard passive and Warren Ampersand ultimate offer solid buffs and control. A well-rounded hero.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Jake's kit revolves around building and expending 'Stretch' stacks to enhance his abilities.  Using Key Hand and Bacon Pancakes! builds stacks, while Shapeshift Slam expends them for burst damage and crowd control. Stretchy Guard further rewards stack management, making Jake a durable and supportive presence on the battlefield.
character_v1.bestFriendshipBuff: Increased shapeshift power and control duration

chapters.title: Plasticity Perfection
chapters.mission: Use your shapeshifting abilities to overcome a series of physical obstacles designed by Plastic Man.
chapters.summary: Jake trains with Plastic Man, unlocking new dimensions to his shapeshifting abilities and learning to apply them in combat and support roles.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Jake, always seeking new ways to use his powers, learns from an unexpected master of malleable abilities.

character_v1.name: Boa Hancock

upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling

abilities.name: Slave Arrow
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~11% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Boa Hancock blows a kiss, launching multiple heart-shaped projectiles in a cone in front of her. Each arrow deals 60 (+60% magic atk) magic damage. Enemies hit have a 30% chance to be Petrified for 1.2 seconds. This chance is doubled against enemies already affected by any crowd control effects. The arrows spread further apart with distance, making it more effective at close to mid range. Proper positioning is key to maximize the chance of petrifying multiple opponents simultaneously.
abilities.flavorQuote: Fall before my beauty!

abilities.name: Slave Arrow Kick
upgrades: Increases the base magic damage dealt by Slave Arrow Kick to 120.
Extends the Petrify duration reset by 0.5 seconds.
The true damage component now scales with 40% magic attack.
Slave Arrow Kick now also knocks back enemies a short distance.
Grants a shield absorbing damage equal to 10% of Boa Hancock's maximum health for 3 seconds after using Slave Arrow Kick.

abilities.description: With a swift, elegant motion, Boa Hancock delivers a devastating kick imbued with her signature Slave Arrow power. This is no mere physical strike; it manifests as a concentrated burst of concussive force projected forward, affecting all enemies caught within a line directly in front of her for 80 (+80% magic attack) magic damage. Enemies already afflicted by Petrify suffer not only from the force of the kick but are also subjected to an amplified affliction, receiving 50 (+20% magic attack) true damage. The Queen's will ensures that the Petrify does not simply end; it is prolonged, resetting the status's duration back to its original value, effectively extending the period of crowd control. The range of this ability is relatively short, encouraging close combat to maximize the impact. The true damage component allows Boa Hancock to threaten opponents regardless of their defenses.

abilities.name: Mero Mero Mellow
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~11% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Boa Hancock releases a wide-area pulse of charm, affecting all enemies within a moderate radius. Enemies who are facing Hancock have a 50% chance to be Petrified for 1.5 seconds, while those facing away are unaffected. This ability requires careful positioning to maximize its effectiveness. It can be used defensively to interrupt enemy attacks or offensively to set up combos with other abilities. Mastering the timing and positioning of Mero Mero Mellow is crucial for maximizing Boa Hancock's crowd control potential.
abilities.flavorQuote: Bask in my radiance!

abilities.name: Serpent's Charm
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: Serpent's Charm scale improved — grants additional effectiveness in late-game situations.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~15% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Boa Hancock's presence emanates pure, irresistible allure, empowering her abilities through the sheer magnetism of her royal demeanor. For each enemy hero within 500 units that is currently afflicted by the Petrified status, Boa Hancock gains a stacking bonus of 8% to her Magic Attack, reaching its zenith at a maximum of 40%. This enchantment necessitates aggressive engagement and well-timed crowd control, as the presence of Petrified adversaries not only renders them vulnerable to follow-up assaults but also significantly augments Boa Hancock's magical output. Players must skillfully navigate the battlefield, ensuring they are both within proximity to Petrified foes and safely positioned to avoid counterattacks. By strategically utilizing Petrify to ensnare multiple enemies, Boa Hancock unleashes a formidable wave of magic-infused strikes, further solidifying her status as the Serpent Princess of Amazon Lily.

abilities.name: Supreme Love
abilities.description: Boa Hancock focuses her overwhelming love and unleashes a devastating attack. She becomes briefly invulnerable (1.5 seconds) and then dashes forward a short distance. Enemies in her path are Petrified for 2 seconds and take 200 (+100% magic atk) magic damage. Following the dash, Boa Hancock releases a final burst of energy dealing 100 (+50% magic atk) true damage to all Petrified enemies within a large radius, consuming the Petrify effect. This ultimate is a high-risk, high-reward ability, requiring precise timing and positioning to maximize its damage and crowd control potential. Mastering this ability is key to unleashing Boa Hancock's full power.
abilities.flavorQuote: For the one I love!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Boa Hancock synergizes well with teammates who can provide additional crowd control, further increasing her ability to apply Petrify and maximize her damage output. Characters that can displace enemies or provide vision also enhance her ability to effectively use Mero Mero Mellow and Supreme Love.
character_v1.tierSummary: Boa Hancock, while having Petrify, suffers from low base stats and unreliable application. D -> F+ to reflect inconsistency. Friendship Campaign missing, will create it. Adjusted KPS to reflect practical performance.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Boa Hancock's kit revolves around the Petrify status. Slave Arrow and Mero Mero Mellow applies it, while Perfume Femur and Supreme Love benefit from it. Empress's Grace rewards her for petrifying enemies near her. This creates a combo-centric playstyle where she aims to Petrify enemies and then burst them down.

chapters.title: Medusa's Legacy
chapters.mission: Attempt to amplify petrify attacks with Medusa. Use those powers in a sparring match.
chapters.summary: Boa Hancock learns from Medusa, unlocking new potential. Medusa teaches her skills to petrify, and amplify her powers.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Boa Hancock seeks to amplify her petrifying abilities. She hopes to learn techniques to immobilize entire armies.

character_v1.name: Death

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~6% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Dark.

abilities.name: Whispers of Mortality
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~9% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Death's presence instills fear in his enemies. Whenever an enemy champion is within 700 units of Death, they gain a stack of 'Dread' every 5 seconds. If an enemy champion is damaged by one of Death's abilities, they gain two stacks of 'Dread' instead of one. 'Dread' stacks up to 5 times. Each stack of 'Dread' increases the damage they take from all sources by 4% and reduces their attack and movement speed by 2%. This passive reflects Death's constant, looming presence, weakening enemies simply by being nearby and punishing them further for engaging with him.
abilities.flavorQuote: "I do love the smell of fear."

abilities.name: Reaper's Shadow
abilities.description: Death dashes a short distance (400 units), becoming untargetable during the dash. Upon arrival, he emits a chilling wave, applying one stack of 'Dread' to all enemies within 300 units. If an enemy already has 3 or more stacks of 'Dread', the dash also silences them for 1 second. This ability allows Death to quickly reposition, apply pressure, and control the battlefield, forcing enemies to respect his space and opening opportunities for follow-up attacks. The silence effect amplifies his disruptive capabilities against heavily weakened targets.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Everyone thinks they'll be the one to defeat me."

abilities.name: Fatal Scythe
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Death unleashes a sweeping scythe attack in a cone (60-degree angle, 500 units range) in front of him, dealing 80 (+60% Attack) physical damage. Enemies hit are knocked back a short distance (200 units). If the target already has at least one stack of 'Dread', the scythe also applies a bleed effect, dealing 30 (+20% Attack) physical damage over 3 seconds. This ability provides Death with both damage and displacement, allowing him to control enemy positioning and create separation, amplifying pressure on already weakened targets.
abilities.flavorQuote: "You're not living up to the legend."

abilities.name: Soul Harvest
abilities.description: Death targets an enemy champion within 600 units. If the target has 5 stacks of 'Dread', Death instantly consumes all stacks and deals 150 (+80% Attack) true damage. If the target does not have 5 stacks of 'Dread', Death instead applies 3 stacks of 'Dread' and the ability goes on a reduced cooldown of 5 seconds. This ability serves as Death's primary execute, rewarding careful application of 'Dread' stacks and punishing enemies who underestimate his presence. The reduced cooldown provides added utility even when the execute condition isn't met.
abilities.flavorQuote: "I've come for you, Puss in Boots."

abilities.name: End of the Line
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~48%).
abilities.description: Death marks a target enemy champion for 8 seconds. During this time, Death gains 30% increased movement speed towards the marked target. Additionally, all sources of damage Death inflicts on the marked target apply an additional stack of 'Dread', up to the maximum of 5 stacks. At the end of the duration, or if the target reaches 5 stacks of Dread before the duration ends, Death unleashes a spectral barrage, dealing 200 (+100% Attack) physical damage to the target and all enemies within 400 units of them. This ultimate cements Death's role as a relentless pursuer, amplifying his threat to a single target and creating opportunities for massive area damage around them.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Run, run, kitty."

character_v1.teamSynergy: Death excels at isolating and weakening priority targets, making him a valuable asset for teams that prioritize burst damage or sustained engagements. His ability to silence enemies and control positioning also provides valuable utility for protecting allies or setting up opportunities for team fights.
character_v1.tierSummary: Death's kit relies heavily on applying Dread, which can be inconsistent. C+ reflects the potential, but also the reliability. Friendship Campaign already exist, so not recreated.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Death's kit revolves around applying and consuming 'Dread' stacks. His passive and 'Reaper's Shadow' are reliable methods for initial Dread application, while 'Fatal Scythe' and 'Soul Harvest' capitalize on existing stacks for bonus effects or execute potential. 'End of the Line' accelerates Dread application and sets up a large AoE burst.

chapters.title: The Ferryman's Dilemma
chapters.mission: Guide the lost soul to accept its fate.
chapters.summary: Death encounters a soul clinging to life, refusing to cross over. He seeks guidance from a compassionate being.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Death finds an unlikely ally in a quest to understand the balance between life and death in the MUGENverse.

character_v1.name: Jonathan Joestar

abilities.name: Zoom Punch
upgrades: Lv10: Damage scales to 100% of attack.
Lv50: Applies a brief Hamon-infused Weakness, reducing affected target's damage by 10% for 3 seconds.
Lv100: Stagger duration increased to 2 seconds.
(Balance Patch) Damage scaling now peaks at 130% attack, decreased from 140%.
(Patch) Ability now emphasizes controller-style interactions.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Jonathan focuses his Hamon energy into his fist, extending his reach for a devastating strike. He propels his fist forward, increasing its speed and power as it travels a short distance before impacting the first enemy in its path. Upon impact, the Zoom Punch delivers a physical blow imbued with Hamon, dealing damage equal to 90% of Jonathan's Attack stat, scaling up to a maximum of 130% based on distance traveled. Furthermore, the Hamon energy disrupts the target's balance, applying a 'Staggered' status effect for 1.25 seconds, hindering their movement and reducing their evasion by 20%. This effect is designed to allow Jonathan and his allies to better follow up with subsequent attacks or reposition strategically, controlling the flow of combat.

abilities.name: Gentleman's Resolve
abilities.description: Jonathan passively emanates a protective aura, granting all nearby allies a shield equal to 5% of his maximum HP. This shield regenerates every 5 seconds as long as allies remain within the aura's range. Additionally, Jonathan's defense is increased by 10 for each ally shielded by this ability, encouraging him to stay close to his team. This passive defines Jonathan's role as a protector, constantly bolstering his allies' survivability and reinforcing his own defenses when he's near them. The range of the aura is moderately sized, requiring allies to stay relatively close to benefit, fostering teamwork and strategic positioning.
abilities.flavorQuote: "I'm fighting to protect my family from those that wish it harm."

abilities.name: Sendo Ripple Overdrive
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~27%).
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~15% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Jonathan channels Ripple energy into the ground, creating a wave that travels forward in a line. Enemies hit by the wave are knocked back a moderate distance and take damage equal to 70% of Jonathan's attack, plus an additional 3% of his max HP as true damage. If the wave passes through an ally currently shielded by 'Gentleman's Resolve', their shield is instantly refreshed and increased by 10% of Jonathan's max HP. The wave travels at a moderate speed, requiring precise aiming to effectively knock back and damage enemies, or to reinforce allies' shields. This ability provides both offensive and defensive utility, enabling Jonathan to control the battlefield and support his team.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Sendo Ripple Overdrive!"

abilities.name: Scarlet Overdrive
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Jonathan focuses Ripple energy into his fists, granting his next three auto-attacks bonus fire damage equal to 40% of his magic attack. These enhanced attacks also apply a burning effect, dealing additional damage over 3 seconds equal to 2% of the target's maximum health per second. If Jonathan uses this ability while an ally is shielded by 'Gentleman's Resolve', the burning damage is converted into a heal over time effect for the ally, healing for the same amount over the same duration. This ability adds a potent offensive option to Jonathan's kit, while also allowing him to use his attacks in a more defensive supportive manner.
abilities.flavorQuote: "My heart resonates! The heat's enough to burn!"

abilities.name: Zoom Punch Barrage
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~8% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Jonathan focuses his Hamon energy, channeling it into his fist before unleashing a rapid barrage of punches infused with Hamon, each strike delivered with incredible speed and force. For 8 seconds, Jonathan's attack damage is amplified by 30%, turning his fists into a whirlwind of offensive power. Furthermore, his attack speed surges by 20%, allowing him to unleash even more blows in rapid succession. This Hamon-infused onslaught also fortifies his defenses, granting him 20% damage reduction. If Jonathan is currently utilizing 'Gentleman's Resolve' to shield an ally, the protective Hamon energy radiates outwards, sharing the 20% damage reduction equally between Jonathan and his shielded ally, ensuring they both benefit from the enhanced resilience. Each punch resonates with Hamon energy, adding a small amount of damage, dealing an additional 2% of the target's maximum health as magical damage with each strike.

abilities.name: Sunlight Yellow Overdrive
abilities.description: Jonathan unleashes a devastating flurry of Ripple-infused punches, targeting a single enemy. The target is stunned for 1 second and receives damage equal to 100% of Jonathan's attack, plus an additional 15% of his maximum HP as true damage. This damage is dealt over the course of the flurry. For each ally currently shielded by 'Gentleman's Resolve', the final hit of Sunlight Yellow Overdrive deals an additional 5% of the target's maximum HP as true damage. This ability serves as Jonathan's ultimate offensive tool, providing a significant burst of damage and control over a single target, scaling with his tankiness and rewarding him for proper positioning and ally support.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Sunlight Yellow Overdrive!"

character_v1.teamSynergy: Jonathan excels in teams that benefit from sustained protection and disruption. He pairs well with damage dealers who need a frontline and can capitalize on knockbacks, or with other support characters to make a very resilient defensive core.
character_v1.tierSummary: Jonathan Joestar's shield-centric kit is tanky, but lacks significant damage output. D+ appropriately places him. Friendship Campaign exists, so not recreated.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Jonathan's abilities synergize around his passive 'Gentleman's Resolve,' enhancing his protectiveness. 'Sendo Ripple Overdrive' refreshes and strengthens shields, 'Scarlet Overdrive' converts damage to healing for shielded allies, and 'Luck and Pluck' shares damage reduction, while 'Sunlight Yellow Overdrive' gains bonus damage.

chapters.title: The Ripple of Courage
chapters.mission: Defeat waves of shadow creatures while keeping Erina safe.
chapters.summary: Jonathan must protect Erina from a sudden surge of darkness and evil energy, reminiscent of his past battles with Dio.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Jonathan Joestar, a true gentleman, seeks to prove that even in the chaotic MUGENverse, honor and courage can prevail.

character_v1.name: Jotaro Kujo

upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction

abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Light.

abilities.name: Ora Ora Rush
upgrades: Increases the cone angle of the 'Ora Ora Rush' to 75 degrees, widening the area of effect and increasing the likelihood of hitting multiple targets.
Reduces the self-slow penalty while channeling 'Ora Ora Rush', allowing Jotaro to maintain a greater degree of mobility during the attack.
Extends the duration of the 'Time Pool' buff, allowing Jotaro to capitalize on the accumulated stacks for a longer period.
Applies a minor armor reduction debuff to enemies struck by the 'Ora Ora Rush', weakening their defenses and amplifying subsequent damage.
Grants Jotaro a brief burst of movement speed immediately after the 'Ora Ora Rush' concludes, facilitating repositioning or pursuit.
(Patch) Role realignment: This ability now emphasizes bruiser-style interactions, enhancing Jotaro's ability to engage and sustain in prolonged fights.
abilities.description: Jotaro focuses his will, summoning Star Platinum to unleash a devastating flurry of punches in a 60-degree cone extending 7 units ahead. For 1.5 seconds, any foe caught in this unrelenting assault will be pummeled, suffering X physical damage with each blow. The sheer force of each strike creates a concussive effect, resulting in a slight knockback, disrupting enemies attempting weaker channeling abilities. More than just physical harm, the 'Ora Ora Rush' empowers Jotaro; each successful hit grants him one stack of 'Time Pool', up to a maximum of 5 stacks. These stacks accumulate, fortifying his resilience and resolve. While channeling the 'Ora Ora Rush', Jotaro's movement speed is reduced by 25%, reflecting the intense focus required to maintain such a rapid barrage; however, this sacrifice allows him to maintain relentless pressure, proving him to be an unyielding force in close combat, ready to exploit any opening his assault creates.

abilities.name: Ora Barrage
abilities.description: Jotaro commands Star Platinum to unleash a furious barrage of punches upon a single enemy standing within a 12-unit range. This unrelenting assault deals a substantial amount of physical damage. Should the target already be suffering from the effects of 'Time Stop,' the already considerable damage is amplified by an additional 30%, turning the barrage into a devastating flurry. Furthermore, if struck during 'Time Stop,' the target also becomes 'Vulnerable,' suffering a 15% increase to all incoming damage for a duration of 3 seconds, leaving them open to follow-up attacks from Jotaro and his allies. Each successful activation of 'Ora Barrage' empowers Jotaro with a stack of 'Time Fracture,' inching him closer to manipulating the very fabric of time. A cooldown of 10 seconds is required before unleashing the barrage again.

abilities.name: Time Stop Counter
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Jotaro enters a defensive stance for 1 second, bracing for an incoming attack. If Jotaro is hit by an enemy attack during this stance, he instantly counters with Star Platinum, stopping time for 1 second. During the Time Stop, Jotaro is invulnerable and can perform one action (attack or movement). After the Time Stop ends, Jotaro gains one stack of Time Fracture and the attacker is stunned for 1.5 seconds. Cooldown: 15 seconds. Dodging with style.
abilities.flavorQuote: Good grief...

abilities.name: Unbreakable Resolve
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~33%).
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~35%).
abilities.description: Jotaro gains increased tenacity based on the number of 'Time Fracture' stacks he has. For each stack of 'Time Fracture,' Jotaro gains 5% tenacity, up to a maximum of 25%. Additionally, when Jotaro's HP falls below 25%, he consumes all 'Time Fracture' stacks to grant himself a shield equal to 10% of his maximum HP per stack consumed. This shield lasts for 5 seconds. A quiet strength.
abilities.flavorQuote: I won't let you have your way.

abilities.name: Star Platinum: The World
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~45%).
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~49%).
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~15%).
abilities.description: Jotaro unleashes Star Platinum's ultimate ability, stopping time for a duration based on his current 'Time Fracture' stacks. With no 'Time Fracture' stacks, the time stop lasts for 2 seconds. Each stack increases the duration by 0.5 seconds, up to a maximum of 4.5 seconds. During 'Time Stop,' Jotaro's attack damage is increased by 20%, and he can move freely. Upon the end of Time Stop all enemies within 8 units are slowed by 40% for 3 seconds. The world stands still. Cooldown: 90 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: The World! Time has stopped!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Jotaro excels at protecting vulnerable teammates with his Time Stop Counter and disrupting enemy formations with Ora Ora Barrage. He synergizes well with damage dealers who can capitalize on the increased damage during Time Stop.
character_v1.tierSummary: Jotaro Kujo's Time Stop is powerful, but not game-breaking at the highest levels. A- allows for strong performance while maintaining balance. KPS adjusted down slightly from A to reflect this. Friendship Campaign exists, so not recreated.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Jotaro's kit revolves around building and utilizing Time Fracture stacks. Landing Ora Ora Barrage and countering attacks with Time Stop Counter are key to empowering Unbreakable Resolve and Star Platinum: The World.

chapters.title: Echoes of Time
chapters.mission: Defeat the time-bending enemy before it unravels reality.
chapters.summary: Jotaro detects a temporal distortion and teams up with Star Platinum to confront the source, a powerful time-manipulating entity.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Jotaro, skeptical but determined, embarks on a journey to uncover the temporal anomalies plaguing the MUGENverse.

character_v1.name: Gum

abilities.description: Gum gracefully extends her hand, causing a focused beam of light to erupt from her glove and strike a single enemy target. This ranged attack deals physical damage enhanced by light energy, scaling directly with Gum's Attack stat. The initial strike inflicts 100% of Gum's Attack as physical damage. At higher levels, this ability gains increased scaling potency, amplifying the effect of Attack on the damage dealt, and gains a chance to inflict the 'Dazed' status effect for 1 second, hindering enemy actions.

abilities.name: Tag Turf
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~15% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~23%).
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Gum's signature passive ability. Whenever Gum uses an ability that involves spraying graffiti, she creates a 'Tag Turf' zone at the target location. These zones last for 8 seconds. If Gum is within a Tag Turf zone created by her, she gains 15% increased movement speed and her next basic attack deals 20% bonus magic damage. If an enemy is within Gum's Tag Turf zone, their movement speed is reduced by 10% and they take 10 magic damage per second. Multiple Tag Turf zones can be active simultaneously, but their effects do not stack. Overlapping Tag Turf zones simply refresh the duration of the effect in the overlapping area. Prioritizes most recent tag.
abilities.flavorQuote: This is MY turf now, punk!

abilities.name: Street Art Sprint
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Ability scaling enhanced for greater late-game impact.
(Bugfix) Resolved reported trigger inconsistencies.
(Patch) Emphasized supportive interactions for role alignment.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Gum kicks off with a burst of speed, performing a swift, unstoppable dash forward. As she skates, she leaves behind a vibrant, glowing trail of graffiti art, tagging the ground she traverses with her personal style. Any enemies caught within this ephemeral artwork take 40 magic damage and are temporarily caught in the sticky paint, reducing their movement speed by 25% for 2 seconds, making them easier targets for Gum and her allies. More than just a visual flourish, this trail instantly creates a Tag Turf zone across its entire length, lasting for a full 5 seconds. Gum capitalizes on these zones, gaining advantages described in her passive ability, offering her strategic positioning and tactical benefits. This ability has a cooldown of 10 seconds. To maximize the impact of her street art, activating Street Art Sprint also refreshes the duration of any existing Tag Turf zones Gum is currently positioned in, allowing her to maintain her influence over the battlefield and control the flow of combat.

abilities.name: Spray Tag
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~15% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Gum throws a spray can at a target location. Upon impact, the spray can explodes in a burst of paint, dealing 60 magic damage to enemies within a small radius and creating a Tag Turf zone. The Tag Turf zone from this ability is slightly larger than those created by other abilities. Additionally, enemies hit by the initial spray can explosion are marked for 4 seconds, causing them to take 15% increased magic damage from all sources. Cooldown: 12 seconds. This ability serves as Gum's primary method for engaging enemies while enabling her to mark high-priority targets.
abilities.flavorQuote: Express delivery!

abilities.name: Grind Rail
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~32%).
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~7% and slightly longer ramp-up.

abilities.description: Gum creates a temporary grind rail in a straight line from her current location for 6 seconds. Gum and allied champions can grind along the rail, gaining 30% increased movement speed and immunity to slows while grinding. Enemies that attempt to cross the rail are knocked back a short distance and take 30 magic damage. The beginning and end points of the grind rail are marked with Tag Turf zones that last the full duration of the ability. Cooldown: 15 seconds. Can be used defensively to escape or offensively to engage.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time to ride!

abilities.name: Art Attack
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~16% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Gum unleashes a massive graffiti storm in a large target area. Over 4 seconds, multiple spray cans fall from the sky, dealing 30 magic damage to enemies per hit and creating numerous overlapping Tag Turf zones across the entire area. Enemies caught in the Art Attack are also silenced for 1 second each time they are hit by a spray can. The entire area becomes heavily saturated with Tag Turf, granting Gum significant advantages if she remains within the zone. Cooldown: 90 seconds. This ability allows Gum to heavily control a zone, punishing enemies who remain within its radius.
abilities.flavorQuote: Let's paint the town!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Gum excels in teams that can capitalize on her zone control and target marking abilities. Allies with strong burst damage or area of effect abilities can benefit from Gum's ability to mark targets and create advantageous zones. She is also effective in compositions that prioritize objective control, as she can use her abilities to secure and defend key areas.
character_v1.tierSummary: Gum's Tag Turf provides zone control, but it can be easily countered. C is a fair placement. Friendship Campaign exists, so not recreated.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Gum's abilities synergize around the Tag Turf mechanic, allowing her to create zones that enhance her mobility and damage while hindering enemies. Graffiti Boost and Spray Tag are her primary tools for creating Tag Turf zones, while Grind Rail provides a mobile escape or engage option. Art Attack serves as a powerful zoning tool that can heavily control a large area.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Gum, ever the rebel, seeks to claim the entire MUGENverse as her personal canvas, one tag at a time.

The colorful blast adheres tightly, applying the 'Marked' status effect to the target for a duration of 3 seconds. Beat's honed reflexes and mastery over his spray can allows for a swift 4-second cooldown on this ability, enabling him to maintain constant pressure on his adversaries with a dynamic barrage of graffiti and empowering damage amplification on his foes.
