Furthermore, his next basic attack within 4 seconds following this burst of speed channels the kinetic energy of his movement, dealing an additional 40 (+ 25% of Rayman's Attack Damage) as bonus physical damage to the target. This bonus damage applies only to the first enemy hit within the 4-second window, reinforcing the hit-and-run tactics favored by the limbless hero and rewarding players who capitalize on his inherent agility to outmaneuver opponents.

character_v1.teamSynergy: Rayman synergizes well with teams that can capitalize on his disruptive abilities. His stun and knockback effects can set up opportunities for allies to deal damage, and his mobility allows him to quickly respond to changing battlefield conditions.
character_v1.tierSummary: Rayman has a disjointed kit with abilities that don't synergize well. While he has some utility, his low stats and lack of focus make him weak. Moving him to F+ reflects this.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Rayman's kit revolves around utilizing his mobility and repositioning abilities to gain an advantage in combat. Nimble Repositioning rewards players for using Telescopic Strike and Whirlwind Fists effectively, while Helicopter Hover provides additional options for maneuverability and engagement.

chapters.title: Whispers of the Corrupted Wood
chapters.mission: Navigate a series of increasingly difficult platforming challenges while purifying corrupted zones with Ori's light. Rayman's Whirlwind Fists clear paths, and Ori's Spirit Flame heals damaged areas.
chapters.summary: Rayman and Ori sense a growing darkness in a once-vibrant forest. They must combine Rayman's limbless agility and Ori's light magic to find the source of the corruption.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Rayman teams up with Ori to navigate a corrupted forest, using their unique movement abilities to overcome obstacles and heal the land.
bondPerks: Rayman gains increased mobility after using Ori's abilities.
Ori's healing is amplified near Rayman.

If the Mana Barrier endures the onslaught and remains unbroken when its duration concludes, the protected target experiences a surge of arcane energy, granting them a 15% increase to their movement speed for 2 seconds, allowing for swift repositioning or aggressive pursuit. Furthermore, by expending a precious stack of Mana Reserve while casting Mana Barrier, Gwen amplifies the shield's protective capabilities by a substantial 50%, creating a bulwark that is far more resistant to damage. The target also experiences a burst of restorative energy, regaining health equal to 3% of their maximum health over 1 second, providing vital sustain in the heat of battle.

character_v1.teamSynergy: Gwen excels in teams that can capitalize on her control and support abilities. Her Manna Web can set up easy targets for high-damage allies, while her Protective Aura keeps them alive long enough to deal significant damage. Her Anodite form provides a substantial boost to team fight potential, allowing her to dish out massive damage and enhance her allies' survivability. She synergizes well with burst damage dealers and tanky frontliners.
character_v1.tierSummary: Gwen has good utility with shields, heals, and crowd control, and her Mana Affinity provides sustain. Her stats are well-rounded. Moving her to B- reflects her support capabilities and decent damage output.
appearanceTags: Red hair with a blue hair clip
White and blue raglan shirt with cat logo
White capri pants and white sneakers
character_v1.internalSynergy: Gwen's kit revolves around generating and consuming Manna Reserves. She uses Manna Bolt to poke enemies and gain stacks, then uses Protective Aura and Manna Web to control the battlefield and protect allies. Her Anodite Spark ultimate is a powerful burst of damage and utility, requiring careful planning and Manna Reserve management to maximize its effectiveness.

chapters.title: Arcane Sisterhood
chapters.mission: Defeat a series of magical constructs using a combination of Gwen's Mana Bolt and Zatanna's backwards spells. Strategic use of Mana Barrier and Zatanna's crowd control is essential.

character_v1.teamSynergy: Kevin works well with teams that can provide sustained damage output, allowing him to build Potential and disrupt enemy formations. His shielding ability protects vulnerable carries, while his crowd control effects set up opportunities for his team to capitalize on.
character_v1.tierSummary: Kevin's kit revolves around absorbing elements and adapting to different situations. His high defense and Osmosian Resilience passive make him a durable character. Moving him to B+ accounts for his tankiness and potential to deal true damage.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Kevin's kit revolves around absorbing damage to build Potential, which he then uses to empower his attacks or create defensive shields. The synergy between 'Osmosian Resilience' and 'Elemental Infusion' allows him to strategically unleash elemental combos. 'Matter Shield' provides sustain, while 'Osmosian Drain' offers a unique way to steal enemy power and heal himself. 'Ultimate Mutation' amplifies all aspects of his kit, making him a formidable force in team fights.

abilities.description: Ju Fu Fu channels her inner tiger, executing a rapid, elegant maneuver that briefly renders her untouchable, phasing out of reality for a crucial 0.75 seconds. During this sliver of time, she becomes completely invulnerable to all forms of incoming damage, deftly avoiding even the most devastating attacks and allowing her to reposition strategically on the battlefield. Each successful evasion grants her 1 stack of 'Momentum', a testament to her growing agility and combat readiness. Upon reaching the maximum of 15 'Momentum' stacks, further successful dodges no longer increase the stack count; instead, they trigger a surge of primal energy, flooding her with 50 'Might'. This 'Might' empowers her next basic attack within 5 seconds, causing it to erupt with fiery energy and inflict additional fire damage equal to 30% of her total attack damage. This strike doesn't just harm; it strategically weakens, applying a 'Weak Spot' debuff to the target. Each stack of 'Weak Spot' increases the critical damage the target receives from all sources by 10%, stacking up to a maximum of 3 times. Thus, at maximum stacks, the target becomes significantly more vulnerable, suffering 30% increased critical damage, a tempting opportunity for Ju Fu Fu and her allies to exploit. When combined with 'Tiger's Roar', Ju Fu Fu's focused battle stance, the invulnerability granted by 'Tiger's Grace' extends to 0.9 seconds. This additional time provides an even greater window of opportunity to evade particularly deadly attacks, giving her the edge she needs in the heat of battle.

When Ju Fufu's base Attack is greater than or equal to 2800, every additional 100 Attack further increases Crit Damage by 5%, up to a maximum additional increase of 30%. While in the 'Tiger's Roar' state, character Chain Attack and Ultimate Damage increases by 10% and 20% respectively. Furthermore, while Ju Fufu is in the 'Tiger's Roar' state, her Impact increases by 25.
abilities.flavorQuote: The power of the tiger roars within!

character_v1.playstyle: High-Risk, High-Reward DPS with Momentum and Might Management
character_v1.teamSynergy: Ju Fufu excels in teams that can capitalize on her 'Tiger's Roar' buff, particularly those with strong Chain Attacks and Ultimates. Characters that can apply crowd control or debuffs to enemies further enhance her damage output.
character_v1.tierSummary: Ju Fu Fu's kit is focused on high damage output with critical hits and fire abilities. His high attack and speed stats make him a formidable damage dealer. However, his low health makes him vulnerable. Keeping him at A- accounts for his high burst potential with a risk factor.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Ju Fufu's kit revolves around building Momentum and Might to unleash devastating Fire damage and buff her team. Her abilities synergize to create a high-skill ceiling gameplay experience where precise timing and resource management are crucial.

abilities.description: Ren loses all self-control and succumbs to an episode of 'Rabid Frenzy', lashing out at everyone around him for 8 seconds! His movement speed dramatically increases by 30%, reflecting his unhinged state, and each basic attack claws away 20% of the target's health, transferring that stolen vitality directly back to Ren. He mindlessly assaults the closest target, friend or foe, unleashing a flurry of unpredictable attacks, filling the air with frantic swipes. Each successful attack grants Ren 5% to his Rage Meter, driving him closer to ultimate madness. If Ren’s Rage Meter is already full at 100% when 'Rabid Frenzy' is activated, the duration of this chaotic rampage extends to a full 10 seconds! Furthermore, the health drained from each attack increases to a whopping 30%, transforming him into an even more terrifying and uncontrollable force. However, be warned: this descent into madness requires a significant period of recovery, resulting in a substantial cooldown before Ren can unleash this primal fury again.

If an enemy is struck by multiple globs within quick succession (1 second), each subsequent hit applies a stacking 'Contagious' debuff for 3 seconds, which reduces their magic resistance by 8% per stack, up to a maximum of 24%. character_v1.playstyle: Aggressive, debuff-focused support with Rage-based power-ups.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Ren works well in teams that capitalize on debuffed enemies and benefit from attack and speed buffs. Characters with high burst damage or sustained DPS can take full advantage of Ren's support, turning him into a potent enabler for the team's damage dealers.
character_v1.tierSummary: Ren's kit is centered around rage and uncontrollable abilities. His basic stats aren't impressive and his abilities have too much randomness. Moving him down to D+ reflects his limited utility and lack of consistent performance.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Ren's kit revolves around building Rage and using it to enhance his disruptive abilities, creating a feedback loop where aggression leads to greater control and damage. His abilities synergize to debuff enemies and buff allies, making him a valuable support character who can also deal respectable damage.

abilities.description: Stimpy, in a moment of what he believes is profound generosity, unleashes a potent, yellowish-green cloud of… well, it’s best not to dwell on what it is. He projects this odorous miasma in a medium-range cone directly in front of him. Any enemy caught within this pungent area is immediately afflicted with the 'Gross Out' effect for a duration of 5 seconds. This initial wave of revulsion causes a 25% reduction in the target's damage output. But that’s not all! In addition to the 'Gross Out' debuff, they also receive a stack of 'Stink'. Each stack of 'Stink' reduces incoming healing by 10%, with a maximum of 3 stacks, resulting in a possible total healing reduction of 30%. However, in a bizarre twist of fate (or perhaps just Stimpy’s peculiar biology), allies caught in this cloud aren't repulsed, but rather invigorated! They gain a damage reduction shield equivalent to 15% of their max health that lasts for 3 seconds. Even more peculiar, during this shielded period, any healing they receive is amplified by 20%, making them surprisingly resilient to damage while under the influence of Stimpy’s… 'gift'. The range of the cone requires Stimpy to be at least moderately close to enemies to fully utilize this ability.

character_v1.teamSynergy: Stimpy synergizes well with aggressive, frontline heroes who can benefit from his buffs and healing. His 'Gross Out' debuffs can weaken enemy damage output, making him a valuable asset in prolonged team fights. He also pairs well with heroes who can capitalize on crowd-controlled enemies, as his Cheese-O-Phone can stun.
character_v1.tierSummary: Stimpy has a mix of support and debuff abilities, but his stats are skewed towards magic attack, which doesn't align well with his kit. His reliance on Gritty Kitty Charges also limits his effectiveness. Moving him to D- acknowledges his utility but also his inconsistencies.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Stimpy's abilities revolve around controlling zones and supporting allies with a mix of healing, buffs, and debuffs. The 'Gritty Kitty Charges' mechanic allows him to amplify his abilities, adding a layer of strategic depth to his gameplay. His ultimate offers both offensive and defensive capabilities, rewarding careful positioning and timing.

abilities.description: Naruto focuses his chakra, forming a concentrated, palm-sized sphere of potent life force. He then propels this sphere towards a single ally within a medium range, mending their wounds upon impact. This injection heals for an amount equal to 40% of Naruto's Attack stat, plus a base heal amount of 50. In addition to the immediate heal, the target also gains a 'Fortitude' buff for 3 seconds. While under the effects of 'Fortitude,' the target's damage reduction is increased by 10%. Furthermore, if the target is below 25% health when this injection lands, they gain an additional 'Guts' buff for 2 seconds. 'Guts' prevents the target from being reduced below 1 health, potentially saving them from a fatal blow. This ability's healing and buffing capacity makes Naruto a valuable asset in keeping his allies alive and thriving on the battlefield.

abilities.description: Naruto, drawing upon his vast chakra reserves, expends 2 Clone Reservoir stacks, momentarily focusing his energy before summoning a Shadow Clone directly in front of a targeted enemy. This clone, a perfect copy in every way, unleashes a relentless flurry of taijutsu, a frenzy of punches and kicks that batter the opponent. Each strike from the Shadow Clone deals a percentage of Naruto's Attack Damage, specifically 2%, augmented by an additional percentage scaled to the target's current health, inflicting 5% of the enemy's remaining hit points as physical damage with each blow. The Shadow Clone continues its assault for a duration of 5 seconds, or until it has successfully landed a total of 10 hits. Should the targeted enemy be suffering from any form of crowd control impairment, such as a stun, root, or slow, the Shadow Clone's attack speed is drastically increased, gaining a 50% boost to its offensive tempo. Further, each successful hit during this heightened state applies a stacking debuff to the target, reducing their physical defense by 5% per strike, stacking up to a maximum defensive reduction of 25%. And, as a testament to Naruto's training, should the Shadow Clone successfully land all 10 blows, Naruto's own chakra control is reinforced, refunding 1 Clone Reservoir stack to the user.

If Naruto takes damage exceeding 10% of his maximum health in a single instance, he gains 1 Clone Reservoir stack.
abilities.flavorQuote: I've got enough clones to keep this fight going!

abilities.description: Naruto focuses, rapidly spinning chakra into a condensed Rasengan, becoming briefly vulnerable as he channels his energy for 2.5 seconds. During this time, his movement speed is reduced by 25%, but he hardens his resolve, mitigating incoming damage by 15%. Once the Rasengan is ready, Naruto vanishes in a burst of speed towards a targeted enemy, slamming the Rasengan into them. This deals 120 base magic damage, enhanced by 60% of Naruto's magic attack stat. The true power of the Vanishing Rasengan is unlocked with the aid of Naruto's Shadow Clones; for each Clone Reservoir stack Naruto possesses at the time of impact, the Rasengan's damage is magnified by 25%. If Naruto has amassed the full potential of 5 Clone Reservoir stacks, the force of the Rasengan's impact is so devastating that it stuns the target for a duration of 1.75 seconds, leaving them vulnerable to follow-up attacks.

abilities.description: Naruto unleashes his full potential, consuming all Clone Reservoir stacks and creating a massive wave of Shadow Clones that charge towards the battlefield, each assisting nearby allies. For every Clone Reservoir stack consumed, one additional clone is summoned. Each Clone persists for 10 seconds. Clones automatically target the nearest ally and grants one of the following buffs to that ally based on remaining stacks (chosen randomly): 1 Stack: +10% atk, 2 Stacks: +10% magic atk, 3 Stacks: +10% def, 4 Stacks: +10% magic def, 5 Stacks: +10% speed. Upon expiration, each clone explodes, healing their respective ally for 3% of their max HP + 3% of Naruto's max HP.
abilities.flavorQuote: This is it! I'm gonna need all the help I can get!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Naruto synergizes well with teams that can capitalize on his buffs and utility. Allies that benefit from attack damage, magic attack, defense, magic defense, and speed will thrive under his support. His taunt and speed boost can enable engage compositions, while his Rasengan can provide burst damage for follow-up.
character_v1.tierSummary: Naruto's kit is versatile with healing, clones, and assassination potential. His high attack and speed stats, combined with clone utility, make him very powerful. He can perform well in multiple roles and his ultimate provides good team support, justifying a promotion to A+.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Naruto's kit revolves around generating and consuming Clone Reservoir stacks. The passive provides a constant stream, while active abilities like Shadow Clone Barrage and Clone Decoy consume them for various effects. Rasengan Charge benefits from having a full stack, rewarding strategic use of clones. The ultimate ability can utilize every remaining Clone Reservoir stack.

upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.

If an enemy steps within a 2-meter radius of the trap, it triggers, launching them backward 5 meters and inflicting 60 (+ 35% magic atk) damage. Additionally, the enemy is stunned for 1.75 seconds. This ability has a cooldown of 18 seconds. This ability offers strong zoning and disruption, creating strategic chokepoints and punishing aggressive enemy movements. abilities.flavorQuote: Just a little something to keep you on your toes!

abilities.description: Usopp consumes 35% of his Ammo Satchel to launch a large, spiked ball filled with explosive powder, covering an extended range of 18 meters. Upon impacting with an enemy or reaching its maximum range, the Cactus Ball detonates in a 4-meter radius, inflicting 75 (+45% Magic ATK) physical damage and knocking enemies back 4 meters. Enemies at the epicenter of the explosion are knocked down for 1.25 seconds, providing a brief window for follow-up attacks. The ability has a 16-second cooldown. This ability serves as both a ranged damage tool and a disruption option. The knockdown effect on central targets allows Usopp to control enemy positioning and create space for himself and allies. The extended range increases his engagement options and enhances his skirmishing capability by punishing enemies attempting to close the distance.
abilities.flavorQuote: Take this! It's got extra prickles!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Usopp provides excellent support for melee-focused teams, creating openings with his stuns and sleeps, allowing allies to engage safely. His zoning capabilities help control the battlefield, giving teammates room to maneuver and avoid enemy attacks.

character_v1.internalSynergy: Usopp's kit focuses on setting up traps with Rubber Band of Doom then capitalizing on the stun with Impact Wolf. Lying Bait can be used to protect Usopp during Tactical Retreats or to set up more intricate trap combinations.

abilities.description: Zoro's relentless three-sword style seeks to leave lasting scars on any opponent daring to face him. Each of Zoro's basic attacks carries a 15% chance to inflict 'Pierced,' a grievous wound that ignores all defenses and deals true damage to the target. This damage equates to 2% of the target's maximum health, dealt over a 3-second duration, showcasing the depth of Zoro's strikes. When Zoro channels his Haki, his resolve intensifies. With each stack of 'Haki Imbued,' the probability of inflicting 'Pierced' escalates by 2%, reaching a maximum of 25% at five stacks, ensuring that enemies constantly feel the bite of his swords. Furthermore, Zoro's iron will grants him 10% tenacity, shortening the duration of crowd control effects such as stuns or slows, allowing him to stay in the fray and continue his relentless assault. Zoro's mastery extends his reach, granting an additional 50 units of attack range, allowing him to strike from a safer distance while maintaining control of the battlefield. The effects of each 'Pierced' application are independent, their 3-second timers unaffected by subsequent attacks, ensuring that the wounds accumulate and the pressure mounts. This passive transforms Zoro into an assassin who punishes enemy mistakes, with unavoidable damage wearing down even the sturdiest foes.

character_v1.teamSynergy: Zoro benefits from allies who can provide crowd control or engage in team fights, allowing him to safely build and expend Haki Imbued stacks. He can also act as a secondary damage threat, punishing enemies who focus on other targets.

character_v1.internalSynergy: Zoro's kit revolves around maintaining Haki Imbued stacks to empower his abilities. Ashura serves as a powerful offensive ultimate, amplifying Zoro's damage and stack generation.

abilities.description: Mitotic Regeneration epitomizes Sakura's unparalleled control over cellular mitosis, manifesting as a potent healing wave. Upon activation, Sakura channels chakra into accelerated cellular division, unleashing a surging tide of restorative energy. This wave emanates outwards in a cone-shaped area, primarily targeting allies, but also possesses a unique interaction with enemies. For allies, the wave instantly restores a significant portion of their health, scaling dynamically with Sakura's maximum HP and Healing Power stats. Furthermore, it applies a Regen buff, granting sustained healing over time, with the duration and potency also scaling with Sakura's stats. Crucially, the wave's interaction with enemies inflicts a temporary 'Cellular Instability' debuff; rather than directly damaging foes, it disrupts their natural healing processes, effectively reducing their healing received from all sources for a short duration. This disruption is particularly effective against enemies that rely on self-healing or regeneration, making it a valuable tactical tool. Moreover, 'Cellular Instability' has a chance to trigger a secondary effect, causing a minor burst of damage-over-time effect proportional to the initial healing reduction. This ability is core to Sakura's role as a supportive healer, enabling her to sustain her team while simultaneously hindering enemy sustain strategies.

character_v1.teamSynergy: Mickey pairs well with damage dealers who can capitalize on the sustained healing and occasional defensive boosts he provides. He benefits from teammates who can initiate engagements and draw enemy attention, allowing him to safely maintain his supportive role.

tips: Prioritize allies who are taking damage with 'Cheerful Tune' to maximize its shield effect.

Save 'Whistle While You Work' for crucial moments when your team needs a burst of speed and protection, like during a focused enemy attack.
strategyData.overview: Mickey Mouse is a dedicated healer who focuses on keeping his team alive through burst heals, shields, and speed boosts. He's very reliant on staying near his allies, and benefits from allies who can use the extra speed he provides.
strategyData.counterplay: Focus fire Mickey Mouse down before he can react, as he doesn't have any self-preserving abilities. CC him and watch his allies crumble.

teamLineups.note: Mickey's 'White Glove Treatment' and 'Whistle While You Work' provide Speed, which is then amplified by Stimpy's 'Happy Helmet Hijinks' to further boost attack speed and movement speed, creating a highly mobile and offensive team. Richard's Trivia buff and the Speed from Trunks help push this momentum.

character_v1.internalSynergy: Mickey's kit focuses on consistent, subtle support, with his passive ability triggering when allies are in danger, giving them a crucial boost to survival. character_v1.playstyle: Versatile buff and heal-oriented support, excels in enhancing allies and providing sustained healing while weaving in light damage and utility.

tips: Optimize Bow Fabric: The name of the game is Bow Fabric! Track the rate you're generating it, and remember you're wasting potential by sitting at max Fabric.
Prioritize Targets: Ribbon Remedy's shield can bait enemies into focusing the shielded target. Polka-Dot Pop is crucial for peeling; hitting debuffed enemies extends its duration.
Time Sweetheart Serenade: Use this when your team can capitalize on the healing or damage. It's a powerful tool in extended fights, but a waste if used carelessly.
strategyData.overview: Minnie Mouse is a resource-dependent Glamour Support who wants to weave in and out of fights. You'll spend most of your time passively gathering Bow Fabric, then strategically spending it to buff allies or debuff enemies. If you don't focus on resource management, you will not be effective with this character.
strategyData.counterplay: Shut down Minnie's Bow Fabric generation or punish her for overspending it. Burst her down when she has low Fabric, since her ability to buff and debuff is directly tied to it. CCing her during ultimate severely reduces the radius that allies and enemies are buffed/debuffed.

abilities.description: Donald Duck, fueled by his trademark temper, winds up with his comically large mallet before unleashing a mighty swing! This attack targets the closest enemy within a medium range, dealing a base of 60 physical damage plus an additional 40% of Donald's attack power. The cooldown on this ability is a swift 4 seconds, allowing for frequent outbursts of rage. Each use of Seething Sailor Swing generates 5 points of Rage, which fuels other abilities, but be warned: as Donald's Rage builds, his accuracy with this attack falters. With Rage between 0 and 50, the attack has a 100% chance to hit. From 51 to 75 Rage, there's a 25% chance the attack will miss. And if Donald's Rage exceeds 75, the attack's damage is boosted by 25%, but it has a 50% chance to target a random enemy within range, potentially hitting an unintended target. This chaos embodies Donald's unpredictable nature when his anger peaks.

abilities.description: Donald unleashes a barrage of random objects from his pockets (hammers, rubber chickens, etc.) in a cone in front of him, dealing X physical damage over 3 seconds to enemies within the area. Each hit applies a small knockback. This ability generates 10 Rage upon activation. The spread of the cone widens as Donald's Rage increases, making the attack harder to focus on a single target but increasing its area of effect. Enemies hit while Donald has 50 or more Rage have a 20% chance to be stunned for 1 second.
abilities.flavorQuote: Take this! And that! And this too!

abilities.name: Seafarer's Spite
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Improved scaling: shield absorbs more damage at later levels.

abilities.description: Donald steels his nerves, drawing upon the salty wisdom of a thousand voyages, manifesting a shimmering bubble of pure, unfettered annoyance! For 4 seconds, Donald gains a shield that absorbs incoming damage, protecting him from harm. The shield's strength scales with Donald's level, providing significant damage mitigation, allowing him to weather even the stormiest of encounters. While this irascible barrier is active, Donald's speed increases by 20%, allowing him to navigate the battlefield with surprising agility, deftly dodging attacks and positioning himself for maximum disruptive impact. However, the intensity of his focus causes a slight dip in his usual offensive capabilities, reducing his attack damage by 15%. The shield also grants Donald immunity to crowd control effects, ensuring that he can't be stunned, silenced, or otherwise hindered during this crucial period. Even if the shield is shattered prematurely by an overwhelming onslaught, the immunity to crowd control remains for the full 4 second duration, a testament to Donald's sheer stubbornness. Once the shield dissipates, whether broken or expired, the concentrated frustration builds to a boiling point, imbuing his next auto-attack with bonus damage equal to 50% of the damage the shield absorbed, punishing his foes for daring to challenge his seaworthy spirit. Finally, as the last vestiges of the shield fade, Donald gains 10% evasion for 2 seconds, allowing him to deftly avoid incoming attacks and maintain his position in the fray, a testament to his surprisingly nimble footwork. Activating this ability also generates 15 Rage, fueling his other abilities.

abilities.description: Donald Duck, known for his easily ruffled feathers, turns frustration into a surprising form of support. When his Irritation reaches 100, Donald doesn't lash out; instead, he channels that energy into a 'Driven' state for 5 seconds. While 'Driven', Donald’s proximity to his allies empowers them: those allies within 600 units gain 15% increased movement speed and a shield that absorbs 50 (+10% of Donald's Max HP) damage. However, after the 'Driven' state ends, Donald becomes momentarily 'Flustered'. While 'Flustered' for 3 seconds, Donald's healing output is reduced by 20%, and he cannot gain Irritation.

abilities.name: Elemental Shift
abilities.description: Arceus constantly cycles through elemental Plates in a set order: Fire, Water, Grass, Electric. Each Plate grants different effects. When on Fire Plate, allies within a medium radius gain 10% increased attack damage. While on Water Plate, allies gain 10% increased magic defense. While on Grass Plate, allies within a medium radius are healed for 2% of their maximum HP every second. While on Electric Plate, enemies within a medium radius have their movement speed reduced by 15%. These effects last as long as Arceus maintains the corresponding Plate and linger for 1 second after switching. The cycle continues indefinitely, providing a dynamic ebb and flow of elemental buffs and debuffs.
abilities.flavorQuote: The essence of creation flows through me, adapting to the needs of all.

abilities.name: Judgment Bolt
abilities.description: Arceus unleashes a Judgment Bolt, the type of which corresponds to the current active Elemental Plate. Fire Judgment deals damage in a line and inflicts a burn, dealing 5% of the target's maximum HP as damage over 3 seconds. Water Judgment creates a small area of effect that slows enemies by 25% for 2 seconds. Grass Judgment heals allies in a small area for 10% of their maximum HP. Electric Judgment stuns the primary target for 0.75 seconds. The bolt travels a medium distance and has a moderate cooldown of 8 seconds. The specific effect is determined at the moment of casting based on the current active Elemental Plate.
abilities.flavorQuote: By my judgment, the elements shall bend to my will!

Fire Plate grants a shield that absorbs 150 damage. Water Plate grants a shield that absorbs 100 damage and regenerates 1% max hp per second. Grass Plate grants a shield that absorbs 100 damage and heals the target for 5% max hp upon breaking. Electric Plate grants a shield that absorbs 200 damage. The shield lasts for 4 seconds or until broken and has a cooldown of 12 seconds. The ally must be within a medium range to be targeted.
abilities.flavorQuote: A shield of cosmic energy protects you!

abilities.name: Omnipotent Aura
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~38%).
abilities.description: Arceus emanates an Omnipotent Aura for 8 seconds, greatly enhancing the effects of its Elemental Plates. While the aura is active, Fire Plate increases ally attack damage by 25%. Water Plate increases ally magic defense by 25% and grants a minor cleanse removing one debuff every 2 seconds. Grass Plate heals allies for 5% of their maximum HP every second and cleanses allies of burns and poisons every 2 seconds. Electric Plate reduces enemy movement speed by 40% and has a 25% chance to inflict a brief stun (0.5 seconds) with each tick. This ability has a long cooldown of 60 seconds and affects allies and enemies within a large radius.
abilities.flavorQuote: Behold, the power of creation unleashed!

abilities.name: Multitype Adaptation
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~17%).
abilities.description: Arceus gains 1% Tenacity and 1% Evasion for each unique type present on the allied team. This bonus caps at 10% Tenacity and 10% Evasion. For example, if the allied team consists of a Fire, Water, and Grass type character alongside Arceus, it will gain 3% Tenacity and 3% Evasion. This passive encourages diverse team compositions, enhancing Arceus's survivability and resistance to crowd control. Should an ally be multi-typed, that only counts as one type for the purposes of this passive.
abilities.flavorQuote: I draw strength from the diversity of creation.

character_v1.teamSynergy: Arceus synergizes well with teams that benefit from constant elemental buffs and debuffs. Characters that can capitalize on attack damage increases, magic defense increases, healing, or slowed enemies will excel alongside Arceus. Its Multitype Adaptation passive encourages team diversity, making it a flexible addition to various team compositions.
character_v1.tierSummary: Arceus's elemental adaptation and utility skills are versatile, but his base stats are relatively low. His performance highly depends on team synergy, placing him at D.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Arceus's kit revolves around its Elemental Shift passive. Judgment Bolt and Cosmic Barrier actively benefit from this passive by gaining different effects depending on the current plate, creating a dynamic playstyle. Omnipotent Aura amplifies the Elemental Plate effects providing bursts of strong support, while Multitype Adaptation encourages teammates to select a diverse team for more Tenacity/Evasion.

abilities.description: Eleven focuses intently, her brow furrowed in concentration as she unleashes a surge of telekinetic energy, creating a visible wave emanating outwards in a straight line from her position. This wave violently repels any enemies caught within its path, shoving them backwards with significant force. The distance enemies are pushed is directly proportional to Eleven's Magic Attack stat, ensuring a greater displacement potential as she grows in power. Any enemy struck by this telekinetic shockwave also suffers 80 magic damage, augmented by 40% of Eleven's Magic Attack. Enemies unlucky enough to be propelled into a solid obstacle, such as a wall, tree, or other immovable object, endure further agony in the form of True Damage equal to 20% of their maximum health, reflecting the raw psychic force of the impact. This surge of power also generates 20 Psychic Resonance within Eleven, fueling her more potent abilities. Telekinetic Repulsion possesses a medium range and has a cooldown of 8 seconds, requiring strategic deployment.

abilities.name: Sensory Deprivation
abilities.description: Eleven taps into the Void, creating a zone of sensory deprivation at a target location. Enemies within the zone have their vision drastically reduced and their attack speed slowed by 25% for 4 seconds. The zone persists for 6 seconds. Casting Sensory Deprivation generates 10 Psychic Resonance. The range of the zone is medium. While within the zone, enemies also have a 15% chance to miss their attacks entirely. The radius of the Sensory Deprivation zone is significant, affecting multiple enemies simultaneously. This ability has a cooldown of 15 seconds. Sensory Deprivation can be strategically placed to disrupt enemy formations, providing cover for allies or setting up ambushes.
abilities.flavorQuote: "I can't see..."

abilities.name: Psychic Resonance
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~28%).
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~47%).
abilities.description: Eleven's abilities generate Psychic Resonance. At 100 Resonance, her next ability becomes Overloaded. Overloaded abilities have increased effects, but after using an Overloaded ability, Eleven becomes Psychically Vulnerable for 5 seconds, taking 20% increased damage from all sources. Overloaded Telekinetic Barrier grants allies within the barrier a 15% increase to their attack damage. Overloaded Psychic Push deals an additional 50% damage and stuns targets for 1.5 seconds. Overloaded Sensory Deprivation silences enemies within the zone for 2 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: "I feel... stronger."

abilities.name: Upside Down Collapse
abilities.description: Eleven channels the power of the Upside Down, creating a large zone that pulls enemies towards its center over 3 seconds. At the end of the duration, the zone collapses, dealing massive magic damage to enemies caught within and stunning them for 2 seconds. The damage scales significantly with Eleven's magic attack. This ability generates 30 Psychic Resonance upon cast, regardless of whether it hits enemies. The ultimate has a long range, allowing Eleven to influence engagements from a safe distance. The initial pull effect is gradual but becomes stronger over time, making it difficult for enemies to escape before the final collapse. This ability deals 250 + (80% of Eleven's Magic Attack) magic damage and has a cooldown of 90 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: "It's coming..."

character_v1.playstyle: Strategic Battlefield Manipulation with Burst Potential
character_v1.teamSynergy: Eleven pairs well with damage dealers who can capitalize on her crowd control and zone creation. Tanks can benefit from her Telekinetic Barrier, and assassins can utilize her Psychic Push for easy target access.
character_v1.tierSummary: Eleven's kit offers a mix of zone control and psychic abilities. However, her reliance on scaling and multiple statuses limits her consistent performance. The stats are average, and the complexity of the kit warrants a mid-tier position. Repositioned to C- to fill the distribution need, KPS is recalculated to reflect her actual viability. Friendship Campaign has been generated.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Eleven's kit revolves around controlling the battlefield with zones and displacing enemies, setting up favorable conditions for her team. Her Passive encourages strategic ability usage and awareness of vulnerability windows.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Eleven, seeking to understand the nature of fear, teams up with Batman to explore the darkness and find inner strength.

character_v1.name: Jane Margolis

abilities.name: Cheap Cigarettes
upgrades: Lv10: +10% ATK Scaling
Lv50: 'Hack' also reduces target's accuracy by 10%.
Lv100: 'Cheap Cigarettes' now heals Jane for 10% of the damage dealt.
abilities.description: With a weary sigh, Jane produces a crushed pack, extracting a cigarette with trembling fingers. She lights it, inhales deeply, and then deliberately exhales a stream of harsh smoke towards a chosen adversary. This cynical exhale deals physical damage equal to 30% of Jane's Attack, augmented by a base damage of 10. The resulting cloud inflicts the 'Hack' debuff for 1.5 seconds. While afflicted by 'Hack,' the target suffers a 15% reduction in their attack speed, struggling to draw breath. Each subsequent 'Cheap Cigarettes' attack landing on the same target extends the 'Hack' duration by 0.25 seconds, up to a maximum of 2.5 seconds. Furthermore, should the target already be affected by the 'Dopesick' debuff—a state of debilitating withdrawal—'Cheap Cigarettes' inflicts additional physical damage equal to 10% of the target's maximum health, bypassing armor. This bonus damage is limited to once every 5 seconds per target, reflecting the lingering effects of the interaction.

abilities.name: Blackmail
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Jane leverages her knowledge to exploit enemy weaknesses. Target enemy receives a debuff that amplifies damage taken from all sources by 10% + (2% per Withdrawal stack), lasting for 5 seconds. The duration is refreshed each time the affected target is hit by an ally. While this debuff is active, Jane gains vision of the target, ignoring stealth and revealing them on the minimap. If the target dies while Blackmail is active, Jane gains a temporary 20% increase in speed for 3 seconds, representing a fleeting sense of victory. This ability has a cooldown of 8 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: I will burn you to the ground.

abilities.name: Relapse
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~7% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Jane succumbs to her addiction, unleashing a wave of debilitating toxins. Jane consumes 5 Withdrawal stacks, dealing 50 + (10 per stack consumed) magic damage to all nearby enemies and inflicting 'Euphoria' for 3 seconds. Euphoria reduces enemy attack speed by 20% and movement speed by 15%. For each enemy affected by Euphoria, Jane heals for 2% of her max HP. After using Relapse, Jane gains 3 stacks of Withdrawal, representing the immediate return of her addiction’s influence. This ability has a cooldown of 12 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: I backslid, okay? Like, what? What, you think I'm proud of this?

abilities.name: Apology Girl
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~26%).
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Jane's attempts at amends have unintended consequences. Every 10 seconds, Jane generates 1 stack of 'Withdrawal', up to a maximum of 10 stacks. Each stack of Withdrawal increases the potency of her debuffs by a small percentage (see abilities) and restores 1% of her missing health per second. However, each stack of Withdrawal also increases the damage she takes from all sources by 3%, reflecting her growing vulnerability. This passive encourages strategic ability usage to manage Withdrawal stacks for optimal risk/reward.
abilities.flavorQuote: I’m sorry.

abilities.name: Haunted
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Jane confronts her inner demons, projecting her guilt onto a single target. Jane spends all stacks of Withdrawal. Target enemy is afflicted with 'Guilt' for 4 seconds. While under the effect of Guilt, the enemy’s healing received is reduced by 30% + (5% per Withdrawal stack spent), and their next damaging ability against an ally is reflected back onto themselves for 50% of the original damage. This reflection cannot trigger critical hits. After using Haunted, Jane is stunned for 0.5 seconds, representing the emotional toll of the ability. Cooldown of 15 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: It was me. I killed her, man. I killed her.

abilities.name: Chain Smoker's Shield
upgrades: Extended Cloud: Enhances the reach of Jane's smoke, increasing the radius of both the initial shield application and the subsequent debuff by 125 units (increased from 100).
Lingering Cough: Amplifies the duration of the 'Smoked Out' debuff, prolonging the enemy's debilitated state by an additional 0.75 seconds.
Strengthened Shield: Fortifies the shield granted to allies by augmenting its protective capacity by an additional 12.5% of Jane's maximum health.
Nicotine Patch: The dissipating smoke now restores 3% of allies maximum health over 3 seconds after Fortified ends.
(Balance Patch) Worsening Addiction: The shielding scales better as the game progresses, making it more effective at later levels.
(Patch) Focus Support: Increases the potency of the buffs for teammates.
abilities.description: With a weary sigh, Jane lights up another cigarette, the smoke curling around her and taking on an almost tangible form, a reflection of the fragile protection she offers her allies. Upon activation, Jane forcefully exhales a massive plume of smoke, instantly enveloping herself and all allied heroes within a 600-unit radius in a protective haze. This smoke grants the 'Fortified' buff for 4 seconds. Fortified provides an immediate shield, absorbing incoming damage equal to 25% of Jane's maximum health (increased from 20%), offering crucial shielding when it matters most. Moreover, allies under the Fortified effect receive a 30% reduction in damage taken from all sources for the duration, helping teammates withstand the most ferocious assaults. As the smoke disperses and the Fortified buff expires, all enemy heroes within a 400-unit radius are afflicted with the 'Smoked Out' debuff for a duration of 1.75 seconds (increased from 1.5 seconds). Smoked Out reduces their attack damage by 35% and their movement speed by 25%, crippling their ability to effectively engage in combat, as they cough and choke. Chain Smoker's Shield has a cooldown of 75 seconds.

character_v1.teamSynergy: Jane excels in teams that can capitalize on her amplified damage and debuffs. Characters with high burst damage or consistent damage output benefit greatly from Blackmail. Tanks can protect her from the increased vulnerability caused by Withdrawal. Her slows from Choke on It enable allies to easily land skillshots or engage in prolonged fights.
character_v1.tierSummary: Jane Margolis' kit revolves around debuffs and damage amplification. Her unique 'Relapse' ability adds a layer of complexity and risk/reward. Her stats are solid, especially the magic attack. She is promoted to B+ to fill distribution gaps and better reflect her disruptive gameplay. KPS is recalculated to appropriately match her viability.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Jane's kit revolves around managing her Withdrawal stacks to amplify her debuffs, but at the cost of increased vulnerability. Relapse allows her to consume stacks for damage and healing, while Haunted spends them for powerful debuffs and reflect. Blackmail provides utility through vision and damage amplification, while her ultimate offers a brief burst of power at a significant personal cost.

abilities.description: Benson fixes his piercing gaze upon a single, hapless enemy, channeling the sheer force of his managerial disapproval into a concentrated blast of magical energy. This withering stare deals X magic damage directly to the target, embodying the crushing weight of unmet expectations. Furthermore, the targeted enemy is immediately afflicted with 'Subpar Performance', causing them to deal 15% less damage for a duration of 3 seconds, reflecting Benson's keen eye for identifying inefficiencies. The psychic backlash of this intense reprimand generates 10 Stress within Benson, representing the burden of his responsibilities. Should Benson's internal Stress Gauge exceed 50% prior to using this ability, the 'Subpar Performance' effect intensifies, increasing the damage reduction to 25% for the same 3 second duration. However, if Benson's accumulated Stress reaches a critical 100% threshold upon activation, he suffers a catastrophic Managerial Meltdown. Benson is Stunned for 1 second, symbolizing his temporary incapacitation, and his Stress is completely reset to 0, representing the cathartic release of his pent-up frustrations.

abilities.name: Overtime!
abilities.description: Benson forces an ally into 'Overtime', granting them 20% increased attack speed and movement speed for 4 seconds. This ability also grants the ally a shield equal to 10% of Benson's Max HP that lasts for 4 seconds. This ability generates 15 Stress. If Benson's Stress Gauge is above 50%, the attack and movement speed bonus is increased to 30%. If Benson’s Stress Gauge reaches 100% after using this ability, instead of buffing the ally, Benson consumes all stress and shields himself for 25% of his max HP.
abilities.flavorQuote: "You two! Work harder, or you're fired!"

abilities.name: Managerial Outburst
upgrades: Reduce stress penalty upon reaching 100 stress.
abilities.description: Benson, overcome by the sheer incompetence surrounding him, unleashes a torrent of pent-up frustration. He surges forward a short distance, propelled by pure, unadulterated managerial stress. During this short dash, lasting 2 seconds, Benson's built-in gumball dispensers go into overdrive, firing a cone of sticky projectiles at all enemies in front of him. Each gumball inflicts X physical damage upon impact, with a maximum of 10 gumballs able to strike a single target during the fit. The sheer act of expelling this much sugary ammunition generates 20 Stress within Benson, bringing him closer to his boiling point. Should Benson's Stress Gauge already be above 50% prior to unleashing this tirade, the force behind the gumballs becomes amplified, causing enemies struck to be knocked back a short distance, effectively disrupting their formations and potentially interrupting any abilities they were attempting to use. If Benson's Stress Gauge reaches 100% as a direct result of the Managerial Outburst, he enters a state of blind, furious resilience. For the duration of the 2-second gumball barrage, Benson becomes temporarily immune to all forms of damage, shrugging off attacks that would normally halt his advance. However, this enraged state also significantly impairs his movement speed, reducing it by 50%, rendering him a relatively stationary target amidst the chaos.

abilities.name: Getting Too Stressed! (Passive)
upgrades: [object Object]
[object Object]
[object Object]
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Benson, ever the diligent manager, is prone to overwork and subsequent stress. Each time an ally unleashes an ability within a generous radius of Benson, his Stress Meter inflates by 5 units, reflecting his concern for operational efficiency. Furthermore, as his own health dwindles, the pressure mounts; for every 5% of Benson's maximum health he loses, the Stress Meter climbs another 10 units. When the pressure becomes unbearable and the Stress Meter maxes out at 100, Benson experiences a momentary but debilitating 'Meltdown'. During this 2-second meltdown phase, Benson is rendered stunned, his focus shattered, leaving him vulnerable to enemy attacks. Upon the meltdown's abrupt conclusion, the Stress Meter is immediately purged back to 0, giving Benson a chance to recover his composure. As a further measure of self-preservation, while Benson teeters below 30% of his maximum health, his inherent desire to stay on top of things compels him to absorb healing effects more efficiently, increasing the potency of all incoming healing by a significant 20%, helping him push through the deadline and maintain his composure.

abilities.name: YOU'RE FIRED!!! (Ultimate)
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Late Game Buff: Ability scaling improved — Gaining extra power at later levels.
(Patch) Role Realignment: ability now emphasizes damage-style interactions.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~23%).
abilities.description: Benson slams his fist down on his gumball machine, unleashing a wave of pure managerial frustration. This manifests as a devastating verbal barrage, dealing X Magic Damage to all enemies across the battlefield. In addition, Benson's righteous fury empowers his allies, granting them a 20% increase to their damage output for a base duration of 6 seconds. This ability consumes all of Benson's accumulated Stress. For every 20 Stress consumed in the process, the duration of the damage buff is extended by 1 second, up to a maximum of 10 seconds. Thus, if Benson unleashes this ability with 80 Stress accumulated, his allies' damage is amplified for the full 10 seconds. Moreover, if Benson is in 'Breakdown' status when activating 'YOU'RE FIRED!!!', the initial magic damage dealt to enemies is boosted by 50%, turning his managerial displeasure into a truly devastating force of nature.

character_v1.teamSynergy: Benson synergizes well with teams that have high ability usage, as this rapidly fills his Stress Gauge, allowing him to use enhanced abilities more frequently. He also benefits from healers who can keep him alive long enough to reach high stress levels and capitalize on the increased damage and effects. Characters that can grant temporary invulnerability or cleanse stuns are valuable to mitigate the 'Breakdown' state.
character_v1.tierSummary: Benson's kit focuses on debuffing enemies with stress and providing minor buffs to allies. His stats are relatively low, and his abilities are somewhat unreliable. His ultimate ability has a chance of backfiring. Considering these weaknesses, Benson is demoted to F+, to fill the very bottom distribution gaps. KPS is recalculated for greater accuracy of kit value.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Benson's kit revolves around the Stress Gauge. His abilities build stress, enhancing their effects, but too much stress leads to Breakdown. Players must balance stress generation with the power of his abilities and be mindful of Breakdown. 'Stress Management' makes him a potent late-game tank, while the ultimate rewards smart stress-stacking.

abilities.name: Drumming Benediction
upgrades: [object Object]
[object Object]
[object Object]
abilities.description: Don-chan channels his boundless Taiko spirit into a life-saving rhythm for his allies. When activated, a series of four commands appears, each demanding either a resounding 'Don!' or a sharp 'Ka!' to match the beat. Successfully executing this musical sequence sends a surge of restorative energy to the targeted ally, mending their wounds and returning vigor, instantly healing them for a robust 15% of their maximum health pool. As the rhythmic healing takes effect, a protective aura forms around the recipient, a shimmering shield that absorbs incoming damage equal to 10% of Don-chan's own potent magic attack, safeguarding them from harm for a crucial 3 seconds. This protective shield is invaluable in weathering incoming attacks, offering a buffer against the enemy's onslaught. However, should the player falter, inputting one or more incorrect beats during the sequence, the restorative power weakens. The heal diminishes to a still-helpful 7.5% of the target's maximum health, and the shield's strength decreases to only 5% of Don-chan's magic attack. Moreover, its duration is halved, lasting for only 1.5 seconds, a fleeting defense against immediate danger. Drumming Benediction demands concentration and rhythmic precision, as it comes with a cooldown of 8 seconds, demanding careful management and well-timed execution for maximum impact on the battlefield.

abilities.name: Drumbeat Barrage
upgrades: Now also grants allies within the area a 10% increase to movement speed for 3 seconds after the barrage ends.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Don-chan channels pure musical energy, unleashing a rapid-fire drumbeat barrage in a target area, disrupting foes with rhythmic chaos. Upon activation, Don-chan must successfully perform a sequence of six 'Don' or 'Ka' inputs within a tight 3-second window. Each successful input resonates outwards, weakening the resolve of enemies caught in the barrage's wake. Each successful input reduces the attack speed and movement speed of enemies within the affected area by a palpable 8% for a duration of 4 seconds; these effects stack additively, intensifying the rhythmic oppression with each perfectly timed strike. However, any incorrect input shatters the rhythmic flow, instantly resetting the debuff duration and demanding unwavering precision to maintain the cacophony of disruption. Should Don-chan flawlessly execute all six inputs, enemies are not only slowed but also afflicted with 'Rhythm Break,' a profound disruption that reduces their tenacity by a substantial 20% for the full duration of the barrage. Drumbeat Barrage has a 12-second cooldown, requiring strategic timing to effectively cripple enemy formations and exploit vulnerabilities exposed by rhythmic discord.

upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.

abilities.description: Don-chan's perfect rhythm empowers his allies. Whenever Don-chan successfully completes a 'Rhythm Resonance' sequence, the targeted ally gains 'Rhythmic Surge' for 5 seconds. 'Rhythmic Surge' increases their attack damage by 10% and magic attack by 10%. If Don-chan fails a 'Rhythm Resonance' sequence, the ally instead gains 'Rhythmic Imbalance', decreasing their attack damage and magic attack by 5% for 3 seconds. This passive encourages skillful play and rewards precise execution, while punishing mistakes. abilities.description: Don-chan channels the ultimate rhythmic power, unleashing a symphony of sound that both empowers allies and damages enemies. Upon activation, a complex sequence of 8 'Don' and 'Ka' inputs appears, each with a shorter timing window than previous abilities. Successfully completing the sequence grants all allies 'Sonic Harmony' for 7 seconds, increasing their speed by 15% and granting them 10% lifesteal. Simultaneously, enemies within a large radius take magic damage equal to 15% of Don-chan's magic attack. If the sequence fails, allies only gain 7.5% speed and 5% lifesteal for 3 seconds, and enemies take only 7.5% of Don-chan's magic attack as damage. Sonic Symphony has a long cooldown of 25 seconds, making it a high-risk, high-reward ultimate ability.
abilities.flavorQuote: Hear the music, feel the might!

abilities.name: Precision Performance
abilities.description: Don-chan's innate sense of rhythm allows for enhanced precision. The timing window for 'Don' and 'Ka' inputs is increased by 10%. Additionally, for every three successful 'Rhythm Resonance' sequences completed without error, Don-chan gains a stack of 'Perfect Pitch.' Each stack of 'Perfect Pitch' increases Don-chan's luck by 5, up to a maximum of 3 stacks. These stacks are lost if Don-chan fails a 'Rhythm Resonance' sequence. This passive rewards consistent, accurate play and encourages players to master the rhythmic input system for increased utility.
abilities.flavorQuote: Every beat counts!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Don-chan pairs well with damage-focused allies who benefit from increased attack damage and speed. His abilities provide both offensive and defensive support, making him a versatile addition to any team composition. character_v1.tierSummary: Don-Chan's rhythm-based kit offers a mix of healing, shielding, and damage. The Rhythm Resonance mechanic provides scaling and utility. His stats are decent. Stays at B but the KPS is readjusted to make sure it matches gameplay value.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Don-chan's abilities are designed to synergize by rewarding accurate rhythm inputs. The passive ability 'Drumbeat Dynamo' enhances allies after successful sequences, while 'Tempo Tantrum' can disrupt enemies, creating opportunities for allies to capitalize on the chaos. 'Precision Performance' makes all other abilities slightly easier to perform. 'Sonic Symphony' can both buff allies and debuff enemies at the same time if performed correctly.

Enemies struck by this barrage are seared with 'Frostbite', reducing their armor by 7% per stack, up to a maximum of 21% armor reduction. This chilling debuff persists for 3 seconds, leaving them vulnerable to further assaults. For each stack of 'Frostbite' applied, Frieza gains 2 stacks of 'Tyranny,' amplifying his cruel power. Frieza will prioritize enemies who have already been inflicted with any form of debuff. When Frieza is in his Golden Form, the Death Beams become empowered, inflicting additional true damage equal to 1% of the target's maximum health with each strike, bypassing all resistances and defenses. Furthermore, the duration of 'Frostbite' is extended by 1 second when Frieza is in Golden Form, amplifying the enemy's vulnerability under his golden gaze.

abilities.name: Death Comet Barrage
upgrades: Lv10: Increases the number of Death Comets launched, enhancing damage output and Ki Suppression application rate.
Lv50: Unlocks a secondary effect: 'Lingering Radiation.' Enemies affected by Ki Disruption also suffer a brief reduction in movement speed.

Lv100: Improves scaling, increases the maximum Ki Suppression stack cap, and adds a team-support interaction: Allies near the target gain a small increase in Ki regeneration while the target is under the effects of Ki Suppression.
abilities.description: Unleash a devastating volley of miniature, super-compressed energy spheres, each a shimmering testament to Frieza's refined cruelty and mastery over Ki manipulation. Instead of a singular strike, Frieza rapidly generates and launches a multitude of these 'Death Comets' at a single target with unnerving precision. These projectiles, rather than impacting simultaneously, strike in rapid succession over a brief period of roughly one and a half seconds, creating a localized zone of chaotic energy bombardment. Each comet deals a moderate amount of physical damage, scaling primarily with Frieza's ATK stat and benefitting from critical hit chance and damage modifiers. However, the true strength of Death Comet Barrage lies in its persistent debuff application. Each successful hit from a Death Comet applies a stack of 'Ki Suppression' to the target. Each stack reduces the target's Ki regeneration rate by a small percentage (stacking multiplicatively to a maximum cap). Upon reaching a certain number of Ki Suppression stacks, the target suffers a brief period of 'Ki Disruption,' significantly increasing the cooldown of their next ability cast. Therefore, Death Comet Barrage is not merely a damage tool, but a tactical instrument designed to disrupt enemy combos, limit their offensive capabilities, and starve them of resources within Frieza's controlled zone, leaving them vulnerable to follow-up attacks and further exploitation. It's a display of overwhelming force disguised as a seemingly simple barrage, epitomizing Frieza's approach to combat: calculated, relentless, and utterly demoralizing. This ability reflects the visual of a golden aura surrounding the hand as small purple orbs are created and fired. After a moment, the ability goes on a moderate cooldown.
abilities.flavorQuote: Such a dazzling display of destruction, isn't it? Pity you're on the receiving end.

abilities.name: Death Ball
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: Ability scaling improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Patch) Role realignment: This ability now emphasizes tank-style interactions.
abilities.description: Frieza focuses his ki, forming a swirling sphere of destructive energy for a tense 1.75 seconds, during which he remains vulnerable to interruption. Upon unleashing this 'Death Ball', a cataclysmic burst of magic damage erupts across a targeted area, obliterating all within its radius. For every two stacks of 'Oppression' Frieza has cultivated through tyrannical dominance, the Death Ball's potency surges by an additional 1%, scaling its devastation with his accumulated malice. Enemies unfortunate enough to be caught at the epicenter of the blast suffer an amplified 25% damage increase, as the concentrated energies tear through their defenses. Moreover, the force of the explosion sends these central targets flying backward a considerable distance, disrupting their formations and leaving them exposed. As a testament to its power, this ability is governed by a lengthy cooldown, demanding strategic deployment. However, should Frieza tap into his ultimate evolution, assuming his Golden Form, the Death Ball transcends its limitations. The casting time vanishes, becoming instantaneous, and the attack transcends conventional magic, dealing true damage equivalent to 10% of each target's current health, ensuring no foe escapes its wrath, in addition to the base magic damage.

abilities.name: My Golden Form!
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~17% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~41%).
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: When the measure of Frieza's dominance, represented by 100 stacks of Oppression, is full, he can unleash his ultimate evolution, declaring to the lesser beings that he will show them his 'Golden Form!' For 10 glorious seconds, Frieza transcends his previous limitations. Initially, the transformation grants Frieza a brief invulnerability, a shimmering golden aura protecting him from all harm for 1.5 seconds, a testament to his absolute power. In this radiant state, Frieza's attacks strike with increased ferocity, his attack damage soaring by 25%, demonstrating the true extent of his evolved strength. Moreover, during the Golden Form, each of Frieza's abilities are augmented with additional, devastating effects. However, such power comes at a price. As the Golden Form fades, Frieza's body is wracked with 'Exhaustion', his speed and attack damage reduced by 15% for 5 seconds, a humbling reminder of his mortal coil. This ability has a very long cooldown.

abilities.name: Oppressive Rule
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Oppressive Rule's reach diminished: Peak potency reduced by approximately 12%, with a slightly extended ramp-up time to achieve maximum effect.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~27%).
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~33%).
(Patch) Role realignment: this ability now emphasizes bruiser-style interactions.
abilities.description: Frieza's mere presence radiates an aura of Oppressive Rule, a testament to his absolute authority that bends the will of those who dare oppose him. Whenever Frieza afflicts an enemy champion with a debuff, be it the slightest slow, a petrifying stun, or any other form of impairment that dares to challenge his supremacy, he accumulates 6 stacks of 'Rule', symbolizing his ever-tightening grasp on the battlefield and the subjugation of his foes. Further showcasing his unparalleled might, Frieza's basic attacks possess a 30% chance to inflict 'Subjugation' upon his target. 'Subjugation' weakens the target, reducing their outgoing damage by a substantial 12% for a duration of 2.5 seconds, a period during which they are forced to endure the crushing weight of Frieza's power and reflect upon their insolence. This 'Subjugation' effect does not stack, ensuring that enemies are not completely annihilated, but rather serve as a constant reminder of Frieza's dominion. Each critical strike Frieza lands unleashes a surge of power, granting him 3 additional stacks of 'Rule', reflecting his ability to exploit weakness and amplify his control. To solidify his unwavering reign, Frieza gains increased tenacity based on his stacks of 'Rule'. For every 6 stacks he accumulates, his tenacity is increased by 1.25%, with a maximum possible increase of 12.5% tenacity, representing his indomitable will and the futility of resistance against his tyrannical reign.

character_v1.playstyle: Punishing aggressors and controlling space through debuffs and calculated bursts of power with Golden Frieza transformation.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Frieza synergizes well with team compositions that can amplify his zone control or provide crowd control to set up his Planet Crushing Ball. Allies that can apply additional debuffs or peel for him during the Exhaustion phase after Golden Form are highly beneficial. Frieza also benefits from allies who can capitalize on the increased damage vulnerability inflicted by his 'Fragile' debuff during his Golden form.
character_v1.tierSummary: Frieza lands at B- due to his mix of damage and debuffs, specifically armor reduction. 'My Golden Form!' provides invulnerability, but the reliance on transformation and somewhat inconsistent scaling limits his overall impact. Moderate KPS due to burst windows.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Frieza's kit revolves around building Oppression stacks quickly through debuffs and damage. The core gameplay loop involves using Death Beam Barrage and Emperor's Pressure to debuff enemies, generating Oppression, and then unleashing the Planet Crushing Ball for significant damage. Golden Tyrant provides a temporary window for enhanced damage output and invulnerability, rewarding aggressive plays and punishing enemies who engage him during this phase.

character_v1.playstyle: Knuckles is a bruiser focused on dealing consistent damage and disrupting the enemy team with physical attacks. His Guardian Stance passive makes him more resilient as he takes damage, allowing him to stay in the fight longer and protect his allies.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Knuckles benefits from allies who can provide healing or further crowd control, allowing him to stay in the fight longer and maximize his damage output. Allies that benefit from a strong frontline presence synergize well with Knuckles.
character_v1.tierSummary: Knuckles struggles with inconsistent damage output and a reliance on status effects that are often unreliable. Lacks the sustained damage necessary for higher tier play, landing him in F-. Low KPS reflects overall lack of impact.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Knuckles' kit revolves around his ability to disrupt enemies with punches and digging, while his Guardian Stance and Echidna Resilience increase his survivability, making him more dangerous as he takes damage. Angel Island Avalanche benefits from Knuckles being in the middle of a fight.

abilities.name: Swords Out: Piercing Barrage
upgrades: Level 25: Increases the number of summoned swords to 4.
Level 75: Swords Out consumes 15% of current ammo. Summoned swords now inflict a stacking bleed effect dealing 2% of the target's max HP as true damage over 3 seconds.
Level 125: The cooldown reduction per Blade Heart stack is increased to 0.15 seconds. When Swords Out is activated, Tao gains 10% evasion for 3 seconds.
Level 175: Swords Out consumes 20% of current ammo, summoning 5 swords. If the target is marked by Fatal Bloom, the swords deal 20% bonus damage.

Level 200: Swords Out now consumes all current ammo to summon swords, capped at 8 swords. If the swords generate a shield, the shield duration is increased to 5 seconds, and any damage absorbed is converted into Blade Heart stacks, up to a maximum of 10 stacks.
abilities.description: Tao summons a barrage of spectral flying swords that autonomously strike nearby enemies. Upon activation, Tao consumes 10% of her current ammo, summoning 3 swords that each deal X physical damage to the nearest enemy within 10 meters, prioritizing enemies marked by Fatal Bloom. Each sword homes in on its target, dealing damage three times in rapid succession. The damage scales with her attack stat and is further increased by 3% per stack of Blade Heart, up to a maximum of 50 stacks. Swords Out has a cooldown of 10 seconds, which is reduced by 0.05 seconds for each Blade Heart stack consumed upon activation. If no enemies are within range, the swords orbit Tao, providing a shield equal to 7% of her max HP, decaying over 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Fatal Bloom: Lingering Wound
upgrades: Level 30: Increases the base magic damage by 25%.
Level 80: Fatal Bloom now also reduces the target's healing received by 10% per stack of Lingering Wound.
Level 130: The cooldown reduction per Blade Heart stack is increased to 0.3 seconds. Fatal Bloom's mark now lasts 7 seconds.
Level 180: When a target reaches 5 stacks of Lingering Wound, Tao gains a stack of Blade Heart.
Level 200: Fully stacked Lingering Wound now also applies a 2 second Silence to the target.
abilities.description: Tao throws a spectral bloom that marks a single target within 15 meters, inflicting a stacking debuff. The initial mark deals X magic damage and applies 'Lingering Wound', causing the target to take 2% increased damage from all sources for 5 seconds. This debuff can stack up to 5 times, increasing the damage taken to 10%. The mark also amplifies the effectiveness of Swords Out, causing the swords to prioritize the marked target. If the target is already marked, the duration is refreshed and an additional stack is added if possible. Fatal Bloom has a cooldown of 8 seconds, which is reduced by 0.1 seconds for each Blade Heart stack. Activating Fatal Bloom consumes 3 Blade Heart stacks, granting Tao 5% increased movement speed for 2 seconds upon successful application of the mark.

abilities.name: Blade Heart Resonance: Measured Response
upgrades: Level 40: Blade Heart stacks now also grant 0.5% increased movement speed, up to a maximum of 25%.
Level 90: Reduces the required ammo consumption to gain a stack of Blade Heart to 4%.
Level 140: Blade Heart Resonance now also grants Tao a 20% critical hit chance for 5 seconds.
Level 190: The maximum Blade Heart stacks are increased to 75, increasing the maximum bonus attack and magic attack to 75%.
Level 200: Blade Heart Resonance now provides immunity to crowd control effects for the duration of its effect.
abilities.description: Tao gains a stack of Blade Heart for every 5% of her magazine capacity consumed by her weapon attacks. Each stack of Blade Heart grants 0.75% increased attack and magic attack, up to a maximum of 50 stacks. When Tao reaches the maximum number of stacks, she gains 'Blade Heart Resonance', causing her next Swords Out to consume all Blade Heart stacks and deal an additional 0.5% true damage per stack consumed, as well as granting 0.5% damage reduction per stack consumed for 2 seconds. Additionally, each Blade Heart stack grants Tao 1% increased shield regeneration rate, up to a maximum of 50%. This passive encourages an aggressive playstyle, rewarding high ammo consumption with increased damage and survivability, allowing Tao to maintain consistent pressure on her enemies.

abilities.name: Blade Heart Tempest: Focused Barrage
upgrades: Level 125: Extends the duration of Blade Heart Tempest to 12 seconds.
Level 150: The damage dealt at the end of Blade Heart Tempest is increased by 30%.
Level 175: During Blade Heart Tempest, Tao gains 20% increased attack and magic attack.
Level 200: Upon activation, Blade Heart Tempest cleanses all debuffs from Tao and grants her immunity to new debuffs for the duration.
abilities.description: Tao focuses her energy, unleashing a concentrated barrage for 8 seconds. During this time, the cost of Swords Out is reduced to 7% current ammo, and the cooldown is reduced by 30%. Additionally, Fatal Bloom’s damage amplification is increased to 3% per stack of Lingering Wound. Activating Blade Heart Tempest consumes all current Blade Heart stacks, granting Tao a shield equal to 0.75% of her maximum HP per stack consumed, lasting for the duration of the ultimate. At the end of the ultimate, Tao releases a final surge of energy, dealing X magic damage to all enemies within 15 meters, scaling with the number of Blade Heart stacks consumed during the ultimate's activation. This ultimate provides Tao with increased sustain and damage, enhancing her role as a resilient assassin capable of trading blows effectively, but at a reduced rate.

character_v1.playstyle: Tao is designed as a high-risk, high-reward assassin that uses ammo consumption to power up her abilities and deliver devastating burst damage. Her kit revolves around stacking Blade Heart through aggressive play, then capitalizing on those stacks to enhance her Swords Out and Fatal Bloom skills. This requires precise timing and resource management to maximize her effectiveness in combat.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Tao excels in teams that can provide sustained damage and crowd control, allowing her to focus on eliminating high-priority targets. Allies that can buff her attack and magic attack further amplify her burst potential, while those that can provide shields can help her maintain Blade Heart stacks more consistently.
character_v1.tierSummary: Tao's extreme attack stat and speed places him firmly in A tier, especially given his single target burst potential. He lacks consistent AOE, hindering his ability to clear content as quickly. KPS adjusted to reflect vulnerability.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Tao's abilities are heavily intertwined through the Blade Heart mechanic. Consuming ammo feeds into Blade Heart stacks, which amplify her damage output with Swords Out and Fatal Bloom. The ultimate provides an explosive release of her accumulated Blade Heart, incentivizing aggressive play and resource management.

character_v1.playstyle: Crown Prince is designed as a utility-focused character who excels at enabling elemental damage for his team. While he can deal damage himself, his primary function is to apply Decay and other elemental statuses, amplifying the damage output of allies who can capitalize on these effects.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Crown Prince excels in teams that can capitalize on elemental effects. His ability to apply Decay, Corrosion, and other elemental statuses makes him a valuable asset to any team composition that includes characters with elemental damage or abilities that synergize with status effects. The increased damage vulnerability from Spirit Realm Purification benefits the entire team, allowing for coordinated bursts of damage.
character_v1.tierSummary: Crown Prince occupies the C tier due to his AOE damage and elemental infusion abilities. His utility is decent, but lacks the raw power to consistently perform at a higher level. KPS reflects mid-tier performance.
character_v1.internalSynergy: The kit revolves around applying multiple elemental effects to enemies using Energy Orb Barrage and Smoke Grenade Deployment, which then synergizes with Elemental Attunement to increase Crown Prince's damage output. Spirit Realm Purification serves as a powerful ultimate, applying all elemental effects and significantly increasing damage vulnerability, setting up enemies for massive burst damage from Crown Prince and his team.
