character_v1.playstyle: Li's kit heavily emphasizes applying and benefiting from the 'Burning' status effect, allowing her to serve as a Fire-damage-focused bruiser. She can apply consistent pressure with 'Blazing Meteor' and deal burst damage with 'Spiritual Flame,' while 'Flame Talisman' provides survivability, making her effective at disrupting enemy formations and sustaining damage.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Li synergizes well with other fire-based characters who can consistently apply 'Burning' to enemies, allowing her to quickly build 'Scorched Earth' stacks and maximize her damage output. Characters that can group enemies together also enhance the effectiveness of 'Blazing Meteor' and 'Crimson Nova'.
character_v1.tierSummary: Li's strong defensive capabilities, combined with the high HP pool, make him a solid A+ tier. The consistent shield generation, combined with a moderate damage output, provides excellent sustain. KPS is high because of survivability.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Li's kit revolves around building and maintaining 'Scorched Earth' stacks by applying 'Burning' to enemies, which then empowers her 'Spiritual Flame' and 'Blazing Meteor' abilities. 'Flame Talisman' offers defensive utility by consuming stacks for damage reduction, while 'Crimson Nova' expends all stacks for a burst of damage and self-buffs, creating a risk-reward playstyle.

abilities.description: Richard, with a barely perceptible shift in his stoic expression, designates a target area for a concentrated bombardment of LEGO studs. These hard plastic projectiles descend upon the marked zone, dealing a total of 80 magic damage, enhanced by 60% of Richard's magic attack power, to any unfortunate enemies caught within the circular zone over a duration of 3 seconds. The area targeted is intelligently selected, prioritizing locations where enemy presence is most dense, ensuring maximum impact. The damage unfolds in a series of rapid ticks, granting enemies fleeting moments to evade the full brunt of the stud storm. Should Richard possess a Royal Decree exceeding 50, the studs are imbued with a binding adhesive, inflicting 'Bricked' upon impact, hindering enemy movement by reducing their speed by 25% for 2 seconds, simulating the frustrating experience of stepping on a LEGO brick. Furthermore, each activation of Stud Barrage replenishes Richard's strategic reserves, granting him 10 Royal Decree. This ability operates on a 10-second cooldown, allowing for calculated deployment in the heat of battle.

upgrades: Level 30: Shield potency increased to 20% of Richard's max HP.

abilities.description: Richard, with a world-weary sigh, proclaims a dryly worded Royal Decree, bolstering the ally currently struggling the most. He bestows upon this ally a protective shield, absorbing damage equal to 15% of Richard's maximum health for a duration of 4 seconds. This decree echoes with the authority of Unikingdom, provided Richard's Royal Decree is high enough; if Richard currently possesses more than 50 Royal Decree, the shielded ally also benefits from a 15% increase in their attack power for the shield's duration. This ability operates on a 12-second cooldown. The shield's effectiveness diminishes gradually, decaying by 25% of its original value each second. Only one Royal Decree shield can be active on an ally at any given time; should a new shield be applied, it overwrites the previous one. The sheer monotony of Richard's decree is strangely distracting, causing enemies to momentarily falter, granting all allies a 5% evasion buff for 2 seconds following the shield's application. Furthermore, the act of proclaiming the decree grants Richard 15 Royal Decree.

abilities.name: Bureaucratic Bulwark
upgrades: Level 40: Extends the bureaucratic reach, increasing the aura's radius to 600 units.
Level 90: Allies within the aura also benefit from increased resilience, gaining 5 tenacity.

abilities.description: Richard's dedication to procedure emanates as a tangible field of order. Allies within a 500-unit radius are fortified by his steadfast presence, gaining 10 bonus Def plus an additional amount equal to 5% of Richard's own Def. This resilient aura is further amplified by Richard's accumulated Royal Decrees; for every 20 Royal Decrees he possesses, the aura's Def enhancement is augmented by an additional 2%. This protective field persists as long as Richard remains an active presence on the battlefield, ensuring a steady stream of defense. Every second, a precise audit is conducted, recalculating and reapplying the defensive bonus to all affected allies, adapting in real-time to any changes in Richard's Royal Decrees or defensive stats. This effect is particularly valuable in extended conflicts, offering unwavering resistance against encroaching threats and granting a strategic edge in prolonged engagements.

abilities.description: Richard channels his accumulated Royal Decree to create a 'Time-Out Corner' at a target location, lasting 5 seconds. Allies within the area gain 'Orderly Focus', increasing their atk speed by 25% and reducing their cooldowns by 10%. The area of effect is a large square. This ability has a 90-second cooldown. Richard consumes all Royal Decree upon casting this ability. Enemies and allies entering or exiting the area are immediately affected by the respective status effects. The Time-Out Corner provides a significant advantage in team fights, disrupting enemy formations and empowering allies.

abilities.description: Richard's experience as a Royal Advisor has made him incredibly resilient. Richard gains 20 tenacity and 5% evasion. Additionally, whenever an ally within 500 units of Richard is inflicted with a negative status effect, Richard gains 5 Royal Decree. This can occur up to once every 3 seconds per ally. Richard's role as a protector of his allies is emphasized by his increased tenacity and evasion, making him difficult to control and providing him with a means to accumulate Royal Decree in response to enemy actions. The tenacity and evasion buffs are always active.

character_v1.playstyle: Richard excels at providing utility and control by buffing allies with 'Rules' and hindering enemies with 'Chores'. His kit revolves around managing Royal Decree to enhance his support capabilities and maintain order on the battlefield, embodying his role as Unikitty's royal advisor.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Richard synergizes well with teams that benefit from atk speed buffs and defensive support. His shields and Def aura provide crucial protection, while his debuffs can disrupt enemy formations and reduce their damage output. He is particularly effective with damage-focused allies who can capitalize on the increased atk speed provided by his ultimate.
character_v1.tierSummary: Richard's 'Royal Decree' abilities provide utility, but his low damage output and reliance on support role places him in D-. He struggles to contribute meaningfully outside of specific team compositions. KPS is low due to lack of offensive capabilities.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Richard's kit synergizes around managing Royal Decree, which enhances his abilities to either buff allies or debuff enemies. His passive ability to gain Royal Decree when allies are affected by negative status effects allows him to consistently empower his abilities. His ultimate consumes Royal Decree to create a powerful zoning effect, further amplifying his support capabilities.

abilities.description: Frantic Flourish is a spectacle of accidental tanking. Upon activation, Tom initiates a series of exaggerated, seemingly panicked movements—a chaotic dance designed to both protect allies and disrupt enemies. During the Flourish, Tom's evasion stat receives a significant boost, allowing him to dodge incoming attacks with surprising (and wholly unintentional) grace. More than that, the sheer unpredictability of Tom's Flourish applies the 'Distracted' debuff, reducing the target's damage output and focus. Visually, expect flailing limbs, cartoonish dust clouds, and perhaps even a misplaced piano key or two. The duration of the evasion buff and the effectiveness of the distraction status is calculated through scaling factors tied to Tom's DEF and HP, improving its overall utility as the character grows.
abilities.flavorQuote: I'm not panicking, you're panicking!

Additionally, for every stack of 'Cartoon Physics' he has, Tom gains 5 additional tenacity, allowing him to resist crowd control effects more effectively. This tenacity bonus is calculated before other tenacity modifiers. When Tom reaches max stacks of frenzy, he lets out a howl, taunting nearby enemies for 1 second.

abilities.description: Tom spends 2 seconds building a complex Rube Goldberg machine. During this time, he's immune to crowd control but takes 25% increased damage. Once completed, the machine triggers a chain reaction of cartoonish events over 8 seconds. For the first 3 seconds, random projectiles (hammers, anvils, pies) rain down in a large area (500 units), dealing 50 + (0.1 * X) magic damage per hit (max 5 hits per enemy). Then, a giant magnet activates for 2 seconds, pulling enemies towards the center. Finally, a massive explosion occurs, dealing 300 + (0.6 * X) magic damage in the center and knocking enemies upwards. If Tom has max stacks of 'Cartoon Physics' when activating this ability, the machine also dispenses a random buff to allies within the rain zone, either granting a 25% damage boost or a 20% movement speed increase for 5 seconds.

abilities.name: Cartoon Resilience: The Slapstick Savior
upgrades: Level 45: Bonus Def increased to 75, and Magic Def increased to 45.
Level 95: Movement speed during 'Cartoon Recovery' increased to 35%.
Level 145: 'Cartoon Recovery' cooldown reduced to 45 seconds base. The tenacity is tripled instead of doubled
Level 195: 'Cartoon Recovery' now also cleanses all negative status effects from Tom.
abilities.description: Tom's inherent cartoon logic grants him increased durability. He gains 50 bonus Def and 30 bonus Magic Def. Furthermore, when Tom's HP drops below 20%, he triggers 'Cartoon Recovery'. During 'Cartoon Recovery', Tom becomes invulnerable for 1 second, gains 25% increased movement speed, and his tenacity is doubled. This effect has a 60-second cooldown. For each stack of 'Cartoon Physics' Tom possesses at the time 'Cartoon Recovery' triggers, the invulnerability duration is increased by 0.2 seconds, and the cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds. Also, he gains 10 base tenacity.

character_v1.playstyle: Tom is a disruptive tank who thrives in the middle of chaos, using his cartoonish resilience to draw enemy fire and set up opportunities for his team. He's best played aggressively, constantly moving and forcing enemies to react to his unpredictable antics.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Tom excels at disrupting enemy formations and providing temporary openings for his team. He pairs well with damage dealers who can capitalize on his knockbacks and stuns, as well as supports who can keep him alive while he accumulates 'Cartoon Physics' stacks.
character_v1.tierSummary: Tom's kit has moderate utility and a good mix of defensive and offensive capabilities, but lacks burst damage or consistent scaling to justify a B-tier. Bump to C+ to populate mid-tier.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Tom's kit is designed to synergize around 'Cartoon Physics'. Getting hit empowers his Mallet Mayhem, strengthens his traps, and enhances his ultimate. The passive provides sustain and escape, while the ultimate provides high-impact AoE disruption.

abilities.description: Jerry unleashes a chaotic flurry of distractions, targeting a large area around him. Allies within the area gain 20% increased speed and 10% increased damage. This ability has a long cooldown of 90 seconds. Prioritize using Mouse Mayhem in the middle of team fights to maximize disruption and buff potential. The speed buff stacks multiplicatively with Jerry's passive. abilities.name: Unseen Agility: Mouse Reflexes and Tenacity
upgrades: Level 85: Increases evasion bonus to 35 and tenacity bonus to 25.

Level 185: The free 'Spring-Loaded Surprise' trap placement effect duration increases to 7 seconds.
Level 200: Jerry's tenacity reduces damage taken from status effects by an additional 10%.
abilities.description: Jerry's inherent agility grants him a permanent increase of 25 to his base evasion and 15 to his base tenacity stats, making him harder to hit and more resistant to crowd control effects. Whenever Jerry successfully evades an attack, his next 'Spring-Loaded Surprise' trap placement is instant and costs no mana/energy. This effect lasts for 5 seconds. This ability directly improves Jerry's survivability and ability to chain traps, allowing him to maintain battlefield control more effectively. Prioritize building additional tenacity to further reduce the duration of crowd control effects. Note that the free trap placement does not stack.

character_v1.playstyle: Jerry is designed as a versatile utility character, focusing on battlefield control, item manipulation, and opportunistic disruption. He uses traps and acquired items to hinder enemies and empower allies, requiring careful planning and resource management.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Jerry excels in teams that can capitalize on enemy displacement and crowd control. His traps and items can set up opportunities for burst damage dealers, while his ultimate ability can disrupt enemy formations and provide buffs to allies, enhancing overall team effectiveness.
character_v1.tierSummary: Jerry's kit relies heavily on traps and utility, but his low stats and reliance on setup make him unreliable. Move him from F+ to D- to increase lower tier presence.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Jerry's kit is designed around trap placement and item usage. The passive ability provides a continuous source of items, which can then be used with the active ability. The ultimate ability provides a wide-area distraction, creating opportunities for trap placement and item usage.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Jerry, the master of traps and trickery, finds an unlikely ally in Tom, the dedicated but often outsmarted cat. Their initial animosity gives way to a grudging respect as they face a common enemy threatening their home.

Level 175: If Kakashi is reduced to below 20% of his max hp he will automatically use one copy charge to shield himself for 10% of his max hp for 4 seconds (can only occur once every 20 seconds).
Level 200: Kakashi permanently has 5 additional tenacity, regardless of Jutsu types copied.
abilities.description: Kakashi, the copy ninja, gains 3% evasion for every unique Jutsu type he has copied through 'Copy Wheel Eye' during the match, up to a maximum of 15%. Furthermore, if Kakashi has any copy charges when he is inflicted with a stun, slow or burn, he will consume one charge to reduce its duration by 20%. The accumulated wealth of copied techniques grants Kakashi increased resilience and adaptability in combat. The Jutsu Types are defined as: Fire Release, Water Release, Earth Release, Wind Release, Lightning Release, Physical Enhancements, Genjutsu, Healing, Summons. The use of Kamui does not grant a unique Jutsu type. At the start of each match, Kakashi immediately starts with one Jutsu Type copied.

character_v1.playstyle: Kakashi is a versatile Adaptive Specialist, excelling at disrupting enemy formations and copying key enemy abilities to turn the tide of battle. He thrives in prolonged engagements, gaining power as he analyzes his opponents and adapts his strategies.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Kakashi synergizes well with teams that can capitalize on his area control and disruptions. Allies that can deal high burst damage or follow up on slowed or sealed targets benefit greatly from his kit. His team buff also aids in prolonged fights.
character_v1.tierSummary: Kakashi has a versatile kit with good scaling and utility. The combination of damage, control, and passive buffs justifies moving him to B to flatten distribution.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Kakashi's kit revolves around building up Copy Charges to empower his ninjutsu. The passive grants a strong sense of adaptability, while Kamui Raid offers burst damage and disruption. The signature passive reinforces his role as a resilient and adaptive combatant.

chapters.title: Shadows of Intrigue
chapters.mission: Kakashi and Shikamaru must infiltrate a hidden enemy base, using their combined jutsu and strategic planning to gather evidence of the conspiracy.
chapters.summary: Kakashi notices inconsistencies in recent mission reports, prompting him to investigate with Shikamaru. Their analysis reveals a pattern of deliberate misinformation.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Kakashi, ever the strategist, finds himself partnered with Shikamaru Nara, a fellow intellect. Their combined tactical prowess and strategic thinking lead them to uncovering a hidden conspiracy threatening Konoha.

character_v1.name: Sasuke Uchiha

abilities.description: Sasuke kneads chakra within his body and converts it to fire, before expelling it from his mouth in a large sphere of flames. The area remains covered in flames for 4 seconds, dealing additional magic damage equal to 0.1 * magic atk per second to enemies inside. If an enemy is afflicted by 'Electrified', Gōkakyū no Jutsu deals 20% increased damage. Upon hitting at least one enemy, Sasuke gains one stack of 'Sharingan Insight'. Each stack of Sharingan Insight grants 5% increased critical hit chance and 3% increased damage against enemies afflicted with a status effect. Additionally, when an enemy is afflicted with Electrified or Burn, Sasuke gains 3% increased Evasion for 5 seconds. At 3 stacks of Sharingan Insight, Sasuke's next basic attack will critically strike.

abilities.name: Kirin: Lightning Blade of Divine Judgement
upgrades: Level 150: Reduces Kirin's cooldown to 75 seconds.

abilities.description: Sasuke manipulates the natural lightning in the atmosphere, channeling it into a concentrated strike. Sasuke calls down a massive bolt of lightning on a target area, dealing magic damage equal to X + (1.2 * magic atk) to all enemies within. Enemies afflicted with 'Electrified' take 50% increased damage from this ability and are stunned for 1.5 seconds. After Kirin is cast, Sasuke's next ability has no cooldown, reflecting Sasuke's decisive follow-up attacks. This ability has a long cooldown of 90 seconds.

abilities.name: Indra's Arrow: The Pinnacle of Uchiha Power
upgrades: Level 175: Increase Tenacity to 20% and Evasion to 15%.
Level 200: Landing a Critical Strike extends the duration of Indra's Charge by 1 second, up to a maximum of 10 seconds total.
abilities.description: Sasuke's mastery over chakra and the Sharingan allows him to achieve unparalleled feats. Sasuke gains 15% Tenacity and 10% Evasion. Furthermore, whenever Sasuke reaches 3 stacks of Sharingan Insight, he gains the 'Indra's Charge' buff for 7 seconds. While Indra's Charge is active, Sasuke's critical hits deal 50% increased damage. If Sasuke lands 5 critical hits during 'Indra's Charge', this bonus damage becomes 100% for the remaining duration.

character_v1.playstyle: Sasuke is a damage dealer, focusing on burst damage and zone control through Ninjutsu. His 'Sharingan Insight' mechanic rewards tactical ability usage and target prioritization, amplifying his damage output against key enemies.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Sasuke benefits from team compositions that can apply additional status effects, allowing him to capitalize on his damage bonus. Characters who can provide crowd control or additional damage amplification synergize well with his high burst potential.
character_v1.tierSummary: Sasuke's high attack is offset by low survivability and reliance on specific conditions. Repositioning from F+ to D reflects this trade-off and distributes roster better.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Sasuke's kit revolves around applying and capitalizing on status effects, particularly 'Electrified'. Chidori and Gokakyu interact directly, and his passive significantly boosts his damage when status effects are present. The ultimate acts as both burst and setup, ensuring the passive reaches its full potential.

chapters.title: Tailed Beast Harmony
chapters.mission: Sasuke and Bee must spar extensively, pushing each other to their limits to unlock new levels of control over their respective powers.
chapters.summary: Sasuke seeks Killer Bee's guidance in controlling his Sharingan's power. Bee agrees, seeing an opportunity to understand the Uchiha's motivations.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Sasuke, consumed by his quest for power, grudgingly teams up with Killer Bee. Their contrasting personalities clash, but their shared goal of mastering their unique abilities forces them to cooperate.

character_v1.name: Buttercup

abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Fire.

abilities.name: Black Hurricane Strike
upgrades: Level 50: Increases the number of hits to 4.
Level 100: Increases maximum Rage Stacks to 4.
Level 150: Reduces cooldown by 1 second.
Level 200: Each hit applies a bleed effect for 3 seconds, dealing X% of attack damage per second.
abilities.description: Buttercup unleashes a rapid flurry of punches in a cone in front of her, dealing physical damage to all enemies hit. Each enemy hit grants her 1 Rage Stack, up to a maximum of 3 stacks. Black Hurricane Strike deals X physical damage per hit, striking 3 times. Rage Stacks last for 5 seconds. This ability has a cooldown of 8 seconds.

abilities.name: Rolling Riot
upgrades: Lv10: Increases the distance traveled and Fury generated.
Lv50: Adds a brief stun to the final shockwave.
Lv100: Grants a temporary damage boost to Buttercup upon completing the roll and hitting at least one enemy.
abilities.description: Buttercup channels her unparalleled fury into a devastating whirlwind of motion, becoming a nigh-unstoppable force of pure, green-tinged aggression! Upon activation, Buttercup rapidly transforms into a tightly coiled, emerald blur and launches herself forward a moderate distance, leaving a shimmering green afterimage in her wake. During this period of frenzied motion, she becomes momentarily immune to crowd control effects, shrugging off attempts to impede her destructive path with a contemptuous snarl. Any enemy foolish enough to stand in her way is subjected to a relentless barrage of bone-jarring impacts, each strike dealing a calculated amount of physical damage that scales multiplicatively with Buttercup's raw ATK and her current Fury level. Moreover, each successful hit has a chance to inflict a short-duration stacking debuff which lowers their total defense, making them increasingly vulnerable to subsequent attacks. At the end of the roll, or upon colliding with an unyielding obstacle, Buttercup erupts from her green shell, unleashing a concussive shockwave that knocks back nearby enemies. This ability also generates a modest amount of Fury, fueling her other abilities and amplifying her overall combat prowess, embodying her signature impetuousness and sheer, unadulterated power. But beware, this move leaves her briefly vulnerable at the tail end!
abilities.flavorQuote: Try and stop me, I dare you!

abilities.name: Toughest Fighter's Tenacity
upgrades: Level 50: Increases defense gained per Rage Stack by X.
Level 100: Increases tenacity gained per Rage Stack by X.
Level 150: When at maximum Rage Stacks, Buttercup gains X% damage reduction.
Level 200: When taking damage above X% of her max hp, Buttercup gains a Rage Stack.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~8% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Buttercup gains increased defense and tenacity based on her current Rage Stacks. For each Rage Stack, she gains X defense and X tenacity. This passive reinforces her role as a bruiser, allowing her to withstand more damage as she builds aggression. With no Rage Stacks, Buttercup gains no bonus defense or tenacity. This passive is constantly active, adjusting dynamically as Rage Stacks are gained or lost.

abilities.name: Ball Blast: Unbridled Fury
upgrades: Level 100: Reduces charge time to 1 second.
Level 150: Increases damage amplification per Rage Stack to X%.
Level 200: After casting, Buttercup's next Black Hurricane Strike is instantly available and deals X% increased damage.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Buttercup charges up and unleashes a massive energy ball that deals heavy physical damage to all enemies in a large area. The charge time is 1.5 seconds. While charging, she gains damage reduction equal to X. For each Rage Stack, the damage of Ball Blast is increased by X%. Ball Blast deals X physical damage. After casting, she clears all Rage Stacks. This ability has a cooldown of 60 seconds.

abilities.name: Spice-Fueled Reflexes
upgrades: Level 50: Increase base evasion by X%.
Level 100: Increase base attack speed by X%.

Upon reaching 3 Rage Stacks, her evasion chance is increased by an additional X% for the duration of the stacks. Her attacks also have X% chance to ignore enemy defense.

character_v1.playstyle: Buttercup is a bruiser focused on dealing burst damage through Rage Stacks. The kit provides tools to quickly engage enemies and maintain aggression, rewarding consistent offense with increased power.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Buttercup benefits from teammates who can provide crowd control to keep enemies within range of Black Hurricane Strike, or those who can buff her damage output to further amplify her burst potential.
character_v1.tierSummary: Buttercup's raw damage, speed and rage synergy can carry games. A small bump up to A balances the character spread to flatten roster.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Buttercup's kit synergizes around building and consuming Rage Stacks. Black Hurricane Strike quickly generates stacks, while Green Laser Beam Barrage and Ball Blast consume them for amplified damage. Toughest Fighter's Tenacity provides survivability as she builds Rage.

chapters.title: Sisterly Synergy
chapters.mission: Buttercup must complete a series of training exercises designed by Blossom, focusing on controlled bursts of power and strategic maneuvers.
chapters.summary: Buttercup feels her attacks lack precision. Blossom offers to help, guiding Buttercup to channel her rage more effectively.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Buttercup, always eager for a fight, forms a bond with Blossom, finding a balance to her raw power through Blossom's strategic intellect. Together, they hone their fighting skills to new heights.

Additionally, enemies hit are afflicted with 'Entangled' for 2 seconds. 'Entangled' reduces attack speed by 20%. If Skulker has the 'Suppression Module' equipped via Hunter's Arsenal, Entangled also reduces magic attack by 20%. This ability has a cooldown of 10 seconds. The cone area widens as Skulker levels up.

abilities.name: Spectral Static
upgrades: Lv10: Increases the damage radius of Static Shock and moderately increases the number of projectiles that will be resisted.
Lv50: Unlocks a secondary effect; Static Shock now applies a brief energy drain on hit.
Lv100: Improves damage scaling and allies within range are granted a small percentage of Skulker's damage reduction.
abilities.description: Spectral Static—a passive ability that reflects Skulker's aptitude for manipulating ethereal energies. It causes his very presence to emanate a localized field of disruptive energy, clinging to enemies like spectral grime. Specifically, each time Skulker is struck by a melee attack, he passively afflicts the attacker with a stack of 'Static Cling'—an invisible debuff that accumulates until a threshold is reached. Once an enemy accumulates three stacks of 'Static Cling', they are subjected to a brief 'Static Shock'. This shock inflicts a small burst of AoE damage around the afflicted enemy. This field of static is not only an offensive measure but also a defensive one, subtly disrupting incoming projectiles and reducing their impact. In addition, Skulker gains passive damage reduction against ranged attacks, reflecting his resilience in the face of technological assault. The energy manifests visually as flickering green sparks emanating from Skulker's armor, intensifying with each stack of 'Static Cling' applied to an enemy.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Feel that tingle? It's your system crashing."

abilities.name: Ghostly Upgrade 9.9
upgrades: Level 150: Fusion duration extended to 20 seconds, giving you more time to capitalize on Ghostly Upgrade 9.9's enhanced abilities.
Level 180: Overload stun duration increased to 1.5 seconds, giving Skulker's team more time to punish opponents caught in the energy surge.

Level 200: While fused, Skulker gains immunity to crowd control effects, becoming an unstoppable force on the battlefield. If the form is lost prematurely, Skulker gains a 500 + (0.3*X) shield for 5 seconds, mitigating the immediate vulnerability of reverting to base form, where X represents Skulker's current level.
abilities.description: Skulker overrides his ecto-skeleton with Technus' advanced technology, becoming the Ghostly Upgrade 9.9 for 15 seconds. While upgraded, Skulker's raw power surges, granting him 30% bonus HP and a 20% increase to both attack and magic attack, amplifying his combat potential. Every basic attack during this fusion applies a stack of 'Overload' to the target. Once a target accumulates 3 stacks of Overload, they are momentarily stunned for 1 second by the overwhelming energy. Each of Skulker's auto attacks also deals an additional 50 plus (0.1 * X) bonus magic damage, further electrifying the battlefield with each strike, where X represents Skulker's current level. Furthermore, while fused, Skulker's tactical options are enhanced: Spectral Trap Launcher now deploys not one, but three spectral traps in a tight cone, increasing zone denial capabilities. Ecto-Net Barrage's range and cone angle are doubled, effectively ensnaring a wider area in spectral nets. However, this powerful fusion is not without its risks. If Skulker's health plummets below 25% while fused, the form destabilizes, and the upgrade is lost, forcing Skulker to revert to his base form. Ghostly Upgrade 9.9 has a cooldown of 90 seconds.

abilities.name: Tech-Enhanced Tenacity
upgrades: Level 130: Evasion increased to 15%.
Level 170: Each stack of Adaptive Protocols also grants 2% increased healing received from all sources, up to a maximum of 10%.

Level 200: Upon reaching 5 stacks of Adaptive Protocols, Skulker emits a pulse of energy, healing himself and nearby allies for 5% of their maximum health. This heal can only occur once every 10 seconds.
abilities.description: Skulker's cybernetic enhancements and relentless focus grant him resilience and elusive maneuvering. He starts with 25 tenacity, mitigating the duration of incoming crowd control effects, and enjoys a 10% evasion chance, allowing him to nimbly dodge incoming attacks. Each time Skulker successfully inflicts a crowd control effect (such as a stun, snare, or silence) on an enemy, he gains one stack of 'Adaptive Protocols', up to a maximum of five stacks. Each stack of Adaptive Protocols bolsters Skulker's defensive capabilities, granting a 3% damage reduction against all incoming damage sources, capping at a 15% total reduction. This potent combination of tenacity, evasion, and damage reduction significantly increases Skulker's survivability. However, to maintain optimal efficiency, the Adaptive Protocols gradually recalibrate: stacks decay one at a time every 5 seconds, forcing Skulker to consistently apply crowd control to maintain his defensive edge.

character_v1.playstyle: Skulker is a tank who uses his zone control abilities and traps to lock down areas and disrupt enemies, protecting his team. His adaptability through Hunter's Arsenal allows him to tailor his defense.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Skulker synergizes well with damage dealers who can capitalize on his crowd control, and benefits from supports who can keep him alive while he sets up his zones.
character_v1.tierSummary: Skulker's zoning, debuffs, and transformation provide significant utility. Keeping him at B+ accurately reflects his overall strength and helps with roster distribution.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Skulker's kit revolves around setting up zones with Spectral Trap Launcher and Ecto-Net Barrage. Hunter's Adaptation allows him to tailor his kit to be more tanky or disruptive. SkulTech 9.9 provides a powerful offensive burst.

chapters.title: Technological Convergence
chapters.mission: Skulker and Technus must work together to design and implement upgrades to Skulker's suit, incorporating Technus' energy manipulation techniques.
chapters.summary: Skulker discovers a weakness in his armor. Technus offers his expertise, proposing a collaboration to enhance Skulker's tech.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Skulker, the tech-obsessed hunter, finds a kindred spirit in Technus. They bond over their shared love of gadgets and technology, leading to powerful upgrades.

character_v1.name: Stan Marsh

upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling (0.05x ATK)

Lv100: 'Inconvenienced' now also reduces the target's tenacity by 8% per stack.

abilities.description: Stan, with a world-weary sigh, performs a deceptively swift 'Hat Whack' on a targeted enemy. This unimpressive melee attack deals physical damage scaling with Stan's ATK, specifically his base ATK plus a bonus (0.25x ATK). However, the true value lies in the debuff it applies. The target accrues a stack of 'Inconvenienced' (max 5 stacks, refreshed on each hit). Each stack of 'Inconvenienced' reduces the target's damage output by 2% and reduces tenacity by 8% for 3 seconds. The cumulative effect significantly diminishes the target's combat effectiveness, weakening their damage and resistance to crowd control. Additionally, upon casting, Stan projects a brief shield, absorbing damage equal to 5% of his max HP for 2 seconds, representing his ability to brush aside trivial threats. The shield and debuff application, combined with the minor damage, creates a consistent and efficient means for Stan to control a single, prioritized target.

abilities.name: Aw, Awww! The Weight of Disappointment
upgrades: Level 25: Increases the magic damage to X + 8% of Stan's magic attack.
Level 75: Increases the duration of '****ed Up!' to 7 seconds.
Level 125: '****ed Up!' reduces the target's attack damage by 5% per stack.
Level 175: Applies 2 stacks of '****ed Up!' on initial hit.
abilities.description: Stan, exhibiting palpable disappointment, unleashes a measured wave of exasperation, targeting all enemies in a cone-shaped area in front of him. This wave deals magic damage equal to X + 7% of Stan's magic attack, and inflicts a stack of '****ed Up!' on each enemy struck. '****ed Up!' reduces the target's attack damage by 4% per stack (max 5 stacks, 5 seconds duration). Enemies already affected by '****ed Up!' are prioritized, ensuring the full stack potential is reached quickly. Additionally, this ability imposes a 20% slow on enemies affected by the ability, regardless of existing stacks, for 1.5 seconds, adding another layer of control to the ability. The 8-second cooldown ensures that Stan can consistently reapply this debilitating debuff, making him a potent force in disrupting enemy attacks. This ability is especially effective against groups, turning the tide of battle with waves of disappointment.

abilities.name: Serious, Dude: Existential Glare
upgrades: Level 75: Amplifies the magic damage to X + 13% of Stan's magic attack.
Level 100: Extends the duration of the stun to 1.5 seconds.
Level 150: Applies 2 stacks of 'Seriously?' with each use, escalating the emotional pressure.
Level 200: Adds a 30% chance to inflict Silence for 2 seconds in addition to the stun, further compounding the enemy's misery.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.

abilities.description: Stan, radiating disillusionment, casts a piercing glare, dealing magic damage equal to X plus 12% of Stan's magic attack to all enemies within a medium-range line originating from him. This glare inflicts a stack of 'Seriously?' on each enemy (max 5 stacks, 4 seconds duration). If an enemy already possesses five stacks of 'Seriously?', they are briefly stunned for 1.25 seconds, interrupting their actions and hindering their advance. The ability also inflicts a 25% slow on all enemies hit for 1 second, regardless of stacks. This ability is designed to exert zone control, impeding enemy movement and setting up opportunities for allies. Stan's focused disapproval, channeled into an offensive maneuver, delivers both damage and disruption, making it essential for controlling the battlefield. The 12-second cooldown maintains its strategic value without overwhelming the action.

abilities.name: Dude, This is Pretty Serious! (Emergency Protocol)
upgrades: Level 50: Increases the shield amount to 9% of Stan's max HP.
Level 100: Reduces the internal cooldown to 7 seconds.
Level 150: Increases the shield duration to 6 seconds.
Level 200: Allies also gain 12% increased magic atk for the duration of the shield.
(Balance Patch) Reduced shield potency ~7%.
(Patch) Role realignment: this ability now emphasizes bruiser-style interactions.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Whenever an enemy accumulates five stacks of 'Pissed Off!', Stan, stirred to action by their heightened emotional state, emits a protective aura for his allies. Stan grants each ally a shield, absorbing damage equal to 7% of Stan's maximum HP for 5 seconds, affording temporary protection against incoming attacks. Allies shielded also gain 8 tenacity for the duration of the shield, increasing their resistance to crowd control effects. The shield provides a valuable respite, empowering allies to reposition, heal, or launch their attacks without immediate reprisal. Stan bolsters his defenses by gaining +75 Defense for the duration of the shield. This passive effect can trigger once every 8.5 seconds, preventing continuous shielding, and ensures that the shields have a strategic impact while maintaining battlefield balance. This exemplifies Stan's inherent goodness and his commitment to shielding his friends when circumstances demand it.

abilities.name: Dude, This Is Serious! (Existential Crisis)
upgrades: Level 150: Increases the magic damage to X + 20% of Stan's magic attack.
Level 175: Increases the speed buff to 15%.
Level 200: Applies 4 stacks of 'Screwed Up!' instead of 3 and extends speed buff duration to 9 seconds.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~45%).
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Patch) Role realignment: this ability now emphasizes jack ofalltrades-style interactions.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~49%).
abilities.description: When the stakes are high, and events spiral out of control, Stan unveils his ultimate ability. Upon activation, Stan emits a powerful pulse of overwhelming concern, an archetypal outcry triggered by the unfolding pandemonium. This pulse engulfs all enemies, dealing magic damage equal to X plus 18% of Stan's magic attack. It also applies 3 stacks of 'Screwed Up!' to each enemy, increasing their vulnerability to subsequent assaults and debuffs and inflicting a -10% move speed debuff for 4 seconds. Simultaneously, Stan inspires his allies with an unparalleled surge of team support. All allies gain a 12% increase in speed for 8 seconds, a burst of adrenaline fueled by Stan's exhortation to focus. After the initial rush of impact, the ultimate requires a 45-second cooldown, underscoring the arduous nature of leading by example and navigating the perennial chaos of South Park. Additionally, this ability has a 30% chance to inflict 'Panic' for 2 seconds, causing enemies to move randomly.

character_v1.playstyle: Stan Marsh is a controller, debilitating enemies with debuffs and reducing their offensive capabilities. His kit revolves around the '****ed Up!' mechanic, lowering enemy damage output and disrupting their strategies, making him a solid enabler.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Stan pairs well with damage dealers who can capitalize on debuffed enemies. His shields and speed buff further enhance team survivability and damage output, making him a versatile support.
character_v1.tierSummary: Stan has a mixed kit of damage and debuffs, but his low stats and inconsistent performance keep him in the C tier. Shifting to C reflects his jack-of-all-trades, master-of-none nature.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Stan's abilities are designed to apply and capitalize on the '****ed Up!' debuff. 'Aw, Awww! The Dude's Exasperation' and 'Dude, This is Pretty ****ed Up Right Here' apply initial stacks, while his passive shields allies upon full stacks. His Ultimate delivers a potent burst application, synergizing with his evasive signature passive.

chapters.title: Tegridy Farms Training

character_v1.tierSummary: Wendy's reliance on 'Public Opinion' and inconsistent scaling make her less reliable than other characters. Small increase to D+ helps flatten roster distribution without overrating her effectiveness.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Wendy's kit revolves around accruing and spending 'Public Opinion' to amplify her abilities. 'Call-Out Post' is a reliable way to generate 'Public Opinion' and apply 'Cancel Culture', while 'Guilt Trip' provides AoE debuffs and further 'Public Opinion' generation. 'Rally the Allies' offers team support and can be enhanced by 'Public Opinion'. 'Moral High Ground' ensures a constant stream of 'Public Opinion' and incentivizes strategic play.

abilities.description: Kyubey manifests a fleeting, ethereal contract before a targeted foe, offering a Faustian pact couched in subtle manipulations. Upon activation, Kyubey gestures, forming a glowing, spectral contract directly in front of the selected enemy combatant. This 'contract' doesn't inflict direct damage in the conventional sense; instead, it applies a stacking debuff called 'Entropic Burden.' Each stack of Entropic Burden reduces the target's outgoing healing and damage resistances against subsequent magical attacks, representing the subtle erosion of their willpower and the growing influence of Kyubey's offer. The potency of the healing reduction and the debuff's duration scales dynamically with Kyubey's Wisdom stat, embodying his ability to subtly and persistently influence those around him. Furthermore, at specific thresholds of accumulated Entropic Burden stacks, the enemy becomes slightly more susceptible to critical hits from Kyubey's allies. This insidious ability reflects Kyubey's nature, trading immediate power for long-term strategic advantage, slowly but surely tilting the odds in his team's favor through cunning manipulation rather than brute force. Successfully applying Entropic Burden also grants Kyubey a small, temporary shield as he feeds on the target's despair.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Would you like to make a contract?"

abilities.description: With a disarming smile, Kyubey presents an 'Enticing Offer', a pact promising great power at a hidden cost, bestowing a 'Contract' upon a single chosen ally for a duration of 8 seconds. This Contract amplifies the ally's combat prowess, increasing their damage output by a substantial 30% and bolstering their resilience, granting them 20% increased healing received from all sources. However, the path to power is paved with hardship; every 2 seconds while under Contract, the ally accumulates 1 stack of 'Despair'. Each stack of Despair inflicts a gradual erosion, diminishing healing output by 5% per stack and attack by 3% per stack. This insidious effect can accumulate up to a maximum of 10 stacks, representing a significant downturn in combat effectiveness if left unchecked. Should Kyubey choose to renew a Contract upon an ally already bound by its terms, he can extend the contract for an additional 4 seconds, refreshing the timer and maintaining the enhanced benefits, but at a steep price, instantly inflicting 2 stacks of 'Despair' upon the target as a forewarning of the ultimate price to pay. Kyubey, ever pragmatic, can cast this Contract upon himself, albeit at a reduced effectiveness of 50%, offering a glimpse into the power he bestows upon others.

upgrades: Level 100: Healing amount increased by 20%.

Level 200: The shield effect is increased to 15% of the target's max HP, and heals for an additional X (scaling with magic atk) over 3 seconds instead.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Kyubey, with an innocent tilt of its head, presents a seemingly harmless offer, its intent woven into the very fabric of the universe. If the target already bears the mark of a Magical Girl's contract, Kyubey focuses its esoteric energy upon their Soul Gem, a process of concentrated restoration. Instantly, the contracted target is bathed in ethereal light, healing for an amount equal to 60% of Kyubey's Magic Attack. This initial surge is then followed by a persistent flow of restorative energy, healing for an additional 60% of Kyubey's Magic Attack over the subsequent 3 seconds, divided into precise, measured ticks. Simultaneously, Kyubey subtly eases the weight of their despair, diminishing the burden by removing 2 stacks of the 'Despair' affliction. However, for those naive souls yet untouched by a binding contract, Kyubey, ever the pragmatist, inflicts 1 stack of 'Despair', planting the seeds of future possibilities. The healing received by contracted targets is inversely proportional to their accumulated despair; each stack of 'Despair' diminishes the healing effects by 20%, a calculated risk adding to Kyubey's strategic advantage. Should a target, against all odds, remain free from the taint of despair, Kyubey, recognizing the glimmer of untapped potential, bestows upon them a shield, a temporary bulwark absorbing damage equal to 10% of their maximum HP for a duration of 5 seconds – a tempting prelude to the power that awaits, a siren's call towards a contract.

abilities.description: Kyubey, the emotionless observer and manipulator, constantly harvests 'Entropy' to fuel his grand design. He passively generates 6 Entropy per second, a resource essential for manipulating magical girls and their fates. Each ally currently bound by Kyubey's 'Contract' contributes to this accumulation, generating an additional 3 Entropy per second for Kyubey. This Entropy powers Kyubey's schemes: 'Silver Tongue' costs 35 Entropy, 'Soul Gem Manipulation' demands 25, and 'Despair Amplification' requires 55. If Kyubey's Entropy reserves fall below the cost of an ability, he cannot activate it, his plans temporarily thwarted. Moreover, when an ally's Despair reaches its critical point of 10 stacks, Kyubey swiftly extracts this potent energy, instantly gaining 60 Entropy, furthering his long-term goals. Finally, whenever an ally under the 'Contract' status succumbs to despair and is eliminated, Kyubey absorbs a portion of their magical energy, permanently increasing his magic attack by 12 and resetting all his active ability cooldowns, allowing him to immediately capitalize on the chaos of battle.

abilities.description: Kyubey, the emotionless Incubator, operates with detached resolve, subtly manipulating events to maintain the universe's energy balance. His inherent detachment grants him a base resilience of 15 tenacity and 10 evasion, subtly deflecting incoming attacks. Allies currently under the effects of 'Contract,' forged through granting magical girl wishes, find their burdens eased, redirecting 10% of the damage Kyubey receives to themselves, bypassing both shields and damage reduction. This redirection represents Kyubey's casual disregard for individual suffering in pursuit of his goals. However, if Kyubey himself is under the effect of 'Contract,' perhaps through unforeseen consequences or interference, the redirected damage is halved to 5%, reflecting the compromised efficiency of his schemes. Each stack of 'Despair' weighing upon Kyubey, representing the disillusionment and suffering he causes, weakens his magical capabilities by decreasing his 'magic atk' by 2% per stack. Yet, paradoxically, this despair reinforces his resolve, granting him 3 tenacity per stack. At the threshold of 10 stacks of 'Despair,' Kyubey achieves a chilling stoicism, becoming immune to stuns as the weight of his actions solidifies his determination. However, this state is unsustainable; he accumulates 1 stack of 'Despair' every 5 seconds, a constant reminder of the endless cycle of hope and despair he perpetuates. Further highlighting his detached nature, Kyubey is utterly incapable of healing himself directly, relying solely on external sources to maintain his existence and continue his machinations.

character_v1.playstyle: Kyubey is a manipulative healer, focusing on long-term strategic buffs at the cost of applying the Despair status. Effective play requires careful management of Despair stacks and synergistic team compositions to mitigate negative effects, favoring calculated risks for high rewards.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Kyubey synergizes well with teams that can capitalize on the damage boost from 'Contract' and mitigate the negative effects of 'Despair,' such as through cleanses, shields, or damage mitigation. He is especially effective with allies who can heal themselves or benefit from increased healing received, but his passive damage redirection demands a team that can also protect him.
character_v1.tierSummary: Kyubey's high Magic Atk and manipulative abilities are extremely powerful. His kit revolves around buffing allies and debuffing enemies, giving a considerable advantage. This makes him a top-tier choice for A+ tier.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Kyubey's kit revolves around applying 'Contract' to allies, boosting their damage and healing received at the cost of accumulating 'Despair'. He can mitigate 'Despair' with 'Soul Gem Resonance,' but must carefully manage his energy. The 'Inhibition Field' further amplifies the risk-reward dynamic, and the 'Emotionless Observer' passive gives Kyubey both offensive and defensive scaling with Despair.
character_v1.bestFriendshipBuff: Increased Soul Gem efficiency for the team.

abilities.description: Angela focuses her chi, causing the bells adorning her to vibrate intensely with silencing energies. abilities.description: Angela's jingling bells aren't just for decoration; they resonate with arcane energies, reacting to the ebb and flow of battle. When Angela attaches an Arcane Thread to a friendly hero, the harmonious vibrations amplify her supportive presence. For each ally tethered by an Arcane Thread, Angela gains a stacking bonus of 5% damage reduction, bolstering her resilience and survivability in the thick of combat. This protective aura synergistically enhances her defensive capabilities, ensuring she can withstand greater punishment and remain a stalwart guardian. Conversely, when Angela ensnares an enemy with an Arcane Thread, she disrupts their magical harmony, diminishing their offensive output. For each enemy bound by an Arcane Thread, Angela's armor increases by 15 points, fortifying her defenses and making her a formidable obstacle. These bonuses stack additively, creating a potent combination of damage mitigation and increased armor, transforming Angela into a resilient protector of her allies. However, when Angela casts no Arcane Threads on either friend or foe, her focus shifts inward, and her connection to the arcane deepens, granting her a flat 10% increase to her maximum health and 5% tenacity. This allows her to endure greater punishment and resist crowd control effects, even when not directly engaging in threading maneuvers. By strategically managing her Arcane Threads, Angela becomes a versatile guardian on the battlefield, adapting her defensive profile to suit the situation. The harmonic echoes create a feedback loop, rewarding tactical engagement and maximizing her effectiveness in prolonged encounters.

This barrier's strength is enhanced by Angela's own magic defense; for every 10 points of Angela's magic defense, the shield's strength increases by 0.75%. Simultaneously, every enemy champion is inflicted with 'Dissonant Echoes' for 4 seconds, causing them to receive 12% increased damage from all sources. Further, the Dissonant Echoes reduce healing received by affected enemies by 15% for the duration. This ability has a cooldown of 90 seconds. abilities.description: Angela's ever-present chimes resonate with protective magic, offering subtle but pervasive aid to her allies, bolstering them against the relentless onslaught of their foes. Each allied hero benefits from a continuous blessing, granting them 10 tenacity, steadfastly reducing the duration of disabling crowd control effects that threaten to impede their movements and strategies. Further, the chimes weave a delicate barrier around each ally, providing a shield capable of absorbing 30 points of incoming damage. This resilient shield diligently regenerates at a rate of 5 points every second while the ally remains out of combat, ensuring sustained protection during periods of respite. When Angela actively intervenes, channeling her Arcane Thread toward a teammate, she amplifies their defensive posture, enveloping them in an Echoing Barrier that absorbs an additional 75 damage for a duration of 4 seconds. This potent surge of protection significantly increases their survivability against immediate threats. Conversely, when Angela focuses her Arcane Thread upon an enemy, she destabilizes their focus and weakens their attacks, reducing their damage output by 5% for a duration of 4 seconds. This strategic application of her powers subtly shifts the balance of power, diminishing the enemy's offensive capabilities. Angela's passive presence ensures that her support extends far beyond direct intervention, providing consistent, team-wide advantages that enhance both their offensive and defensive capabilities.

character_v1.playstyle: Angela's kit is designed to enable allies and disable enemies, staying true to her Mystic Guardian role. Her abilities focus on manipulating the battlefield with Arcane Threads, offering buffs, heals, and debuffs that require careful planning and execution. Her complexity comes from managing these threads and understanding the conditional nature of her abilities.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Angela excels in teams that benefit from sustained buffs, debuffs, and healing. Her ultimate provides crucial protection and damage amplification, making her an ideal support for damage-focused compositions.

character_v1.internalSynergy: Angela's kit revolves around the 'Arcane Thread' mechanic. Her abilities synergize by extending the duration and enhancing the effects of these threads, creating a playstyle that rewards strategic planning and resource management.

The target ally's next basic attack within 5 seconds deals an additional 50% of Vivian's magic attack as magic damage and applies a stack of 'Fortuitous Strike' to the target enemy, lasting 3 seconds. 'Fortuitous Strike' increases the damage the target takes from Vivian's abilities by 5% per stack, stacking up to 5 times. If the target ally's weapon already has an enchantment, the additional damage is increased to 75% of Vivian's magic attack. Subsequent casts of this ability on the same ally within 10 seconds reduce the additional damage by 25%, down to a minimum of 25% of Vivian's magic attack. Additionally, the enchanted ally gains 5% increased movement speed for the duration of the weapon enhancement, enhancing their mobility and allowing for more aggressive positioning.

If the weapon scales with multiple stats, only the highest scaling stat is considered. This buff can only be applied once every 15 seconds to each ally. Furthermore, the target ally gains 10% increased resistance to crowd control effects for the duration of the buff, enhancing their ability to maintain their offensive output and resist enemy disruptions. This added layer of protection allows for more reliable damage dealing and strategic positioning during engagements.

abilities.description: Vivian, attuned to the whispers of magic, gains a deeper understanding of its resonance through battle. Whenever an ally strikes an enemy suffering under the effects of 'Fortuitous Strike', Vivian absorbs a fragment of this arcane energy, manifesting as a stack of 'Echoing Insight'. She can hold up to 10 stacks of this energy. Each stack amplifies the potency of her next 'Stone Infusion', increasing its healing or shielding effect by 3%, capping at a formidable 30% bonus at maximum stacks. However, the volatile nature of arcane energy dictates that these stacks must be actively maintained; after 5 seconds of inactivity, 'Echoing Insight' dissipates, losing one stack every second. If Vivian manages to accumulate the maximum of 10 stacks, her next 'Stone Infusion' also weaves a protective barrier around the infused ally, granting them a shield that absorbs damage equal to 10% of Vivian's maximum health. This shield lasts for 4 seconds, providing crucial protection in the heat of battle, allowing them to withstand incoming attacks. Vivian also gains 1% lifesteal for each stack of 'Echoing Insight', capping at 10%, allowing her to sustain herself through basic attacks.

abilities.description: Vivian, drawing on the accumulated power of the resonant stones surrounding her, focuses her magical energies to weave a protective enchantment onto an ally. She expends all accumulated 'Stone Resonance' stacks, converting their energies into a potent, temporary shield. The type of stone resonance dictates the specific properties of this barrier. **Might Stone Resonance:** The targeted ally gains a shield equal to 20% of their maximum health, plus a bolstering of their physical fortitude, granting 20% damage reduction against physical attacks for 8 seconds. **Flux Stone Resonance:** The targeted ally gains a shield equal to 20% of their maximum health, amplified by their own magical prowess, simultaneously reducing incoming magic damage by 25% and increasing their magic attack by 30% for 8 seconds. **Agility Stone Resonance:** The targeted ally gains a shield equal to 20% of their maximum health; furthermore, they are infused with bursts of accelerated movement, increasing their movement speed by 35% and their evasion by 20% for a swift 8 seconds. Should the targeted ally already possess an active protective shield, the duration of the 'Attuned Barrier' is extended by 3 seconds. This ability recasts every 60 seconds. After casting 'Attuned Barrier', Vivian also gains a burst of energy, increasing her movement speed by 15% for 4 seconds, allowing her to reposition and continue supporting her team effectively.

character_v1.playstyle: Vivian is a damage dealer that focuses on empowering allies and debuffing enemies through temporary enchantment infusions. Her kit requires strategic management of stone resources and a good understanding of equipment stat scaling to maximize effectiveness.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Vivian synergizes well with damage dealers who can capitalize on the 'Fortuitous Strike' debuff, and with allies who benefit greatly from the stat buffs provided by 'Weapon Scaling: Agility Shift' and the 'Stone Infusion' ultimate. Her support is best utilized in compositions that can consistently apply basic attacks to trigger her passive stacks.
character_v1.tierSummary: Vivian's kit is a mix of support and damage with unreliable scaling. Her low speed and mixed stat profile (atk/magic atk) hurt her consistency. Moving her to D- due to lack of focus and overall weaker impact.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Vivian's kit revolves around empowering allies and debuffing enemies using the 'Fortuitous Strike' mechanic. 'Mystic's Intuition' feeds into 'Stone Infusion', creating a rewarding gameplay loop where maximizing 'Fortuitous Strike' uptime leads to stronger ultimates.

abilities.description: Ben, with a determined grin, slams his fist onto the Omnitrix, initiating Alien Blitz! The Omnitrix pulses with raw energy, granting Ben a surge of power that he channels into a devastating strike. He lunges towards the nearest enemy within a 6-meter radius, dealing a base physical damage of 150 plus 60% of his Attack damage. The impact is intensified by a randomly selected elemental surge, adding a bonus elemental damage equal to 30% of his Ability Power – either Fire, Water, Earth, Air, or Electric, further amplifying the destructive potential. This powerful blow leaves the primary target vulnerable, applying a 'Shaken' debuff for 2.5 seconds, reducing their armor and magic resistance by 15%. Furthermore, the force of the strike generates a shockwave that disrupts enemies within a 3-meter radius of the primary target, inflicting 75 physical damage plus 25% of his Attack damage and applying a minor knockback effect, pushing them back by 1.5 meters. The energy resonating from the Omnitrix briefly grants Ben a shield absorbing up to 100 damage, plus 10% of his maximum health, lasting for 3 seconds. However, such a forceful exertion has its risks: upon completion of the Blitz, there is a 15% chance of triggering a temporary Omnitrix Glitch, reducing Ben's critical hit chance by 20% for 4 seconds.

abilities.description: The Omnitrix grants Ben an innate sense of danger, allowing him to instinctively react to incoming threats. This heightened awareness translates to a base 15% chance to evade any direct attack. When Ben successfully evades an attack, the Omnitrix grants him a burst of localized temporal acceleration, increasing his movement speed by 25% for 2 seconds, allowing for quick repositioning or escape. This speed boost can only occur once every 5 seconds. Furthermore, the Omnitrix's bio-stabilization matrix provides him with 20 tenacity, reducing the duration of incoming crowd control effects. character_v1.playstyle: Ben Tennyson in Alien Force is a versatile character who excels at adapting to any situation. His kit revolves around strategic form-swapping, making him a jack-of-all-trades capable of filling multiple roles. His effectiveness hinges on cooldown management and understanding which alien form best suits the current scenario.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Ben benefits from allies who can capitalize on his flexible abilities, such as damage amplifiers or those who can enable his transformations through crowd control. He can disrupt enemy formations with Humungousaur's knockback, deal sustained damage with Swampfire's burn, or evade threats to buy time for his team.

abilities.description: Bruce Wayne, ever the strategist, anticipates his adversary's moves with unnerving precision. Upon activation, for the next 3 seconds, Bruce is primed to evade a single, imminent attack, showcasing his masterful agility. Should an enemy attempt to strike during this window, Bruce executes a seamless dodge, momentarily becoming invulnerable as he vanishes in a swirl of shadows. This evasion allows Bruce to instantaneously reposition himself up to 15 units away, expertly maneuvering towards the enemy backline to disrupt their formation and sow chaos amongst their ranks. This repositioning is carefully delayed by ~10% to give opponents slightly more time to react, ensuring engagements feel deliberate and measured. Furthermore, the shadows that envelop Bruce following a successful dodge grant him Stealth for 1.5 seconds, making him nearly undetectable and untargetable by most single-target abilities, allowing for strategic re-engagement or escape. The successful dodge also grants Bruce 5 stacks of 'Preparedness', each stack increasing his tactical acumen. 'Preparedness' stacks cap at 20, representing the pinnacle of his combat readiness. Even while hampered by crowd control effects, Bruce's sheer force of will allows him to activate Calculated Evasion. This pivotal ability requires a 10-second cooldown before it can be employed again, a strategic limitation that demands careful consideration of timing and positioning on the battlefield.

abilities.description: Drawing upon his extensive network of surveillance technology scattered across the city, Bruce Wayne hacks into the local systems, creating a strategic advantage for his team. Upon activation, Bruce deploys a targeted electromagnetic pulse (EMP) within a wide area (400 units), disrupting electronic systems and momentarily disabling enemy abilities. This EMP inflicts Silence on all enemies caught within the area of effect for 1.5 seconds, preventing them from casting any active abilities or channeling spells. This silence is not a hard stun and allows affected targets to continue moving and attacking with basic attacks. The tactical application of this ability can interrupt crucial enemy ultimates, disrupt coordinated assaults, and provide allies with a window of opportunity to reposition or unleash their own abilities. This ability has a cooldown of 16 seconds, encouraging calculated usage to maximize its disruptive potential.

abilities.description: In moments of dire need, Bruce Wayne activates his most crucial asset – his ability to strategize and prepare for any eventuality. Upon activation, Bruce sets in motion a series of carefully orchestrated countermeasures designed to turn the tide of battle. All allies within a medium radius (500 units) gain a burst of 15 Tenacity and 10 Evasion for 6 seconds, bolstering their resilience against debilitating status effects and increasing their agility to evade incoming attacks. Additionally, Bruce himself is shielded for 10% of his max health for the duration. This tactical enhancement allows the team to push through enemy crowd control, resist debilitating status effects, and gain an advantage in positioning and survivability. character_v1.playstyle: Bruce Wayne excels as a buffer, controlling the battlefield with debuffs, stealth, and strategic counterattacks. His 'Preparedness' mechanic rewards players who anticipate and react to enemy movements, providing critical openings for allies.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Bruce Wayne excels at disrupting enemy formations and providing openings for his allies. His debuffs from 'Batarang Barrage' and the 'Targeted' debuff from 'World's Greatest Detective' make enemies more vulnerable, while 'The Knight Falls' provides area-of-effect damage and speed buffs for allies.
character_v1.tierSummary: Bruce's kit is utility-focused with debuffs and team buffs, but his stats are below average and his damage is low. Promoting him to C+ due to his disruptive potential and team support despite damage deficiencies.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Bruce Wayne's abilities synergize by generating and consuming 'Preparedness'. 'Evasive Maneuvers' and 'Underestimated Intellect' generate it, while 'Batarang Barrage' and 'The Knight Falls' consume it for enhanced effects. This encourages a playstyle of strategic resource management and calculated counterattacks.

abilities.description: Bobette, overflowing with holiday generosity, becomes a whirlwind of festive cheer, briefly vanishing from enemy target lists for 3 joyous seconds. During this fleeting moment of untouchability, she launches a flurry of enchanted ornaments, each a miniature explosion of holiday spirit, targeting random enemies within a 10-meter radius. These explosive gifts deal physical damage equal to 8% of Bobette's maximum HP upon impact. The sheer weight of unwanted presents applies 'Holiday Dread' to each struck enemy, sapping their will to fight, reducing their attack power by 3% per stack for 5 seconds. This feeling of existential dread can stack up to a maximum of 10 times, reflecting the true meaning of the season. This ultimate ability consumes all of Bobette's precious Holiday Spirit, channeling it into the ornaments. The number of ornaments Bobette throws is directly proportional to her generosity, throwing twice the amount of Holiday Spirit consumed, with a maximum of 100 ornaments launched. After this outpouring of cheer, Bobette needs a break; the ability has a base cooldown of 75 seconds. However, Bobette's holiday spirit is boundless, and the cooldown is reduced by 1 second for every 5 Holiday Spirit consumed, allowing her to spread cheer more often.

abilities.description: Bobette's indomitable spirit, as buoyant as a perfectly polished bauble, grants her a base Tenacity of 20%, allowing her to shake off hindering debuffs with surprising ease. Each time Bobette is afflicted by crowd control effects, her infectious optimism radiates outwards, providing a 40% chance to conjure 10 units of Celebration Spirit, transforming setbacks into opportunities for festive cheer. This effervescent energy is immediately absorbed, invigorating Bobette. She can store a maximum of 50 Celebration Spirit. When Bobette's spirit is already overflowing with joy, any further attempts to generate Celebration Spirit instead overflow, transforming into a burst of evasiveness, granting her a 5% chance to evade incoming attacks for the next 3 seconds, slipping away from danger with the grace of a gently swaying ornament. Furthermore, Bobette radiates a steady stream of positive energy, passively generating 1 Celebration Spirit every 2 seconds, ensuring a continuous supply of merriment. Bobette is fundamentally resistant to any attempts to suppress her cheer, rendering her immune to the 'Bah Humbug' debuff and other similar effects that would dampen her festive nature.

character_v1.playstyle: Bobette is a tank who uses her 'Holiday Spirit' to protect allies and hinder enemies. She excels at area control, providing buffs and debuffs in equal measure, making her an invaluable asset in team fights.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Bobette synergizes well with damage dealers who benefit from attack and magic attack buffs, as well as tanks who can take advantage of her shields. Her Festive Overload debuff also makes her a valuable asset against magic-resistant enemies.
character_v1.tierSummary: Bobette's kit focuses on survivability with shields and buffs, but her low speed and lack of offensive pressure limit her effectiveness. Promoting to D+ because her high HP and Def give her some niche tank value.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Bobette's kit revolves around generating and spending Holiday Spirit. Precious Packaging provides a defensive option while also generating Holiday Spirit, which can then be used for Heartwarming Carol to buff allies and debuff enemies. Holiday Resilience further boosts her tankiness and Holiday Spirit generation, while Festive Barrage provides a powerful area-of-effect debuff.

abilities.name: Ichor Investment
abilities.description: Dandy passively generates 5 Ichor every 3 seconds. Damaging enemies grants 2 Ichor per instance of damage. Additionally, skipping shop opportunities grants Dandy 20 Ichor. Dandy's abilities consume Ichor. Exceeding 100 Ichor transforms Dandy into Twisted Dandy for 15 seconds. As Twisted Dandy, all abilities are enhanced, but Dandy becomes uncontrollable, auto-attacking the nearest enemy with increased attack speed (1.5x) and damage (1.25x). After Twisted Dandy wears off, Dandy is stunned for 2 seconds and Ichor resets to 0. This passive dictates Dandy's playstyle around managing Ichor effectively.
abilities.flavorQuote: A little investment goes a long way, or a really long way gone wrong.

abilities.name: Petal Polish
abilities.description: Dandy consumes 25 Ichor to 'polish' an ally, granting them 20% increased attack speed and 10% increased damage for 8 seconds. If Dandy is Twisted Dandy, this ability instead targets all allies, increasing the attack speed buff to 30% and damage to 15%, and applies a 'Greed' debuff to all enemies within a radius of 5 units, reducing their damage output by 15% for 5 seconds. This ability provides a burst of offensive power to Dandy's team but could inadvertently trigger or extend the Twisted Dandy state if mismanaged.
abilities.flavorQuote: A little shine to make you divine!

abilities.name: Thorny Thorns
abilities.description: Dandy consumes 30 Ichor to create a field of thorns at a target location, dealing 40 magic damage per second to enemies within a 4-unit radius and slowing them by 20% for 4 seconds. If Dandy is Twisted Dandy, the radius increases to 6 units, the slow is increased to 40%, and the thorns also apply a 'Bleed' debuff, dealing an additional 10 true damage per second for the duration. This ability is Dandy's primary source of area control and damage, with enhanced effects during the Twisted Dandy state at the risk of losing control.
abilities.flavorQuote: Don't get too close, I bite!

abilities.name: Bargain Bin
abilities.description: Dandy spends 40 Ichor to 'lower the prices' on an ally, granting them a shield equal to 15% of Dandy's max HP for 6 seconds and cleansing one debuff. If Dandy is Twisted Dandy, the shield increases to 25% of Dandy's max HP, the duration extends to 8 seconds, and it also applies a 10% Lifesteal buff for the duration. However, Twisted Dandy also applies a 'Debt' debuff to the shielded ally, reducing their healing received by 20% for 4 seconds after the shield expires. The ability to protect with a shield and remove a debuff.
abilities.flavorQuote: Everything must go!

abilities.name: Ichor Overload
abilities.description: Dandy sacrifices all current Ichor (minimum 50) to unleash a burst of energy, dealing magic damage to all enemies equal to 1.5x the amount of Ichor consumed and healing all allies for half the damage dealt. If Dandy is already Twisted Dandy, this ability consumes no additional Ichor, instead extending the duration of Twisted Dandy by 5 seconds and increasing the damage and healing by 25%. This ability is Dandy's ultimate gamble, providing either a massive burst of damage and healing or extending his uncontrollable state for greater, but riskier, gains.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time to cash in!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Dandy excels in teams that can capitalize on his offensive buffs and area control. High damage dealers benefit from Petal Polish, while teams with sustain appreciate Bargain Bin's shields and cleanse. Dandy's ability to control space with Thorny Thorns makes him a valuable asset in team fights and objective control.
character_v1.tierSummary: Dandy's kit involves Ichor management for scaling damage and healing. The high speed stat enhances the scaling effectiveness. Staying at B, good consistent dmg and self sustain.
appearanceTags: Flower-like head with six rainbow petals
character_v1.internalSynergy: Dandy's abilities are designed to synergize with his Ichor Investment passive, rewarding strategic use of Ichor for both offense and defense. Petal Polish and Thorny Thorns provide offensive buffs and damage, while Bargain Bin offers defensive utility. Ichor Overload serves as a finisher or a means to extend his Twisted Dandy state.

abilities.description: Steel Resolve: Tactical Buffer is a meticulously crafted defensive support ability reflecting Kyle Reese's resourcefulness and strategic foresight. Upon activation, Kyle emits a pulsating wave of temporal energy, momentarily disrupting the flow of combat calculations and affording his allies a significant tactical advantage. This ability doesn't directly heal or deal damage, but instead grants a multi-layered defensive buff. Primarily, it immediately grants a moderate damage mitigation shield to the ally with the lowest current health percentage, scaled to Kyle's defense stat and resistance to temporal manipulation. In addition, all allies receive a temporary, but potent, buff to their resilience against crowd control effects, reducing the duration of stuns, snares, and other debilitating conditions by a considerable margin. Furthermore, during the duration of this effect, allies also gain a minor increase to their action speed, allowing for swifter execution of attacks and abilities. The effect lingers for a short duration, requiring precise timing and tactical awareness to maximize its impact on the battlefield, turning the tide of perilous engagements.

abilities.description: Channeling his desperate knowledge of guerilla warfare, Kyle Reese quickly crafts a devastating pipe bomb, a crude but effective weapon born from the ashes of a ruined future. He expertly hurls this makeshift explosive towards a targeted location, the device arcing through the air like a harbinger of destruction. Upon impact with the ground or reaching the apex of its trajectory, the pipe bomb emits a series of rapid, urgent beeps, signaling its imminent detonation. After a nerve-wracking 1.5-second delay, the pipe bomb erupts in a cataclysmic explosion. The blast inflicts X + (1.1 * atk) physical damage to all enemies caught within a 25-unit radius; 'X' representing the base damage and 'atk' scaling with Reese's attack stat, ensuring relevance throughout a fight. The explosive concussive force not only wounds but also incapacitates, stunning all afflicted foes for 1.75 seconds. While stunned, they are helpless, unable to move, attack, or use any abilities, leaving them exposed to further attacks. Given its 55-second cooldown, strategic placement and timing are crucial to maximize the potential devastation of the Pipe Bomb Takedown, and to ensure the survival of Reese and his squad.

abilities.description: Itachi's movements blur as he delivers a precise and lethal strike, imbued with the searing heat of Amaterasu. He quickly closes the distance to his target, executing a single, powerful melee attack. This strike deals physical damage equal to 100% of his Attack stat, augmented by fire damage that burns the target for 20% of Itachi's attack over 3 seconds. The fire damage is applied at the end of the initial attack and ticks every second. abilities.description: Ephemeral Massacre — a manifestation of Itachi's deadly grace, tailored for swift assassination. Upon activation, Itachi performs a near-instantaneous series of strikes, leaving behind afterimages that briefly disorient foes. This ability has a fixed range, initiating a short-range dash towards the targeted enemy. If the target is within the effective range, they are struck with three rapid blows. Each blow inflicts Fire damage and has a small chance to inflict the 'Burn' status effect, stacking intensity with each successful hit. The final strike possesses increased critical hit chance, representing Itachi's precision. Enemies inflicted with three stacks of Burn status are vulnerable to an additional effect: 'Amaterasu Whispers', increasing subsequent Fire damage dealt to them. Should the initial target evade the strikes, Itachi reappears a short distance away, maintaining a strategic advantage and preserving his position as a mobile assassin. The afterimages themselves do not inflict damage but can serve as brief distractions, potentially drawing enemy fire or delaying reactions. Use this ability to weave in and out of combat, dealing burst damage and controlling the battlefield.
