abilities.description: Ganon, channeling malevolent sorcery through his Skull Trident, unleashes a piercing projectile in a targeted direction, dealing an initial X magic damage to all enemies caught in its path, signifying the raw force of his dark ambition. Upon impact, the ground cracks and fissures erupt, transforming the area into a 'Warlock's Waste' that lasts for 5 seconds. This corrupted terrain reduces the movement speed of enemies by 20%, hindering their escape, and inflicts 'Miasma', a vile curse that siphons 1% of their maximum health per second as magic damage, showcasing Ganon's insidious control over life itself. The Warlock's Waste visually manifests as shadowy energy crackling along the ground, making it clear to all who behold it that they are under Ganon's dominion. Should Ganon need to reposition or utilize his dark energies elsewhere, he may prematurely recall the Skull Trident by activating another ability, causing the Warlock's Waste to dissipate instantly and returning the weapon to his grasp, ready for further displays of dark power.

character_v1.playstyle: Ganon excels at controlling the battlefield, creating hazardous zones that disrupt enemy formations. His kit rewards strategic placement and punishes those who dare to invade his territory.

character_v1.playstyle: Momo is designed as a utility character focused on scouting and disrupting enemies. His small size and agility, combined with stealth mechanics, make him an excellent roamer and vision provider. He can significantly impact team fights by revealing enemy positions and interrupting key abilities.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Momo excels at providing vision and disrupting the enemy team, making him a valuable asset for coordinated teams. His vision control allows for safer engages, while his knockback and stun can create opportunities for teammates to follow up. Momo's ability to scout ahead and reveal enemy positions is invaluable for strategic planning and objective control.

tips: Prioritize item collection: Constantly scavenge for consumables to maximize your evasion and buff your team. This is your PRIMARY job.
Master Sudden Flutter: Use this for crucial dodges and repositioning. Don't waste it on trivial movement.
Use Sky Bison Sense proactively: Place sensors in high-traffic areas and around objectives for vision control. Vision wins games.
strategyData.overview: Momo's gameplay revolves around evasion, strategic buffing, and scouting. You're a slippery pest, darting in and out of fights, buffing your team with scavenged items, and using your vision to keep your team informed. You're not a damage dealer; your value comes from utility and disruption. Accept this, or you'll feed the enemy team.
strategyData.counterplay: Focus fire Momo after he's burned Sudden Flutter. CC him to interrupt item consumption. Clear out his Sky Bison Sensors to deny vision. He's squishy and vulnerable without his evasion and speed buffs; exploit that.

character_v1.internalSynergy: Momo's abilities synergize to create a slippery and disruptive playstyle. 'Sudden Flutter' allows for quick escapes and repositioning, while 'Moon Peach Pilfer' provides buffs that enhance his combat abilities. 'Lemur Lookout' grants vision for safe positioning, and 'Pygmy Puma Pounce' can disrupt enemy formations. 'Gluttonous Agility' rewards strategic item consumption with increased evasion, further enhancing his survivability.

abilities.description: When Elliott reaches out with Psychic Link: Shared Sensation, a fragile, shimmering glow clings to the connected ally, a testament to the enduring strength of their bond. Even after the initial psychic bridge dissolves, this faint luminescence lingers, a tangible reminder of Elliott's protective intent. For 3 seconds following the dissipation of Psychic Link's primary effects, this Fading Glow bestows upon the ally a subtle resilience, granting them 5% increased Tenacity and 5% increased Evasion. This borrowed fortitude helps them to weather incoming storms, reducing the duration of debilitating crowd control effects like stuns and silences, and heightening their ability to nimbly evade incoming attacks. It is a temporary safeguard, born of empathy and psychic power, offering a brief respite as the ally regains their footing. Note that the effect does not stack with itself; only a single Fading Glow can protect the target at any given time, even if multiple instances of Psychic Link are cast, making careful timing essential to maximize this ability's impact.

character_v1.playstyle: Elliott is a dedicated support character, enhancing a single ally through life-force transfer and memory-based buffs. His kit focuses on boosting an ally's damage and mobility, while also providing sustain through self-healing.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Elliott synergizes best with high-damage carries who benefit from increased damage, speed, and sustain. His healing and buffs can help keep them alive and effective in prolonged fights.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Elliott's abilities are designed to synergize with each other. 'Psychic Link' provides initial healing and damage, 'E.T.'s Glowing Finger' further boosts damage potential, and 'Flying Bike Escape' offers a powerful escape or engage tool. The 'I'll Be Right Here' passive provides a small but consistent buff after the initial link fades.

chapters.title: The Lonely Signal
chapters.mission: Guide Momo and Elliott through an emotional gauntlet, shielding them from psychic feedback. Keep both characters above 50% HP while purifying corrupted thoughts.
chapters.summary: Elliott struggles to connect, overwhelmed by others' emotions. Momo, sensing his distress, offers guidance. They must navigate a complex emotional landscape to reach a fragile spirit.
chapters.resonanceBuff: Increases Shield Strength by 40% based on Elliott's Magic Defense.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Elliott, feeling isolated, seeks connection. He embarks on a journey to understand true friendship, culminating in a powerful bond and amplified abilities.

abilities.description: Brusha passively generates Ichor, a unique resource, at a rate of 5 Ichor per second, up to a maximum of 200 Ichor. Brusha's presence inspires nearby allies. For every 50 Ichor stored, the Skill Check bonus increases by an additional 5%, up to a maximum of 30% at 200 Ichor. However, for every 50 Ichor stored, Brusha's movement speed is reduced by 5%, capping at a 20% speed reduction at maximum Ichor.
abilities.flavorQuote: Inspiration flows, but at a cost.

abilities.name: Palette Splash
abilities.description: Brusha spends 50 Ichor to fling a glob of paint at a targeted location within a 10-unit range. Upon impact, the paint creates a zone that lasts for 8 seconds. Allies standing within this zone gain a burst of speed, increasing their movement speed by 25% for 3 seconds. Additionally, enemies caught within the zone have their vision obscured, reducing their vision range by 40% for the duration. If Brusha has less than 50 Ichor, this ability cannot be activated. This ability has a cooldown of 15 seconds. The speed boost and vision reduction do not stack with multiple Palette Splashes.
abilities.flavorQuote: A splash of color can change everything.

abilities.description: Brusha channels her artistic energy into a single, powerful brushstroke, targeting a single ally within a range of 8 units. This ability costs 30 Ichor. The targeted ally gains a shield that absorbs damage equal to 15% of Brusha's maximum HP for 5 seconds. Furthermore, the ally's next skill check within 8 seconds receives a critical success, automatically succeeding regardless of the check's difficulty. If Brusha has less than 30 Ichor, the shield is reduced to 5% of Brusha's maximum HP. Focused Brushstroke has a cooldown of 20 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Precision and protection, a true artist's touch.

abilities.name: Canvas Trap

abilities.description: Brusha creates an illusory canvas on the ground at a targeted location within a 12-unit range. This canvas remains invisible to enemies unless they step directly onto it. When an enemy steps on the canvas, it triggers a trap, rooting them in place for 2 seconds. Additionally, Brusha gains 25 Ichor. The canvas lasts for 20 seconds, or until triggered. Only one Canvas Trap can be active at a time. This ability has a cooldown of 25 seconds. Enemies with tenacity are rooted for a shorter duration.
abilities.flavorQuote: Beauty can be deceiving.

abilities.name: Masterpiece Manifestation

abilities.description: Brusha unleashes her full artistic potential, expending all stored Ichor to create a zone of artistic influence centered around herself for 10 seconds. Additionally, allies' attack and magic attack are increased by 30%. The duration of the effect is increased by 0.1 second for every 1 Ichor spent, up to a maximum of 30 seconds at 200 Ichor. After the ultimate ends, Brusha is stunned for 2 seconds as she recovers from the exertion.
abilities.flavorQuote: Behold! The pinnacle of artistic power!

character_v1.playstyle: Strategic Buffing, Positional Support, Ichor Management
character_v1.teamSynergy: Brusha synergizes well with Toons that benefit from increased Skill Check, such as Bassie or Cosmo. The speed boost from 'Palette Splash' can help slower allies reposition, while 'Focused Brushstroke' can ensure critical extractions or repairs. Canvas Trap helps protect her Skill Check allies from being harassed while they work. 'Masterpiece Manifestation' is best used in coordinated pushes or defenses.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Brusha's kit revolves around building and expending Ichor to empower her allies. 'Artistic Aura' provides a constant, scaling Skill Check buff. 'Palette Splash' offers utility with speed and vision reduction. 'Focused Brushstroke' protects allies and guarantees Skill Check success. 'Canvas Trap' provides control and Ichor generation. 'Masterpiece Manifestation' is a powerful, all-in buff that provides significant utility and damage, but leaves Brusha vulnerable afterwards.

abilities.description: Effie presents a shimmering bauble, concentrating a beam of pure Capitol spectacle. This ranged attack strikes a single target, dealing fire damage equal to 40% of her Attack. The sheer extravagance momentarily stuns the target, inflicting a brief but noticeable daze, reducing their movement speed by 15% for 0.75 seconds as they are overwhelmed by the display. The intensity of the Flare also leaves a lingering heat, applying a Burn effect which deals an additional 10% of her Attack as fire damage over 3 seconds. This Burn does not stack. Effie’s impeccable style even allows her to occasionally strike with particular flair, granting a 10% chance to critically hit, doubling the initial damage dealt by the spectacle. As Effie grows in power, so too does her presentation — the damage scaling of the Flare increases, enhancing both its initial impact and the lingering burn damage.

abilities.description: Effie levels a devastatingly polite yet utterly withering critique at her chosen target. This targeted verbal assault deals a burst of psychic damage, meticulously calculated based on Effie's attack power to ensure maximum embarrassment. More importantly, the target is afflicted with 'Mortified', a debilitating status effect that reduces their outgoing damage by 15% for a duration of 4 seconds. Effie, with her uncanny sense of dramatic timing, always directs her 'Scathing Rebuke' towards the enemy combatant currently suffering the most egregious lack of decorum – that is, the one with the lowest remaining health. Prepare to be judged, tributes.

abilities.description: Effie's Sugarcoated Command is a marvelously manipulative maneuver that blends the art of distraction with a subtle deployment of tactical advantage. Upon activation, Effie flourishes her hand with dramatic flair, creating a shimmering, illusory confection that briefly captures the attention of a single target enemy. This confectionery projection, resembling an exquisitely decorated cake or perhaps a tower of delightful pastries, hangs tantalizingly in the air before rapidly dissolving, leaving the target slightly dazed and disoriented. During this brief period of bewilderment, the targeted enemy suffers a decrease in their combat effectiveness, experiencing a reduction in both attack damage and accuracy as their focus is momentarily compromised by the allure of the ephemeral treat. Simultaneously, Effie amplifies the morale of a chosen ally, imbuing them with a fleeting surge of confidence. This inspiration manifests as a temporary increase in critical hit chance and a bolstering of their resolve, affording them greater resistance to incoming status ailments or crowd control effects. This exquisitely orchestrated display of support and subtle debilitation reflects Effie's knack for controlling situations from behind the scenes, offering a strategic edge wrapped in a veneer of whimsical indulgence.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Remember, darling, presentation is EVERYTHING!"

abilities.description: With a flourish and an unnerving smile, Effie designates an unfortunate contestant from the enemy ranks. The 'lucky' target is immediately, and against their will, transported to a strategically chosen locale within a medium radius. The sudden and disorienting move leaves them utterly bewildered, rendering them Stunned for a full 1.5 seconds as they struggle to regain their bearings amidst the unfamiliar surroundings. However, should the Fates, or rather, the game's geometry, conspire against this relocation, the target will find themselves abruptly and firmly rooted in place for 2 seconds, a particularly vulnerable position ready to be exploited by opportunistic allies. Effie's range extends to a medium distance from herself, offering considerable tactical control over the battlefield, provided the designated landing spot is permissible terrain. A failed relocation means a rooted target, ensuring someone's day just got a whole lot worse. The selected target will find it hard to avoid the upcoming spectacle that they will certainly be a part of.

abilities.description: Effie unleashes the true power of Capitol chic. Upon activation, she gestures dramatically, conjuring a dazzling storm of Capitol finery over a wide area. This spectacle manifests as a vibrant, whirling vortex of feathered hats, bejeweled gloves, and shimmering scarves that buffet foes, dealing initial damage. The overwhelming fashion statement inflicts 'Dazed by Design' for 5 seconds, reducing enemy movement speed by 30% and attack damage by 15%. Simultaneously, allies within a generous radius are emboldened by Effie’s impeccable style, gaining 'Capitol Confidence' for 7 seconds, increasing their critical hit chance by 25% and granting them an additional 10% damage reduction. Furthermore, during the duration of 'Capitol Confidence', allies receive a burst heal of 5% of Effie's maximum health every 2 seconds, reinforcing their survivability amidst the chaos of battle. character_v1.playstyle: Effie is designed as a support character who enhances allies and disrupts enemies. Her kit is centered around buffing allies' stats and manipulating enemy positioning, making her a valuable asset in team compositions. Her 'supportive coordinator' role fits best given the focus on logistical skills and Capitol connections.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Effie excels in team compositions that capitalize on attack and magic attack buffs. Carries and mages benefit significantly from 'Sponsor's Gift' and 'Panem's Unifying Power,' while the team-wide Tenacity from 'Refined Sensibilities' protects against crowd control. The disruptive potential of 'Capitol Decree' allows her to peel for allies or set up favorable engagements.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Effie's kit is designed around buffing allies and debuffing enemies. Her 'Sponsor's Gift' enhances damage output, while 'Capitol Decree' disrupts enemy positioning. 'Refined Sensibilities' provides team-wide Tenacity, and 'Panem's Unifying Power' delivers a powerful burst of buffs and debuffs. 'Mockingjay's Advocate' offers personal sustain and survivability.

abilities.description: Cato, a relentless survivor hardened by countless trials, channels his raw resilience, forging a temporary bond with an ally and mending their wounds by drawing from his own vitality. As the lines of past battles etch deeper, he expends a fraction of his indomitable fortitude to restore a base amount of X health to a single chosen ally, enhanced by 5% of Cato's maximum health. Once this pact is established, Cato imbues his target with a 'Blood Pact', boosting their physical damage by 5% and their magical damage by 10 for 5 seconds, turning the tide of survival. Upon casting, Cato's primal hunting instincts sharpen, increasing his damage by 5% and speed by 3% for 5 seconds in the form of a 'Savage Pursuit' stack. However, each strike of Savage Pursuit has a toll. At three or more stacks of Savage Pursuit, Cato's tactical vision wanes. For each stack of Savage Pursuit, his evasion is reduced by 5%, and the hunt blurs his decision making, creating a 20% chance per stack for his next basic attack to lash out at a random ally instead of the enemy—a constant reminder of the sacrifice for the hunt, and the fine line that lies between survival and demise.

character_v1.playstyle: Haymitch excels as a tactical support, using alcohol to enhance allies while strategically placing deterrents to control the battlefield. abilities.description: Haymitch produces a glass filled with amber liquid, the contents of which appear both innocuous and deceptively potent. Upon imbibing a generous portion himself (for tactical purposes, naturally), Haymitch performs a sweeping, somewhat unsteady gesture towards his allies. The mystical fumes emanating from the glass coalesce around the designated target, providing a refreshing, if somewhat alcoholic, buff. Specifically, this ability grants a moderate heal over time, representing a temporary boost in morale and resilience. Simultaneously, the target benefits from increased attack speed, fueled by a reckless abandon granted by the 'spirits'. However, prolonged exposure can induce a state of 'Drunken Courage', resulting in slightly diminished accuracy but significantly heightened critical hit chance. Manage your team's sobriety wisely, or they might just stumble into victory... or a ditch.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Alright, alright, settle down. Little somethin' to loosen you up...and maybe the enemy's teeth."

abilities.name: Haymitch's Hasty Hooch

Level 150: Reduces the ability's cooldown by 2 seconds. If used with 0 Intoxication, Haymitch gains 10 Intoxication instead.
Level 200: Grants immunity to slows and roots during the duration of the speed boost.

(Patch) Role realignment: Now emphasizes healer-style interactions more effectively.
abilities.description: Haymitch signals for a hasty retreat, splashing a bit of his potent, locally sourced spirits towards his allies. When used with at least 25 Intoxication, all allies within a radius of X are invigorated, receiving a sturdy shield that absorbs damage equal to 15% of Haymitch's magic attack for 3 seconds. This alcoholic surge also propels them forward, increasing their movement speed by 25% for the duration, providing a critical window for repositioning or escape. However, if Haymitch’s Intoxication level is low, below 25, he instead conserves his drink for the ally most in need, the one currently suffering with the lowest health. That ally gains a smaller shield worth 8% of Haymitch's magic attack, along with a 15% speed boost for the same 3-second duration. This strategic imbibing always costs Haymitch 25 Intoxication, focusing his blurred mind.

abilities.name: Sponsor's Tip: Liquid Courage
upgrades: Level 50: The buzz lasts longer; buff duration is increased to 7 seconds.

Level 100: If the target is teetering on the brink of collapse (below 40% health), they also receive a burst heal equal to 10% of Haymitch’s magic attack, mending their wounds just enough to keep them in the fight.

Level 150: Haymitch streamlines his drunken wisdom, reducing the cooldown by 1 second. Furthermore, if Haymitch's Intoxication is completely depleted (at 0) when used, he sobers up enough to shave an additional 50% off the cooldown.
Level 200: Haymitch's pep talk becomes even more potent; the attack and magic attack buff is amplified to 30%, and the defense buff surges to 15%.

abilities.description: Haymitch slurs a few words of (questionable) encouragement, bolstering a single ally with the strength of a thousand bottles. The targeted ally experiences a surge of effectiveness, granting them a 20% increase to both attack and magic attack, alongside a 10% increase to their defense, for a duration of 5 seconds. However, the effectiveness of Haymitch's advice depends on his current state of inebriation. If Haymitch has accumulated over 50 Intoxication before casting this ability, the targeted ally benefits even further, receiving a Cleanse effect that instantly removes all detrimental debuffs affecting them. This potent cocktail of motivation and magical assistance is costly, consuming 30 Intoxication upon use. As Haymitch’s understanding deepens, so does his ability to mentor and protect.

upgrades: Level 50: Intoxication decay rate is reduced to 2 every 7 seconds.

abilities.description: Haymitch starts each encounter with 50 'Intoxication'. 'Intoxication' naturally decays by 2 every 5 seconds. Haymitch gains 3% magic atk and Def per 25 'Intoxication', up to a maximum of 6% magic atk and Def at full Intoxication, reflecting his enhanced tactical awareness when inebriated. When 'Intoxication' reaches 0, Haymitch suffers a 20% reduction to his speed and magic atk.

abilities.name: Abernathy's Gambit: Arena Refraction
upgrades: Level 100: Reduces the initial delay before the 'Refraction Zone' activates to a more responsive 1.5 seconds, allowing for quicker adaptation to dynamic combat situations.
Level 150: Enemies caught within the 'Refraction Zone' also have their movement speed reduced by 20%, hindering their ability to escape its distorted effects.

Level 200: Once the 'Refraction Zone' dissipates, Haymitch gains immunity to the negative effects of 'Intoxication' decay for a period of 10 seconds, allowing a temporary clarity after the chaos subsides.
(Balance Patch) Buff: The scaling of the ability has been improved, providing extra potency at later levels based on the amount of Intoxication consumed.
(Balance Patch) Buff: Further enhancements to the late-game scaling, rewarding strategic Intoxication management with increased area of effect and debuff intensity.
(Patch) Role realignment: This ability now more strongly emphasizes utility and area control, providing greater tactical flexibility.

abilities.description: Haymitch, ever the strategist despite appearances, leverages his… unique perspective to bend the rules of engagement. Upon activation, Haymitch designates a circular area on the battlefield. After a brief, tipsy pause of 2 seconds – time enough for a swig of something strong – this designated zone becomes a 'Refraction Zone' for a duration of 6 seconds. Within this warped space, the laws of trajectory are… adjusted. All projectiles originating from enemy champions inside the Refraction Zone are not merely deflected, but redirected with malicious precision back towards their original casters. However, instead of dealing damage, these returned projectiles restore health to the enemy, healing them for 50% of the projectiles' potential damage. Furthermore, the disoriented enemies within the Refraction Zone become increasingly vulnerable, suffering a 10% increase to all incoming damage during its duration. To fuel this reality-bending feat, Haymitch consumes all of his remaining 'Intoxication.' The radius of the Refraction Zone expands by 10% for every 25 Intoxication consumed, allowing skilled players to maximize its effectiveness through resource management. It's a chaotic gamble, but, as Haymitch would say, always worth a shot.

mechanics: Provides a chance to evade incoming attacks, increasing survivability.
Offers bonus Tenacity, shortening the duration of debuffs applied to Haymitch.
'Drunken Dodge' triggers when health is low, allowing a last-chance escape or repositioning.
abilities.description: When Haymitch's health drops below 25% of his maximum, he utilizes his years of experience and questionable lifestyle to narrowly avoid the next incoming attack. This dodge grants him 40 Intoxication and makes him untargetable for 0.75 seconds. This effect can only occur once every 40 seconds. Haymitch also gains a permanent 15% Tenacity and 10% Evasion.

character_v1.playstyle: Haymitch is built as a support character focusing on team utility and battlefield control. His alcoholism is represented as a resource management system that can boost his abilities, but at a potential cost. His kit rewards tactical play and team coordination.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Haymitch excels at supporting high-damage allies by providing buffs, shields, and debuffs. His 'Capitol Sabotage' can create opportunities for burst damage, while 'Tactical Reprieve' helps the team reposition and survive burst damage. He works especially well with allies who benefit from increased attack speed and damage.
character_v1.tierSummary: Haymitch's kit is strong in utility, cleansing and buffing allies. Elevated to A+ due to his superior support capabilities and evasion-based survivability. His KPS reflects his strategic advantage.

tips: Keep Intoxication above 50 to enable your cleanses and empower your shields, but don't hoard it or you waste potential ultimate radius.
Time Tactical Reprieve to block incoming burst damage, and keep allies mobile.
Use Mentor's Advice primarily on damage dealers to amplify their output.
strategyData.overview: Haymitch is a resource-juggling support who protects allies using shields, buffs, and debuff cleanses. Manage his Intoxication resource to maximize your effectiveness, but don't let it bottom out or you'll become a liability. Proper timing of his ultimate can completely turn the tide of battle, especially against projectile-heavy comps. Otherwise, this guy is awful.
strategyData.counterplay: Punish Haymitch when his Intoxication is low to exploit his speed and magic attack debuff. Burst him down before he can trigger his signature passive, as his evasion and tenacity aren't reliable enough to save him otherwise. Bait out his ultimate and then re-engage once it's over.

teamLineups.note: This comp focuses on keeping Haymitch alive with shields and heals, while providing damage buffs for him to amplify. Vilgax and Orihime offer strong defensive abilities, while Alastor provides damage boosts and some control. Ember Mclain provides additional magic damage support and further reduces enemy magic resistance.
teamLineups.label: Peel & Protect

teamLineups.note: Rukia's control allows Haymitch to safely position and use his ultimate, Ganon provides slow/damage amp to maximize output, Astro provides additional support and defense. Blossom adds to the controller element and provides additional magic damage amplification.
teamLineups.label: Control & Amplify

teamLineups.note: This team offers strong sustain and utility to keep Haymitch and the team alive. Debbie and Atom Eve both provide sustain and protection. Lex and Porkey provide additional utility for various situations.
teamLineups.label: Sustain & Utility

teamLineups.note: This team plays for an aggressive early game, utilizing strong bruisers/tanks with high damage to enable Haymitch to buff effectively. Aeris keeps Haymitch alive with quick damage mitigation, E.T. provides healing. Poison Ivy and Mark Grayson provide front line pressure.
teamLineups.label: Aggressive Support

character_v1.internalSynergy: Haymitch's kit revolves around the strategic use of 'Intoxication'. His active abilities are strengthened by consuming this resource, while his passive provides scaling buffs. Using his ultimate effectively requires anticipating enemy movements and managing his 'Intoxication' level to maximize its impact.

chapters.title: Unlikely Mentors
chapters.mission: Assist Vilgax in navigating a trap-filled environment while intoxicated. Use Haymitch's abilities to strategically manipulate the environment and keep Vilgax alive.
chapters.summary: Haymitch, seeing Vilgax's potential, decides to become his unlikely mentor. He teaches Vilgax the importance of adaptability and thinking outside the box. Haymitch assists Vilgax in a heist while Vilgax is under the influence of intoxication.
chapters.resonanceBuff: Haymitch's White Liquor Cache cooldown is reduced by 30% while Vilgax is under the effects of Aquatic Transformation. Vilgax's Aquatic Transformation applies Taunt to nearby enemies affected by Intoxication.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Haymitch mentors the struggling Vilgax, imparting unconventional wisdom about leadership and resourcefulness.

character_v1.name: Vilgax

abilities.description: Vilgax channels his noxious essence, unleashing a concentrated blast of rancid seawater at a targeted enemy. This vile projectile deals physical damage equal to 50% of Vilgax's Attack stat, scaled multiplicatively by a baseline factor of 1.0x. The corrosive nature of the attack also inflicts the 'Drenched' status effect for 3 seconds, increasing the target's vulnerability to subsequent Water-based attacks by 10%. Furthermore, the initial impact has a 15% chance to inflict 'Tainted,' reducing the target's healing received by 25% for a duration of 2.5 seconds. Should the target already be afflicted with 'Drenched,' the chance to apply 'Tainted' doubles to 30%. The 'Septic Barrage' benefits from Vilgax's raw strength, scaling directly with his Attack stat, enhancing both its base damage and the likelihood of applying debuffs. The chilling intensity of this brackish attack is visually punctuated by swirling eddies of dark green vapor, lingering briefly upon impact and signifying the ongoing decay it inflicts.

abilities.description: Vilgax, fueled by his insatiable desire for conquest, becomes increasingly resilient in the heart of battle. For every enemy champion within a 400-unit radius, Vilgax gains 2% tenacity, reducing the duration of incoming stuns, slows, and other crowd control effects. Simultaneously, he hardens his armor, receiving 1% damage reduction for each nearby foe, mitigating incoming physical and magical damage. This effect stacks up to a maximum of 10% tenacity and 5% damage reduction, transforming Vilgax into an unyielding force when surrounded. Furthermore, Vilgax's basic attacks now carry an imposing taunt. Upon striking an enemy, they are forced to focus their attention and attacks solely on Vilgax for 1 second, making them easy to focus and control.

character_v1.playstyle: Vilgax excels as a tank, absorbing enemy abilities to enhance his durability and control the battlefield. His kit focuses on zone control, resource denial, and adapting to enemy strategies, making him a formidable presence in team fights.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Vilgax provides significant area control and disruption, enabling damage dealers to focus on priority targets. His tankiness and taunt ability make him an ideal frontline champion, while his ability to absorb enemy abilities can provide crucial utility for the team.
character_v1.tierSummary: Vilgax has a mixed kit that doesn't synergize well. Moved up to F+ due to tanking potential from Def and Tenacity but still below avg, KPS adjusted based on overall kit performance.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Vilgax's abilities synergize to create a powerful tank that can absorb enemy abilities and control the battlefield. Relentless Advance increases his durability, while Assimilate and Adapt allows him to gain useful abilities from his enemies. The ultimate enhances his tanking ability significantly. Unyielding Domination ensures he becomes stronger the more he is crowd controlled.

chapters.title: Tech and Terror
chapters.mission: Guide Vilgax through a stealth mission using Tucker's abilities. Vilgax must remain undetected while collecting valuable tech components.
chapters.summary: Vilgax seeks to understand and utilize Earth technology. Tucker, seeing Vilgax's potential, agrees to teach him, but on the condition that Vilgax assists him in a 'meat-related' task. Use Tucker's abilities to guide Vilgax through a stealth mission.

character_v1.playstyle: Tucker's abilities are skewed towards a skirmisher role due to his capacity to enhance allies and disrupt enemies, but his occasional access to powerful offensive abilities allows him to directly engage as needed.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Tucker synergizes well with damage-focused compositions, providing attack speed and magic damage buffs while disrupting enemy positioning and control. His Meat Sense enhances map awareness, aiding in ganks and objective control. His ultimate can provide area control and damage during crucial team fights.
character_v1.tierSummary: Tucker, while boasting a varied kit, suffers from a lack of focus. Moving to B+ as his PDA and support abilities offer decent utility. KPS reflects a balanced but not exceptional kit.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Tucker's PDA Hack can set up enemies for enhanced damage from allies, while Techno-Boost can amplify the effectiveness of damage dealers. Meat Sense provides crucial information for strategic positioning. King Tuck's transformation offers burst damage potential but demands careful timing due to the subsequent Exhaustion. Ghostly Intuition allows Tucker to reactively support allies and disrupt enemies more frequently.

abilities.description: Alfred, with a knowing grimace, deploys a cleverly concealed array of caltrops at a targeted location, creating a zone of momentary chaos. Any foes unfortunate enough to tread within this spiky minefield immediately find their advance stymied. Upon activation, Alfred selects a ground location within a 600-unit range. A 300-unit radius area is then instantly seeded with caltrops, remaining active for 5 seconds. Enemies entering this area are immediately subjected to a 40% movement speed reduction for 2 seconds. Additionally, affected enemies suffer 10 damage per second while within the field, a constant reminder of Alfred's resourceful defenses. Further amplifying Alfred's tactical prowess, allies traversing the caltrop field gain a 20% increase to their armor for 3 seconds, representing a brief window of reinforced resilience as they push forward, making this gambit ideal for both defensive maneuvers and aggressive counter-attacks.

abilities.description: Alfred channels his decades of experience and stern disapproval into a focused beam of revitalizing energy. Upon activation, Alfred swiftly recalibrates a single ally's condition, mending their wounds and bolstering their resolve. This ability projects a narrow, concentrated ray that instantly heals the target for an amount scaling with Alfred's ATK and a percentage of their missing health. The beam also grants the ally a temporary buff, 'Proper Bearing,' increasing their resistance to debuffs and interrupting effects for a short duration. While Corrective Reprimand prioritizes healing, its true strength lies in its ability to swiftly counteract debilitating conditions and ensure that allies maintain unwavering focus in the face of adversity. The buff lasts for a duration determined by upgrade level. Proper application requires foresight and precise timing, making it invaluable for preventing devastating status ailments and maintaining momentum during crucial moments.

abilities.description: Alfred, ever the bastion of calm in a storm, employs his extensive knowledge of first aid and herbal remedies to alleviate the suffering of allies. 'A Soothing Balm' is a passive ability that triggers upon an ally taking damage exceeding a certain threshold (scaling with Alfred's level). Upon activation, Alfred swiftly and efficiently applies a revitalizing balm, momentarily halting the advance of debilitating ailments and bolstering the target's resolve. This balm provides an immediate burst of healing (scaling with Alfred’s healing power and the target's missing health), followed by a lingering regeneration effect that restores health gradually over a brief duration. Furthermore, the soothing properties of the balm grant the afflicted ally a temporary buff to their status resistance, mitigating the impact of future afflictions from foes that dare to impede the party's progress, because certainly Alfred doesn’t approve of poor treatment to good people!
abilities.flavorQuote: There, there, a little tending is all that's required.

character_v1.playstyle: Alfred is a strategic healer who focuses on positioning, resource management, and proactive support. His abilities emphasize tactical awareness and precise execution, rewarding players who can anticipate enemy movements and protect their team with timely interventions.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Alfred excels in teams that require precise positioning and protection. He synergizes well with high-damage carries who benefit from the attack speed boost provided by Adrenaline Shot and the invulnerability from Emergency Extraction. His smoke screen can enable stealth-based allies to engage or disengage more effectively. His magic resistance buff can benefit mages.
character_v1.tierSummary: Alfred is a decent support with some utility. Staying in C+ because of average stats and not much output but valuable support.

tips: Prioritize upgrading 'Wayne Family Protocol'. A longer invulnerability window and extra shield can save your carry from getting bursted down.
Use 'Tactical Deployment: Smoke Screen Evasion' proactively to disrupt enemy vision and create opportunities for your team to reposition or engage.
Don't rely on Alfred for damage. His 'Piercing Emergency' and 'Rapid Unflappable' skills deal damage, but are there to supplement his support capabilities, not carry the fight. Focus on utility!
strategyData.overview: Alfred is a utility-focused support character who excels at disrupting enemy formations and saving allies from certain doom. He's not going to carry any fights, but his kit offers clutch evasion, emergency teleports, and magic resistance that can turn the tide. Positioning and timing are KEY.
strategyData.counterplay: Punish Alfred's positioning. He needs to be close to allies to use his ultimate effectively, making him vulnerable to AoE damage and crowd control. Bait out his 'Secret Service Training' by using ultimates outside of its range. Avoid fighting inside of his smoke screen.

abilities.description: Vee activates her microphone, scanning the battlefield for valuable intel. Upon activation, the player is presented with a trivia question related to enemy abilities. abilities.name: Commercial Break
abilities.description: Vee interrupts the flow of battle, broadcasting an amusing yet strategic commercial. The player receives a trivia question regarding allied heroes and their strengths. A correct answer grants all nearby allies a temporary buff, increasing their attack damage by X% and magic attack by X% for 8 seconds. In addition, correctly answering the trivia question also grants allies within range a 10% increase to their tenacity for 4 seconds, making them more resistant to crowd control effects and enhancing their survivability in team fights. An incorrect answer subjects allies to a wave of 'Ad Fatigue,' reducing their attack damage by X/2% and magic attack by X/2% for 4 seconds. This ability has a 25-second cooldown and affects allies within X units of Vee.
abilities.flavorQuote: And now, a word from our sponsors... or maybe not!

upgrades: (Patch) Adds a cleanse to remove debuffs on a correct answer, enhancing its utility in removing harmful effects.

abilities.description: Vee initiates a deep diagnostic scan on a targeted ally within her operational range. This comprehensive assessment takes the form of a trivia question, probing for vital information regarding the selected ally’s well-being and combat readiness. A correct response to Vee's inquiry triggers a 'System Restore,' instantly mending the target's digital framework and restoring X% of their missing health. Moreover, the System Restore grants the targeted ally a 'Shield Buffer,' absorbing damage equal to 20% of Vee's total AP and lasting for 4 seconds, bolstering their defenses against incoming threats. As a bonus, for every 1% of health healed by System Restore, the ally gains 1 additional armor and magic resistance, scaling up to a maximum of 10% bonus armor and magic resistance for 4 seconds. An incorrect response results in a 'Minor Corruption,' dealing a small amount of damage equal to 10% of Vee's AP to the target over 3 seconds, but providing a burst of 15% additional healing for 4 seconds to the ally. Vee's advanced diagnostics can only be run every 30 seconds, requiring her systems to recalibrate between assessments.

abilities.name: Behind the Scenes
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~14% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Vee's extensive knowledge of the inner workings of the arena grants her and her allies a strategic advantage. Vee passively gains knowledge of an approaching enemy's strongest stat every 30 seconds. The next time Vee uses an ability, a trivia question appears related to counteracting the revealed stat. Answering correctly grants a stacking buff of 5% resistance to that stat per ally nearby within X units, up to a maximum of 25%. Additionally, answering correctly grants a 'Counter Intel' buff, reducing the cooldown of Vee's next ability by 1 second per nearby ally, up to a maximum of 5 seconds. Answering incorrectly causes Vee to gain 5% vulnerability to that stat for 5 seconds. This passive effect has a 45 second internal cooldown.
abilities.flavorQuote: I know your secrets. Do *you* know mine?

character_v1.teamSynergy: Vee excels in teams that can capitalize on her buffs and debuffs. High-damage carries benefit greatly from her 'Commercial Break' and 'Grand Finale,' while bruisers appreciate the speed and damage reduction provided by 'Technical Difficulties.' Her vision control from 'Mic Check' also allows for coordinated engages and objective control.
character_v1.tierSummary: Vee's 'Trivia Stream' gimmick is a fatal flaw; mechanics reliant on real-world knowledge are inherently unbalanced and uncompetitive. Her kit, theoretically a support hybrid with vision, buffs, and sustain, suffers from a lack of focus and questionable scaling. 'Mic Check' could be valuable for revealing stealth, but the 'Commercial Break' buff/debuff is highly inconsistent and likely negligible in practice. 'Diagnostic Scan' provides sustain, but dedicated healers will likely outperform it. Passive 'Behind the Scenes' provides a marginal strategic advantage, but the overall design lacks the raw power and reliable utility necessary to displace established supports. Vee appears destined for low-tier obscurity, offering neither overwhelming synergy nor meta-defining disruption.

tips: Prioritize 'Pop Quiz' to lock down high-priority targets; the confusion it inflicts can turn the tide of a fight, especially once upgraded.
Use 'Reboot' proactively for both the cleanse and mobility; don't save it just for emergencies.
Maximize 'Data Stream's cone to apply 'Parse Error' to multiple enemies; the stacked atk reduction can significantly weaken enemy damage output.
strategyData.overview: Vee is a utility character who is designed to disrupt enemies and provide some support for her team. Her kit is a mixed bag of damage and control, but she lacks the raw power to be a primary damage dealer. You'll need to play smart and focus on using your abilities to create opportunities for your teammates.
strategyData.counterplay: Vee is vulnerable to burst damage since her shield from 'Critical Glitch' requires her to get crit first. Hard CC also shuts her down, preventing her from using 'Reboot' to escape. Focus fire and prevent her from kiting to neutralize her effectiveness.

abilities.description: Sovereign Bloom — a wind single-target providing supportive utility that reflects the essence of Danny Phantom. As a utility, On cast: this ability targets a single enemy at short range, dealing precisely tuned wind damage. The strike is designed with a specific frame data profile: it triggers a singular, heavy-impact blow. Mechanically, the damage output scales primarily with the character's ATK stat, while deriving secondary potency from Luck and critical hit modifiers. Furthermore, the ability applies a primary elemental interaction. This move should be used strategically in a rotation, ideally after gap-closers or as a decisive finisher for low-HP foes.

abilities.description: Danny Phantom focuses his spectral energy, conjuring a shimmering, translucent, teal-colored Ghost Shield encompassing himself and nearby allies within a 7-unit radius. This protective sphere, sustained by Danny's concentration for up to 6 seconds, absorbs incoming damage equivalent to 99% of Danny's Defense stat plus 77% of his bonus Health, preferentially shielding allies nestled within its ghostly embrace. The shield emanates a soothing aura, mending the wounds of those it shelters, restoring 5% of their maximum health every second. The vibrant intensity of the teal glow mirrors Danny's vitality, radiating brightly at full health and gradually dimming to a faint, ethereal glimmer as his condition deteriorates. Should an enemy attempt to penetrate the Ghost Shield's boundary, they are instantly assailed by a concentrated blast of ectoplasmic energy, inflicting magic damage scaling from 6% of their maximum health and inflicting Ghostly Chills for 1 second, slowing their movement speed by 30% and hindering their attacks. Moreover, allies cloaked within the Ghost Shield's protective aura immediately gain a 15% increase in movement speed, enabling them to swiftly reposition or capitalize on tactical opportunities while safeguarded. When the Ghost Shield ultimately dissipates, whether through expiration or intentional deactivation, it unleashes a final surge of restorative energy, healing allies for 30% of the shield's remaining health, up to a maximum heal of 175, ensuring lasting benefit even in its final moments.

abilities.description: Spectral Tether: Danny channels ectoplasmic energy, forming a translucent, shimmering tether that latches onto a targeted enemy. Upon activation, Danny launches a spectral rope toward a designated foe within medium range. This rope, composed of solidified ghost energy, deals initial damage based on Danny's attack stat, and then applies a secondary effect based on the enemy type and current game phase. Humanoid enemies suffer a brief 'Fear' effect, causing them to flee uncontrollably for a short duration, whilst spectral enemies become 'Suppressed,' reducing their damage output and incoming healing for a slightly longer period. Non-spectral, non-humanoid enemies instead suffer from decreased movement speed. Scaling: Primary damage scales with Attack; the effect duration is affected by Luck and any applicable debuff potency bonuses. Use to disrupt enemy formations, interrupt powerful attacks, or debuff particularly troublesome foes to improve your team's survivability.

abilities.description: Channeling the raw, untamed power of his ghost half, Danny Phantom unleashes a focused blast of spectral energy, the Ghostly Wail, aimed at a single enemy within a 400-unit range. This initial blast freezes foes with spectral ice, inflicting damage equal to 60% of Danny's Attack, and potentially scaling up to 120% depending on his Luck. This potent attack has a cooldown of 8 seconds before it can be unleashed again. If the Ghostly Wail lands as a critical hit, amplifying its icy power by 50%, it also chills the target, reducing their movement speed by 20% for 2 seconds, providing Danny and his team with an opportunity to strategically engage or retreat as needed. Furthermore, the effectiveness of this Chill effect can be intensified by Danny's Luck, reaching a maximum slow of 40%, further hindering the enemy's mobility. As the Wail's spectral echoes resonate with the target, it also applies a special 'Marked' status effect.

abilities.description: Danny Phantom's unique half-ghost physiology grants him a natural resistance to the chaos of battle, providing 30 Tenacity, reducing the duration of incoming disables, and 30 Evasion, increasing his chance to dodge incoming attacks. Furthermore, when Danny's spectral form is truly threatened, and he is reduced to or below 25% of his maximum health by an enemy attack, he instinctively unleashes a burst of ghostly energy. character_v1.playstyle: Danny Phantom is designed as a utility character, switching between human and ghost forms to provide versatile support, damage mitigation, and strategic advantages to his team. abilities.description: Every 15 seconds, Poison Ivy spontaneously generates a shield of interwoven vines and thorny growths, absorbing incoming damage. This barrier possesses a strength equivalent to 10% of Ivy's maximum health, providing a substantial buffer against direct attacks and potent abilities. The thorny shield remains active for 5 seconds, during which time any attacker unfortunate enough to strike it directly suffers the consequences. Should Ivy be struck by an enemy currently suffering from Poison, the natural regenerative properties of her botanical defenses kick into high gear, immediately reducing the cooldown of Thorned Embrace by 3 seconds, allowing her to re-establish her defenses more quickly. This ensures that enemies relying on sustained poisoning tactics inadvertently bolster Ivy's resilience, creating a dangerous feedback loop. The ability emphasizes damage-style interactions.

character_v1.playstyle: Poison Ivy excels as a bruiser by controlling the battlefield with plant-based traps and summons, applying debilitating poisons, and charming enemies to turn them against each other. tips: Maximize Poison stacks: Use Thorn Whip and Entangling Roots to consistently apply Poison, amplifying your damage and triggering Toxin Immunity's effects.

strategyData.overview: Poison Ivy is a bruiser who specializes in controlling enemies with poison and charms. Her kit revolves around stacking poison and using her ultimate to turn enemies against each other. She's best played aggressively, applying pressure with her DoTs and setting up opportunities for her team.
strategyData.counterplay: Ivy is vulnerable to burst damage, heroes that can cleanse poison, and those who can quickly eliminate her before she stacks poison. Focus fire to take her down before she can control the battlefield. If you can outrange her Entangling Roots, you limit her poison stacking. Tenacity-reducing effects will also help to mitigate her crowd control.

abilities.name: Sweet Spot
abilities.description: Yatta designates a target area, showering it with a cascade of colorful candies over 3 seconds. Allies within the area who pick up the candies gain a 'Sugar Rush,' increasing their movement speed by 10% and attack speed by 7% for 4 seconds. Enemies caught in the area are inflicted with 'Sugar Crash,' reducing their movement speed by 10% and attack speed by 7% for 4 seconds. Each candy picked up grants 1 stack of 'Candy Craze'. The size of the area increases by 5% and the duration of the speed and attack speed buffs/debuffs is extended by 0.25 seconds for every 5 stacks of 'Candy Craze' Yatta possesses, up to a maximum of 50%. The base radius of 'Sweet Spot' is reduced by 10%.
abilities.flavorQuote: Everyone deserves a little treat… or maybe a whole lot!

abilities.name: Sugar Shell
abilities.description: Yatta coats an ally in a sugary shell, granting them a shield that absorbs X amount of damage for 4 seconds. The amount of damage absorbed is equal to 8% of Yatta's maximum HP, scaling with 60% of her magic attack. Each candy picked up by the shielded ally while the shield is active grants them 1 stack of 'Candy Craze'. Additionally, upon the shield breaking or expiring, the ally releases a burst of sugary energy, healing themselves for 3% of the damage absorbed by the shield. If Yatta has 50 or more stacks of 'Candy Craze' when casting this ability, the shield also grants immunity to slows only for its duration.
abilities.flavorQuote: Don't worry, I'll keep you safe… with sweetness!

abilities.name: Candy Comet
abilities.description: Yatta launches a high-velocity candy projectile at a target enemy, dealing X magic damage upon impact. The damage is equal to 65% of Yatta's magic attack, plus an additional 3% for each stack of 'Candy Craze' she possesses, up to a maximum of 50%. Upon hitting the target, the Candy Comet explodes, scattering candies in a small area around the impact zone. Enemies struck by the explosion have their magic defense reduced by 7% for 2.5 seconds. Allies picking up these candies gain 1 stack of 'Candy Craze'. If Yatta has 75 stacks of 'Candy Craze' when using this ability, the Candy Comet slows the target by 30% for 1 second upon impact.
abilities.flavorQuote: Here comes a little something... straight to your face!

abilities.name: Sugar Rush Overload
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~44%).
abilities.description: Yatta unleashes a wave of pure sugary energy, instantly consuming all stacks of 'Candy Craze'. For every stack consumed, allies within a large radius gain a 0.75% increase to their attack, defense, magic attack, and magic defense for 6 seconds. Enemies within the same radius suffer a 0.75% decrease to their attack, defense, magic attack, and magic defense for 6 seconds. After the effect ends, allies are healed for 0.75% of their maximum HP per 'Candy Craze' stack consumed, while enemies take true damage equal to 0.75% of their maximum HP per stack consumed. This ability has a longer cooldown, but its impact can be game-changing.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time to turn up the sweetness... all the way to eleven!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Yatta excels in teams that can capitalize on her area control and stat buffs. Melee-focused compositions benefit from the movement and attack speed boosts from 'Sweet Spot', while ranged carries appreciate the protection and healing from 'Sugar Shield'. High-damage burst teams can leverage the amplified damage provided by 'Sugar Rush Overload'. Her ability to manipulate enemy positioning with 'Candy Comet' and 'Sweet Spot' also makes her valuable for setting up engages and disengages.
character_v1.tierSummary: Yatta possesses high scaling and strong AoE debuffs. Her A+ tier reflects her ability to control the battlefield.

tips: Maximize Candy Craze: Your entire kit depends on stacking 'Candy Craze'. Prioritize using Sweet Spot frequently, and position it where allies can easily grab the candies.
Time Sugar Rush Overload: Save your ultimate for when you have a high number of Candy Craze stacks to maximize the buffs, debuffs, healing, and damage.
Protect Your Candy Carrier: If a teammate is actively collecting candies, use Sugar Shell on them to keep them alive and further boost their Candy Craze stacks.
strategyData.overview: Yatta is a stat-buffing hybrid that needs to constantly collect candies to make any of her abilities worthwhile. Without 'Candy Craze' stacks, Yatta's abilities are mediocre, but with a lot of stacks, she can be a solid offensive and defensive support. Hope your teammates are on board with picking up all those candies!
strategyData.counterplay: Deny Candy Craze stacks: If Yatta's teammates can't get candies, Yatta's abilities become far less effective. Zone out her teammates or kill the ones trying to get candies. Burst her down: Yatta is fairly squishy and needs time to ramp up. Focus her down before she can get enough Candy Craze stacks to be a threat.

character_v1.internalSynergy: Yatta's kit synergizes around her 'Candy Craze' mechanic, with her abilities either generating candies, consuming them, or scaling based on the number of stacks. 'Sweet Spot' creates area control, 'Sugar Shield' provides protection and sustain, 'Candy Comet' offers offensive utility, and 'Sugar Rush Overload' delivers a powerful burst of team-wide buffs and debuffs. This creates a dynamic playstyle where careful candy management and strategic ability usage are crucial.

character_v1.playstyle: Deceptive assassination with resource-managed decoys. Requires strategic planning and precise execution.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Blot excels in teams that can capitalize on his distractions and debuffs, such as high-damage burst assassins or mages who can quickly eliminate enemies caught out of position. character_v1.tierSummary: Blot's kit is reliant on resource management and untargetability, with low impact. His F- tier reflects his difficulty in performing consistently.

tips: Prioritize applying 'Inked' with Ink Evasion to debuff enemies, increasing the damage they take via Backwards Talk.
Use Tape Clone strategically to taunt enemies and create openings for your team, especially when diving into the backline.

strategyData.overview: Blot is a slippery assassin who thrives on hit-and-run tactics, debuffing enemies with 'Inked', and controlling the battlefield with Ink Slicks and Tape Clones. Master the art of evasion and maximizing damage against 'Inked' targets to succeed, as Blot can't take a beating himself.
strategyData.counterplay: Focus fire on Blot to exploit his low health pool and limited defensive capabilities. Crowd control effects shut him down, preventing him from applying 'Inked' and making him an easy target. Avoid grouping up too closely to minimize the impact of Tape Clone's taunt and Ink Slick's slow.

abilities.description: Sukuna carves through the very essence of his target, unleashing a brutal slash that rends flesh and spirit alike, inflicting immense physical damage equal to X plus 100% of Sukuna's Attack. This vicious strike tears open grievous wounds, applying Bleed to the target. The Bleed effect causes the target to suffer additional physical damage equal to 10% of the initial Cleave damage over 3 seconds, a torturous reminder of Sukuna's power. Furthermore, Sukuna capitalizes on his opponent's weakened state; if the target is already afflicted by Bleed when Cleave connects, the initial physical damage of Cleave is amplified by 15%, punishing their existing suffering. Unleash Cleave to exploit openings and ensure your enemies drown in their own blood. Prioritize bleeding targets to maximize damage and control the flow of battle with calculated cruelty, ensuring your dominance with each precise and devastating strike.

abilities.name: Divergent Dismember
upgrades: Level 60: Reduces the cooldown of Divergent Dismember by 1 second, allowing Sukuna to use this ability more frequently and maintain relentless pressure on his opponents.

Level 110: After teleporting, Sukuna's next basic attack is infused with cursed energy, dealing bonus damage equal to 30% of his ATK, ensuring that his sudden arrival is met with immediate and devastating force.

abilities.description: Sukuna carves a path through reality, instantly repositioning himself with cruel and uncanny speed. He tears the fabric of space, vanishing and reappearing up to 6 units away in a chosen direction, contingent on terrain and obstructions that might impede his malevolent transit. This ability initiates a cooldown of 8 seconds, demanding strategic foresight and calculated aggression to maximize its potential. Upon activation, Sukuna leaves behind a shimmering, residual trace of cursed energy, a momentary distortion that serves as a reminder of his terrifying speed. Sukuna becomes a harbinger of inescapable doom, exploiting Divergent Dismember to close the distance and unleash a flurry of strikes, or to elude the grasp of pursuers, leaving chaos and despair in his wake. Time your movements carefully, for Sukuna's wrath is most potent when his presence is least expected.

character_v1.playstyle: Sukuna is a hyper-aggressive damage dealer who excels at burst damage and zone control through the strategic use of his Shrine. His Ten Shadows abilities provide versatile options for adaptation and disruption.

character_v1.tierSummary: Sukuna's kit is straightforward with limited utility. His E+ tier reflects his early-game viability but falls off due to a lack of scaling.

abilities.description: Leo, ever the mischievous coder, unleashes a torrent of distracting pop-up windows and glitchy code directly into the mind of his target. This digital onslaught deals a burst of magic damage to a single enemy, scaling powerfully with Leo's Magic Attack. The potency of this digital disruption is somewhat unpredictable, inflicting damage that fluctuates between 50% and 150% of his base magic attack value, reflecting the chaotic nature of hastily written code. As the barrage intensifies, there's a 40% chance that the sheer overload of information will induce a debilitating effect on the target for 3 seconds. This effect is randomly chosen from Silence, preventing them from casting abilities; Slow, reducing their movement speed; or Weaken, lowering their damage output, ensuring the target is thoroughly disrupted and vulnerable to Leo's allies.

abilities.description: Leo frantically searches for a box, then dives headfirst into it, becoming invulnerable for 2 seconds. Upon exiting the box, Leo launches himself at the nearest enemy, dealing physical damage equal to 75% of his attack stat and stunning them for 1 second. character_v1.playstyle: Leo thrives on chaotic, damage-focused gameplay, utilizing unpredictable basic attacks and abilities to overwhelm enemies with random effects. He relies on surprising burst damage and disrupting enemy strategies through his inherent idiocy, making him a high-risk, high-reward character.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Leo works well with teams that can capitalize on chaos and randomness. Characters that can benefit from being randomly targeted, or that have abilities that work regardless of the target, will pair well with him. He can also disrupt enemy strategies, creating openings for his allies to exploit.
character_v1.tierSummary: Leo has burst potential and invulnerability frames but lacks consistent sustain or damage mitigation. His kit relies heavily on lucky procs. B- balances his strengths and weaknesses.

tips: Prioritize ATK: Maximize the damage from your basic attack and scaling abilities. You'll need all the help you can get to offset the randomness.
Mitigate Risks: Pair Leo with healers and tanks who can keep him alive through his self-inflicted debuffs and unfortunate Idiot's Luck procs.
Embrace the Chaos: Accept that some matches will be out of your control. Focus on making the most of the positive outcomes when they occur.
strategyData.overview: Leo is a physical damage dealer defined by randomness, with both active and passive abilities that can have unpredictable outcomes. This can lead to high-risk, high-reward gameplay, but also makes him unreliable in strategic team compositions. He's at his best when he can survive long enough for his buffs to stack, but his self-debuffs and reliance on chance make this a tall order.
strategyData.counterplay: Exploit Leo's unreliability. Target him early to prevent him from stacking buffs, and be ready to capitalize on his self-stuns or self-damage. Status ailment-heavy teams will ruin his day because of his very low Tenacity.

character_v1.teamSynergy: Aeris works well with teams that can either protect her while she builds Annoyance or that benefit from her brief bursts of damage and crowd control during Rage Quit. character_v1.tierSummary: Aeris, previously at C, has a mixed kit. While she possesses healing and utility, her scaling is weak, and she lacks reliable damage output. Her 'Tilt Proof' passive is interesting but insufficient for higher tiers. Lowered to D due to limited impact.

tips: Track your Annoyance: Understanding when Aeris is Calm or Annoyed is critical to making the right play; you need to be aware of the threshold to get the effect you want.
Use Ragequit strategically: This is your primary Annoyance-generating ability; use it wisely to switch between buffing and debuffing.
Prioritize targets with Static Shock: This ability targets the lowest health enemy, making it great for finishing off weakened opponents.
strategyData.overview: Aeris is a bruiser who oscillates between supporting her team and disrupting the enemy, based on her Annoyance level. Managing this resource is key to maximizing her effectiveness. You will need to balance when you want to shield/buff your allies, and when to stun/silence the enemy team.
strategyData.counterplay: Control her Annoyance: Preventing her from reaching the desired Annoyance state will disrupt her gameplan; CC and burst damage are effective. Watch for patterns in her Ragequit usage: Predict her shifts between Calm and Annoyed to anticipate her next move.

character_v1.internalSynergy: Aeris' kit revolves around building and managing her Annoyance level. Keyboard Fury and Mouse Precision both scale with Annoyance, while Alt+Tab Escape provides an escape tool and small amount of Annoyance. Rage Quit is her ultimate release, consuming all Annoyance for a burst of power. The passive, Tilt Proof, ties everything together, rewarding aggressive play and punishing teammates' mistakes by increasing Annoyance and providing a power boost.

abilities.description: Zuko channels the power of the Dancing Dragon, unleashing a wave of fire in a sweeping arc. This fiery display can strike up to three enemies within the immediate area, inflicting an initial burst of 50 magic damage enhanced by 25% of Zuko's Magic Power. The true artistry of the Dancing Dragon lies not just in the initial strike but in the fiery aftermath. After the initial wave, a path of flames remains for 4 seconds, turning the ground into a treacherous landscape. Any enemy unfortunate enough to step onto this burning ground will suffer 15 magic damage every half-second, augmented by 5% of Zuko's Magic Power. The Dancing Dragon technique also amplifies the effect of Zuko's Burning Resolve. If a foe caught in either the initial blast or the subsequent flames is already afflicted with stacks of Burning Resolve, each stack intensifies the inferno as it is consumed, dealing an additional 10 fire damage plus 2% of Zuko's Magic Power for each consumed stack. This skillful technique can dictate the flow of battle, punishing enemies for their every misstep and creating an advantage for Zuko and his allies.

abilities.description: Zuko's burning resolve intensifies as he faces adversity, transforming his inner turmoil into tangible strength. For each enemy hero within a 800-unit radius, Zuko channels his rage, gaining 3 (+0.5 per level) Attack Damage and 2% (+0.3% per level) Attack Speed. This effect stacks multiplicatively, amplifying his combat prowess as the odds stack against him. This internal fire ignites even brighter when Zuko is wounded; when his health falls below 50%, the Attack Damage and Attack Speed bonuses granted by each nearby enemy hero are doubled. This surge of adrenaline steels his will, pushing him to fight harder when faced with danger. Moreover, as Zuko stands against a crowd, his resilience grows. For each nearby enemy hero within the same 800-unit radius, he gains 3 (+0.5 per level) Tenacity. This heightened tenacity reduces the duration of incoming crowd control effects, granting him increased resistance to stuns, slows, and other debilitating conditions. Zuko's determination ensures he can maintain his focus on the battle, even when outnumbered.

character_v1.teamSynergy: Zuko benefits from teammates who can provide crowd control to keep enemies within range of his abilities. He also synergizes well with allies who can amplify fire damage.

abilities.description: Astral Embrace manifests Astro's innate ability to manipulate the very fabric of sleep. Upon activation, Astro momentarily fades into a spectral form, becoming partially invulnerable as they dash a short distance toward the targeted ally. Upon reaching their comrade, Astro emits a wave of comforting, astral energy. This wave does not directly harm enemies but instead bolsters the targeted ally with a restorative shield, its strength scaling principally with Astro's maximum HP and defensive stats, ensuring resilience even against formidable foes. Further, the 'Astral Embrace' bestows a subtle yet impactful buff, temporarily amplifying the ally's resistance to status ailments by a modest degree. The primary function, however, lies in its immediate soothing effect: clearing one detrimental debuff from the targeted ally, be it a potent poison, a debilitating slow, or a silencing hex. In essence, 'Astral Embrace' isn't merely a shield; it's a lifeline woven from the very essence of peaceful slumber, designed to keep allies safe and unburdened in the heart of battle.

abilities.description: Ricochet Disc — Robin hurls a specialized batarang, a sleek disc weapon designed for precision and calculated impact. This ability is best used against tightly packed groups or to extend pressure to secondary targets following a successful engagement. A truly tactical move.

abilities.description: Vegetarian Vamp — a transformative, debuff-focused support ability reflective of Sam's unique brand of rebellion. On activation, Sam manifests a spectral aura of raw, untamed nature, channeling the earth's primal energies. This manifests visually as thorny vines that erupt from the ground in a targeted area, ensnaring enemies within a moderate radius. These vines not only impede the movement of affected foes, inflicting a potent slowing effect (reducing movement speed by 40% for a duration of 5 seconds), but also drain a percentage of their attack power (reducing ATK by 15% for the same duration), redistributing a portion of it to the ally with the lowest current health. The amount of ATK drained and granted scales modestly with Sam's elemental mastery stat and total HP. Furthermore, each enemy trapped within the Vegetarian Vamp is afflicted with a stacking 'Compost' debuff. Each stack of Compost reduces the affected enemy's resistance to nature-based damage by 3%, up to a maximum of 9%. Aesthetically, the ability showcases dark purples and vibrant greens, mirroring Sam's signature color palette.

abilities.description: Sam Manson, drawing upon her deep connection to the shadows and her unique aesthetic, conjures a personal haven for a chosen ally. Upon activation, Sam manipulates the ambient gloom, forming a swirling vortex of dark energy around the targeted ally, or around herself if no ally is specifically chosen. This shadowy manifestation coalesces into a protective barrier, a spectral sanctuary manifested as a swirling vortex of darkness, visually reminiscent of a gothic cathedral, emanating a pulsating aura of protective energy. This sanctuary grants the target a substantial shield composed of solidified shadow energy, absorbing incoming damage equal to 40% of Sam's support stat plus 10% of her level. The spectral sanctuary possesses an intriguing reaction to elemental attacks: when struck by Fire, Ice, or Lightning, the structure shimmers, 'consuming' a portion of that element and converting it into a temporary boost for the shielded target. Fire energy is converted into increased ATK, boosting the target's attack damage by 15% for 4 seconds. Ice is converted into increased DEF, enhancing the target's defensive capabilities by 20% for 4 seconds. Lightning is converted into increased Speed, granting the target a 25% boost to their movement speed for 4 seconds. This spectral haven persists for 6 seconds, providing sustained protection while the converted elemental power surges through the recipient. The ability prioritizes shielding allies with the lowest remaining health percentage, ensuring that Sam's aid goes to those who need it most.

abilities.description: Sam's innate connection to the occult allows her to twist shadows into a potent personal defense and devastating offensive tool. Her rebellious spirit grants her 10 tenacity, further augmented by 0.1 for every point of luck she possesses, lessening the duration of all incoming crowd control effects. More importantly, when an 'Occult Resonance' field materializes, Sam is enveloped by a 'Shadow Resonance,' a shimmering aura of dark energy that persists for 3 seconds. This aura fortifies her, granting 5 bonus armor and magic resistance, increasing by 0.05 for each point of luck she possesses, warding off incoming damage. As the 'Shadow Resonance' dissipates, it unleashes a wave of concentrated goth energy, dealing 50 magic damage to all foes caught within a 4-unit radius, with an additional 0.2 magic damage for every point of luck Sam holds. These unfortunate targets are also afflicted with 'Marked for Rebellion' for 4 seconds, causing them to receive 15% more damage from the next ability Sam casts, ensuring that her enemies pay the price for underestimating the power of a goth girl's conviction and cunning.

character_v1.playstyle: Sam Manson is a support character, creating disruption, supporting allies, and controlling the battlefield using strategically placed traps and terrain manipulation through her understanding of the occult and the application of Fenton technology. The kit is heavily designed to enable her to generate and manipulate zones on the battlefield that empower allies and debilitate foes.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Sam excels in team compositions that benefit from area control and support. Her 'Occult Resonance' fields provide buffs for allies, debuffs for enemies, and a safe zone for sustained engagements. High-damage carries can capitalize on the damage buffs, while tanks and bruisers benefit from the increased healing received and tenacity. She synergizes well with characters that can displace enemies into her traps or extend the duration of her 'Occult Resonance' fields.
character_v1.tierSummary: Sam Manson, formerly B-, boasts great support potential but lacks consistent offensive pressure. Her crowd control and debuffs are valuable, but her low HP hinders her survivability. Positioned at C to reflect her role as a niche support character. Kit overlap requires pruning.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Sam's kit is designed around generating and utilizing 'Occult Resonance' fields. Her Spectral Decoy and Ectoplasmic Webcaster Trap create these fields, while her Protective Spectral Aura passively generates them when allies are damaged. Her Ultimate Goth Empowerment Ritual creates a large and powerful field, amplifying the benefits for allies and hindering enemies. The Dark Arts Expertise: Ethereal Shift passive provides survivability, allowing Sam to effectively position and maintain these fields.

abilities.description: Ember channels her inner rock star, unleashing a focused blast of fiery sound from her guitar, dealing physical damage equivalent to 20% of her Attack plus an additional 5% of her attack as bonus fire damage. This attack is ranged, striking a single target with pinpoint accuracy. The sheer force of the sonic-fire assault also ignites the target, inflicting a 'Burning' debuff. This debuff deals damage per second equal to 2% of Ember’s total attack, applied as fire damage for 3 seconds. This attack's base damage and burning damage scales up with Ember's level.

abilities.description: Sonic Boom projects a targeted, cone-shaped wave of pure sound energy. The essence of this ability embodies Ember's love for music and her rebellious spirit. Upon activation, Ember strums her guitar, unleashing a concentrated burst of sonic force directly ahead. Enemies caught within the cone are blasted with sonic damage, which scales primarily with ATK and Charisma, and secondarily with Luck for critical hits. The Sonic Boom's range is short to medium. This move applies 'Weakened' for a duration equal to 2 turns. This move synergizes with allies who specialize in follow-up attacks and debuff amplification. It also causes disruption and chaos on the battlefield, reflecting Ember's disruptive personality. The ability's visual effects include vibrant soundwaves emanating from Ember's guitar. This ability may be performed after moving.

abilities.description: Lullaby of Torment unleashes Ember's signature blend of sonic chaos and ghostly influence upon a single, unfortunate target. Upon activation, Ember strums a searing chord on her guitar, projecting a spectral wave of sound directly at the targeted enemy. This isn't just noise; it's a carefully crafted symphony of suffering. The initial impact deals significant Dark damage, but the real torment begins thereafter. The target becomes 'Enthralled,' suffering a potent debuff that amplifies their vulnerability to subsequent Dark attacks. While Enthralled, the enemy experiences a cascading series of 'phantom echoes' from Ember's song, dealing minor, but persistent Dark damage over a short duration and slightly reducing their movement speed. The effectiveness of the Enthralled debuff is amplified by Ember's Charisma stat, while the damage scales with both her ATK and Special Attack, making it a devastating opening gambit for a coordinated assault. This move can be followed by allies' hard hitting, slower skills.
abilities.flavorQuote: Wanna hear my new hit single? It's a real scream!

abilities.name: Rebellious Refrain
upgrades: Level 140: Increase starting tenacity to 15% and starting evasion to 7%.
Level 190: Increase magic attack per Rebellion stack to 3%.
