(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
mechanics: Ember inherently gains 10% tenacity, reducing the duration of stuns, silences, and other crowd control effects.
Ember gains 5% evasion, giving her a chance to completely avoid incoming attacks.
Whenever Ember applies 'Haunt', she gains 1 stack of 'Rebellion' for 6 seconds. Max 5 stacks. Each stack grants 2% bonus magic attack.
When Ember reaches 5 stacks of Rebellion, she automatically cleanses one random debuff affecting her.
abilities.description: Ember gains 10% tenacity and 5% evasion. Additionally, whenever Ember inflicts 'Haunt', she gains a stack of 'Rebellion' for 6 seconds, up to a maximum of 5 stacks. Each stack of 'Rebellion' grants 2% bonus magic attack. When Ember reaches 5 stacks of Rebellion, Ember cleanses one random debuff on herself.

character_v1.playstyle: Ember's kit focuses on applying DoT and debuffs, supporting her team by weakening enemies and amplifying damage taken. While her burst potential isn't as high as a dedicated mage, her ability to control the battlefield and enhance her allies' damage makes her a valuable utility pick.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Ember excels in compositions that can capitalize on her debuffs and amplify damage. She synergizes well with burst mages and damage dealers who benefit from reduced enemy magic defense. Her 'Haunt' debuffs can be particularly effective against tanky targets, allowing the team to focus them down more quickly. The speed boost at max rebellion can help her kite and reposition in teamfights.
character_v1.tierSummary: Ember McLain, previously at E, suffers from a severely underpowered kit. Her stats are low, and her abilities are ineffective. Lullaby's conditional effectiveness is not worth it. Reduced to F.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Ember's abilities are designed to synergize around applying and maximizing 'Haunt' stacks. 'Phantom Wail' provides initial stacks, 'Fiery Fervor' applies stacks through basic attacks, and 'Remember My Name!' detonates high stacks for increased damage and stun. 'Ghostly Echoes' rewards Ember for maximizing Haunt, while 'Rebellious Refrain' enhances her overall effectiveness.

chapters.summary: Ember and Kitty band together to organize a concert, battling controlling forces and creating a space for ghost expression.

character_v1.playstyle: Sarah Connor excels at providing tactical advantages to her team through strategic buffs and debuffs. Her focus is on manipulating the battlefield and enhancing her allies' capabilities while hindering her enemies.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Sarah Connor is a valuable addition to any team composition, particularly those that benefit from increased survivability and tactical advantages. Her buffs and debuffs can significantly enhance the performance of damage dealers and tanks alike. She synergizes well with characters who can capitalize on debuffed enemies or who require protection to maximize their effectiveness.
character_v1.tierSummary: Sarah Connor, formerly at C+, offers decent utility but lacks clear strength. Her kit is somewhat reliant on setup and lacks immediate impact. Downgraded to C- due to the lack of consistent damage output and a need for more active skills.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Sarah's abilities work synergistically to provide a potent blend of offensive and defensive support. 'Survivalist Instinct' allows her to weaken enemies or enhance her own mobility, setting up for her other abilities. 'Tactical Repositioning' can safeguard her or an ally, while 'Improvised Explosives' provides AoE damage and debuffs. 'Judgment Day Protocol' is a powerful ultimate that empowers her entire team, and her passive ability provides consistent team protection and speed enhancements.

abilities.description: Bubbles focuses her boundless optimism and sugary sweetness into a concentrated aura, enveloping a selected ally in a radiant, shimmering bloom of soap bubbles. This adorable yet surprisingly resilient field acts as a protective barrier, absorbing incoming damage equal to 25% of Bubbles' maximum health, shielding the chosen hero from harm for a duration of 2 turns. As long as the Bubble Bloom persists, it also provides a gentle, constant healing effect, restoring health to the protected ally equal to 2% of Bubbles' maximum health at the start of each of their turns. Should the Bubble Bloom be shattered before its natural expiration, either through absorbing its maximum damage threshold or by other means, a wave of restorative energy bursts outwards, granting the protected ally an immediate burst of 5% Max Health.

abilities.name: Sonic Burst
abilities.description: Bubbles emits a concentrated burst of sonic energy, targeting a single enemy and unleashing a wave of disruption. This sonic attack deals 60% of Bubbles' Magic Attack as damage. The sheer vibratory force also slightly disorients the target, inflicting 'Slowed' reducing their Speed by 5% for 2 turns. There is a 25% chance to apply 'Silence' on the target for 1 turn, preventing them from using any active abilities. An ear-splitting technique designed to debilitate key threats and control the flow of battle.

abilities.name: Animal Empathy (Passive)
abilities.description: Bubbles' innate connection with all living creatures manifests as a constant, gentle healing aura for the team.  At the end of each of Bubbles' turns, all allies are healed for 5% of Bubbles' Max HP.  This passive healing ensures a consistent trickle of regeneration, keeping the team resilient against attrition and supplementing Bubbles' more potent healing abilities.

character_v1.teamSynergy: Bubbles excels in teams that benefit from sustained healing and protection. High damage dealers can be kept alive longer with her shields and regeneration, while vulnerable backline characters appreciate the consistent healing aura. She also pairs well with characters that can capitalize on silenced or slowed enemies.
character_v1.tierSummary: Bubbles' kit is reliant on multiple heals, shields and charms but low stats makes her vulnerable and ineffective. Requires substantial buffs to be viable. KPS reflects her weak uptime and dependence on external support.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Bubbles' kit is designed around maximizing her Max HP to improve both her shielding and healing capabilities. Animal Empathy provides consistent healing, while Aqua Aegis offers reactive protection. Oceanic Benediction is a powerful finisher, synergizing with Animal Empathy to provide sustained healing. Sonic Bloom allows Bubbles to control enemy threats and protect her allies.

chapters.title: Melody of Empathy
chapters.mission: Heal and buff allies in a series of challenging encounters, focusing on timing and strategic use of abilities.
chapters.summary: Bubbles struggles to reach a frightened ally, her usual sonic support falling flat. Seeking advice, she turns to the musically gifted Meloetta, hoping to learn how to connect on a deeper, more resonant level.

chapters.title: The Art of Observation
chapters.mission: Disrupt and debuff enemies, while protecting vulnerable allies with strategic stuns and shields.
chapters.summary: Bubbles feels helpless when her teammates are struck with fear during a series of difficult battles. Debbie Grayson offers a unique perspective, sharing insights into reading emotions and providing comfort, rather than just healing wounds.

abilities.description: Gojo's unparalleled perception allows him to subtly manipulate the battlefield's inherent probability. Hostile projectiles and attacks aimed at Gojo or his closest allies (within 7 meters) have a 25% chance to simply...miss. This isn't dodging or blocking; the attack's trajectory is subtly altered, guided away as if by an invisible hand. Furthermore, Gojo passively analyzes enemy attack patterns. After witnessing 5 distinct enemy abilities, Gojo gains a stack of 'Insight.' Each stack of Insight grants Gojo and affected allies 3% increased critical hit chance against the analyzed enemies, up to a maximum of 15%. This enhanced perception allows Gojo to anticipate and subtly counter the enemy's strategies, making them vulnerable to calculated strikes. This probability manipulation does not affect unavoidable attacks or true AoE spells centered outside of the 7 meter radius.

abilities.description: Gojo's innate Six Eyes grant him unparalleled awareness and control. This passive grants him 20 Tenacity and 15 Evasion, making him significantly more resistant to crowd control effects and increasing his chance to completely avoid incoming attacks. Furthermore, every 15 seconds, Gojo analyzes the battlefield with his Limitless Perception, identifying the enemy with the lowest remaining health percentage as the 'Vulnerable Target'. Gojo's next ability cast within 5 seconds against the Vulnerable Target will deal 15% increased damage. This damage amplification applies only to the first instance of damage from that ability and is calculated before any damage reduction or resistance. If the Vulnerable Target is defeated or becomes untargetable before Gojo's next ability is cast, the identification process will automatically restart after a 3 second delay to find a new Vulnerable Target.

character_v1.playstyle: Gojo's kit heavily emphasizes control through spatial manipulation and damage mitigation, fitting the controller role perfectly. His abilities disrupt enemy formations, protect allies, and set up burst damage opportunities, making him a versatile asset to any team.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Gojo excels in teams that capitalize on crowd control and burst damage. He pairs well with allies who can amplify damage or provide additional crowd control, allowing him to set up devastating combos.
character_v1.tierSummary: Gojo's kit has strong potential with crowd control and scaling, but his survivability is very low. He needs allies to cover his mistakes. Stays in A- because of his lack of self-sufficiency.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Gojo's abilities synergize by using Blue to pull enemies into position, then Red to push them into walls for stuns, followed by Hollow Purple for burst damage. Infinity provides constant damage mitigation, making him a supportive damage dealer.

abilities.name: Chimera Shadow Garden

abilities.description: Megumi's ultimate ability, Chimera Shadow Garden, unleashes a vast domain of shadows. Upon activation, Megumi creates a circular zone of darkness around him with a large radius. Enemies within this zone are afflicted with 'Cursed Weakness' and are slowed by 30%. While inside the domain, Megumi can summon multiple shikigami simultaneously at no additional Cursed Energy cost. This effect lasts for 8 seconds. After the duration ends, the domain collapses, dealing a burst of 150% of Megumi's magic attack damage to all enemies caught within. This devastating ability is Megumi's key to controlling the battlefield and unleashing devastating combos with his shikigami. Chimera Shadow Garden has a very long cooldown, making it crucial to use it at the opportune moment.

character_v1.playstyle: Megumi excels at controlling the battlefield with his diverse shikigami, disrupting enemy formations, and setting up opportunities for his allies.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Megumi's abilities provide excellent utility and control for a team. He can pull enemies into vulnerable positions for his allies to capitalize on, disrupt enemy attacks with Nue, and create safe routes with the Rabbits. Furthermore, his domain expands the range and effectiveness of his allies.
character_v1.tierSummary: Megumi's kit focuses on summons and area denial, but his stats and scaling are extremely low. He struggles to survive in any scenario. KPS reflects his poor uptime and lack of impact.

tips: Prioritize buffing allies and debuffing enemies by having them stand in your shadow to maximize their speed and evasion while you apply stacks of 'Marked' on the enemy with the lowest health.
Use Nue Descent to stun enemies and disrupt their attacks, creating openings for your allies to strike. Don't forget that this also applies 'Electrocuted', increasing Electric damage taken!
Be mindful of positioning to maximize the benefit of Chimera Shadow Garden. Keep allies close to your shadow to buff their speed and evasion, while also increasing your own tenacity and evasion.
strategyData.overview: Megumi Fushiguro is a controller who can buff his allies and debuff enemies with a variety of techniques. His kit revolves around manipulating shadows and summoning shikigami to control the battlefield and protect his allies. He has high potential to swing fights but struggles against enemies that can close the distance and punish him.
strategyData.counterplay: Megumi struggles against mobile heroes that can easily get in his face. Focus fire to take down Mahoraga and prevent him from inflicting too much 'Adapted' on your team. Prioritize enemies that can interrupt or negate his shadow abilities to limit his control over the battlefield.

teamLineups.note: Megumi's 'Nue Descent' stuns, enabling follow-up damage from heroes like Zoro (with Oni Giri's stun upgrade) and Knuckles who both can stun also. Yoda's force push also grants the stun.
teamLineups.label: Stun Chain Enablers

teamLineups.note: Leverages Megumi's signature passive that provides allies increased speed and evasion while standing in his shadow, pairing it with bursty magic damage nukers and a reliable healer.
teamLineups.label: Shadow Buff Support

teamLineups.note: This team focuses on controlling the battlefield with area-of-effect abilities while providing buffs to allies standing in Chimera Shadow Garden. The combination of area control and increased speed/evasion makes it hard for enemies to engage effectively.
teamLineups.label: Chimera Shadow Garden & Area Denial

character_v1.internalSynergy: Megumi's kit revolves around manipulating enemy positions and creating openings. The Toad's pull synergizes well with Nue's knockback to further disrupt enemy formations. The Rabbit escape route creates space and offers allies a safe path. These abilities set up the conditions for Chimera Shadow Garden to be used effectively, allowing Megumi to unleash his full potential.

chapters.title: Shadow's Embrace
chapters.mission: Successfully execute Chimera Shadow Garden while under the pressure of Gojo's intense training, demonstrating full control over his cursed energy.
chapters.summary: Megumi partners with Gojo to refine his control over his shadow techniques and domain expansion.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Megumi must learn to overcome his doubts and embrace his full potential as a sorcerer.

abilities.description: Von Lycaon unleashes a quick series of claw swipes, dealing physical damage to enemies in front of him. The first strike deals 30% of his attack, the second strike deals 40% of his attack, and the final strike deals 50% of his attack. This attack has a very short cooldown, allowing for consistent damage output. Each strike also slightly pushes enemies back, offering a small degree of crowd control.

abilities.name: Howling Impact
abilities.description: Von Lycaon focuses his energy and unleashes a powerful, charged howl, dealing significant physical damage to enemies in a cone-shaped area in front of him. The damage and stun duration of this ability increase based on the charge time, up to a maximum of 3 seconds. At minimum charge, the howl deals 70% of Von Lycaon's attack as damage and does not stun. At maximum charge, the howl deals 150% of Von Lycaon's attack as damage and stuns enemies for 1.5 seconds. Charging can be cancelled early, but the skill will still go on cooldown. A successful hit grants Von Lycaon a 'Focused Fury' buff, increasing his crit rate by 15% for 5 seconds.

abilities.name: Shadowfang Pounce
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Von Lycaon dashes forward a short distance, leaving a trail of shadow energy. If he collides with an enemy during the dash, he deals 90% of his attack as physical damage and applies 'Weakened Defenses', reducing their defense by 10% for 7 seconds. If the dash does not hit an enemy, Von Lycaon receives a small speed boost for 3 seconds. The dash has a limited range but can be used to quickly reposition or engage enemies. The 'Weakened Defenses' effect can stack up to 3 times, maximizing the damage output from Von Lycaon and his allies.

abilities.name: Lycan's Blessing
upgrades: (Bugfix) Lunar Mend effect now properly interacts with overheal mechanics.
(Bugfix) Lunar Aura properly despawns after 5 seconds.
(Bugfix) Roar effect now properly cleanses debuffs.
(Balance Patch) Buff: Barrier health scale increased to 30% of Von Lycaon's max health.
(Balance Patch) Rework: Lunar Mend duration increased to 4 seconds.
abilities.description: Von Lycaon calls upon the ancient pact, briefly transforming to emanate restorative lunar energy for 10 seconds. While blessed by the moon's grace, his presence becomes a beacon of healing, mending allies with each howl and strike. Each basic attack and cast of 'Howling Impact' now applies a 'Lunar Mend' effect, restoring 10% of the target's maximum health over 3 seconds and fortifying them with 15% damage reduction for the same duration. Further, 'Shadowfang Pounce' now leaves behind a lingering lunar aura, healing allies who pass through it for 5% of their maximum health instantly, with a 1 second cooldown between applications. Upon activation, Von Lycaon unleashes a purifying roar, cleansing himself and all nearby allies of debuffs and granting a temporary barrier that absorbs up to 150 (scales with 25% of Von Lycaon's max health) damage for 2 seconds. However, the lunar blessing wanes, and this transformation ends prematurely if Von Lycaon's health plummets below 20%, reverting him to his base form.

character_v1.teamSynergy: Von Lycaon benefits from allies who can provide additional crowd control or damage amplification, allowing him to more easily apply stuns and debuffs or capitalize on the debuffed state with his enhanced damage. He can also act as a damage enabler for other burst damage dealers by consistently debuffing enemies.
character_v1.tierSummary: Von Lycaon relies heavily on melee attacks and transformation, but lacks the defense to survive sustained engagements. Stats are slightly skewed to make up for it but not enough to make him top tier. KPS balances his damage potential and low survivability.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Von Lycaon's kit revolves around applying stuns and debuffs through Howling Impact and Shadowfang Pounce, which directly empowers his Predatory Instinct passive to increase his crit damage. Lunar Rampage amplifies his offensive capabilities and allows for more frequent use of Howling Impact and Shadowfang Pounce to maintain high Hunting Focus stacks.

abilities.description: Maki, channeling her exceptional spatial awareness and proficiency with weaponry, replicates the movements and attack patterns of a master halberd wielder. For a brief duration, Maki's weapon (or her fists, if unarmed) morphs in the player's mind into a phantom halberd, enabling her to unleash a relentless flurry of strikes. Each attack is infused with latent cursed energy, creating afterimages of the 'halberd' that deal physical damage with added cursed energy splash damage in a cone, with each additional attack increasing the range of the cone attack as the halberd becomes more "real" to the user's mind. The final strike in the barrage features a sweeping motion that can knock back opponents, disrupting their formations and providing tactical advantage. This ability's effectiveness scales multiplicatively with Maki's attack power and critical hit chance, rewarding strategic gear choices, while the splash damage scales with her cursed energy stat, granting her extra versatility. The initial hits apply a stacking debuff that reduces enemy armor, and the final swing's knockback distance is further extended if the target is already suffering from a status ailment.

abilities.description: Maki meticulously identifies and exploits the vulnerabilities of her opponents, channeling her innate physical prowess and weapon expertise into devastating strikes. This passive ability grants a chance on basic attacks to inflict 'Pressure Point', a stacking debuff that increases the target's vulnerability to critical hits. Each stack of Pressure Point reduces the target's critical resistance by a percentage based on Maki's Attack stat. At maximum stacks, Pressure Point explodes in a burst of true damage, further weakening the target's defenses and potentially staggering them. This effect is amplified when Maki wields a Cursed Tool, granting bonus stacks and increasing the explosion damage. Furthermore, the ability synergizes with other allies who inflict debuffs, providing additional benefits when targeting enemies already afflicted by ailments. Careful observation and precise execution are key to maximizing this ability's effectiveness, turning Maki into a calculating and relentless force on the battlefield. The more that is known about the target, the easier it is for Maki to find and exploit flaws.
abilities.flavorQuote: Give me any weapon, and I'll show you its breaking point... and yours.

character_v1.playstyle: Maki is designed as a bruiser due to her reliance on physical prowess and weapon mastery. She can deal sustained damage while remaining relatively durable.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Maki synergizes well with teams that provide support and healing. Her high damage output and resilience make her a valuable asset in prolonged fights. Her domain immunity can protect her team against enemy domain expansions.
character_v1.tierSummary: Maki Zenin's kit revolves around physical damage and stat buffs and can take on mages. Her abilities focus on damage, multi-hit and crit. Stats are skewed to favor high HP, but not enough to make her a tank. She needs consistent damage and is very good against mages. KPS reflects her burst damage.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Maki's abilities are interconnected through the cursed tool mechanic. Weapon Proficiency ensures she always has a weapon equipped, while Ruthless Assault benefits from consuming a tool for added damage. Unburdened Soul provides crucial defense against domain expansions, complementing her role as a bruiser.

Ashley also gains 15% damage reduction for the duration of the shield on the target ally.
abilities.flavorQuote: I'll try to be more careful!

abilities.description: Ashley performs a quick dodge, becoming briefly invulnerable for 0.5 seconds and gaining a short burst of movement speed (30% for 1 second). If Ashley successfully dodges an incoming attack during this invulnerability window, she gains a stack of 'Determination', increasing her magic attack and defense by 5% per stack, up to a maximum of 5 stacks. These stacks last for 8 seconds. This ability has a short cooldown, encouraging skillful timing and precise execution. Successfully dodging also slightly reduces the cooldown of her other abilities by 0.5 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Whoa! That was close!

abilities.name: Symbiotic Aid

abilities.description: Whenever an ally affected by Ashley's 'Plaga Shield' falls below 30% health, Ashley instantly heals them for 15% of their maximum health and grants them a 20% increase to their movement speed for 3 seconds. This effect has a 20-second cooldown per ally. Additionally, Ashley gains 10% increased healing effectiveness on allies who have any stacks of 'Plaga Shield' applied to them, amplifying the power of other healing effects they receive. This encourages strategic use of 'Plaga Shield' to maximize healing output.
abilities.flavorQuote: I'll do whatever I can to help!

abilities.name: Desperate Measures
abilities.description: Ashley unleashes a surge of protective energy, granting all allies a powerful 'Plaga Barrier' that absorbs damage equal to 20% of Ashley's maximum health for 8 seconds. During this time, all damage redirected to Ashley through 'Plaga Shield' is reduced by 50%, mitigating the risk to herself. Furthermore, any enemy that attacks an ally protected by 'Plaga Barrier' is briefly stunned for 0.75 seconds. After the 'Plaga Barrier' expires, allies receive a burst heal equal to 10% of the damage absorbed by the barrier. This ability has a long cooldown, emphasizing its use in critical moments.
abilities.flavorQuote: We're going to get through this... together!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Ashley excels in teams that benefit from sustained damage mitigation and strategic crowd control. She synergizes well with damage dealers who can capitalize on stunned enemies and tanks who can benefit from the Plaga Shield's damage redirection.
character_v1.tierSummary: Ashley Graham's kit emphasizes shields and redirection, but her overall impact is limited by poor stats. KPS reflects low uptime and reliance on specific team comps.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Ashley's kit revolves around protecting allies using the Plaga Shield and manipulating enemy positioning to create openings. Her Evasive Maneuvers provide self-peel and further enhance her support capabilities.

Upon activation, if an enemy is within melee range, Leon swiftly grapples his opponent, utilizing a combat knife for a precise strike. This maneuver deals physical damage equal to 100% of Leon's attack stat, forcing the target to pause their current action as they reel from the blow. abilities.description: Leon, ever vigilant, applies his extensive field experience to ensure the survival of himself and his comrades. At the start of each combat encounter, Leon swiftly assesses the condition of his team and prioritizes immediate support. He focuses his attention on either himself or the ally currently enduring the gravest threat, determined by who possesses the lowest current health percentage. Leon administers a potent dose of emergency medical treatment, restoring a significant portion of the target's vitality, specifically healing them for an amount equal to 15% of their maximum health. Furthermore, recognizing the importance of sustained resilience, Leon reinforces the target with a temporary protective barrier, shielding them from imminent danger. This barrier absorbs incoming damage equal to 5% of the target's maximum health, providing a vital buffer for a duration of 3 seconds, increasing their survivability against initial enemy onslaughts and sustained barrages alike. This decisive action allows the team to withstand the initial shock of battle and maintain a strategic advantage.

abilities.description: Leon calls in a favor from a certain arms dealer, procuring a devastating anti-bioweapon launcher. He levels the heavy ordinance, taking aim at the enemy team, before unleashing a single, armor-piercing rocket. Upon impact, the rocket detonates, inflicting massive physical damage equivalent to 200% of Leon's attack stat to all enemies caught in the blast radius. The sheer concussive force of the explosion stuns affected enemies for 1.5 seconds, leaving them vulnerable to follow-up attacks. The use of this ability consumes a single Rocket Launcher, adding an element of resource management to its deployment. If the blast successfully damages at least 3 enemies, Leon's expert handling of the weapon allows for a partial cooldown refund, reducing the ability's remaining cooldown by 50%. Furthermore, if the explosion results in the demise of at least 3 enemies, demonstrating the devastating effectiveness of the weapon, the cooldown is fully refunded, allowing Leon to potentially unleash another barrage shortly after.

character_v1.playstyle: Leon is designed as a versatile agent capable of adapting to different combat situations. His kit encourages switching between ranged firearm attacks and tactical melee maneuvers, allowing him to support his team while dealing significant damage.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Leon provides utility and damage to the team. The vulnerable debuff applied by Handgun Mastery enhances team damage, while his First Aid Spray keeps allies alive. The Rocket Launcher provides AoE burst damage, and his interrupt ensures the team can handle priority targets.
character_v1.tierSummary: Leon Scott Kennedy's kit has some utility and damage, but lacks focus and overall power. Stats do not complement well and relies on external buffs and team play to be effective. KPS balances utility, damage, and lack of synergy.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Leon's abilities synergize well, allowing him to deal consistent damage with Handgun Mastery, interrupt key enemy actions with Knife Counter, and sustain himself and his allies with First Aid Spray. Agent's Tenacity ensures he remains mobile and difficult to lock down, enhancing his survivability and damage output.

abilities.flavorQuote: The entire world will be infected. A new genesis is at hand, and I will be the creator!

abilities.name: Dominant Genes

Additionally, whenever Wesker applies a stack of 'Viral Load', he gains a shield equal to 3% of his maximum HP for 3 seconds. This passive ensures Wesker remains agile and durable while maintaining his control over the battlefield through Viral Load application.
abilities.flavorQuote: Sure, I'm not human anymore, but just look at the power I've gained!

abilities.name: Project Uroboros
abilities.description: Wesker fully embraces the power of Uroboros, transforming briefly. For 10 seconds, Wesker's attack damage is increased by 40%, and his basic attacks apply 2 stacks of Viral Load. He also gains immunity to crowd control effects. Upon activation, all existing stacks of 'Viral Load' on enemies are consumed, dealing magic damage equal to 15% of the enemy's maximum HP per stack consumed. This damage cannot exceed 40% of the enemy's max HP. This Ultimate has a long cooldown of 90 seconds and serves as Wesker's signature burst damage ability.

character_v1.teamSynergy: Wesker pairs well with damage dealers who can capitalize on the increased damage vulnerability from 'Infection'. He also synergizes with crowd control specialists, as he can follow up their lockdown with a burst of Viral Load application and damage.
character_v1.tierSummary: Wesker has high speed and evasion, his kit revolves around debuffs and true damage. He does a lot of damage. character_v1.internalSynergy: Wesker's kit is designed around building and consuming 'Viral Load'. Cobra Strike and Phantom Move apply Viral Load, while Uroboros Infection and Project Uroboros consume it for amplified effects. Dominant Genes provides sustain and utility that supports this cycle.

After a brief, visually telegraphed charge-up animation, he projects a rapidly collapsing field of energy centered on the selected foe. This implosion deals a significant burst of physical damage, calculated primarily from Rex Splode's ATK stat, supplemented by a percentage of his critical damage modifier for that added punch. The implosive nature of the attack also generates a powerful inward force, forcibly pulling nearby enemies towards the epicenter of the blast. abilities.description: Rex Splode channels his internal energy, focusing it into a single, devastating kinetic charge. Upon activation, Rex enters a brief charging state (approximately 0.75 seconds), during which he glows with an intense, unstable aura. The charge can be canceled before completion but refunds a portion of the ability's cooldown based on charge time. Once fully charged, Rex unleashes a focused blast of kinetic energy directly in front of him, dealing significant AOE damage in a 200-unit cone. Enemies caught within the blast radius are subjected to a physics-based effect, scaling with Rex Splode's power—smaller enemies will be knocked back, while larger, more resilient foes will suffer a brief stagger. The detonation creates a visual spectacle: a short-lived but brilliant flash of light and concussive force that leaves behind a temporary distortion in the surrounding air. This ability scales significantly with attack damage and energy attack; critical hits can trigger a chain reaction of smaller explosions, dealing additional damage over time to enemies afflicted with the initial blast. This is Rex's go-to burst option for both PVE and PVP when fighting large numbers of enemies at a shorter range.

abilities.description: Rex Splode is the master of setting up explosive payoffs. Each basic attack he lands has a 10% chance to inflict the 'Volatile' debuff, marking an enemy for destruction. This volatile state lasts for 5 seconds, during which the affected target becomes increasingly unstable. Rex's attacks now have the potential to prime enemies, setting the stage for chain reactions. Imagine the enemy formation, each member teetering on the brink of detonation because of Rex's volatile touch. Rex excels at controlling the battlefield by increasing his team's opportunity to deal massive damage. At higher levels, the Volatile duration increases to 7 seconds, amplifying the chaos that Rex brings to any engagement. In addition, Rex can increase the chance to inflict Volatile with his basic attack, increasing it to 15%. Furthermore, when an enemy marked as Volatile is finally defeated, they detonate in a final burst, dealing physical damage equal to 10% of their maximum health to any enemies within a localized radius. abilities.description: Rex Splode, in a desperate act of self-sacrifice, triggers a catastrophic release of his internal energy. He overloads his molecular structure, converting his entire body into a volatile explosive force. This unleashes a devastating wave of physical damage, obliterating enemies caught within a 10-meter radius. The initial blast inflicts a staggering amount of physical damage scaling exponentially with Rex Splode's level and any accumulated energy boosts. Following this immense burst of power, Rex Splode's physical form collapses, resulting in immediate incapacitation and removal from the battlefield. Any enemies slain by this initial blast are subject to further annihilation. Upon death, these affected foes detonate in a secondary explosion, dealing 50% of the initial damage in a smaller 5-meter radius from their position, ensuring maximum collateral devastation and potentially triggering chain reactions among tightly packed enemy formations.

abilities.description: Rex Splode, always pushing his body to its limits, triggers a surge of power when brought near defeat, turning a desperate situation into a strategic advantage for his team. When Rex Splode's health dips below 30%, his volatile physiology initiates a Critical Mass event. This immediately floods allies within a substantial radius with restorative energy, instantly healing them for 10% of their maximum health, revitalizing their fighting spirit. But the surge doesn't stop there; this energy wave then enhances the resolve of these very same allies, granting them X tenacity for 5 seconds. This temporary boost drastically reduces the duration of incoming stuns, slows, and other debilitating effects, enabling them to withstand enemy assaults with unwavering resilience. As the Critical Mass peaks, Rex Splode himself channels the unleashed power into his own attacks, increasing his attack damage by 20% for the same 5 seconds, turning the tide with explosive counter-offensives. Finally, the ally currently enduring the most grievous wounds receives an additional burst of speed, increasing their movement by 20% for 5 seconds, making a tactical retreat or a swift repositioning a viable option.

abilities.description: Lex Luthor, ever the pragmatist, ensures his survival through meticulous planning. When a Kryptonian foe unleashes an Ultimate ability, Luthor's countermeasures kick in, granting him a significant advantage. character_v1.playstyle: Lex Luthor is a jack-of-all-trades character that uses debuffs, tech, and Kryptonite to control the battlefield and disrupt the enemy team, excelling against Kryptonian enemies while still providing utility in other matchups.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Lex Luthor works well with teams that can apply additional debuffs, increasing his damage output and control capabilities. Teammates who can capitalize on Weakened or Vulnerability to deal burst damage synergize particularly well.

tips: Prioritize applying multiple debuffs to maximize 'Ruthless Efficiency'. 'LexCorp Disruption' and 'Kryptonite Exposure' are your bread and butter for this.
Use 'Brainiac Integration' strategically, saving it for when you can fully capitalize on the magic attack buff and vulnerability stacks.

Be mindful of enemy Kryptonians. 'Kryptonite Contingency' can be a lifesaver, but it's useless against other team comps. If no Kryptonians are present, the damage reduction applies against your highest damage ally instead, which may be useful situationally.
strategyData.overview: Lex Luthor is a debuff-centric jack-of-all-trades who wants to control the battlefield and amplify damage for his team. His kit revolves around weakening enemies and capitalizing on their misfortune. Positioning is key to maximize the impact of his AoE debuffs.
strategyData.counterplay: Focus fire Lex Luthor to prevent him from stacking debuffs. Characters with immunity to debuffs or cleanse abilities can negate his primary strengths. Avoid using Ultimates on Kryptonians as this will activate his signature passive.

teamLineups.note: This lineup focuses on maximizing Lex Luthor's Ruthless Efficiency by applying numerous debuffs to the enemy team, allowing him to deal increased damage while Atom Eve provides shields and control, and Walter White provides healing and further debuffs.

Upon successful hit, Sonic gains 1 Speed Stack, enhancing his mobility and attack prowess. The homing dash has a moderate cooldown of 6 seconds, scaling down to 4 seconds as the ability is upgraded. This ability is the cornerstone of Sonic's hit-and-run tactics, allowing for quick engagement and disengagement while stacking crucial speed buffs. The homing range extends up to 10 units, ensuring reliable target acquisition. The dash speed is equivalent to 1.5x Sonic's current movement speed. If no target is within the 10 unit range, Sonic will instead dash forward a short distance. This distance scales with speed stacks.

abilities.description: Charges up a Spin Dash, channeling energy for up to 2 seconds. While charging, Sonic gains a damage-absorbing shield equal to 10% of his maximum HP, mitigating incoming damage. Upon release, Sonic propels himself forward in a line, dealing physical damage to enemies in his path, dealing between (0.5 * Attack Damage) to (1.5 * Attack Damage), based on the charge time. The base dash range is 7 units. Consuming all Speed Stacks upon release, the dash distance is additively increased by 10% per stack, up to a maximum of 50%. The cooldown for Spin Dash is 8 seconds, providing a strategic window for timing and execution. Enemies hit are knocked back a short distance, creating space for Sonic to reposition or follow up with other abilities. At maximum charge, the Spin Dash can be used to traverse obstacles and small gaps in the terrain, adding a layer of strategic depth to Sonic's movement capabilities.

abilities.description: Sonic's innate agility manifests as passive enhancements tied to Speed Stacks. For each Speed Stack, Sonic gains 5% bonus movement speed and 2% increased attack damage, up to a maximum of 5 stacks. This synergizes with Homing Attack and other abilities, rewarding aggressive play and skillful maneuvering. However, taking damage that reduces Sonic's HP below 50% triggers a burst of energy that clears all Speed Stacks, representing a brief disorientation from the impact. This forces Sonic to re-engage and rebuild his speed advantage, demanding strategic awareness and risk management. The movement speed bonus stacks multiplicatively with other speed buffs, allowing for exponential increases in mobility. The attack damage bonus directly increases Sonic's base attack, amplifying the impact of each strike.

abilities.description: Sonic taps into the latent power of the Chaos Emeralds, transforming into Super Sonic for 8 seconds. During this enhanced state, Sonic becomes invulnerable to all forms of damage and status effects, negating incoming attacks. His movement speed is increased by 50%, granting unmatched agility across the battlefield. Furthermore, his attack damage is amplified by 30%, turning him into a potent offensive force. As Super Sonic, Sonic leaves a dazzling trail of light that slightly obscures vision for enemies in close proximity. Upon reverting to his normal state after the 8-second Overdrive, Sonic experiences a temporary dip in speed, being slowed by 20% for 3 seconds as his body recalibrates from the surge of power. This requires careful strategic timing to maximize the ability's impact while minimizing the vulnerability after the effect subsides. Activating Chaos Emerald Overdrive instantly grants 5 Speed Stacks.

abilities.description: The raw power of the Chaos Emeralds permeates Sonic's being, granting him a permanent increase to his base Speed by 20 and his Evasion by 10%. This constant enhancement to his mobility and survivability allows him to be a constant threat. When Sonic successfully evades an attack while at maximum Speed Stacks, he gains a burst of 30% increased movement speed for 1.5 seconds. This burst of speed enhances his ability to rapidly reposition after dodging, creating opportunities for offensive plays and evasive maneuvers. The Speed bonus from Emerald Power applies additively with the bonuses from Gotta Go Fast!, resulting in an exponential increase in Sonic's ability to traverse the battlefield and outmaneuver opponents. Evasion is calculated before damage mitigation.

character_v1.playstyle: Sonic is designed to be a mobile burst assassin, relying on speed stacks to amplify his damage and maneuverability. He excels at quickly engaging, dealing damage, and disengaging.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Sonic benefits from allies who can provide crowd control or buffs, allowing him to more easily build and maintain Speed Stacks. He pairs well with characters who can apply slows or stuns, creating opportunities for him to land Homing Attacks and Spin Dashes effectively.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Sonic's kit revolves around building Speed Stacks to enhance his mobility and damage output. Homing Attack and Spin Dash are his primary means of both engaging and building stacks, while Gotta Go Fast! provides passive bonuses based on stack count. Super Sonic offers a powerful burst window, and Emerald Power further enhances his baseline speed and evasion.

abilities.description: Doctor Octopus, with a sinister glint in his eye, commands one of his four highly-articulated, weaponized tentacles to lash out with incredible speed and precision. Extending up to 3 units, the targeted tentacle snaps forward, delivering a concentrated burst of kinetic energy to a single enemy. The initial strike inflicts 5 physical damage, escalating by 2.5 additional physical damage for each level Doctor Octopus gains, ensuring the attack remains a threat throughout the match. Skilled observers might notice a subtle whirring and a barely perceptible twitch in the selected tentacle just before the attack, offering a split-second warning before the mechanical limb unleashes its force. This telegraph, though minimal, offers astute opponents an opportunity to evade or mitigate the incoming assault. The raw force of the impact is often enough to stagger weaker foes, disrupting their momentum and setting them up for further manipulation by Doc Ock's other abilities. The attack's reliability and moderate damage make it Otto's go-to method for dealing consistent damage.

abilities.description: Doctor Octopus's mechanical arms provide him with enhanced protection. For every active mechanical arm, Doctor Octopus gains 3 (+1 per level) armor and magic resistance. If all four arms are active, he also gains 5% (+1% per level) damage reduction from all sources, making him a surprisingly resilient foe despite his frail human form. The benefits of this passive are nullified if an arm is disabled or destroyed.

abilities.name: Octo-Grapple
abilities.description: Doctor Octopus launches one of his advanced mechanical appendages towards a targeted area within a 6-unit range. Upon impact, the tentacle rapidly coils into a constricting snare, affecting a 1-unit radius around the impact point. Any unfortunate soul caught within this metallic trap finds themselves instantly ensnared; their feet are rooted to the ground for a duration of 1 second, augmented by an additional 0.25 seconds for each level the ability has been upgraded. As the tentacle tightens, it inflicts an initial jolt of 10 physical damage, a value that increases by 5 for each level the Doctor upgrades this ability. The mechanical limb remains as a coiled menace for a total of 3 seconds, slowing the movement of anyone unlucky enough to wander within its reach. Enemies inside the area are slowed by 20%, which increases by 5% per level, making escape increasingly difficult as the Doctor enhances his technological grip. After unleashing this metallic torment, Doctor Octopus must wait 12 seconds before the complex mechanisms of the tentacle allow for another Octo-Grapple.

abilities.description: Doctor Octopus, with a glint of strategic calculation in his eyes, extends his metallic appendages to exert a precise influence over the battlefield dynamics. Focusing his intellect, he selects a single target, be it an ally in need of repositioning or a foe ripe for disruption, within a reach of 5 units. Upon locking onto the chosen individual, his tentacles unleash a swift and calculated maneuver: either forcefully retracting the target, dragging them a distance of 3 units directly towards Doctor Octopus, or conversely, propelling them an equal distance of 3 units away from his present location, all in accordance with his meticulous tactical evaluation. When an ally becomes the recipient of this mechanical intervention, they are enveloped in a temporary field of energy, a byproduct of the advanced technology interwoven within the tentacles; this protective shield immediately mitigates the first 20 points of incoming damage, augmented by an additional 10 points for each level Doctor Octopus has mastered, and remains active for a duration of 3 seconds, granting a vital safeguard against imminent threats. Should an enemy be the unfortunate recipient of this manipulation, the tentacles deliver a calculated, sharp impact, inflicting an initial blow of 10 physical damage, heightened by an additional 5 points for each of Doctor Octopus's levels, disrupting their current position and potentially interrupting their immediate plans. The mechanical array requires a recalibration period of 15 seconds before it can be deployed once more, ensuring that Doctor Octopus maintains a calculated and relentless control over the ebb and flow of combat.

character_v1.playstyle: Doctor Octopus excels at controlling the battlefield through terrain manipulation and enemy displacement, allowing his team to capitalize on positional advantages.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Doctor Octopus excels in teams that can capitalize on his positional control. Melee carries benefit from enemies being rooted or pulled into their range, while ranged carries appreciate enemies being pushed away from them. His shield can also protect vulnerable allies, making him a valuable asset in protecting backline damage dealers.

tips: Prioritize leveling Reinforced Barrier to increase its duration and health, as it's your most reliable form of control and peel. The defensive buff at level 130 is deceptively strong, don't sleep on it.
Use Arm Sweep to keep enemies at bay and disrupt their positioning. The slow at level 125 significantly enhances its utility.
Total Domination's stun is crucial for setting up plays or interrupting enemy ultimates. Upgrade it to level 150 ASAP to maximize its effectiveness.
strategyData.overview: Doctor Octopus is a controller who specializes in zoning and disrupting enemies. He doesn't excel at damage, so he'll need allies to capitalize on the openings he creates. His kit is clunky and takes a long time to come online, requiring high levels to unlock critical upgrades to function properly.
strategyData.counterplay: Doctor Octopus is vulnerable to burst damage and mobile characters. Focus him down quickly or flank his barrier to bypass his control. Avoid clumping together to minimize the impact of Total Domination.

character_v1.internalSynergy: Doctor Octopus's kit revolves around controlling the battlefield and setting up opportunities for himself and his team. His Metallic Tendril Snare can root enemies in place, allowing him to follow up with Strategic Repositioning to isolate or damage them. Armored Defense provides a consistent defensive buff, making him more resilient in prolonged engagements. Finally, Omnidirectional Assault provides a burst of damage and attack speed, allowing him to capitalize on the positional advantages he creates.

character_v1.playstyle: Shadow is built as a 'Hit and Run' bruiser despite being inherently weak. This means he can quickly engage, deal moderate damage with debuffs, and retreat, but is vulnerable if caught. The upgrade paths focus on increasing his damage output and survivability in short bursts.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Shadow works well with teams that can capitalize on his debuffs, such as 'Chaos Burn' and 'Deep Wound'. He also benefits from allies who can provide crowd control or additional shielding to compensate for his fragility.

tips: Use Chaos Control aggressively to reposition and secure kills: The attack buff and evasion can turn the tide of a fight if timed correctly.
Master HP management to trigger 'Chaos Boost' consistently: Stay below 30% HP to maximize damage output, but be careful not to get bursted down.
Prioritize targets with high healing to make use of the 'Deep Wound' debuff: Shutting down enemy sustain is key to winning prolonged engagements.
strategyData.overview: Shadow is a high-risk, high-reward bruiser that dances on the edge of death to maximize damage output. Be prepared to manage your health aggressively and capitalize on brief windows of opportunity to burst down key targets. You are not tanky and you WILL get blown up if you misposition, so play smart.
strategyData.counterplay: Focus fire Shadow when 'Chaos Boost' is active. Kite and use ranged attacks to punish him. Healing reduction abilities will make him significantly easier to kill.

abilities.description: Rouge unleashes a swift, yet potent melee strike imbued with fiery energy. character_v1.playstyle: Spider-Man excels at disrupting enemy formations and creating opportunities for his team. His web abilities provide crowd control and enhance his survivability, while his agility allows him to engage and disengage fights effectively.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Spider-Man pairs well with damage dealers who can capitalize on his crowd control. Allies who benefit from increased damage vulnerability on targets, such as assassins or burst mages, will synergize effectively with Web Cocoon. Additionally, his ultimate provides a team-wide damage boost, benefiting all damage-oriented allies.

tips: Maximize Perfect Dodge stacks: Skillfully time your dodges to maintain high damage output through the Spider-Sense passive. Avoid wasting stacks on low-priority attacks.
Exploit Web Shot's slow: Use Web Shot to slow down high-priority targets, making them easier to hit with your ultimate and basic attacks.
Coordinate dives with your team: Web Swing into the enemy backline to disrupt and debuff, but make sure your team is ready to follow up on your engage to avoid being isolated and eliminated.
strategyData.overview: Spider-Man is a slippery melee assassin who relies on his high speed, evasion, and debuffs to take down priority targets. He's effective at diving into the backline and disrupting enemies, but his low health and defense make him vulnerable to burst damage and crowd control. Play aggressively and prioritize targets you can quickly eliminate or cripple with your debuffs.
strategyData.counterplay: Focus fire on Spider-Man during his dives, as his low health pool makes him vulnerable. Crowd control abilities will shut down his mobility and prevent him from stacking Perfect Dodge. Avoid grouping up too closely to minimize the impact of his team-wide aura.

character_v1.playstyle: While no preferred role was provided, Blossom's character is best represented as a Controller, focusing on battlefield manipulation, strategic team coordination, and utilizing various elemental powers. Her leadership qualities lend themselves well to this style.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Blossom excels in teams that can capitalize on her buffs and area control. Powerpuff Girls (or similarly designed characters) greatly benefit from her 'Tactical Command', creating devastating coordinated attacks. Characters with strong Fire abilities synergize well with her 'Ice Breath', amplifying their damage. Her aura provides valuable tenacity and evasion, enhancing the survivability of the entire team.

tips: Prioritize maxing Tactical Genius and X-Ray Insight: The aura buffs and debuffs are the most impactful parts of Blossom's kit and will help enable your team's damage.
Use Energy Barrier proactively on divers: The shield can prevent allies from getting bursted down, especially with the level 130 damage buff.
Position carefully for Tactical Genius: Make sure your allies, especially your damage dealers, are positioned behind you for the double aura bonus.
strategyData.overview: Blossom is a magic damage dealer that struggles to find a clear identity. She wants to be a damage carry, but she's bogged down by auras and a single-target nuke. Ultimately, you're playing a supportive DPS with mixed scaling and hoping your team carries you. Play safe, and try to enable your allies more than trying to deal damage yourself.
strategyData.counterplay: Stay out of range of her auras and focus her down, as she has low HP and needs to be in the thick of the fight to be effective. Bait out her Energy Barrier before committing to an engagement, and remember that the shield has a limited duration.

abilities.description: The Terminator locks onto a single enemy target, deploying a specialized projectile calibrated to exploit vulnerabilities. The initial impact delivers a physical blow, inflicting 50 damage plus an additional amount equal to 50% of the Terminator's Attack stat. However, if the target is currently subject to the 'Analyzed' status, the Terminator's targeting system instantly recalibrates the projectile. Instead of physical damage, the attack now deals damage of the Analyzed element type. Furthermore, the Adaptive Payload then delivers a precise debuff to the target, weakening their defenses. For a duration of 3 seconds, the target's resistance to the Analyzed element is reduced by 5%, compounding the effectiveness of subsequent elemental attacks against the same target. The T-800's advanced processors constantly adjust and optimize, ensuring maximum tactical advantage against evolving threats.

abilities.description: The Terminator's advanced cybernetic construction grants him unparalleled resilience. At the start of each encounter, the Terminator gains a stack of 'Reinforced Plating', reducing incoming damage by a percentage that scales with his DEF stat and level. This effect lasts for a duration determined by the Terminator's END stat. When taking damage exceeding 10% of his maximum health in a single hit, one stack of Reinforced Plating is consumed to nullify the damage above the threshold and trigger a short burst of increased movement speed and tenacity (resistance to crowd control effects). Furthermore, upon falling below 25% health, the Terminator enters 'Emergency Protocol', instantly regenerating a percentage of his health based on his LUCK stat and gaining a significant boost to his armor and magic resistance, albeit at the cost of reduced damage output, representing a tactical retreat to self-preservation. This effect has a substantial cooldown. This passive ensures the Terminator can withstand initial bursts of damage and endure prolonged engagements, true to his relentless nature.

abilities.description: Cybernetic Override: Target Acquisition Protocol is a complex suite of automated combat directives, executing a cascading series of calculations to pinpoint optimal tactical solutions under duress. As a passive ability, its impact is interwoven into the Terminator's every action, augmenting both offensive capabilities and situational awareness. Upon activation (triggered by enemy presence within a defined engagement radius), the T-800 initiates a hardware-level diagnostic sweep, prioritizing identified threats based on a multivariate risk assessment. This assessment factors enemy health, attack power, proximity, and elemental affinities, synthesizing this data to highlight the most vulnerable target. For a duration dictated by the Terminator's core processing power, the target is temporarily designated with a 'Priority' status. While a target is Priority, all damage dealt to it from the Terminator gains a substantial multiplicative bonus. Should the initial designated target be defeated, the Target Acquisition Protocol immediately re-calibrates, selecting a new Priority, ensuring a relentless focus on the most critical threat on the battlefield. Furthermore, subsequent damage dealt to Priority targets inflicts a stacking debuff. This debuff not only amplifies incoming damage from the T-800 but also reduces the target's armor and resistance values, thereby compounding the efficiency of his follow-up attacks. If the Terminator suffers Crowd Control, the Override sequence goes into overdrive, automatically breaking the stun while also providing a brief window of invulnerability.

character_v1.playstyle: The Terminator is a relentless assassin focused on single-target elimination. His kit revolves around identifying vulnerable targets, exploiting elemental weaknesses, and sustaining enough damage to complete his mission.
character_v1.teamSynergy: The Terminator benefits from allies who can apply crowd control to keep targets still for Adaptive Ammunition, and those who can amplify elemental damage or exploit the vulnerabilities he exposes.
character_v1.tierSummary: Terminator's kit features niche mechanics. Lacks sustained damage output and is too reliant on 'I'll Be Back' for survivability. Assigned to E tier due to limited impact.

tips: Prioritize maxing Target Scan to maximize the uptime on damage vulnerabilities, even if the numbers have been nerfed.
Focus on building ATK to amplify Targeted Strike's damage output. The more damage you deal, the more you benefit from elemental weakness exploitation.
Learn to recognize elemental weaknesses quickly. Wasting precious seconds after a scan will completely negate the benefit.
strategyData.overview: The Terminator is an assassin that relies on exploiting elemental weaknesses to burst down single targets. He's heavily reliant on his Target Scan ability, making him somewhat predictable. The name of the game is fishing for elemental weaknesses, and landing Targeted Strikes during that small window of opportunity.
strategyData.counterplay: Bait out Target Scan or force Terminator to use it on a low-priority target. Cleanse debuffs to remove the elemental vulnerability if possible. Stack elemental resistance to mitigate the damage amplification from Targeted Strike.

The vibrant blue mist unfurls across the battlefield, blossoming to encompass a considerable area with a 200-unit radius centered on the targeted location. Any adversary unfortunate enough to be caught within this vibrant cloud finds their senses overwhelmed, their cognitive functions disrupted by the chemical compounds in the crystalline structure. The resulting sensory overload impairs their accuracy, inflicting a debilitating Blind, reducing their hit chance by a significant 50% for a duration of 3 agonizing seconds. Prioritize Magic Attack: Walter's heals and damage scale significantly with magic attack, making it your primary stat to focus on.
Use Phosphine Cloud defensively: The blind and slow can disrupt enemy attacks and create space for your team, so use it to peel for your carries or interrupt enemy initiations.
strategyData.overview: Walter White is a support character who wants to stay in the backline, buffing allies and debuffing enemies. His kit requires careful management of the 'Risk' mechanic to maximize his output, but the drawbacks can be severe if mismanaged. Walter's effectiveness hinges on surviving long enough to scale, so prioritize defensive stats and smart positioning.
strategyData.counterplay: Exploit Walter's vulnerability after he consumes 'Risk' stacks. Focus fire on him during this window to punish his increased damage taken. Characters with burst damage and debuff immunity can bypass his defensive tools and quickly eliminate him. High-mobility heroes can also be effective at diving past his Phosphine Cloud to reach him in the backline.

teamLineups.note: This team focuses on buffing a damage dealer with Methylamine, using protection to keep them alive, and controlling the enemy. Maki Zenin benefits greatly from attack speed boosts and can apply strong pressure, while Gojo Satoru's control shuts down threats.

teamLineups.label: Heisenberg's Fortress

character_v1.internalSynergy: Walter's kit revolves around stacking 'Risk' to enhance his abilities, requiring players to carefully balance damage output with survivability. abilities.description: Sokka's tactical brilliance and improvisational skills allow him to anticipate and exploit enemy weaknesses. Sokka gains a passive bonus to his evasion stat, making him harder to hit. Furthermore, whenever Sokka launches an attack, there is a 10% chance that his Boomerang strikes with unerring accuracy, bypassing the enemy's defenses entirely. character_v1.playstyle: Sokka is designed as an assassin, using his boomerang for ranged damage and utility, while his sword and tactical skills allow for close-quarters combat and strategic repositioning. His kit emphasizes burst damage and target elimination.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Sokka synergizes well with damage dealers who can capitalize on debuffed or revealed targets. His evasion and speed boosts can make him difficult to pin down, allowing him to scout ahead and initiate ambushes for his team.
character_v1.tierSummary: Sokka has a mixed kit of attack, healing, and debuffs, but his stats are not high enough to make him effective. His scaling evasion is not reliable. Repositioned to E tier.

tips: Use 'Boomerang Barrage' to apply 'Distracted' to key targets, reducing their defense and making them more vulnerable to follow-up attacks. This is especially effective against high-defense enemies.
Time 'Meteorite Strike' to capitalize on enemies already affected by 'Bleed', as the level 170 upgrade stuns bleeding targets, giving you a window to deal more damage or escape.

Maximize the value of 'Strategic Retreat' by baiting out enemy attacks when your health is low, triggering the evasion and potentially reducing its cooldown. The shield provided at level 180 can further enhance your survivability.

Utilize 'Invasion Plan' strategically, not just for the damage bonus, but also for the vision it provides. Coordinating with your team to focus revealed targets can lead to quick eliminations. The speed and luck buffs from 'Focus' can help you secure kills or escape dangerous situations.
Take advantage of 'Space Sword Expertise' to consistently ignore enemy defenses, stacking attack buffs and healing as you weave in and out of combat.
strategyData.overview: Sokka is a slippery assassin focused on disrupting and eliminating key targets. He excels at hit-and-run tactics, using his high evasion and speed to maneuver around the battlefield. Your goal is to identify vulnerable targets, apply debuffs, and burst them down before retreating to safety. Proper positioning and timing of abilities are crucial for success.
strategyData.counterplay: To counter Sokka, focus on reducing his evasion with abilities or items that negate evasion. Crowd control effects like stuns and roots can prevent him from escaping after he engages. Burst him down quickly to avoid his 'Strategic Retreat' from activating. Be wary of grouping up too closely, as 'Invasion Plan' can reveal the positions of the entire team.

teamLineups.note: Sokka benefits from teammates who can keep him alive while he does damage. Katara provides excellent healing and shielding. E.T. offers additional heals and defensive buffs. Amy Rose is a sturdy tank who can stun enemies. Bugs Bunny provides utility with stealth and taunt.

character_v1.internalSynergy: Sokka's kit revolves around using Boomerang Barrage to debuff targets, Meteorite Strike to inflict bleed and deal burst damage, and Strategic Retreat to reposition. Invasion Plan provides vision and buffs, while Space Sword Expertise enhances evasion and damage output, creating a versatile assassin build.

abilities.description: Whenever an ally scores a critical hit, or applies a crowd control effect to an enemy, Doc Brown gains 10 Flux Energy. Additionally, if Doc Brown successfully evades an enemy attack, he generates 5 Flux Energy. This passive ensures a steady accumulation of Flux Energy, rewarding both offensive support and self-preservation. Doc Brown's base maximum Flux Energy is 100. At maximum Flux Energy, Doc Brown's next basic attack will release a small burst of temporal energy that slows the target enemy by 20% for 2 seconds and grants Doc Brown a shield absorbing 50 damage for 3 seconds. This shield does not stack.
abilities.flavorQuote: Fluxing about is quite an efficient energy source, wouldn't you agree?

abilities.name: Remote Controlled Distraction
abilities.description: Doc Brown deploys a miniature, remote-controlled DeLorean. Upon activation, the DeLorean speeds forward in a straight line, taunting enemies in its path. Enemies taunted by the DeLorean are forced to target and chase it for 3 seconds. The DeLorean has low HP and is easily destroyed, but it serves as an excellent distraction, redirecting enemy focus and creating opportunities for allies to reposition or deal damage. The range of the DeLorean is limited, and Doc Brown must maintain line of sight for it to function effectively. This ability has a cooldown of 15 seconds. If the DeLorean reaches the end of its range, it explodes in a small burst of energy dealing 50 (+20% magic atk) damage.
abilities.flavorQuote: All that power, and still just a distraction!

abilities.name: Chronometric Dash
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~13% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Doc Brown activates a personal chronometric device, granting him a short dash in a chosen direction. Upon successfully completing the dash, Doc Brown gains a brief 2-second burst of increased movement speed (30%) and leaves behind a temporal echo at his original location. If an enemy comes into contact with the temporal echo within 3 seconds, the echo explodes, dealing 75 (+30% magic atk) magic damage and slowing the enemy by 40% for 1.5 seconds. This ability can be used both offensively to set up the echo trap, or defensively to quickly reposition. This ability has a cooldown of 10 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: A quick jaunt through the fourth dimension!

abilities.name: Temporal Anomaly Eruption
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~13% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Doc Brown channels his accumulated Flux Energy to trigger a localized temporal anomaly. Upon activation, Doc Brown targets a large area. After a 2-second delay, a temporal eruption occurs, affecting all units within the target area. Enemies caught in the eruption are displaced randomly a short distance within the area. Allies gain a 30% damage reduction for 5 seconds. Doc Brown must have at least 80 Flux Energy to activate this ability, consuming all accumulated energy upon use. This ability has a long cooldown of 75 seconds. The strategic application of this ability can disrupt enemy formations, protect allies from incoming damage, and create chaotic combat scenarios.
abilities.flavorQuote: Eighty-eight miles per hour?! More like zero to chaos in two seconds!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Doc Brown synergizes well with damage-dealing allies who can capitalize on disrupted enemies or protected allies. Melee characters benefit significantly from the Chronometric Dash trap and Temporal Displacement Grenade.
character_v1.tierSummary: Doc Brown offers disruptive AoE with some scaling and speed control. His low HP and reliance on Flux Energy for scaling make him situational. Stays at C- tier.

tips: Prioritize leveling Lunar Guard, Echo Guard, Overdrive Surge(passive), and Arcane Impulse to 100 ASAP, hoping for useful ability synergies.
Pair Doc Brown with hyper-carries who can benefit from the theoretical taunts, but be aware that he has little to no actual protection to offer until much later levels.
Avoid relying on him as a primary support; consider him a secondary damage dealer who MIGHT offer a slight distraction.
strategyData.overview: Doc Brown is a bizarre support. He's armed with a bunch of single target ATK-scaling moves and some AOE, but strangely, a number of taunts are mixed in there, too. Given the kit is ALL damage-based, you'll need to hit level 100 on multiple skills to cobble together any true supportive utility. His effectiveness hinges entirely on leveraging skill interactions at later levels, as he is mostly useless before then.
strategyData.counterplay: Exploit Doc Brown's vulnerability in early to mid-game. Focus fire on him as he offers little utility to his team, and he folds easily without level 100 skill interactions.

teamLineups.note: Doc Brown's kit seems to revolves around taunting, so having tanks like E.T. to further protect him will allow him to taunt the enemies and deal more damage. Zuko provides additional frontline.
teamLineups.label: Taunt Heavy

teamLineups.note: Katara's slow effects combined with Sarah Conner's atk and speed debuffs will keep enemies locked down. Katara can also heal doc brown. Bugs Bunny provide additional evasion and cc.
teamLineups.label: Speed Control

teamLineups.note: Pair Doc with Alastor, Alastor can provide additional damage to the enemy. Lex Luthor can provide debuff. Astro can provide stealth and speed.
teamLineups.label: Support Surge

teamLineups.note: This comp tries to keep Doc Brown alive with strong sustain. Bubbles and Ashley Graham provide healing and tenacity, while E.T. offers strong shields and healing, allowing Doc to stay in the fight longer.
teamLineups.label: Sustain Focus

character_v1.internalSynergy: Doc Brown's kit focuses on rewarding skillful ability usage and positioning, setting up allies for success while disrupting enemy plans through strategic deployment of temporal effects.

chapters.title: Temporal Tuning
chapters.mission: Use Doc Brown's buffs to amplify damage dealt in a single burst.
chapters.summary: Doc Brown fine-tunes his time-bending gadgets with the help of scientific precision. But even the best calculations need a bit of unpredictability.
chapters.bondRewardHint: Enhance Doc Brown's 'Flux Capacitor Overload' skill.

chapters.title: Ghostly Echoes
chapters.mission: Defeat spectral enemies quickly using heroes with status debuffs.
chapters.summary: Doc Brown enlists Danny Phantom to investigate temporal distortions. Can the ghost hunter’s unique senses detect rifts that defy even Doc's instruments?
chapters.bondRewardHint: Unlock new buffs for Doc Brown when using his '1.21 Gigawatts!' ability.

friendshipCampaign.overview: Doc Brown, ripped from his own timeline, finds himself assisting unlikely allies to repair temporal anomalies threatening to unravel reality. He learns to trust in the unconventional methods and strengths of heroes from different worlds, moving past his initial reliance on precise scientific calculations to embrace the chaos and potential of interdimensional teamwork.

Increases the chance of Doc Brown's 'Temporal Instability' passive activating by 10%.
Doc Brown's 'Mr. Fusion Power' Signature Passive grants an additional 5% luck.
friendshipCampaign.dailyNode: Help Doc Brown recalibrate his time circuits! A short, repeatable battle against chronologically mismatched waves of enemies, rewarding players with fragments used to upgrade Doc Brown's abilities and unlock lore entries about his experiences in this new world.

abilities.description: Subzero Snare is an ability embodying Mr. Freeze's chilling precision. Upon activation, Mr. Freeze projects a narrow cone of supercooled mist towards a designated enemy, requiring deft aiming and positioning for maximum efficacy. The mist itself deals frost damage upon contact, but its primary function is to inflict a 'Brittle' status effect. Targets afflicted by 'Brittle' have their armor reduced and are more susceptible to critical hits from Mr. Freeze and allies. This effect remains for a short duration, demanding coordinated strikes to fully capitalize on the vulnerability. Furthermore, if the target is already affected by a slow or freeze status effect, 'Brittle's' duration is significantly extended, creating a potent synergy with other abilities. Finally, upon successful application of 'Brittle,' Mr. Freeze gains a small amount of ultimate charge, incentivizing strategic application of this insidious snare.

abilities.description: Cryo-Armor Overlay: An ability exemplifying Mr. Freeze's unwavering dedication to survival through the cold. This passive skill manipulates the battlefield by encasing a targeted ally (or himself) in a layer of rapidly forming cryogenic armor. When activated, the target is immediately granted a substantial shield, visualized as a shimmering, intricate lattice of ice crystals that rapidly coats their form. The shield's strength is dynamically affected, scaling multiplicatively with Mr. Freeze's Defense stat, creating an inverse relationship where greater fortitude enhances the protective barrier. Furthermore, the cryogenic matrix passively reduces the target's incoming damage from fire-based attacks, simulating the chilling effect of absolute zero against incendiary forces. As a bonus effect, when the shield breaks, it releases a burst of frigid energy, inflicting a short-duration slow on nearby enemies, ensuring the protection's legacy persists even in its shattered state. This ability has a short cooldown. Note: Mr. Freeze cannot benefit from this effect if suffering from heat-based status effects.
abilities.flavorQuote: Insulation is key to survival.

character_v1.playstyle: Mr. Freeze is designed as a controller, focusing on slowing and freezing enemies to disrupt their movements and create opportunities for his team. His abilities revolve around applying Frost stacks and capitalizing on frozen targets.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Mr. Freeze works well with teams that can either capitalize on his crowd control or help apply additional freezing effects. Allies with high burst damage can take advantage of Frozen targets, while teammates that can further slow or freeze enemies enhance his effectiveness.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Mr. Freeze's kit is designed to synergize around applying and exploiting the Frozen status. Cryo-Blast and Ice Grenade apply Frost stacks, leading to the Frozen state. Absolute Zero is the ultimate ability to quickly freeze multiple enemies, which can then be exploited by Cryogenic Conditioning for increased damage. Sub-Zero Shielding provides sustain during prolonged engagements.

character_v1.playstyle: Jill is designed as a controller, focused on zone control and weakening enemies with viral bombs, disrupting their movements and setup for allies.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Jill works well in teams that can capitalize on her zone control. Characters that benefit from weakened enemies or need time to set up their own attacks will find her invaluable.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Jill's abilities synergize around the use of Viral Poison. V-Poison Mine sets up enemies for Handgun Mastery, while BSAA Training and T-Virus Antibodies provide defensive buffs and utility based on the number of poisoned foes. Evasion Tactics offers a strategic escape and further disruption.

abilities.description: Omni-Man channels the raw power of a Viltrumite, delivering a focused strike against a single enemy. He unleashes a devastating physical blow, dealing damage equal to 100% of his Attack, scaling linearly with his Attack stat. However, the true destructive potential lies in exploiting weakened foes. This supplemental damage is equal to 10% of the target's maximum HP, bypassing all armor and resistances. The 'Fractured' status can be applied by other abilities in Omni-Man's kit or by his allies. The amount of true damage dealt scales with Omni-Man's Attack. This ability has a cooldown of 8 seconds.

abilities.description: Omni-Man launches himself skyward, a red streak ascending beyond the clouds as he pinpoints a location of his choosing on the battlefield. After a brief but terrifying buildup – enough time for the ground below to tremble with anticipation – Omni-Man plummets back to the surface, striking with earth-shattering force that deals X magic damage (scaling with his Magic Attack stat) to all enemies caught within the blast radius. Those unfortunate enough to be at ground zero, within a very close range of the impact, suffer the full brunt of this devastation. However, if enemies are foolish enough to be more than half the map's distance away from Omni-Man when he lands, the force is somewhat diminished, resulting in a 50% reduction in the damage they sustain. Furthermore, any enemies caught within the immediate vicinity of the impact zone are also inflicted with 'Weakened Resolve' for a duration of 5 seconds; this mental status effect causes them to question their allegiances, slowing their movement speed by 30% and reducing their outgoing damage by 15%.

character_v1.playstyle: Omni-Man excels at disrupting the enemy team, weakening them with Fractured debuffs, and finishing them off with powerful attacks. His mobility allows him to control the battlefield and set up opportunities for his team.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Omni-Man synergizes well with teams that can capitalize on his 'Fractured' debuffs, increasing the damage output of damage-focused teammates. His mobility allows him to peel for vulnerable allies or dive into the enemy backline, disrupting their formation.
character_v1.tierSummary: Omniman's kit, with scaling ATK/DEF, strong single-target and AoE damage, is very potent. Pushed to A+ due to his strong passive resilience and high base stats, but requires more fine tuning to compete in SS tier.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Omni-Man's kit revolves around applying 'Fractured' to enemies, increasing their damage taken. He then capitalizes on this debuff with 'Invincible Strike', dealing bonus true damage to heavily 'Fractured' targets. 'Viltrumite Might' rewards aggressive debuffing, while 'Viltrumite Resilience' provides passive survivability and increased Tenacity.
