friendshipCampaign.overview: Omni-Man, a hero of immense power, struggles to reconcile his Viltrumite heritage with his adopted home. This campaign explores his efforts to understand humanity, learning to trust in allies, and accepting that true strength lies not just in power, but in compassion and connection. He starts as a lone wolf, eventually becoming a trusted comrade.

Instead of directly harming opponents, Amy’s attack creates a localized 'Hope Zone' in front of her, affecting a single target within a moderate range. This 'Hope Zone' lasts for 3 seconds. Allies entering this zone receive a burst of cheerful energy, increasing their movement speed by 15% for 2 seconds, allowing them to reposition and engage with renewed vigor. Moreover, the first ally to enter the zone is blessed with a temporary shield of pure affection, absorbing up to 50 points of damage for 2 seconds, protecting them from immediate threats. Additionally, enemies caught within the initial hammer swing are enveloped by the 'Aura of Friendship,' causing their attack speed to decrease by 10% for 2 seconds, subtly hindering their combat effectiveness. This slowdown does not stack, but its duration refreshes with subsequent applications.

abilities.description: Amy's unwavering optimism, stemming from her deep affection for Sonic, radiates outward, uplifting her allies and bolstering their fighting spirit. A constant aura surrounds Amy, granting all allied heroes within a generous radius a 5% increase to both their Attack and Magic Attack. This boost represents the sheer power of belief, pushing allies to fight harder and channel their abilities more effectively. Furthermore, when an ally's health dwindles, falling below the critical threshold of 30%, Amy's protective instincts surge to the forefront. Instantly, she hardens her resolve, granting herself a temporary burst of increased defense and tenacity for a duration of 5 seconds. This surge in defensive capabilities manifests as a 15% increase to her defense, providing a tangible barrier against incoming attacks, and a 10% increase to her tenacity, allowing her to shrug off debuffs and maintain her focus. This protective effect, fueled by concern for her allies, can only occur once every 15 seconds per individual ally, preventing continuous procs and ensuring strategic resource management.

character_v1.teamSynergy: Amy excels on teams that benefit from sustained damage output and crowd control. Her buffs enhance the damage of damage-oriented allies, while her crowd control helps lock down high-priority targets, enabling her damage dealers to focus on eliminating threats. She provides consistent support and defensive capabilities, making her a valuable asset to any team.

tips: Prioritize building HP to maximize the effectiveness of your damage abilities.
Use 'Hammer Time!' proactively to interrupt enemy channels and control key targets.
Position yourself strategically to maximize the number of enemies hit by 'Whirlwind Hammer' and 'Storming Heart'.
Remember that 'Sonic Radar' makes you tankier the more you're targeted, so don't be afraid to get into the fray.
Adapt your playstyle based on the Tarot card you draw at the start of each battle.
strategyData.overview: Amy Rose is a durable damage dealer who excels in the thick of the fight. Her kit revolves around dealing consistent AoE damage based on her max HP, while disrupting enemies with stuns and taunts. She benefits from drawing enemy attention, becoming tankier the more she's focused. Amy's strategic variance via Tarot Reading introduces an element of adaptability to each battle.
strategyData.counterplay: Focus fire to eliminate Amy before she can ramp up her damage and defenses. Avoid clustering together to minimize the impact of her AoE abilities. Crowd control abilities can shut down her 'Whirlwind Hammer' and interrupt her 'Storming Heart' channel. Be wary of her taunt and position accordingly.

teamLineups.note: Amy benefits from a team that provides sustain and can survive some initial burst, letting her stacks of Infatuation build up. ET provides healing and shields, while Katara offers area healing and further shielding. Mark Grayson offers some damage reduction and a small dash, while Alastor weakens the magic resistance of enemies. This lets Amy more easily output damage with her abilities. ET can also provide shields for allies, while Alastor is able to silence enemies and further increase the team's damage.
teamLineups.label: Balanced Sustain

teamLineups.note: Amy's ultimate applies Taunt, but she lacks reliable ways to force enemies to attack her before that. Powdered Toast Man and Daffy Duck both offer additional taunts. Alastor provides magic damage amplification and disables, while Tails the Fox can blind enemies and reduce ability cooldowns.
teamLineups.label: Aggressive Taunt Comp

teamLineups.note: This composition focuses on speed control and debuffs to enhance Amy's survivability and damage output. Doc Brown provides speed and evasion buffs to Amy and other allies, while Dib reveals and slows enemies with stealth. Katara further slows and shields allies, while Harley Quinn can inflict confusion.
teamLineups.label: Speed and Control

character_v1.internalSynergy: Amy's kit revolves around using Protective Spin Dash to mitigate damage, setting up Hammer Vault for positioning, and then unleashing Rose Typhoon to deal sustained damage while crowd controlling enemies. Sonic's Inspiration provides passive support to her team, further enhancing her role as a tank.

abilities.description: Superman focuses his Kryptonian energy, unleashing a concentrated beam of heat vision upon a single target. The beam pierces through a single enemy, inflicting significant thermal damage and searing their flesh. Upon impact, the intense heat has a chance to ignite the target, inflicting a damage-over-time effect that burns the enemy for a short duration, dealing a percentage of the initial hit as additional fire damage each second. As Superman levels up, the potency of Heat Vision Burst increases, both in terms of initial damage output and the duration of the burning effect. abilities.description: Superman calls upon his Kryptonian resilience, creating a protective bulwark around himself and nearby allies. This shield absorbs a percentage of incoming damage, mitigating the impact of enemy attacks. Simultaneously, allies enveloped by the bulwark gain a stack of 'Fortitude', bolstering their defensive capabilities and enhancing their resistance to crowd control. Fortitude stacks increase defense, tenacity, and eventually, knockback immunity, transforming Superman and his team into an unyielding wall against enemy assaults. abilities.description: Superman channels his immense strength into a devastating ground slam, sundering the earth beneath his feet and unleashing a shockwave that pulverizes his foes. Upon activation, Superman braces himself before slamming his fists into the ground, creating a localized earthquake. Enemies within the impact zone are not only dealt physical damage, scaling with Superman's Attack stat, but are also forcefully knocked back, disrupting their formations and creating tactical openings. The force of the slam is so great that it leaves fissures in the earth, creating hazardous terrain that slows enemy movement. This ability is perfect for disrupting enemy assaults, scattering grouped-up foes, or setting up follow-up attacks. Skilled timing and positioning are essential to maximize the effectiveness of Sundered Earth, transforming Superman into a master of battlefield control.

abilities.description: Man of Steel represents Superman's inherent resilience and regenerative capabilities, allowing him to endure and recover from even the most grievous wounds. This passive ability significantly enhances Superman's survivability, granting him several key benefits. Firstly, it provides a constant, passive health regeneration effect, allowing him to slowly recover lost HP over time. The regeneration rate scales with his Max HP stat, making him increasingly difficult to bring down as he levels up. Secondly, whenever Superman's HP dips below a critical threshold, Man of Steel triggers a burst of rapid regeneration, instantly restoring a significant portion of his health. This burst heal provides a crucial lifeline, allowing him to withstand concentrated bursts of damage and stay in the fight. Finally, for a short duration after the burst regeneration, Superman gains temporary immunity to critical hits, further bolstering his defenses and preventing enemies from capitalizing on his vulnerability. This ability transforms Superman into a nearly unstoppable force, capable of weathering the most brutal assaults and emerging victorious.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Hope endures, even when strength is tested."

abilities.description: Superman embodies the very essence of hope, inspiring his allies with his unwavering resolve and bolstering their spirits with a surge of restorative energy. Upon activation, Beacon of Hope emits a radiant aura, bathing the battlefield in a wave of healing power. All allies within range are instantly healed for a significant amount, scaling directly with Superman's Max HP. This immediate influx of health can turn the tide of battle, bringing wounded allies back from the brink and allowing them to continue the fight. Furthermore, Beacon of Hope grants each ally 3 stacks of 'Fortitude', significantly enhancing their defensive capabilities and empowering them to withstand enemy assaults. The healing and defensive buffs provided by Beacon of Hope create a powerful synergy, ensuring that Superman and his team can weather any storm and emerge victorious.

character_v1.playstyle: Superman is built as a tanky support character, focusing on buffing allies' defense and providing shields while mitigating damage. His reliance on 'Hope' buffs and vulnerability to Kryptonite/magic force him to be strategically positioned and supported by teammates.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Superman synergizes well with teams that can benefit from increased defense and damage, and can provide follow-up healing or shielding to maximize the effectiveness of his 'Last Stand of Krypton'. He is vulnerable to enemies that inflict 'Burn', 'Freeze', or 'Dark' effects, so teammates who can provide cleanses or elemental resistance are valuable.
character_v1.tierSummary: Superman has decent defense but lacks offensive power and speed. Demoted to C- as his beacon ability is useful, but not impactful enough.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Superman's kit revolves around building and maintaining 'Hope' stacks on himself and his allies. 'Inspiring Presence' and 'Kryptonian Endurance' provide initial stacks and shields, while 'Beacon of Hope' rewards allies for having high stacks. 'Last Stand of Krypton' serves as a burst heal and shield to protect allies in critical situations. 'Kryptonian Resilience' helps him recover from status effects, turning a negative into a small positive.

abilities.description: Bugs Bunny's innate trickery grants him a 15% chance to completely evade incoming attacks, dodging out of the way with cartoonish agility. Each successful evasion not only avoids the attack entirely but also enrages Bugs, increasing his damage output by 5% for 3 seconds, a state visually represented by steam emanating from his ears and an extra twitch in his whiskers. This damage bonus can stack up to 3 times, reaching a maximum damage amplification of 15%. Moreover, once Bugs reaches this maximum stack of heightened aggression, his already impressive reflexes enable him to cleverly reflect 5% of single-target damage back to the original attacker, turning their own force against them with a mischievous grin. This reflected damage is calculated before any damage reduction on Bugs' part and applies to the attacker before any subsequent damage calculations occur during their attack animation.

character_v1.playstyle: As a jack-of-all-trades, Bugs Bunny's kit provides a mix of utility, disruption, and some supportive elements, allowing him to adapt to various team compositions and situations. He focuses on battlefield manipulation and trickery rather than raw damage.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Bugs Bunny supports damage dealers by providing evasion buffs and taunting enemies away from them, while his carrot patches and disguised ultimate can disrupt enemy formations, allowing allies to capitalize on openings.
character_v1.tierSummary: Bugs Bunny's kit is heavily reliant on evasion and utility. Promoted to C+ due to his Disguise Master ability, but can be countered with focus fire strategies.

tips: Prioritize max HP and Evasion stats: Bugs is designed to survive and annoy, not to deal damage. Build him tanky and evasive to maximize his disruption potential.
Use 'Tunnel Time' aggressively: This isn't just an escape; it's a repositioning tool. Use it to get behind enemies, set up ambushes, or dodge crucial abilities.
Time your taunts: The passive taunt is your bread and butter, so make sure to trigger it at the right time to pull enemies off your damage dealers or to interrupt key enemy abilities.
strategyData.overview: Bugs Bunny is a slippery, disruptive character who excels at drawing enemy attention and surviving unexpected situations. He's not a primary damage dealer, but his ability to taunt, evade, and even disguise himself makes him a tricky opponent to deal with. His effectiveness hinges on smart ability usage and capitalizing on openings.
strategyData.counterplay: Bugs relies on trickery and evasion. Characters with high accuracy, true sight, or the ability to lock down movement will make his life miserable. Burst damage dealers can also overwhelm his defenses before he can properly utilize his evasion or healing.

character_v1.playstyle: Katara's kit focuses on controlling the battlefield with water and ice, supporting allies with heals and debuff removal. Her abilities offer a mix of offensive and defensive options, making her a versatile controller.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Katara works well in teams that benefit from sustained healing and crowd control. Her abilities can protect damage dealers and disrupt enemy formations, making her a valuable asset in both offensive and defensive compositions. She is particularly effective with allies that can capitalize on slowed or weakened enemies.
character_v1.tierSummary: Katara's strong healing, shield, and damage capabilities make her a strong pick. Staying in A as her Ultimate is conditional and requires setup, preventing her from reaching S tier.

tips: Prioritize max HP: The Ice Shield scaling makes it the most impactful stat to boost.
Stay near teammates: Healing Waters is your only source of healing, so position yourself to maximize its effectiveness.
Time Bloodbending carefully: Use it to disrupt key enemy abilities or to enable your team to engage safely.
strategyData.overview: Katara is a support character who struggles to do much of anything on her own. Her primary goal is to keep her allies alive and debuff enemies, but she needs allies who can capitalize on the openings she creates. Without a strong team, Katara will be overwhelmed, as her personal damage is negligible.
strategyData.counterplay: Focus fire Katara to remove her supportive presence from the fight. Anti-heal effects will severely reduce the impact of Healing Waters. Characters that can ignore slows or cleanse debuffs will be less affected by Bloodbending and Water Whip.

teamLineups.note: Katara's Slow from Water Whip sets up Han Solo's Quick Draw Blaster Shot for a crit, and both Katara and Rukia provide Water-based control to enable each other and follow up with damage.

teamLineups.note: Katara's Ice Shield provides a percentage-based shield that scales with her max HP, benefiting from characters that can boost her survivability or synergize with shields. Princess Leia provides another shield, and Orihime Inoue provides shielding and healing.
teamLineups.label: Shield Support

teamLineups.note: Katara's Water Whip slows enemies, which can be chained with further slows from Aang and Bart to lock down targets, allowing the team to focus damage effectively.
teamLineups.label: Slow Control Comp

teamLineups.note: Katara's Ice Shield scales off max HP, and her passive heals based on max HP. This team focuses on building max HP scaling for Katara, while Orihime provides percentage based healing that synergizes with max HP.
teamLineups.label: Max HP Synergy

character_v1.internalSynergy: Katara's skills synergize by providing a mix of support and control. 'Healing Waters' provides consistent sustain, while 'Ice Shield' offers burst protection. 'Water Whip' and 'Bloodbending (Restrained)' control enemy movement and damage output, creating opportunities for allies. 'Southern Resolve' enhances her support capabilities in critical moments.

abilities.description: With an unsettling giggle and manic energy, Niffty unleashes a whirlwind of cleaning supplies, targeting a selected area on the battlefield and creating a 'Sanitized Zone' that lasts for 8 seconds. Enemies unfortunate enough to find themselves within this sparkling maelstrom suffer 20 (+5% of Niffty's Magic Attack) magic damage per second, representing the corrosive power of improperly mixed chemicals and the sting of lemon-scented disinfectant in the eyes. The sudden, unexpected scrubbing also reduces their movement speed by 15%. However, Niffty's chaotic cleaning spree isn't entirely discriminatory; allies who enter the Sanitized Zone receive a burst of healing, restoring 30 (+10% of Niffty's Magic Attack) health instantly, as Niffty's frantic dusting and polishing inadvertently spruces them up. They also benefit from a 10% increase to their attack speed for 4 seconds, energized by the sheer speed and energy of the cleaning process. The size of the Sanitized Zone is initially 200 units in radius, scaling up to a maximum of 400 units based on Niffty's current Magic Attack stat, ensuring larger areas are thoroughly 'sanitized' as Niffty grows in power. Given the considerable 20-second cooldown, precise placement and timing of Cleaning Frenzy are crucial for maximizing its battlefield control potential.

abilities.description: Niffty is most effective when there's a mess to clean. Whenever any hero, friend or foe, unleashes their Ultimate ability within a 700-unit radius of Niffty, she flies into a flurry of activity, gaining one stack of 'Tidying Up'. Each stack of Tidying Up grants Niffty a 3% increase to her outgoing healing and a 5% boost to her movement speed. Niffty can accumulate up to 5 stacks of Tidying Up, reaching a maximum of 15% increased healing and 25% increased movement speed. Because she's easily distracted, these stacks of Tidying Up will only remain for 6 seconds. If she's not near more mess, they will be lost one by one, every 1.5 seconds. Niffty must remain engaged in the thick of battle to maintain her maximum efficiency, making her a whirlwind of supportive power during intense engagements.

character_v1.teamSynergy: Niffty pairs well with aggressive damage dealers who benefit from her healing and protection, such as melee carries and dive assassins. She can also protect vulnerable backline heroes from enemy aggression with Compulsive Cleaning and Clean Sweep, making her a versatile addition to any team composition.

tips: Maximize Mess stacks: Consistently apply Mess with Scrub-a-Dub-Dub to set up enemies for Clean Sweep's stun and bonus damage; if an ally can help apply debuffs, even better.
Prioritize 'bad boy' synergy: Stick close to 'bad boy' allies (if you have one!) to take advantage of Bad Boy Bonus's increased healing and shield effectiveness and amplified damage.
Time Duster Dash strategically: Use Duster Dash to cleanse key debuffs from allies and provide shields, but don't waste it when Mess stacks aren't present to trigger the heal.
strategyData.overview: Niffty is a Water-elemental healer focused on debuffing enemies with Mess and buffing allies with shields and heals. She shines when paired with 'bad boy' allies, further amplifying her healing and shielding capabilities. She punishes enemies who are slow to cleanse.
strategyData.counterplay: Focus fire Niffty to prevent her from consistently applying Mess and healing allies. Cleanse Mess stacks quickly to avoid Clean Sweep's stun. If no bad boy is present, consider her healing and shielding to be mid-tier.

abilities.description: Edelgard calls upon her inner strength and tactical acumen to unleash a devastating melee attack known as Raging Storm. With a swift and purposeful movement, she propels herself toward the nearest enemy within her reach, executing a single, calculated strike with her axe, Aymr. The force of the blow inflicts physical damage equal to 110% of Edelgard's Attack. Edelgard’s extensive combat experience allows her to identify the most vulnerable targets, granting a 2% increased Critical Hit Chance against enemies currently afflicted by any debuff such as poison or slow. Further showcasing her leadership, Edelgard will prioritize targets identified by allied abilities, focusing her attack to maximize team synergy. Drawing strength from her resolve, she gains additional damage equivalent to 1% of her missing Health. These advantages converge to create an opening, guaranteeing a critical hit if her target is at or below 20% health. This ability has a 10 second cooldown.

abilities.description: Edelgard focuses her indomitable will, channeling the Hegemonic Impetus into a devastating single strike. abilities.description: Edelgard, embodying the strength and burden of her imperial authority, invokes the Aegis Imperii, a strike embodying both offense and defense. Unleashing her weapon, she sunders the earth, dealing physical damage to all enemies within a radius centered around her, equivalent to 1.1 times her attack stat. Additionally, Edelgard's strategic mind and personal resolve grant her increased potency when positioned away from her allies, reflecting her calculated approach to leadership and combat. For each turn that Edelgard is at least three units away from any allied unit, the damage inflicted by Aegis Imperii is amplified by 7%, stacking multiplicatively. This bonus caps at a maximum increase of 35%, showcasing the height of her independent power and tactical acumen. As the shockwaves subside, Edelgard hardens her resolve; for three turns she gains bonus armor equal to 15% of her attack power, enhancing her durability and ability to withstand incoming attacks.

abilities.description: Edelgard's relentless ambition manifests as a dark flame, imbuing her strikes with 'Black Eagle's Ire.' Each basic attack and ability applies this debuff, searing foes with dark energy. 'Black Eagle's Ire' deals Dark damage equal to 3% of Edelgard's Attack stat every second for 5 seconds, relentlessly chipping away at their vitality. The debuff stacks additively, up to a maximum of 3 stacks, amplifying the dark fire's intensity with each application. Subsequent attacks refresh the duration of all existing stacks, ensuring constant pressure. Against adversaries hardened by armor or magic resistance exceeding 50, the damage over time escalates, increasing by 1% of Edelgard's Attack per stack. This strategic adaptation makes Edelgard exceptionally effective against resilient, tank-like opponents. The 'Black Eagle's Ire' not only ensures consistent damage output but also grants a unique tactical advantage: each stack also reduces the target's outgoing damage by 2%, stacking up to 6% at max stacks. This subtle yet impactful reduction weakens the foe's offensive capabilities, further solidifying Edelgard's control over the battlefield, emphasizing her role as both a damage dealer and a utility-focused disruptor.

character_v1.playstyle: Edelgard is a damage dealer who thrives when isolated from her team, reflecting her independent personality. Her abilities provide stacking damage bonuses for solo play, encouraging players to aggressively position her away from allies.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Edelgard benefits from team compositions that can provide initial setup, drawing enemy attention while she flanks. Support characters that can provide shields or heals from a distance are also valuable, allowing her to maintain her solo positioning without being easily punished.
character_v1.tierSummary: Edelgard's stat distribution and kit are weak. She is a mishmash of effects. Moving her down to D+.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Edelgard's abilities synergize by rewarding solo play. Imperial Lineage buffs her stats when away from allies, Axe Smash deals bonus damage in the same situation, and Swinging Fury scales with time spent alone. Emperor's Might amplifies this aggressive, isolated playstyle.

abilities.description: Vox Infernalis—a devastating sonic attack channeled through Alastor's unique brand of hellish broadcasting. This ability is a masterclass in psychological warfare disguised as raw power. Upon activation, Alastor unleashes a cacophony of static, distorted radio signals, and echoes of forgotten broadcasts directly into the minds of his enemies. The initial sonic assault deals a potent burst of reality-bending typeless damage to all foes within a moderate radius, scaling with both Alastor's ATK and his accumulated 'Sinister Ambience' stacks. But the true devastation lies in its secondary effects. Each affected enemy suffers a 'Dissonance' debuff, reducing their magical and physical resistance by a significant percentage. Furthermore, the debuff induces a brief period of uncontrollable fear, disrupting enemy formations and preventing them from using targeted abilities. The ability also grants Alastor and his allies a temporary surge of confidence. The 'Radiant Charisma' buff increases outgoing damage and provides a small boost to status resistance. Activating this ability consumes all 'Sinister Ambience' stacks. Use this ability strategically to initiate major engagements, disrupt enemy defenses, and secure a decisive advantage.

abilities.description: Alastor's inherent charm grants him 15 Tenacity, reducing the duration of incoming crowd control effects. However, the Radio Demon's influence extends beyond mere resistance. When an enemy attempts to inflict Alastor with a negative status effect, there's a 20% chance that his demonic resilience will twist the affliction, reflecting it back upon the attacker. The caster then suffers the very fate they intended for Alastor, feeling the sting of their own malice, for the effect's original duration. This reflection occurs before the status effect is applied to Alastor, preventing its direct impact on him. Furthermore, this passive highlights Alastor's opportunistic nature, granting him an edge in tactical engagements.

character_v1.playstyle: Alastor excels at disrupting enemies and controlling the battlefield, while dealing damage through radio waves and shadow manipulation. His skills can be used to interrupt enemy actions, displace them, and make them vulnerable to attacks.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Alastor works well with teams that can capitalize on debuffed enemies and area control. Allies that can deal burst damage to marked targets or take advantage of silenced enemies benefit greatly. He also appreciates teammates that can provide additional crowd control or peel for him, allowing him to stay safe and disrupt the enemy team.
character_v1.tierSummary: Alastor has a mixed support kit that lacks focus. His stats are a bit skewed towards defense but that's his thing. Keeping him at E.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Alastor's kit synergizes around debuffing enemies and controlling their actions. Broadcast Disruption weakens enemies for his damage, while Radio Static and Demonic Deal provides further damage amplification. Always Smiling helps Alastor resist being controlled, allowing him to consistently apply pressure.

Upon detonation at the targeted location, the pellet releases a plume of specially formulated smoke, engulfing a considerable area in a dense cloud. Enemies caught within this shroud are immediately Blinded, their accuracy diminished by 50% for a duration of 3 seconds, severely impacting their ability to effectively engage in combat. But Batman's innovation doesn't stop there: The smoke is laced with minute enhancements designed to bolster the awareness of his allies. Team members bathed in the smoke experience a 10% increase in their evasion, making them nimbler and harder to hit. This duality of impairment and support positions Batman and his squad to seize control of tight battlegrounds, turning disadvantage into overwhelming advantage.

abilities.description: From the shadows, Batman launches his grappling hook, latching onto the furthest visible enemy with pinpoint accuracy. As he hurtles through the air, the momentum builds into a devastating strike. Upon impact with the primary target, Batman delivers a powerful blow, inflicting physical damage equivalent to his full attack power, and stunning them for a crucial 1.5 seconds, disrupting their attack pattern and leaving them vulnerable. The force of the impact doesn't stop there; a shockwave ripples outwards, striking all enemies within a moderate radius. Each enemy caught in this blast suffers physical damage equal to half of Batman's attack power, further hindering their advance and allowing for strategic repositioning of the team. Batman lands prepared, and upon impact, generates a protective shield around himself, absorbing damage equal to 10% of his maximum health. This shield persists for 5 seconds, ensuring he can withstand counter-attacks and maintain his position on the front lines.

abilities.description: Batman, utilizing his unparalleled mastery of gadgets and tactical awareness, initiates 'Batarang Echo' – a signature passive ability that leverages the versatility of his iconic Batarangs. Instead of a direct, singular strike, this ability unleashes a carefully calibrated array of three aerodynamically advanced Batarangs, each possessing unique utility functionalities. The first Batarang, a sonic emitter, unleashes a focused burst of subsonic waves, disorienting the targeted enemy and inflicting a temporary reduction to their accuracy stat. Following this sonic assault, the second Batarang deploys a micro-grapple line, briefly tethering the enemy to a nearby object (or, in the absence of a fixed point, creating a localized gravitational anomaly), imposing a short-duration root effect. Finally, the third Batarang – the core of the 'Echo' – emits a burst of echolocation pulses. This pulse not only reveals hidden enemies within a moderate radius but also amplifies the damage dealt by Batman's allies to the primary targeted enemy by a percentage based on Batman's support stat for a fleeting, but critical, window of opportunity. The 'Batarang Echo' ability's cooldown is subtly extended to account for its multifaceted utility and supportive capabilities, demanding judicious deployment in the ebb and flow of combat encounters. This passive can be triggered every 20 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Every tool has a purpose.

abilities.description: Tails, channeling the unique energy of his twin tails, generates a vibrant, swirling cyclone centered on a targeted allied hero, sustaining it for a duration of 3 seconds. During the channeling period, Tails remains firmly rooted to the spot, his focus absolute and unwavering, which renders him immune to any crowd control effect that would otherwise disrupt his concentration. The chosen ally, enveloped within the protective embrace of the cyclone, benefits from a 25% increase to their movement speed, allowing for swift maneuvers and strategic repositioning. Furthermore, the cyclone provides a comforting and restorative effect, healing the allied hero for 15 health plus an additional amount equal to 40% of Tails's Magic Attack stat, applied every half-second (every 0.5 seconds). As the cyclone subsides, Tails unleashes a final surge of revitalizing energy, bestowing upon the ally a protective shield capable of absorbing 50 damage plus 100% of Tails's Magic Attack stat, which persists for a duration of 5 seconds, providing a durable buffer against incoming threats. If the targeted ally's damage output scales with their movement speed, the final burst of energy will additionally grant them a burst of 50% bonus movement speed for 1 second.

character_v1.teamSynergy: Tails synergizes well with teams that can capitalize on his mobility and crowd control. He can disrupt enemy formations with 'Whirlwind Kick' and 'Cyclone Burst', creating openings for burst damage dealers. He can also provide tactical advantages with the movement speed buff from 'Whirlwind Kick'. His ability to go untargetable makes him resistant to common forms of counter-engage, though he remains vulnerable while casting his Ultimate.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Tails' kit revolves around constant ability usage to maintain his passive 'Adaptive Cunning' stacks, boosting his damage output. 'Whirlwind Kick' provides mobility and a small movement speed buff for allies, allowing for coordinated engages. 'Propeller Flight' is crucial for repositioning and avoiding damage, while 'Cyclone Burst' offers area denial and crowd control, synergizing well with his role as an assassin.

character_v1.playstyle: Katniss is designed as an assassin, focusing on ranged damage and exploiting enemy weaknesses. Her kit encourages tactical positioning and burst damage on priority targets.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Katniss benefits from allies who can provide crowd control or further amplify damage on Marked targets. She can also provide valuable vision for her team, allowing for coordinated attacks and ambushes.
character_v1.tierSummary: Katniss is an effective damage dealer with strong sustain. Her attack and speed stats are higher than average. Downgrading to A- as she is not SS tier. She is very viable.

tips: Prioritize maxing out 'The Mockingjay's Call' ASAP to apply multiple stacks of Vulnerability for maximum damage amplification.

strategyData.overview: Katniss is designed as a single-target burst assassin who punishes enemies with debuffs. She can snowball leads with her ultimate and passive movespeed, but beware her dependence on basic attacks, vulnerability to disruption, and a weak early game.
strategyData.counterplay: Interrupt Katniss' arrow combos with stuns or displacement to prevent her from stacking Vulnerability. Exploit her weak defenses by focusing her down with AOE damage. Anti-heal effects will diminish the impact of Radiant Bind.

abilities.description: Aang conjures his signature air scooter, gathering a swirling vortex of wind around his feet as he launches himself towards the nearest enemy. Upon impact, the air scooter violently dissipates, releasing a concentrated blast of pressurized air capable of staggering even the most stalwart of foes. This initial burst deals significant direct damage, equivalent to a base of 30 Air damage plus 50% of Aang's total Attack. But the beauty of this technique extends beyond mere brute force. The residual winds linger briefly after the impact, forming a small localized area of disruption. Any enemy standing within this area suffers a reduction in their movement speed by 15% for a duration of 3 seconds, hindering their ability to advance or retreat effectively. Furthermore, if the target is afflicted by a 'grounded' status effect, then the Air Scooter Strike deals an additional 20% damage on impact, signifying Aang's mastery in capitalizing on his opponent's vulnerabilities and limitations with the nimble power of the air.

abilities.description: Aang taps into the Avatar State's latent potential, channeling a rapid, transformative burst of elemental energy to reposition himself and debilitate his foes. Activating this ability empowers Aang to briefly become an untargetable conduit of pure elemental force, swiftly dashing forward, leaving behind a wake that reflects his current elemental attunement. When attuned to Air, Aang transforms into a swirling vortex of wind, increasing his evasion chance by 40% for 2 seconds after the dash. While attuned to Water, a cascading wave of icy water emanates from Aang's movement, applying a stacking chilling effect to enemies caught in the wave. Each application reduces enemy movement speed by 10%, stacking up to 3 times, for a maximum slow of 30% for 3 seconds. While attuned to Earth, Aang's dash becomes a localized earthquake, creating a fissure in the ground that deals 50 (+30% Ability Power) physical damage over 2 seconds to enemies standing within the fissure. When attuned to Fire, Aang's dash becomes a blazing inferno, leaving a trail of flames that ignites enemies who cross it, inflicting 30 (+15% Ability Power) fire damage per second for 4 seconds. This ability's cooldown is significantly reduced based on the number of unique elemental stances Aang has shifted into within the past 15 seconds.

abilities.description:
Aang channels the elements to create a swirling vortex of protective energy around himself for 5 seconds. This swirling elemental shell absorbs incoming damage, converting a percentage of it into elemental energy that empowers Aang's subsequent attacks. The shell has a base health equal to 20% of Aang's maximum health, decaying by 5% each second after activation. 

While the shell is active:
- If in Air Stance, the shell grants Aang increased movement speed and evasion chance, allowing him to nimbly dodge attacks while mitigating damage. Each successful dodge further empowers the shell, increasing its damage absorption by a small percentage, stacking up to five times.
- If in Water Stance, the shell applies a chilling aura to nearby enemies, slowing their attack and movement speed. Damage absorbed by the shell converts into additional slow potency, up to a maximum threshold.
- If in Earth Stance, the shell gains significant damage reduction and grants Aang armor and magic resist. Damage absorbed is converted into temporary bonus health for Aang upon the shell's expiration.
- If in Fire Stance, the shell ignites nearby enemies, dealing damage over time. Damage absorbed by the shell explodes outwards upon expiration, dealing additional fire damage in a small radius around Aang, scaling with the amount of damage absorbed.
abilities.flavorQuote: Protecting others is the most important task of an Avatar!

abilities.name: Elemental Harmony
abilities.description:
Aang cycles through the four elements (Air, Water, Earth, Fire) every 8 seconds, granting him a different passive bonus based on his current stance. 
Air Stance: +15% movement speed and evasion.
Water Stance: Regenerates 2% of max HP every second.
Earth Stance: +10% armor and magic resist.
Fire Stance: +10% atk and magic atk. Activating an ability while in Fire Stance leaves a temporary burn DoT effect on Aang himself (stacking, but has diminishing returns). Additionally, all of Aang's other abilities are modified based on his current Elemental Stance. This passive also reduces the cooldown of Aang's other abilities by 1 second.
abilities.flavorQuote: The cycle of the Avatar.

abilities.name: Avatar State Unleashed
abilities.description: Aang enters the Avatar State for 12 seconds, greatly amplifying his abilities. While in the Avatar State, Aang gains 30% increased damage, 20% damage reduction, and cycles through his Elemental Harmony stances every 3 seconds instead of 8. Additionally, all of his active abilities have their cooldowns reduced by 50%. At the end of the Avatar State, Aang is stunned for 1 second as he returns to normal. If used strategically, this ultimate can turn the tide of battle, but improper timing can leave Aang vulnerable. The stun duration can be reduced by increasing Aang's Tenacity stat.
abilities.flavorQuote: The power of all the Avatars!

character_v1.teamSynergy: Aang benefits from allies who can capitalize on his crowd control and mobility. Characters who deal burst damage can synergize well with Aang's Avatar State Unleashed, while tanks can protect him during the brief stun after the ultimate ends. He also provides sustained damage and disruption in team fights, making him a valuable asset to any team composition.
character_v1.tierSummary: Aang's kit is versatile but lacks focus and impact. He has damage and utility, but struggles to excel. Downgrading to C-.

tips: Prioritize leveling Elemental Shift early to maximize the benefits of each stance, adapting your stance to the needs of the current fight.
Use Air Shield proactively to block key enemy abilities or projectiles, especially when anticipating burst damage.
Manage your 'Energy Flux' stacks carefully to apply 'Weakened Spirit' at opportune moments, such as before a large damage window or when facing a particularly tanky target.
Save Avatar State for crucial moments, such as when your team needs a burst of damage or when you need to quickly adapt to a changing situation.
strategyData.overview: Aang is a highly versatile, mobile, and durable character who excels at sustained engagements. His ability to cycle through stances allows him to adapt to various situations, while his defensive tools and debuffs make him a difficult target to take down. He's not a burst damage dealer, but he can wear down opponents over time.
strategyData.counterplay: Aang struggles against heavy burst damage that can quickly break his Air Shield and overcome his healing. Focus fire to quickly eliminate him before he can capitalize on his versatility. Characters with cleanse abilities can mitigate the effects of 'Weakened Spirit'. Crowd control can also interrupt his stance dancing.

The Air Scooter Dash provides mobility and initiation, while the Water Whip Surge offers ranged damage and crowd control. The Earth Wall Rampart provides cover and utility, and the Avatar State Unleashed amplifies his abilities for a powerful burst of damage and survivability. Mastering the stance cycling is key to maximizing Aang's potential.

abilities.description: Mark's Viltrumite physiology grants him inherent resilience. He gains a base Defense boost equal to X plus an additional amount equivalent to 0.5 times his Defense stat. As Mark takes damage and his health dwindles, his resolve hardens, granting him damage reduction. For every 10% of his maximum health he loses, he gains 2% damage reduction, mitigating incoming attacks. This effect stacks linearly, up to a maximum damage reduction of 20%. When pushed to the brink, Mark's inner strength surges. Should he fall below 25% of his maximum health, the adrenaline floods his system, allowing him to break through even the most daunting obstacles. In this desperate state, the usual damage reduction cap is lifted, granting him an additional 1% damage reduction for every 5% of maximum health lost beyond the 75% threshold. This effect allows him to effectively mitigate all but the most devastating of blows, demonstrating his unwavering determination to prevail, even when battered and bruised.

abilities.description: Interstellar Intervention is a reality-bending, team-focused Ultimate ability. Upon activation, Mark briefly channels cosmic energies, drawing upon his Viltrumite heritage to manipulate the very fabric of space around his allies. Instead of directly damaging foes, Mark creates miniature, localized distortions in spacetime near his teammates, visually manifesting as shimmering, ethereal fields. These distortions impart several powerful benefits. First, allies within the area gain a significant boost to their damage resistance, reducing incoming damage by a flat percentage. Second, each ally's next damaging ability within the distortion field is empowered, gaining increased range, critical hit chance, or a unique secondary effect tailored to their specific kit. Finally, as the effect ends, the distortions implode, releasing a burst of concentrated energy that heals allies within the area based on a portion of the damage they mitigated during the ability's duration. The heal is distributed evenly among them, incentivizing team coordination and strategic positioning. This power requires careful timing to be effective, rewarding tactical players who can anticipate enemy attacks and position allies strategically.
abilities.flavorQuote: "I'm not just protecting you, I'm bending reality to help you."

abilities.name: Viltrumite Grit
upgrades: Lv10: Reduces Viltrumite Grit's cooldown by 1.5 seconds.
Lv50: Extends the duration of 'Focused Fury' to 5 seconds.
Lv100: The shield granted by Viltrumite Grit now heals Mark for 2% of his max health per second for the shield's duration.
abilities.description: Viltrumite Grit embodies Mark's innate resilience and ability to capitalize on incoming attacks. When Mark sustains damage exceeding 20% of his maximum health from a single source, he doesn't just absorb the blow; he channels the impact into a tactical advantage. Instead of a simple rebound, this triggers a surge of Viltrumite power. This surge grants him 'Focused Fury' for the next 4 seconds, during which his next basic attack deals 150% bonus damage and applies a 'Weakened' debuff for 3 seconds. The 'Weakened' debuff reduces the target's damage output by 10%. The Grit further enhances his survivability by granting Mark a temporary shield equal to 10% of his maximum health. This shield lasts for 5 seconds, providing a crucial buffer against follow-up attacks. This ability has an internal cooldown of 12 seconds. Mark also gains 15% movement speed for 3 seconds, allowing him to quickly close the distance or escape danger after absorbing a major hit.

character_v1.playstyle: The kit is geared towards a bruiser role, focusing on high mobility, damage mitigation, and escalating damage output in prolonged engagements, aligning well with Mark's character as a resilient and powerful combatant.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Invincible works well in teams that can capitalize on his dive potential and sustained damage. He benefits from allies that provide healing or shielding to mitigate the Scourge Virus's drawback, and those who can apply crowd control to set up his Omni-Punch.
character_v1.internalSynergy: The kit revolves around building 'Momentum' stacks to amplify Omni-Punch damage while Viltrumite Resilience provides sustain. Scourge Virus offers a high-risk, high-reward damage boost, and Unstoppable ensures Mark remains mobile and hard to control, enhancing his bruiser playstyle.

character_v1.franchise: The Legend of Zelda (A link to The Past)
character_v1.playstyle: Zelda is a support mage specializing in defensive maneuvers, ally repositioning, and battlefield control. She uses barriers and teleports to protect her team and disrupt the enemy.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Zelda works well with damage dealers who need protection or repositioning, as well as tanks who can draw aggro while she shields and heals from the back lines.
character_v1.tierSummary: This Zelda kit is overloaded with utility, but her individual contributions are soft. Sacred Shield is a reactive band-aid, unlikely to prevent burst in a meta defined by it. Farore's Wind is a niche repositioning tool that relies too heavily on ally AI; unreliable in clutch moments. Hyrule's Aegis provides team-wide Magic Resist, but its radius restricts positioning options. Light Arrow Barrage has the potential to swing fights, but its delayed area-of-effect and dependence on Magic Attack stat create vulnerability to counter-initiation. Despite a theoretically high skill ceiling, Zelda lacks the agency to consistently influence high-level matches, slotting her as a greedy 'S' Tier support that needs constant babysitting.

tips: Prioritize leveling Nayru's Love early to provide a strong magic shield for your carries, mitigating burst damage.
Use Farore's Wind proactively before engaging in team fights to give your entire team a magic resistance boost.

Save Crystal Prison for high-priority targets like enemy damage dealers or those channeling powerful abilities. Coordinate with your team to capitalize on the increased damage taken by the imprisoned target.
Stay near your team to maximize the benefits of Triforce Resonance, providing consistent magic defense and other bonus stats to your allies.
Pay attention to debuffs on your allies. Triforce Resonance can proc to cleanse them, potentially saving a teammate from a crowd control effect or damage over time.
strategyData.overview: Zelda is a dedicated support champion focused on enhancing her team's survivability against magic damage and providing crucial crowd control. Your goal is to keep your allies alive through magic shields and buffs, while disrupting key enemies with well-timed Crystal Prisons. Positioning is key, as your passive aura provides significant benefits to teammates who stay close.
strategyData.counterplay: Focus fire on Zelda to eliminate her quickly, preventing her from providing continuous support. Bait out Nayru's Love and Farore's Wind before engaging to reduce their effectiveness. Crowd control effects that bypass magic resistance, such as silences or stuns, are particularly effective against Zelda and her team.

character_v1.internalSynergy: Zelda's kit synergizes through protection and repositioning. Nayru's Love provides shields, Farore's Wind allows for quick repositioning and debuff removal, and Telepathic Rescue offers a last-ditch save. Wisdom of the Sages bolsters magic defense, making her team more resilient.

abilities.description: Dib, ever vigilant against the alien menace, deploys a high-tech Containment Pod designed to isolate and neutralize Irken threats (and sometimes just normal people who look suspicious). This device launches towards the targeted enemy champion, encasing them in a shimmering, weasel-powered energy cage for a duration of 3 seconds, rendering them completely stunned and unable to act. The targeted enemy champion cannot move, attack, or use abilities while trapped within the pod. After the 3-second containment period, the pod destabilizes, releasing a burst of contained ecto-weasel energy that deals X magic attack damage to all enemies within a small radius around the initial target. Dib, in his pursuit of paranormal knowledge, has unfortunately run into some trouble with this experimental technology, hence the Pod's somewhat erratic and explosive end.

abilities.description: Fueled by an unwavering belief in the paranormal, Dib's vigilance grants him a 10% chance to evade incoming attacks. This stems from Dib's innate ability to sense anomalies, extending even to enemies attempting to cloak themselves in shadow. Should an enemy try to enter a stealth state within 600 units of Dib, his heightened awareness pierces through the deception, instantly revealing them. The psychic backlash from this intrusion causes them to suffer 50 (+25% Magic Attack) magic damage, disrupting their plans and reinforcing Dib's conviction that he's right all along. This reveal effect only triggers once per enemy every 5 seconds, preventing repeated psychic interference.

character_v1.playstyle: The 'controller' role fits Dib perfectly, as his kit focuses on disrupting enemy strategies, exposing hidden threats, and punishing specific targets, fitting his investigator persona.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Dib works well on teams that can capitalize on revealed and debuffed enemies, offering increased damage output and control. He is particularly strong against stealth-heavy compositions, allowing his team to focus on other threats.
character_v1.tierSummary: Dib's kit is too unfocused and lacks damage, despite the utility. The nerfs to core abilities coupled with base stats keeps him at D-. Overrated kit overall, given his reliance on specific counters.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Dib's abilities work together to reveal stealthed enemies, debuff them, and then deal increased damage to them. Paranormal Knowledge helps Dib survive longer in fights, while Obsessive Vigilance acts as a deterrent to stealthy characters.

abilities.description: Jenny's Multipurpose Lifeform Integrated Processor, or M.L.I.P., grants her superhuman reflexes and processing power. This allows her to maintain a consistently higher base Speed, increasing her movement and attack speed. Furthermore, her lightning-fast calculations give her a base 10% chance to completely evade incoming attacks. This isn't just luck; it's the culmination of millions of calculations per second, predicting enemy movements and executing perfectly timed dodges. Each successful evasion showcases Jenny's superior processing capabilities, allowing her to swiftly analyze and respond to threats, making her a formidable opponent on the battlefield. Jenny's internal systems continuously adapt and improve her reaction times, further enhancing her combat effectiveness.

Initially, their movement speed is decreased by 25%, reflecting the creeping anxiety and unease that clouds their judgment under his gaze. Simultaneously, their defense is subtly compromised, lowered by 15%, a consequence of distractions orchestrated by Gus's meticulous planning. Furthermore, Gus's acute understanding of human psychology grants him a chance, scaling with his Intelligence stat (base 20% + 0.5% per Intelligence), to inflict 'Distrust' for a brief but impactful duration of 2 seconds. This unique status effect significantly reduces damage output against allies by 30%, sowing seeds of doubt and hindering cooperative efforts. Allies, however, find themselves subtly emboldened within this carefully curated environment, increasing their status effect resistance by 10%, fortifying their resolve against external manipulations. This area is not merely a battleground, but a carefully constructed stage where Gus orchestrates the demise of his opposition through insidious influence.

Enemies caught in the crossfire immediately suffer a calculated chemical burn, equivalent to 20% of Gus's magic attack stat. The shock and disruption from this unexpected 'flavor' silences them for a crucial 2.5 seconds, preventing any immediate communication or coordinated response. Fellow members of the team within the area of effect experience a 12% surge in their outgoing damage, symbolizing the strength and benefits derived from being part of the Los Pollos Hermanos enterprise. Moreover, the affected area is designated as 'Controlled Territory' for 4 seconds. abilities.description: Gus Fring, a man of exacting standards, maintains control through calculated risks and precise execution. For a duration of 4 seconds, each afflicted enemy grants Gus a stack of 'Influence,' increasing his damage output by 3%. These stacks, representing Gus's growing dominance, accumulate up to a maximum of 5 stacks. At maximum stacks, Gus's next basic attack against a debuffed enemy within 10 seconds inflicts 'Overcooked,' dealing bonus true damage equal to 10% of the target's current health and removing all Influence stacks. 'Overcooked' can only be applied once every 15 seconds per target, ensuring Gus maintains a measured approach to his dealings, turning vulnerability into brutal leverage.

abilities.description: Flux Capacitor Overload is a uniquely unstable ability that embodies the unpredictable nature of time travel and Marty McFly's often-chaotic interactions with it. When triggered, this passive has a chance to activate a brief, but potent, temporal anomaly around Marty. This anomaly manifests in one of three potential ways, chosen entirely at random and determined by a complex (though invisible to the player) probability matrix. First, it might unleash a burst of chroniton energy, dealing moderate AoE damage and slightly slowing nearby enemies as temporal distortions disrupt their movement. Second, it could create a localized time dilation field, briefly speeding up Marty's attack and movement speed while slowing enemies within its radius, offering a tactical advantage. Finally, it has a smaller chance to trigger a minor temporal shift, briefly displacing Marty to a nearby, random location—potentially escaping danger or disrupting enemy formations. The Flux Capacitor Overload is entirely unpredictable by design, requiring players to adapt to its randomized effects, making it both a high-risk, high-reward ability and a perfect representation of the unexpected consequences that follow Marty's every move.
abilities.flavorQuote: Great Scott! I don't know what's gonna happen!

character_v1.playstyle: Marty McFly is a high-mobility utility character, excelling at disrupting enemies and empowering allies with temporary buffs. His gameplay revolves around strategic positioning and calculated risks, but is balanced to inflict self-damage tied to his time manipulation abilities.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Marty synergizes well with damage dealers who can capitalize on the buffs provided by 'Great Scott!'. He can also provide valuable utility by stunning enemies and disrupting their formations, making him a versatile addition to various team compositions.
character_v1.tierSummary: Marty moves to C because his Time-Hop and Temporal Echo offer utility and escape, while Flux Capacitor provides chaotic effects. Overall, he lacks consistency and is very team reliant.

tips: Use Skateboard Dash aggressively to stun key targets, but be mindful of generating Paradox stacks and making yourself vulnerable.
Temporal Echo is your lifeline. Place it strategically to escape dangerous situations or reposition for better support opportunities. The shield it provides can be crucial for survival.
Coordinate 'Great Scott!' with your team to maximize its impact. Time it for when your team is ready to push or needs a burst of damage and speed. Be aware of the damage you take from using it.
Master Paradox management. Use it to aggressively take down enemies, but remember to use temporal echo to disengage, or Great Scott! to unleash your power before the stacks become dangerous
Utilize 'Nobody Calls Me Chicken!' to avoid critical status effects. The tenacity buff can be vital for maintaining your momentum in fights and the evasion allows you to take risks.
strategyData.overview: Marty McFly is a highly mobile and versatile utility character who excels at buffing allies and disrupting enemies. Managing his Paradox stacks is crucial, as they provide significant damage boosts but also increase his vulnerability. Positioning is key, using his mobility to engage, disengage, and protect teammates.
strategyData.counterplay: Focus Marty McFly to punish his increased vulnerability at high Paradox stacks. Crowd control abilities can shut down his mobility and prevent him from escaping or supporting his team effectively. Time your attacks to interrupt the Temporal Echo teleport.

abilities.description: With a flourish and a manic giggle that sends shivers down spines, The Joker hurls a specially doctored playing card – the 'Ha-Ha Harpoon' – at a chosen adversary. This isn't just a card trick; it's a prelude to pandemonium. The card, edged with a neurotoxin concocted in his own twisted lab, slices through the air to deal physical damage equivalent to 90% of The Joker's Attack stat directly to the single, most deserving target. But the real punchline is the cocktail of insanity that follows. Upon impact, a cloud of noxious gas erupts, subjecting the target to one of his patented psychological torments for a duration of 3.5 seconds. The debuff, selected randomly from his repertoire of madness, may inflict 'Giggles Frenzy', forcing the target into uncontrolled fits of laughter, rendering them unable to cast spells and silencing them completely. Alternatively, 'Fear Gas' might cloud their vision, inflicting Blindness and reducing their accuracy by a hefty 50%, causing them to stumble and flail like a blindfolded clown. And for those especially privileged victims, 'Weakness Venom' could cripple their defenses, reducing their armor by a substantial 35%, leaving them exposed and vulnerable to follow-up attacks. The higher The Joker's Attack soars, the sharper the card's edge and the more potent the venom, ensuring that his twisted jokes always land with maximum impact.

abilities.description: The Joker flourishes a seemingly harmless playing card before launching it with deadly precision. Upon activation, Joker throws a sharpened playing card at the targeted enemy. The card deals physical damage, scaling with ATK, but with a twist: each consecutive use of 'Ace in the Hole' against the same target increases the damage dealt by 10%, representing the growing sense of unease and paranoia induced by The Joker's unpredictable antics. This damage bonus caps at 50%. Furthermore, if the target is affected by a 'Madness' debuff, the card explodes on impact, dealing additional AoE damage around the primary target. Consider this Ace up your sleeve as the perfect means to escalate a battle into utter chaos, favoring long-term strategic plays with explosive and psychological payoffs that will drive your enemy to laugh...or cry.

abilities.description: The Joker cackles maniacally as he pulls out a comically oversized pistol. With a dramatic flourish, he fires a single shot at the targeted enemy. This attack deals significant physical damage, scaling with Joker's attack power. However, the true power of 'Final Joke' lies in its execution mechanic. The damage dealt is increased based on the target's missing health, up to a maximum of 100% bonus damage when the target is below 25% health. This makes it an ideal finisher for weakened enemies. If the target's remaining HP falls below 10% after the attack, Joker triggers a ‘Surprise!’ causing the target to explode in a puff of green smoke. If the ability fails to kill the target, Joker pulls out a Bat-shaped Batarang, throwing it at the target dealing additional damage equal to 10% of the targets max health.

character_v1.playstyle: Joker's kit is designed around unpredictable burst damage and debuffs, fitting the assassin role by disrupting enemy teams and creating opportunities for quick takedowns. His reliance on randomness requires adaptability.
character_v1.teamSynergy: The Joker synergizes well with teams that can capitalize on debuffed enemies or benefit from burst damage. His 'Acid Flower Prank' and 'Bang! Flag Gun' can set up opportunities for damage-focused allies, while 'The Last Laugh' provides significant AoE threat. He struggles against teams with high resistance to debuffs.
character_v1.tierSummary: Joker is firmly at F-. His abilities are too random and lack consistent impact. Low stats and reliance on Chaos severely limit his effectiveness, keeping him bottom tier.

tips: Prioritize targets with low magic defense to maximize the impact of 'Acid Flower Prank' and 'The Last Laugh'.
Use 'Bang! Flag Gun' strategically to disrupt enemy formations and prevent crucial abilities.
Be mindful of your positioning to capitalize on 'The Last Laugh's' AoE damage. Try to target enemies who are clustered together for maximum impact.
strategyData.overview: The Joker is a high-risk, high-reward assassin who thrives on chaos and unpredictability. His kit revolves around applying debuffs and dealing burst damage, especially when enemies are grouped together. You'll want to play aggressively, looking for opportunities to isolate targets and set them up for a devastating 'The Last Laugh'. Master the art of manipulating Chaos Theory to turn the tide of battle in your favor.
strategyData.counterplay: The Joker is vulnerable to hard crowd control and burst damage that can take him down before he can utilize his low HP passives. Silence and stuns can shut down his ability to apply debuffs and set up his ultimate. Spread out to minimize the impact of 'The Last Laugh' and focus fire to eliminate him quickly.

abilities.description: Toasty Trauma: Powdered Toast Man, in a display of raw, unfiltered buttery power, unleashes a seismic slam upon the hapless foe. Visualize, if you will, a cascade of powdered sugar erupting forth as PTM leaps into the very air, his toast-like physique gleaming with an unnatural, yet oddly appealing sheen. Then, with the earth-shattering force of a thousand breakfast pastries, he descends, his clenched fist impacting the ground directly beneath the targeted enemy. The result? abilities.description: Powdered Toast Man, sensing danger or opportunity, unleashes his signature move: diving headfirst 'Into the Toaster'! With a heroic yell, he launches himself towards the designated location with incredible speed and agility. Upon landing, PTM causes a spectacular burst of toasted energy, emanating from his very being. This toasted aura forces all enemies within a 3-meter radius to become utterly fixated on him for 2 full seconds, compelling them to relentlessly target Powdered Toast Man with their basic attacks. As the toasted dust settles, all can finally admire the man who is truly responsible for saving the day. The incredible demands on the toast-based hero require him to wait 12 seconds before he can execute his dive again.

abilities.description: With a hearty "Cling!", Powdered Toast Man commits the ultimate sacrifice, tearing off a substantial hunk of his golden-brown form and launching it like a carbohydrate-fueled missile at the nearest enemy within a range of 15 units. This magnificent, gravity-defying projectile inflicts a respectable amount of physical damage equal to 80% of Powdered Toast Man's total Attack Power, supplemented further by 30% of his robust Defense, a testament to the surprising durability of perfectly toasted cellulose. The sheer audacity of being assaulted by airborne toast carries a palpable 60% chance to inflict the 'Crumbling' debuff upon the unfortunate recipient. This debilitating effect weakens the target's armor by 25% for a duration of 5 glorious seconds, rendering them exceptionally vulnerable to follow-up strikes from allies. Furthermore, the sheer spectacle of this bread-based barrage generates a wave of focused animosity, causing the targeted enemy and any adjacent foes within a 5 unit radius to fixate their attention squarely upon Powdered Toast Man, ensuring that he becomes the central target of their ire for precisely 3 seconds, effectively forcing him to embody the role of a doughy, delicious, and remarkably resilient bread-based bulwark.

abilities.description: Powdered Toast Man, ever the paragon of pastry protection, surveys the arena with a determined gleam in his toasty eyes, deciding that a crumb-sized crisis requires his immediate attention! In a burst of floury fortitude, he propels himself vertically, becoming briefly intangible and impervious to all forms of harm for a period of 2 seconds, ascending to the ethereal realm above the battlefield. From his high-altitude vantage point, he identifies the ally currently staggering under the most grievous wounds (lowest health percentage), then prepares for a gravity-defying descent, plummeting downward with a resounding battle cry of 'Spoon!'. Upon impact, heralded by a triumphant 'DING!', the targeted ally is instantly revitalized, receiving a heal equivalent to 15% of their maximum health, effectively restoring their fighting spirit. Not only that, Powdered Toast Man emanates a golden-brown aura of crispy protection, granting the ally a shield that can absorb damage equal to 10% of *Powdered Toast Man's* maximum health, safeguarding them from further attacks for 4 seconds. As Powdered Toast Man lands, his sheer presence generates a wave of toast-fueled energy, causing a mighty concussive blast that knocks back all enemies within a 3-meter radius, creating space and time for his newly-healed ally to re-engage. This display of toasted heroism requires a 20-second cooldown before Powdered Toast Man is ready to launch into action once more.

abilities.description: Powdered Toast Man, ever vigilant in his fight for processed pastry justice, decides a change of scenery is needed, even if his opponents don't agree! He braces himself, channeling his toasted might for 1.5 seconds; during this brief period of intense concentration, Powdered Toast Man's vulnerability increases, causing him to take 20% increased damage. Upon successfully completing his channel, Powdered Toast Man rends the fabric of reality itself, creating a massive, bread-crumb-lined portal directly in front of him. All enemies caught within a 5 meter wide cone emanating from Powdered Toast Man are irresistibly drawn into this sugary-sweet abyss. These hapless foes are then instantaneously ejected to a random point within a generous 10 meter radius from the portal's original location, giving Powdered Toast Man and his allies a golden opportunity to reposition or press their advantage. Emerging from the portal after a disorienting 0.5 second journey through television static, enemies are struck by a wave of magical energy, suffering magic damage equivalent to 50% of Powdered Toast Man's magic attack. The siren song of the commercial beckons again after a cooldown of 60 seconds.

character_v1.teamSynergy: Powdered Toast Man is a valuable asset to teams that benefit from crowd control and disruption. He can protect squishy allies by taunting enemies and repositioning them, creating space for damage dealers to operate.
character_v1.tierSummary: Powdered Toast Man is moved to E. His Toasty Torpedo and Into the Toaster offer disruption, but damage is severely lacking. Toast-Powered Savior is also a life-saver.

tips: Prioritize max HP and Def: These stats directly enhance the effectiveness of 'Buttocks Boost' and 'Dimension Toast', as well as the healing from 'Vitamin F Fortification'.
Abuse 'Crouton Cannon': Its short cooldown, ability to cast while moving, and Corrosion debuff make it an invaluable tool for weakening enemies and controlling the battlefield.
Time 'Buttocks Boost' carefully: Launching allies at the wrong moment can leave them vulnerable. Use it to peel for them when they are dived, or to provide aggressive repositioning.
strategyData.overview: Powdered Toast Man is a highly disruptive tank, capable of both protecting and repositioning allies while debuffing enemies. This playstyle is all about area denial and maximizing the impact of his 'Crouton Cannon'. Vitamin F Fortification is a trap; don't rely on it. His kit scales decently into the late game, offering significant utility through displacement, debuffs, and shields.
strategyData.counterplay: Focus fire Powdered Toast Man to prevent him from using his abilities effectively. Crowd control effects can shut down his repositioning and shielding, while armor penetration will reduce the effectiveness of his high Defense. Be wary of grouping tightly around him, as this will maximize the impact of 'Crouton Cannon' and 'Raisin Fire'.

abilities.description: Samus primes her Arm Cannon with specialized adaptors, each granting unique defensive capabilities. Cycling between these adaptors allows her to dynamically respond to diverse combat situations. The Charge Beam Adaptor projects a shimmering energy shield that absorbs damage equivalent to 30% of her Defense stat for 3 seconds, providing a robust barrier against incoming attacks. Alternatively, the Ice Beam Adaptor encases her in a frigid aura, reducing all incoming damage by 10%. Furthermore, attackers striking Samus while this aura is active are afflicted with the Freeze status for 1 second, halting their advance. For those relying on arcane arts, the Wave Beam Adaptor reflects 15% of incoming magic damage directly back to the originating caster, turning their own power against them. Finally, should the battlefield erupt in flames, the Plasma Beam Adaptor grants a flat 30% resistance to all Fire damage, turning searing infernos into a mild inconvenience.

abilities.description: Samus compresses her power suit, transforming into the Morph Ball for a duration of 4 seconds, a tactic often used to navigate tight spaces or evade danger. In this compact form, Samus gains a significant burst of speed, increasing her movement speed by 25%, allowing her to rapidly traverse the battlefield and reposition effectively. While in Morph Ball form, Samus can deploy up to three timed Morph Ball Bombs, each detonating after a brief delay to inflict physical damage equal to 60% of her Attack stat to enemies caught in the blast radius. These bombs are excellent for disrupting enemy formations or creating escape routes. Use this ability to swiftly maneuver around enemies, lay down a trail of explosive surprises, and gain a tactical advantage in combat, all while evading incoming attacks with enhanced mobility.

abilities.description: Energy Barrier: Samus channels reserve power from her suit into a temporary, reactive energy shield. Upon activation, the ability instantly grants a shield to Samus. This shield's strength scales linearly with Samus's total HP, with a small quadratic contribution from her DEF stat, symbolizing her ability to adaptively reinforce her armor plating against incoming threats. Furthermore, *any* damage taken while the shield is active is partially converted (approximately 35% by default) into a temporary buff that increases the effectiveness of Samus's *next* healing ability – whether it's a personal regeneration technique or a team-based healing surge from an ally. Note that 'effectiveness' encompasses both the *amount* healed and the *duration* of any regeneration effects. This creates a tactical decision: strategically absorb heavy hits to empower future healing, maximizing both survivability and support potential. Finally, the energy shield itself has a unique interaction with elemental damage: it is inherently resistant to energy attacks (fire, ice, electricity, etc.), reducing their damage by 20%, representing the insulation properties of Samus's Power Suit; however, it is slightly *weaker* against purely physical, non-energy kinetic damage, taking 5% increased damage from such sources. Manage your defense layers to succeed!

abilities.description: Samus taps into the latent Phazon within her Metroid DNA, unleashing a surge of power. For 10 seconds, she becomes infused with Phazon energy, increasing her attack damage by 40% as crackling energy emanates from her suit. During this state, she becomes highly resistant to damage, reducing incoming damage by 30%. However, this immense power comes at a cost. The Phazon strains her body, causing her to lose 4% of her maximum health per second while the overload is active. Upon the duration expiring, or if cancelled early, the Phazon destabilizes rapidly, dealing 120% of her attack damage as an area-of-effect blast to nearby enemies within a 5-meter radius. The resulting shockwave also knocks back enemies a short distance.

character_v1.playstyle: Samus is built as a tank, focusing on damage mitigation through beam types and mobility with Morph Ball. She uses Hypermode as a last resort to absorb damage and retaliate.
character_v1.teamSynergy: Samus works well with teams that need a durable front-liner and benefit from enemy debuffs like Freeze. Her Hypermode can be used to absorb burst damage while the team recovers or sets up.
character_v1.internalSynergy: Beam Switch synergizes with Hypermode by providing defensive options for different situations. Morph Ball enhances survivability. Hunter's Tenacity ensures that Samus can stay in the fight longer.
